column1: Built for both ComStar and the Word of Blake in 3067, the Thug 12E is a redesign of the Thug 11E with the aim of extending it’s accuracy and range. The traditional PPCs have been upgraded to ER PPCs and an improved C3 computer has been added. To make the change to a C3i computer, a double heat sink, one ton of ammunition, and the corresponding CASE were removed.
column2: Thug 12E于3067年为ComStar和布雷克圣言会制造，是Thug 11E的重设计，目标是扩大精度和射程。传统PPC升级为ER PPC，并增加改进型C3计算机。为改用C3i计算机，拆除了一个双重散热器、一吨弹药及相应CASE。

column1: This looted Viper retains its traditional high mobility and energy-resistant armor, but the weapons have been replaced with heavy inner-sphere pulse lasers. Living up to its inner-sphere nickname, this 'Dragonfly' packs a nasty punch at close range.
column2: 这台缴获的 Viper 保留了传统的高机动性和抗能量武器装甲，但武器已换成重型内圈脉冲激光。它不负内圈绰号“蜻蜓”，在近距离能打出凶猛火力。

column1: 'Mechs like these aren't too much of a surprise. You send some big, heavy metal out to the outer reaches of the Sphere for somebody to use to dig a hole, and somebody's gonna end up pissed off enough to slap a ton of rockets on it.
column2: 这种机甲并不令人意外。你把一堆又大又重的金属送到星圈边缘去挖洞，总会有人气到给它装上一吨火箭。

column1: 3 x Gauss Rifles mounted in the 炮塔, which is linked to a 定位 Computer and a C3 Slave. The 车辆's 引擎 is downgraded to a 200 XL Fusion, and its 装甲 reduced by two and half tons. Named for Morgan Hasek-Davion, the DI Morgan was created as fire support 车辆 as a replacement of the aging Schrek PPC carrier in House Steiner's armed forces. The 车辆 was first created after the loss of many of the old Lyran standby during the onslaught of the Jihad. However, due to its expensive equipment, the 车辆 had high price tag and few smaller commands can afford the 车辆. Defiance offered low-interest loans to allow the 车辆 to be more affordable. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 2/3 格 / 60/90 米. 装甲: 重型铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 260 50 左侧 150 50 右侧 150 50 后方 105 50 炮塔 160 50 总计 825 250 怪癖: 高级光学系统

column1: 4 MML Launchers and a Light AC5 in the Centertorso is the Mainstay Weapon of this Mech. It has a Narc Launcher for giving others a Helping Hand, but other than that it does its own Job. Whats more surprising to me is the Reactive Armour and the Endo Composite, both Very Rare and Hard to Install. Theres also a Shield in the Left side, giving it some more Protection from incoming Fire. A Skilled Mechwarrior can do some Real damage with this, if he uses the shield to his Advantage. Sadly theres no Case in this, so if you get hit in the Ammo, the whole Mech is going to Blast off into Space.
column2: 四具 MML 发射器和一门装在中央躯干的轻型 AC/5 是这台机甲的主力武器。它还配有一具 NARC 发射器，可为友军提供支援；除此之外，基本靠自己完成任务。更让我惊讶的是反应装甲和 Endo Composite 复合结构，这两样都非常稀有，而且很难安装。左侧还装有一面盾牌，可进一步抵挡来袭火力。熟练的机甲战士若能善用盾牌，就能造成可观的伤害。可惜它没有 CASE，一旦弹药被击中，整台机甲就会炸飞上天。

column1: 5D 执法者于 3050 年末首次下线，是标准机甲的重大升级，满足了许多机师对更快、防护更好、续航更久的需求。日产 200 引擎被移除，换成玛格纳 250 超轻型引擎，将执法者最高速度提升至 86.4 公里/小时，并腾出更多空间用于其他加装。装甲被剥离，改为星卫 CIV 铁纤维装甲并配 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸，武器配置也作了更改。保留小型激光的同时，自动炮/10 和大型激光换成一门迈德龙 Excel LB-X 自动炮/10（由两吨弹药供弹）和一门烈焰"甜射"ER 大型激光。最后加装一个跳跃推进器，使跳跃距离增加三十米，以跟上执法者新的速度曲线。 Quirk: 改良冷却套-自动炮 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 5D 执行者于 3050 年末首次亮相，是对标准型号的重大改进。设计师重新调整了机体配置，提升了可靠性。它以 250 级引擎取代原有的 200 级引擎，最高速度达到 86.4 公里/小时，并加入额外装甲。民用级 Ferro-Fibrous 装甲和 CASE 可防止弹药殉爆。机体还配备一门小型激光。主武器自动炮/10和大型激光被一门 Excel LB-X 自动炮/10取代，弹药储量也有所增加；一门 ER 中型激光则保留用于自卫。跳跃喷射器使其跳跃距离达到 120 米，进一步提高了执行者的机动性。 特性：散热器冷却（自动炮） 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

Based on a previously rejected redesign of the venerable Cyclops, the Hecatoncheires downsizes the classic cyclops to 65 tons in weight. A Beagle Active probe paired with a C3 unit make up the mech's specialist electronics.  4 Medium Lasers and a pair of SRM-6s with Artemis IV provide a nasty punch at close range, while a Gauss Rifle covers longer ranges.
column2: 赫卡通刻伊尔斯是一款 3050 年代的设计，是自由世界联盟为现代战场打造专用重型侦察机甲的尝试。它以曾遭否决的老牌独眼巨人改型方案为基础，将经典独眼巨人缩减至 65 吨。Beagle 主动探测器与 C3 单元组成了该机甲的专用电子设备。四门中型激光器和一对配备 Artemis IV 的 SRM-6 可在近距离造成猛烈打击，高斯步枪则负责远程交战。

column1: A BattleMech Mace is nothing to take lightly but when you combine one with Triple-Strength Myomer on a 'Mech as fast as the Valkyrie II-HLD, you should pay extra attention. 'Hildr' here has been a terror in the Solaris arenas, leaving many opponents crushed with that mace or slagged with the Snub-Nosed PPC in the left hand.
column2: BattleMech 级别的狼牙棒绝不能轻视；当它与三重强度肌肉束结合，并安装在像 Valkyrie II-HLD 这样快速的机甲上时，更应格外小心。这里的“Hildr”曾在 Solaris 竞技场上令人闻风丧胆：许多对手被狼牙棒砸碎，或被左手的短管 PPC 熔成残渣。

column1: A Canopian noblewoman got bored and commissioned a gladiatorial mech on Solaris VII. That is the whole story. Anya Sokolov wanted something fast, close-range and built around melee, and whoever built this delivered exactly that. The VSP lasers get more accurate the closer you are, the MASC gets you there faster than anyone expects, and then the whip and vibroblade do the rest. She won several tournaments with it. Looking at the loadout, that does not surprise me at all.
column2: 一位卡诺皮亚贵族女士感到无聊，并在索拉里斯七号上委托了一台角斗机甲。这就是整个故事。安雅·索科洛夫想要一些快速、近距离、围绕近战构建的东西，而无论是谁建造了它，都恰好实现了这一点。您离得越近，VSP 激光器就越准确，MASC 比任何人预想的更快地到达目的地，然后鞭子和振动刀片完成剩下的工作。她用它赢得了几场比赛。看看负载，我一点也不感到惊讶。

column1: A Clan Buster upgrade, the Rifleman 5CS was a Comstar refit designed with the aim of extending the Rifleman’s battlefield endurance. Replacing the original 240-rated Fusion Core with a larger 300-rated XL Engine increased the Mechs speed and allowed for the installation of additional armor. DHS replaced the original SHS, reducing the chronic overheating issues that plagued the Rifleman, while the AC/5’s were upgraded to a pair of UAC/5’s with 2 tons of ammo. The pair of Large Lasers remain, but the 2 Medium Lasers were removed to make space for the UAC ammo. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Rifleman 5CS 是一款反氏族改装型，由 ComStar 进行翻新，旨在延长 Rifleman 的战场续航能力。它以更大型的 300 级 XL 引擎取代原有的 240 级聚变核心，提高了机甲速度，并腾出空间加装更多装甲。双倍散热器取代了原有的单倍散热器，缓解了长期困扰 Rifleman 的过热问题；AC/5 则升级为一对 UAC/5，配备 2 吨弹药。原有的一对大型激光得以保留，但两门中型激光被拆除，以容纳 UAC 弹药。 特性：防空瞄准 部署费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: A Clan Diamond Shark variant, the Medusa 5 retains three SRM-6 launchers but upgrades them with Artemis IV fire control systems. The remaining weapons payload is dropped in favor of a pair of newly developed Plasma Cannons, one in each arm.
column2: 这是钻鲨氏族的 Medusa 5 型号。它保留三具 SRM-6 发射器，并为其升级 Artemis IV 火控系统；其余武器载荷被削减，换成两门新开发的等离子炮，左右臂各一门。

column1: A Clan Hell's Horses variant made use of two Large Pulse Lasers in each arm and two ATM 9s with four tons of ammo in the torso. Two ER Micro Lasers to protect the 'Mech's rear arc, while the other equipment was removed to add heat sinks.
column2: 地狱之马氏族的一个变体在两臂各装有两门大型脉冲激光器，躯干内则配备两具 ATM-9 和四吨弹药。两门增程微型激光器用于保护机甲后方，其余设备则被拆除以腾出空间安装散热器。

column1: A Clan Jade Falcon variant that uses Experimental Technology extensively, the Kraken-XR was first spotted at Olivetti Weaponry on Sudeten. Replacing most Weapons with 4 Rotary AC/2 and 2 Streak LRM-10.
column2: 这是 Jade Falcon 氏族大量使用实验技术的变体，Kraken-XR 最初在 Sudeten 的 Olivetti Weaponry 被发现。它以四门旋转式 AC/2 和两具 Streak LRM-10 替换了大部分武器。

A Targeting Computer enhances the mech’s accuracy and Improved Jump Jets increase it’s mobility.

column1: A Costly, but important Refit of the Aging Stalker Chassis. Whoever made this Refit kep the 75tons of Mech, but Upgraded them to Resemble a normal Stalker. After 'donating' a whole Warehouse full of these Old Stalkers, one of the Free Worlds League breakaway State Refitted these things to Combat Capabilities. Gotta give it to them though, this Looks like a Proper Stalker if you just Glance at them. Nothing too Expensive is on these Stalkers Either to be fair, its just having Restored these from Mothballed to Functioning must've been a Huge Money Sink. Wonder who would do something stupid. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是对老旧 Stalker 底盘进行的一次昂贵却重要的翻新。改装者保留了这台 75 吨机甲的吨位，却把它升级成乍看之下像标准 Stalker 的样子。自由世界联盟的一个分离政权在“捐赠”到整整一仓库旧 Stalker 后，将它们翻修到可以投入战斗。不得不说，只要匆匆一瞥，这东西确实像一台正经的 Stalker。公平地说，这批机甲没有装上什么昂贵设备；真正烧钱的是把封存的旧机甲重新修复到能正常运转。真想知道谁会做这种蠢事。 特性：战斗计算机 部署费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: A Custom Mech of a Solahma Mechwarrior of the Steel Vipers, This Scylla is made for Long Range Fighting. While there are Few Weapons, they Pack a Strong Punch with very Long Range to boot. Combined with a Special Cockpit Package built to Deal the Most Damage at Range. this Mech is a Danger to anyone in its Line of Sight. Considering that the Steel Vipers had a Lot of Failures in their Trials, this Mech is a Rare sight, as the Steel Viper Solahmas were still Very Dangerous Foes. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.3 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是 Steel Vipers 钢蛇氏族一名 Solahma 老兵的自定义机甲 Scylla，专为远程作战打造。虽然武器数量不多，却威力强大且射程极远；再加上为最大化远距离伤害而设计的特殊驾驶舱套件，任何进入其视线的目标都将面临威胁。Steel Vipers 在试炼中经历过许多失败，因此这款机甲十分罕见；不过钢蛇氏族的 Solahma 老兵仍是极其危险的敌人。 特性：坚固耐用 部署成本倍率：1.3 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: A Dark Age rebuild of the Mauler, the Mauler 4K is a Kuritan update of the older 3R variant. Designed as a heavy brawler and urban assault unit, the Mauler 4K swaps the LRM-20’s of the 3K for Apollo enhanced MRM-30’s and the LB-10X’s for Snub Nose PPC’s. The XL Engine is removed to lower costs and increase durability, though this has resulted in the loss of 3 tons of armor which is seen as an acceptable trade-off. The C3 Slave is retained, allowing the 4K to transmit data which it’s longer range lance mates can take advantage of. 16 DHS keep the 4K cool while 4 tons of MRM ammo in CASE protected bays give the MRM’s plenty to shoot with. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Mauler 4K 是 Mauler 的黑暗时代重建型号，也是龙蛇联合对较早 3R 型的升级。它被设计为重型近战斗士和城市突击单位，以 Apollo 增强型 MRM-30 取代 3K 型的 LRM-20，并以短管 PPC 取代 LB-10X。为降低成本并提高耐久性，该型号拆除了 XL 引擎；虽然因此损失了 3 吨装甲，但这被认为是可以接受的取舍。它保留了 C3 从属计算机，可以传输数据，供友军远程长枪队利用。16 台双倍散热器可为 4K 散热，CASE 保护舱内的 4 吨 MRM 弹药则确保其弹药充足。 特性：扰人 部署费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: A Gnat actually 设计ed for Solaris Combat, but never made it into the Sands of said Arena, This Gnat was supposed to Outlast the Enemy in every Way. Only Equipped with Low amounts of Weaponry, and the Armour Slowing it down, it might seem like a Slow Opponent. Do not be Overconfident, this Gnat is hard to Pick off.
column2: 这是一台真正为Solaris战斗设计的Gnat，但最终没能登上那座竞技场的沙场。它原本计划在各个方面拖垮敌人。虽然武器数量不多，装甲又拖慢了速度，看起来似乎是个缓慢的对手，但千万别大意：这只Gnat很难被击落。

column1: A Great Turtle that somehow Made its Way from the Sands of Solaris, into the Research Complexes of the Society. While Defense was still a Important Design idea for this Prototype 机甲, the Offensive Capabilities have been Increased by a Generous Amount. Society Equipment coupled with the InnerSphere chassis, has shown interesting Results. The Name is apparently Derived from a Turtle with Great Jaw Strength and Speed, it still Lives on Terra to this Day.
column2: 这是一只不知如何从 Solaris 的沙漠一路来到社会研究设施的巨龟。虽然防御仍是这台原型机甲的重要设计理念，社会设备大幅增强了它的攻击能力。社会设备与内层圈底盘结合后产生了有趣的效果。它的名字显然源自一种拥有强大颚力和速度的海龟，而这种海龟直到今天仍生活在 Terra 上。

column1: A Light Clan OmniMech, the 30 ton Kit Fox was introduced in 2890 by 云蛇氏族. Favouring a mix of fire power and armor over speed, the Kit Fox is powered by a 180 XL Engine and features a mix of Endo Steel and Ferro Fibrous; giving it 16 tons of pod space. The Kit Fox A-EWR is s an emergency refit developed by the Invading Clans to improve the Mechs combat effectiveness. The standard Gauss Rifle is swapped for an LB-10X with a pair of Flamers and a 小型脉冲激光 added to handle enemy infantry.

column1: A Pirate special Grasshopper. How they thought a heavy mech with jumpjets was going to be stealthy is beyond me.
column2: 一台海盗专属 Grasshopper。这台机甲的驾驶舱里藏着好几份卡佩兰死亡突击队训练手册，我觉得他们确信自己是忍者机甲战士，尤其考虑到它的隐形系统。至于他们怎么认为一台带跳跃喷射器的重型机甲能隐形，我就想不通了。

column1: A Solaris VII BattleMech, the Silver Fox uses a large but light engine to provide a lot of speed for low weight. column1: A Waukheon? You just know those Wobbies had a hand in this. The T74 is a 'decapitation' design, built for high-speed high-priority-target raiding behind enemy lines. It's fielding a surprisingly heavy EWAR loadout, including a custom Stealth armor that worked with the transformation mechanism (though rumors abound about the right leg's stealth armor being of poorer quality, to the point of not existing, despite being identical to the left leg's). The weaponry equipped is niche, as to be expected: MML's with Acid ammo, and MG arrays with AP ammo; perfect for melting the armor off of command vehicles behind enemy lines.
column2: Waukheon？你就知道这一定有那些 Wobbies 的手笔。T74 是一款“斩首”设计，用于高速突袭敌后高价值目标。它配备了出人意料的重型电子战套件，包括与变形机构配合的定制隐形装甲（不过传闻右腿的隐形装甲质量很差，甚至根本不存在，尽管它和左腿完全相同）。武器配置很专门：装填酸性弹药的 MML，以及装填穿甲弹的机枪阵列；非常适合剥掉敌后指挥车辆的装甲。

column1: A common Periphery rebuild, this mech is a mix of different weapons systems. A primitive medium laser copied from the original Wasp model provides subpar firepower, backed up by the one shot punch of an RL15. A small calibre rifle makes for a semi effective sniper weapon whilst its ammo lasts. The rest of the mech is almost standard spec, rebuilt by a succession of engineers to specs nearly identical to Inner Sphere counterparts. Surprisingly enough, this rebuild offers somewhat superior capabilities compared to most Inner Sphere models. Produced in any number of Periphery junk yards and back alley chop shops, this mech is incredibly common amongst periphery factions; who field the mech in vast quantities, praising its cheap firepower and easily repaired chassis. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

Quirk: Hyper-Extending Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 3T 是圣战期间 ER PPC 机甲常见的战地改装，也用于应对物资短缺。它以先进型号替换两门 Magna Hellstar 标准 PPC。虽然射程有所缩短，但机甲过载的冷却系统热负荷也因此下降，最终成为工厂配置之一。 特质：超伸展驱动器 部署费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: A common field refit choice for ER PPC–mounting 'Mechs as much as a way to overcome matériel shortages during the Jihad, the 3T swaps two Magna Hellstar standard PPCs for the advanced models. While reducing range, it also reduces the heat load on the 'Mech's overstressed coolant systems, leading to it being offered as a factory configuration. Quirk: 超伸展驱动器 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 圣战期间ER PPC机甲常见的战地改装，3T将两门Magna Hellstar标准PPC换为先进型号；射程降低但减轻热负荷，最终成为工厂配置。 特性：超伸展执行器 部署费用倍率： 1.11 手臂执行器限制： 左下、右下

column1: A common misconception is that this is named after the Crusader 'Mech, but it isn't. The name is taken from on those weird blakeist quotes.
column2: 很多人误以为它是以十字军机甲命名，其实不是。这个名字取自那些古怪的圣言之子格言。

column1: A common misconception is that this is named after the Crusader 'Mech, but it isn't. The name is taken from one those weird blakeist quotes.
column2: 常见的误解是它因 Crusader 机甲而得名，但事实并非如此。它的名称取自某条奇怪的 Blake 教徒格言。

column1: A comparatively new variant that appeared with the Dragoons shortly before the fighting on Outreach, the 4D saves weight through the use of a Light Engine, Endo Steel, and Ferro-Fibrous armor. Like the 4C, this variant adds an Artemis IV FCS to the LRM-5. The D, however, upgrades the lasers to ER Medium Lasers. Due to space constraints, the 4D uses twelve single heat sinks that are sorely taxed. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 4D 是一款较新的型号，在 Outreach 战役前不久随龙骑兵现身。它使用轻型引擎、Endo Steel 和铁磁纤维装甲来减重。与 4C 一样，该型号为 LRM-5 加装 Artemis IV 火控系统；不同的是，4D 将激光升级为增程中型激光。受空间限制，4D 使用 12 具单重散热器，散热负担极重。 特质：改进型传感器 部署费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: A competent long range engagement mech, I guess. Just make sure you don't take any fire. It's quite lightly armored for a Heavy mech, and that internal structure is a deathtrap as soon as the armor is breached.
column2: 我想，这是一个称职的远程交战机甲。只要确保你不会着火即可。对于重型机甲来说，它的装甲相当轻，一旦装甲被破坏，其内部结构就是一个死亡陷阱。

column1: A competent long range engagement mech, I guess. Just make sure you don't take any fire. It's quite lightly armored for a Heavy mech, and that internal 结构 is a deathtrap as soon as the 装甲 is breached.
column2: 一台合格的远程交战机甲吧。只要确保别挨炮。对于重型机甲来说，它的装甲相当薄；而内部结构一旦装甲被击穿，就会变成死亡陷阱。

column1: A complete rebuild of the R25, this new chassis draws inspiration from the RetroTech designs flooding the periphery arm’s markets. Built with a mixture of periphery and advanced tech, the center piece of this mech are the heavy rocket launchers that enable this mech to go toe to toe with foes, many times it’s weight class. It’s relatively high cost and limited production, has so far kept it confined to the more advanced periphery nations.
column2: 这是对R25的一次彻底重建，新底盘的灵感来自席卷边疆市场的复古科技设计。它融合了边疆与先进技术，机体核心是重型火箭发射器，使这台机甲能够与数倍于自身重量级别的敌人正面交锋。较高的成本和有限的产量，至今让它只能在技术更先进的边疆国家服役。

column1: A complete rebuild of the R25, this new chassis draws inspiration from the RetroTech designs flooding the periphery arm’s markets. It’s relatively high cost and limited production, has so far kept it confined to the more advanced periphery nations. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是 R25 的全面重建型新底盘，设计灵感来自充斥边境联盟军火市场的复古科技设计。它融合边境联盟技术与先进科技，核心武器是重型火箭发射器，使其足以正面迎战吨位高出许多的敌人。较高的造价和有限的产量，至今仍使它仅在科技较先进的边境国家服役。 特性：360° 扭转躯干 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: A considerably better variant for the hotter climates compared to the -10K, at the cost of slightly more complicated maintenance.
column2: 与 -10K 相比，这一变体更适合炎热气候，代价是维护稍微复杂一些。

column1: A custom configuration used by a Lyran Commonwealth criminal, this Mauler variant (named Todesbote by the LCAF) replaces the standard weaponry of a Mauler with a single Hypervelocity AC/10 in each arm, while the missile racks were replaced by MML-7s. Each autocannon has two tons of ammo while the twin MML-7s use a single ton of ammunition. All ammunition bays are protected by CASE II, and the Todesbote is protected by twenty-seven tons of Hardened Armor. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这种 Mauler 变种（LCAF 命名为 Todesbote）是天琴联邦罪犯使用的定制配置，它用每只手臂上的一个超高速 AC/10 取代了 Mauler 的标准武器，而导弹架则被 MML-7 取代。每门自动炮有两吨弹药，而两门 MML-7 使用一吨弹药。所有弹药舱均受 CASE II 保护，Todesbote 受二十七吨硬化装甲保护。 怪异：分散注意力 成本乘数：1.18 Arm执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: A custom configuration used by the Blessed Order's revived First Division's Unending Faith III, the Mad Cat BLO carries a ER PPC in each arm supported by Streak SRM-6 rack in each side torso and a ER Small Laser in the center torso.
column2: Mad Cat BLO 是受祝福者教团复兴的第一师团所属 Unending Faith III 使用的定制配置。双臂各装备一门增程 PPC，左右侧躯干各配一具 Streak SRM-6 发射架，中央躯干则安装一门增程小型激光。

column1: A custom configuration used by the Blessed Order's revived First Division's Unending Faith III, the Mad Cat BLO carries a ER PPC in each arm supported by 锁定式SRM-6 rack in each side torso and a ER Small Laser in the center torso.
column2: Blessed Order复兴第一师Unending Faith III使用的定制配置Mad Cat BLO，双臂各装备一门ER PPC，两侧躯干各有一具锁定式SRM-6发射架，中央躯干配备一门ER小型激光。

column1: A custom made adaptation of the JHK-03 ordered by Celina Santos. It replaces the the SRM-6s with an Advanced Tactical Missile System and an LB-X Autocannon/5. It was the first Jade Hawk to become (in)famous in the Inner Sphere.
column2: 这是 Celina Santos 订制的 JHK-03 改装型，以一套先进战术导弹系统和一门 LB-X AC/5 取代两具 SRM-6。它是第一台在内天体声名狼藉的玉隼机甲。

column1: A custom made adaptation of the JHK-03 ordered by Celina Santos. It replaces the the SRM-6s with an 高级战术导弹 System and an LB-X Autocannon/5. It was the first Jade Hawk to become (in)famous in the Inner Sphere.
column2: 这是塞丽娜·桑托斯订购的JHK-03定制改型。它用原有的SRM-6替换为一套高级战术系统和一门LB-X自动火炮/5。这是第一台在内圈声名大噪、也臭名昭著的玉鹰。

column1: A custom redesign of the Falconer for the Rabid Foxes - the special forces division of the Federated Suns, the FLC-12X switches to use a clan acquired Gauss Rifle and a Large Re-engineered Lasers instead of the Heavy PPC. It also mounts a Chameleon Light Polarization Shield. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这是为联邦太阳共和国特种部队 Rabid Foxes 定制重设计的 Falconer。FLC-12X 使用从氏族获得的高斯步枪和一门大型重新设计激光替代重型 PPC，并搭载 Chameleon Light Polarization Shield。 特质：稳定 部署费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: A custom redesign of the Falconer for the Rabid Foxes - the special forces division of the Federated Suns, the FLC-12X switches to use a clan acquired Gauss Rifle and a Large Re-engineered Lasers instead of the Heavy PPC. It also mounts a 变色龙光极化护盾. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 联邦太阳特殊部队Rabid Foxes的定制Falconer，FLC-12X以氏族高斯步枪和大型重构激光替代重型PPC，并安装变色龙轻型偏振护盾。 特性：Stable 部署费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左下、右下

column1: A custom refit created for a member of the SLDF Gunslinger Program, the Cicada CDA-GSR is an unusual refit. Powered by a heavily modified and rebuilt 320 rated XL Engine sourced from a Manta class attack submarine, the CDA-GSR uses a Null Signature system to minimise sensor signatures. Using the freed weight from the XL Engine, SLDF Engineers exchanged the Medium Lasers for Snub-Nosed PPCs. Double Heatsinks and a ton of extra armour round out the design. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是为 SLDF 枪骑兵计划成员打造的 Cicada CDA-GSR 定制改装型。它由一台经过大幅改造和重建、来自 Manta 级攻击潜艇的 320 级 XL 引擎驱动，使用 Null Signature System 尽量降低传感器特征。SLDF 工程师利用 XL 引擎节省的重量，以短管 PPC 替换中型激光。双重散热器和额外一吨装甲完善了设计。 特质：改进型传感器 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: A custom refit of Skobels MKII Vulture, installing Skinwalker's Interface Cockpit, experimental non-modular targeting computer and a rare Tracker Mk2 sensors to create an extremely effective long range sniper.
column2: 这是对 Skobel MKII Vulture 的定制改装，安装了 Skinwalker 的接口式驾驶舱、实验型非模块化瞄准计算机和稀有的 Tracker Mk2 传感器，打造出极其有效的远程狙击机甲。

column1: A custom refit of Skobels MKII Vulture, installing Skinwalker's 接口驾驶舱, experimental non-modular targeting computer and a rare Tracker Mk2 sensors to create an extremely effective long range sniper.
column2: 这是对Skobels MKII Vulture的定制改装，安装Skinwalker接口驾驶舱、实验型非模块化瞄准计算机和罕见的Tracker Mk2传感器，打造出一台极其高效的远程狙击机甲。

column1: A custom refit of the standard Whitworth WTH-1S, the WTH-GSR is built for the elite pilots of the SLDF Gunslinger program. Powered by a larger 200 rated XL Engine sourced from a Mongoose 66b and equipped with DHS, the WTH-GSR is faster and better cooled then a standard WTH-1S. Armed with a trio of Medium Pulse Lasers and paired Streak SRM-2's, the WTH-GSR is a close in brawler optimised for the duels that Gunslingers specialise in. A rare Chameleon Light Polarisation Shield makes the Mech near invisible to opponents. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: WTH-GSR 是 Whitworth WTH-1S 的定制改装型，为 SLDF Gunslinger 精英驾驶员打造。它采用 200 级 XL 引擎、双倍散热器、三门中型脉冲激光、两具连射 SRM-2 和变色龙轻型偏振护盾，专长近距离决斗。 特性：坚固耐用 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: A custom variant of the ASN-99 Assassin. First, the stealth armor and its Guardian ECM are removed. The head-mounted TAG is swapped for a small laser. The SRM-2s of the ASN-99 are retained. Each arm has new weapons, the left has a small vibroblade and right has a medium X-pulse laser. Finally, each leg contains a small X-pulse laser. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是 ASN-99 Assassin 的定制型号。首先拆除隐形装甲及其 Guardian ECM，并将头部安装的 TAG 换成小型激光。ASN-99 的 SRM-2 得以保留。双臂都换装新武器：左臂为小型振动刀，右臂为中型 X 脉冲激光。最后，双腿各安装一门小型 X 脉冲激光。 特质：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

column1: A custom variant of the ASN-99 Assassin. First, the stealth armor and its 守护者ECM are removed. The head-mounted TAG is swapped for a small laser. The SRM-2s of the ASN-99 are retained. Each arm has new weapons, the left has a small vibroblade and right has a medium X-pulse laser. Finally, each leg contains a small X-pulse laser. Quirk: 易于维护 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 这是 ASN-99 刺客的定制型号。首先，拆除了隐形装甲及其 Guardian ECM；头部安装的 TAG 被一门小型激光取代。ASN-99 原有的 SRM-2 发射器予以保留。两条手臂均换装新武器：左臂安装一把小型振动刀，右臂安装一门中型 X-Pulse 激光。最后，两条腿各装有一门小型 X-Pulse 激光。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂执行器限制：右下臂

column1: A customised model, this RQA-B was one of the original prototypes, built prior to the first production run. Full of technological upgrades that never made it into production, this mech is equally deadly at range and close quarters. Featuring 3 PPC’s, first generation heat dissipation armour and a unique FCS built to maximise the damage potential of the weapons; this Urbanmech has claimed many unwary opponents. Piloted by one of Damage Inc’s senior officers, this mech is equally notorious among Damage Inc’s opponents and allies.
column2: 该 RQA-B 是一款定制模型，是在首次生产运行之前构建的原始原型之一。这款机甲充满了从未投入生产的技术升级，无论是在远距离还是近距离都同样致命。配备 3 个 PPC、第一代散热装甲和独特的 FCS，旨在最大限度地提高武器的潜在伤害；这个 Urbanmech 招致了许多粗心的对手。这台机甲由损害公司的一名高级官员驾驶，在损害公司的对手和盟友中同样臭名昭著。

column1: A customised model, this RQA-B was one of the original prototypes, built prior to the first production run. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: RQA-B 是生产前原型，配备三门 PPC、第一代散热装甲和独特火控系统，远近距离都很致命，由 Damage Inc 高级军官驾驶。 特性：360° 扭转躯干 部署成本倍率：1.05 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: A customized 1D model variant created for Captain Anna Ramirez during the FedCom Civil War. Ramirez collected several Medium Pulse Lasers and additional Medium Lasers and had techs fit them in place of her SRM-6 launcher. In addition, she had a half ton of additional armor added to the thin hulled design.
column2: 这是联邦内战期间为 Anna Ramirez 上尉定制的 1D 型号改型。Ramirez 收集了几门中型脉冲激光和额外中型激光，让技师拆除 SRM-6 发射器并换装这些武器；此外还为这台薄装甲机甲增加了半吨装甲。

column1: A customized 1D model variant created for Captain Anna Ramirez during the FedCom Civil War. Ramirez collected several 中型脉冲激光s and additional 中型激光s and had techs fit them in place of her SRM-6 launcher. In addition, she had a half ton of additional 装甲 added to the thin hulled 设计.
column2: 这是联邦内战期间为Anna Ramirez上尉定制的1D变型。Ramirez收集了数门中型脉冲激光器和额外中型激光器，让技术人员用它们替换SRM-6发射器。此外，她还为这台薄装甲设计增加了半吨装甲。

column1: A customized variant created in 3085 for Lawrence Sawyer of the Lamenkov's Liability, only the MML-7 and Beagle were kept, with the rest of the weaponry replaced with a Heavy PPC, two 中型脉冲激光s, and a C3 Slave. For improved cross-country handling it also mounted five 改进的 Jump Jets. A 紧凑型陀螺仪 was also installed.
column2: 这是3085年为兰科夫责任公司的劳伦斯·索耶定制的变体。只有MML-7和猎犬主动探测器得到保留，其余武器换成一门重型PPC、两门中型激光和一台C3从属计算机。为改善越野机动性，它还安装了五具改进型跳跃喷射器，并加装了一套增强型传感器。

column1: A customized variant of the 掠夺者 IIC, the Helion mounts a HAG/40, backed up by an ER PPC in each arm supported by two ER 中型激光s split between each side torso. Twelve tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲 protect the Helion and it carries six tons of HAG ammo and fourteen double heat-sinks. 怪癖: 超伸展驱动器 掉落成本乘数: 1.21 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 这是掠夺者 IIC 的定制改型。Helion 装备 HAG/40，双臂各有一具 ER PPC，左右躯干各分担一具 ER 中型激光器。十二吨铁纤维装甲保护机体，另携六吨 HAG 弹药和 14 具双散热器。 怪癖: 超伸展驱动器 掉落成本乘数: 1.21 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: A dark ages variant of the Blackjack, replacing almost every part of it with update clan technology. The '机甲 mainly sees use within the Inner Sphere clans and their allies as well as with the Wolf's Dragoons. 怪癖: 延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 这是黑暗时代的黑杰克变体，几乎每个部件都换成了更新的星盟技术。该机甲主要由内圈星族及其盟友，以及狼之龙骑兵使用。 特性：长距离转向 击杀倍率：1.09 左上部装甲，右上部装甲

column1: A deadly campaign configuration, the Karhu D mounted a pair of ER PPCs in its left arm, supported by a 锁定式SRM-6 in its left torso and three ER 中型激光s in its right arm. Packed with advanced electronics, a 定位 Computer enhanced its weaponry alongside an 主动探头 and ECM Suite in its right torso. Protected by a pair of anti-missile systems, four extra double heat sinks were added to prevent the '机甲's single ton of AMS and streak reloads from exploding. 怪癖: 易于驾驶 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: Karhu D 是致命的战役配置，左臂装一对 ER PPC，左侧躯干配锁定式 SRM-6，右臂装三具 ER 中型激光器。先进电子设备包括瞄准计算机、右侧躯干主动探头和 ECM 套件。两套反导系统提供防护，额外四具双散热器防止机甲一吨 AMS 与 Streak 再装弹药爆炸。 怪癖: 易于驾驶 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1: A dedicated electronic warfare and scout 机甲, the 35 ton Raven has seen continuous service since it entered service in 3024. Powered by a 280-rated XL引擎, the Raven 5L is 装甲ed in Stealth 装甲 and mounts an Angel ECM. Armed with a Narc发射器 and a TAG for spotting and tagging hostile units, the Raven 5L also mounts a pair of ER 中型激光s and 2 SRM-2’s for close range combat. 怪癖: 改进的 Jammer 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Raven是一台专用电子战与侦察机甲，自3024年服役以来持续投入使用。这台35吨级机甲由280级XL引擎驱动，Raven 5L采用隐形装甲，并装有天使ECM。它装备NARC发射器和TAG，用于发现并标记敌方单位；同时配备一对ER中型激光和两具SRM-2，负责近距离作战。 特性：改进型干扰器 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左侧上臂，右侧上臂

column1: A departure from the attempt to emulate the Mad Cat, the 2A model removes the 'Mechs arsenal and upgrades it with a new weapons mix geared toward close combat. column1: A desperate field refit of the Confederations existing VND-1AA’s, the 1AAX was intensely loathed by the warriors assigned to it. Possessing less armor and weaponry than many comparable mechs, the 1AAX was designed as a highly mobile battlefield sniper; but struggled to survive once engaged by the enemy. A Partial Wing significantly boosted the designs mobility, whilst an Actuator Enhancement System bolstered the accuracy of the HPPC that constituted most of the designs firepower. The Small X-Pulse Laser and ER Medium Laser were insufficient firepower for anything other than anti-infantry work, posing little threat to heavily armored targets. The inclusion of Ferro-Fibrous armor allowed the design team to somewhat improve protection, even if it still fell far behind that off other comparable mechs, whilst the Laser AMS provided a degree of protection against incoming missiles. Unsurprisingly the design suffered high losses in combat and many mech warriors refused their assignments; only accepting them once the alternatives were made clear.
column2: 这是对联邦现有 VND-1AA 的绝望战地改装型，配发该机甲的战士都极其厌恶它。1AAX 的装甲和武器少于许多同级机甲，原本定位为高机动战场狙击手；但一旦遭敌人交战，生存能力很差。部分机翼显著提升机动性，致动器增强系统则提高了主力 HPPC 的精度。小型 X 脉冲激光器和增程中型激光器只能对付步兵，对重装目标威胁很小。铁纤维装甲稍微改善了防护，但仍落后于同类机甲；激光 AMS 则提供一定的导弹防护。该设计在战斗中损失惨重，许多机甲战士拒绝驾驶，直到别无选择才接受任务。

This version carries a single Light PPC and SRM-2 in its turret. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：6/9 格 / 180/270 米. 装甲： 装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 110 15 左侧 90 15 右侧 90 15 后方 70 15 炮塔 90 15 总计 450 75 特性：防护机构 全向 Vehicle Can carry 1 战斗装甲 Squads. Has firing ports.
column2: 轻型履带式装甲运兵车獾由狼之龙骑兵团引入内圈。作为全向载具，它装有聚变引擎和 6 吨装甲板，配备 4 吨步兵舱以及可容纳武器的 5 吨模块舱空间。该版本在炮塔中搭载一门轻型 PPC 和一具 SRM-2。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：6/9 格 / 180/270 米. 装甲： 装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 110 15 左侧 90 15 右侧 90 15 后方 70 15 炮塔 90 15 总计 450 75 特性：防护机构 全向载具 可搭载 1 个战斗装甲小队。配有射击孔。

column1: A lightly armored vehicle, the MASH Truck is not designed for combat. Equipped with a pair of Anti-Missile Systems, the MASH Truck is considered to be neutral, with most combatants going out of their way to avoid targeting or attacking the Truck. With it’s onboard array of medical equipment, the MASH can perform everything from basic triage all the way up to life saving surgery; as the situation demands. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 60 10 Left 75 10 Right 75 10 Rear 50 10 Turret 45 10 Total 305 50 Quirk: Rugged
column2: MASH 卡车装甲薄弱，并非为战斗设计。它配备一对反导系统，被视为中立单位，大多数战斗人员都会特意避免瞄准或攻击这辆卡车。凭借车载医疗设备，MASH 可以根据情况完成从基础分诊到救命手术的一切工作。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：5/8 格 / 150/240 米。 装甲：铁磁纤维 结构：结构 数值 A S 前部 60 10 左侧 75 10 右侧 75 10 后部 50 10 炮塔 45 10 总计 305 50 特质：坚固

column1: A loadout mainly seen with the capellan forces, the C configuration uses Stealth 装甲, a Beagle probe and an Angel ECM to gain an Electronic Warfare advantage. It's weapons were downgraded to a Light Gauss Rifle and one ER 中型激光器. 特性：Easy to Pilot 部署费用倍率：0.95 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 这一主要由卡佩兰部队使用的配置采用隐形装甲、比格犬探头和天使ECM，以获得电子战优势。武器降级为一门轻型高斯步枪和一门ER中型激光器。 特性：易于驾驶 部署费用倍率：0.95 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A lumbering mountain of 装甲 and weaponry, Solaris Arms' massive assault 'Mech definitely lives up to the name of Juggernaut in the Solaris Games. While not a flashy design, Solaris Arms kept up steady production of the design since the early 3050s. Sixteen and half tons of Valiant Chainmail 装甲 protect a GM 270 Fusion 引擎, propelling the 'Mech at fairly standard assault 'Mech speed of 54 km/h. 特性：Improved Lifesupport 部署费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: Solaris Arms的巨型突击机甲是一座由装甲和武器堆成的迟缓山岳，在Solaris赛事中完全配得上Juggernaut之名。虽然设计并不华丽，Solaris Arms自3050年代初一直稳定生产。16.5吨Valiant Chainmail装甲保护GM 270聚变引擎，使机甲以54 km/h的标准突击机甲速度前进。 特性：改进型生命维持系统 部署费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 下臂

column1: A medium-range saber-fighter, most of the Infernus variant's pod space is taken up by a head-mounted Snub-Nose PPC. Each arm mounts an ER Medium Laser, giving the Malak the ability to cover its flanks. To protect it from enemy electronics, the Malak B also carries a Guardian ECM Suite.
column2: Infernus 型号是一种中程剑斗机甲，大部分吊舱空间被头部安装的短管 PPC 占用。每条手臂各装一门增程中型激光，使 Malak 能覆盖侧翼。为抵御敌方电子设备，Malak B 还搭载 Guardian ECM 套件。

column1: A medium-range saber-fighter, most of the Infernus variant's pod space is taken up by a head-mounted 短管PPC. Each arm mounts an ER 中型激光, giving the Malak the ability to cover its flanks. To protect it from enemy electronics, the Malak B also carries a 守护者ECM Suite.
column2: Infernus 改型是中程剑士，大部分 pod 空间被头部短管 PPC 占据。双臂各装一具 ER 中型激光器，使 Malak 能覆盖侧翼；Malak B 还配备守护者 ECM 套件，防止敌方电子战。

column1: A midweight MBT developed by Clan Cloud Cobra, the Naja has since spread throughout the homeworld clans. A 55 ton Omni-Tank, the Naja is armoured in 14 tons of Ferro Lamellor and powered by a 330 rated XXL Engine giving it 19.5 tons of pod space. Known variants include: A pair of iATM-9s with Improved Heavy Medium and Small Lasers augmented by a Targeting Computer, an ATM-6 paired with a TC augmented ER Large Pulse Laser, a HG/30 paired with an ER Medium Pulse Laser and lastly 3 Improved Heavy Medium Lasers and an IH Small Laser all tied to a TC and a Light Active Probe. Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Ferro-Lamellor (C) Structure: Endo-Steel (C) Values A S Front 275 30 Left 215 30 Right 215 30 Rear 150 30 Turret 200 30 Total 1055 150 Quirk: Protected Mechanisms
column2: Naja 是一款由 Clan Cloud Cobra 氏族开发的中量级主战坦克，自此在家乡世界氏族中传播开来。 Naja 是一款重 55 吨的全能坦克，采用 14 吨 Ferro Lamellor 装甲，由 330 级 XXL 发动机提供动力，提供 19.5 吨的吊舱空间。已知的变体包括：一对带有改进型重中型和小型激光器的 iATM-9，由瞄准计算机增强，ATM-6 配有 TC 增强型 ER 大型脉冲激光器，HG/30 配有 ER 中型脉冲激光器，最后 3 个改进型重中型激光器和 IH 小型激光器，全部与 TC 和光有源探头相连。 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 许可使用。 生物群系限制：无。 运动：4/6 六角形/120/180米. 铠装： Ferro-Lamellor (C) 结构： Endo-Steel (C) 值 A S 前 275 30 Left 215 30 右 215 30 后 150 30 T炮塔 200 30 总计 1055 150 Quirk：受保护机制

column1: A mild evolution of the GLT-5M, the -7M boosts the Guillotine’s long-range firepower with a capacitor-boosted ER PPC backed-up by twin light PPCs. A pair of ER medium lasers and an ammo efficient Streak SRM-6 round out the weaponry. Durability is enhanced with CASE II, which reputedly also corrects the intermittent missile arming problems that plagued the original system from its inception Quirk: Integrated Searchlight Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: -7M 是 GLT-5M 的温和演变，通过由双轻型 PPC 支持的电容器增强 ER PPC 增强了 Guillotine 的远程火力。一对 ER 中型激光器和弹药高效的 Streak SRM-6 使武器更加完善。 CASE II 增强了耐用性，据说它还纠正了从一开始就困扰原始系统的间歇性导弹武装问题 Quirk：集成Searchlight 下降成本乘数：1.1 Arm执行器限制：左下，右下

column1: A militarized BattleMech version of Achernar's Loader King IndustrialMech, the Roughneck is a low-cost heavy 'Mech intended for price conscious buyers such as planetary militias and down-on-their-luck mercenary units. The Roughneck-3A is an advanced technology version of the Roughneck that makes heavy use of 双散热器 to power an all-energy loadout of 2 PPCs, 4 中型激光s, and a solitary Small Laser. 18 双散热器 keep the mech nice and cool.
column2: Roughneck是Achernar装载王工业机甲的军事化战斗机甲版本，面向行星民兵和拮据的雇佣兵部队等注重价格的买家。这款Roughneck-3A先进技术版本大量使用双散热器，为全能量武器配置供能：2门PPC、4门大型激光和1门小型激光；18组双散热器让机甲保持凉爽。

column1: A militarized BattleMech version of Achernar's Loader King IndustrialMech, the Roughneck is a low-cost heavy 'Mech intended for price conscious buyers such as planetary militias and down-on-their-luck mercenary units. The Roughneck-3A is an...
column2: 粗汉是阿克尔纳装载之王工业机甲的军用战斗机甲版本，是一款低成本重型机甲，面向精打细算的买家，如行星民兵和落魄的佣兵部队。粗汉-3A 是粗汉的先进技术版本，大量使用双倍散热器来驱动一套全能量配置：2 门 PPC、4 门中型激光和一门单独的小型激光。18 台双倍散热器让机甲保持凉爽。Base

column1: A minor modification to the CMA-1S, the CMA-C drops the Machine Gun and its ammunition and replaces them with a C3 Slave unit, allowing the Mech to be integrated into C3 equipped units.
column2: 这是CMA-1S的小幅改进型。CMA-C拆除机枪及其弹药，换成C3从属单元，使这台机甲能够编入配备C3的部队。

column1: A mix of Inner Sphere and Clan tech, this 'Mech a lot of fun toys but does surprisingly bad on the battlefield. This is mainly due to its poor cooling, resulting in the MechWarriors piloting the -7X spending a lot of their attention managing the heat.
column2: 这款机甲融合了 Inner Sphere 和 Clan 科技，是很多有趣的玩具，但在战场上的表现却出人意料地糟糕。这主要是由于其散热不良，导致驾驶-7X的机甲勇士花费大量精力来管理热量。

column1: A mix of the Prime and the D configurations, alternate configuration N mounts an ER PPC in each arm alongside an LRM-15 rack in the left and right torsos. These weapons are supported at short range by paired Machine Guns and 中型脉冲激光s in each side torso. Two tons of LRM reloads and a half ton of machine gun rounds force a focus on the energy weapons with an extra 双散热器 tries to assist in managing their heat.
column2: 这是Prime与D配置的混合型，替代配置N在双臂各安装一门ER PPC，左右躯干各有一具LRM-15发射架。两侧躯干的机枪和中型脉冲激光器在近距离提供支援。两吨LRM弹药和半吨机枪弹药迫使机甲更多依赖能量武器，额外双重散热器则尝试控制热量。

column1: A mixed-range combatant, the Sun Spider B is built around a right-torso mounted Gauss Rifle, supported by a left-torso ER Large Laser and matched 锁定式SRM-6 and ER 中型激光s in each arm. An 反导系统 and a 轻型 主动探头 in the left torso prevent the B from being caught unaware, carrying two tons of Gauss and Streak reloads along with a single ton of AMS ammo and an extra double heat sink.
column2: Sun Spider B是混合射程战斗机甲，右侧躯干安装一支高斯步枪，左侧躯干装有ER大型激光；两条手臂各配一具锁定式SRM-6和ER中型激光。左侧躯干的反导系统和轻型主动探头防止它被偷袭；同时携带两吨高斯与Streak弹药、一吨AMS弹药和一枚额外双重散热器。

column1: A mixed-tech brawler, the BLR-6R mounts a Clan-grade Rotary AC/5 in its right arm supported by a left torso–mounted Inner Sphere grade Streak SRM-6 rack, twin Light PPCs in each side torso and pair of rear-facing Improved Heavy Medium Lasers. Carrying three tons of RAC rounds and one ton of Streak reloads in CASE II–protected bays, this loadout is made possible by a Light Fusion Engine. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15
column2: BLR-6R 是一台混合技术近战机甲，右臂装备氏族级旋转 AC/5，左侧躯干安装内圈级 Streak SRM-6 发射架，两侧躯干各有一门轻型 PPC，另有一对朝后的改进型重型中型激光。它携带三吨 RAC 弹药和一吨 Streak 备用弹药，均存于 CASE II 保护舱；轻型聚变引擎使这一配置成为可能。 特质：指挥机甲 部署费用倍率：1.15

column1: A modern Clan take on the classic Succession Wars era RFL-3N Rifleman, the A variant carries a 大型脉冲激光 and 超级自动炮/5 in each arm, supported by an ER 中型激光 in each side torso. Built around a 260-rated XL引擎, Endo Steel frame, and ten tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲, the A is fitted with sixteen 双散热器 and four tons of UAC ammo.
column2: 这是氏族对继承战争时代经典RFL-3N Rifleman的现代改造。A配置双臂各装一门大型脉冲激光和一门超级自动炮/5，两侧躯干各有一门ER中型激光器支援。它以260额定XL引擎、内骨骼框架和10吨铁纤维装甲为核心，配备16组双重散热器和4吨UAC弹药。

column1: A modern take on the venerable SRM/LRM Carriers, the JES II Strategic Missile Carrier was a common missile based fire support vehicle in use in the early thirty-second century. Closely matching more primitive LRM Carriers, the standard JES II mounted four FarFire LRM-15 racks in its nose, supported by a pair of side-mounted FarFire MML-9 launchers. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 2/3 hexes / 60/90 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 320 50 Left 175 50 Right 175 50 Rear 170 50 Total 840 200 Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Ballistics
column2: JES II 战略导弹载具是对经典 SRM/LRM 载具的现代化改进，三十二世纪初常被用作导弹火力支援车辆。标准 JES II 与较早的 LRM 载具十分相似：车头装有四具 FarFire LRM-15 发射架，车体两侧另有一对 FarFire MML-9 发射器提供支援。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：2/3 格 / 60/90 米。 装甲：装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 前部 320 50 左侧 175 50 右侧 175 50 后部 170 50 总计 840 200 特性：精准武器 - 弹道

column1: A modification of the 2D, the 2D1 variant removes the Active Probe from the 2D model and replaces it with a C3 Slave unit, allowing it to share targeting data with friendly units.
column2: 这是 2D 型的改装版，2D1 移除了原型的主动探头，换成 C3 从属单元，使其能够与友军分享目标数据。

column1: A modification of the Charger BattleMech, the Cudgel 2A made its debut in the Solaris VII arenas in 3066. Built by Innovative Design Concepts with brutal melee combat in mind, the 2A comes fitted with Triple Strength Myomer and enough lasers to easily activate it.
column2: 这是 Charger 战斗机甲的改型，Cudgel 2A 于 3066 年首次亮相 Solaris VII 竞技场。它由 Innovative Design Concepts 打造，专为残酷的近战而设计，配备三倍强度肌电束和足够的激光器，可以轻松启动该系统。

column1: A modification of the Charger BattleMech, the Cudgel 2A made its debut in the Solaris VII arenas in 3066. Built by Innovative Design Concepts with brutal melee combat in mind, the 2B comes fitted with Triple Strength Myomer and enough lasers to easily activate it.
column2: Charger BattleMech 的改进型 Cudgel 2A 于 3066 年在 Solaris VII 竞技场首次亮相。2B 采用创新设计理念，考虑到残酷的近战战斗，配备了三重强度 Myomer 和足够的激光，可轻松激活它。

column1: A modified ANH-1E, the Mean Baby upgrades the engine to a 300-rated XL Engine. The arm mounted lasers are removed, one of the two center-torso lasers are moved to the head and both are upgraded to ER Medium Lasers. If an enemy manages to close the distance, 4 Streak SRM-6s with 5 tons of ammo provide a devastating close-range punch, with fifteen and a half tons of armor providing adequate defense. Sixteen double heat sinks are hard-pressed to dissipate all the waste heat, so care must taken when firing the weapons. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Mean Baby 是 ANH-1E 的改装型，将引擎升级为 300 级 XL 引擎。双臂安装的激光被拆除，中央躯干两门激光中的一门移至头部，并且两门都升级为增程中型激光。若敌人成功逼近，四具 Streak SRM-6 和五吨弹药可提供毁灭性的近距离火力；15.5 吨装甲也足以提供防护。16 具双重散热器难以消散所有废热，因此开火时必须谨慎。 特质：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.2 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: A modified ANH-1E, the Mean Baby upgrades the engine to a 300-rated XL Engine. The arm mounted lasers are removed, one of the two center-torso lasers are moved to the head and both are upgraded to ER 中型激光s. If an enemy manages to close the distance, 4 锁定式SRM-6s with 5 tons of ammo provide a devastating close-range punch, with fifteen and a half tons of armor providing adequate defense. Sixteen double heat sinks are hard-pressed to dissipate all the waste heat, so care must taken when firing the weapons. Quirk: 易于维护 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.2 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Mean Baby 是对 ANH-1E 的改装型，引擎升级为 300 级 XL 引擎。拆除了手臂上的激光，并将两门中央躯干激光中的一门移至头部，两门均升级为 ER 中型激光。若敌人逼近，4 具 Streak SRM-6 发射器和 5 吨弹药可提供毁灭性的近距离火力；15.5 吨装甲则提供足够防护。16 台双重散热器仍难以消散全部废热，因此开火时必须谨慎控制热量。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.2 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: A modified Minsk 101, the 102 is not a true upgrade. Instead Ghost Bear engineers opted to remove the Star League era Active Probe in favour of a modern model. With the freed weight, the engineers installed an additional 2 Machine Guns. Produced with Minsk 101's pulled out of a Brian Cache, the Bears would use the design as a bodyguard unit for PGC units; freeing up more resources for Operation Revival. Quirk: Protected Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Minsk 102 是改装型 Minsk 101，并非真正的升级型号。Ghost Bear 工程师选择拆除星盟时代的主动探测器，换装现代型号。腾出的重量用于加装两挺机枪。该型号使用从 Brian Cache 中取出的 Minsk 101 改造而成；熊族将其作为 PGC 部队的护卫单位，从而为复兴行动腾出更多资源。 特性：执行器防护 部署成本倍率：1.14 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: A modified Sea Wolf in Ghost Bear Delta Galaxy colours, this mech sure looks like it has seen some action judging by those massive scorch marks on the torso. Also, that railgun looks unusual...
column2: 这是一台涂装为幽灵熊 Delta 星群配色的改装 Sea Wolf。从躯干上大片焦痕来看，它肯定经历过不少战斗。另外，那门轨道炮看起来有些特别……

column1: A more radical variant removes the jump jets and mounts an ER Large Laser and twin ER Medium Lasers. It retains the Stealth Armor and Guardian ECM, but adds a Targeting Computer to make the lasers more accurate. MASC enables the ST to move in bursts up to 151 km/h.
column2: 更激进的变体拆除了跳跃喷射器，改装一门增程大型激光器和两门增程中型激光器。它保留隐形装甲和守护者 ECM 系统，并增设瞄准计算机以提高激光命中率。MASC 可让 ST 型短时间加速至 151 千米/时。

column1: A more radical variant removes the jump jets and mounts an ER Large Laser and twin ER Medium Lasers. It retains the Stealth Armor and Guardian ECM, but adds a Targeting Computer to make the lasers more accurate. MASC enables the ST to move in bursts up to 151 km/h. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower

column1: A more recent variant of the Victor produced on New Valencia, the 10D is an excellent close combat 'Mech. The 10D variant has a powerful Ultra Autocannon/20 as its primary weapon. This is supported by two ER Medium Lasers and a Streak SRM-4 to finish off a damaged target. The 10D is also capable of jumping up to one hundred and twenty meters, making it an excellent urban combat machine. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: Victor 的较新型号 10D 产自新瓦伦西亚，是一台出色的近战机甲。10D 以强大的超高斯炮/20 作为主武器，并由两门增程中型激光和一具连射短程导弹/4 辅助，可追击受损目标。10D 还能够跳跃 120 米，是优秀的城市作战机甲。 特性：坚固耐用 部署成本倍率：1.14 手臂执行器限制：右上臂

column1: A much needed upgrade to the 3V, but still not quite good enough to make it truly useful. Those Rockets just aren't that great.
column2: 这是 3V 的一次急需升级，但仍不够优秀，无法真正实用。那些火箭的表现确实不怎么样。

column1: A much tougher BattleMech than its predecessor, the Viking IIC is protected by a massive 31 tons of GC Hardened Slab Armor. This is a dense and tough hardened armor, which while providing considerable protection in combat also slows the 'Mech down. Its lack of speed would make the Viking IIC unpopular with Clan warriors, who prefer swifter machines in combat. The foundation of toughness is also found in its GC Type 2C Endo Steel skeleton and a General Motors 270-Rated Fusion Engine.
column2: Viking IIC 是一款比其前身更加坚固的 BattleMech，由 31 吨重的 GC 硬化平板装甲保护。这是一种致密而坚韧的硬化装甲，虽然在战斗中提供相当大的保护，但也减慢了“机甲”的速度。由于缺乏速度，维京 IIC 不受氏族战士的欢迎，因为他们更喜欢在战斗中使用速度更快的机器。其 GC 型 2C Endo 钢骨架和通用汽车 270 级 Fusion 发动机也奠定了韧性的基础。

column1: A new production variant of the THE-N1 developed by the Word of Blake in 3071, the THE-N2 took its cues from both the THE-N and THE-T variants, swapping the ER-PPC with an MML-7 and the standard small laser for a Diverse Optics ER Small Laser. A two-ton CASE protected ammo bay allowed the THE-N2 to carry both LRM and SRM munitions to make best use of the Multi-Missile Launcher. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: THE-N2 是由布莱克 (Blake) 于 3071 年开发的 THE-N1 的新生产变体，THE-N2 借鉴了 THE-N 和 THE-T 变体的启发，将 ER-PPC 与 MML-7 和标准小型激光器替换为 Diverse Optics ER 小型激光器。两吨重的 CASE 保护弹药舱使 THE-N2 能够携带 LRM 和 SRM 弹药，以充分利用多导弹发射器。 特点：易于携带维护 下降成本乘数：0.97 Arm执行器限制：左下

column1: A new take on a classic, Boss. This thing trades up the AC5 for an Improved AC10, the missiles for a Rocketstorm battery, and, best of all, it finally has the proper amount of Jump Jets.
column2: 老板，经典的新演绎。这东西用 AC5 换成了改进型 AC10，用导弹换成了火箭风暴电池，最重要的是，它终于拥有了适量的跳跃喷气机。

column1: A new variant, just recently launched by Clan Hell's Horses, the 8 model replaces the jump jets with Actuator Enhancement Systems, sacrificing mobility for stunning accuracy.
column2: Clan Hell's Horses 最近推出的新变体 8 型号用执行器增强系统取代了跳跃喷气机，牺牲了机动性以获得惊人的精度。

column1: A newer weapon configuration, the 2PA is designed for work against domestic insurgents. It has a pair of Plasma Rifles, four Medium Lasers, retains the Streak SRM launcher, and mounts two Machine Gun Arrays, each with four Machine Guns. It can also utilize a Beagle Active Probe to find hidden units.
column2: 这是一种较新的武器配置，2PA 专为对付国内叛乱分子而设计。它配备一对等离子步枪、四门中型激光器，保留 Streak SRM 发射器，并安装两组机枪阵列，每组含四挺机枪。它还可使用 Beagle 主动探测器来发现隐藏单位。

column2: 这是一套更新的武器配置，2PA专门用于对付国内叛乱分子。它装备一对等离子步枪、四门ER中型激光，保留连射SRM发射器，并安装两个机枪阵列，每个阵列装有四挺机枪。它还可使用猎犬主动探测器寻找隐藏单位。

column1: A non-Omni variant of the Deimos, this design features mainly Experimental equipment. This variant was speculated by Armed Forces of the Federated Suns intelligence as being based on the original prototype of the Deimos.
column2: 这是 Deimos 的非 Omni 变体，主要采用实验型设备。联邦太阳联邦武装部队情报部门推测，该变体可能源自 Deimos 的原型机。

column1: A one of a kind Rattlesnake 开发 by Headhunter 稳定s of Solaris 7; the 响尾蛇 JR7-31R was piloted by Gideon Wozniak during his arena fight with the wanted war criminal and ex ROM agent, Victor Reskov. Built from a Rattlesnake JR7-37, the 37R model upgrades the 机甲 with Clan made 铁纤维装甲 装甲 and MASC. 2 Clan ER 中型激光s, 3 中型激光s and a Clan ER Small Laser form the 机甲s armament; with Angel ECM and a Clan made 定位 Computer enhancing the 机甲s effectiveness. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 这是Solaris 7上由Headhunter武器制造商打造的独一无二的Rattlesnake。Rattlesnake JR7-31R由Gideon Wozniak驾驶，参加了与通缉战犯、前ROM特工Victor Reskov的竞技场决斗。37R型号基于Rattlesnake JR7-37，将氏族制造的铁纤维装甲和MASC升级到机体上。2门氏族ER中型激光、三门中型激光和一门氏族ER小型激光构成其武器；天使ECM和氏族制造的瞄准计算机进一步提升机甲效能。 特性：敏捷 部署费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左侧上臂，右侧上臂

column1: A pirate band found one of these drifting in a misjumped dropship, not a soul left alive aboard, just skeletal remains and a strange 'Mech in the cargo bay. Nothing about it matched Star League records they knew. Named it after that old Terran tale on account of the mongoose painted on the shoulder. Sold it to King Grimm for fifty million C-Bills, though it never made it to Oberon. Mysterious white fighters tore the whole convoy apart before they got there.
column2: 一支海盗团在一艘因跳跃失误而漂流的运输船上发现了它：船上没有一个活人，只剩骨骸，以及货舱里一台奇怪的机甲。他们掌握的星盟记录中没有任何与之相符的资料。由于肩部涂着一只猫鼬，他们便以那部古老的泰拉故事为它命名。他们以五千万 C-Bills 的价格卖给了格林王，但它没能抵达欧贝隆。几架神秘的白色战斗机在他们到达之前就把整支车队撕得粉碎。

column1: A post Jihad re设计, the Commando 8S uses an Endo Steel chassis and XL引擎. A pair of 锁定式SRM-2 launchers are carried in the right arm with a pair of ER 中型激光s in the left arm. The Streak ammunition is stored in a CASE II protected bay. A 增强型C3从机 allows the Commando to share targeting data with friendly forces, and a Supercharger allows it to reach speeds of 140 km/h in short bursts. 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 0.98
column2: 圣战后的重新设计，Commando 8S采用内骨骼钢底盘和XL引擎。右臂装有一对锁定式SRM-2发射器，左臂装有一对ER中型激光。连击弹药存放在CASE II防护舱内。增强型C3从机让Commando能够与友军共享瞄准数据，增压器则使其能在短时间内达到140公里/小时。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.98

column1: A post-Jihad variant 生产 by Krupp Armament Works for the 球体共和国 in 3084, the production model 8R was based on the prototype SDR-8X that used during the liberation of Terra. Built on an Endo Steel chassis and powered by a smaller 210 Light Fusion 引擎 - while its ground speed was reduced, the SDR-8R's ten Pitban LFT-20X 改进的 Jump Jets gave it amazing maneuverability. Carrying ten double heat sinks allowed the 8R to fire its twin 多元光学 ER 中型激光s and jump without fear of overheating. Boasting a very different look, the re设计ed 8R was also notable for being one of the first Spiders to include an ejection system. 怪癖: Nimble 掉落成本乘数: 0.99
column2: 这是 Krupp 武器公司的圣战后型号，于 3084 年为球体共和国生产。量产型 8R 基于解放 Terra 时使用的原型 SDR-8X。它采用内骨骼钢底盘和较小的 210 级轻型聚变引擎；虽然地面速度降低，但十具 Pitban LFT-20X 改进型跳跃喷射器赋予 SDR-8R 惊人的机动性。十台双重散热器让 8R 能够发射两门多元光学增程中型激光器并进行跳跃，而不用担心过热。重新设计的 8R 外形截然不同，也是最早配备弹射系统的蜘蛛型号之一。 怪癖: 灵巧 掉落成本乘数: 0.99

column1: A powerful and hard hitting configuration, the H represents the Warwolf's Heavy Laser–focused weapon layout. A pair of Improved Heavy Large Lasers are split between each of the 'Mech's side torsos, while the right arm is fitted with a Gauss rifle with sixteen rounds of ammunition. CASE II protects the 'Mech's right and left torsos in the event of a heavy laser capacitor explosion. To help cope with the extreme heat generated by the 'Mech's weapons, two additional Double Heat Sinks and a pair of Coolant Pods are added. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: H 型是 Warwolf 的重型激光专精配置，火力强大而凶猛。一对改进型重型大型激光分别安装在机甲两侧的躯干内，右臂则装有一支高斯步枪及 16 发弹药。CASE II 可在重型激光电容器爆炸时保护机甲的左右躯干。为应对武器产生的极端热量，额外安装了两台双倍散热器和一对冷却剂舱。 特性：改进型瞄准 - 中程 部署费用倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A production version of the experimental X model, the vehicle is fitted with a 210 XL fusion engine with a supercharger. Weaponry includes a 中型X脉冲激光 laser and 锁定式SRM-6. A C3 Computer greatly improves its scouting abilities. The Pegasus is a popular recon unit, due to its good speed, decent armor, and respectable firepower. It can be found in almost all militaries, having been introduced in the First Succession War and continuously updated ever since. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 11/17 hexes / 330/510 meters. column2: 作为实验X型号的量产版本，Pegasus X配备210额定XL聚变引擎和增压器。武器包括一门中型X脉冲激光和一具MML-6。C3计算机大幅提升了它的侦察能力。Pegasus是广受欢迎的侦察单位，速度优秀、装甲可靠且火力可观。它几乎在所有军队中都能找到，自第一次继承战争引入后便持续升级至今。 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 11/17 格 / 330/510 米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 120 20 左侧 80 20 右侧 80 20 后方 55 20 炮塔 80 20 总计 415 100 怪癖: 改进的 通信

column1: A proposed Dark Age overhaul of the classic Phoenix Hawk, the PHX-99 is a unique take on the standard Phoenix Hawk. Emphasizing 装甲 over mobility, the PHX-99 is coated in Hardened 装甲, reinforced by a Heavy Duty Gyro and Modular 装甲. To fit this in, the 引擎 has been downgraded to a 50-rated Fusion Core, forcing the 机甲 to rely on a pair of 改进的 Jump Jets for mobility. Armed with a Large X-Pulse Laser, a pair of ER 中型激光器 and a pair of ER Small Lasers, the PHX-99 is considered a failed prototype for a reason. 怪癖: 改进的 Communications 掉落成本乘数: 1.05
column2: PHX-99 是经典凤凰鹰的黑暗时代改造方案，对标准凤凰鹰进行了独特重制。PHX-99 强调装甲而非机动性，覆盖强化装甲，并由重型陀螺仪和模块化装甲加固。为容纳这些设备，引擎降级为 50 级聚变核心，迫使机甲依靠一对改进型跳跃喷射器机动。它装备一门大型 X 脉冲激光器、一对增程中型激光器和一对增程小型激光器，被视为失败原型并非没有原因。 怪癖: 改进的 通信系统 掉落成本乘数: 1.05

column1: A prototype OmniMech built on the success of the Stormcrow line, fielded by Clan Wolf for trials before going into full production. Using a combination of a 330-rated Extra-Light Fusion Engine and TSM, the 'Mech is able to achieve speeds up to 110 km/h. Perhaps the most startling innovation included in this design is the Clan Interface Armor, which allows a MechWarrior to interface with their 'Mech while being completely armored should they be forced to eject. This combination interface allows the Ryoken III pilot's a degree of control in combat, and removes the need to have a Gyro mounted in the 'Mech. This technology was thought to have been lost at the time of Skinwalker's baptism in combat by Inner Sphere powers. In addition to having its pilot encased in a power-armor interface, the Mech's hull is protected by 11.5 tons of Ferro-Lamellor Armor.
column2: 这是一台基于 Stormcrow 系列成功经验打造的原型全能机甲，由狼氏族在全面生产前投入试验。330 级超轻型聚变引擎与 TSM 结合，让它的速度可达 110 公里/小时。最惊人的创新是氏族接口装甲：即使被迫弹射，机甲战士也能在完全装甲防护下与机甲连接。该接口让 Ryoken III 驾驶员在战斗中拥有更高控制力，也不再需要在机甲内安装陀螺仪。内天体势力曾以为这项技术在 Skinwalker 首次参战时已经失传。除了让驾驶员包裹在动力装甲接口中，机甲外壳还由 11.5 吨 Ferro-Lamellor 装甲保护。

column1: A prototype improvement of the -6WB that never went into larger production due to the defeat of the Blakist forces. Through the combination of both Endo Steel 结构 and 铁纤维装甲 装甲, the prototype managed to fit both an ER Large Laser and a 轻型高斯步枪 in the left arm. Four ER 中型激光s and a Streak SRM4 launcher provides closer range firepower as needed. 怪癖: 集成探照灯 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower, 左侧 Upper
column2: 这是 -6WB 的原型改进型，因布雷克势力战败而未大规模生产。内骨骼钢结构与铁纤维装甲的组合让它能在左臂安装 ER 大型激光器和轻型高斯步枪；四具 ER 中型激光器与 Streak SRM-4 提供近距离火力。 怪癖: 集成探照灯 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower, 左侧 Upper

column1: A prototype that never saw widespread adoption, the Merlin 2A was Mountain Wolfs next generation offering unveiled alongside the 1B variant in 3053. Built around a 240-rated XL引擎, it is armed with a pair of ER Large Lasers and a pair of Medium Pulses. The 1A's Machine Gun is retained and the LRM-5 upgraded to a LRM-10. The addition of CASE protects the ammunition bays and 14 双散热器 handle the increased heat burden. At almost 19 million CBills, the design was rejected as too expensive and too reliant on advanced technology that the Outworlds Alliance struggled to produce. Mountain Wolf shelved the design, though not before a single run of 20 2A's were produced. Most of these were fielded by the Mountain Wolf security team, but some found their way into the hands of the elite Avellar Guard.
column2: 梅林2A是未获广泛采用的原型机，由山狼在3053年与1B型一同公布，作为下一代产品。它以额定功率240的XL引擎为核心，装备一对增程大型激光和一对中型脉冲激光；保留1A型的机枪，并将LRM-5升级为LRM-10。CASE保护弹药舱，14台双倍散热器承担增加的热负荷。该设计造价接近1900万C币，因过于昂贵且依赖外世界联盟难以生产的先进技术而被否决。山狼随后搁置项目，但仍生产了仅20台的首批2A型，其中大多数由山狼保安队使用，少数落入精英阿韦拉尔卫队手中。

column1: A prototype that only ever entered limited development, the 2G swaps the standard HAG-20 for a Gauss rifle. An XL engine freed up the tonnage needed to mount the rifle and allowed for the incorporation of a light active probe. Needless to say, this wasn’t popular with most the warriors assigned to it. Production was eventually cancelled in 3074, due to unacceptably high losses under combat conditions.
column2: 这是一款仅进入有限开发阶段的原型机。2G 型将标准 HAG-20 换成了高斯步枪。XL 引擎腾出了安装该步枪所需的吨位，并允许加装轻型主动探头。不用说，这并不受大多数被分配驾驶它的战士欢迎。由于实战损失高得无法接受，生产最终于 3074 年取消。

column1: A prototype that only ever entered limited development, the 2G swaps the standard HAG-20 for a Gauss rifle. An XL engine freed up the tonnage needed to mount the rifle and allowed for the incorporation of a light active probe. Needless to say, this wasn’t popular with most the warriors assigned to it. Production was eventually cancelled in 3074, due to unacceptably high losses under combat conditions. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这款原型机仅进入有限开发阶段。2G 型号以高斯步枪取代标准的 HAG-20。XL 引擎腾出了安装步枪所需的载重空间，也让设计得以加入轻型主动探测器。显而易见，这种改动并不受大多数配属战士欢迎。由于实战损失高得无法接受，该型号最终于 3074 年取消生产。 特性：360° 扭转躯干 部署成本倍率：1.03 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: A prototype that only ever entered limited development, the 2G swaps the standard HAG-20 for a Gauss rifle. An XL引擎 freed up the tonnage needed to mount the rifle and allowed for the incorporation of a light active probe. Needless to say, this wasn’t popular with most the warriors assigned to it. Production was eventually cancelled in 3074, due to unacceptably high losses under combat conditions.
column2: 2G是一款仅进行有限开发的原型机，用高斯步枪替换标准HAG-20。XL引擎腾出了安装步枪所需的重量，也使其能够搭载轻型主动探头。显然，这套配置并不受大多数驾驶员欢迎。由于实战损失高得无法接受，该项目最终于3074年取消。

column1: A radical departure from the prime configuration, this configuration strips out all of the weapons, replacing them with an 改进的 Heavy Large Laser in the right arm, a pair of ER 中型激光s in the center torso and Gauss Rifle in the left arm. The C Configuration also mounts a 定位 Computer in the right torso. 怪癖: 受保护的驱动器 掉落成本乘数: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: 这是一种彻底偏离基础配置的改型：拆除全部武器，右臂换装一门改进型重型大型激光器，中央躯干安装两门ER中型激光器，左臂安装高斯步枪。C型配置还在右侧躯干安装了一台瞄准计算机。 特性：受保护的驱动器 部署成本倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A rare modification of the R60L model, the R60T removes the unused 11th heat sink and the AC/20 and its ammo. A Thumper Artillery piece and a ton of ammo are installed in their place.
column2: R60T 是 R60L 型号的罕见改装，拆除了闲置的第 11 具散热器以及 AC/20 和其弹药，改装位置安装了一门 Thumper 火炮和一吨弹药。

column1: A rare modification of the R60L model, the R60T removes the unused 11th heat sink and the AC/20 and its ammo. A 重击者火炮 piece and a ton of ammo are installed in their place.
column2: R60T是R60L的罕见改装型，拆除了未使用的第11组散热器、AC/20及其弹药，改为安装一门重击者火炮和一吨弹药。

column1: A rare refit of the venerable Black Knight Chassis often found among Mercenaries and Pit Fighters, exchanges most of the Energy Weapons for a Sawed-Off Thumper, Active Combat Shield and advanced Electronics.
column2: 这是一种罕见的改装型，常见于佣兵和竞技场斗士使用的老牌黑骑士底盘。它拆除了大部分能量武器，换成一门短管 Thumper 火炮、一面主动战斗盾和先进电子设备。

column1: A rare refit of the venerable 黑骑士 Chassis often found among Mercenaries and Pit Fighters, exchanges most of the Energy Weapons for a Sawed-Off Thumper, Active 战斗盾牌 and advanced Electronics.
column2: 这是著名黑骑士底盘的罕见改装型，常见于佣兵和斗士之中。它用一门削短型Thumper、主动战斗盾牌和先进电子设备替换了大部分能量武器。

column1: A rare sight boss! This is a light scout OmniVehicle pretty much exclusively made by Clan Hell's Horses. It was designed to comfortably fit infantry in that bay there but I reckon we could squeeze a full squad of battle armor in there in a pinch, they probably won't be happy about it though.
column2: 少见的景象，老板！这是一台几乎只由地狱之马氏族制造的轻型侦察全能载具。它原本设计成能舒适地容纳步兵，但我想，真有必要的话，我们也能硬塞进一整班战斗装甲——他们大概不会喜欢。

column1: A rebuild of the previous MAD-5L, attempting to create a better profile for a stealth 'Mech. Never saw much success.
column2: 之前的 MAD-5L 的重建，试图为隐形“机甲”创造更好的轮廓。从未见过太大的成功。

column1: A recent upgrade of the Lineholder, this variant of the 'Mech carries a pair of Rotary Autocannon/2s in place of the two LRM-5 launchers and the four Medium Lasers. The LH8 also carries an ER Large Laser in place of the Large Laser. Nicknamed the Linebreaker, this variant was designed for the Federated Suns. Following the commencement of the Jihad, however, production ceased.
column2: 这是线卫机甲近期的升级型，以两门旋转 AC/2 取代两具 LRM-5 发射器和四门中型激光器。LH8 还以一门增程大型激光器取代大型激光器。该型绰号“破线者”，原为联邦太阳联邦设计；然而圣战爆发后，生产便告停止。

column1: A recent upgrade of the Lineholder, this variant of the 'Mech carries a pair of 转管自动炮/2s in place of the two LRM-5 launchers and the four 中型激光s. The LH8 also carries an ER Large Laser in place of the Large Laser. Nicknamed the Linebreaker, this variant was designed for the Federated Suns. Following the commencement of the Jihad, however, production ceased.
column2: 这是 Lineholder 的近期升级型，以一对旋转自动炮/2取代两具 LRM-5 发射器和四门中型激光。LH8 还以一门 ER 大型激光替换原有大型激光。该型号绰号“破线者”，专为联邦太阳设计。不过，圣战爆发后生产便停止了。

column1: A recovered-technology version of the RFL-4D, the 5D was introduced in 3050 for the Federated Commonwealth. Based on the earlier 4D, it replaces the PPCs with ER PPC models and restores the original model's medium lasers to the side torsos. A 240-rated XL engine was used to free up weight for the mounting of seventeen double heat sinks and an increase in armor protection to nine tons. Production of this model was taken up by Kallon Industries on Talon, Trellshire Industires on Twycross and Red Devil Industries on Pandora.
column2: 作为 RFL-4D 的复得技术版本，5D 于 3050 年为联邦太阳国推出。它以早先的 4D 为基础，用 ER PPC 型号取代 PPC，并恢复了原型号装于两侧躯干的中型激光。一台 240 额定 XL 引擎腾出了重量，用于安装十七具双联散热器，并把装甲防护提升至九吨。该型号的生产由 Talon 的 Kallon Industries、Twycross 的 Trellshire Industires 与 Pandora 的 Red Devil Industries 承接。

column1: A recovered-technology version of the RFL-4D, the 5D was introduced in 3050 for the Federated Commonwealth. Based on the earlier 4D, it replaces the PPCs with ER PPC models and restores the original model's 中型激光器 to the side torsos. A 240-rated XL引擎 was used to free up weight for the mounting of seventeen double heat sinks and an increase in 装甲 protection to nine tons. Production of this model was taken up by 卡隆工业 on Talon, Trellshire Industires on Twycross and Red Devil Industries on Pandora.
column2: RFL-4D的恢复技术版本5D于3050年为联邦合众国推出。它以早期4D为基础，用ER PPC替换PPC，并将原版中型激光器恢复到两侧躯干。240额定XL引擎腾出重量，用于安装17组双重散热器并将装甲提高到9吨。该型号由Talon上的卡隆工业、Twycross上的Trellshire Industries和Pandora上的Red Devil Industries生产。

column1: A refit designed for garrison troops, the Urbanmech IICr was as a stop gap upgrade utilised by Clan Snow Raven and later the Raven Alliance; to guard against piracy attacks on their frontier holdings. Trading the traditional IIC armament for a pair of Heavy Large Lasers and enough heat sinks to keep it more or less functional in combat, it is capable of delivering a knockout punch against adversaries far exceeding it’s own weight . The raw fire power of the Heavy Lasers forces the pilot to alternate their firing sequences to minimise heat build up or risk a shutdown. Never a popular mech, it found a new life as a training mech in the Alliance armed forces; teaching sibko the importance of heat management and battlefield awareness.
column2: Urbanmech IICr 是为驻防部队设计的改型，曾由 Snow Raven 氏族、后来的 Raven Alliance 用作临时升级，以防范边境领地遭受海盗袭击。它用一对重型大型激光器替换传统 IIC 武器，并配备足够的散热器，使其在战斗中勉强维持运作，能够重创吨位远超自身的敌人。重型激光器的强大火力迫使驾驶员交替安排开火顺序，以尽量减少热量积聚，否则机甲可能关机。它从未广受欢迎，后来却在联盟武装部队中作为训练机甲重获新生，用于教导 sibko 热量管理与战场意识。

column1: A refit designed for garrison troops, the Urbanmech IICr was as a stop gap upgrade utilised by 雪鸦氏族 and later the 渡鸦同盟; to guard against piracy attacks on their frontier holdings. Trading the traditional IIC armament for a pair of Heavy Large Lasers and enough heat sinks to keep it more or less functional in combat, it is capable of delivering a knockout punch against adversaries far exceeding it’s own weight . The raw fire power of the Heavy Lasers forces the pilot to alternate their firing sequences to minimise heat build up or risk a shutdown. Never a popular mech, it found a new life as a training mech in the Alliance armed forces; teaching sibko the importance of heat management and battlefield awareness.
column2: Urbanmech IICr是为驻军部队设计的改装型，最初是雪鸦氏族、后来是渡鸦同盟为防范边疆领地海盗袭击而采用的过渡升级。它放弃传统IIC武器，换装两门重型大型激光器和足够的散热器，使其基本能够投入战斗，并能对远超自身重量的敌人造成致命打击。重型激光器的原始火力迫使驾驶员交替射击，以尽量减少热量积累，否则就有停机风险。这台机甲从未广受欢迎，却在同盟武装部队中获得了新用途，成为训练机甲，教导氏族学员掌握热量管理和战场态势感知。

column1: A refit made by the Society to the base Erebus designs, adding a lot more cutting edge technology. Titano-Carbide Lamellor armor, Endo-Titanium Structure and a Radical Heat Sink kit are all amongst the upgrades. Even the cockpit systems have been upgraded with Enhanced Imaging and a Nova CEWS.
column2: 这是 Society 对基础 Erebus 设计所做的改装，加入了更多尖端技术。升级项目包括碳化钛层片装甲、钛内骨架结构和激进散热器套件。连驾驶舱系统也升级为增强成像系统和 Nova CEWS。

column1: A refit made by the Society to the base Erebus designs, adding a lot more cutting edge technology. Titano-Carbide Lamellor 装甲, Endo-Titanium 结构 and a Radical Heat Sink kit are all amongst the upgrades. Even the cockpit systems have been upgraded with 增强成像 and a Nova CEWS.
column2: 这是Society对Erebus基础设计的改装型，加入了更多尖端技术。升级项目包括钛碳化物层叠装甲、内钛结构和激进型散热器套件；甚至驾驶舱系统也升级为增强成像和Nova CEWS。

column1: A refresh of the Ostwar OWR-2M, the OWR-2MX replaces the LRM and 中型激光s with an upgrade to double SRM6 launchers and 3 Extended Range Large Lasers. Using an XL引擎 and Endo Steel 结构 allows the switch to 双散热器 for better cooling performance as well as an upgrade to a 325-rated fusion core. One large oddity is the fact the SRM6 launchers are in the legs, leading a strange angle of launching that can surprise enemy Mech Warriors.
column2: OWR-2M的更新型OWR-2MX用两具SRM-6发射器和3门增程大型激光器替换LRM和中型激光器。XL引擎与内骨骼结构允许换装双重散热器并升级为325额定聚变核心。一个显著怪异之处是SRM-6发射器安装在腿部，导致发射角度奇特，能够出其不意地打击敌方机甲战士。

column1: A rivalry between two lesser Solaris stables begot the prototype Huron Warrior nicknamed the ’Thunderchief.’ While the original was made almost entirely from, illegibly, stolen parts; the few knock-offs and reproductions that have filtered throughout the Inner Sphere have solidified this unusual design. The Thunderchief is primarily built around a Thumper Artillery piece, which is used to pummel targets at range, and a hatchet used for in-close work. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.06
column2: 两家 Solaris 小型车队之间的竞争催生了原型 Huron Warrior，绰号‘Thunderchief’。原型几乎完全由零件拼成，其中大部分显然是盗来的；不过，少量仿制品和复制型号流入内圈后，反而巩固了这一独特设计的地位。Thunderchief 主要围绕一门 Thumper 火炮打造，用于远距离轰击目标；近战则使用战斧。 特质：改进型传感器 部署费用倍率：1.06

column1: A salvaged Conjurer from a Lyran Pirate, the Hoellenhund received mercury weapon mounts to face every possible threat.
column2: 一种salvaged Conjurer 来自 a Lyran Pirate, the Hoellenhund received mercury 武器 安装 以 face every possible threat.

column1: A second variant of the CP-11-C3, which tries cutting costs by using cheaper weapon technology and armor. Since the main purpose of the 'Mech is the experimental boosted C3 Master computer, it was deemed weapons were a far lower priority.
column2: 这是 CP-11-C3 的第二种型号，通过采用更廉价的武器技术和装甲来削减成本。由于该机甲主要用于搭载实验型增强 C3 主计算机，武器被视为低优先级配置。

column1: A second variant of the CP-11-C3, which tries cutting costs by using cheaper weapon technology and 装甲. Since the main purpose of the 'Mech is the experimental boosted C3 Master computer, it was deemed weapons were a far lower priority.
column2: 这是CP-11-C3的第二种变型，试图通过采用更便宜的武器技术和装甲来降低成本。由于机甲的主要目的在于试验强化型C3主计算机，武器被认为远不如其他方面重要。

column1: A second variant of the Spiner, focused around its Extended Range PPC. To be able to fit the weapon and the extra cooling needed, the engine core had to be downgraded from the original SPR-SNP-X's 150 rating to the 130 rating. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - PPC Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Spiner 的第二个变体，专注于其增程 PPC。为了能够适应武器和所需的额外冷却，发动机核心必须从原始 SPR-SNP-X 的 150 等级降级至 130 等级。 Quirk：精确武器 - PPC 下降成本乘数：0.98 Arm执行器限制：左上，右上

column1: A second variant of the Spiner, focused around its 增程PPC. To be able to fit the weapon and the extra cooling needed, the 引擎 core had to be downgraded from the original SPR-SNP-X's 150 rating to the 130 rating. 特性：精准武器 - PPC 部署成本倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 这是Spiner的第二种变型，围绕增程PPC打造。为了安装武器及其所需的额外冷却，必须将引擎核心从原始SPR-SNP-X的150额定值降至130额定值。 特性：精准武器 - PPC 部署成本倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: A short-ranged energy boat, the A variant carries three Small Pulse Lasers in both the right and left arm, with two extra double heat sinks to keep up a sustained rate of fire.
column2: A 型号是一台短程能量武器平台，左右臂各装三门小型脉冲激光，并额外配备两具双重散热器，以维持持续射速。

column1: A short-ranged energy boat, the A variant carries three 小型脉冲激光s in both the right and left arm, with two extra double heat sinks to keep up a sustained rate of fire.
column2: A配置是近程能量平台，左右双臂各携带三门小型脉冲激光器，并增加两组双重散热器以维持持续射速。

column1: A sidegrade of the Yeoman, replacing the traditional Missile Weapons with Rocket Launchers and adding 2 Heavy PPC. The addition of energy weapons frees the Yeoman from the ammunition dependencies that plagued the earlier models.
column2: 这是 Yeoman 的侧向升级型，以火箭发射器取代传统导弹武器，并加装两门重型 PPC。增加能量武器后，Yeoman 不再依赖弹药，也摆脱了早期型号的弹药供应问题。

column1: A sidegrade of the Yeoman, replacing the traditional Missile Weapons with Rocket Launchers and adding 2 Heavy PPC. The addition of energy weapons frees the Yeoman from the ammunition dependencies that plagued the earlier models. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是 Yeoman 的侧向改型，以火箭发射器替换传统导弹武器，并增加两门重型 PPC。能量武器的加入摆脱了早期型号受弹药供应制约的问题。 特质：精准武器 - 导弹 部署费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: A sidegrade of the Yeoman, replacing the traditional Missile Weapons with 火箭发射器s and adding 2 Heavy PPC. The addition of energy weapons frees the Yeoman from the ammunition dependencies that plagued the earlier models.
column2: 这是Yeoman的侧重调整型，用火箭发射器替换传统导弹武器，并增加两门重型PPC。能量武器的加入让Yeoman摆脱了早期型号长期受弹药限制的问题。

column1: A significant departure from the Osiris' usual loadouts, a Machine Gun in each arm provides defense against infantry, while an SRM-4 in each side-torso and two center torso mounted Medium Lasers provide a powerful close-range punch. A ton of ammo feeds the machine guns, while the SRMs are fed by 2 tons of ammo. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 与奥西里斯通常的装备有很大不同，每只手臂上都有一挺机枪，可防御步兵，而每侧躯干上的一挺 SRM-4 和躯干中央安装的两门中型激光器可提供强大的近距离打击。机枪有一吨弹药供弹，而SRM则有2吨弹药供弹。 Quirk：扩展躯干Twist 下降成本乘数：0.99 Arm执行器限制：左上，右上

column1: A simple conversion, often seen among mercenary units; the UM-R60LRM or LRMbie is an attempt to provide cheap fire support. The AC/20 is replaced with an LRM-20 and 2 tons of ammo, while 2 medium lasers are added to the mech for improved mid range efficiency. Cheaper and easier to maintain then the expensive AC versions, the LRMbie is proving surprisingly popular amongst its pilots. The longer reach of the LRM pairs better with its slower ground speed and has led to claims that it improves the mech's survivability rates in combat situations. With Helm Core technology becoming increasingly widespread, many owners plan to mate the LRM with the increasing range of speciality munitions, creating an effective support mech that can provide everything from mine laying capability to indirect fire support in a cheap package. A number of examples are known to have been obtained by various manufactures, who are keen to experiment with the design. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 这是一种在雇佣兵部队中很常见的简单改装；UM-R60LRM，即 LRMbie，旨在提供廉价火力支援。它以 LRM-20 和 2 吨弹药替换 AC/20，并为机甲增加两门中型激光器以提升中距离效率。LRMbie 比昂贵的 AC 型号更便宜、更易维护，正逐渐受到驾驶员欢迎。LRM 更远的射程与较慢的地面速度相得益彰，甚至有人认为它提高了机甲在战斗中的生存率。随着 Helm 核心技术日益普及，许多所有者计划让 LRM 使用射程更远的特种弹药，打造一台能以低廉成本执行从布雷到间接火力支援各种任务的有效支援机甲。已知多家制造商获得了样机，并热衷于试验这一设计。 特性：360° 躯干扭转 部署费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂，右上臂

column1: A simple field modification that replaces the AC/10 with an HVAC/10, it isn't geared toward long range or extended engagements.
column2: 一种simple field modification that 替换 the AC/10 配备 an HVAC/10, it isn't geared 以ward long 射程 或 extended engagements.

column1: A simple field refit used during the Jihad, this version mounts a C3 slave unit in the torso and a second arm-mounted laser by removing the rear-firing model, while replacing the original autocannon with a light autocannon/5.

column1: A simple modification of the R4L model, the 3065 R4O model of the Huron Warrior carries double heat sinks, enabling it to drop one heat sink and carry an additional ton of ammunition for the Gauss Rifle.
column2: 这是 R4L 型号的简单改装。3065 年款 R4O 型 Huron Warrior 配备双重散热器，因此可以拆下一具散热器，为高斯步枪额外携带一吨弹药。

column1: A simple refit of the Royal Catapult C1b performed as part of the SLDF's Gunslinger program, the -GSR saw more use in duels than in actual combat. Taking advantage of the common assumption that a Catapult would be carrying LRMs, the -GSR instead replaces them with 4 Holly SRM6 racks with Artemis IV fire controllers and swaps the Medium Lasers for a pair of Raker-IV Medium Pulse Lasers. This surprisingly short-ranged loadout secured the SLDF several victories over Kuritan duelists. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: -GSR 是作为 SLDF 枪骑兵计划一部分，对皇家 Catapult C1b 进行的简单改装；相比实战，它更多用于决斗。利用人们普遍认为 Catapult 会携带 LRM 的认知，-GSR 反而拆除它们，换成四具配备 Artemis IV 火控器的 Holly SRM-6 发射架，并以一对 Raker-IV 中型脉冲激光替换中型激光。这套近距离配置出人意料地帮助 SLDF 击败了多位 Kurita 决斗者。 特质：精准武器 - 导弹 部署费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: A skilled pilot at the controls of a PNT-12DC-I can tear the head off an enemy ‘Mech with a single shot at close range. And that is precisely what it has been designed to do – taking the fight to enemy ‘Mechs in a city environment.

column1: A special 'Mech for a very special Lady, who will be long missed. May she now rest in eternal peace and her legacy spread amongst the stars forever, bringing love to all as she always desired.

column1: A special refit of the Sun Spider, made deadlier by using 锁定式发射器s and Battlecomputers. Everything in the '机甲 is Clan spec, but the launchers look like they're a weird mix of Clan and Inner Sphere Tech. From the markings it looks like either a showcase 机甲 for research, or a museum showpiece. The close range viability of this Sun Spider is deadly, but it has few options at long distance.
column2: 这是太阳蜘蛛的特殊改装型，通过锁定式发射器和战斗计算机变得更加致命。机甲内的所有设备均为氏族规格，但发射器看起来像是氏族与内层圈技术的奇怪混合。根据标记判断，它要么是用于研究的展示机甲，要么是博物馆展品。这台太阳蜘蛛在近距离作战中极其危险，但远距离选择很少。

column1: A specially designed variant created for Duke Morgan Hasek-Davion. In return for a safe production facility for Bander BattleMechs, the Duke desired this line of -01Ds to bolster his personal forces. Two ArtemisIV-capable LRM10 launchers, in addition to keeping the dual LB 10-X Autocannons, ensures the long range capabilities of the 'Mech. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 专为杜克·摩根·哈塞克·达维恩 (Duke Morgan Hasek-Davion) 设计的变体。作为为班德战机提供安全生产设施的回报，公爵希望使用这一系列 -01D 来增强他的个人部队。两个支持 ArtemisIV 的 LRM10 发射器，除了保留双 LB 10-X 自动炮之外，还确保了“Mech. Quirk”的远距离能力：稳定 下降成本乘数：1.11 Arm执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: A stark departure from the standard design doctrine of the Sprite, the 3 mounts a pair of the new Fusillade launcher systems, backed by a pair of Medium Chemical Lasers. While limited in it’s main punch and entirely dependent on ammunition, the sheer versatility in available munition types for the Fusillade system allow it a great degree of battlefield versatility, from dealing heavy direct damage to disabling and overheating hostile vehicles and BattleMechs.
column2: Sprite 3 型完全背离标准设计理念，安装两套新型 Fusillade 发射系统，并以两门中型化学激光器支援。它的主要火力有限且完全依赖弹药，但 Fusillade 系统可使用多种弹药，因而拥有极强的战场适应性：既能造成直接伤害，也能瘫痪或过热敌方车辆与战斗机甲。

column1: A stealthy Crusader with Jump Jets, be prepared for pain delivered from above with little warning. And still it keeps a respectable level of weaponry. Impressive.
column2: 这是一台装备跳跃喷射器的隐身Crusader；准备好承受从上方突然袭来的痛击吧。即便如此，它仍保有相当可观的武器配置。令人印象深刻。

column1: A stolen, rewired, repurposed Marauder-4HB has been upgraded to an extent that is almost unbelievable. Normally these would be fielded by the Marian Hegemony loyalist units, but by God, whoever touched this thing had an ego to rival Seto Kaiba. Instead of the cheap rockets mounted in the torsos, there are iATMs. A LOT of iATMs. Apart from those, the electronics, cooling, engine and gyro have been upgraded. According to the onboard computer records, apparently there are multiple improvements that could be done, but they have been held back by 'Voices' in their head, telling them to put in different things or change that wire with another. Hope this doesn't happen to me while I work on this thing, Boss. I hate ghosts.
column2: 一台被偷走、重新接线并改造的 Marauder-4HB，升级程度几乎令人难以置信。通常这种机甲会由效忠马里安霸权的部队使用，但天知道改造它的人自负得足以和 Seto Kaiba 媲美。他们把躯干上廉价的火箭换成了 iATM——数量多得离谱。此外，电子设备、冷却系统、引擎和陀螺仪也都升级了。根据机载电脑记录，似乎还可以进行多项改进，但改造者脑中的“声音”阻止了他们，要求换装别的东西或把这根线换到另一根上。希望我修理它时不会发生这种事，Boss。我讨厌鬼魂。

column1: A support variant, the second most-commonly seen version of the Septicemia mounts two ATM 12s with three tons of ammunition for each. These are supplemented by three Heavy Small Lasers in each arm. Extra double heat sinks keeps heat levels in check.
column2: 这是 Septicemia 的支援型，也是最常见的第二种版本。它装备两门 ATM 12，每门配备三吨弹药；每只手臂另有三门重型小型激光器。额外的双散热器帮助控制热量。

column1: A support variant, this configuration carries two Arrow IV missile launchers and four tons of ammunition.
column2: 这是支援型配置，携带两具 Arrow IV 导弹发射器和四吨弹药。

column1: A surprisingly competent mech, coming from Quicsell... Yes, the armor is paper, but if you can avoid being shot at and stay at range, it has a huge amount of firepower for a light. Never let the enemy close to melee range though, that Heavy PPC might as well be a boat anchor in that case.
column2: 这是一台出人意料地能打的机甲，居然来自 Quicsell……没错，装甲薄得像纸，但只要避免挨打并保持距离，它对轻型机甲而言拥有巨量火力。不过千万别让敌人靠近到近战距离，那门重型 PPC 到时候还不如船锚。

column1: A surprisingly decent headhunter and pigeon shooter. Those so called 'LBX' lasers may silly, but they can certaily hit their intended target... with at least some of the power of a decent laser. So long as you're firing at soft and evasive foes, this thing actually stands a decent chance of killing them.
column2: 一台出人意料的优秀猎头机和打鸟机。那些所谓的“LBX”激光看起来很可笑，但确实能击中目标——至少还能发挥出普通激光的一部分威力。只要攻击脆弱且善于闪避的敌人，它其实很有机会把对方干掉。

column1: A typical refit seen in the periphery, this is the salvaged remains of multiple Urbanmechs; sheathed in repurposed industrial armour and carrying just enough ammo to survive a battle.

column1: A unique Champion variant, the Invictus is a custom build 设计ed for the battlefields of the Jihad. Built around an Endo Steel frame and 300-rated XL引擎; the mech is clad in 轻型铁纤维装甲-Fibrous 装甲. The Invictus is armed with a Large Laser and 锁定式SRM-4 in each arm, supported by a 锁定式SRM-6 in each side torso. Four tons of Streak SRM reloads, four jump jets and eleven double heat sinks give it surprising longevity and agility in battle.
column2: Invictus 是独特的 Champion 分型，为圣战战场定制设计。它采用 Endo Steel 骨架和 300 级 XL 引擎，覆盖轻型铁纤维装甲。每条手臂各配备一门大型激光和一组锁定式 SRM-4，两侧躯干各配备一组锁定式 SRM-6。四吨 Streak SRM 弹药、四台跳跃喷射器和十一台双重散热器，使它在战斗中拥有出色的续航与机动性。

column1: A unique FrankenMech created by the Tooth of Ymir Mercenary unit, the 100 ton Schwerer Gustav was built from parts sourced from a variety of destroyed mechs and grafted onto the remains of a salvaged Annihilator. Powered by a 400-rated XL Engine, the Schwerer Gustav mounts a 重击者火炮 Piece, with a 二元激光 and a Clan RAC/5 for close range combat. Intended as a 指挥机甲, a 指挥控制台 is mounted in the head and a 血猎犬主动探头 in the Center Torso.
column2: 舒维勒·古斯塔夫是由尤弥尔之牙佣兵部队制造的独特弗兰肯机甲。这个 100 吨机甲由多台被摧毁机甲的零件拼装而成，嫁接在一台回收的歼灭者残骸上。它由额定 400 的 XL 引擎驱动，装备一门重击者火炮、一门双联机枪和一门氏族 RAC/5，用于近距离战斗。作为指挥机甲，它在头部安装指挥控制台，并在中央躯干安装血猎犬主动探头。
