column1: A utilitarian medium-class workhorse, the Septicemeia is intently devoid of the more experimental technology utilised by the Cephalus and Osteon. 设计 for mass production, the Septicemia uses a combination of an XL引擎, Endo Steel chassis, and nine tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲 in order to mount 28 tons of weapons. The prime configuration is a long-range combatant with a HAG 40 and an ER Large Laser mounted in opposing torsos. A targeting computer improves the weapons accuracy.
column2: 塞普蒂克米亚是一款实用型中型主力机，几乎完全没有头足龙和奥斯顿所采用的实验性技术。它为大规模生产而设计，使用 XL 引擎、内骨骼钢底盘和 9 吨铁纤维装甲，从而能够搭载 28 吨武器。标准配置是远程战斗型，在左右躯干分别安装 HAG 40 和一门 ER 大型激光器；瞄准计算机可提高武器命中率。

This gave the SturmFeur increased ability to defend itself at short range and was sometimes used as a bodyguard for standard SturmFeurs. column1: A variant of the 6S developed in 3067 for the Com Guards only to also fall into hands of the 布雷克圣言会, the 6CS used an Endo Steel frame and was powered by an extralight engine. The 'Mech's primary weapons were an ER PPC and an Artemis IV-enabled LRM-15 launcher. The 6CS carries two ER medium lasers for short range engagements, and has an advanced electronics warfare suite, consisting of a 守护者ECM Suite and a C3i computer, to allow it to share targeting telemetry with friendly units.
column2: 6CS 是 6S 的改型，最初于 3067 年为 Com Guard 开发，后来也落入圣殿骑士团之手。它采用 Endo Steel 框架，并由超轻型引擎驱动。主武器为一门 ER PPC 和一具配备 Artemis IV 的 LRM-15 发射器；两门 ER 中型激光用于短程交战。先进电子战套件由 Guardian ECM 和 C3i 计算机组成，可与友军共享目标遥测数据。

column1: A variant of the Griffin 6S, introduced in 3071; the 5K is a nimble sniper, sporting enough improved jump jets for it to vault up to 240 米 in a single bound. Built around a 迪法恩斯轻型 引擎 and a Heavy Duty Gyro, the 5K has 10 tons of 轻型 铁纤维装甲 with a CASE added to protect the ammunition bay. Carrying a Light PPC, an LRM-10 and a ER 中型激光, the Griffin is equipped to handle combat at any range.
column2: Griffin 5K 是 6S 型的变体，于 3071 年推出，是一台灵活的狙击机甲，改进型跳跃喷射器可让它一次跃过 240 米。它采用迪法恩斯轻型引擎和重型陀螺仪，装有 10 吨轻型铁纤维装甲，并以 CASE 保护弹药舱。配备轻型 PPC、LRM-10 和一门增程中型激光，能够应对各个距离的战斗。

column1: A variant sold exclusively to the 布雷克圣言会, the 9K1B variant of the Falcon Hawk is a major upgrade of the 设计. The ER PPC, both medium pulse lasers, and the small pulse laser have all been removed, replaced with an ER large laser and a trio of ER medium lasers. The saved weight has been used to add a TAG laser 设计ator, a Beagle active probe, and a 守护者ECM suite. 怪癖: 均衡 掉落成本乘数: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 9K1B型猎鹰鹰是专门出售给布雷克圣言会的改型，对原设计进行了重大升级。ER PPC、两门中型脉冲激光和小型脉冲激光全部拆除，换成一门ER大型激光和三门ER中型激光。节省的重量用于增加TAG激光指示器、比格犬主动探头和守护者ECM套件。 怪癖：均衡 掉落成本乘数：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左侧下臂、右侧下臂

column1: A variant used exclusively by the Blakists starting in 3068, the 4WB swaps out the 铁纤维装甲 装甲 for stealth 装甲, resulting in a '机甲 that is more difficult to target at the cost of overall 装甲 protection. 怪癖: 改进的 Communications 掉落成本乘数: 0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower
column2: 布雷克分子自 3068 年起专用的改型，4WB 用潜行装甲替换铁纤维装甲，使机甲更难被锁定，但牺牲了整体装甲防护。 怪癖：改进型通信 掉落成本乘数: 0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower

column1: A variant with firepower on par with the ancient Awesome, the 'Mech comes with three Extended Range Particle Projection Cannons, mounted in each arm and left torso.
column2: 这是火力堪比古老 Awesome 的型号，双臂和左侧躯干各安装一门增程粒子投射炮。

column1: A variant with firepower on par with the ancient Awesome, the '机甲 comes with three Extended Range Particle Projection Cannons, mounted in each arm and left torso.
column2: 这是一台火力足以媲美古老的强袭者的变体，双臂和左侧躯干各安装一门延伸射程粒子投射炮，共三门。

column1: A versatile 60 ton chassis 开发 by 明尼苏达部落 engineers, the Lunar Crab shares a lot of 设计 considerations in common with its lighter cousin, the Crab. The Lunar Crab 1E carries a pair of ER Large Lasers and six 中型激光s. 怪癖: 稳定 Weapons 掉落成本乘数: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Lunar Crab是明尼苏达部落工程师开发的多用途60吨底盘，与较轻的Crab拥有许多共同设计理念。Lunar Crab 1E携带两门ER大型激光器和六门中型激光器。 怪癖： 稳定 武器 部署费用倍率: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: A versatile 60 ton chassis 开发 by 明尼苏达部落 engineers, the Lunar Crab shares a lot of 设计 considerations in common with its lighter cousin, the Crab. The Lunar Crab 1F shoulders a Flechette 20 and carries a pair of 中型激光s and a Small Laser in each arm. 怪癖: 稳定 Weapons 掉落成本乘数: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Lunar Crab是明尼苏达部落工程师开发的多用途60吨底盘，与较轻的Crab拥有许多共同设计理念。Lunar Crab 1F装备一门Flechette 20，双臂各携带两门中型激光器和一门小型激光器。 怪癖： 稳定 武器 部署费用倍率: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: A very advanced Locust, the IIC 9 uses the latest Clan tech to attempt to move beyond just the scout role.
column2: IIC 9 是一款非常先进的 Locust，它使用最新的 Clan 技术来尝试超越侦察角色。

column1: A very basic FedCom upgrade of the standard Atlas introduced in 3050, the S model removed five heat sinks from the design, upgrading the rest to 双散热器. The weight savings are used to add two rear firing Coventry T4H 锁定式SRM-2 launchers, giving the Atlas increased protection in its rear arc of fire. After the civil war production of this model ceased, although garrison forces in both sundered states continued to use them, with AFFS units using Precision Ammunition for the autocannon and LAAF units making use of specialized LRM munitions captured from the Free Worlds League.
column2: 这是3050年推出的标准Atlas的联邦升级版。S型从设计中移除五枚散热器，并将剩余散热器升级为双重散热器。减重后增加两具向后发射的Coventry T4H锁定式SRM-2，使Atlas的后方火力弧防护得到提升。内战后该型号停止生产，但两个分裂国家的驻军仍继续使用；AFFS部队为自动加农炮使用精准弹药，LAAF部队则使用从自由世界联盟缴获的专用LRM弹药。

column1: A very light sniper mech with a very big laser but cannot take a hit. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 一个非常轻的狙击机甲，带有非常大的激光，但不能被击中。 Quirk：改进的生命支持 下降成本乘数： 0.97 臂执行器限制：左上、右上

column1: A very mobile 'Mech, the Eris will cause you some headaches unless you deal with it. Its speed and jump capabilities means it can constantly reposition to attack from the flanks with its not insignificant weapons.
column2: 厄里斯是一种非常机动的机甲，除非你处理它，否则它会给你带来一些头痛。它的速度和跳跃能力意味着它可以不断地重新定位，用其不重要的武器从侧翼发起攻击。

column1: A very recent design from Jötunn BattleWorx, they bring together a lot of the recently learned clan technologies to create a powerful OmniMech. Thanks to its durability Mastodon MechWarriors often exaggerate signs of damage, prompting foes to overcommit in attempts to down them. Coordination with quicker units usually results in an enveloped and defeated opponent—and a still-functioning Mastodon.
column2: 这是 Jötunn BattleWorx 非常新的设计，将近期掌握的多项氏族技术结合起来，打造出强大的全能机甲。由于耐久性出色，Mastodon 的驾驶员常常故意夸大受损迹象，引诱敌人投入过多力量试图击毁它。只要与更快的单位协同，通常就能包围并击败对手，而 Mastodon 仍会继续运转。

column1: A very survivable mech. It's got Quicsell's special armor (which doesn't say much), and it's got a lot of it. About as much as the mech can carry, to be honest. Those missiles aren't that bad either. Swap out the Quicsell name brand stuff for the good stuff, and you'll have a decent mech. Just... Uh. Don't ask me to touch that damn engine.
column2: 这台机甲非常耐用。它有 Quicsell 的特殊装甲（不过这说明不了什么），而且装甲很多，老实说已经接近机体承载上限。那些导弹也不算太差。把 Quicsell 的品牌货换成真正的好东西，你就会得到一台不错的机甲。只是……呃，别让我碰那该死的引擎。

column1: A very survivable mech. It's got Quicsell's special 装甲 (which doesn't say much), and it's got a lot of it. About as much as the mech can carry, to be honest. Those missiles aren't that bad either. Swap out the Quicsell name brand stuff for the good stuff, and you'll have a decent mech. Just... Uh. Don't ask me to touch that damn 引擎.
column2: 一台非常耐打的机甲。它使用Quicsell的特制装甲（这并不能说明质量有多好），而且装得很多，老实说几乎达到了机体能承载的极限。那些导弹也不算差。把Quicsell的品牌货换成真正的好东西，你就能得到一台不错的机甲。只是……呃，别让我碰那台该死的引擎。

column1: A vintage Griffin refitted to the 6S standard and beyond with captured 布雷克圣言会 technology, when Francine rescued the Black Widow Company at the Royal Pass of the Ridges in 3070, her 'Mech carried half a ton less armor and swapped the 6S's ER PPC for an advanced 短管PPC as well as adding an extra ER medium laser to the left arm and a rear-facing small laser.
column2: 一架老式狮鹫改装成6S标准及更高标准，采用缴获的布雷克圣言会技术，当弗朗辛于3070年在山脊皇家通道营救黑寡妇连时，她的机甲少了半吨装甲，将6S的ER PPC换成了先进的短管PPC，并在左臂上增加了一个额外的ER中型激光器和一个后向小型激光器。

column1: A vintage Griffin refitted to the 6S standard and beyond with captured 布雷克圣言会 technology, when Francine rescued the Black Widow Company at the Royal Pass of the Ridges in 3070, her 'Mech carried half a ton less 装甲 and swapped the 6S's ER PPC for an advanced 短管PPC as well as adding an extra ER 中型激光器 to the left arm and a rear-facing small laser.
column2: 这是一台按 6S 标准及更高规格改装的老式 Griffin，使用缴获的布雷克圣言会技术。3070 年 Francine 在山脊皇家隘口救出黑寡妇连队时，她的机甲少了半吨装甲，将 6S 的 ER PPC 换成先进短管 PPC，并在左臂增加 ER 中型激光器和后向小型激光器。

column1: A weak attempt to hide from Word of Blake sensors. I wouldn't say the Guardian ECM makes a real difference, and the price in reduced weapons might be too high.
column2: 这是一次试图躲避布雷克之言传感器的拙劣尝试。我不认为守护者 ECM 真能带来明显效果，而为此牺牲武器可能代价过高。

column1: A weak attempt to hide from 布雷克圣言会 sensors. I wouldn't say the 守护者ECM makes a real difference, and the price in reduced weapons might be too high.
column2: 这是一次试图躲避布雷克圣言会传感器的拙劣尝试。我不认为守护者ECM真的起到了多大作用，而且以减少武器为代价换来的隐蔽性可能并不值得。

column1: A well equipped recon unit with a lot of firepower, the 86 is a direct evolution of the original mongoose design.
column2: 86 型是一台装备精良、火力强大的侦察单位，是原始 Mongoose 设计的直接发展型。

column1: A workhorse configuration, the Templar B can engage an enemy at either short or long ranges. For long range combat, the Templar B carries an ER PPC. For intermediate ranges, the 'Mech has three Rotary Autocannon/2s and also has two ER Medium Lasers for close combat. To handle the 'Mech's heat load, the Templar B has four additional double heat sinks.
column2: Templar B 是全能型配置，可在远近距离与敌人交战。远程作战时装备增程 PPC；中距离配备三门旋转自动炮/2，近战则使用两门增程中型激光。为处理热负荷，Templar B 额外安装四具双重散热器。

column1: A workhorse configuration, the Templar B can engage an enemy at either short or long ranges. For long range combat, the Templar B carries an ER PPC. For intermediate ranges, the 'Mech has three Rotary Autocannon/2s and also has two ER 中型激光器 for close combat. To handle the 'Mech's heat load, the Templar B has four additional double heat sinks.
column2: Templar B是一种多用途配置，可在近距离或远距离与敌人交战。远程作战时携带一门ER PPC；中距离配备三门转管自动炮/2，近战则使用两门ER中型激光器。为处理热量，Templar B额外安装四组双重散热器。

column1: A 坦克 formerly owned by filthy and demented pirates is the last place you'd expect a Shakespeare reference, but here we are. Renowned for its heavy punch, the 布鲁图斯突击坦克 features an impressive combination of long and short range firepower. Powered by a Rawlings 225 Fusion 引擎 with a top speed of 54kph, the Brutus compares well to other fusion 引擎 equipped 坦克s of similar weight and role like the Von Luckner and Manticore, though most variants are more lightly 装甲ed in exchange for a heavier weapons array. Despite its abilities, the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces remained lukewarm on the 设计. However it eventually found an enthusiastic user base among the Federated Suns. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 3/5 格 / 90/150 米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 200 40 左侧 160 40 右侧 160 40 后方 120 40 炮塔 165 40 总计 805 200 怪癖: 主战坦克
column2: 一辆曾属于肮脏而疯狂海盗的坦克，竟然会引用莎士比亚，这大概是最出人意料的地方。布鲁图斯突击坦克以强大的打击力闻名，结合了远程与近程火力。它由 Rawlings 225 聚变引擎驱动，最高速度 54 公里/小时；与同等重量和定位、同样配备聚变引擎的冯·卢克纳和曼提柯尔等坦克相比，布鲁图斯表现不俗，不过大多数变体会以较轻装甲换取更强的武器配置。尽管性能出色，卡佩兰联邦武装部队对这一设计仍兴趣寥寥，但它最终在联邦太阳中找到了热情的用户。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米。 装甲： 装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 200 40 左侧 160 40 右侧 160 40 后方 120 40 炮塔 165 40 总计 805 200 怪癖：主战坦克

column1: A 布雷克圣言会 design which emerged in 3076, the Griffin 4R uses 改进型跳跃推进器 to cover 270 米 at a time, and a larger 引擎 brings the top speed to 97 km/h. Carrying a 短管PPC, an MML-5 launcher, and an ER 中型激光, the 4R is a close range brawler. Endo Steel forms the chassis, and eleven double heat sinks keep the 'Mech cool.
column2: 布雷克圣言会于 3076 年推出的 Griffin 4R 使用改进型跳跃喷射器一次跃进 270 米，更大的引擎将最高速度提升至 97 km/h。它携带短管 PPC、MML-5 和 ER 中型激光器，是近战斗士；内骨骼钢构成底盘，11 具双散热器保持机甲冷却。

column1: A 布雷克圣言会 variant of the Wolverine, which as most of their variants use a lot of modern tech.
column2: 一款布雷克圣言会的狼獾变体；与他们大多数变体一样，采用了大量现代技术。

column1: A 氏族地狱马 variant made use of two 大型脉冲激光s in each arm and two ATM 9s with four tons of ammo in the torso. Two ER Micro Lasers to protect the 'Mech's rear arc, while the other equipment was removed to add heat sinks.
column2: 该星盟变体双臂各安装两门中型激光，并在躯干中装有两具ATM-9和四吨弹药。两门ER微型激光负责保护机甲后方，其他设备则被拆除以腾出空间增加散热器。

column2: 一台氏族钻石鲨 variant, the Medusa 5 retains three SRM-6 launchers but upgrades them，配备Artemis IV fire control systems. 该remaining weapons payload是dropped in favor的a pair的newly developed 等离子炮s, one in each arm.

column2: 这是一个玉鹰氏族改型，Medusa 5 保留三具 SRM-6 发射器，但为其升级了 Artemis IV 火控系统。其余武器载荷被取消，换成一对新开发的中型脉冲激光器，双臂各一具。 特性：标准瞄准增强 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: A 玉鹰氏族 variant that uses Experimental Technology extensively, the Kraken-XR was first spotted at Olivetti Weaponry on Sudeten. Replacing most Weapons with 4 Rotary AC/2 and 2 Streak LRM-10.
column2: 这是玉鹰氏族广泛采用实验技术的变型。Kraken-XR最初在Sudeten的Olivetti武器公司被发现，用4门转管自动炮/2和2具Streak LRM-10替换了大部分武器。

column1: A 球体共和国 redesign of the 500 year-old Icarus II, the -2R completely replaces the autocannon and laser payload of most Icarus II designs in favor for a pair of debilitating TSEMP磁脉冲炮s and a Tag. 特性：瞄准增强—近程 部署成本倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower
column2: 这是球体共和国对有500年历史的Icarus II进行的重新设计，以2门压制性的TSEMP磁脉冲炮和一具TAG彻底替换大多数Icarus II型号的机炮与激光配置。 特性：瞄准增强—近程 部署费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左侧下臂

column1: AWS-8R 以一门大型激光和成对的 LRM-15 取代更昂贵的 PPC。虽然此变体仍能造成相近的伤害，却因依赖有限的弹药储备而吃亏。 Quirk: 战斗铁拳 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: AWS-8R 以一具大型导弹发射器取代一门 PPC，降低了热量负荷，却牺牲了远距离伤害输出。它仍拥有惊人的火力，但弹药储量有限，需要谨慎规划射击。 特性：战斗铁拳 部署费用倍率：1.12 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: Abandoned during Operation BULLDOG, this Balar was later recovered by DCMS forces. The damage to the original chassis was extensive, but the modularity of the 全向Pods allowed it to be restored to battlefield service in short order. 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 这台Balar在BULLDOG行动期间被遗弃，后来由龙马联盟军队回收。原始底盘损坏严重，但全向舱位的模块化设计使其很快恢复战场服役。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Achernar built this when the AFFS needed something they could actually manufacture with what they had left after the Succession Wars. The LN-15 ended up being a big export seller to the Free Worlds League and the Magistracy. Finding any of these variants is reasonably straightforward compared to some of what comes through the bay.
column2: 当 AFFS 需要一种能用继承战争后残余资源实际生产的机甲时，Achernar 造出了它。LN-15 最终成为自由世界联盟和金星都督府的大卖出口型号。与那些偶尔出现在机甲库里的稀有型号相比，这些变体相当容易找到。

column1: After Clan Hell's Horses forces' invaded the Rasalhague Dominion during Operation Noyan in 3147, the Mastodon was designed and signified a large change from their previous reliance on a mix of Executioner variants as the mainstay of their army. The Mastodon's performance after its introduction makes it inevitable that it will be at the forefront of many campaigns to come. The heavily reinforced 结构 resists both weapons fire and the standard wear and tear that accompanies most campaigns. The A configuration combines an Artemis IV enabled LRM-15 launcher with three Large Pulse Lasers and a Gauss Rifle. 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 3147年诺扬行动期间，氏族地狱马部队入侵拉萨尔哈格自治领后，Mastodon应运而生，标志着他们不再主要依赖Executioner系列变型作为军队支柱。Mastodon投入使用后的表现表明，它必将成为未来许多战役的先锋。经过强化的结构可抵御武器火力以及大多数战役中常见的正常磨损。A配置将装配Artemis IV的LRM-15发射器、三门大型脉冲激光和一门高斯步枪组合在一起。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: After finishing the development of the Osteon, the Society moved into superheavy territory with the 150 ton Keratos. A 420 XL engine core provides the 'Mech's power, and a radical double heat sink kit is used as the cooling system. Still focused on ranged attack, mostly through ATM launchers, it shares many of the traits of the original Osteon. The Keratos is the first Society developed 'Mech that uses the new Superheavy CLPS, which operates at a slightly lower capacity than the standard version due to the difference in frame size of superheavies.
column2: 社团完成 Osteon 的研发后，又凭借 150 吨的 Keratos 进军超重型领域。420 XL 引擎核心为机甲提供动力，激进型双重散热器套件负责冷却。它仍然专注于远程攻击，主要依靠 ATM 发射器，并继承了许多 Osteon 的特征。Keratos 是社团研发的第一台采用新型超重型 CLPS 的机甲；由于超重型机架尺寸不同，其工作容量略低于标准版本。

column2: Draconis Combine 俘获 Quentin 及 Raijin 生产设施后，对这台机甲进行了改造并重新命名为 Fujin，供出口和 DCMS 使用。

column1: After the Liberation of Terra many Celestials have been captured by Republic Forces, using them as Testbed for advanced design for their Future Forces was this Archangel Recreated, sacrificing Omni Capabilities for Advanced Defenses and replacing the Blade for a Large Vibro Blade.
column2: 泰拉解放后，共和国军队俘获了许多天体机甲，并将它们用作未来部队先进设计的试验平台。这台 Archangel 就是在此基础上重建的，牺牲 Omni 能力换取先进防御，并以一把大型振动刀取代原有刀刃。

column1: After the Penetrator PTR-4D of Major General Archer Christifori, known as the leader of militia group Archer's Avengers, was heavily damage during intense fighting against six Jaguar 'Mechs on its own, Archer eventually rebuilt the 'Mech and took the chance to customize it to his own preferences.
column2: Archer Christifori 少将是民兵组织 Archer's Avengers 的领袖。其 Penetrator PTR-4D 在独自与六台 Jaguar 机甲激战时严重受损，Archer 最终重建了机体，并趁机按个人偏好进行了定制。

column1: After the Word of Blake was defeated in the Jihad, Maxwell-Pulaski Motors modified the design slightly and produced it for the Republic of the Sphere in 3084. The main differences are the removal of its Blakist features. The infantry bay was reduced to four tons, and the C3i system was replaced by a C3 slave unit. The machine gun ammunition was reduced to half a ton. All these changes increased the pod space available to the RAF Bollas by four and a half tons, but the turret can only mount fifteen tons of equipment. The Stealth Armor was retained, as was the Guardian ECM suite. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. column1: After 氏族地狱马 forces' invaded the 蛇夫座自治领 during Operation Noyan in 3147, the Mastodon was designed and signified a large change from their previous reliance on a mix of Executioner variants as the mainstay of their army. column1: Ah, the joys of weapon modularity. column2: 啊，武器模块化的乐趣。作为机甲技师，干久了以后，你会不再从武器是什么的角度看它们，而是开始考虑它们能装在哪里。对 Blue Shot 的家伙来说——没错，LB 20-X AC 和高斯步枪就是一回事。

column1: Aleksandr Hazen: Arguably the Gyrfalcon’s most famous MechWarrior, he was Galaxy Commander of Zeta Galaxy during the Clan's desant into the Republic of the Sphere in 3134. Piloting his 'Mech which he named the White Lily, he would artfully cut through enemy forces in the Republic until reaching Prefecture IX's Capital of Skye. With his sibkin, Galaxy Commander Malvina Hazen, they would nearly take the world through his methods. However, he would be killed in action with Prefect Tara Campbell at the hands of her Hatchetman signature weapon. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 亚历山大·黑兹：他或许是最著名的 Gyrfalcon 机师。3134 年氏族突袭球体共和国期间，他担任泽塔星系的星系指挥官。他驾驶着自己命名为“白百合”的机甲，在共和国境内巧妙地突破敌军，直抵第九专区首府斯凯。与他的同胞、星系指挥官玛尔维娜·黑兹并肩作战时，他凭借这套战法几乎夺下了整颗星球。然而，他最终在与专区长塔拉·坎贝尔交战时，被她标志性的战斧机甲武器击毙。 特性：扰人 部署费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: All of the offensive weaponry on this Ursa has been replaced or broken down. The Medium Pulse lasers have been 'piratified' and put into the 左侧 and 右侧 Torso, while the RAC2 was wholly replaced by a Pirate AC20 with 稳定外壳, but i'm not even sure it's going to help that much. They put in some kind of TAG System in the Head but its taking up a lot of space. The MASC and XL引擎 have been ripped out to make space for some kind of Fuel intake for a Nitro Canister to increase its speed. Parts of the Armour have been lined with Spalling, to decrease Shrapnel that might come off of this thing for whatever Reason. There is also a Double Heatsink kit in there, to my surprise. This thing will blow itself up anyway as soon as that Nitro reaches the Core.
column2: 这台Ursa的所有进攻武器都被替换或拆解。中型脉冲激光被“海盗化”后装进左、右两侧躯干；RAC2则彻底换成带稳定器的海盗AC20，但我不确定这能帮上多大忙。他们在头部塞进了某种TAG系统，却占用了大量空间。MASC和XL引擎被拆掉，为某种燃料进气装置腾出位置，再通过硝基罐提高速度。部分装甲内衬了防剥落层，以减少各种原因造成的碎片飞散。里面居然还有一套双联散热器组件，真让人意外。不过硝基燃料一旦抵达核心，这东西迟早会把自己炸上天。

column1: Almost a direct counter-point to the Prime, the A Config mounts twin Ultra AC/2s in each side torso, supported by an ER Large Laser in each arm if the two tons of Ultra reloads run dry. The config is rounded out by an extra 双散热器.
column2: A型几乎是Prime型的直接反制版本：每侧躯干各装两门Ultra AC/2；如果两吨Ultra弹药耗尽，双臂的ER大型激光可继续提供火力。该配置还增加了一组双散热器。

column1: Almost identical to the standard version of the Red Shift introduced in 3063, the 2B is modified to find hidden enemy units by removing the ECM Suite and replacing it with a Beagle Active Probe.
column2: 2B型几乎与3063年推出的标准Red Shift相同，但移除了ECM套件并换成比格犬主动探头，以发现隐藏的敌方单位。

column1: Alright as a sniper, I guess, but useless as a general mech. Too slow and too lightly armored. If you know where you're going to be engaging the enemy then I suppose you can use it for overwatch, since that 'target lock' on those Heavy PPCs will at least prevent friendly fire accidents.
column2: 作为狙击机还行吧，但用作通用机甲就毫无用处。速度太慢、装甲太薄。如果你知道交战地点，倒可以拿它做监视火力，因为那些重型 PPC 的“目标锁定”至少能避免误伤友军。

column1: Alt configuration P of the Arctic Wolf 全向Mech features a ER Large and ER 中型激光 in left arm and paired ER Mediums in the right arm, supported by twin 锁定式SRM-4s in the left torso and two ER Small Lasers in right torso. Two tons of Stream reloads and five extra double heat sinks keep the Arctic Wolf P in battle.
column2: Arctic Wolf OmniMech 的 P 备用配置在左臂装备增程大型激光器和增程中型激光器，右臂装备两门增程中型激光器；左侧躯干配备两具改进型 SRM-4，右侧躯干配备两门增程小型激光器。两吨 Stream 弹药和五组额外双散热器让 Arctic Wolf P 能持续作战。

column1: Although not having the same alpha strike potential as some other loadsouts, this one is flexible with its standard ammunition loadout to deal with several different scenarios a Crossbow can find itself in.
column2: 虽然不具有与其他一些装备相同的阿尔法打击潜力，但这款装备的标准弹药装备非常灵活，可以应对十字弓可能遇到的几种不同情况。

column1: An 80-ton Quad Mech, the Goliath entered production in 2652. Partially based on data from the earlier Scorpion Quad Mech, the Goliath carries a heavier payload of weapons and armor, intended to boost it's effectiveness on the battlefield. Powered by a 320-rated Fusion Core, the Goliath GOL-1H is armed with a PPC and a pair of LRM-10's. A pair of Machine Guns provide closer ranged firepower.
column2: 戈利亚斯是一款 80 吨四足机甲，于 2652 年投产。它的设计部分参考了更早的蝎式四足机甲数据，配备更重的武器与装甲载荷，以提升战场效能。GOL-1H 由 320 级融合核心驱动，装备一门 PPC 和一对 LRM-10。一对机枪则提供更近距离的火力。

column1: An AC20 should not move that fast, boss. It just ain't right.

column1: An Advanced Tech version of the Toyama that was introduced during the Jihad. The 1C was re-designed as a fire support 'Mech. Its long-range weaponry includes; an Artemis IV-enhanced LRM-20 Launcher with 2 tons of CASE-protected ammunition and a Gauss Rifle with 2 tons of ammunition. For the 'Mech's secondary weaponry, it has two Medium Variable Speed Pulse Lasers mounted in the right arm. The 'Mech has also been equipped with an XL Gyro and retains the original's Endo Steel.
column2: Toyama 的先进科技版本，于圣战期间推出。1C 被重新设计为火力支援机甲，远程武器包括一具 Artemis IV 增强型 LRM-20 发射器（配备两吨 CASE 保护弹药）和一把高斯步枪（配备两吨弹药）。副武器是安装在右臂的两门中型变速脉冲激光器。机甲还装备 XL 陀螺仪，并保留原版 Endo Steel。

column1: An all-rounder mech from Quicsell. It's only got SRMs, but those are pretty versatile. It would technically be cooking itself, if it weren't for the fact that half the missiles are used as temporary Streak modules for the other half, meaning only successful target locks get launched. Watch that engine though, one side torso, and the mech's toast.
column2: Quicsell 的全能型机甲。它只有 SRM，但这些导弹用途很广。严格来说它会把自己煮熟，因为一半导弹被临时当作另一半的 Streak 模块使用，只有成功锁定目标的那部分才会发射。不过要盯紧引擎：只要一侧躯干出问题，这台机甲就完了。

column1: An ambush predator that originated in the Solaris VII arenas, Harmony MetalWorks' Violator originally rose to prominence through both the arena fights and the actions of a band of aces from the Regulan Fiefs during the late thirty-first century. The Violator's reputation continued to improve in the thirty-second century from continued arena performances and combat actions featuring the mech in service with the Regulan Hussars. The flashy reputation the Violator earned in the arenas belied the ease with which the Violator can be maintained and repaired, but despite the nine tons of Heavy standard armor and an Armored Cockpit the Violator wasn't suited for line combat.
column2: Harmony MetalWorks 的 Violator（侵扰者）是一种源自 Solaris VII 竞技场的伏击猎手。三十一世纪末，它凭借竞技场战斗以及 Regulan 领地一群王牌的战绩声名鹊起。进入三十二世纪后，随着竞技场持续参赛，以及 Regulan 骠骑兵服役期间的战斗表现，Violator 的声誉进一步提升。它在竞技场赢得的华丽名声掩盖了其易于维护和维修的特点；然而，尽管配备九吨重型标准装甲和装甲驾驶舱，Violator 仍不适合线列作战。

column2: RISC 试图把老式 Hollander 改装成莱拉 Hollander II 的高性能规格，在底盘上硬塞一门重型高斯步枪。虽然证明技术上可行，但成本同样高得无法承受，需要整条装配线。

column1: An early FedSuns BattleMech, the 75 ton Hammerhands debuted in 2475 and served as one of the progenitor designs that would influence the iconic Warhammer. Powered by a 225-rated Fusion Core, the Hammerhands HMH-5D is armed with a pair of AC/10’s, with a pair of ER Medium Lasers supporting the autocannon at close range. A C3 Slave allows the HMH-5D to function as part of a C3 enabled Lance, while Improved Jump Jets give it additional mobility.
column2: Hammerhands 是联邦太阳共和国早期的战斗机甲，75 吨的它于 2475 年问世，并成为影响 Warhammer 的先驱设计之一。Hammerhands HMH-5D 由 225 级聚变核心驱动，装备一对 AC/10，另有一对增程中型激光近距离支援。C3 从属单元使其能作为 C3 联网长机的一部分行动，改进型跳跃喷射器则提供额外机动性。

column1: An early FedSuns BattleMech, the 75 ton Hammerhands debuted in 2475 and served as one of the progenitor designs that would influence the iconic Warhammer. Powered by a 225-rated Fusion Core, the Hammerhands HMH-6E is armed with a pair of RAC/5’s, with a pair of 中型激光s supporting the RAC’s at close range. A C3 Slave allows the HMH-5D to function as part of a C3 enabled Lance, while 改进型跳跃推进器 and TSM give it additional mobility. 守护者ECM adds to the Mechs defensive capabilities.
column2: 锤手是早期联邦太阳战斗机甲之一，于 2475 年首次亮相，并成为影响标志性战锤设计的先驱型号之一。它由额定 225 的聚变核心驱动，锤手 HMH-6E 配备一对 RAC/5；另有一对中型激光在近距离为 RAC 提供支援。C3 从属计算机使 HMH-5D 能够作为 C3 网络长枪小队的一员行动，改进型跳跃喷射器和 TSM 则提高其机动性。守护者 ECM 进一步增强了机甲的防御能力。

column1: An experimental field refit kit for the -1532 Jackal 开发 by Earthwerks, the -1579 retained the ER PPC and anti-missile system while switching to double heat sinks to free up weight for a few appliqué 装甲 panels. The main difference was the replacement of the unloved 锁定式SRM-2 launcher and its attendant ammo with a PPC capacitor to boost the effectiveness of its sole offensive weapon, and an advanced Angel ECM suite to protect the 设计 from enemy electronics. 怪癖: 改进的 Cooling Jacket - PPC 掉落成本乘数: 0.99
column2: 这是 Earthwerks 为 -1532 Jackal 开发的实验性战地改装套件。-1579 保留 ER PPC 和反导系统，改用双散热器，为附加装甲板腾出重量。它用 PPC 电容器替换不受欢迎的锁定式 SRM-2 及弹药，并加装先进天使 ECM 保护设计免受敌方电子战影响。 怪癖：改进型冷却夹套 - PPC 掉落成本乘数: 0.99

column1: An experimental prototype 开发 by Arc-Royal 机甲Works, this version used a Torso-Mounted Cockpit, 轻型引擎, and Endo Steel skeleton as the frame to carry six 改进的 Jump Jets. The standard weaponry is replaced with a head mounted 中型脉冲激光 and a 浮夸激光 in each arm. To find its opponents, the head also carries a 血猎犬主动探头. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.12
column2: Arc-Royal机甲Works开发的实验原型机，该版本使用躯干安装驾驶舱、轻型发动机和Endo Steel骨架作为框架，可携带六架改进的跳跃喷气机。标准武器装备被替换为头戴式中型脉冲激光和各臂上的浮夸激光。为了找到对手，头部还带有血猎犬主动探头。 怪癖：强化 可疑成本乘数： 1.12

column1: An experimental reworking of the Gallant's original weapons array 开发 by Federated Suns, this variant featured a pair of 雷电10 Launchers in place of the 大型脉冲激光s. The '机甲's secondary weapon systems were exchanged for four 中型X脉冲激光 Lasers. CASE was added to protect the ammunition for the Thunderbolt Launchers. 怪癖: 稳定 Weapons 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Upper
column2: 这是对 Gallant 原有武器阵列的实验性重制，由联邦太阳联合会完成。该改型以一对雷霆 10 发射器替换原有的小型脉冲激光器。Gallant 的副武器系统改为四具 X 脉冲大型激光器，并加装 CASE 保护雷霆发射器的弹药。 特性: 稳定武器 部署费用倍率: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Upper

column1: An experimental testbed configuration sighted in use among the Blakist Shadow Divisions in 3075, the Caelestis config features a right arm mounted Thunderbolt 10 complimented by a Binary Laser Cannon in each side torso. Support weaponry comes in the form of a pair of Clan-tech ER Small Lasers in the left arm, two Clan ER Mediums in the center torso and a pair of head mounted ER Flamers. A single ton of thunderbolt missiles is carried, while seventeen double heat sinks keep its energy weapons firing.
column2: 这是 3075 年在 Blakist Shadow Divisions 中发现的实验测试平台。Caelestis 配置右臂安装一门 Thunderbolt 10，两侧躯干各有一门 Binary Laser Cannon。支援武器包括左臂两门氏族科技增程小型激光器、中央躯干两门氏族增程中型激光器，以及头部两门增程喷火器。机体携带一吨 Thunderbolt 导弹，十七组双散热器让能量武器能够持续射击。

column1: An experimental testbed configuration sighted in use among the Blakist Shadow Divisions in 3075, the Caelestis configuration features a PPC Capacitor enhanced ER PPC mounted on its right arm, supported by a trio of ER Small Lasers.
column2: Caelestis 配置是 3075 年在 Blakist Shadow Division 中使用的实验性测试台配置，其右臂上安装有 PPC 电容器增强型 ER PPC，由三个 ER 小型激光器支持。

column1: An experimental upgrade of the prototype K3, this Kuritan variant carries twin Heavy and Light PPCs linked to a Prototype Capacitor.
column2: 这款 Kuritan 变体是原型 K3 的实验性升级版，带有与原型电容器相连的双重型和轻型 PPC。

column1: An experimental variant of the Jenner 开发 by Luthien 装甲 Works in 3072. Using the JR7-K as its base the 设计ers sought to update the mech with new technology. The internal 结构 was swapped for a composite version. Its 引擎 was replaced with a 245-rated XL引擎, maintaining the original speed. The forward jutting cockpit was replaced with a 躯干挂载 Cockpit. The old SRM's were completely dropped in favor of increasing the '机甲's 中型激光器 armament to six 中型激光s. For the '机甲's protection, it has Angel ECM and its hull has been encased with seven tons of 装甲. For its stealth capacities, the '机甲 has been given an Experimental Null-Signature System. Only seven of these '机甲s were known to have been built. 怪癖: 改进的 Lifesupport 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 这是 Luthien 装甲工坊于 3072 年开发的 Jenner 实验改型，以 JR7-K 为基础更新技术。内部结构换成复合结构，引擎替换为 245 级 XL 引擎以保持原速度，前置驾驶舱改为躯干挂载驾驶舱。旧 SRM 全部移除，机甲中型激光器增加至六具；天使 ECM 和七吨装甲提供防护，实验型零信号系统增强潜行能力。已知仅制造七台。 怪癖：改进型生命维持 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: An experimental variation first sighted in 3086, the 凤鹰 IIC 8 benefits from the XXL 引擎 first 开发 for the Dasher II, freeing up nine extra tons over the more common 400-rated XL引擎. A shell of standard 装甲 wrapped around an Endo Steel frame, the 8 Variant mounts an ER PPC and two 小型脉冲激光s in each side torso, an ECM Suite and five 改进的 Jump Jets making it agile and deadly. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.2
column2: 这款于 3086 年首次发现的实验改型，凤鹰 IIC 8 采用最初为 Dasher II 开发的 XXL 引擎，相比常见的 400 级 XL 引擎多出九吨可用重量。标准装甲包覆内骨骼钢框架，双侧躯干各安装一具 ER PPC 和两具小型脉冲激光器；ECM 套件与五具改进型跳跃喷射器使其灵活而致命。 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.2

column1: An experimental 机甲 生产 by Comstar during the Jihad, the 灭绝者 EXT-6CS is built around a rare Chameleon Light Polarisation Shield. A 390-rated XL引擎 and Endo Steel allow the 机甲 to mount paired Light PPCs and 中型脉冲激光s. AN MML-7 provides additional firepower with CASE II protecting the munitions. 怪癖: Nimble 掉落成本乘数: 1.09
column2: 这是 ComStar 在圣战期间生产的实验机甲，围绕罕见的变色龙轻型偏振护盾构建。390 级 XL 引擎和内骨骼钢让它能安装两具轻型 PPC 和中型脉冲激光器，MML-7 提供额外火力，CASE II 保护弹药。 怪癖：灵巧 掉落成本乘数: 1.09

column1: An extensively remodeled variant 开发 by the Ceres Metal facility on Menke in 3085, the 超级自动炮 is replaced with a Luxor Mobile Battery Arrow IV system. While the original Po was intended to be cheap and simple to manufacture and maintain, the modern upgrade traded the Ceres 240 internal combustion 引擎 with a much more expensive but considerably lighter Pitban 240 XL Fusion 引擎 to allow a great deal increase in firepower. Eleven tons of 装甲, a modest increase of half a ton, provided average protection for the 车辆's weight. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 4/6 格 / 120/180 米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 230 30 左侧 175 30 右侧 175 30 后方 140 30 炮塔 175 30 总计 895 150 怪癖: 主战坦克
column2: 这是Ceres Metal在Menke设施于3085年开发的深度改装型，以Luxor机动电池Arrow IV系统替换超级自动炮。原版Po原本追求廉价、易于生产和维护；现代升级型则用昂贵但轻得多的Pitban 240 XL聚变引擎替换Ceres 240内燃机，以显著增加火力。11吨装甲仅增加了半吨，为这辆车的重量提供平均水平的防护。 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 4/6 格 / 120/180 米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 230 30 左侧 175 30 右侧 175 30 后方 140 30 炮塔 175 30 总计 895 150 怪癖: 主战坦克

column1: An improvement over your garden variety Lynx, boss. Between that fancy ERPPC and the improved Large Lasers, this thing packs a punch.
column2: 这是普通 Lynx 的改进型，Boss。那门炫酷的 ERPPC 和改进型大型激光让它火力十足。

column1: An interesting take on a modern Locust. Those twin MagShots combined with a Medium X-Pulse really is not something we have seen before on one.
column2: 这是对现代化蝗虫机甲的一种有趣诠释。双联 MagShot 配合一门中型 X-Pulse，这种组合此前确实少见。

column1: An interesting take on a modern Locust. Those twin MagShots combined with a 中型X脉冲激光 really is not something we have seen before on one.
column2: 这是对现代化Locust的有趣尝试。两门MagShot与一门中型X脉冲激光结合，在同一台机甲上实属少见。

column1: An interesting upgrade to the Locust IIC focused on dealing with other Light 'Mechs. And does a damn good job at it.
column2: 这是 Locust IIC 针对其他轻型机甲的一次有趣升级，而且效果相当出色。

column1: An odd experimental 设计, the Maxim Flanker is 设计ed to increase the hovercraft's performance while dropping troops, it has much more 装甲 on its right side than on its left side. The idea was to present a heavily-装甲ed broadside to the enemy while performing its primary duty. 生物群系限制: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. 移动: 8/12 hexes / 240/360 meters. 装甲: Ferro-Fibrous 结构: 结构 Values A S 前方 95 25 左侧 50 25 右侧 220 25 后方 60 25 炮塔 95 25 总计 520 125 怪癖: 坚固

column1: An unusual Clan 设计, the Tercio 4 is almost fully focused on very long range, indirect fire. column1: An unusual Urbanmech, the UM-R62 trades fire power for range. The removal of the standard weapons systems allows for the installation of an AC/2 and a PPC, inverting the usual Urbanmech load out. Deployed as a fire support and AA mech alongside infantry and armor units, the UM-R62’s range more than makes up for its slow speed and lack of heavy firepower.

column2: HZD-2 是对 Hazard HZD-1A 的升级型。该设计最初出现在马里安霸权入侵天狼星联邦的后期阶段。HZD-2 将 SHS 升级为 DHS，并为 SRM 发射器额外增加一吨弹药。标准中型激光器也被中型脉冲激光器取代。

column1: An upgrade of the Hazard HZD-1A first seen in the later stages of the 马里安霸权 invasion of the 圆规座联合会, the HZD-2 upgrades the SHS to DHS models and adds an extra ton of ammo for the SRM launchers. 中型脉冲激光s replace the standard 中型激光s.
column2: 这是Hazard HZD-1A的升级型，最早出现在马里安霸权入侵圆规座联合会的后期。HZD-2将单重散热器升级为双重散热器，并为SRM发射器增加一吨弹药；中型脉冲激光器替换标准中型激光器。

column1: An upgrade of the Highlander introduced in 3115, the Highlander 740 is powered by a 270-rated Fusion Core. An ER PPC is paired with an Artemis IV augmented LRM-20 for long range combat, while a Streak SRM-6, 2 M-Pods and a pair of ER Medium Lasers cover close range combat.
column2: 高地人 740 是 3115 年推出的升级型号，由 270 级融合核心驱动。一门增程 PPC 与一具配备 Artemis IV 的 LRM-20 负责远程作战；Streak SRM-6、两具 M-Pod 和一对增程中型激光器则负责近距离交战。

column1: An upgrade of the Highlander introduced in 3115, the Highlander 740 is powered by a 270-rated Fusion Core. An ER PPC is paired with an Artemis IV augmented LRM-20 for long range combat, while a 锁定式SRM-6, 2 M-Pods and a pair of ER 中型激光s cover close range combat.
column2: 高地人 740 是 3115 年推出的高地人升级型，由额定 270 的聚变核心驱动。远程武器是一门 ER PPC 和一具经阿尔忒弥斯 IV 增强的 LRM-20；近距离武器包括一具锁定式 SRM-6、两具 M-Pod 和一对 ER 中型激光。

column1: An upgrade of the Highlander introduced in 3115, the Highlander 740 is powered by a 270-rated Fusion Core. An ER PPC is paired with an Artemis IV augmented LRM-20 for long range combat, while a 锁定式SRM-6, 2 M-Pods and a pair of ER 中型激光s cover close range combat. 特性：强化腿部 部署成本倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: Highlander的升级型号，于3115年推出，由额定功率270的融合核心驱动。ER PPC与配备阿尔忒弥斯IV的LRM-20搭配，用于远距离作战；锁定式SRM-6、两具M型吊舱和一对ER中型激光则负责近距离作战。 特性：强化腿部 部署费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右侧下臂

column1: An upgrade of the Mongoose introduced in 3129, the Mongoose MON-96 is powered by a 200-rated Light Engine augmented by a Supercharger. Armed with 3 ER Medium Lasers and an ER Small Laser, the MON-96 carries a Bloodhound Active Probe in the right torso.
column2: Mongoose MON-96 是 3129 年推出的 Mongoose 升级型，由 200 级轻型引擎和增压器驱动。它装备三门增程中型激光和一门增程小型激光，右侧躯干搭载 Bloodhound 主动探测器。

column1: An upgrade of the Mongoose introduced in 3129, the Mongoose MON-96 is powered by a 200-rated 轻型引擎 augmented by a Supercharger. Armed with 3 ER 中型激光s and an ER Small Laser, the MON-96 carries a 血猎犬主动探头 in the right torso.
column2: Mongoose MON-96 是 3129 年推出的 Mongoose 升级型，由 200 级轻型引擎驱动，并由增压器强化。它装备三门增程中型激光器和一门增程小型激光器，右侧躯干携带血猎犬主动探头。

column1: An upgrade of the Watchman made after the incursion into the Draconis Combine by James Sandoval, the Duke of Robinson, the 4DM upgrades the Watchman to make it more potent on the modern battlefield. The 'Mech has had the Large Laser and Machine Guns replaced with a PPC, giving the 'Mech a great deal of long range firepower. The 'Mech has also upgraded its heat sinks to double heat sinks and the armor has been upgraded to Ferro-Fibrous armor, providing the 'Mech with better armor protection.
column2: 这是James Sandoval、Robinson公爵入侵龙马联盟后对Watchman进行的升级，4DM让Watchman在现代战场上更具威力。大型激光和机枪被一门PPC替换，带来强大的远程火力；散热器升级为双重散热器，装甲升级为铁纤维装甲，提供更好的防护。

column1: An upgrade of the Watchman made after the incursion into the Draconis Combine by James Sandoval, the Duke of Robinson, the 4DM upgrades the Watchman to make it more potent on the modern battlefield. The 'Mech has had the Large Laser and Machine Guns replaced with a PPC, giving the 'Mech a great deal of long range firepower. The 'Mech has also upgraded its heat sinks to double heat sinks and the 装甲 has been upgraded to 铁纤维装甲 装甲, providing the 'Mech with better 装甲 protection.
column2: 这是James Sandoval、Robinson公爵在龙马联盟入侵后对Watchman进行的升级改装，使其更适合现代战场。机甲用一门PPC替换大型激光器和机枪，大幅增强远程火力；散热器升级为双重散热器，装甲升级为铁纤维装甲，提供更好防护。

column1: An upgrade package incorporating Helm core technology, the Grasshopper 5P is armed with 2 中型激光s, 2 Medium pulse Lasers and 2 PPCs with 双散热器 installed to handle the increased heat.
column2: 作为纳入地狱核心技术的升级包，蚱蜢5P装有2门中型激光、2门中型脉冲激光和2门粒子加农炮，并安装双散热器以应对增加的热量。ZH

column1: An upgraded model of the Oro produced by 地狱马 in the run up to Operation Revival which downgrades the weapons with the freed weight being dedicated to additional armour, an 主动探头 and a bulldozer blade. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：4/6 格 / 120/180 米. 装甲： 铁纤维装甲(氏族) 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 210 30 左侧 170 30 右侧 170 30 后方 100 30 炮塔 150 30 总计 800 150 特性：防空瞄准系统
column2: 这是地狱马在复兴行动前夕生产的Oro升级型。它降低了武器配置，将腾出的重量用于增装装甲、主动探头和推土铲。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：4/6 格 / 120/180 米. 装甲： 铁纤维装甲(氏族) 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 210 30 左侧 170 30 右侧 170 30 后方 100 30 炮塔 150 30 总计 800 150 特性：防空瞄准系统

column1: An upgraded version of the Vanquisher, the 5V keeps the ER Large Lasers of the 2A. It trades out the Light Gauss rifles, however, in favor of a Heavy Gauss Rifle. Two of the ER Medium Lasers are retained, and a pair of B-Pods are added for defense against battle armor. Ferro-Fibrous armor is utilized, though a Compact Engine is needed to make room. A Heavy-Duty Gyro increases the 5V's survivability.
column2: 5V 型是征服者的升级型，保留了 2A 型的增程大型激光器，但将轻型高斯步枪换成一门重型高斯步枪。它保留两门增程中型激光器，并加装一对 B-Pod 用于防御战斗装甲。机体采用铁纤维装甲，但为腾出空间还需使用紧凑型引擎。重型陀螺仪提升了 5V 的生存能力。

column1: An upgraded version of the Vanquisher, the 5V keeps the ER Large Lasers of the 2A. It trades out the Light Gauss rifles, however, in favor of a 重型高斯步枪. Two of the ER 中型激光s are retained, and a pair of B-Pods are added for defense against battle 装甲. 铁纤维装甲 装甲 is utilized, though a Compact 引擎 is needed to make room. A Heavy-Duty Gyro increases the 5V's survivability.
column2: 作为 Vanquisher 的升级型号，5V 保留了 2A 的 ER 大型激光。不过它放弃轻型高斯步枪，改用一门重型高斯步枪。两门 ER 中型激光被保留，并增设一对 B-Pod，以防御战斗装甲。该机采用铁纤维装甲，但需要紧凑型引擎来腾出空间。重型陀螺仪进一步提升了 5V 的生存能力。

column1: Another Jihad era configuration, this configuration setup as a fire support mission. Each arm slot has a MML-7 Launcher with 2 tons of ammunition. Mounted in the left torso, the 'Mech has three ER Medium Lasers.
column2: 这是另一种圣战时期的配置，专为火力支援任务而设。每个手臂武器槽都安装一具 MML-7 发射器，并配有 2 吨弹药。机甲左侧躯干还装有三门增程中型激光器。

column1: Another Jihad era configuration, this configuration setup as a fire support mission. Each arm slot has a MML-7 Launcher with 2 tons of ammunition. Mounted in the left torso, the 'Mech has three ER 中型激光s.
column2: 这是另一种圣战时代配置，专为火力支援任务设置。每个手臂槽位安装一具MML-7发射器，配备两吨弹药；左侧躯干还装有三门ER中型激光。

column1: Another Quicsell 'special'. Those guns are way too hot for what they do, but they get around that fact with that crazy XL internal combustion engine. Don't even ask me to replace it. The damn thing is hardwired into the mech, so you'll just have to get used to belching smoke. Heh. On a so-called 'stealth mech'.
column2: 另一个Quicsell“特别”。这些枪对于它们的用途来说太热了，但他们用疯狂的 XL 内燃机解决了这个问题。甚至不要要求我更换它。这该死的东西是硬连线到机械中的，所以你只需要习惯喷出烟雾即可。呵呵。在所谓的“隐形机甲”上。

column1: Another Quicsell 'special'. Those guns are way too hot for what they do, but they get around that fact with that crazy XL internal combustion 引擎. Don't even ask me to replace it. The damn thing is hardwired into the mech, so you'll just have to get used to belching smoke. Heh. On a so-called 'stealth mech'.
column2: 又一个Quicksell“特制品”。这些火炮的发热量与性能完全不匹配，不过那台疯狂的XL内燃引擎解决了问题。别指望我替你更换它：这玩意儿硬接在机甲上，你只能习惯它喷烟。呵，所谓的“隐形机甲”。

column1: Another Quicsell all-rounder. I would even call it a decent mech, if it weren't for that abomination of an extra-light infernal combustion engine. No, I did not choose the wrong word there. You'll be belching smoke as you run around the battlefield, so good luck with stealth.
column2: 又一台 Quicsell 全能机。我甚至会称它为不错的机甲，要不是那台额外轻型地狱内燃机实在太离谱。不，我没用错词。你驾驶它在战场上跑动时会一路喷烟，想靠隐身作战就祝你好运吧。

column1: Another Quicsell all-rounder. I would even call it a decent mech, if it weren't for that abomination of an extra-light infernal combustion 引擎. No, I did not choose the wrong word there. You'll be belching smoke as you run around the battlefield, so good luck with stealth.
column2: 又一台Quicsell全能机甲。如果不是那台荒谬的超轻型地狱内燃机，我甚至会称它为一台不错的机甲。不，我没有用错词。你驾驶它在战场上到处跑时会一路喷烟，祝你隐身好运。

column1: Another Quicsell cockroach. Yeah, it's hard to kill, but it's ugly, it's shoddy, and it's undergunned. Less total damage than one AC20 shell, and the thing still overheats if you manage to land all three shots in rapid succession. Still, makes for a good rookie mech, since it's just about impossible to fuck up with those so called 'streak PPCs'.
column2: 又一只 Quicsell 蟑螂。没错，它很难杀，但又丑又破，火力还不足。总伤害甚至不如一发 AC/20，而且即使你成功快速打出三发，它仍然会过热。不过它很适合新手，因为那些所谓的“Streak PPC”几乎不可能用错。

column1: Another Quicsell mech with one of those insane extra-large internal compustion engines. I'd hate them for it, if it weren't for the fact that it allows the mech to field twice as much firepower as it should rightly be able to. Still has the normal XL engine vulnerability though, so watch your armor on those side torsos.
column2: 又一台 Quicsell 机甲，装着那种疯狂的超大型内燃机。要不是这引擎让它能带上远超合理水平的火力，我真想为这事骂他们。不过它仍有普通 XL 引擎的脆弱问题，所以要盯紧两侧躯干的装甲。

column1: Another Quicsell mech with one of those insane extra-large internal compustion engines. I'd hate them for it, if it weren't for the fact that it allows the mech to field twice as much firepower as it should rightly be able to. Still has the normal XL引擎 vulnerability though, so watch your 装甲 on those side torsos.
column2: 又一台装备疯狂超大型内燃机的Quicsell机甲。要不是它能让机甲搭载正常情况下两倍的火力，我真会恨死这种设计。不过它仍有普通XL引擎的脆弱性，所以要当心两侧躯干上的装甲。

column1: Another Solaris custom, the Wolverine DS is designed to deal massive damage in a short time, and have the mobility to get out safely.
column2: 又一台Solaris定制机。Wolverine DS旨在短时间内造成巨大伤害，同时具备安全撤离所需的机动性。

column1: Another Solaris custom, the Wolverine X was designed by a wealthy Heir to compete in the Arenas as a pasttime.
column2: 又一台 Solaris 定制机甲。Wolverine X 由一名富有的继承人设计，作为消遣参加竞技场比赛。

column1: Another Solaris custom, the Wolverine X was 设计ed by a wealthy Heir to compete in the Arenas as a pasttime.
column2: 另一款索拉里斯定制型号，狼獾 X 由一位富有的继承人设计，用于在竞技场参赛消遣。

column1: Another advanced variation, this Vedette variant replaces all the weaponry with a 轻型高斯步枪, the increased weight of this weapon leading to a reduction in 铁纤维装甲 装甲. 生物群系限制：该单位因使用内燃机，无法在月球或火星生物群系部署。 移动：5/8 格 / 150/240 米. 装甲： 铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 75 25 左侧 55 25 右侧 55 25 后方 50 25 炮塔 60 25 总计 295 125 特性：快速起步
column2: 这是另一种先进变体，用一挺重型高斯步枪替换了维达特的全部武器。武器重量增加，导致强化纤维装甲的防护随之减少。 生物群系限制：该单位因使用内燃机，无法在月球或火星生物群系部署。 移动：5/8 米/秒 / 150/240 米。 装甲: 强化纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前部 75 25 左侧 55 25 右侧 55 25 后部 50 25 顶部 60 25 总计 295 125 特性：耐久

column1: Another command variation, this configuration mounts a C3 Master computer. It carries three Medium Pulse Lasers, a Heavy PPC, and a Light Gauss Rifle. Four jump jets give it a 120 meter jump range.
column2: 这是另一种指挥配置，安装一台 C3 主机。它配备三门中型脉冲激光器、一门重型 PPC 和一门轻型高斯步枪，四具跳跃喷射器让其跳跃距离达到 120 米。

column1: Another custom designed variant produced from the BBM factories at Nanking on the orders of Duke Morgan Hasek-Davion.
column2: 这是另一种定制改型，由南京BBM工厂根据Morgan Hasek-Davion公爵的命令生产。

column1: Another decent all-rounder from Quicsell. So long as you mind the very low stability from those leg actuator replacements, and keep an eye on your heat when enemies are packing flamers, you should do alright.
column2: Quicsell 另一台不错的全能型机甲。只要注意那些腿部驱动器替换件带来的极低稳定性，并留意敌人使用火焰喷射器时的热量，你应该能应付。

column1: Another laser focused configuration, the T loads 2 Improved Heavy Medium Lasers, an Improved Heavy Small Laser, a Large Pulse Laser and an ER Small Laser. A SRM6 with 1 ton of ammunition is added as extra support.
column2: 这是另一种以激光为核心的配置。T 型配备两门改进型重型中型激光器、一门改进型重型小型激光器、一门大型脉冲激光器和一门增程小型激光器。此外还配有 SRM-6 和 1 吨弹药作为辅助火力。

column1: Another laser focused configuration, the T loads 2 Improved Heavy 中型激光s, an Improved Heavy Small Laser, a 大型脉冲激光 and an ER Small Laser. A SRM6 with 1 ton of ammunition is added as extra support.
column2: 这是一套同样专注激光的配置。T型装备2门改进型重型中型激光、一门改进型重型小型激光、一门中型激光和一门ER小型激光，另加一具配备1吨弹药的SRM6作为支援。

column1: Another long-range configuration of the Firestarter, the G configuration mounts an LB-X Autocannon/5. For close combat, the 'Mech carries three Medium Lasers and a pair of Flamers that allow the Firestarter to start fires to create smoke to cover its movement.
column2: 这是 Firestarter 的另一种远程配置，G 型号安装一门 LB-X Autocannon/5。近战时，机甲装备三门中型激光和一对喷火器，可点燃火焰制造烟幕掩护移动。

column1: Another long-range configuration of the Firestarter, the G configuration mounts an LB-X Autocannon/5. For close combat, the 'Mech carries three 中型激光s and a pair of Flamers that allow the Firestarter to start fires to create smoke to cover its movement.
column2: 这是火蜥蜴的另一种远程配置：G 型安装一门 LB-X 自动炮/5。近距离作战时，机甲配备三门中型激光和一对火焰喷射器；火焰喷射器能够点燃地面，并制造烟幕掩护机体移动。

column1: Another modification of the 2D model, the 2D2 removes the Active Probe from the 2D model and replaces it with a TAG target designator, allowing it to spot for Arrow IV artillery bombardments.
column2: 这是 2D 型的另一种改装：2D2 拆除了主动探测器，换上 TAG 目标指示器，可为 Arrow IV 火炮轰击标定目标。

column1: Another modification of the 2D model, the 2D2 removes the 主动探头 from the 2D model and replaces it with a TAG target designator, allowing it to spot for Arrow IV 火炮 bombardments.
column2: 这是2D的另一种改装型，2D2拆除2D的主动探头，换成TAG目标标定器，使其能够为Arrow IV火炮轰击进行标定。

column1: Another of the Word of Blake's Celestial series OmniMechs, the Deva (named for celestial beings from the Hindu belief system) also makes extensive use of new technologies. It is built with a light fusion engine, a heavy-duty gyro that can take half again as much punishment as its standard counterpart, and the small cockpit common to all of the Celestials. Meant to stay a good distance back from enemy units, the Deva B carries an ER PPC in each arm. The Infernus piles on enough heat sinks that the MechWarrior has no real heat concerns. Adding to that A pair of Medium Pulse Lasers that also benefit from the advanced computer can be utilized should an enemy get within range. Defensively, a Guardian ECM Suite ensures that enemies cannot benefit from electronics against the Deva or its nearby allies.
column2: 提婆是布雷克之言天体系列全能机甲之一（名称取自印度教信仰中的天界众生），也大量采用了新技术。它配备轻型融合引擎、重型陀螺仪（比标准型号多承受一半的损伤）以及所有天体系列共有的小型驾驶舱。提婆 B 旨在与敌方单位保持较远距离，双臂各装一门增程 PPC。地狱火配置配备了充足的散热器，使机甲战士几乎无需担心热量。此外，两门中型脉冲激光器也可受益于先进计算机的辅助，在敌人进入射程后投入攻击。防御方面，守护者 ECM 套件可确保敌人无法利用电子设备对付提婆或其附近盟友。

column1: Another of the Word of Blake's Celestial series OmniMechs, the Deva (named for celestial beings from the Hindu belief system) also makes extensive use of new technologies. It is built with a light fusion engine, a heavy-duty gyro that can take half again as much punishment as its standard counterpart, and the small cockpit common to all of the Celestials. The Comminus variant is designed to mix it up close to enemies, a task it is aided in by the mobility that jump jets give it. An Ultra Autocannon/20 is still the most powerful gun in the Inner Sphere's arsenal. A three-ton, CASE-protected ammunition bin keeps it in supply, though a MechWarrior should not waste shots. column1: Apparently designed as a command vehicle, the Perseus E has three tons of Communications Equipment in the right torso. A Beagle Active Probe is available to find hidden units. Offensively, the E configuration carries a Gauss Rifle, Large Variable Speed Pulse Laser, Medium Variable Speed Pulse Laser, and ER Small Laser. An ER Medium Laser covers the rear. For last ditch defense, the E variant carries an Improved One-Shot SRM-6 in the center torso.
column2: Perseus E 似乎被设计成指挥车辆，右侧躯干装有三吨通信设备。比格犬主动探测器用于发现隐藏单位。E 配置的武器包括高斯步枪、大型可变速脉冲激光器、中型可变速脉冲激光器和增程小型激光器；增程中型激光器负责后方防御。最后关头，E 型还在中央躯干装有一具改进型一次性 SRM-6。

column1: Apparently intended as a capture 'Mech, this Cephalus configuration keeps the Light TAG but replaces the Modular Armor and anti-missile systems with a BattleMech Taser.
column2: 这套 Cephalus 配置似乎原本用于捕获机甲，保留轻型 TAG，但以战斗机甲电击器替换模块化装甲和反导系统。

column1: Apparently intended for Word of Blake use, this configuration mounts an Improved C3 Computer. It also has a trio of ER Medium Lasers and the left and right arms carry a Gauss Rifle and LB 20-X autocannon, respectively. Interestingly neither side torso mounts CASE to protect from ammunition or weapon explosions.

column1: Apparently intended for long range direct fire support or anti-aircraft work, this configuration carries three LB 2-X autocannons, an ER PPC, and a Light Gauss Rifle. It can share targeting data with lancemates via a C3 Slave unit.

column1: Apparently intended for 布雷克圣言会 use, this configuration mounts an 改进的 C3 Computer. column1: Apparently 生产 for the 布雷克圣言会 Protectorate Militia divisions in 3080, this unit's 装甲 and weaponry is the same as the KGC-008. In fact the only difference between this unit and its cousin is the removal of the C3i computer and its replacement with a standard C3 Slave and a second CASE-protected ammunition bin.

column1: Appearing in 3012, the Marauder II is a redesign of the classic Marauder, turning the 75 ton Heavy Mech into a 100 ton Assault. Originally a Wolf's Dragoons exclusive Mech, it wasn’t until after the 4th War of Succession in 3030 that the Mech would spread beyond the Dragoons. Powered by a 300-rated Fusion Core, the Marauder II MAD-5W is armed with a Heavy PPC and a pair of Snub Nose PPC’s. C3i and Improved Jump Jets round out the variant. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Marauder II 于 3012 年问世，是经典 Marauder 的重新设计版本，将 75 吨重型机甲改为 100 吨突击机甲。它最初是 Wolf's Dragoons 独占的机甲，直到 3030 年第四次继承战争之后才传到龙骑兵以外的势力手中。Marauder II MAD-5W 由 300 级聚变核心驱动，配备一门重型粒子炮和两门短鼻粒子炮。C3i 与改进型跳跃喷射器完善了该型号的配置。 特性：窄体/低轮廓 部署成本倍率：1.18 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: Appearing in 3012, the Marauder II is a redesign of the classic Marauder, turning the 75 ton Heavy Mech into a 100 ton Assault. Originally a Wolf's Dragoons exclusive Mech, it wasn’t until after the 4th War of Succession in 3030 that the Mech would spread beyond the Dragoons. Powered by a 400-rated XL Engine, the Marauder II MAD-10D is armed with a Large Re-Engineered Laser, paired Can ER PPC’s and Medium X-Pulses. Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18.
column2: 掠夺者 II 于 3012 年问世，是经典掠夺者的重新设计，将 75 吨重型机甲改为 100 吨突击机甲。它最初是狼之龙骑兵的专属机甲，直到 3030 年第四次继承战争之后才流传到龙骑兵以外的势力。MAD-10D 由 400 级 XL 引擎驱动，配备一门大型重构激光器、一对 Can ER PPC 和中型 X-Pulse 激光器。投放费用倍率：1.18。

column1: Approximately twice as expensive as the original, the Hellfire 2 uses an 300-rated XL Engine to increase the 'Mech's speed to 86 km/h. In place of the LRMs are a pair of ATM 6s. The heavy smalls are replaced with a single ER Small Laser and an additional double heat sink.
column2: Hellfire 2 的价格约为原型的两倍，使用 300 级 XL 引擎将机甲速度提升至 86 km/h。LRM 被一对 ATM-6 取代，重型小型激光则换成一门增程小型激光，并额外增加一具双重散热器。

column1: Approximately twice as expensive as the original, the Hellfire 2 uses an 300-rated XL引擎 to increase the '机甲's speed to 86 km/h. In place of the LRMs are a pair of ATM 6s. The heavy smalls are replaced with a single ER Small Laser and an additional double heat sink.
column2: Hellfire 2的价格约为原版两倍，采用300额定XL引擎，将机甲速度提升至86 km/h。它用两具ATM-6替换LRM，用一门ER小型激光器和一组额外双重散热器替换重型小型激光器。

column1: Aquired from Clan Diamond Shark has this 'Mad Cat MKII' refit with RISC technologies and designed to carry 2 prototype Risc Hyper Assault Gauss Rifles, though carrying only 6 salvos for its primary weapons, does this platform offer unparralled firepower in its Class.
column2: 这台 Mad Cat MK II 从钻石鲨氏族手中获得后，进行了 RISC 技术改装，专为携带两门原型 RISC 超级强袭高斯步枪而设计。主武器只有六轮齐射弹药，但这台平台仍能在同级中提供无与伦比的火力。

column1: Aquired from 氏族钻石鲨 has this 'Mad Cat MKII' refit with RISC technologies and 设计ed to carry 2 prototype Risc 超重型突击高斯 Rifles, though carrying only 6 salvos for its primary weapons, does this platform offer unparralled firepower in its Class.
column2: 从氏族钻石鲨获得的这款“Mad Cat MKII”采用 RISC 技术进行改装，旨在携带 2 支原型 Risc 超重型突击高斯步枪，尽管其主要武器仅携带 6 次齐射，但该平台是否能提供同类产品中无与伦比的火力。

column1: Arcturan Arms was mostly keeping the lights on with RetroTech contracts during the Jihad, so the Vishnu stands out as evidence they had not completely walked away from advanced design work. The LCAF picked it up in serious numbers and kept running it into the Dark Age, deploying it heavily along the Jade Falcon and Free Worlds League borders where it had to perform against a wide range of opponents at unpredictable ranges. A heavy mech that stays dangerous whether the enemy closes or holds distance is exactly what a contested border unit wants.
column2: 圣战期间，Arcturan Arms 主要依靠 RetroTech 合同维持运营，因此 Vishnu 的问世证明这家公司并未完全放弃先进设计。LCAF 大量采购了该机甲，并一直使用到黑暗时代，尤其部署在玉隼氏族和自由世界联盟边境，以应对射程变化莫测、类型各异的对手。一台无论敌人逼近还是保持距离都能持续构成威胁的重型机甲，正是争夺激烈的边境部队所需要的。

column1: Arcturan Arms was mostly keeping the lights on with RetroTech contracts during the Jihad, so the Vishnu stands out as evidence they had not completely walked away from advanced 设计 work. The LCAF picked it up in serious numbers and kept running it into the Dark Age, deploying it heavily along the Jade Falcon and Free Worlds League borders where it had to perform against a wide range of opponents at unpredictable ranges. A heavy mech that stays dangerous whether the enemy closes or holds distance is exactly what a contested border unit wants.
column2: 圣战期间，阿克图鲁斯武器公司主要依靠 RetroTech 合同维持经营，因此毗湿奴成为其尚未完全放弃先进设计工作的证明。天琴联邦武装部队大量采购该机甲，并一直使用到黑暗时代；它被重点部署在玉鹰氏族与自由世界联盟边境，面对射程和敌人类型都难以预测的战斗环境。对于边境部队而言，一台无论敌人逼近还是保持距离都依然危险的重型机甲正是理想选择。

column1: Armed with Dual UAC5's in the Right Arm, supported by a Specially modified shoulder to absorb the Recoil better, This Nova Cat is Very dangerous Boss. The Right Torso also Sports Streak LRM's and a Guardian ECM. The Left Torso has 2 Pulse Lasers and a Probe in it. The Left Arm Has a Shield, this makes me Question Things. All in All, this Mech seems Extremely out of Touch for Clanners, even if it was made by Blood Spirits.
column2: 右臂装备双联 UAC5，并专门改造肩部以更好吸收后坐力，这台 Nova Cat 非常危险，老大。右侧躯干还装有 Streak LRM 和 Guardian ECM；左侧躯干装有两门脉冲激光和一台探测器。左臂则有一面盾牌，这让我开始怀疑一些事情。总的来说，这台机甲对氏族人而言似乎极其不合常规，即使它由血灵氏族制造也是如此。

column1: Armed with Dual UAC5's in the 右侧 Arm, supported by a Specially modified shoulder to absorb the Recoil better, This Nova Cat is Very dangerous Boss. The 右侧 Torso also Sports Streak LRM's and a 守护者ECM. The 左侧 Torso has 2 Pulse Lasers and a Probe in it. The 左侧 Arm Has a Shield, this makes me Question Things. All in All, this 机甲 seems Extremely out of Touch for Clanners, even if it was made by Blood Spirits.
column2: 右臂装备双 UAC/5，并由经过特殊改造、用于更好吸收后坐力的肩部结构提供支撑，这台 Nova Cat 非常危险，Boss。右侧躯干还装有 Streak LRM 和守护者 ECM；左侧躯干装着两门脉冲激光和一具探头。左臂配有盾牌，这让我开始怀疑人生。总的来说，这台机甲对氏族人而言极不寻常，即使它由血誓氏族制造也是如此。

column1: Armed with mainly energy weaponry and a single missile launcher, this configuration again takes a page from the older model's configuration by the same name. In the arms is pair of ER Large Lasers and ER Mediums Lasers tied into a Targeting Computer. The left torso is home of the 15-tubed LRM launcher and its two tons of ammunition. Eight additional Double Heat Sinks and five Jump Jets round out the equipment for this configuration equipment.
column2: 该配置主要使用能量武器，另有一具导弹发射器，再次借鉴同名旧型号的配置。双臂各装一对与瞄准计算机连接的增程大型激光和增程中型激光。左侧躯干容纳一具 15 联装 LRM 发射器及两吨弹药。八具额外双重散热器和五具跳跃喷射器完善了装备。

column1: Armed with mainly energy weaponry and a single missile launcher, this configuration again takes a page from the older model's configuration by the same name. In the arms is pair of ER Large Lasers and ER Mediums Lasers tied into a 瞄准计算机. The left torso is home of the 15-tubed LRM launcher and its two tons of ammunition. Eight additional 双散热器 and five Jump Jets round out the equipment for this configuration equipment.
column2: 这套配置主要采用能量武器，并配备一具导弹发射器，再次沿用了同名旧型号的设计思路。双臂装有一对ER大型激光和ER中型激光，并接入瞄准计算机。左侧躯干装有15管LRM发射器及两吨弹药。八个额外双联散热器和五具跳跃喷射器完善了这套配置。

column1: Arrr, me space buccaneers! Feast yer eyes on the UrbanMech UFO – a cosmic terror of the spaceways! Its Gauss Rifle boasts a mischievous 'tractor beam,' hurlin' scrap through the barrel and leavin' ammo troubles in the void. With loads of small lasers, rockets, and Metal blarin' through its comms, we be sowin' cosmic confusion. Join the pirate crew with the UrbanMech UFO – where scrap's a cannon, and the echoes of Metal rule the galactic seas! Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 啊哈，太空海盗们！睁大眼睛瞧瞧 UrbanMech UFO——太空航道上的宇宙恐怖！它的高斯步枪带有恶作剧般的‘牵引光束’，能把废料塞进枪管发射，从此不必担心弹药不足。大量小型激光、火箭和通讯中震耳欲聋的金属乐，足以让宇宙乱成一团。加入 UrbanMech UFO 海盗船员吧——废料就是炮弹，金属乐回荡在银河海洋！ 特质：陆空机甲 部署费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: Artemis IV LRM 15s, Extended Range Pulse Lasers, Streak SRM launchers! What is there not to like here? Can I have one, Boss? Just for research purposes of course, I would never use it to terrorize the local wildlife for fun on the next planet we arrive at.
column2: Artemis IV LRM-15、增程脉冲激光、Streak SRM发射器！这里有什么不喜欢的？老板，我能要一台吗？当然只是出于研究目的；下一个星球上我绝不会拿它去吓唬当地野生动物取乐。

column1: As ER PPC quickly became hard to source, the Lu Bu LB-189 variant was designed as a continuation of the LB-182 variant with its Endo-Steel structure. Instead of the ER PPC it uses two standard PPCs, allowing it to drop three heat sinks. As a compensation for the lack of the new fancy ER PPC technology, the LB-189 instead uses a slightly upgraded in rating Extra-Light engine core. The changes allowed the addition of two Large Lasers which greatly increases its damage potential, but the variant was deemed far too expensive to be mass-produced. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - PPC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 由于增程 PPC 很快变得难以取得，Lu Bu LB-189 型在采用 Endo-Steel 结构的 LB-182 型基础上继续改进。它用两门标准 PPC 取代增程 PPC，因此可以拆除三台散热器。为了弥补缺少新式增程 PPC 技术的问题，LB-189 改用了额定功率略高的额外轻型引擎核心。这些改动腾出的重量可用于加装两门大型激光，大幅提高了杀伤力；但该型号成本过高，无法大规模生产。 特性：改进型冷却套件 - PPC 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: As ER PPC quickly became hard to source, the Lu Bu LB-189 variant was designed as a continuation of the LB-182 variant with its Endo-Steel 结构. column2: 由于ER PPC很快变得难以获得，Lu Bu LB-189变型在LB-182变型基础上继续发展，采用内骨骼结构。它用两门标准PPC替代ER PPC，因此可以减少三组散热器。为弥补缺少新式ER PPC技术的不足，LB-189改用额定值略有提升的超轻型引擎核心。改动后可增装两门大型激光器，大幅提升伤害潜力，但该变型成本过高，无法量产。 特性：改进型冷却夹套—PPC 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂, 右下臂

column1: As Pirate refits go, this is mostly not too deranged. The AC/10 has been replaced with a mortar, and the machine guns are still there, if mangled. The small laser has been upgraded to a light PPC, and the SRM launcher has been "upgraded" as well. They've even given it a '机甲-sized "shotgun" to carry. Just don't ask what's going on in the 引擎 and cooling systems.
column2: 作为海盗改装机，这台东西总体还不算太离谱。AC/10被替换成迫击炮，机枪还在，只是已经被胡乱拼装过。小型激光升级成轻型PPC，SRM发射器也被“升级”了。他们甚至给它装了一个机甲尺寸的“霰弹枪”。只是别问引擎和冷却系统到底发生了什么。

column1: As a PPC-toting '机甲, the Gunslinger Cicada refit was undertaken by 狼獾氏族. While the Clan's Enhanced PPCs were significantly ahead of the original Star League Snub-Nose variants, the increased weight necessitated the transfer of the 设计 to a full Endo-Steel chassis. The resulting loadout ran blisteringly hot over extended deployment, prompting the development of more efficient cooling jackets to mitigate the problem without adding even further bulk.
column2: 作为一台搭载 PPC 的战斗机甲，Gunslinger Cicada 改装由太阳神联盟完成。虽然氏族增强型 PPC 明显领先于最初的星盟短管型号，但增加的重量迫使改装方将结构转为完整的内骨骼钢底盘。最终武器装载在长时间部署中产生极高热量，因此开发了效率更高的冷却夹套，以缓解问题而不再增加体积。

column1: As a Second-Line mech, the Incubus was a prime candidate for Society engineers to refit into a light mech capable of being integrated into Society formations easily. The Incubus Z drops the Large Pulse Laser for a Large Supra Laser and drops the ER Medium for a Nova CEWS.
column2: 作为二线机甲，Incubus 很适合由 Society 工程师改装成能轻松编入 Society 编队的轻型机甲。Incubus Z 用大型 Supra 激光替换大型脉冲激光，并用 Nova CEWS 替换增程中型激光。

column1: As far as Excalibur 'Mechs go, Boss, this one is a tough nut to crack. Getting rid of the Gauss rifle freed up a lot of tonnage that got used for armor and heat sinking.
column2: 要说 Excalibur 机甲，老大，这台可真是块难啃的骨头。拆掉高斯步枪腾出了不少吨位，都用来加装装甲和散热器了。

column1: As far as Excalibur '机甲s go, Boss, this one is a tough nut to crack. Getting rid of the Gauss rifle freed up a lot of tonnage that got used for 装甲 and heat sinking.
column2: 老板，就Excalibur机甲而言，这台很难对付。拆除高斯步枪后腾出的重量被用于增加装甲和散热能力。

column1: As far as battlefield hackjobs go, I've seen worse. Sure, it's not the prettiest, or the most heat efficient, or the most stocked on ammo, or-- well. You get the idea. At least the fact it's still here meant it worked, I guess.
column2: 就战场黑客工作而言，我见过更糟糕的情况。当然，它不是最漂亮的，也不是最热效率最高的，也不是弹药储备最多的，或者——好吧。你明白了。我想至少它还在这里意味着它有效。

column1: As far as custom jobs go, this isn't anything too special, Boss. Standard electronic warfare additions, an engine upgrade, et cetera. It's all pretty mundane, except for these Large Pulse Lasers. Probably some kinda early Clan technology, if I had to guess; they're leagues ahead of some of the stuff we usually go through.
column2: 就定制工作而言，这台没什么特别的，Boss。标准电子战组件、引擎升级之类的，整体相当普通，除了这些大型脉冲激光。要我猜的话，它们可能是早期氏族技术，性能远超我们平常接触的某些装备。

column1: As far as custom jobs go, this isn't anything too special, Boss. Standard electronic warfare additions, an 引擎 upgrade, et cetera. It's all pretty mundane, except for these Large Pulse Lasers. Probably some kinda early Clan technology, if I had to guess; they're leagues ahead of some of the stuff we usually go through.
column2: 就定制改装而言，这没什么特别的，老板。标准电子战组件、引擎升级之类的常规项目都在其中。唯一不寻常的是这些大型脉冲激光器。我猜它们可能属于早期氏族技术；性能远远领先于我们平时接触的某些装备。

column1: As long as you don't miss you can deliver a big oof to any approaching hostile 'Mechs.
column2: 只要别打偏，就能给任何逼近的敌方机甲狠狠一击。

column1: As long as you don't miss you can deliver a big oof to any approaching hostile '机甲s.
column2: 只要别打偏，你就能给任何逼近的敌方机甲送上一记沉重的痛击。

column1: As more and more Superheavy 'Mechs started appearing with the Inner Sphere and Clan armies, a rising demand for them was created within the periphery states as well. With their limited resources and more mundane needs, Earthwerks Limited saw an opportunity to create a cheap, simple design that still could take a beating. The choice was to create the 190 ton Thunderstone, trying to use the good reputation of the Thunderbolt as a launch platform it was designed with very similar looks. The high tonnage might at first seem to go against the cheap and simple concept, but it allows Earthwerks Limited to use less optimized components, which in turn allows the customers to do their own repair and maintenance at lower costs. The design comes with a 350 rated engine core, double heat sinks and an AMS by default.
column2: 随着内天体和氏族军队中越来越多的超重型机甲出现，边缘邦国也产生了需求。Earthwerks Limited 资源有限、需求朴素，于是看准机会，打造了价格低廉、结构简单却经得起打击的设计。他们选择制造 190 吨的 Thunderstone，并借用 Thunderbolt 的良好声誉，采用相似外形作为基础。高吨位乍看似乎违背低价简洁理念，但它允许 Earthwerks Limited 使用优化程度较低的部件，让客户以更低成本自行维修保养。该设计默认配备 350 级引擎核心、双重散热器和 AMS。

column1: As the original loadout of the Hierophant, the Prime configuration was initially a test platform for TEMPEST and Ares attachments. It features 2 Hyper PPCs with TEMPEST, 2 i-AC/10s with Ares TPS, and a flamer equipped with TEMPEST, though the flamer’s extremely short range rendered it practically useless in combat, serving only to verify TEMPEST compatibility. The inclusion of AMS Mk2 rounds out the build. Its strong performance led to expanded Hierophant production and inspired the diverse loadouts that followed, cementing its role as the Minnesota Tribe’s premier superheavy command ‘Mech. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.45 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 作为 Hierophant 的原始配置，Prime 最初是 TEMPEST 与 Ares 附件的测试平台。它配备两门带 TEMPEST 的 Hyper PPC、两门带 Ares TPS 的 i-AC/10，以及一具装有 TEMPEST 的火焰喷射器；不过火焰喷射器射程极短，实战中几乎无用，只用于验证 TEMPEST 的兼容性。AMS Mk2 让整套配置更加完整。出色的表现推动了 Hierophant 的扩大生产，并催生出后续多样化的装载方案，最终确立了它作为明尼苏达部落首席超重型指挥机体的地位。 特质：精准武器 - 能量 部署费用倍率：1.45 手臂驱动器限制：全 Omni

column1: As with the Warhammer IIC, the Marauder IIC is ten-tons heavier than its Inner Sphere progenitor, pushing it into the assault weight class, but otherwise the design usually matches the original's ground speed. Though both designs carry over ten tons of armor, the Marauder IIC's use of more advanced ferro-fibrous plating gives it superior protection, with an endo steel frame freeing up weight. While structurally the Marauder IIC appears to offer little advantage over the LosTech refitted Marauders introduced by the Successor States, the blatant superiority of Clan weaponry allows the design to pound its opponents to pieces in short order.
column2: 与战锤 IIC 一样，掠夺者 IIC 比其内天体前身重十吨，因此跻身突击级；除此之外，其地面速度通常与原型相当。两种设计的装甲都超过十吨，而掠夺者 IIC 采用更先进的铁纤维装甲板，配合内骨钢骨架减轻重量，防护能力更胜一筹。从结构上看，掠夺者 IIC 相比继承国引入的失落科技改装型掠夺者并无明显优势，但氏族武器的压倒性优势足以让它迅速将对手轰成碎片。

Though both designs carry over ten tons of armor, the 掠夺者 IIC's use of more advanced ferro-fibrous plating gives it superior protection, with an endo steel frame freeing up weight. While structurally the 掠夺者 IIC appears to offer little advantage over the LosTech refitted Marauders introduced by the Successor States, the blatant superiority of Clan weaponry allows the design to pound its opponents to pieces in short order.
column2: 与战锤 IIC 一样，掠夺者 IIC 比其内层星域原型重 10 吨，因此归入突击级别；除此之外，它通常仍保持原型的地面速度。两种设计都配备超过 10 吨装甲，而掠夺者 IIC 采用更先进的 Ferro-Fibrous 装甲，防护能力更强；Endo Steel 框架则腾出了额外重量。单从结构上看，掠夺者 IIC 相较继承国推出的 Lostech 翻新掠夺者优势有限，但氏族武器的明显优势足以让它迅速将对手轰成碎片。

column1: Astoundingly little was broken as they repaired this Uziel, even the XL is intact! Just dont look at these missile launcher they jury rigged into that poor little pumpkin...
column2: 他们修复这台 Uziel 时损坏的东西少得惊人，连 XL 引擎都完好无损！不过千万别看那些被临时接到可怜南瓜上的导弹发射器。

column1: At 255 tons, the Armageddon Prototype is less a Battle机甲 and more a mobile doomsday device. Built by the 明尼苏达部落, its centerpiece is the Rotary Railgun. A four-shot magnetic cannon so extreme it risks structural failure with each volley. Flanking it are eight compact PPCs, equipped with particle recyclers for increased efficiency, a Fire and Forget 8 for indirect fire and an I-AC/20 linked to an Ares TPS fire-control unit for medium-range precision. But the price for this arsenal is speed. The Armageddon is slow, ponderous, and vulnerable if outmaneuvered. Still, when it arrives on the field, it obliterates any enemy.
column2: Armageddon 原型机重达 255 吨，与其说是战斗机甲，不如说是一台移动末日装置。它由明尼苏达部落建造，核心武器是旋转轨道炮——这种四发磁力炮威力极端，每次齐射都可能导致结构失效。两侧布置八门紧凑型 PPC，配备粒子回收器以提高效率；一门 Fire and Forget 8 用于间接火力；一门 I-AC/20 与 Ares TPS 火控单元连接，用于中距离精确射击。然而，这套武库的代价是速度。Armageddon 缓慢、笨重，被绕到侧翼后会十分脆弱。但只要抵达战场，它就能摧毁任何敌人。

column1: At the urging of then-Archon Katherine Steiner-Davion, Norse-Storm opened up talks with 胜利兵工 to secure Stealth 装甲 for the light '机甲. Though the deal did not work out exactly as they had hoped, the 5S incorporates Stealth 装甲. Space constraints force the consolidation of the 中型激光s into one 中型脉冲激光.
column2: 在当时的Archon Katherine Steiner-Davion敦促下，Norse-Storm与胜利兵工展开谈判，为轻型机甲获取隐形装甲。虽然交易结果并不完全符合预期，5S仍采用了隐形装甲。受空间限制，中型激光器被合并为一门中型脉冲激光器。

column1: Badb Catha（战鸦）以古老的 Terra 爱尔兰民间传说中的死亡与混沌女神命名，预示着即将到来的血腥冲突与混乱。Part of the Morrigan 全向Mech program, alongside the Mhacha and Anand. 特性：Morrigan C3i 部署成本倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: Badb Catha（战鸦）以古老泰拉爱尔兰传说中的死亡与混沌女神命名，预示着即将到来的血腥冲突与混乱。它是莫里甘全能机甲计划的一部分，与Mhacha和Anand并列。 特性：莫里甘C3i 部署成本倍率：1.05 部位装甲限制：全能

column1: Banshee IIC 2 在 Kerensky 星团一次黑暗氏族袭击中被发现，常被误认为缴获的内星 BNC-5S。它保持突击机甲约 68 km/h 的速度，装备两门改进型重型大型激光、两门大型脉冲激光和 20 级超高斯步枪，全部连接瞄准计算机；高热和缺少跳跃喷射器限制了它。 Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.23 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Banshee IIC 2 是在克伦斯基星团对星蝰蛇势力的一次黑暗氏族袭击中发现的，常被误认为是缴获的内星 BNC-5S，并被认为性能较弱。它在孤军作战时仍击杀了三名敌人，直到对手撤退。IIC 2 保持了突击机甲令人印象深刻的速度，约为 68 千米/小时。它装备两门改进型重型大型激光器、两门大型脉冲激光器和一门 20 级超高斯步枪，全部连接至瞄准计算机。虽然严重的发热需要谨慎管理，驾驶员也对缺少跳跃喷射器、限制战场机动性这一点颇有怨言。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.23 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: Based heavily on the Uziel 8S, the Hai enhances the medium ‘Mech’s performance with a Sea Fox XL engine and Clan-spec weaponry, increasing durability and firepower. Its extra 10 tons allow for an Angel ECM suite and CASE II armor integrated into Light Ferro-Fibrous plating. Though slightly hotter running, the Hai carries more armor and retains similar mobility. The extended weapon range lets it skirmish at safer distances, avoiding close-range damage. Offensively, eight Improved Jump Jets boost maneuverability, while four Clan Medium Pulse Lasers and a Streak SRM 6 launcher, supported by one ton of ammo, deliver lethal mid-range strikes. Quirk: Tacticon TC7000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Hai 基于 Uziel 8S 深度改进，通过 Sea Fox XL 引擎和氏族规格武器提升这台中型机甲的性能，增强了耐久性与火力。额外的 10 吨载重空间可容纳 Angel ECM 套件和整合在轻型铁磁纤维装甲中的 CASE II。虽然运行温度略高，Hai 的装甲更多，机动性也相近。延伸后的武器射程让它能在更安全的距离交战，避免承受近距离伤害。进攻方面，8 具改良跳跃喷口提升机动性，四门氏族中型脉冲激光和一具 Streak SRM 6 发射器在一吨弹药支援下，可造成致命的中距离打击。 特质： Tacticon TC7000 部署费用倍率： 1.09 手臂驱动器限制： 左上臂, 右上臂 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 许可使用。

column2: Aquagladius 以 Crab 战斗机甲为基础，由维宁工程与回收团队（VEST）为索拉里斯 VII 比赛打造。Aquagladius 4 采用更传统的战斗机甲配置，而不是其前代使用的非主流武器。

column1: Based on ComStar's Beowulf, the Beowulf IIC is a more advanced Clan-Tech version for the Ghost Bear Dominion. One of the many smaller manufacturers to emerge in the wake of the Clan Invasion, Odin Manufacturing's prospects soared with the Word of Blake Jihad and the Clan Ghost Bear takeover of the Free Rasalhague Republic. Flush from the success of the Karhu OmniMech and eager to make the 15-year-old Beowulf more profitable, Odin set about developing IIC style remake under its own initiative. Though the Ghost Bear touman's post-Jihad need for a fast medium Clan BattleMech to supplement the slower Ursus led them to buy the overly expensive Beowulf IIC, the fact the Dominion needed a fast medium OmniMech even more and that Odin was clearly engaging in blatant profiteering increasingly soured the integration of Rasalhagian and Ghost Bear arms manufacturing.
column2: Beowulf IIC 以 ComStar 的 Beowulf 为基础，是为幽灵熊领地打造的先进氏族技术版本。氏族入侵后，许多小型制造商崭露头角；圣战和幽灵熊氏族接管自由拉萨尔海格共和国更让 Odin Manufacturing 前景大好。在 Karhu OmniMech 成功后，Odin 希望让这台已有 15 年历史的 Beowulf 更赚钱，于是主动开发 IIC 改型。圣战后的幽灵熊机甲部队需要一台快速的中型氏族机甲来补充缓慢的 Ursus，因而购买了昂贵的 Beowulf IIC；然而，领地其实更需要快速的中型 OmniMech，而 Odin 明显的暴利行为也逐渐损害了拉萨尔海格与幽灵熊武器制造业的融合。

column1: Based on ComStar's Beowulf, the Beowulf IIC is a more advanced Clan-Tech version for the 鬼熊 Dominion. One of the many smaller manufacturers to emerge in the wake of the 氏族入侵, Odin Manufacturing's prospects soared with the 布雷克圣言会 Jihad and the Clan Ghost Bear takeover of the 自由蛇夫座共和国. Flush from the success of the Karhu 全向Mech and eager to make the 15-year-old Beowulf more profitable, Odin set about developing IIC style remake under its own initiative. Though the Ghost Bear touman's post-Jihad need for a fast medium 氏族战斗机甲 to supplement the slower Ursus led them to buy the overly expensive Beowulf IIC, the fact the Dominion needed a fast medium 全向Mech even more and that Odin was clearly engaging in blatant profiteering increasingly soured the integration of Rasalhagian and Ghost Bear arms manufacturing.
column2: Beowulf IIC 基于 ComStar 的 Beowulf，是面向鬼熊自治领的先进氏族技术版本。氏族入侵后出现的众多小型制造商之一 Odin Manufacturing，随着布雷克圣言会圣战和鬼熊氏族接管自由蛇夫座共和国而迅速发展。为让已有 15 年历史的 Beowulf 更具利润，Odin 以 Karhu 全能机甲的成功经验重新设计了它。

column1: Based on Mad Dog's looted during Operation Bulldog has Skobel Mechworks released this design, Having to rely on Inner Sphere technologies forced them to Upgrade the Chassis by 10 Tons, despite sporting Clan Grade base Armor and Endo Steel and a permanently mounted Chin Turret.
column2: 斯科贝尔机甲工坊根据缴获的疯狗机甲进行了这项设计，并在“斗牛犬行动”后将其发布。由于只能依赖内天体技术，他们不得不将底盘增重 10 吨，尽管它仍采用氏族级基础装甲、内骨骼，并永久安装了下巴炮塔。

column1: Based on a heavily modified -5S, this custom refit replaces the Lasers with an ER PPC and two medium Pulse Lasers, and the SRM-6 launcher with a Streak counterpart. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 这套定制改装以经过大幅改造的 -5S 为基础，把激光换成了一门增程粒子加农炮和两门中型脉冲激光，并把 SRM-6 发射器换成了连发型号。特性：坚固 投放费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左臂下部

column1: Based on configuration C, this Septicemia is also intended for battle against conventional forces. Three plasma cannons, six AP Gauss rifles, and six machine guns in two machine gun arrays provide devastating firepower against conventional infantry and 车辆s. Two medium pulse lasers in each arm deal with more heavily 装甲ed foes, while still remaining effective against infantry. Finally, the Society's engineers equipped this model with a Nova CEWS.
column2: 基于配置C，这种败血病也是为了对抗常规部队而设计的。两个机枪阵列中的三门等离子炮、六门 AP 高斯步枪和六挺机枪可为常规步兵和车辆提供毁灭性的火力。每只手臂上有两个中型脉冲激光器，可以对付装甲更重的敌人，同时仍然可以有效对抗步兵。最后，协会的工程师为该模型配备了 Nova CEWS。

column1: Based on old Prototypes of the Project Phoenix 'Super Griffin', the 3-X is an attempt to create a more modern and capable upgrade of the somewhat ancient Griffin.
column2: 基于凤凰计划“超级狮鹫”的旧原型，3-X 试图对有些古老的狮鹫进行更现代、更强大的升级。

column1: Based on recovered blueprints from the fabled 'Guerilla' was this Gauntlet Commissioned, designed with mobility and long standing firepower in mind does it employ a Chameleon Light Polarisation Shield and a Torso Mounted Interface System.
column2: 这台 Gauntlet 以传说中的‘Guerilla’留下的蓝图为基础受委托制造，设计重点是机动性与持久火力，配备 Chameleon 轻型偏振护盾和躯干安装式接口系统。

column2: 这台 Gauntlet 基于从传奇的“Guerilla”回收的蓝图制造，受命时强调机动性和持久火力，装备了变色龙轻型偏振护盾和机械接口系统。

column1: Based on specs from Operation Trapdoor, the 45 ton Rattlesnake II is a 10 ton upgrade of the original Rattlesnake 机甲. Built by 海狐氏族 for the AFFS during the waning years of the Dark Age, the RSN-1 is powered by a 315-rated Clan XL Engine. 8 tons of Clan Ferro-Fibrous 装甲 and a 守护者ECM suite protect the 机甲 while Clan MASC increases the 机甲s ground speed. A pair of Clan ER 中型激光s backed up a quartet of 中型激光s form the bulk of the 机甲s arsenal with an ER Small Laser rounding out the weapons. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Rattlesnake II是基于陷阱门行动规格打造的45吨机甲，比原始Rattlesnake增加10吨。它由海狐氏族为AFFS建造于黑暗时代末期，RSN-1由315级氏族XL引擎驱动。8吨氏族铁纤维装甲和守护者ECM套件保护机体，氏族MASC提高地面速度。两门氏族ER中型激光、四门中型激光构成主要火力，另有一门ER小型激光。 怪癖：坚固 掉落成本乘数：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左侧上臂、右侧上臂

column1: Based on the King Crab, and built in the same factory that first produced the Mackie, the Vanquisher has a legendary pedigree. The Vanquisher has its genesis in the development of reverse engineered Improved C3 Computers. Once the 布雷克圣言会 had perfected their version of C3i, Cameron St. Jamais contacted 斯科贝尔机甲工厂 and contracted them to produce a 'Mech that would showcase the features of the new system. The Vanquisher was the result of that request. In order to allow it to carry as heavy a payload as possible without sacrificing durability, the 'Mech is built on a Hollis Alteration Mark VI Endo Steel that carries a Vlar 300 fusion engine, which propels the 'Mech to a top speed of 54 km/h. column1: Based on the standard Purifier suit, the primary difference is the removal of the mimetic armor and its replacement with Clan standard armor identical to that used on the Elemental suit. The Purifier Terra uses a Modular Weapon Mount to provide a variety of weapons options. The Coalition encountered variants equipped with Clan level ER Small Laser, Small Pulse Laser, and AP Gauss Rifle. Other variants used a Medium Recoilless Rifle. Beyond that, any equipment that could fit into a 400kg MWM could be carried.
column2: 它基于标准净化者战斗装甲，主要区别是移除了拟态装甲，换成与元素战士装甲相同的氏族标准装甲。Purifier Terra 使用模块化武器挂点，提供多种武器选择。联军曾遭遇装备氏族级 ER 小型激光、小型脉冲激光和 AP 高斯步枪的变体，另一些变体使用中型无后坐力步枪。除此之外，只要能装进 400 千克模块化武器挂点的设备都可以携带。

column1: Based upon the 4WA from Arc-Royal MechWorks is this version made to order to incorporate a Chameleon Light Polarization Suite to bring its Capacitor enhanced PPCs close enough for a deadly precision strike.
column2: 该版本以 Arc-Royal MechWorks 的 4WA 为基础，结合了变色龙光偏振套件，使其电容器增强型 PPC 足够接近，以进行致命的精确打击。

column1: Based upon the Clan Stone Rhino and original Matar designs left on Terra's Skobel Mechworks, acting as a Testbed for the Republics SuperHeavy Research Projects does the Dreadnought forever advance on a enemies Position.
column2: Dreadnought以泰拉Skobel机甲工厂留下的氏族Stone Rhino和原始Matar设计为基础，作为共和国超重型研究项目的测试台，永远向敌方阵地推进。

column1: Based upon the rare 10B Variant was this Centurions iconic Shield Arm replaced with an 'Active Shield' that incorporates both an APDS and Blue Shield Dampener alongside the finest Information Warfare equipment money can buy.
column2: 该 Centurion 基于罕见的 10B 型，标志性的盾臂被替换为“主动盾”，集成 APDS 和 Blue Shield Dampener，并配备金钱能买到的最先进信息战设备。

column1: Before it entered full production, the Wendigo had limited number of prototypes made. These similar forerunners were also OmniMechs featuring a smaller engine with only 10 double heat sinks, but had Pod capacity. These slower designs were among units first sent into the Republic as part of the Combine's invasion force. However, these prototypes were flawed and fraught with glitches. It was decided to sacrifice its large carrying capacity for more speed and thus were scrapped in favor of the production model.
column2: Wendigo 全面生产前曾制造少量原型机。这些早期型号同样是 OmniMech，但引擎较小，只有 10 具双重散热器，却拥有吊舱容量。这些较慢的设计是联合王国入侵部队最早派往共和国的单位之一。然而原型机缺陷重重、故障不断，最终决定牺牲巨大搭载能力换取速度，原型机被放弃，转而生产正式型号。

column1: Before it entered full production, the Wendigo had limited number of prototypes made. These similar forerunners were also 全向Mechs featuring a smaller 引擎 with only 10 double heat sinks, but had Pod capacity.
