column1: Before you even say it, no, the rocket-assisted combining thing detailed in the cockpit does not work. I have no idea why they though that would, but carrying around so much fuel and transformation mechanisms just makes for a very crappy LAM. Oh crap... NO! We're not going to make one of these from Urbie LAMs, it wouldn't even work like that! Just be happy it's the massive Urbie of your dreams and will freak out most green troops. Heck, it even has some fancy Clan armor and weaponry!
column2: 在你开口之前先说好：不，驾驶舱里写的火箭助推合体机构根本不能用。我完全不知道他们当时为什么会觉得这东西能行，但带着那么多燃料和变形机构，只会造出一台糟糕透顶的 LAM。哦，糟了……不！我们不会拿城市机甲 LAM 改出这种东西，那样根本行不通！你就知足吧，它已经是你梦想中的巨型城市机甲，足以把大多数新兵吓得魂不附体。见鬼，它甚至还装着一些花哨的氏族装甲和武器！

column1: Being developed in 3147 by the Republic of the Sphere, this variant is based on the LMT-2R. The 2R is an experimental Drone Command Unit.
column2: 这个变体由球体共和国于 3147 年开发，以 LMT-2R 为基础。2R 是一种实验型无人机指挥单位。

column1: Being developed in 3147 by the 球体共和国, this variant is based on the LMT-2R. The 2R is an experimental Drone Command Unit.
column2: 球体共和国于 3147 年开发这一型号，设计基于 LMT-2R。2R 是一台实验型无人机指挥单元。

column1: Bergan Industries has never ceased tinkering with its flagship product. Its latest variant, the -7V, harkens back to the original -1V, easing the transition for the many rookies who still pilot that venerable ’Mech as their trainer. Featuring a significant speed increase, a modestly improved weapons loadout, and a slight boost to its armor, it is best described as “the original, only more so.” Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Bergan Industries 从未停止改进其旗舰产品。最新的 -7V 型号让人想起最初的 -1V，方便众多仍驾驶这款老牌训练机甲的新手平稳过渡。它显著提升了速度，适度改良了武器配置，并略微加强装甲；简单来说，就是“原版的全面强化型”。 特性：窄体/低轮廓 部署成本倍率：0.97 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: Besides its typical experimental Mauler Laser laser, the Master Orion MO-O3 only mounts a combination of advanced targeting hardware and cooling. It's large 引擎 is an attempt at making the Mauler Laser overcome it's main weakness, the short range. 特性：Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser 部署费用倍率：1.28 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 除实验性的 Mauler 激光器外，Master Orion MO-O3 只搭载先进瞄准硬件和冷却设备。它的大型引擎旨在弥补 Mauler 激光器射程过短这一主要弱点。 特性：Improved 冷却夹套 - 激光 部署费用倍率：1.28 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: Between this and the 6T, I am not sure which one I'd prefer. More weapons or better targetting? It's a tough choice, Boss.
column2: 在这台和6T之间，我不确定自己更喜欢哪一台。是更多武器，还是更好的瞄准？老板，这是个艰难的选择。

column1: Big fan of this 'Mech's name. Certainly looks like it'd be one to face down, too. Just be careful with how hot she runs, Boss. She wasn't designed for alpha striking.
column2: 我非常喜欢这台机甲的名字。它看起来确实不好对付。只要注意她运行时的热量，Boss；她不是为全力齐射设计的。

column1: Bigger is better, right, Boss? The Ultra AC/20 leaves a lot bigger holes than a Gauss rifle. Boom, boom!
column2: 越大越好，对吧，老大？Ultra AC/20 打出的窟窿比高斯步枪更大。轰、轰！

column1: Bit more durability at the cost of less weapons. Probably worth it since earlier models struggled with the heat build-up during long engagements.
column2: 牺牲部分武器换取更高耐久性。考虑到早期型号在长时间交战中容易积热，这笔交换或许值得。

column1: Bit of an odd one, to be honest. It's got a fair amount of specialty ammo, but those Quicsell launchers go through it twice as fast as normal. At least the 'special guidance' means that the ammo that you do use won't go to waste. Decent all-rounder mech, although you'll probably be better off swapping those SRM launchers out for normal streaks.
column2: 说实话，这台有点奇怪。它携带不少特种弹药，但Quicsell发射器消耗弹药的速度是正常的两倍。至少“特殊制导”意味着你用掉的弹药不会浪费。整体性能尚可，不过最好把SRM发射器换成普通Streak型号。

column1: Black Rose is the personal 'Mech of the legendary Shrike MechWarrior Malvina Hazen, Jade Falcon Star Colonel and later Khan. Her 'Mech was later used as the inspiration for the SRK-3 variant.
column2: Black Rose是传奇Shrike机甲战士、玉鹰氏族星上校及后来的汗王Malvina Hazen的私人机甲。她的机甲后来成为SRK-3型的灵感来源。

column1: Blackjacks are supposed to be solid, well-rounded 'Mechs for their tonnage. This... isn't.
column2: 按吨位来说，Blackjack 本应是坚固、均衡的机甲。这台……不是。

column1: Born from the Terran Hegemony's attempts to create a medium fire-support platform that would be more advanced than the RLN-1N Rifleman, Mitchell Vehicles unveiled the GLH-1D Galahad in 2570. Though it outgunned the earlier design and found significant acceptance within the Hegemony Armed Forces, the Galahad suffered from the same heat issues as the BattleMech it was meant to replace. The Word of Blake's version of the Galahad, the GLH-3D variant, employs a 240-rated Light Fusion Engine and a small cockpit. For weapons it uses two Light Gauss Rifles with four tons of ammo to split between them. It was also given more sophisticated electronics, in the way of an improved C3 computer and a Guardian ECM Suite.
column2: 泰拉霸权曾试图制造比 RLN-1N Rifleman 更先进的中型火力支援平台；这一尝试催生了 Mitchell Vehicles 于 2570 年推出的 GLH-1D Galahad。尽管火力超过早期设计，并获得霸权武装部队认可，Galahad 仍受到与其要替代的战斗机甲相同的散热问题困扰。Blake 圣言的 Galahad，即 GLH-3D 型号，采用 240 级轻型聚变引擎和小型驾驶舱。武器为两门轻型高斯步枪，并配备四吨弹药供两门步枪分用；同时升级电子设备，安装改进型 C3 计算机和 Guardian ECM 套件。

For weapons it uses two Light Gauss Rifles with four tons of ammo to split between them. It was also given more sophisticated electronics, in the way of an improved C3 computer and a Guardian ECM Suite.
column2: Mitchell Vehicles 为创造比 RLN-1N Rifleman 更先进的中型火力支援平台，于 2570 年推出 GLH-1D Galahad。它火力超过早期设计并获星盟军方采用，却有与替代对象相同的热量问题。布雷克圣言会的 GLH-3D 使用 240 级轻型聚变引擎和小型驾驶舱，装备两具轻型高斯步枪及四吨弹药，并配备改进型 C3 计算机和守护者 ECM 套件。

column1: Boss this thing has increased the missile tube count over standard JES II models at the expense of nearly all the armor. It's a glass cannon; but it sure is a large caliber glass cannon.
column2: 老大，这玩意儿牺牲了几乎全部装甲，把 JES II 标准型的导弹发射管数量加了上去。简直是玻璃大炮，而且口径还特别大。

column1: Boss this thing has increased the missile tube count over standard JES II models at the expense of nearly all the 装甲. It's a glass cannon; but it sure is a large caliber glass cannon.
column2: 老板，这东西用几乎全部装甲为代价，增加了比标准JES II型号更多的导弹管。它是一门玻璃大炮，而且确实是一门口径巨大的玻璃大炮。

column1: Boss, I am in awe. This whole mech is built around permanent mounts for those massive Silver Bullet Gauss Rifles. Your classic example of picking your gun and THEN figuring out how to make it move.
column2: 老板，我服了。这整台机甲都围绕那些巨大的银弹高斯步枪固定挂点建造。典型的先选武器，再想办法让它动起来。

column1: Boss, I don't know how this got past the design review board, but this thing has two Sniper Artillery pieces and nothing else. If anything gets in close, there isn't much it can do. However, those cannons will pulverize most things that are unfortunate enough to be spotted.
column2: 老大，我不知道这个是怎么通过设计审查委员会的，但这东西只有两门狙击炮，没有别的。如果有什么东西靠近，它就无能为力。然而，那些大炮会粉碎大多数不幸被发现的东西。

column1: Boss, I don't know how this got past the design review board, but this thing has two Sniper 火炮 pieces and nothing else. If anything gets in close, there isn't much it can do. However, those cannons will pulverize most things that are unfortunate enough to be spotted.
column2: 老板，我不知道这东西怎么通过了设计审查，但它只有两门狙击炮，除此之外什么也没有。敌人一旦近身，它几乎无计可施。不过，那些火炮能把任何不幸被发现的目标轰成碎片。

column1: Boss, I don't know where these things came from.  I have no idea how they actually work.  And finally, I have no idea why you you think it's a good idea to keep them
column2: 老大，我不知道这些东西从哪里来的，也完全不知道它们究竟怎么运作。更别提我不明白你为什么觉得把它们留下来是个好主意。

column1: Boss, I have no idea how pirates managed to acquire one of the most advanced prototype series 'Mechs in existance. They broke and "fixed" all the weapons but the electronics still seem to be in good shape!
column2: Boss，我完全不知道海盗怎么弄到一台最先进的原型系列机甲。他们把所有武器都拆坏又“修好”了，但电子设备似乎仍然工作良好！

column1: Boss, I hope you don't plan on piloting this yourself.  A round penetrates the armor, and you could see limbs fly off. I heard the designer in charge of this was in a relationship with a test pilot's sibling, and wanted to eliminate the test pilot for some inheritance scheme. It ended up wiping a whole class of test pilots, but missed the one the designer wanted.  Infuriated, the designer took the mech out for a test, hoping to crush the test pilot as they were examining a Roadrunner, and blew themselves up. So, uhh, guess the moral of the story is... don't date coworkers? Or maybe keep an eye on your heat? Don't be greedy?
column2: Boss，希望你没打算亲自驾驶它。只要一发炮弹穿透装甲，你就可能看到四肢飞出去。我听说负责设计的人与试飞员的兄弟姐妹谈恋爱，为了某个继承计划想除掉试飞员。结果整批试飞员都被干掉，却唯独漏掉了目标。设计师恼羞成怒，亲自驾驶机甲测试，趁试飞员检查 Roadrunner 时想把对方碾碎，结果把自己炸上了天。所以这故事的寓意是……别和同事约会？或者注意热量？别太贪心？

column1: Boss, I know it looks like some AeroTechs decided they wanted a Crab to fly but I promise you, this thing is more than just a bigger Crab. The extra ten tons of ‘Mech really make this thing sing, it’s fast enough to get you in trouble and durable enough to get you back out.
column2: 老板，我知道它看起来像是某些 AeroTech 想让一只 Crab 飞起来，但我保证，这东西不只是更大的 Crab。多出来的十吨机体让它真正活了起来：速度快到足以把你带进麻烦，也足够结实，能把你带出来。

column1: Boss, I really don't know what to say about this thing.  Basically some junkhead rigged the weapons up so they could fire nearly any missile or AC10 caliber round imaginable and it was stuffed full of said ammo. I'll try and put this thing back together but it doesn't look good.
column2: 老板，这件事我真不知道该说什么好。  基本上，一些垃圾佬对武器进行了改装，这样他们就可以发射几乎任何可以想象到的导弹或 AC10 口径子弹，而且里面装满了上述弹药。我会尝试把这个东西重新组装起来，但看起来不太好。

column1: Boss, if we have an accidental discharge of those lasers in the bay, I think they'd melt a hole all the way to the galley. Let's not do that.
column2: Boss，如果那些激光在机库里走火，我觉得它们能直接熔穿一个洞，直到船员餐厅。我们可千万别这么做。

column1: Boss, some arena Mechwarrior has put some serious upgrades into this thing. They upgraded the already good stealth systems, weapons, and even threw on jump jets!
column2: 老大，某个竞技场 MechWarrior 对这台机甲做了大量升级。他们强化了本就不错的隐形系统和武器，甚至还加装了跳跃喷射器！

column1: Boss, that Quicsell Incubus? It's all flash and no substance. The extralight structure screams 'cheap,' and the firepower is just a distraction from the flimsy internals. Limited-time offer? Classic sales trick. I'd pass on this one if you're looking for a Mech that'll last longer than a firecracker's pop.
column2: 老大，那个Quicsell Incubus？一切都是闪光，没有实质内容。超轻的结构尖叫着“便宜”，而火力只是分散了脆弱的内部结构的注意力。限时优惠？经典的销售技巧。如果你正在寻找一种比鞭炮爆炸更持久的机甲，我会放弃这个。

column1: Boss, that's a lot of pew pew for the Choo Choo.
column2: 老大，对Choo Choo来说，这火力也太猛了。

column1: Boss, the Minnesota Tribe took the Abyss design and rebuilt it with everything they could get their hands on. Clan engine, Clan PPC, Angel ECM, Artemis V, CASE II, jump jets. They only gave it to their best, so every time one showed up on a Clan homeworld, people paid attention. Getting one of these in our bay is something else. This is not a mech you put a rookie in.
column2: 老大，明尼苏达部族拿 Abyss 的设计重新打造了一遍，能弄到手的东西全用上了：氏族引擎、氏族 PPC、天使 ECM、Artemis V、CASE II、跳跃喷射器。他们只把这种机甲交给最精锐的战士，所以每次它出现在氏族母星，所有人都会格外留意。咱们机库里能有一台，真是难得。这可不是能交给新手驾驶的机甲。

column1: Boss, the Minnesota Tribe took the Abyss design and rebuilt it with everything they could get their hands on. Clan 引擎, Clan PPC, Angel ECM, Artemis V, CASE II, jump jets. They only gave it to their best, so every time one showed up on a Clan homeworld, people paid attention. Getting one of these in our bay is something else. This is not a mech you put a rookie in.
column2: 老板，明尼苏达部落拿到Abyss设计后，用能找到的一切对它进行了重建：氏族引擎、氏族PPC、天使ECM、Artemis V、CASE II和跳跃喷射器。他们只把它交给最优秀的人，所以每当一台出现在氏族母星时，人们都会格外关注。让这样的机体进入我们的维修舱非同小可，绝不能交给新手驾驶。

column1: Boss, these Shadow Hawk IICs are a sleek redesign of the classic Shadow Hawk. They are lighter and faster than the original but still manage to pack a similar punch
column2: Boss，这些 Shadow Hawk IIC 是经典 Shadow Hawk 的流线型重设计。它们比原版更轻、更快，同时仍能保持相近的火力。

column1: Boss, these pirates somehow got their hands on an Anubis stealth mech. How they managed to salvage the delicate advanced Stealth and ECM systems, yet broke the LRMs is beyond me.  They have replaced them with some semblance of an MML system and of course it wouldn't be a pirate without flamers.
column2: 老板，这些海盗不知怎么弄到了一台Anubis隐形机甲。他们竟能打捞出脆弱的高级隐形和ECM系统，却把LRM弄坏了，真是不可思议。他们用某种MML系统替代，当然还加了火焰喷射器——没有火焰喷射器就不算海盗。

column1: Boss, they're pushing the Quicsell Locust – agility, firepower, and some fancy cockpit view. I'm not buying the 'specially lightened' structure bit; sounds like they're hiding something. Flashy promises, but I'd approach it cautiously – could be more trouble than it's worth in the heat of battle.
column2: 老板，他们正在推动 Quicsell Locust——敏捷性、火力和一些奇特的驾驶舱视图。我不买“特别轻”的结构钻头；听起来他们好像在隐瞒什么。华而不实的承诺，但我会谨慎对待它——在激烈的战斗中可能会带来更多的麻烦。

column1: Boss, they're selling this Quicsell Wolfhound – all chemical lasers and a fancy laser AMS. Lightened structure for agility, sure, but chemical lasers mean you're playing with volatile ammo. And that laser AMS? It sounds like a lot of glitz for a Wolfhound. I'd be cautious – chemical carnage might just turn into a Mech meltdown when you least expect it. Flashy promises, but I'm not sold on the practicality.
column2: 老板，他们正在出售这款 Quicsell Wolfhound - 全化学激光器和精美的激光 AMS。当然，减轻结构可以提高灵活性，但化学激光器意味着你使用的是挥发性弹药。那激光 AMS 呢？对于猎狼犬来说，这听起来很浮华。我会很谨慎——化学屠杀可能会在你最意想不到的时候变成机械崩溃。华而不实的承诺，但我并不相信其实用性。

column1: Boss, they're tryin' to sell us this laughable UrbanMech UFO as the pinnacle of space piracy. A Gauss Rifle with a fancy 'tractor beam' for scrap, a bunch of small lasers, and Metal blarin' through its comms. It's like they're playin' MechWarrior dress-up in space. Hurlin' scrap through a Gauss Rifle might be a spectacle, but I'd bet it's more likely to backfire than impress. And those small lasers? It's a joke – like they strapped glow sticks to a Mech and called it a day. I'd pass on this cosmic clown show; there's no serious threat here, just a Mech trying too hard to be something it ain't.
column2: 老大，他们正试图向我们推销这个可笑的UrbanMech UFO，作为太空盗版的巅峰之作。一把高斯步枪，带有用于废料的奇特“牵引光束”、一束小型激光器，以及通过其通讯发出的金属声。就像他们在太空中玩机甲战士装扮一样。用高斯步枪投掷碎片可能会很壮观，但我敢打赌这更有可能适得其反，而不是给人留下深刻印象。还有那些小型激光器？这是个笑话——就像他们把荧光棒绑在机甲上然后就到此为止了。我会放弃这个宇宙小丑表演；这里没有严重的威胁，只是一个机甲试图成为它不是的东西。

column1: Boss, this beauty is one of those Valkyrie IIs from the Solaris stables; I've seen these in action. 'Sigrun' here has a BattleMech Sword and TSM allowing it to cleave limbs clean off many 'Mechs. Her left-hook is also pretty damn brutal with that Plasma Cannon. Roll that all together with that monstrous engine and six jump jets, this 'Mech can chase down and murder most 'Mechs.
column2: 老板，这台漂亮货是Solaris马厩里的Valkyrie II之一，我见过它们实战。“Sigrun”装有战斗机甲剑和TSM，能把许多机甲的肢体整条砍下。它的左勾拳配合等离子炮也相当残暴。再加上那台怪物般的引擎和六具跳跃喷射器，这台机甲能追上并消灭大多数机甲。

column1: Boss, this beauty is one of those Valkyrie IIs from the Solaris stables; I've seen these in action. 'Sigrun' here has a BattleMech Sword and TSM allowing it to cleave limbs clean off many 'Mechs. Her left-hook is also pretty damn brutal with that Plasma Cannon. Roll that all together with that monstrous 引擎 and six jump jets, this 'Mech can chase down and murder most 'Mechs.
column2: 老板，这台漂亮机体是Solaris马厩里的Valkyrie II之一，我见过它们实战。“Sigrun”配备战斗机甲剑和TSM，能干净利落地砍下许多机甲的肢体。它的左拳同样凶狠，因为装有等离子炮。再加上那台怪物般的引擎和六具跳跃喷射器，这台机甲能追上并杀死大多数机甲。

column1: Boss, this is a Kuritan refit of the Grasshopper featuring an upgraded Endo-Steel chassis and a new heavy-duty gyro for increased stability. Its sporting an energy loadout featuring six Light PPCs, four of them even have attached capacitors to boost their damage.
column2: Boss，这是一台库里塔改装的 Grasshopper，采用升级的 Endo 钢底盘和新型重型陀螺仪来提高稳定性。它以能量武器为主，装备六门轻型 PPC，其中四门还加装了电容器以提升伤害。

column1: Boss, this is a RISC overhaul of an already strong support unit converting it to a direct support role.
column2: Boss，这是一台本就强大的支援单位经过 RISC 彻底改造后的版本，转而承担直接支援任务。

column1: Boss, this is a... Timber Cat? Is this wood? This IS wood! Who put wood into the structure? And are those decorative ears on the missile launchers? How does this not explode into fire when hot? How does that wood even survive the stresses of a mech? I can't believe QuicSell somehow developed some sort of magical wood that worked. And I have to order parts from them, can't replace it with stuff I find. Well, at least the weaponry is good. Those Streak PPCs are some of my favorite weapons, and the REX laser series is just exquisite.
column2: 老大，这是……木猫？这是木头吗？这是木头！谁将木材放入结构中？那些装饰性的耳朵是导弹发射器上的吗？这怎么能在热的时候不爆炸呢？那块木头是如何承受机甲的压力的呢？我不敢相信 QuicSell 不知何故开发出了某种有效的神奇木材。我必须从他们那里订购零件，不能用我找到的东西替换它。好吧，至少武器装备还是不错的。这些 Streak PPC 是我最喜欢的武器之一，REX 激光系列非常精致。

column1: Boss, this is basically a beached battleship, but the main guns are intact and there's a top-of-the-line stealth system masking the whole thing. It may only move by dropship, but as long as you keep anything from getting close enough to see it, "Tommy" here will light up the countryside from here to Tharkad, no problem.
column2: 老大，这基本上是一艘搁浅的战舰，但主炮完好无损，而且有一个顶级的隐形系统掩盖了整个事情。它可能只能通过运输船移动，但只要你不让任何东西靠近到看到它，“汤米”就会照亮从这里到塔卡德的乡村，没问题。

column1: Boss, this is one of Defiance Industries' Fafnirs, but the heavy gauss rifles have been replaced with these idiotic "rotary hammers" and the engine seems to be a homebrew attempt to replicate SLDF tech. They managed to get their hands on a bona fide Capellan stealth suite, though.
column2: 老大，这是一具 Defiance Industries 的 Fafnir，但重型高斯步枪被换成了这些愚蠢的“旋转锤”，引擎似乎是自制的星盟技术仿制品。不过他们确实弄到了一套正宗的卡佩兰隐身套件。

column1: Boss, this is one of 迪法恩斯工业' Fafnirs, but the heavy gauss rifles have been replaced with these idiotic "rotary hammers" and the 引擎 seems to be a homebrew attempt to replicate SLDF tech. They managed to get their hands on a bona fide Capellan stealth suite, though.
column2: 老大，这是一台迪法恩斯工业公司的Fafnir，但重型高斯步枪被替换成了这些愚蠢的“旋转锤”，而引擎似乎是他们试图仿制SLDF技术的土制产物。不过，他们确实弄到了一套正宗的卡佩兰隐形套件。

column1: Boss, this thing ain't much for hurtin' 'Mechs but between that engine and that Ion Projector, infantry and the like don't stand a chance.
column2: 老大，这东西对机甲伤害不大，但在引擎和离子投射器之间，步兵之类的人根本没有机会。

column1: Boss, this thing has as much armor as an assault mech and it ain't no pirate junkhead doing it either, it was purposely designed like this for some reason. Sure, it's heavily armored but it's gonna need it because it's gonna be outpaced by even dismounted infantry..at a walk.
column2: 老大，这东西的装甲量和突击机甲一样多，而且不是海盗废物碰巧做到的，它显然是出于某种原因被特意设计成这样。确实，它装甲厚重；但它确实需要这些装甲，因为哪怕是下车步兵用走的都能超过它。

column1: Boss, this thing has as much 装甲 as an assault mech and it ain't no pirate junkhead doing it either, it was purposely designed like this for some reason. Sure, it's heavily armored but it's gonna need it because it's gonna be outpaced by even dismounted infantry..at a walk.
column2: 老板，这东西的装甲和一台突击机甲一样厚，而且可不是哪个海盗废物随便拼出来的，它似乎就是出于某种原因被刻意设计成这样。没错，它装甲极厚，但这是必要的，因为就算是徒步步兵慢慢走，也能超过它的速度。

column1: Boss, this thing has had some serious RISC technical upgrades. It has had most weapons stripped from it in favor of two RISC MML-10 systems in the torsos along with an Artemis IV control system.
column2: Boss，这台机甲接受了大规模 RISC 技术升级。大多数武器都被拆除，换成躯干中的两套 RISC MML-10 系统和一套 Artemis IV 控制系统。

column1: Boss, this thing is an odd mix of primitive junk and impressive firepower, I'm not sure how to feel about it.
column2: 老大，这东西把原始的破烂和惊人的火力混在了一起，我真不知道该作何感想。

column1: Boss, this thing is meant to put some serious hurt on other units through FIRE! It's got a special Fire Control System that some yahoo hardwired into the LAM that somehow causes it to toss out some type of Plasma with each shot it fires.
column2: Boss，这东西就是要靠火力给其他单位造成严重伤害！它装有一套特殊火控系统，某个蠢货把它硬接进 LAM，结果每次开火都会以某种方式喷出等离子。

column1: Boss, this thing is one of a kind, literally. Dark Caste built it from Star League parts pulled off a Goliath Scorpion cache in 2898. No Clan tech, just old hardware put together right. It raided for fifty years before vanishing on Glory. Well, now we know where it ended up. Whoever had it last took good care of it. There is nothing else like it out there.
column2: 老大，这家伙真是独一无二。黑暗阶层在 2898 年从一处星盟时期的 Goliath Scorpion 储藏点拆下零件，把它拼装了出来。没有氏族技术，只有老旧设备，但都组装得恰到好处。它四处劫掠了五十年，后来在 Glory 消失。现在我们知道它最后落到了谁手里。前任主人把它保养得很好。世上再找不到第二台这样的机甲。

column1: Boss, this thing is one of a kind, literally. Dark Caste built it from Star League parts pulled off a 歌利亚蝎 cache in 2898. No Clan tech, just old hardware put together right. It raided for fifty years before vanishing on Glory. Well, now we know where it ended up. Whoever had it last took good care of it. There is nothing else like it out there.
column2: 老板，这台东西确实独一无二。黑暗卡斯特在2898年用从歌利亚蝎储藏库中拆出的星盟部件制造了它。没有氏族技术，只有精心拼装的老式硬件。它进行了五十年的掠袭，随后在Glory上失踪。现在我们知道它最终去了哪里。上一任拥有者把它保养得很好，外面没有任何同类。

column1: Boss, what did you bring me this time?!? This thing is barely funcional, and it can't mount much of anything but missiles. Whatever yokel refit this thing absolutely LOVED his rockets, to the point that there is a sticker plastered on the cockpit viewscreen that just says 'Rocket Man'.
column2: Boss，你这次又带了什么回来？！这东西几乎无法正常工作，除了导弹之外什么都装不了。不管哪个乡巴佬改装了它，他肯定极度热爱火箭，甚至在驾驶舱视窗上贴了一张只写着“Rocket Man”的贴纸。

column1: Boss, what even is this thing? It actually TRANSFORMS itself into a tank! And it's got 2 MRM40 launchers hardwired into the torsos, that just have images of ducks painted all over them.
column2: 老板，这东西到底是什么？它真的能把自己变成坦克！而且躯干里硬接了两具MRM-40发射器，上面全画着鸭子。

column1: Boss, whoever gets in this thing's way is braver than me... maybe whoever pilots it as well, we found some handwritten instructions on how you can make popcorn in the cockpit while that TOS is active.
column2: Boss，谁挡在这东西面前都比我勇敢……也许驾驶它的人也是如此。我们还发现了一份手写说明，教你如何在 TOS 启动时待在驾驶舱里爆玉米花。

column1: Boss, with two of those Sniper Artillery Pieces, this Helepolis is capable of leveling entire city block in one or two salvos. I don't know what they were thinking but I'm sure it involved a bunch of craters.
column2: 老大，赫勒波利斯装了两门那种狙击炮，一两轮齐射就能把整片街区夷为平地。我不知道他们当时怎么想的，不过肯定离不开一大堆弹坑。

column1: Boss, with two of those Sniper火炮 Pieces, this Helepolis is capable of leveling entire city block in one or two salvos. I don't know what they were thinking but I'm sure it involved a bunch of craters.
column2: 老板，这台 Helepolis 配备两门狙击炮，一两轮齐射就能夷平整条城市街区。我不知道设计者在想什么，但肯定和制造一堆弹坑有关。

column1: Boss...  What were these Institute guys thinking? This has to be the strangest looking Land Air 'Mech you've brought to my Mechbay. But I'll be damned if I don't see the appeal. It's fast as hell for a 65 ton LAM in its preferred mode, and has a LOT of bombs. Mad Bomber, indeed.
column2: Boss……这些研究所的人到底在想什么？这是你带进我的机甲库里外形最奇怪的陆空两用机甲。但不得不说，它确实有吸引力。在偏好的模式下，对于一台 65 吨的 LAM 来说它快得离谱，而且炸弹多得惊人。Mad Bomber，名副其实。

column1: Boss... This mech is based on Seraph, however this version is fully packed with experimental technologies. I don't know where you got it, but I smell troubles.
column2: Boss……这台机甲基于 Seraph，但这个版本塞满了实验技术。我不知道你从哪弄来的，但我闻到了麻烦的味道。

column1: Boss... this thing! I don't know who in the hells came up with the idea to add freaking spikes to a VTOL and have it ram itself into a 'Mech, but I'll be damned if it doesn't work pretty well.
column2: 老大……这东西！我不知道到底是谁想出了这个主意，在垂直起降飞机上添加怪异的尖刺，并让它自己撞上“机甲”，但如果它不能很好地工作，我就该死了。

column1: Boss... this was a perfectly good Timber Wolf until some tarwaffle with more money than sense strapped it into half a dozen rocket packs and a bulldozer. It's basically a missile, with a very unlucky pilot inside.
column2: 老大……这是一只非常好的大灰狼，直到一些比理智更赚钱的松饼将它绑在六个火箭包和一个 推土机 上。它基本上是一枚导弹，里面有一个非常不幸的飞行员。

column1: Boss? You ever wonder what a reactor breach looks like up close? No? Well, if you ever do, go stand near the right arm on this thing.
column2: 老板？您有没有想过近距离观察反应堆破裂是什么样子？不？好吧，如果你愿意的话，就站在这个东西的右臂附近。

column1: Built around a 360-rated XL Engine, the Lancelot LNC25-01M is armed with a duo of ER Large Lasers and a Rocketstorm battery.
column2: 兰斯洛特 LNC25-01M 以 360 级 XL 引擎为核心，配备两门增程大型激光器和一组火箭风暴发射器。

column1: Built around a 360-rated XL引擎, the 兰斯洛特 LNC25-01M is armed with a duo of ER Large Lasers and a Rocketstorm battery.
column2: 兰斯洛特 LNC25-01M 围绕 360 级 XL 引擎建造，装备一对增程大型激光器和一组火箭风暴电池。

column1: Built as one of the earliest SecurityMechs ever fielded, drawn up just days after the original Wasp debuted. Sigourney Renault put it together using common IndustrialMech parts and cheap Hegemony weapons, aiming for something any world could afford at around a million C-Bills. Never stood a chance against real BattleMechs, so it mostly stuck to Periphery worlds that didn't expect that kind of trouble.
column2: 作为最早投入使用的安全机甲之一，是在最初的黄蜂号首次亮相几天后制定的。西格妮·雷诺使用常见的工业机甲零件和廉价的霸权武器将其组装起来，目标是打造任何世界都可以用大约一百万张国库券买得起的东西。从来没有机会对抗真正的机甲战士，所以它主要停留在没有预料到会出现这种麻烦的外围世界。

column1: Built by Meridian Manufacturing, the Arbiter is nothing more than a light WorkMech crafted to look like a large and impressive Heavy Battlemech. A common refit to the Arbiter does it exchange the rifle for a 'real' Weapon.
column2: Arbiter 由 Meridian Manufacturing 制造，本质上只是披着大型重型战斗机甲外形的轻型工业机甲。常见的 Arbiter 改装会拆掉步枪，换上一件“真正的”武器。

column1: Built for House Liao the 5L attempted to make the reliable Marauder chassis work alongside their modernized Stealth Forces.
column2: 5L 为廖氏家族打造，试图让可靠的 Marauder 底盘与他们现代化的隐形部队协同作战。

column1: Built for Solaris by Barrymore Munitions, this Marauder replaces the usual autocannon with a large mech mortar. The rest of the loadout is dedicated to flexibility, carrying a bit of just about everything.
column2: Barrymore Munitions 为 Solaris 打造了这台 Marauder，用一门大型机甲迫击炮替换通常的自动火炮。其余配置注重灵活性，几乎每类装备都带了一点。

column1: Built for long-range firepower, this Pulverizer relies on a Hyper PPC for firepower at all ranges and the inclusion of a standard engine and Heavy Cockpit makes it sturdier than many of its contemporaries.
column2: 这款粉碎机专为远程火力而设计，依靠 Hyper PPC 提供所有射程的火力，并且包含标准发动机和重型驾驶舱，使其比许多同时代产品更坚固。

column1: Built for long-range firepower, this Pulverizer relies on a Hyper PPC for firepower at all ranges and the inclusion of a standard 引擎 and Heavy Cockpit makes it sturdier than many of its contemporaries.
column2: 这台Pulverizer专为远程火力打造，以Hyper PPC在所有射程提供火力；标准引擎和重型驾驶舱使它比许多同时代机体更加坚固。

column1: Built on Solaris VII, the Valiant K7 is a light skirmisher that relies on a trio of ER Medium Lasers, a deadly Hatchet, and MASC.
column2: Valiant K7 在 Solaris VII 建造，是一台轻型突击机甲，依靠三门增程中型激光、一把致命战斧和 MASC 作战。

column1: Built on Solaris VII, the Valiant K7 is a light skirmisher that relies on a trio of ER 中型激光s, a deadly Hatchet, and MASC.
column2: 勇士K7在太阳神七号建造，是一台依靠三门ER中型激光、致命战斧和MASC作战的轻型游击机甲。

column1: Built on the Marauder IIC workhorse chassis, the Z variant eschews the ERPPCs for a Society Heavy Gauss Rifle, a quartet of Medium Supra Lasers, a prototype supercharged light 340SL engine and four Jump Jets for mobility.
column2: Z 型以掠夺者 IIC 的成熟底盘为基础，舍弃 ERPPC，改装社会体重型高斯步枪、四门中型 Supra 激光器、原型增压轻型 340SL 引擎，并配备四具跳跃喷射器以提升机动性。

column1: Built on the design of the Shrike, the Caracara is Clan Jade Falcons first foray into Superheavies. Packing a variation of advanced equipment for command, EWS and weapons targeting, the design is clearly aimed towards the Star Commanders of the Clan. The Caracara further keeps the jump capabilities of the Shrike by use of two Booster Jets and a Partial Wing System.
column2: Caracara 以 Shrike 为基础，是玉衡鹰氏族首次进军超重型机甲的尝试。它搭载多种先进的指挥、电子战和武器瞄准设备，显然是为氏族星指挥官打造的。Caracara 还通过两台助推喷气机和部分机翼系统保留了 Shrike 的跳跃能力。

column1: Built on the design of the Shrike, the Caracara is Clan Jade Falcons first foray into Superheavies. Packing a variation of advanced equipment for command, EWS and weapons targeting, the design is clearly aimed towards the Star Commanders of the Clan. The Caracara further keeps the jump capabilities of the Shrike by use of two Booster Jets.
column2: 卡拉卡拉以鹫鹰为基础，是 Jade Falcon 氏族首次涉足超重型机甲领域。它配备多种先进的指挥、EWS 和武器瞄准设备，显然是为氏族星指挥官量身打造。卡拉卡拉还通过两具助推喷射器保留了鹫鹰的跳跃能力。

column1: Built on the design of the Shrike, the Caracara is 玉鹰氏族s first foray into Superheavies. Packing a variation of advanced equipment for command, EWS and weapons targeting, the design is clearly aimed towards the Star Commanders of the Clan. The Caracara further keeps the jump capabilities of the Shrike by use of two Booster Jets.
column2: 卡拉卡拉以伯劳为基础，是玉鹰氏族首次尝试制造超重型机甲。它携带用于指挥、电子战支援和武器瞄准的先进设备，显然是为氏族星级指挥官设计的。卡拉卡拉还通过两具助推喷射器保留伯劳的跳跃能力。

column1: Built on the 掠夺者 IIC workhorse chassis, the Z variant eschews the ERPPCs for a Society 重型高斯步枪, a quartet of Medium Supra Lasers, a prototype supercharged light 340SL 引擎 and four Jump Jets for mobility.
column2: Z变型采用掠夺者IIC的主力底盘，舍弃ER PPC，改装一门Society重型高斯步枪、四门中型Supra激光器、一台原型增压轻型340SL引擎和四具跳跃喷射器，以提升机动性。

column1: Built with experimental RISC Technology, this Mauler excels at dealing extreme alpha strikes at all ranges.
column2: 这台 Mauler 采用实验性的 RISC 技术建造，擅长在所有射程发动极端的全力齐射。

column1: Built with nearly Same Mindset as the Other Spirit Walkers, the symmetrical Loadout gives this Spirit Walker one Hell of a Punch. A Gauss Rifle, SRM6 and LRM15 Launcher per side make it even scarier than the normal ones. While not Faster, it has Even more Armour than before, so even the Occasional shots in the Back are Shrugged off by this Mech. The only Downside to this Variant is the ammo Dependancy, which as it stands, might be the only Weakness.
column2: 这台 Spirit Walker 与其他同族机甲采用近乎相同的设计理念，对称的武器配置让它拥有惊人火力。左右两侧各装一门高斯步枪、一具 SRM-6 和一具 LRM-15 发射器，比普通型号更加可怕。它的速度没有提高，但装甲比以前更多，因此即使偶尔被击中背部，也能轻松承受。这个型号唯一的缺点是依赖弹药，而就目前而言，这或许是它唯一的弱点。

column1: Built with nearly Same Mindset as the Other 灵魂行者s, the symmetrical Loadout gives this 灵魂行者 one Hell of a Punch. A Gauss Rifle, SRM6 and LRM15 Launcher per side make it even scarier than the normal ones. While not Faster, it has Even more Armour than before, so even the Occasional shots in the Back are Shrugged off by this Mech. The only Downside to this Variant is the ammo Dependancy, which as it stands, might be the only Weakness.
column2: 这台机甲与其他型号采用近乎相同的思路，对称式载荷让它拥有惊人的火力。每侧各配备一门高斯步枪、一具 SRM-6 和一具 LRM-15 发射器，比普通型号更加可怕。虽然速度没有提升，但装甲比以前更厚，因此连偶尔击中后方的炮火也能轻松承受。这一变体唯一的缺点是依赖弹药，而这可能正是它目前唯一的弱点。

column1: CRB-C Crab 是该设计的一次小幅更新，改装后加入了 C3 从属单元。它由德拉科尼斯联合体于 3056 年推出，通过移除中型激光为 C3 单元腾出空间。 Quirk: 易于维护 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: CRB-C Crab 是该型号的早期小规模改型，配备由多个 C3 组件组成的 C3 网络系统。它于 3056 年推出，通过拆除中型激光为 C3 组件腾出内部空间。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.02 手臂执行器限制：左下臂

column1: CTF-4X 是这款原型机甲的最新变体。4X 降级了引擎，使它跑得更慢，但以两门自动炮 5、一门大型激光和一具 LRM5 增加了更多远程火力。 Quirk: 防护驱动器 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.08 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: CTF-4X 是该原型机甲的早期改型。4X 提升了装甲，使其更能承受伤害；它以一门自动炮/5、一门大型激光和一具 LRM-5 发射器换取更强的远程火力。 特性：精确操控 部署费用倍率：1.08 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: Capitalizing on the hatred of Wolfs Dragoons. Kurita had a plan for several captured Annihilators. Remove the limiters on the LBX weapons and show Jaime Wolf and his Mercenary Dogs what Death was really about.
column2: 利用狼龙骑兵的仇恨。栗田对抓获的几名歼灭者制定了计划。移除 LBX 武器的限制，并向 Jaime Wolf 和他的雇佣狗展示死亡的真正含义。

column1: Centipede Scout Car由Gienah Combat Vehicles & Red Devil Industries于3053年生产. 该车辆旨在为其指挥单位前方进行侦察 发现隐藏单位. 这种客户订购的变体在3067年FedCom内战期间推出 首次提供给第7多尼戈尔卫队的装甲旅. 此变体将车辆的中型激光替换为TAG. 该车辆拥有增强的装甲保护 并配备守护者ECM以增加防御. 环境限制: 由于使用ICE 此单位无法部署在月球或火星环境. 移动: 8/12格 / 240/360米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 110 10 左侧 110 10 右侧 110 10 后方 110 10 总计 440 40 特质: 灵活 #武器: 1x TAG 1x 车载火焰喷射器
column2: 蜈蚣侦察车由 Gienah Combat Vehicles 与 Red Devil Industries 于 3053 年生产，用于在指挥单位前方侦察并发现隐藏目标。该客户定制改型以 TAG 替换中型激光，并加装守护者 ECM。 装甲： 移动: 8/12格 / 240/360米. 结构： 装甲 数值 A S 结构 前方 左侧 110 10 右侧 110 10 后方 110 10 炮塔 110 10 总计 440 40 #武器: 1x TAG 1x 车载火焰喷射器

column1: Centipede Scout Car由Gienah Combat Vehicles & Red Devil Industries于3053年生产. 该车辆最初设计用于在其指挥单位前方进行侦察 以发现隐藏单位 但Centipede SRM变体是在3062年FedCom内战期间创建的战场改装版 专门改装用于作为快速打击者进行打了就跑的攻击. 它移除了标准型号的所有原始装备 改为装备六具SRM-2导弹发射器 配备一吨弹药 以显著提升火力 代价是失去其先进传感器和侦察能力. 环境限制: 由于使用内燃机 该单位无法部署在月球或火星环境. 移动: 8/12格 / 240/360米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 80 10 左侧 80 10 右侧 80 10 后方 80 10 总计 320 40 特质: 灵巧 #武器: 6x SRM-2
column2: 蜈蚣侦察车由 Gienah Combat Vehicles 与 Red Devil Industries 于 3053 年生产，用于在指挥单位前方侦察并发现隐藏目标。该 SRM 改型专为 FedCom 内战期间的快速突袭设计。 装甲： 移动: 8/12格 / 240/360米. 结构：装甲 数值 A S结构 前方 左侧 80 10 右侧 80 10 后方 80 10 炮塔 80 10 总计 320 40 #武器: 6x SRM-2

column1: Ceres Metals put this together as a joint project between the Confederation and the Magistracy, and honestly it shows. Reinforced Structure under all that Ferro-Fibrous plating means this thing shrugs off punishment that would wreck most other heavies. It is slow, but it does not need to be fast when everything shooting back at it is having such a hard time actually hurting it. Good machine to have on your side in a grinding fight.
column2: Ceres 金属公司将这台机甲作为卡佩兰联邦与治国会的联合项目打造，说实话，一看就知道是两家合作的产物。铁纤维装甲下方的强化结构让它能轻松承受足以摧毁大多数其他重型机甲的打击。它速度较慢，但当敌人根本难以伤到它时，也不需要跑得快。在消耗战里，有它站在你这边准没错。

column1: Chompie goes Om Nom Nom Nom.
column2: Chompie 大口咀嚼，吧唧吧唧。

column1: Cicada 于 2740 年推出，重 40 吨，是作为 Locust 的竞争对手而开发的。Slightly better armed and just as fast, the Cicada’s heavier 装甲 and better melee capabilities enable it to function as an effective Light Mech hunter and scout. Cicada 3X 由 280 级 XL 发动机提供动力，配备一对中型 X 脉冲激光激光器和一对 MML-7。隐形装甲和守护者 ECM 完善了该变体。
column2: Cicada 于 2740 年推出，重 40 吨，作为 Locust 的竞争者。它武装略强而速度相同，更厚装甲和更出色近战能力使其成为有效的轻型机甲猎手和侦察机。Cicada 3X 由 280 级 XL 引擎驱动，装备一对中型 X 脉冲激光器和一对 MML-7；潜行装甲与守护者 ECM 完善了配置。

column1: Clan Diamond Shark built these out of their Twycross factory after they rebuilt it. Ultralight scout, fifteen tons, not meant to fight anything seriously. Lyran Alliance bought most of them and mercenaries liked them too because they're cheap enough to risk losing. That Chameleon Light Polarization Shield is Star League era tech which is a nice touch for something this small. Don't let anyone shoot at it though.
column2: 钻石鲨鱼氏族在重建 Twycross 工厂后建造了这些产品。超轻型侦察机，十五吨，不适合认真战斗。天琴联盟购买了其中的大部分，雇佣兵也喜欢它们，因为它们便宜到足以冒失去的风险。变色龙光偏振护盾是星际联盟时代的技术，对于这么小的东西来说这是一个很好的接触。但不要让任何人向它开枪。

column1: Clan Diamond Shark built this at the turn of the 32nd century and the engine alone takes up 40% of the total mass. Most of the ones produced ended up with wealthy private buyers using them for illegal street racing in the Periphery rather than actual military service. A former pirate named Ryan Reynolds bought one, won a bunch of races, then hit a canyon wall at nearly 400 kph on Tincalunas in 3142. Finding one of these intact and operational is almost unbelievable.
column2: 钻鲨氏族在 32 世纪之交制造了这台机甲，单是引擎就占整机质量的 40%。大多数量产机都落入富有的私人买家手中，被用于边疆非法街头竞速，而非真正服役。一名前海盗 Ryan Reynolds 买下一台，赢得多场比赛后，于 3142 年在 Tincalunas 以近 400 kph 撞上峡谷壁。还能找到一台完整且可运行的机体，几乎令人难以置信。

column1: Clan Ice Hellion took the old Coriolis design and rebuilt it from the ground up using Clan tech in 2888. Lighter, faster, more dangerous. The Ultra AC/20 alone makes it something you take seriously, but stacking an LB-10X and Ultra AC/5 on top of that means it can threaten targets at almost any range. Nearly every Clan ran these as second-line units before the Invasion. Finding one in our bay means we pulled something genuinely rare out of the field.
column2: Ice Hellion 氏族在 2888 年使用氏族科技彻底重建了老旧的 Coriolis 设计。它更轻、更快，也更危险。单凭 Ultra AC/20 就足以让人认真对待，而再加上 LB-10X 和 Ultra AC/5 后，它几乎能威胁所有距离的目标。入侵前，几乎每个氏族都把它作为第二线单位使用。在我们的机库里发现一台，说明我们从战场带回了真正稀有的战利品。

column1: Clan Ice Hellion, always prolific users of fast light 'Mechs, copied the original redesign of the Incubus, but decided to create their own variant. This fifth version mounts an ATM 6 with two tons of ammunition, two ER Medium Lasers, and four Light Machine Guns.
column2: 冰猎手氏族一向大量使用高速轻型机甲；他们仿制了 Incubus 的原始改进型，但决定打造自己的版本。第五型安装一具 ATM-6 和两吨弹药、两门增程中型激光以及四挺轻型机枪。

column1: Clan Ice Hellion, always prolific users of fast light 'Mechs, copied the original redesign of the Incubus, but decided to create their own variant. This fifth version mounts an ATM 6 with two tons of ammunition, two ER 中型激光s, and four 轻型 Machine Guns.
column2: 冰狱氏族一向大量使用高速轻型机甲，他们复制了Incubus的原始重设计，并决定创建自己的变型。第五版装备一具ATM-6和两吨弹药、两门ER中型激光器及四挺轻型机枪。

column1: Clan Nova Cat’s Conjurer program in the 3060s saw refits and various new builds at times only loosely based on the original. Some of them, like the Conjurer 6, had back-canted legs and weapon pod arms reliant on energy weapons. These served as foundation to the Hellcat, and inspired the Avalanche's upgrade to the Wendigo seventy years later on Avon. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 新星猫氏族在 3060 年代推进 Conjurer 计划，对原型进行改装并推出多种新设计，有些型号与原型只有松散关联。例如 Conjurer 6 采用后倾式双腿和依赖能量武器的武器舱手臂。这些设计成为 Hellcat 的基础，并于七十年后在 Avon 启发了 Avalanche 对 Wendigo 的升级。 特性：扩展躯干旋转 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂致动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: Clan Sea Fox built this a few years before Clan Wolf took Terra, named it after their old Diamond Shark identity. It sold well. The Federated Suns, Lyran Commonwealth, Capellans, Taurian Concordat, even the Magistracy bought their own versions. Hell's Horses ran a few variants too. Three hard-wired Medium Pulse Lasers in the left torso no matter what config you drop in, which tells you exactly how Sea Fox wanted this thing used. They built it to sell, and they built it right.
column2: 海狐氏族在狼氏族夺取 Terra 前几年制造了这台机甲，并以钻石鲨时期的旧身份为它命名。它卖得很好。联邦太阳、莱兰联邦、联邦制、陶里安协约，甚至摄政领都购买了自己的版本；地狱之马也运行着几种变体。无论采用哪种配置，左侧躯干都硬连着三门中型脉冲激光，这充分说明海狐希望它如何投入战斗。他们造它是为了销售，也确实把它造得很好。

column1: Classified Quirk: Reinforced Legs Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 机密 特质: 强化腿部 投放成本倍率: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制: 右下

column1: Codenamed Puma by Inner Sphere forces who first engaged it, the Adder is a light Clan Omni机甲 that serves as a direct or an indirect fire-Zupport unit in most of its configurations. The ADR-Z only carries a pair of Society-设计 MRM 30s and the hard-mounted Flamers, leaving it vulnerable once the MRMs run dry.
column2: 最初与它交战的内层圈部队给它起了“Puma”的代号。Adder 是一台轻型氏族全向机甲，在大多数配置中担任直接或间接火力支援单位。ADR-Z 只携带一对 Society 设计的 MRM-30 和固定安装的火焰喷射器；MRM 打光后它就会变得十分脆弱。

column1: Codenamed TT, this loadout of the Phantom is actually rumored to be a prototype of an updated base 设计 due to the similarity of the abbreviations TT and II. Two ER Micro Lasers, a Heavy Large Laser and a 定位 Computer linking them are combined with a 守护者ECM. 怪癖: 改进的 Sensors 掉落成本乘数: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这套Phantom配置代号为TT，据传由于TT与II缩写相似，它其实是更新基础设计的原型。两门ER微型激光、一门重型大型激光和连接它们的定位计算机，与守护者ECM组合在一起。 怪癖：改进的传感器 掉落成本乘数：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: ComStar refit of their vintage stockpile of Thors. Removing the 中型激光s, the Thor is left with only the 重击者火炮 Piece and 40 rounds of Ammunition. The 车辆 is enhanced with a C3i network computer to allow better communication with its Lance, in case an enemy unit gets too close. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 5/8 格 / 150/240 米. 装甲: 铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 165 30 左侧 115 30 右侧 115 30 后方 115 30 炮塔 140 30 总计 650 150 怪癖: 精准 Weapon - Ballistics
column2: 这是 ComStar 对库存老式雷神机甲的改装型号。拆除中型激光器后，雷神只剩下一门重击者火炮和 40 发弹药。车辆增装 C3i 网络计算机，以便与所属长机保持更好通信，防止敌方单位过度接近。 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 5/8 格 / 150/240 米. 装甲: 铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 165 30 左侧 115 30 右侧 115 30 后方 115 30 炮塔 140 30 总计 650 150 怪癖: 精准 武器 - 弹道

column1: ComStar selected the Battle Cobra as the focus of their efforts to reverse-engineer and develop their own OmniMech after obtaining a large number of mostly operational units in the aftermath of a brutal conflict in the Devil's Bath during the Battle of Tukayyid.
column2: ComStar 在 Tukayyid 战役 Devil's Bath 的惨烈冲突后获得大量基本完好的 Battle Cobra，于是选定它作为逆向工程并开发自有 OmniMech 的重点。

column1: Combining the role of IFV and Light Tank, the Kamisori is a Republic era Light Tank produced by Pesht Motors. Designed to work in conjunction with Battle Armor whilst bring the firepower of a Galleon the Kamisori is a 20 ton Omni Tank. Powered by a 120-rated fusion core, the Kamisori can reach speeds of 97 km/h and is protected by 5.5 tons of Heavy Ferro-Fibrous armor. A 5 ton allocation of pod space in the turret allows for a diverse range of variants. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 6/9 hexes / 180/270 meters. Armor: Heavy Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 150 10 Left 100 10 Right 100 10 Rear 55 10 Turret 145 10 Total 550 50 Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Omni Vehicle
column2: Kamisori 结合了 IFV 和轻型坦克的角色，是 Pesht Motors 生产的共和国时代轻型坦克。 Kamisori 是一款 20 吨的全能坦克，旨在与战斗装甲配合使用，同时带来帆船的火力。 Kamisori 由 120 级聚变核心提供动力，速度可达 97 公里/小时，并受到 5.5 吨重型铁纤维装甲的保护。炮塔中 5 吨的吊舱空间分配允许多种变体。 生物群系限制：无。 运动： 6/9 六边形 / 180/270 米。 装甲： 重型铁纤维 结构： 结构 值 A S 前部 150 10 左 100 10 右 100 10 后 55 10 炮塔 145 10 总计 550 50 怪异：精确武器-能量 全能载具

column1: Coming from the same project that took a second look at the Phoenix Super Griffin has this Wasp received substantial upgrades to nearly every piece.
column2: 这台黄蜂与打造凤凰超级狮鹫的项目出自同一计划，因此也获得了几乎全身上下的大幅升级。

column1: Coming from the same project that took a second look at the Phoenix 超级狮鹫 has this Wasp received substantial upgrades to nearly every piece.
column2: 这个 Wasp 来自与 Phoenix Hawk 同一项计划，在重新评估后，几乎每个部件都获得了大幅升级。

column1: Coming straight from the bloody sands of Solaris; this Warhammer refit carries a mix of Advanced and Experimental technology, including a genuine Interface Cockpit, alongside Advanced Cooling tech.
column2: 这台 Warhammer 改装机直接来自 Solaris 的血腥沙场，搭载先进与实验技术，包括真正的接口驾驶舱，以及先进冷却技术。

column1: Commander, I must say, the Hell's Horses have really outdone themselves with the Boreas Prime's Alternate Configurations. Configuration D in particular caught my eye - with its heavy emphasis on heat-based weaponry, it's sure to make a devastating impact on the battlefield. I can only imagine the amount of heat this mech will generate, but with the additional Laser Heat Sinks, it should be able to sustain itself in combat. It's certainly a bold move to sacrifice some of the mech's versatility in favor of pure firepower, but I have a feeling it will pay off in the right hands.
column2: 指挥官，我得说，地狱马氏族确实把 Boreas Prime 的替代配置做到了极致。D 配置尤其引人注目：它高度偏重热能武器，肯定能在战场上造成毁灭性影响。我只能想象这台机甲会产生多少热量，但额外的激光散热器应该足以让它维持战斗。牺牲部分多用途能力换取纯粹火力是大胆的选择，不过在合适的驾驶员手中，我感觉它会取得回报。

column1: Commander, I've received some intel on a new configuration for the Boreas that was developed by Clan Hell's Horses. This variant, known as Configuration A, is equipped with a single Class-20 Hyper-Assault Gauss Rifle and two tons of ammunition. It seems that the Horses have opted for a more focused approach with this variant, relying on the massive firepower of the Gauss Rifle to take out targets quickly and efficiently. It could be a formidable weapon in the hands of a skilled pilot. However, we should also be aware that the lack of backup weapons could be a liability in certain situations. We'll need to assess the situation carefully before deciding if this variant is right for our mission.
column2: 指挥官，我收到一些关于 Hell's Horses 氏族开发的 Boreas 新配置情报。这个被称为 A 配置的型号装备一门 20 级 Hyper-Assault Gauss Rifle 和两吨弹药。看来马队选择了更专注的路线，依靠高斯步枪的巨大火力快速、高效地消灭目标。它在熟练驾驶员手中可能是可怕的武器。不过我们也应注意，缺乏备用武器在某些情况下可能成为弱点。在决定该型号是否适合任务前，我们需要仔细评估形势。

We'll need to assess the situation carefully before deciding if this variant is right for our mission.
column2: 我知道为什么这个机甲的所有宣传材料都是关于它的速度。他们几乎忘记了武器！它只有四个轻型 PPC，对于这么重的机甲来说这是相当可悲的。不仅如此，如果你真的设法用所有这些攻击击中敌人，除非你在可怕的北极，否则你会在一两次齐射中使机甲过热。

column1: Commander, have you seen the latest refit for the Boreas? It's the R variant, also known as the Amirault, and let me tell you, I am impressed! The frame is made of Endo Steel, which means it's lighter and more maneuverable, and the weapons have been replaced with a Bunch LRM 15 launchers n a couple Clan ER Medium Lasers. Can you imagine the kind of firepower this mech can unleash? I can't wait to see this baby in action!
column2: 指挥官，你看过Boreas最新的改装吗？这是R型，也叫Amirault。我得说，真让我印象深刻！框架采用内骨骼钢，因此更轻、更灵活；武器则换成一大堆LRM-15发射器和几门氏族ER中型激光。想象一下这台机甲能倾泻出什么样的火力吧？我迫不及待想看它投入战斗！

column1: Commander, the Arion is a hybrid vehicle developed by Clan Hell's Horses. It has a powerful ER Large Laser and two SRM-4 launchers, giving it a strong punch at range and up close. Its top speed of 97 km/h makes it a fast and agile vehicle, perfect for hit-and-run tactics. What makes the Arion unique is its ability to convert from a BattleMech to a tank, allowing it to adapt to different combat situations. Keep in mind that this vehicle was developed by a Clan known for their expertise in hybrid technology, so it's likely to be a formidable opponent on the battlefield.
column2: 指挥官，Arion 是地狱之马氏族研发的混合型载具。它配备一门强力增程大型激光器和两具 SRM-4 发射器，远近距离都能打出重拳。最高时速 97 千米，机动迅捷，非常适合打了就跑的战术。Arion 的独特之处在于能够在战斗机甲与坦克形态间转换，以适应不同战况。别忘了，它出自以混合技术见长的氏族，很可能会是战场上的劲敌。

column2: 指挥官，阿里翁是由地狱战马氏族开发的混合车辆。它配备一门强力 ER 大型激光和两门 SRM-4 发射器，在远距离和近距离都能造成强大打击。97 km/h 的最高速度使它成为快速灵活的车辆，非常适合突袭战术。阿里翁的独特之处在于能够在战斗机甲与坦克之间转换，从而适应不同战斗情况。请记住，这款车辆由以混合技术见长的氏族开发，因此很可能是战场上难缠的对手。

column1: Commander, the Boreas Prime is a unique Omni Mech-Quadvee hybrid developed by the Hells Horses. It's an impressive combination of versatility and firepower with a loadout that includes an ER PPC, Medium Pulse Laser, and a Streak SRM-6. Its top speed may not be the fastest at 64km/h, but it's more than adequate for most engagements.What sets the Boreas Prime apart is its ability to quickly swap out weapons and equipment, allowing it to adapt to various battlefield scenarios. It's a true multi-role mech, capable of both long-range sniping and close-range brawling.Overall, the Boreas Prime is an impressive example of Clan Hells Horses' technological prowess. Its combination of firepower, maneuverability, and versatility make it a formidable opponent on the battlefield.
column2: 指挥官，Boreas Prime 是 Hell's Horses 开发的独特 OmniMech—Quadvee 混合体。它兼具多功能性与火力，配置包括增程 PPC、中型脉冲激光和 Streak SRM-6。最高速度 64 km/h 虽不算快，但足以应对大多数交战。Boreas Prime 的独特之处在于能快速更换武器和装备，适应各种战场情况。它是真正的多用途机甲，既能远程狙击，也能近距离混战。总的来说，Boreas Prime 展示了 Hell's Horses 氏族高超的技术实力；火力、机动性和多功能性的结合让它成为战场上的强敌。

column2: 指挥官，Boreas Prime 是地狱战马开发的独特全能机甲—四足车混合体。它兼具多用途性和火力，装备一门 ER PPC、一门中型脉冲激光和一组锁定式 SRM-6。它的最高速度为 64 公里/小时，虽然不算最快，但足以应对大多数交战。Boreas Prime 的独特之处在于能够快速更换武器和设备，从而适应各种战场环境。这是一台真正的多用途机甲，既能执行远程狙击，也能进行近距离格斗。总体而言，Boreas Prime 展现了地狱战马氏族的技术实力，其火力、机动性和多用途性的结合使它成为战场上的可怕对手。

column1: Commander, the Harpagos is a heavy BattleMech developed by Clan Hell's Horses. It's armed with two Gauss rifles, capable of dealing massive amounts of damage to its targets from long range. However, due to its lack of jump jets, it's not as mobile as some other BattleMechs. It has a top speed of 64 km/h, which is decent for its weight class. Its heavy armor and firepower make it a great choice for a front-line combat unit.
column2: 指挥官，Harpagos 是 Hell's Horses 氏族开发的重型战斗机甲。它装备两门高斯步枪，能够从远距离对目标造成巨大伤害。不过由于没有跳跃喷射器，它的机动性不如其他一些战斗机甲。最高速度 64 km/h，对其吨位而言尚可。厚重装甲与强大火力使它非常适合作为前线作战单位。

column1: Commander, the Hells Horses have developed a new configuration for the Boreas Prime that focuses on long-range fire support. They've equipped it with a 20-tubed Streak LRM and two tons of ammunition. This will allow it to rain down missiles on enemy positions from afar, providing invaluable support to our ground forces. It won't be as effective up close, so we'll need to pair it with some heavier mechs to protect it in case of close-range engagements. Overall, I think it's a solid addition to our arsenal and I'm looking forward to seeing it in action.
column2: 指挥官，地狱之马氏族为 Boreas Prime 开发了一种新配置，专注于远程火力支援。他们为它装上一具 20 管连发 LRM 发射器和两吨弹药，能够从远处向敌方阵地倾泻导弹，为地面部队提供宝贵支援。它不擅长近战，因此需要搭配更重型的机甲保护，以防敌人逼近。总的来说，这是个很扎实的补充，我很期待看到它投入战斗。

column1: Commander, the Hells Horses have developed another variant of the Boreas, known as Configuration C. This one is a generalist configuration, equipped with an ATM-12 missile launcher for long-range attacks and two ER medium lasers for closer engagements. The scientists have also managed to allow it to carry up to three tons of ammunition, giving it plenty of staying power on the battlefield. It's a versatile configuration that can adapt to a variety of situations, making it a valuable addition to any lance.

column1: Conceived as a long-range infantry support Mech, the ill-fated Jackrabbit entered prototyping mere weeks before the Amaris Coup. Mass produced without regard for its design flaws, the 25 ton Jackrabbit suffered from anaemic firepower and poor armor; resulting in a bad reputation and the eventual extinction of the design. Powered by a 150-rated Fusion Engine, the Jackrabbit carries 3.5 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor and has a top speed of 97 km/h. An endosteel skeleton allows the Jackrabbit JKR-9W to carry a Light AC/5 and a Streak SRM-2, both with a single ton of ammo. An ER Medium Laser rounds out the weapons.
column2: Jackrabbit 原本是远程步兵支援机甲，原型机在阿马里斯政变前几周才开始试制。它不顾设计缺陷被大量生产，25 吨的 Jackrabbit 火力贫弱、装甲薄弱，最终名声不佳并走向绝迹。它由 150 级聚变引擎驱动，拥有 3.5 吨铁磁纤维装甲，最高速度 97 km/h。Endo Steel 骨架让 Jackrabbit JKR-9W 携带一门轻型 AC/5 和一具 Streak SRM-2，各配一吨弹药；一门增程中型激光补足武器配置。

column1: Conceptualised as a long range support platform, the Pendragon was a result of House Davion’s Jihad era MUSE programs. A 95-ton mech, the Pendragon is built around a 285-rated XL Engine and is loosely based on the Templar OmniMech. The Pendragon PDR-1X is the original MUSE prototype utilising a mix of Clan and IS technology. A pair of Extended Range LRM-20’s provide extreme range firepower, while an ER PPC and a trio of Clan ER Medium Lasers provide closer ranged firepower.

The Pendragon PDR-1R is the first production model and unlike the original prototype is entirely built with Inner Sphere technology. A pair of Extended Range LRM-15’s provide extreme range firepower, while an ER PPC and a trio of ER 中型激光s provide closer ranged firepower.
column2: Pendragon最初被设想为远程支援平台，是达维翁家族在圣战时期MUSE计划的成果。这台95吨级机甲围绕380级XL引擎构建，大体基于Templar全向机甲。Pendragon PDR-1R是首个量产型号，与最初原型不同，它完全采用内圈技术。两具扩展射程LRM-15提供极远距离火力，ER PPC和三门ER中型激光则负责较近距离的火力支援。

column1: Concordat Telecom built these for under a million C-Bills a unit which tells you everything about what they were going for. Taurian Concordat needed cheap security across dozens of border worlds and this is what they got. Spread all over unstable planets along the Periphery and Federated Suns border. Don't put it up against anything with real armor but for keeping local populations in line it did the job well enough.
column2: Concordat Telecom 以不到一百万 C-Bill 的单价制造这些机甲，这已经说明了它们的定位。陶里安协约需要为数十个边境世界提供廉价安保，于是得到了这种产品。它们遍布外环与联邦太阳联邦边境的不稳定行星。别让它对上真正的重装甲单位；但要维持当地人口秩序，它已经足够好用。

column1: Cosara built this thing out of pure ambition basically. Project Scuttle they called it, mid 32nd century. Two hundred tons, XXL engine, price tag that would make a Lyran noble choke. Draconis Combine bought some, Capellans too. Even Clan Sea Fox picked one up and nobody really knows why. Less than a dozen ever made, not sure if it was good or bad lucky to find one of them to spend money on restoring.
column2: Cosara 建造这个东西基本上是出于纯粹的野心。他们称之为“天窗计划”，发生在 32 世纪中叶。两百吨的 XXL 发动机，价格标签足以让天琴座贵族窒息。天龙联合公司买了一些，卡佩兰人也买了一些。就连海狐氏族也捡到了一只，但没有人真正知道原因。制作过的不到十几个，不知道能找到其中一个花钱修复是幸运还是不幸。

A 300 xxl engine powers the tank and 24.5 tons of Ferro Lamellor provide heavy protection. 50.5 tons of podspace allow for a lot of firepower. column1: Cuchulainn Support Armor was named for a hero from Irish mythology and was the product of a joint program between Clan Wolf-in-Exile and the Kell Hounds. Limited to moving at just over 10 km/h while carrying its Detachable Weapon Pack, Cuchulainn suits were designed to provide direct firepower support to other battle armor units, engaging enemy units at long range while lighter suits swarmed units that attempted to get close to the Cuchulainns. Almost half a ton of improved stealth armor helped protect the Cuchulainns while they engaged the enemy at range, but while the Cuchulainn mounted a Basic Manipulator on each arm and could ride on mechanized transport it was incapable of making swarm or leg attacks.
column2: 库丘林支援装甲以爱尔兰神话中的英雄命名，由流亡之狼氏族与凯尔猎犬共同研发。携带可拆卸武器包时，其移动速度仅略高于 10 km/h。库丘林装甲的设计用途是为其他战斗装甲单位提供直接火力支援：它们在远距离交战，较轻型装甲则围攻试图接近的敌方单位。近半吨的改良隐形装甲帮助库丘林在远距离交战时抵御攻击；不过，库丘林每条手臂都装有一个基础操纵器，也能搭乘机械化运输工具，但无法发动蜂群攻击或腿部攻击。

column1: Custom built from discarded Locust wrecks, the Koto is a 25-ton mech built exclusively for the Solaris 7 arenas by Omnitech Industries. Sharing the same basic shape as it's parent design the Koto is extensively rebuilt with an Endo Steel skeleton, Ferro-Fibrous armor, double heat sinks and an XL Engine. Weighing 5 tons heavier then the Locust, the Koto has a significantly heavier weapons array; built for annihilating opponents in the arena. The Koto 3A is armed with a Large Pulse Laser, 2 Medium Lasers and a Small Laser.
column2: Koto 由 Omnitech Industries 用废弃 Locust 残骸定制打造，专供 Solaris 7 竞技场使用，是一台 25 吨机甲。它保留原设计基本外形，但彻底重建为 Endo Steel 骨架、铁磁纤维装甲、双重散热器和 XL 引擎。Koto 比 Locust 重 5 吨，武器阵列显著增强，专为竞技场歼灭对手。Koto 3A 装备一门大型脉冲激光、两门中型激光和一门小型激光。

column1: Debuted in 3144 on the Black Hills Urban Combat Zone Arena and piloted by Jillian Robertson and squad, this variant is a rebuild of an existing Clan battlesuit model. The base chassis was increased in mass to improve its armor and weapon options, without sacrificing the suit’s airborne mobility or its anti-'Mech attack options. The variant retains the Clan engineering HarJel technology and the life support systems keeping its warrior battle-ready even when compromised. The lighter-weight Clan armor has been upgraded here by sixty percent over the original, that now can sustain hits from all but the heaviest lasers and autocannon, while still closing in to swarm its target. The variant trades the original Sylph’s bomb rack for a one shot five-pack of SRMs which also gives it a little extra punch, allowing a squad of these up-sized air Elementals to put some serious hurt on even a medium BattleMech.

column1: Debuting in 3063, the 5E is a Word of Blake designed upgrade to the older 4E design. Intended for deployment with Protectorate Militia units and Free Worlds League formations, the Blakists sought to rebuild the design with newer technology and correct some of the flaws apparent in the older design. Installing an Endo Steel chassis enabled the designers to swap the Thumper for the much larger and more powerful Sniper Artillery Piece. Defensively the design mounts CASE to protect against the ammunition explosions that plagued the older 4E model. A swap to ER Lasers and DHS round out the design, giving it increased range and striking power. Popular with Hunchback pilots and Artillery units, the design is slated for continuous production; with Kali Yama having to expand their Hunchback line to keep up with demand.

column1: Debuting in 3072, the Sprite SPT-15 is one of the Society’s premier frontline ‘Superheavy’ ProtoMechs. Designed as a highly survivable, highly mobile fire support unit, the Sprite mates four LRM5 launchers to a rugged chassis fitted with five Extended Jump Jets and 3.25 tons of armor, over 20% of the unit’s mass. While not the most mobile unit on the ground, and a little light on ammunition, grouped Sprite formations have proved to be a lethal and stubborn foe to dislodge time and time again.
column2: Sprite SPT-15 于 3072 年首次亮相，是 Society 最先进的前线‘超重型’ ProtoMech 之一。它设计为高生存、高机动火力支援单位，将四具 LRM-5 发射器安装在坚固底盘上，配备五具增程跳跃喷射器和 3.25 吨装甲（超过单位质量的 20%）。它在地面机动性方面并非最佳，弹药也略显不足，但 Sprite 编队一次又一次证明自己是难以击溃的致命敌人。

column2: Sprite SPT-15于3072年亮相，是星盟最优秀的前线“超重型”原型机甲之一。它被设计成生存力和机动性都很高的火力支援单位，坚固的机体搭载四具LRM-5发射器、五具延伸跳跃喷射器和3.25吨装甲，装甲超过全机质量的20%。它在地面上的机动性并非顶尖，弹药也略显不足，但成群行动的Sprite编队一次又一次证明自己是难以击退的致命敌人。

column1: Debuting in 3101, the Valkyrie QD-5 is a revamp of the older QD-4 model. Powered by a 150-rated XL Engine and armored with Light Ferro-Fibrous; the QD-5 is armed with a Medium Pulse Laser, MML-7 and an ATM-3.
column2: Valkyrie QD-5 于 3101 年首次亮相，是旧 QD-4 型号的改进版。QD-5 由 150 级 XL 引擎驱动，采用轻型铁磁纤维装甲，装备一门中型脉冲激光、MML-7 和 ATM-3。

column1: Debuting in 3101, the Valkyrie QD-5 is a revamp of the older QD-4 model. Powered by a 150-rated XL引擎 and 装甲ed with 轻型铁纤维装甲-Fibrous; the QD-5 is armed with a 中型脉冲激光, MML-7 and an ATM-3.
column2: 女武神 QD-5 于 3101 年首次亮相，是旧 QD-4 型号的改进版。它由 150 级 XL 引擎驱动，装有轻型铁纤维装甲；QD-5 配备一门中型脉冲激光器、MML-7 和 ATM-3。

column1: Decently armored for a fast scouting light, this mech is mostly limited by it's chem laser ammo, as it has nothing to fall back on once that runs out. Oh, and swap out that cockpit ASAP, while it does provide for very good views, it's a deathtrap, with almost no cockpit armor at all. It's not even armored glass!
column2: 以快速侦察轻型机甲来说，它的装甲还算不错；主要短板是化学激光弹药，一旦打光就没有其他火力可用。还有，尽快换掉驾驶舱！它视野确实很好，却几乎没有驾驶舱装甲，简直是个死亡陷阱。连防弹玻璃都没有！

column1: Decently armored for a fast scouting light, this mech is mostly limited by it's chem laser ammo, as it has nothing to fall back on once that runs out. Oh, and swap out that cockpit ASAP, while it does provide for very good views, it's a deathtrap, with almost no cockpit 装甲 at all. It's not even armored glass!
column2: 对于一台快速侦察轻型机甲来说，它的装甲还算不错；但它主要受化学激光弹药限制，弹药耗尽后没有任何备用手段。还有，尽快换掉那个驾驶舱：它虽然视野极佳，却是个死亡陷阱，几乎没有驾驶舱装甲，甚至连装甲玻璃都不是！

column1: Defiance built this in 3151 to mark 500 years of the original Sentinel and it is a serious upgrade in every respect. Rotary AC/5, Streak SRM 6, MASC, Ballistic-Reinforced armor. The Maskirovka apparently agreed it was worth having because their agents stole the blueprints within a few years and the Capellans were building their own by 3157. That is probably the most honest endorsement a mech design can get.
column2: Defiance 于 3151 年建造了这款产品，以纪念最初的 Sentinel 诞生 500 周年，它在各个方面都是一次重大升级。 Rotary AC/5、Streak SRM 6、MASC、弹道强化装甲。马斯基洛夫卡家族显然认为这是值得拥有的，因为他们的特工在几年内窃取了蓝图，而卡佩兰家族则在 3157 年建造了自己的蓝图。这可能是机甲设计可以获得的最诚实的认可。

column1: Depending on the situation and the length of the engagements this 'Mech can be either a weakness or a strength since its only weapons are Streak LRMs.
column2: 根据战况和交战持续时间，这台机甲可能成为弱点，也可能成为优势，因为它唯一的武器是 Streak LRM。

column1: Deployed by the Homeworld Clans as a fast harasser and recon tank, the Kefira is a lightweight and heavily armoured Omni-Tank. A 175 XL Engine pushes the Kefira to speeds of 150 kph and 7.5 tons of Ferro Lamellor armour allow it to shrug off absurd levels of firepower for its small size. Known variants include: 3 ER Medium Lasers tied to a targeting computer, an ER Large Pulse model, dual ERML and an iATM-9 and lastly dual Improved Heavy Medium Lasers tied to a TC with an Angel ECM suit and Active Probe.Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 11/17 hexes / 330/510 meters. Armor: Ferro-Lamellor (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 160 20 Left 120 20 Right 120 20 Rear 95 20 Turret 100 20 Total 595 100 Quirk: Agile
column2: Kefira 由内环氏族部署为快速骚扰与侦察坦克，是一款轻型且装甲厚实的 Omni-Tank。175 级 XL 引擎使 Kefira 速度达到 150 km/h，7.5 吨 Ferro-Lamellor 装甲则让它以小巧体型承受惊人的火力。已知型号包括：三门接入瞄准计算机的增程中型激光器型；增程大型脉冲激光器型；双增程中型激光器与 iATM-9 型；以及双改进型重型中型激光器、瞄准计算机、天使 ECM 套件和主动探测器型。经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。 生物群系限制：无。 移动： 11/17 格 / 330/510 米。 装甲： 铁磁层叠装甲（氏族） 结构： Structure 数值 A S 正面 160 20 左侧 120 20 右侧 120 20 后方 95 20 炮塔 100 20 总计 595 100 Quirk: Agile

column1: Designed and constructed during the Jihad, the 4S updated the design of the popular 3S series of Marauders with new technology designed to improve its effectiveness on the modern battlefield. Built around 18 双散热器, the 4S has similar design principles to its predecessor; designed for ease of maintenance and repair. With an extra ton of 装甲 and a targeting computer, it is capable of taking a heavier pounding at close range and boasts superior accuracy at mid to long range. Aside from this it is functionally similar to it’s predecessor, retaining the 中型激光器 and PPC loadout; though the PPCs have been updated to ER versions and the old single heat sinks swapped for more efficient double heat sinks. Production has been brisk, with 通用汽车 taking orders from across the Inner Sphere and the Periphery; as mercenaries and planetary militias look to upgrade the older Marauders in their arsenals.
column2: 4S是在圣战期间设计并制造的型号，使用新技术更新了广受欢迎的掠夺者3S系列，以提升其在现代战场上的效能。它围绕18组双重散热器构建，仍采用前代便于维护和修理的设计理念。额外增加一吨装甲并安装瞄准计算机后，它能在近距离承受更猛烈的打击，同时在中远距离拥有更高精度。除此之外，它基本保留前代的武器布局和PPC配置；不过PPC已升级为ER型号，原有单散热器也换成效率更高的双散热器。产量增长迅速，通用动力公司接到了来自内圈和边缘区域的大量订单，佣兵与行星民兵都在设法升级军械库中的老式掠夺者。

column1: Designed and developed during the Word of Blake Jihad, the Partisan Hull Defense Tank was a failed attempt by Kallon Industries to develop a new role for it’s classic Partisan AA Tank. Designed to be stationed on a Warship and to act as a mobile turret, operating on the Warships Hull during combat; the Partisan Hull Defense was armed with a pair of Large X Pulse Lasers. A combination of Reflective armor and a Blue Shield Particle Field Damper would neuter the energy based weapons carried by most Aerospace craft; while a Boosted C3 Slave would enable effective fire coordination. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 2/3 hexes / 60/90 meters. Armor: Reflective Coating Structure: Environmental Sealing Values A S Front 235 40 Left 190 40 Right 190 40 Rear 140 40 Turret 235 40 Total 990 200 Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting
column2: Partisan 舰体防御坦克是圣言之子圣战期间由 Kallon Industries 开发的失败尝试，试图为经典 Partisan 防空坦克开辟新用途。它被设计为战舰上的机动炮塔，在战斗中沿舰体行动，配备两门大型 X 脉冲激光。反射装甲和 Blue Shield 粒子场阻尼器可削弱多数航天器的能量武器，增强型 C3 从属系统则用于协调火力。 生物群系限制：无。 移动： 2/3 格 / 60/90 米。 装甲： 反射涂层 结构： Environmental Sealing 数值 A S 正面 235 40 左侧 190 40 右侧 190 40 后方 140 40 炮塔 235 40 总计 990 200 特性：防空瞄准

column1: Designed and produced for the Magistracy of Canopus; as part of an upgrade of mothballed Succession Wars era Mechs, the KGC-0010M takes the already fearsome King Crab and upgrades it with new weapons and 2.5 tons of extra armor. Quad 等离子步枪s form the primary weaponry, backed up by a Snub Nose PPC and a single 火箭发射器 15. A 比格犬主动探头 is the last addition, perfect for the ecm choked battlefields of the 32nd century. Quirk: 指挥机甲 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 这款机甲为坎诺普斯女公爵领设计并生产，属于对封存的继承战争时代机甲进行升级的计划。KGC-0010M 在原本就令人畏惧的王蟹基础上，换装新武器并增加 2.5 吨装甲。四门无后坐力步枪构成主武器，另有一门短鼻 PPC 和一具 Rocket Launcher 15 支援。最后加装远程精确探测器，使其适合在 32 世纪 ECM 密布的战场上作战。 特性：指挥模块 部署费用倍率：1.18

column1: Designed and produced in limited numbers by Luthien Armor Works, the DRX Dragon II Omni was an ambitious precursor to what would later become the DRG-11K. The A variant carries an MRM-30 in the right torso, backed up by three medium X-Pulse lasers and a snub-nosed PPC.
column2: DRX Dragon II Omni 由 Luthien Armor Works 设计并限量生产，是后来 DRG-11K 的雄心勃勃先驱。A 型号右侧躯干安装 MRM-30，另有三门中型 X 脉冲激光和一门短管 PPC 支援。

column1: Designed and produced in limited numbers by 鲁西恩装甲工厂, the DRX Dragon II Omni was an ambitious precursor to what would later become the DRG-11K. The primary configuration is a bit of a showcase model, mounting a 雷电20 launcher with six tons of ammo filling a wide variety of roles.
column2: 鲁西恩装甲工厂少量设计并生产的DRX Dragon II全能机甲，是后来DRG-11K的雄心前身。基础配置有些像展示样机，安装一具雷电20发射器和六吨弹药，可承担多种任务。

column1: Designed and produced in limited numbers by 鲁西恩装甲工厂, the DRX Dragon II 全向 was an ambitious precursor to what would later become the DRG-11K. The A variant carries an MRM-30 in the right torso, backed up by three medium X-Pulse lasers and a snub-nosed PPC.
column2: DRX Dragon II全向机甲由鲁西恩装甲工厂设计并少量生产，是后来DRG-11K的雄心勃勃的前身。A变型在右侧躯干安装一具MRM-30，并以三门中型X脉冲激光器和一门短管PPC提供支援。

column1: Designed and produced in limited numbers by 鲁西恩装甲工厂, the DRX Dragon II 全向 was an ambitious precursor to what would later become the DRG-11K. The B configuration bears a 'Silver Bullet' Gauss Rifle on the right arm, backed up by a torso-mounted MML and the usual X-Pulse lasers on the left arm. An 'Iron Dome' AMS system and Angel ECM provide this loadout with ample long-range defenses.
column2: DRX Dragon II全向机甲由鲁西恩装甲工厂设计并少量生产，是后来DRG-11K的雄心勃勃的前身。B配置在右臂搭载一门“银弹”高斯步枪，左臂则配备躯干安装的MML和常规X脉冲激光器。一套“铁穹”AMS系统和天使ECM为该配置提供充足的远程防御。

column1: Designed and produced in limited numbers by 鲁西恩装甲工厂, the DRX Dragon II 全向 was an ambitious precursor to what would later become the DRG-11K. The C loadout is a through-and-through brawler. The primary weapon is officially the center-mounted ATM-12, but it's the 转管自动炮 sourced from 斯科贝尔机甲工厂 that really draws attention. An 'Iron Dome' 反导系统 and single pulse laser round out the 'Mech.
column2: 鲁西恩装甲工厂设计并限量生产的 DRX Dragon II 全向机甲，是后来 DRG-11K 的雄心勃勃的先驱。C 配置是一台彻头彻尾的近战斗士。官方主武器是安装在中央的 ATM-12，但真正引人注目的是从斯科贝尔机甲工厂取得的转管自动炮。一个“铁穹”反导系统和一门脉冲激光完善了这台机甲的配置。

column1: Designed and produced in limited numbers by 鲁西恩装甲工厂, the DRX Dragon II 全向 was an ambitious precursor to what would later become the DRG-11K. This particular configuration tests the limits of a 70-ton Mech's stability by fitting a 长汤姆加农炮 on the right arm. Like the other variants, the DRX-OD showcases a stunning variety of ammunition types, both for the 火炮 piece and the center-mounted 雷电10.
column2: DRX Dragon II全向机甲由鲁西恩装甲工厂设计并少量生产，是后来DRG-11K的雄心勃勃的前身。该配置在右臂安装长汤姆加农炮，考验70吨机甲的稳定极限。和其他变型一样，DRX-OD展示了惊人的弹药类型多样性，既适用于火炮，也适用于中央安装的雷电10。

column1: Designed as a close range brawler, the Merlin 1E is marketed to smaller periphery states and mercenary commands in the market for a cut price heavy mech. Replacing the traditional PPC with an AC/10 and removing the anti-personnel weapons, allows for an extra pair of Medium Lasers to be added.With a third less heatsinks than the usual Merlin designs, pilots will need to be careful with their heat or risk a premature ammo explosion.
column2: Merlin 1E 是专为近战斗士设计的机甲，面向希望以低价购入重型机甲的小型边疆国家和佣兵指挥部。它以 AC/10 替换传统 PPC，并拆除反人员武器，从而增加一对中型激光。散热器比普通 Merlin 型号少三分之一，驾驶员必须谨慎管理热量，否则弹药可能提前爆炸。

column1: Designed as a replacement to the Timber Wolf, the 65 ton Linebacker entered production in 3052. Built around a 390-rated XL Engine, the Linebacker’s faster speed enables it to keep up with lighter star mates in running battles, something the Timber Wolf struggled to do. A combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and Endo Steel give the OmniMech 17.5 tons of free pod space. The Linebacker LBK-F is armed with an ER PPC and 4 SRM-6’s. A Narc Beacon fills the remaining free tonnage. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Linebacker 旨在取代 Timber Wolf，65 吨的它于 3052 年投产。它以 390 级 XL 引擎为核心，较快的速度使 Linebacker 能在机动战中跟上较轻的星队友，这是 Timber Wolf 难以做到的。铁磁纤维装甲与 Endo Steel 为 OmniMech 提供 17.5 吨自由吊舱空间。Linebacker LBK-F 装备一门增程 PPC 和四具 SRM-6；NARC 信标填补剩余吊舱吨位。 特质：稳定 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1: Designed by Adam Tech Industries and manufactured from their plant on Abadan, the Havoc was inspired by the JR7-K Jenner and managed to improve on many of the JR7-K's design features. The combination of almost double the Jenner's armor, a 10% increase in speed thanks to the 280 XL engine and a weapons loadout that allowed it to battle 'Mechs heavier than itself spurred the Adam Tech advertising campaign, which was geared exclusively towards pilots of light BattleMechs. The key to the Havoc's success was the Octagon Tartrac System E, considered the best short-range targeting and tracking system available on the market at the time and often compared to the highly successful and effective Garret D2j targeting system. The Octagon system identified threats faster than comparable systems, an invaluable aid to MechWarriors in the field. The Havoc also mounted five jump jets distributed throughout the Havoc's torso locations, allowing it to jump up to 150 meters.
column2: Havoc 由 Adam Tech Industries 设计并在其位于阿巴丹的工厂制造，受到 JR7-K Jenner 的启发，并设法改进了 JR7-K 的许多设计功能。 Jenner 的装甲几乎翻了一番，由于 280 XL 发动机而速度提高了 10%，再加上武器装载使其能够与比自身更重的机甲作战，这些因素的结合刺激了 Adam Tech 的广告活动，该广告活动专门针对轻型战机飞行员。 Havoc 成功的关键是 Octagon Tartrac System E，它被认为是当时市场上最好的短程瞄准和跟踪系统，经常与非常成功和有效的 Garret D2j 瞄准系统进行比较。 Octagon 系统比同类系统更快地识别威胁，这对战场上的机甲战士来说是宝贵的帮助。 Havoc 还安装了五架喷射机，分布在 Havoc 的躯干位置，使其跳跃高度可达 150 米。

column1: Designed by Defiance Industries, the Storm Raider was intended to be an alternative to the Hollander light 'Mech. Unfortunately for Defiance, the Storm Raider was 50 years too late for the market, and the various prototypes were poorly received - so poorly received, in fact, that Defiance licensed all of the designs to Coventry Metal Works. Coventry Metal Works was manufacturing four different variants of the Storm Raider intended for use in urban defense roles or for small-scale surgical strikes, but the Storm Raider was a poor performer in both roles, outgunned by contemporaries and slower than most. Despite that, the Storm Raider proved an able fighter in the arenas at Solaris VII, where it became a fan favorite.
column2: Storm Raider 由 Defiance 工业设计，原本是 Hollander 轻型机甲的替代方案。遗憾的是，它进入市场晚了 50 年，各种原型机的评价都很差——差到 Defiance 最终把全部设计授权给 Coventry 金属工厂。Coventry 金属工厂生产了四种不同变体，用于城市防御或小规模外科式突袭，但 Storm Raider 在这两种任务中的表现都很糟糕：火力被同时代机甲压制，速度也比大多数对手更慢。尽管如此，Storm Raider 在 Solaris VII 的竞技场中仍证明了自己的战斗力，并在那里成为观众最喜爱的机甲之一。

column1: Designed by the Marian Hegemony using the most cutting-edge gear available to them, the Marauder Battle Armor is patterned after the venerable Marauder BattleMech. Armed with a pair of Support PPCs and a Light Recoilless Rifle, the Marauder BA is one of the most heavily armed BA in existence. The Marians deploy them in squads of five called a contubernium and the suits are designed for that kind of larger deployment. While not particularly well armored, their extreme firepower load for battle armor makes them deadly on the field.
column2: 马里安霸权使用手头最尖端的装备设计了掠夺者战斗装甲，其外形参考了久负盛名的 Marauder 战斗机甲。它配备一对支援型 PPC 和一门轻型无后坐力步枪，是现存武装最强的战斗装甲之一。马里安人以五具为一组部署它们，称为 contubernium；这些装甲正是为这种大规模部署而设计。虽然装甲防护并不突出，但对战斗装甲而言极其强大的火力足以让它们在战场上致命。

The Nightstar ceased production a year after it first walked off the factory line and would not see production again until the late 3050’s. Powered by a 285-rated XL Engine, the Nightstar 10D is armed with a pair of Light Gauss Rifles and a pair of Clan ER Large Lasers. A Medium X-Pulse Laser provides extra firepower at close quarters.

column1: Designed for fast recon and close-quarters combat, the Night Stalker is a medium BattleMech first produced during the mid-thirty-second century. The first original BattleMech produced by Victory Conditions Industries on Mizar, the Night Stalker was first unveiled in the arenas of Solaris VII, where it would gather a reputation that propelled the company’s sales to success. The design would soon see service with the Federated Suns, the Lyran Commonwealth, mercenary units, and among all the nation states of the Inner Sphere.
column2: 夜行者专为快速侦察和近距离战斗而设计，是一种在三十二世纪中叶首次生产的中型战斗机甲。它是胜利条件工业公司在米扎尔制造的第一款原创战斗机甲，最初在太阳神 VII 的竞技场亮相，并在那里积累了声誉，推动公司销售走向成功。很快，这一设计便开始在联邦太阳、莱阳联邦、雇佣兵部队以及内圈各国服役。

column1: Designed for long-range combat, the Gambit was a solid, light BattleMech, the second 'Mech to have been brought to market by Adam Tech Industries. Straightforward to maintain and built around some of the most popular items on the market including armor plating, heat sinks, and myomer bundles, the Gambit was very popular with 'Mech technicians following its entry to service in 3136. Adding to the Gambit's appeal for MechWarriors was the cockpit, which in addition to featuring a reliable emergency release mechanism, was also armored to resist battle armor-scale weapons for at least 10 seconds - a feature clearly intended to make the Gambit suitable for use in the battlefields of the Dark Ages.
column2: 甘比特是一款为远程作战而设计的坚固轻型战斗机甲，也是亚当科技工业公司推向市场的第二款机甲。它易于维护，采用市场上广受欢迎的装甲板、散热器和肌腱束等部件。自 3136 年服役以来，甘比特深受机甲技师欢迎。它对机甲战士同样颇具吸引力：驾驶舱配有可靠的紧急弹射机构，还经过加固，至少能抵御战斗装甲级武器十秒。这项设计显然是为了让甘比特适应黑暗时代的战场。

column1: Designed in secrecy, the Centaur is a Heavy-weight battle armor, first designed for the Republic of the Sphere's armed forces during the later Dark Age era. This was part of an effort by the Republic to develop a highly mobile battle armor-scale artillery piece. It was first built on Devil's Rock at the highly secretive Rhodes Foundry Ltd. factory, along with other secret projects. The battle armor first entered production in 3136 along with the Simian battle armor, and they would often be teamed up in the years ahead.
column2: 半人马是在秘密中设计的重型战斗装甲，最初为黑暗时代后期的球体共和国武装部队研制。这是共和国开发高机动战斗装甲级火炮的一部分工作。它最初与其他秘密项目一起，在高度保密的Rhodes铸造有限公司工厂、恶魔之岩上制造。战斗装甲于3136年与Simian战斗装甲一同投产，之后多年经常配合作战。

column1: Designed in the middle of the thirty-second century, the Wendigo is a Medium Class OmniMech designed and produced originally for Clan Nova Cat. The 'Mech's creation stems from the results of the Clan's prolonged efforts with Draconis Combine's Luthien Armor Works to produce a replacement design for its touman. The resulting Avalanche turned out to be less than what the Clan had hoped for, so using the basic premise of the Avalanche design, the results of Clan Scientists would become the Wendigo.
column2: 温迪戈设计于三十二世纪中叶，是最初为新星猫氏族设计并生产的中型全能机甲。这台机甲的诞生源于该氏族与龙蛇合众国卢森装甲厂长期合作、试图为其图曼部队制造替代设计的成果。最终的雪崩未能达到氏族预期，于是氏族科学家以雪崩设计的基本理念为基础，研发出了温迪戈。

column1: Designed to engage in close range brawls, the 100 ton Berserker debuted in 3056. A 400-rated Light Engine paired with TSM allows the BRZ-C3 to outrun almost any other heavy or assault grade Mech. An ER PPC and 6 ER Medium Lasers make up the Mech’s ranged armament while a colossal 10 ton Hatchet is lethal at close range. AMS and Guardian ECM keep the Mech safe as it closes in, a C3 Slave allows the Berserker to act as a scout; while a head mounted Flamer adds to the Mechs intimidation factor.
column2: Berserker 是为近距离混战设计的 100 吨机甲，于 3056 年问世。400 级轻型引擎配合 TSM，使 BRZ-C3 能超过几乎所有重型或突击级机甲。它的远程武器是一门增程 PPC 和六门增程中型激光；近战则由一把 10 吨巨型战斧造成致命杀伤。AMS 与 Guardian ECM 保护它接近敌人，C3 从属单元让 Berserker 能充当侦察机甲；头部安装的喷火器则进一步增强威慑力。

column1: Despite the design being considered obsolete well before the Exodus, the schematics for the Helepolis siege mech survived the journey to the Pentagon Worlds where it went largely ignored until the Golden Century. A small group of Coyote scientists retooled the arcane design, increasing its tonnage and applying most of the weight saving techologies available, and submitted it to their Khan. Despite being rejected as a dishonorable design the HEP-IIC survived in Society caches and has slowly been upgraded over the years. The Z variant sports a Sniper Artillery Piece and a Society MRM60.
column2: 尽管该设计早在出埃及记之前就被认为已经过时，但赫勒波利斯攻城机甲的示意图在前往五角大楼世界的旅程中幸存下来，在那里它基本上被忽视，直到黄金世纪。一小群土狼科学家重新设计了神秘的设计，增加了其吨位并应用了大部分可用的减重技术，并将其提交给了他们的可汗。尽管 HEP-IIC 被认为是一种不光彩的设计而被拒绝，但它仍然在协会的缓存中幸存下来，并且多年来一直在缓慢升级。 Z 型配备狙击火炮和协会 MRM60。

column1: Despite the standard Elemental's all-around utility, 氏族地狱马 sought to enhance their Elementals mobility. The result of their work, Elemental II, discards Jump Jets and SRM pack in favor of battle 装甲 myomer booster. column1: Developed as a complement to the Griffin in the later years of the Jihad, the Ghost is a medium strike 'Mech that saw considerable use in the years after the formation of the Republic of the Sphere. Developed by the Lyran Commonwealth and elements of the former Free Worlds League the Ghost carries an extensive array of electronic warfare equipment into combat. A Beagle Active Probe allows the Ghost to find enemy units, and a Guardian ECM Suite allows the 'Mech to live up to its name. With excellent land speed and formidable medium-range weaponry, the Ghost is ideal for hunter-killer and heavy raiding missions, especially when paired with Griffins. This Ghost variant introduced in 3082 is popular with mercenary commands and is available for purchase by anyone. The key difference is the Stealth Armor has been removed and replaced by conventional armor.
column2: Ghost 是在圣战后期作为 Griffin 的补充而开发的中型突击机甲，在球体共和国成立后的数年中得到广泛使用。它由 Lyran 联邦和前自由世界联盟成员共同开发，携带大量电子战设备。Beagle 主动探测器可发现敌人，Guardian ECM 套件则让它名副其实地难以捉摸。凭借优秀地速和强大中程武器，Ghost 适合猎杀和重型突袭，尤其适合与 Griffin 协同。这款 3082 年推出的型号深受佣兵指挥部欢迎，也向所有人开放购买。主要区别是拆除了隐形装甲，改用常规装甲。

column1: Developed by 伯洛克氏族 to augment second line units, the Dervish IIC is a rebuild of a number of Star League Dervishes found in a Brian Cache. Eventually spreading to other Clans, the design would prove to be a dependable and tough Mech, with a production line opening in 3000 to meet the Burrocks needs. Armed with a pair of LRM-10's for ranged combat; and a mix of ER Lasers and SRM's for close combat, the 55 ton Dervish IIC is powered by a 275 rated Fusion Core.

column1: Developed on Betelguese by Capellan Confderation scientists in secret on direct orders from Chancellor Liao and later produced by Hellespont Industries in the same star system, the Roncone is a superheavy design loosely based on the Battlemaster 4L. The Roncone was an attempt to build on the stealth and ECM capabilities of the Battlemaster 4L, but constant struggles with the sheer size of a Superheavy meant that the stealth was mediocre at best.
column2: Roncone 是一种超重型设计，大致基于 Battlemaster 4L，由卡佩兰联盟科学家根据廖议长的直接命令在参宿四上秘密开发，后来由赫勒斯滂工业公司在同一恒星系统中生产。 Roncone 是在 Battlemaster 4L 的隐身和 ECM 能力基础上的一次尝试，但与超重型坦克的巨大尺寸的不断斗争意味着隐身能力充其量是平庸的。

column1: Developed under the guidance of Angelique Claw for Zellbrigen Stables, the Wraith Alexander combines Experimental Technology from the Clans and Inner Sphere to create a unique 'Mech. The use of a Clan-made XL引擎 keeps the speed high, and allows for the installation of more equipment. The jump jets, Endo Steel 结构, and 短管PPC are of Inner Sphere manufacture, but the two ER 中型激光s, 铁纤维装甲, and twin 部分机翼s were built by the Clans. The partial wings increase the Wraith's jump range to 270 米.

column1: Enhanced Imaging, Special Sensors and very nice Optics make this Glass Spider a Real Danger to anything it sees. column1: Few BattleMechs designed and produced in the Inner Sphere after the fall of the first Star League managed to become as beloved as the Penetrator. A mainstay of AFFS, LCAF, and mercenary heavy lances, it has a well-deserved reputation for phenomenal staying power. The variant was initially created by refitting battle-damaged Penetrators, but soon multiple production lines were dedicated to building this new variant. For the AFFS, struggling to recover from devastating losses of personnel and materiel, the PTR-8D has been a lifeline, and demand is sky-high.
column2: 第一星盟覆灭后，在内圈设计并生产的战斗机甲中，很少有能像 Penetrator 一样深受爱戴。它是 AFFS、LCAF 和佣兵重型长机的主力，拥有名副其实的惊人持久力。该型号最初通过翻新战损 Penetrator 制造，随后多条生产线专门生产这一新型号。对于正努力从人员和物资惨重损失中恢复的 AFFS 而言，PTR-8D 是救命稻草，需求量极高。

column1: Fighting against the powers of the Inner Sphere brought several harsh realities to light for Clan Jade Falcon, with one of the most glaring being their lack of effective reconnaissance and electronic warfare units in their touman. In an effort to rectify this issue, Jade Falcon engineers were tasked with upgrading the venerable Ostscout to Clan standards in 3063 and their prototype, dubbed the Ostscout IIC, displayed several excellent qualities for a scouting unit. These included being able to outpace even the infamous Fire Moth despite weighing 15 tons more, as well as a nearly 400 meter jump distance thanks to the coupling of a high volume of eleven jump jets with a Partial Wing.
column2: 与内圈各势力作战让 Jade Falcon 氏族看清了几项残酷现实，其中最明显的是其 touman 缺乏有效的侦察和电子战单位。为解决这个问题，Jade Falcon 工程师在 3063 年将老牌 Ostscout 升级为氏族规格，原型被称为 Ostscout IIC，展现出优秀的侦察性能：虽然重 15 吨，却能超过臭名昭著的 Fire Moth；十一具高容量跳跃喷射器配合部分机翼，还能实现近 400 米的跳跃距离。

column1: Firefly Foundry built this alongside the Ranger as one of their first two designs, exclusively for Riley's Rangers. Three standard variants right out of the gate, each covering a different range bracket, and two more later on. The sixth variant, the ND-RRDS, is the odd one out, built in 3102 specifically to mark the partnership between the Rangers and Clan Sea Fox. That one also saw service with the Sea Foxes themselves, which tells you something about what the partnership was worth to both sides.
column2: 萤火虫铸造厂为 Riley 游骑兵制造了这台机甲，并将它与 Ranger 作为最初两种专属设计。它一开始就有三种标准变体，分别覆盖不同射程，后来又增加两种。第六种变体 ND-RRDS 是个例外，于 3102 年专门为纪念游骑兵与海狐氏族的合作而制造。它后来也在海狐部队服役，这足以说明双方都多么看重这段合作。

column1: Firefly Foundry built this one for Firefly Stables on Solaris VII in 3105, same year as the Yun Qi. They wanted a heavy to round out their tournament roster and they got one. Mixed tech from the Sea Foxes, Apollo-guided MRM 40, Large X-Pulse Laser that runs hot but hits hard. Pure arena machine, never saw field service outside the stadiums. Fourteen double heat sinks tell you everything about how they expected pilots to run this thing.
column2: Firefly Foundry 于 3105 年为 Solaris VII 的 Firefly Stables 建造了这台机甲，与 Yun Qi 同年。他们需要一台重型机甲完善锦标赛阵容，最终得偿所愿。机甲混合采用 Sea Fox 技术，装备 Apollo 引导的 MRM-40 和一门射程短但威力强、发热高的大型 X 脉冲激光。它是纯粹的竞技场机器，从未离开场馆投入实战。14 具双重散热器充分说明他们期望驾驶员如何使用这台机甲。
