column1: Focused on bringing the Snub-Nose PPC into battle as fast as possible, this 'Mech can reach some real high speeds. But that is also its weakness, if that PPC goes down or misses, the remaining weapons are not very impressive.
column2: 这台机甲专注于尽快把短鼻 PPC 带入战场，因此速度非常高。但这也是它的弱点：如果 PPC 被摧毁或未命中，剩余武器就不太值得一提。

column1: Focused on bringing the 短管PPC into battle as fast as possible, this 'Mech can reach some real high speeds. But that is also its weakness, if that PPC goes down or misses, the remaining weapons are not very impressive.
column2: 这台机甲专注于尽快将短管PPC送入战场，因此速度极高。但这也是它的弱点：如果那门PPC损坏或未命中，剩余武器就不太出色了。

column1: Following on the heels of the Jade Falcon’s adoption of physical attacks, the Gargoyle K represents a paradigm shift in tactics of other Clans. Mounting a six ton Hatchet in its right arm the Gargoyle K is the first Clan 'Mech so equipped. Adding to the danger of the hatchet is a Supercharger that allows the K to run at over 100 km/h, a staggering speed for an assault 'Mech. Focused solely on short range destruction, the K's other weapons are for use up close. Each of the 'Mech’s torsos comes equipped with a Streak SRM-4 launcher. All three launchers are fed by a single ton of ammo in the CASE II protected left torso. Four Improved Heavy Medium Lasers reside in the left arm. To ensure no targets can hide from the K an Active Probe is housed in the right torso. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: Gargoyle K 代表氏族战术转变，是首款装备战斧的氏族机甲。右臂安装 6 吨战斧，超级充能器使其速度超过 100 km/h；三具连射 SRM-4、四门改进型重型中型激光和右躯干主动探测器专注近距离毁灭。 特性：稳定武器 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

column2: 翡翠隼氏族采用实体攻击战术后，石像鬼 K 型代表了其他氏族战术理念的一次重大转变。它在右臂安装了一把 6 吨战斧，成为首台装备战斧的氏族机甲。增压器使 K 型速度超过 100 公里/小时；对突击机甲而言，这是惊人的速度。K 型专注于近距离摧毁目标，其他武器也都用于贴身作战。机甲两侧躯干各装有一具 Streak SRM-4 发射器，三具发射器共用左躯干内受 CASE II 保护的 1 吨弹药。左臂装有 4 门改进型重型中型激光。为确保敌人无处藏身，右躯干还安装了主动探测器。 特性：稳定平台 部署费用倍率：1.15 手臂执行器限制：Omni

column2: 继玉鹰氏族采用物理攻击之后，石像鬼 K 型代表了其他氏族战术上的范式转变。右臂安装六吨重的战斧，使石像鬼 K 成为首台配备此类武器的氏族机甲。战斧的威胁还得到增压器强化，使 K 型速度超过 100 公里/小时；对于突击机甲而言，这是惊人的速度。K 型专注于近距离毁灭，其他武器也都用于贴身作战。机甲两侧躯干各配备一具锁定式 SRM-4 发射器，三具发射器共用左侧躯干中由 CASE II 保护的一吨弹药。左臂安装四门改进型重型中型激光器。为确保没有目标能躲过 K 型，右侧躯干内置一具主动探头。 怪癖：武器稳定 掉落成本乘数：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Following the Blakist defeat, many of their weapons were changed for the victorious powers. This version of the GLT-6WB Guillotine introduced in 3080 exchanges the 改进的 C3 CPU for a 守护者ECM and a C3 slave CPU. 怪癖: 集成探照灯 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower, 左侧 Upper
column2: 布雷克圣言会战败后，胜利者改装了许多缴获武器。3080 年推出的 GLT-6WB Guillotine 用守护者 ECM 和 C3 从属计算机替换改进型 C3 CPU。 怪癖: 集成探照灯 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower, 左侧 Upper

column1: Following the HPG blackout and the splintering of the Republic, TharHes Industries hastily reopened the Wolfhound line that had been destroyed during the Jihad. Based upon the WLF-5, albeit with TharHes’s original stylings, the -6S variant drops the MASC system and the entire weapons array. A large re-engineered laser is mounted in the right arm, with enhanced actuators to provide increased accuracy. As with the -3S, three ER medium lasers provide backup. A small X-pulse laser covers the rear. The Wolfhound is once again a match for the Combine’s Panther Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: HPG 通讯网瘫痪、共和国分裂之后，TharHes Industries 匆忙重启了在圣战期间被摧毁的 Wolfhound 生产线。-6S 型以 WLF-5 为基础，但恢复了 TharHes 原有的外观设计；它拆除了 MASC 系统和整套原有武器。右臂安装一门大型重制激光，并配有强化驱动器以提高精度。与 -3S 一样，它以三门增程中型激光作为辅助武器，后方则由一门小型 X 脉冲激光提供掩护。Wolfhound 再次足以与龙蛇联合的 Panther 一较高下。 特性：精准武器 - 能量 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

column1: Following the conquest of Coventry by the 布雷克圣言会, the Jihadists modified the 7S to meet their specifications. The 7B keeps one ER 中型激光 in the left arm, but adds two Flamers to it, making the 7B a lethal threat to un装甲ed infantry. A small cockpit makes room for two SRM-4s, which are still fed by a CASE-protected ammunition bin. The weight savings enabled engineers to add enough jump jets to rocket the Commando up to one hundred-twenty meters at a time. They also added an additional ton of 装甲.
column2: 布雷克圣言会征服考文垂后，圣战分子修改了 7S 以满足他们的规格。 7B在左臂保留了一个ER中型激光炮，但增加了两个火焰喷射器，使7B对非装甲步兵构成致命威胁。一个小驾驶舱可以容纳两架 SRM-4，它们仍然由受 CASE 保护的弹药箱供弹。减轻的重量使工程师能够添加足够的跳跃喷气机，将突击队一次提升到一百二十米。他们还额外增加了一吨装甲车。

column2: 布雷克圣言会征服 Coventry 后，圣战分子按自身规格改造 7S。7B 保留左臂 ER 中型激光器并增加两具火焰喷射器，成为对无装甲步兵的致命威胁。小型驾驶舱腾出空间安装两具 SRM-4，弹药由 CASE 保护。节省的重量使工程师增加足够跳跃喷射器，让 Commando 一次跃进 120 米，并额外增加一吨装甲。

column1: Following the start of the Jihad, the Luthien 装甲 Works on Abiy Adi began upgrading the Jenner. Borrowing a page from the Clan Jenner, the C2 is armed with three MML 5s, making the '机甲 effective at all ranges with three tons of ammunition. 重型铁纤维装甲 装甲 was added as well, while in order to make room for this an XL引擎, XL Gyro, and 小型驾驶舱 were used. A C3 Slave Unit allows it to share targeting data with other members of its lance. Finally, the jump capacity is increased to 180 米. 怪癖: 改进的 Lifesupport 掉落成本乘数: 0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 圣战开始后，Abiy Adi的Luthien装甲工坊开始升级Jenner。借鉴氏族Jenner的设计，C2装备三具MML-5发射器，配备三吨弹药后可在所有射程作战。它还增设重型铁纤维装甲；为腾出空间，采用XL引擎、XL陀螺仪和小型驾驶舱。C3从属单元使其能与小队其他成员共享瞄准数据。最后，跳跃能力提升至180米。 怪癖: 改进的 生命保障 掉落成本乘数: 0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: Following the success of the Hermit Crab, StarCorps on Son Hoa found itself in the curious position of being a profitable advanced BattleMech manufacturer on an independent Periphery world. The company's Gladiator line had been running since the Blakist war, producing a few -5R export units every year. With minimal capital expansion costs and only a few newly-sourced components, the -7R refit became both an economical and effective local defense unit as well as a distinctive addition to the Son Hoa branch’s catalog for regional sales.
column2: Hermit Crab 成功后，Son Hoa 的 StarCorps 发现自己成了独立外环世界上颇为奇特的先进战斗机甲制造商。该公司的 Gladiator 产品线自圣言之子战争以来一直运行，每年生产少量 -5R 出口型。-7R 改装型只需很少的资本扩张和少量新采购部件，既成为经济高效的本地防御单位，也成为 Son Hoa 分部面向地区销售的独特产品。

column1: Following the success of the Hermit Crab, StarCorps on Son Hoa found itself in the curious position of being a profitable advanced Battle机甲 manufacturer on an independent Periphery world. column2: 随着寄居蟹的成功，山和星军团发现自己处于一个奇怪的境地：成为独立外围世界中一家盈利的先进战机甲制造商。该公司的“角斗士”生产线自布莱克战争以来一直在运行，每年生产一些-5R 出口单位。凭借最低的资本扩张成本和仅少量新采购的部件，-7R 改装成为既经济又有效的地方防御单位，也是山和分公司区域销售目录中的独特补充。

column1: Following the surprise invasion of Huntress, most of the Clans looked to upgrade the defenders of their homeworlds. In so doing, 云蛇氏族 decided to upgrade their aging 步枪手IICs. The IIC 3 first entered service in the early part of 3062. Based upon the original 设计, it nonetheless uses two Model HHC-30 超级自动炮/2s to plink at a target from long range. Any opponent who believes he or she is facing a IIC 2 is quickly surprised, however, when the IIC 3 opens up with its paired Series 4D-2 Heavy Large Lasers. Twenty one double heat sinks keep this 设计 cool-running. This rebuilt version still mounts the 主动探头.
column2: Huntress遭到突然入侵后，大多数氏族都开始升级母星防御者。云蛇氏族决定升级老旧的步枪手IIC。IIC 3于3062年初服役。它基于原始设计，却使用两门Model HHC-30超级自动炮/2从远距离骚扰目标。任何以为自己面对IIC 2的对手，都会在IIC 3用成对的Series 4D-2重型大型激光器开火时大吃一惊。21组双重散热器让设计保持低热运行，同时保留主动探头。

column1: For a knockoff attempt at a Raven, this mech actually has decent E-war capabilities. The scanning is very powerful, albeit not very detailed, and the EWS shielding is surprisingly good, albeit very range limited. Neat PPC though.
column2: 这是一台仿制 Raven 的尝试，却拥有不错的电子战能力。扫描功能非常强大，虽然细节不足；EWS 屏蔽也出人意料地好，不过有效范围很有限。PPC 倒是挺漂亮。

column1: For a light mech, this thing is pretty quick and pretty armored. Hard to go wrong with that.
column2: 作为轻型机甲，它速度很快，装甲也很厚。拥有这两点，基本很难出错。

column1: For a light mech, this thing is pretty quick and pretty 装甲ed. Hard to go wrong with that.
column2: 对于一台轻型机甲来说，这东西速度很快，装甲也很厚。选择它很难出错。

column1: For a mech that's primary armament consists of chem-lasers, and that runs off an internal combustion engine, this mech is surprisingly dangerous once it closes to close range. Which will take a while, seeing as they downgraded the already downsized engine the Charger is famous for, and then swapped it out for an ICE.
column2: 对于主要武器由化学激光组成、并且依靠内燃机运行的机甲来说，一旦接近近距离，这种机甲就会非常危险。这需要一段时间，因为他们降级了 Charger 著名的小型发动机，然后将其更换为 ICE。

column1: For a mech that's primary armament consists of chem-lasers, and that runs off an internal combustion 引擎, this mech is surprisingly dangerous once it closes to close range. Which will take a while, seeing as they downgraded the already downsized 引擎 the Charger is famous for, and then swapped it out for an ICE.
column2: 这台机甲主要装备化学激光器，并由内燃机驱动；当它终于接近近距离后，危险程度出人意料。只是接近需要一段时间，因为它把 Charger 著名的、已经缩小过的引擎进一步降级，然后换成内燃机。

column1: For a medium mech, this thing is dangerously fast. That Enhanced ERPPC allows it to stay at a safe range until it is ready to pounce.
column2: 对于中型机甲来说，这东西的速度快得危险。增强型 ERPPC 使其能够保持在安全范围内，直到准备好突袭。

column1: For a scout this locust does the job with the benefit of a quick mission kill on other lights in it's weight bracket. We can work with it boss.
column2: 作为侦察机，这台 Locust 很称职，还能迅速击杀同吨位级别的其他轻型机甲。我们可以用它，老大。

column1: For a so called medium mech, Quicsell has done their best to make a heavy mech with this one. While it's not very fast, and that XL ICE is an affront to engineering, the foundations are solid. Good rookie mech, since it's very hard to kill; although they may fall over a lot, thanks to those unstable leg replacements.
column2: 对于一台所谓的中型机甲，Quicsell 已经尽力把它做成重型机甲了。它速度不快，那台 XL ICE 更是工程学的耻辱，但基础结构很扎实。它很适合新手，因为很难被摧毁；不过腿部不稳定替换件可能让驾驶员经常摔倒。

column1: For its weight, this thing is a sturdy wall and folks better watch out when that laser swings around the side of that shield.
column2: 以它的重量而言，这东西简直是一堵坚固的墙；不过大家最好小心那面盾牌侧边扫过来的激光。

column1: For once Pirate Lingo makes sense on a 机甲, the Bilge Rat is exactly like the archaic Rodent it gets its name from. Relying on a mixture of speed and EWAR does this Quad 机甲 try to skim under the Radar and hide in the murky depths of a Chaotic Battlefield. Showing some bite when threatened the 机甲 packs several MRM 5's with paired Chem Lasers wired through the cockpit. Whoever 设计ed the couplings made the machine a bumpy ride at best with the fumes leading straight into the Cockpit. I can only compare this to huffing a Marker while trying to run for your Life, unless the 引擎 explodes underneath you in true PiraSte Fashion. Someone carved 'Cheese and Sin' in the cockpit's interior as well.
column2: 海盗黑话这次倒很贴切：Bilge Rat正如其名称所指的古老啮齿动物。它依靠速度和电子战在混乱战场中贴地掠行、躲避雷达。受到威胁时，这台四足机甲会用数具MRM-5和连接驾驶舱的成对化学激光反击。设计耦合装置的人显然没考虑乘坐体验，废气直接灌入驾驶舱；这就像叼着标记器狂奔时吸入烟雾，除非引擎像真正的海盗风格那样在脚下爆炸。有人还在驾驶舱内刻下了“奶酪与罪恶”。

column1: Formerly a Royal variant, these M2s are tough and reliable. I'd think twice about trying to get close in under the LRMs.
column2: 这些 M2 以前是皇家型号，坚固可靠。我会三思而后行，尝试接近LRM。

column1: Formerly a Word of Blake design, the Yao Lien is a Capellan Confederation BattleMech based on the Blakists' Celestial series OmniMechs. The Yao Lien started life as the Eidolon, a mass-produced FrankenMech using excess parts from the Celestial OmniMechs. With House Liao discovering the existence of the top secret Liberty-based Martinson Armaments facility that built it, the CCAF interrupted Operation SCOUR's recapture of the planet to secure the plant for themselves, dismantling the facility and spiriting it away before anybody in Stone's Coalition realized it was even there. Initially using captured parts before switching to locally manufactured subcomponents, the rebuilt facility on Capella was turning out the now renamed 'Mech for the Confederation shortly after the recapture of Terra.
column2: Yao Lien 原本是 Blake 圣言的设计，后来成为卡佩兰联邦基于 Blake 教徒 Celestial 系列 OmniMech 的战斗机甲。Yao Lien 最初名为 Eidolon，是利用 Celestial OmniMech 多余部件批量生产的‘弗兰肯机甲’。廖家发现了制造它的、位于 Liberty 的绝密 Martinson Armaments 工厂后，CCAF 中断了 SCOUR 行动对该行星的收复，转而夺取工厂；他们拆解设施并秘密转移，直到 Stone 联盟发现之前都未被察觉。工厂起初使用缴获部件，之后改用本地制造的子组件；在收复泰拉后不久，重建于卡佩拉的工厂便开始为联邦生产这款更名后的机甲。

column1: Formerly a 布雷克圣言会 设计, the Yao Lien is a Capellan Confederation Battle机甲 based on the Blakists' Celestial series Omni机甲s. The Yao Lien started life as the Eidolon, a mass-生产 Franken机甲 using excess parts from the Celestial Omni机甲s. With House Liao discovering the existence of the top secret Liberty-based 马丁森军械 facility that built it, the CCAF interrupted Operation SCOUR's recapture of the planet to secure the plant for themselves, dismantling the facility and spiriting it away before anybody in Stone's Coalition realized it was even there. Initially using captured parts before switching to locally manufactured subcomponents, the rebuilt facility on Capella was turning out the now renamed '机甲 for the Confederation shortly after the recapture of Terra.
column2: 姚连恩的前身是布雷克圣言会设计，是一款基于布雷克派天界系列全能机甲的卡佩伦联邦战机甲。妖连最初的名字是 Eidolon，这是一种使用天界全能机甲多余部件进行批量生产的弗兰肯机甲。随着廖家族发现了建造该工厂的最高机密的自由女神马丁森军械设施的存在，CCAF 中断了夺回星球的行动 SCOUR，以保护自己的工厂安全，在斯通联盟中的任何人意识到它的存在之前，拆除了该设施并将其偷偷带走。最初使用捕获的零件，然后改用本地制造的子组件，在收复泰拉后不久，卡佩拉上的重建设施就为联邦生产了现在更名为“机甲”的设施。

column1: Found some cobwebs while working through the internals of this one, boss. Looks like we scored ourselves an old piece of Star League junk. It's solid - perhaps except for the prototype autocannon model - but boy is it running light on ammo.
column2: Boss，我在检查这台机甲内部时发现了一些蜘蛛网。看来我们捞到了一件古老的星盟废品。整体很扎实——也许原型自动火炮除外——但它的弹药少得可怜。

column1: Founded in 3132, Jötunn BattleWorx's one purpose was the local development of reinforced chassis technology in a workable BattleMech. Flush with Bear-Krona thanks to Gray Monday appropriations, Jötunn took an old Grizzly and rebuilt it. The Bruin’s superior durability and similar armament had relegated the Grizzly to obsolescence decades earlier. Four years of testing saw endless permutations of weapons to find the ideal combatant. To allocate mass lost to the chassis, the sturdy old reactor was replaced with an XL model with no loss in resilience, proving the concept. Its arsenal remained largely the same, though a Plasma rifle replaced the Gauss rifle and targeting was improved for all weapons. The Grizzly that marched off Jötunn’s first production line in 3138 was highly compromised, but the lessons learned informed the development of a new generation of OmniMechs Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: Jötunn BattleWorx成立于3132年，唯一目标是在可实际服役的战斗机甲上开发强化底盘技术。凭借“灰色星期一”拨款带来的充足熊克朗，该公司找来一台老式灰熊机甲并进行改造。早在数十年前，熊式凭借更强的耐久性和相近的武装，便已使灰熊式过时。之后四年间，团队反复测试各种武器组合，力求找到理想的战斗平台。为补偿强化底盘增加的重量，他们将坚固的旧反应堆换成XL型号，而机甲的韧性并未因此下降，证明这一设计思路可行。武器配置大体沿用原方案，但以等离子步枪取代高斯步枪，并改进了所有武器的瞄准系统。3138年，第一台走下Jötunn生产线的灰熊式虽作出了许多妥协，但研发过程中积累的经验为新一代全地形机甲的开发提供了依据。 特性：易于驾驶 部署成本倍率：1.16 手臂执行器限制：左下臂

A 100 ton tank, the Laurens mounted a pair of AC/2s and UAC/5s in its turret with an LB-10X for backup at closer ranges. The manufacturing line for the tank was destroyed in 2769, dooming it to a long and slow decline to extinction during the Succession Wars. Biome Restrictions: None. column1: Full production of this version, known as the Goblin II Infantry Support Vehicle, began in 3053. Though the Goblin remained a capable tank during its time in the Inner Sphere, the Clan Invasion prompted Johnston Industries to redesign it. A 180 FireHeart fusion engine replaces the ICE, enabling the infantry bay to be expanded. The large laser is replaced with a ER Medium Laser, LRM-10 and an SRM-6 to increase its firepower. The redesign mounts two Johnston miniguns, providing even more defense against infantry. Finally, an anti-missile system was installed to increase its survivability. The armor protection was increased from 8 tons to 9.5 tons of ferro-fibrous. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 230 25 Left 160 25 Right 160 25 Rear 130 25 Turret 200 25 Total 880 125 Quirk: Variable Range Targeting
column2: Goblin II 步兵支援车于 3053 年开始全面生产。Goblin 在内星服役期间一直是合格的坦克，但氏族入侵促使 Johnston Industries 重新设计。180 级 FireHeart 聚变引擎取代内燃机，腾出空间扩大步兵舱。大型激光换成增程中型激光、LRM-10 和 SRM-6，提升火力；两挺 Johnston 迷你机枪强化反步兵能力，并加装反导系统提高生存力。铁磁纤维装甲也从 8 吨增至 9.5 吨。 生物群系限制：无。 移动： 4/6 格 / 120/180 米。 装甲： 铁磁纤维装甲 结构： Structure 数值 A S 正面 230 25 左侧 160 25 右侧 160 25 后方 130 25 炮塔 200 25 总计 880 125 特性：可变距离瞄准

The Cannon's three tons of ammunition is found in the right torso with one of the 'Mech's three additional heat sinks.
column2: B 型专为火力支援设计，强大火力集中在 Long Tom 炮和增程大型激光器上，四门中型脉冲激光器则完善近防武器。火炮的三吨弹药位于右侧躯干，其中还装有机体三台额外散热器之一。

column2: B配置作为火力支援平台，主要火力集中在长程Tom火炮和ER大型激光上，四门中型脉冲激光完善了机甲的防御武器。火炮的三吨弹药存放在右侧躯干，并与机甲额外三具散热器中的一具同处一处。

column1: General Motors saw the Clans rebuild the Fire Wasp and decided the Inner Sphere needed its own answer. Ten tons heavier, proper long-range weapons, Heavy Flamers instead of standard ones, and a Retractable Blade tucked into the right arm. It became one of the most common medium mechs of its era, which tells you something. The Magistracy Highlanders ran these too. Star Corporal Luna Rhodes fought in one right up until Cate's Hold in 3101. That is a name worth remembering.
column2: 通用汽车看到氏族重建 Fire Wasp 后，决定让内层圈拥有自己的回应。它重十吨，配备真正的远程武器，用重型火焰喷射器替换标准型号，并在右臂藏有一把伸缩刀。它成为那个时代最常见的中型机甲之一，这本身就说明了问题。治安官高地人也驾驶过它。Star Corporal Luna Rhodes 一直驾驶此型号战斗到 3101 年 Cate's Hold 战役。这个名字值得记住。

column1: General Systems built exactly one of these right before the Amaris Civil War. SLDF wanted the biggest mech ever made and they wanted it to run without a pilot. That Drone Control System ate twenty tons and the whole project got written off as a failure. Then some poor mercenary scavengers dug it up in 3025 on an icy world and accidentally switched it back on. Took out everything in sight until someone found the control center and shut it down for good. After that they same group of mercenary buffoons ripped the Drone Control System out and converted it to manual controls, can't say it seemed worth the effort looking at it now.
column2: General Systems 在阿玛瑞内战前夕制造了唯一一台这样的机器。SLDF 想要史上最大的机甲，并且希望它无需驾驶员即可运行。无人机控制系统占用了 20 吨重量，整个项目随后被判定为失败。3025 年，一群可怜的佣兵拾荒者在冰封世界挖出了它，并意外重新启动。它摧毁视线内的一切，直到有人找到控制中心并永久关闭。后来同一群佣兵蠢货拆除了无人机控制系统，改成手动操纵；看现在的结果，我不能说这番努力值得。

column1: Ghost Bear always is looking to use advanced technology in there mech re-designs. This one looks to be a prototype of the upcoming II model. I shudder to think if they can actually get a self healing mech.
column2: 幽灵熊氏族总喜欢在机甲重设计中采用先进技术。这台看起来像即将推出的 II 型号原型机。一想到他们真的可能造出自我修复机甲，我就不寒而栗。

column1: Gotta say, boss, this looks like a real catch! No? Alright. This little one-hundred ton baby has some of the best stealth technology I've ever seen. The two SB gauss rifles it had mounted look real nasty too. Definitely wouldn't want this thing sneaking up on me, that's for sure.
column2: 老大，必须承认，这看起来真是个好货！不？好吧。这台一百吨的小宝贝拥有我见过最好的隐形技术之一。它装的两把 SB 高斯步枪看起来也很凶。绝对不想让这东西悄悄摸到我身后。

column1: G配置被设计为远程狙击手 并可作为C3网络的侦察单位. 其主要武器是安装在炮塔中的一对轻型AC/2. 自动加农炮由瞄准计算机引导 并由两吨弹药供弹 可装载不同类型的弹药. 此配置还安装了C3从属单元. Scapha Hovertank是一种三十二世纪的悬浮万能车辆 最初专为球体共和国的武装部队生产. 由Grumman Industries于3123年在泰拉建造 Scapha采用了当时最先进的技术设计. 由于其灵活性和火力 它在RAF中担任了多种角色. 该设计在RAF服役中极受欢迎 直到3132年后共和国大部分Prefectures落入入侵势力之手. 作为许多Republic Standing Guard单位的一部分 Scapha以延缓许多共和国世界的陷落而闻名. 作为一种快速灵活的坦克 Scapha由Strand 265-rated Extra-Extralight Fusion Engine提供动力 赋予其额外速度. 尽管引擎成本高昂且体积庞大 Scapha仍有十三吨的pod空间用于武器和设备. 保护其装甲外壳的是7.5吨Grumman CRR反射装甲 可减弱能量武器造成的伤害. 环境限制: 无. 移动: 11/17格 / 330/510米. 装甲: 反射涂层 结构: 结构 数值 装甲 结构 正面 185 20 左侧 105 20 右侧 105 20 后方 100 20 炮塔 160 20 总计 655 100 特质: 可变距离瞄准 万能车辆 #武器: 2x 轻型AC/2

column2: 这台龙来自库里塔人的竞技世界，经过重新设计，能够向敌人喷吐火焰与毁灭，让观众看得热血沸腾。

column1: Hailing from a Kuritan Gamesworld this Dragon got re设计ed to spit fire and destruction upon it's Enemy causing the crowd to go fiery wild.
column2: 这台Dragon来自库里塔的竞技世界，经过重新设计后能够向敌人喷吐火焰与毁灭，令观众陷入狂热。

column1: Hailing from the punishing arenas of Solaris VII, the Storm Wolf combines the latest and greatest of technology on the Arctic Wolf II Omni Chassis. Capable of quickly traversing the battlefield and exploiting terrain to bring its payload to bear.
column2: Storm Wolf 来自 Solaris VII 残酷的竞技场，将 Arctic Wolf II 全向底盘上最新、最优秀的技术融为一体。它能够迅速穿越战场并利用地形发挥武器载荷。

column2: Storm Wolf来自Solaris VII残酷的竞技场，将最新、最先进的技术融合到Arctic Wolf II全向底盘上。它能够迅速穿越战场，利用地形发挥所携载武器的威力。 特性：瞄准增强—近程 部署成本倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Hell's Horses built this one as a proper upgrade for a new age, not just a refit. Sixty tons, same top speed as the original, six jump jets, and four ER Flamers that will cook anything they get near. Every single Clan ended up running these eventually, even the Homeworld ones. Usually listed as second-line but that label undersells what this thing can do in the right hands. The whole Fire Wasp lineage is something special and this is the biggest version of that idea.
column2: 地狱之马将这款车打造为新时代的适当升级，而不仅仅是改装。六十吨，与原来相同的最高速度，六架跳跃式喷气机和四架 ER 火焰喷射器，可以烹饪它们附近的任何东西。每个氏族最终都会运行这些，甚至是家园的。通常被列为二线产品，但这个标签低估了这个东西在合适的人手中可以做的事情。整个火黄蜂血统都很特别，这是这个想法的最大版本。

column1: Hellespont Industrials built this for the Capellan Confederation on Sun Tzu Liao's personal commission. Stealth armor, MASC, Vibroblade, the whole package. The HAR-101 uses mixed tech from the Clans while the HAR-111 is a pure Inner Sphere build that they actually exported to the Magistracy and Fronc Reaches. Both versions are built around the same idea, get in faster than anyone expects, do damage, disappear before they can respond. That is a concept that works regardless of what tech you fill it with.
column2: 赫勒斯庞工业受孙志辽亲自委托，为卡佩兰联邦制造了这款装甲。隐形装甲、MASC、振动刀，配置一应俱全。HAR-101 使用氏族混合技术；HAR-111 则是纯内星系技术打造的型号，甚至曾出口至治安官辖区和弗隆克边境地区。两个型号的设计理念相同：以超出敌人预料的速度突入，造成伤害，并在敌人还击前撤离。无论采用何种技术，这套思路都行之有效。

column1: Hellespont Industrials built this for the Capellan Confederation on Sun Tzu Liao's personal commission. Stealth 装甲, MASC, Vibroblade, the whole package. The HAR-101 uses mixed tech from the Clans while the HAR-111 is a pure Inner Sphere build that they actually exported to the Magistracy and Fronc Reaches. Both versions are built around the same idea, get in faster than anyone expects, do damage, disappear before they can respond. That is a concept that works regardless of what tech you fill it with.
column2: Hellespont Industrials受Sun Tzu Liao亲自委托，为卡佩兰联邦制造了这台机体。隐形装甲、MASC、振动刀，整套配置一应俱全。HAR-101采用氏族混合技术，HAR-111则是纯内天体构型，实际出口到了治安官辖区和Fronc边域。两个版本都围绕同一理念打造：比任何人预想的更快切入，造成伤害，然后在敌人反应前消失。无论填充何种技术，这一理念都有效。

column1: Hellespont named this one after a MechWarrior operating in Capellan space, which tells you what kind of machine it was meant to be. The Partial Wing came from Jade Falcon hardware, the MML from a mercenary company. Maggie Faraday herself raided one in 3069 and ran it for decades. After the Jihad the CCAF sold a limited number to mercenaries working with the Magistracy. Whatever you paid for this one, it was worth it.
column2: Hellespont 以一名在卡佩兰空间活动的机甲战士命名这台机甲，这已经说明了它的用途。部分机翼来自 Jade Falcon 的装备，MML 则来自一家佣兵公司。Maggie Faraday 本人于 3069 年突袭缴获一台，并驾驶了数十年。圣战后，CCAF 向与治安官合作的佣兵出售了少量该型号。无论你为它付了多少钱，都物有所值。

column1: Here We Have the OG Variant Of The Blackjack OmniMech. This Loadout Replaces The UAC/5's With Twin RAC AC/5's For Added Punch.
column2: 这是 Blackjack OmniMech 的原始型号。该配置将 UAC/5 换成双联 RAC AC/5，获得更强火力。

column1: Here We Have the OG Variant Of The Blackjack Omni机甲. This Loadout Replaces The UAC/5's With Twin RAC AC/5's For Added Punch.
column2: 这是黑杰克全能机甲的原始配置。该装载用双联RAC AC/5替换了UAC/5，以获得更强的爆发火力。

column1: Here We Have the OX Variant Of The Blackjack OmniMech. This Loadout Changes The OmniMech Into A PPC Monster.
column2: 这就是 Blackjack OmniMech 的 OX 变体。它的配置将这台 OmniMech 变成了 PPC 怪兽。

column1: Here We Have the OX Variant Of The Blackjack Omni机甲. This Loadout Changes The Omni机甲 Into A PPC Monster.
column2: 这里展示的是Blackjack全向机甲的OX变型。这套配置将全向机甲改造成PPC火力怪物。

column1: Hey Boss! They updated the ancient Icestorm platform with improved firepower, armor and cooling. The result is a question for philosophers, not me.
column2: 老大，他们用更强火力、装甲和散热升级了那套古老的冰风暴平台。结果如何？这问题还是留给哲学家回答吧。

column1: Hey Boss! They updated the ancient Icestorm platform with improved firepower, 装甲 and cooling. The result is a question for philosophers, not me.
column2: 嘿，老板！他们用更强火力、装甲和冷却系统升级了古老的冰风暴平台。至于结果如何，那是哲学家该回答的问题，不是我。

column1: Hey Boss, the clans call these things the Summoner but I've always called em' the Thor.  These OmniMechs are a tad light on available pod space for their weight class and those early structural mounts are not compatable with anything else. But with that huge engine and lots of jumpjet hardpoints you will be hard pressed to find many 'Mechs its size that are faster.
column2: 老大，氏族称这些东西为 Summoner，但我一直叫它们 Thor。这些 OmniMech 对其吨位而言可用吊舱空间略少，而且早期结构挂点无法兼容其他装备。不过凭借那台巨型引擎和大量跳跃喷射器挂点，你很难找到同尺寸但速度更快的机甲。

column1: Hey Boss, the clans call these things the Summoner but I've always called em' the Thor.  These Omni机甲s are a tad light on available pod space for their weight class and those early structural mounts are not compatable with anything else. But with that huge engine and lots of jumpjet hardpoints you will be hard pressed to find many '机甲s its size that are faster.
column2: 老板，氏族把这些东西叫Summoner，但我一直称它们为Thor。这些全向机甲对于自身重量级别来说吊舱空间略少，早期结构挂点也无法兼容其他设备。不过凭借那台巨大的引擎和大量跳跃喷射器挂点，很难找到同体型且速度更快的机甲。

column1: Hey Boss, the clans call these things the Summoner but I've always called em' the Thor.  These Omni机甲s are a tad light on available pod space for their weight class and those early structural mounts are not compatible with anything else. But with that huge engine and lots of Jump Jet hardpoints you will be hard pressed to find many '机甲s its size that are faster. There is something a little off about this particular one and it appears to be a repurposed underwater model. Look at all these watertight seals on everything!
column2: 嘿，老大，部落将这些东西称为“召唤者”，但我一直称它们为“雷神”。  这些全能机甲的可用吊舱空间相对于其重量等级来说有点轻，而且那些早期的结构安装座与其他任何东西都不兼容。但有了巨大的发动机和大量的跳跃喷气机挂载点，你将很难找到比它的尺寸更快的机甲。这个特定的模型有点不对劲，它似乎是一个重新设计的水下模型。看看所有东西上的这些防水密封！

column1: Hey Boss, the clans call these things the Summoner but I've always called em' the Thor.  These Omni机甲s are a tad light on available pod space for their weight class and those early structural mounts are not compatible with anything else. But with that huge 引擎 and lots of Jump Jet hardpoints you will be hard pressed to find many '机甲s its size that are faster. There is something a little off about this particular one and it appears to be a repurposed underwater model. Look at all these watertight seals on everything!
column2: 老板，星族把这些东西叫作召唤者，但我一直称它们为雷神。这些全能机甲对于自身重量级别来说可用挂载空间偏少，早期的结构挂点也不兼容其他设备。不过，凭借那台巨大的引擎和大量跳跃喷射器挂点，很难找到同级别中比它更快的机甲。这一台似乎有些不对劲，看起来像是改造自水下型号。看看这些遍布全身的水密封条！

column1: Hey boss, the inside of this cockpit has the words 'write something funny for how we got this' scratched into it.
column2: 嘿，老板，这个驾驶舱的内部刻有“为我们如何得到这个写一些有趣的东西”的字样。

column1: Hey, a Quicsell mech that's not a deathrap! Probably mostly because they didn't try to get fancy with it. Other than a slight increased tendency to fall over, this thing is actually pretty sturdy. A good 'kiddies first assault mech' for the trainees.
column2: 嘿，一台不是死亡陷阱的Quicsell机甲！主要是因为他们没试图把它做得花里胡哨。除了更容易摔倒一点，这东西其实相当结实。对训练生来说，是一台不错的“儿童入门突击机甲”。

column1: Hey, for once Quicksell actually made a respectable 'Mech, Boss. Sure, the armor is low, and the movement is just faster than an Urbie, but that damage output is pretty good and it's relatively cheap. All we'd need to do is save some weight, up the armor, and it should be good in smaller battles.
column2: 嘿，这一次，Quicksell 实际上制造了一个令人尊敬的“机甲，老板”。当然，护甲较低，移动速度也比 Urbie 快，但伤害输出相当不错，而且相对便宜。我们需要做的就是减轻一些重量，增加装甲，这在较小的战斗中应该会很好。

column1: Hollis Incorporated built a handful of these for the Capellan Confederation and called it experimental, which is putting it mildly. Two Arrow IV systems with nuclear ammunition aboard is not something most commanders want pointed anywhere near their own forces. The torso cockpit is unusual but it freed up the head for an AMS which makes sense given what it carries. Opponents who knew what it was loaded with sometimes just backed off entirely. Can't really blame them.
column2: Hollis Incorporated 为卡佩兰联盟制造了少量这种实验机，称其为“实验”还算客气。两套 Arrow IV 系统配上核弹药，绝不是多数指挥官愿意让它靠近己方部队的东西。躯干驾驶舱很不寻常，但它腾出的头部空间可以安装 AMS，这对它携带的武器来说很合理。知道它装了什么的敌人有时会直接撤退，也不能怪他们。

column1: House Davion focused on boosting mobility while fielding upgraded autocannons. The haphazard WVR-7D was followed by several Project Phoenix models before the Talon factory disappeared in nuclear fire during the Jihad. Not content to lose a defining medium ’Mech after the success of the SHD-6D, the AFFS financed rapid production of the WVR-10D at Kallon of Wernke. Its performance compares well with the initial run of Conjurers built at Thermopolis for the Wolf Empire. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 达维昂家族着力提升机动性，同时为机甲配备升级型自动炮。仓促推出的 WVR-7D 后续衍生出多个 Phoenix 计划型号，直到 Talon 工厂在圣战期间的核火中消失。SHD-6D 获得成功后，AFFS 不愿失去这款标志性的中型机甲，遂资助 Kallon 公司在 Wernke 快速生产 WVR-10D。它的性能不逊于 Wolf Empire 在 Thermopolis 生产的首批 Conjurer。 特性：改进型通信 部署成本倍率：1.05

column1: How did you come by this Mech? There was only one, Khan Malvina Hazen will kill you if she finds out you have her brother's Mech.
column2: 你是怎么弄到这台机甲的？世上只有一台。Khan Malvina Hazen 要是发现你有她兄弟的机甲，会杀了你的。

column1: How do we keep coming across tricked out custom jobs like this, Boss? It's like every crackpot mercenary group has their own factory sitting planetside or something. What? Don't gimmie that look - the Argo's different!
column2: 我们怎么总能遇到这种改得面目全非的定制机，Boss？简直像每个异想天开的佣兵团都在行星地面有自己的工厂似的。什么？别这么看我——Argo 不一样！

column1: However a Pirate got his hands on this tech, and then stuffed it all into a Locust  ...also someone scribbled a Wang was here into the Cockpit.
column2: 然而，一名海盗掌握了这项技术，然后将其全部塞进了蝗虫中……还有人在驾驶舱中写下了“王在这里”。

column1: However this Black Python ended up in the hands of a pirate is a mystery; the scarier mystery is how they got advanced and experimental technology into it.
column2: 这台 Black Python 怎么落入海盗手中是个谜；更令人担心的是，他们是如何弄到先进实验技术并装上去的。

column1: However this 黑蟒 ended up in the hands of a pirate is a mystery; the scarier mystery is how they got advanced and experimental technology into it.
column2: 这台机甲为何落入海盗手中是个谜，更可怕的问题是他们究竟如何把先进实验技术装进了它。

column1: I can respect when somebody orders a custom job on a 'Mech and they don't ask you to replace every little thing on it. The LB-10-X here slots nicely into where the AC-10 used to be, and those Streak SRMs sit nice and pretty in the old LRM-5 mounts. Feels like an homage to the original — like there's some respect for it.
column2: Giftzwerg，也就是“有毒矮人”，是莱拉骑手委托制造的机甲，大幅提升了Imp的防御能力。

column1: I can tell why all the promotional material for this mech is about it's speed. They practically forgot the weapons! It's only got four light PPCs, which is pretty sad for a mech this heavy. Not only that, but if you actually manage to hit the enemy with all of them, you'll overheat the mech in one or two volleys unless you're in the freaking arctic.
column2: 我知道为什么这个机甲的所有宣传材料都是关于它的速度。他们几乎忘记了武器！它只有四个轻型 PPC，对于这么重的机甲来说这是相当可悲的。不仅如此，如果你真的设法用所有这些攻击击中敌人，除非你在可怕的北极，否则你会在一两次齐射中使机甲过热。

column1: I don't believe it. A Quicsell mech that actually does a decent job that the original was designed for! This Black Knight is almost worthy of the name. The long range damage is piss poor thanks to those 'REX' lasers, but it's a nasty brawler.
column2: 我不敢相信。Quicsell 居然造出了一台真正完成原设计任务的机甲！这台 Black Knight 几乎配得上这个名字。由于“REX”激光，远程伤害糟糕透顶，但它是个凶狠的近战斗士。

column1: I don't believe it. Quicsell actually made a normal, basic mech! Sure, it a bit undergunned and over-tuned for speed, but it's actually decent at what it does, which is move sixty tons of metal around really fast. If you can find a real double heatsink kit, it would allow you to get better cooling, but there's not all that much to complain about here.
column2: 我不敢相信。Quicsell 居然造出了一台正常的基础机甲！当然，它火力略显不足、速度调校过头，但确实擅长把 60 吨金属高速搬来搬去。如果能找到真正的双重散热器套件，就能改善冷却；不过除此之外也没什么好抱怨的。

column1: I don't even want to know from whom they looted a Wolfhound, but whoever did, surely indulged themself with upgrading it's weapons, all these lasers sure pack a whallop, if it doesn't just melt looking at the trigger.
column2: 我甚至不想知道他们从谁那里抢来这台 Wolfhound，但无论是谁，都肯定沉迷于升级它的武器。这些激光器的火力很猛，只是别在扣下扳机时把它自己融化了。

column1: I don't know what to say, Boss. Almost every part of this Banshee has been compromised by seemingly random modifications and jury-riggings. I have no idea how it is all holding together, but somehow it is. If you want to use this for your own lances, you might have to find the craziest pilot out there, because this 'Mech is just one unlucky hit away from blowing up in a massive plasma ball.
column2: 我不知道该说什么，老板。这艘女妖号的几乎每个部分都因看似随机的修改和陪审团操纵而受到损害。我不知道这一切是如何结合在一起的，但不知何故它是这样的。如果你想将它用于你自己的长矛，你可能必须找到那里最疯狂的飞行员，因为这个“机甲”距离在巨大的等离子球中爆炸只差一个不幸的打击。

column1: I don't know whose bright idea it was to bolt a Siege Laser on such a light 'Mech but at least they gave it a Stealth engine to keep its profile down.
column2: 真不知道是谁想出把攻城激光装在这么轻的机甲上这个馊主意，不过至少他们给它装了隐形引擎来降低特征。

column1: I don't know whose bright idea it was to bolt a Siege Laser on such a light 'Mech but at least they gave it a Stealth 引擎 to keep its profile down.
column2: 不知道是谁想出了在如此轻型的机甲上安装攻城激光的馊主意，但至少他们给它配了隐形引擎来降低信号特征。

column1: I dont know who, or why, but someone thought a Marauder would be the perfect fit for a Long Tom Cannon
column2: 我真不知道是谁、又是为什么，觉得掠夺者机甲最适合装一门 Long Tom 炮。

column1: I dont know who, or why, but someone thought a Marauder would be the perfect fit for a 长汤姆加农炮
column2: 我不知道是谁，也不知道为什么，但有人认为 Marauder 最适合装进一台巨型战斗机。

column1: I feel pity for the poor soul that had to turn a perfectly fine machine into this excuse for a working Battlemech. Sure it's not as faultily wired or skimps on the armor as much as some of their other gimmick models. Yes there is some severe firepower here but the drawbacks, the ammo consumption is horrible on these supposed 'Premium' launchers. And the cooling, this is meant for the Arena? How badly do you want the Pilot to sweat while risking their paycheck. All considered, could have been worse but I am not betting my personal stash of Scotch on this bucket of bolts anytime soon.
column2: 我为那些可怜的灵魂感到遗憾，他们不得不将一台完美的机器变成了一个工作战机的借口。当然，它不像其他一些噱头模型那样有错误的接线或在装甲上的吝啬。是的，这里有一些强大的火力，但缺点是，这些所谓的“高级”发射器的弹药消耗是可怕的。还有冷却，这是为竞技场准备的吗？你多么希望飞行员在冒着薪水风险的情况下流汗。综合考虑，情况可能会更糟，但我不会很快就把我个人收藏的苏格兰威士忌押在这桶螺栓上。

column1: I get the feeling whoever put this thing together was expecting to receive a different chassis, and just crammed everything in however they could. It certainly is "shiny" with that AMS running, though.
column2: 我感觉组装这东西的人本来以为会收到另一种底盘，只好把所有东西硬塞进去。AMS启动时确实很“闪亮”。

column1: I had to science the shit out of this one.
column2: 我不得不把这台机甲彻底科学化改造。

column1: I have been finding R model parts all over the galaxy lately. It is no wonder the pirates have managed to scrape one together and make it a melee monster.
column2: 我最近在整个银河系到处发现 R 型部件。难怪海盗能拼出一台，还把它变成近战怪物。

column1: I have long since learned to not ask questions that I don't want the answers to but I need to know: why is 'Old Nicky is a bitch' scratched into the console?
column2: 尽管在大撤离前很久就被认为过时，Helepolis攻城机甲的蓝图仍在前往五角世界的旅途中幸存，直到黄金世纪才基本被忽视。一小群郊狼科学家重新设计了这套古老方案，增加吨位并应用大多数可用的减重技术，然后提交给他们的汗王。尽管被判定为不光彩的设计，HEP-IIC仍在社会氏族缓存中幸存，并逐年缓慢升级。ZA型装备两具箭V，近距离防御只能依靠一具iATM-3。

column1: I know I give the Clans a lotta flak for ruining what ain't broke, but this time I think they might've been onto something. No unnecessary bullshit here, just a straight continuation of what the Shadow Hawk used to be. Top marks - for a Clan design, anyway.
column2: 我知道我经常批评氏族把没坏的东西改坏，但这次我觉得他们可能做对了。这里没有多余的废话，只是 Shadow Hawk 原本设计的直接延续。满分评价——当然，是按氏族设计的标准。

column1: I mean, it's pretty much what you'd expect out of a Hammerhands: a pair of big ol' -er- cannons.
column2: 这正是你对Hammerhands的期待：两门巨大、呃……加农炮。

column1: I mean, it's pretty much what you'd expect out of a Hammerhands: a pair of cannons supplemented by a PPC; just, ya know, better.
column2: 这基本就是你对 Hammerhands 的预期：两门火炮再由一门 PPC 支援，只是——你懂的——性能更好。

column1: I never thought I'd see this many rifles on one mech. That's not a compliment, boss; rifles are periphery tech for a reason. I suppose they do the job of destabilizing other mechs well enough, but they're really not cut out for penetrating armor, especially at these low calibers. Oh, and rip out that 'Omni-jammer', it jams your mechs too, and you can't turn the damn thing off.
column2: 我从没想过一台机甲上会有这么多步枪。别误会，老大，这不是夸奖；步枪是边疆技术是有原因的。我想它们确实足以让其他机甲失稳，但实在不适合穿透装甲，尤其是这种低口径武器。哦，还有，把那台‘Omni 干扰器’拆了，它连你的机甲也会干扰，而且你根本关不掉该死的东西。

column1: I never thought I'd see this many rifles on one mech. That's not a compliment, boss; rifles are periphery tech for a reason. I suppose they do the job of destabilizing other mechs well enough, but they're really not cut out for penetrating 装甲, especially at these low calibers. Oh, and rip out that '全向-jammer', it jams your mechs too, and you can't turn the damn thing off.
column2: 我从没想过一台机甲上会有这么多步枪。这可不是夸奖，老大；步枪之所以是边疆技术，自有原因。我承认它们足以有效削弱其他机甲，但真的不适合穿透装甲，尤其是这种低口径步枪。还有，把那个“全向干扰器”拆掉，它连你的机甲也会干扰，而且你根本关不掉这该死的东西。

column1: I pity the fool facing this thing when all four iATM systems get a lock with HE loaded.
column2: 如果这东西的四套 iATM 都锁定目标并装填高爆弹药，我真同情它的对手。

column1: I really like RACs, boss but four may be too many on one frame.
column2: 老大，我确实喜欢 RAC，但一台底盘上装四门可能有点太多了。

column1: I think I saw a Solaris match with one of these; that field artillery strapped on the right arm is a force to be reckoned with and that axe in the other arm is no slouch either.
column2: 我好像在 Solaris 看过这种机甲的比赛；右臂捆着的野战火炮很难对付，另一只手的斧头也毫不逊色。

column1: I think Quicsell farmed out the engine shielding on this one, since it's far beyond their usual quality. The guns, on the other hand, are exactly what I would expect from them. I'm pretty sure they rotate just for show. While it's not very fast, at least it's well protected.
column2: 我怀疑 Quicsell 把这台机甲的引擎屏蔽外包了，因为质量远超他们平时的水平。至于枪炮嘛，倒完全符合我对他们的预期。我敢说那些炮管旋转纯粹是做样子。它虽然不快，至少防护不错。

column1: I think Quicsell farmed out the 引擎 shielding on this one, since it's far beyond their usual quality. The guns, on the other hand, are exactly what I would expect from them. I'm pretty sure they rotate just for show. While it's not very fast, at least it's well protected.
column2: 我猜Quicsell把这台机甲的引擎屏蔽外包出去了，因为质量远超他们平时的水平。至于火炮，倒是完全符合我对他们的预期。我很确定那些炮管只是为了炫耀才会旋转。它虽然不快，但至少防护不错。

column1: I think whatever pirate owned this thing had a duel go wrong with a missile carrier or something, because they were clearly terrified of missiles. It's got half a dozen different AMS throughout the mech, and I think they even managed to turn the volume up on the missile lock warning sound in a way that I don't know if I can undo.
column2: 我认为无论哪个海盗拥有这东西，都会与导弹航母或其他什么东西进行决斗，因为他们显然害怕导弹。整个机甲中有六种不同的 AMS，我认为他们甚至设法调高了导弹锁定警告声音的音量，但我不知道我是否可以撤消。

column1: I wouldn't call this a mech, so much as a turret that can walk. Keep it away from enemy fire at all costs, since it's only got some machineguns to protect itself at close range. Still, it can put out a lot of bullets, a very long distance.
column2: 老板，我不知道他们为了让它跑得这么快削掉了哪些设计环节，但肯定削得不少。建议只让有经验的驾驶员使用：它快得刺眼，却因为那些该死的腿部替换件而相当不稳定。还要记住，大量重量用于聚变核心，所以武器相对较轻。

column1: I wouldn't want to be in front of one of those Ion Stream Projectors, let alone two. That'd be' a lot of particles I don't understand flying at me.
column2: 我可不想站在离子流投射器前面，更别说两个了。那会有一大堆我完全不懂的粒子朝我飞来。

column1: I'd say this is a better version than the 7V for any longer engagements, but the difference is not that big.
column2: 在持续交战中，我会说它比 7V 更好，但差距并不大。

column1: I'm at a loss for words, boss. I don't even know what this is. I'm not sure I wanna know what this is. So, this is - or was - a Phoenix Hawk model 1. Somebody's given it wings, and a gun. And a knife. Why does it have a knife? And why does it have "P-HAWK WITH SHIV" stamped onto the torso armor?
column2: 我无话可说，Boss。我甚至不知道这是什么，也不确定自己想不想知道。它原本——或者说曾经——是 Phoenix Hawk 1 型。有人给它装了翅膀、一门炮和一把刀。为什么会有刀？为什么躯干装甲上还印着“P-HAWK WITH SHIV”？

column1: I'm at a loss for words, boss. I don't even know what this is. I'm not sure I wanna know what this is. So, this is - or was - a Phoenix Hawk model 1. Somebody's given it wings, and a gun. And a knife. Why does it have a knife? And why does it have "P-HAWK WITH SHIV" stamped onto the torso 装甲?
column2: 老大，我已经无话可说了。我甚至不知道这是什么，也不确定自己想不想知道。这东西原本是一台Phoenix Hawk 1型。有人给它装了翅膀、火炮，还有一把刀。它为什么会有刀？为什么躯干装甲上还印着“P-HAWK WITH SHIV”？

column1: I'm no stranger to the Emperor's reputation to keep lasers running cool, but this is an incredibly ambitious build, even with the improvements to the cooling jackets. That said, I think with some restraint, I could see this thing doing some serious work as direct fire support.
column2: 我很熟悉 Emperor 让激光保持低温的名声，但即使考虑到冷却套的改进，这套构造也极其大胆。话虽如此，只要有所节制，我认为它能胜任严肃的直接火力支援。

column1: I'm no stranger to the Emperor's reputation to keep lasers running cool, but this is an incredibly ambitious build, even with the improvements to the cooling jackets. That said, I think with some restraint, I could see this thing doing some serious work as direct fire support. Shame that some monster removed the jump jets, though. Those things were iconic!
column2: 我对 Emperor 让激光器保持低温的名声并不陌生，但这套设计实在过于大胆，即使冷却套管已经改进也是如此。话虽如此，只要稍加节制，我认为它完全可以胜任直接火力支援。可惜某个怪物拆掉了跳跃喷射器——那些东西可是标志性装备！

column1: I'm not entirely sure what to make of this, Boss. If it wasn't for the fact this thing apparently saw real combat, I'd've just said it was a dummy 'Mech used in a lab to test that weapons at least integrated. Lasers? Clan. Heat Sinks? Not Clan. The missiles? It feels like they're somewhere in between. It's weird.
column2: 我不太确定该怎么评价它，Boss。如果不是因为它显然参加过实战，我会说这只是实验室里用来测试武器是否能集成的样机。激光器？氏族的。散热器？不是氏族的。导弹？感觉介于两者之间。真奇怪。

column1: I'm not really sure we can call it a Panther at this point.
column2: 我真不确定现在还能不能把它叫作Panther。

column1: I'm not sure I've ever seen an anti-missile mech take it this far. A huge amount of its tonnage is dedicated to anti-missile warheads. While it does produce an excellent defence, it's also limited by ammunition in a way that laser systems aren't, so a good LRM barrage is always going to win that fight at the end of the day. Decent backup weaponry though, in the form of those deadfire SRMs.
column2: 我不确定自己是否见过把反导机甲做到这种程度的。它大量吨位都投入了反导弹战斗部。虽然防御效果出色，但它像激光系统一样受弹药限制，所以到最后，一轮优秀的 LRM 齐射总能赢得对决。不过备用武器还不错，比如那些死火 SRM。

column1: I'm pretty sure this thing growled at me, boss. Hyperion Prime 是a hell of a machine, despite being 25 tons heavier, it 是just as fast as an Atlas, 携带more 装甲, and those Arrow V missiles pack a hell of a punch.
column2: 老板，我很确定这东西刚才对我咆哮了。Hyperion Prime真是一台可怕的机器：虽然重了25吨，却和Atlas一样快，携带更多装甲，而那些Arrow V导弹的威力也极其惊人。

column1: I'm pretty sure this thing growled at me, boss. The Hyperion A is a hell of a machine, despite being 25 tons heavier, it is just as fast as an Atlas, carries more armor, and that pair of MRM60s will tear most things apart, one missile at a time.
column2: 老大，我很确定这东西刚才冲我咆哮了。Hyperion A 是一台可怕的机器；尽管比 Atlas 重 25 吨，它却一样快、装甲更多，而那两具 MRM60 能一枚接一枚地撕碎大多数目标。

column1: I'm pretty sure this thing growled at me, boss. The Hyperion A is a hell of a machine, despite being 25 tons heavier, it is just as fast as an Atlas, carries more 装甲, and that pair of MRM60s will tear most things apart, one missile at a time.
column2: 老板，我很确定这东西刚才对我咆哮了。Hyperion A 真是台可怕的机器：虽然比 Atlas 重 25 吨，速度却一样快，装甲更多，而那两门 MRM-60 足以一次一枚导弹地撕碎大多数目标。

column1: I'm pretty sure this thing growled at me, boss. The Hyperion Prime is a hell of a machine, despite being 25 tons heavier, it is just as fast as an Atlas, carries more armor, and those Arrow V missiles pack a hell of a punch.
column2: 我很确定这东西在向我咆哮，老板。 Hyperion Prime 是一台地狱般的机器，尽管重 25 吨，但它的速度与 Atlas 一样快，携带更多装甲，而且那些 Arrow V 导弹威力惊人。

column1: I'm pretty sure this thing growled at me, boss. The Hyperion Prime is a hell of a machine, despite being 25 tons heavier, it is just as fast as an Atlas, carries more armor, and those Heavy Gauss Rifles are no joke.
column2: 老大，我敢肯定这家伙刚才冲我吼了。海伯利安 Prime 真是台猛兽，虽然重了 25 吨，却和阿特拉斯一样快、装甲还更厚，那些重型高斯步枪可不是闹着玩的。

column1: I'm pretty sure this thing growled at me, boss. The Hyperion Prime is a hell of a machine, despite being 25 tons heavier, it is just as fast as an Atlas, carries more armor, and those Heavy Plasma Cannons will slag almost anything.
column2: Boss，我很确定这东西刚才对我咆哮了。Hyperion Prime 真是台可怕的机器：虽然重了 25 吨，却和 Atlas 一样快，装甲更多，那些重型等离子炮几乎能熔毁一切。

column2: 老大，我敢肯定这东西刚才对我咆哮了。Hyperion Prime 真是台可怕的机器：它虽然重 25 吨，却和 Atlas 一样快，携带更多装甲，而那些重型等离子炮几乎能把任何东西熔化。

column1: I've heard of the Dragon Fire, boss, but this thing ain't much like them other ones. This Dragon Fire IIC is an Omni-Mech and sports all sorts of shenanigans that make it a force to be reckoned with in any configuration.
column2: 老大，我听说过 Dragon Fire，但这台和其他 Dragon Fire 可不一样。这台 Dragon Fire IIC 是 OmniMech，配置里充满各种花招，无论采用哪种配置都不好对付。

column1: I've heard of the Dragon Fire, boss, but this thing ain't much like them other ones. This Dragon Fire IIC is an Omni-机甲 and sports all sorts of shenanigans that make it a force to be reckoned with in any configuration.
column2: 老板，我听说过Dragon Fire，但这东西和那些Dragon Fire不太一样。这台Dragon Fire IIC是全向机甲，拥有各种奇特装备，无论采用哪种配置都不容小觑。

column1: If you need to turn the lights out on a Mech, the Icarus II-2R would be a good choice to use. It is moderately fast and sports two TSEMP Cannons capable of doing terrible things to a Mech.
column2: 如果你需要让一台机甲熄灯，Icarus II-2R 是不错的选择。它速度适中，装备两门 TSEMP 炮，足以对机甲造成可怕的后果。

column1: If you overlook the heat management issues, this is a powerful variant for close quarters. As long as you keep it out of Long to Extreme ranges of firing it will likely be useful.
column2: 如果忽略散热管理问题，这是一款强大的近距离作战型号。只要避免在远距离至极远距离开火，它应该会很有用。

column1: If you see this Hatchetman heading towards you, you better brace for impact and hope you are wearing your brown shorts.
column2: 如果你看到这台 Hatchetman 朝你冲来，最好做好承受撞击的准备，并祈祷自己穿了棕色裤子。

column1: If you see this thing coming at you, Boss, and you are not in a fully armored Assault Mech with lots of fast targetting weapons...run. Disengage. Withdraw. Flee. Whatever you can do, do it to get away from this monster.
column2: 老板，如果你看到这东西朝你冲来，而自己不在一台全装甲突击机甲里、手上也没有大量快速瞄准武器……快跑。脱离接触，撤退，逃走。想尽办法远离这个怪物。

column1: If you want to move a lot of ammo this is great. It's a big truck, Boss.
column2: 如果你想运输大量弹药，这辆车非常合适。老板，它就是一辆大卡车。

column1: Impaler 是 James“Amalor Myrnnyx”Degenhardt 为取代失踪的 UrbanMech“Crossfire”而定制打造的机甲。它于 3085 年随 Melody's Rockers 首次亮相，是一台 50 吨机甲，采用 350 级 XL 引擎，速度可达 119 千米/时，设计侧重高速。它配备隐形装甲、守护者 ECM，底盘部分参考 Mad Cat Mk II Enhanced，因此难以追踪，更难命中。Impaler 装有双长枪和氏族技术，在战场上带来中世纪般的威胁，同时避免了混合来源改装常见的平衡问题。
column2: Impaler 是 James“Amalor Myrnnyx”Degenhardt 为取代失踪的 UrbanMech“Crossfire”而定制打造的机甲。它于 3085 年随 Melody 乐队首次亮相，是一台 50 吨机甲，采用 350 级 XL 引擎，速度可达 119 千米/小时，设计重点在于高速。它配备隐形装甲和守护者 ECM，底盘部分参考增强型 Mad Cat Mk II，因此难以追踪，更难命中。Impaler 装有双枪骑兵长枪和氏族技术，在战场上带来中世纪般的威胁，同时避免了混合来源改装常见的平衡问题。

column1: Improved Jumpjets and a Booster Pack make this Jenner Variant a Formidable Foe, being able to Jump and Run wherever it wants. The ReEngineered Lasers also do Quite a lot of Work, together with the Punch of the MRM10 its a Fearsome Armament. 14 Double Heatsinks and Cooling Jackets in the Arms also make it Cooler than Usually. A Very nice Piece of Tech, Boss.
column2: 改进型跳跃喷射器和助推包让这款 Jenner 变体成为可怕的敌人，能够随心所欲地跳跃和奔跑。重构激光器也相当卖力，再加上 MRM-10 的拳头般打击，武器非常凶猛。14 个双重散热器和安装在手臂中的冷却套让它比通常型号凉爽得多。Boss，这是一件非常漂亮的技术。

column1: In 3075, in the midst of the Jihad, designers refitted the Sloth by removing the pop-up mine and small lasers in place of an ECM suite and a pair of ER Small Lasers. This system disrupted Word of Blake forces very effectively.
column2: 3075 年圣战期间，设计师拆除 Sloth 的弹出式地雷和小型激光器，换装 ECM 套件与两门增程小型激光器。这套系统非常有效地干扰了 Blake 之言部队。

column1: In a bid to join the Arms Race of Inner Sphere OmniMech Designs have Hellespont reacted with an attempt to upgrade their most iconic salespiece, The UrbanMech. Dubbed the 'Mobile Turret' does it do what every 'Urbie' ever did, sadly the upgraded cost and expertise required for Maintenance, left it mostly unsold.
column2: 为了加入内天体全能机甲的军备竞赛，Hellespont 试图升级其最著名的畅销品 UrbanMech。这台被称为“移动炮塔”的机甲，确实完成了每一台 Urbie 都会做的事；可惜升级后的成本和维护所需专业技术太高，导致它几乎卖不出去。

column2: 为了加入内圈全向机甲设计的军备竞赛，赫勒斯庞特试图升级其最具标志性的产品：城市机甲。这款机甲被称为“移动炮塔”，依旧在做每一台“垃圾桶”曾经做过的事。可惜，维护所需的高昂成本和专业技术让它几乎无人问津。

column1: In an attempt to marry OmniTechnology to a Advanced Stealthed Land Air Mech have Shengli Arm's created the 'Berkut' based on recovered Shadowhawk LAM designs. Only being able to mount a limited amount of Slots was the Design still considered a success.

column1: In an effort to revive sales in the late 3130s, OstCorp's subsidiaries introduced an advanced—and considerably more expensive—update to the Ostrichmech line. Drawing inspiration from the OST-R2 rather than the original OST-R, the newly released OST-RS incorporates the same sophisticated internal structure and compact subsystems, as well as Ferro-Fibrous armor. Marketed as an ultralight skirmisher, the OST-RS is beginning to find traction among smaller forces seeking fast, budget-conscious combat units. Though it sacrifices some of the OST-R2's speed, it retains respectable mobility and improves firepower with twin MML-3 launchers. Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: 为了在 3130 年代末重振销量，OstCorp 旗下子公司推出了 Ostrichmech 系列的先进升级型，成本也高出不少。新推出的 OST-RS 借鉴了 OST-R2，而非最初的 OST-R，并采用同样先进的内部结构与紧凑子系统，以及铁磁纤维装甲。它被宣传为超轻型游击机甲，正逐渐受到规模较小、寻求快速且经济实惠战斗单位的部队青睐。OST-RS 牺牲了部分 OST-R2 的速度，但仍保有不错的机动性，并以双联 MML-3 发射器增强火力。 特性：窄小/低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.99 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: In common with several lighter clan combat units this Jenner carries an impressive loadout of machine guns. The pair of heavy medium lasers are quite capable of punching a hole in armor that you can pour bullets into.
column2: 与其他轻型氏族战斗部队一样，詹纳号也装备了大量机枪。这对重型中型激光器非常有能力在装甲上打出一个洞，你可以将子弹倒入其中。

column1: In its primary configuration the Summoner has a basic yet effective arsenal. The primary direct fire weapons are four ER PPC backed up by a Rotary AC/10. For fire support and bombardment, the Summoner also has an Arrow IV launcher.

column1: In the late 3060s, under Khan James Cobb's command, Clan Hell's Horses began preparation for a renewed presence in the Inner Sphere. The scientist caste saw this as an opportunity to create a new cavalry vehicle, which they called the Bellona. Designed as a striker and flanker, the Bellona carries enough firepower on a nimble enough frame to keep up with even the fastest-advancing lines. The original specs called for tracks, but test pilots for the vehicle cited that 'speed is armor', which led to the Bellona being redesigned as a hovertank. Biome Restrictions: None. column1: In the late hours of the Amaris Civil War, there were rumors of an advanced stealth mech head hunter equipped with four gauss rifles. Now if this is true or just an urban legend, I couldn't tell you Boss. What I can tell you is that someone tried to impersonate this legend with a Nightstar. 4 Light Gauss rifles make this a very capable direct fire Long Range Mech. An AMS makes it survivable against Long Range Missiles. Where they got the Clan-XL Engine from though, that's a mystery - Hell, it even has a full SLDF-spec Warfare Suite. This 'Mech is filled with a solid mix of IS and Clan technology to make an actual nightmare. Don't ask me about the name of this Mech we've started calling "Number 3". It's got 13 threes in its 17-digit serial number and the number '3' carved into the emergency ejection button.
column2: 阿马里斯内战末期，曾有传言称一台装备四具高斯步枪的先进隐形猎头机甲横空出世。究竟是真事还是都市传说，我可说不准，老大。但有人试图用一台 Nightstar 冒充这个传说。四具轻型高斯步枪让它成为极具实力的直射远程机甲；AMS 使它能在远程导弹下生存。至于他们从哪弄来氏族 XL 引擎，仍是个谜——见鬼，它甚至配备完整的 SLDF 规格战争套件。这台机甲混合了扎实的内圈与氏族技术，确实像一场噩梦。别问我它的名字，我们已经开始叫它“3 号”：它 17 位序列号中有 13 个数字 3，紧急弹射按钮上也刻着数字“3”。

column2: 熊（Kuma 在日语中意为“熊”）旨在象征内天体圈与氏族的团结，是幽灵熊自治领一款速度极快但武装较轻的重型骑兵战斗机甲。有些人轻蔑地称其为“充电器 IIC”，但在圣战后的自治领军团中，这款专业化的熊是轻型星群的重心。它采用 Endo-Steel 机架，由庞大的 360 XL 融合引擎驱动，并配备大量改进型跳跃喷射器，是有史以来机动性最高的重型机甲之一：地面速度与中型凤凰鹰相当，跳跃距离则可媲美轻型蜘蛛。机体覆有十吨半标准装甲，十一台双散热器勉强应付其武器和跳跃喷射器产生的热量。

column1: Intended as a symbol of Inner Sphere/Clan unity, the Kuma (Japanese for "Bear") is a fast if lightly armed 鬼熊 Dominion heavy cavalry BattleMech. While derisively referred to by some as the Charger IIC, the specialist Kuma was a heavy cornerstone to light Stars in the post-Jihad Dominion touman. Built on an Endo Steel frame, powered by an enormous 360 XL fusion engine and equipped with a large number of 改进型跳跃推进器, the Kuma is one of the most mobile heavy 'Mechs ever built, with a ground speed equal to the medium-weight 凤鹰 and a jump distance as high as the light-weight Spider. Clad in ten and half tons of standard armor, eleven 双散热器 are barely able to cope with the design's weaponry and jump jets.

column1: Intended for long range combat, the Templar A is configured to engage an enemy at long ranges. column1: Introduced by Clan Ghost Bear, the Constable Pacification Suit was designed to help the Ghost Bear Dominion maintain order among its Inner Sphere-born citizenry. The Ghost Bear Watch originally developed it to help them against a Rasalhagian terrorist group known as the Motstånd. The suit's array of weapons and equipment options allowed the Watch to handle the terrorists while not exposing their civilian population to harm with a fully militarized police force. The suit's first usage was mishandled by the Ghost Bear Watch. The suit's sale to civilian police and other organizations allowed the Watch to be able develop less military tactics. The suit has since been spread to other Clans and the Draconis Combine's paramilitary organizations such as the Internal Security Force and the Civilian Guidance Corps.
column2: 治安官镇压服由幽灵熊氏族推出，旨在帮助幽灵熊自治领维持内天体出生公民的秩序。幽灵熊守望队最初研发它，是为了对付一个名为 Motstånd 的拉萨哈格恐怖组织。装甲的武器和设备选项丰富，使守望队能够处理恐怖分子，同时避免动用全面军事化的警察力量伤害平民。守望队第一次使用该装甲时处理不当。后来将它出售给民用警察及其他组织，让守望队得以发展更少军事化的战术。如今它已经传播到其他氏族，以及龙辰联邦的内务安全部队和民事指导队等准军事组织。

column1: Introduced during the Jihad, this is a modernization of the 'Mech utilizing newer technologies. The WoB engineers first exchanged the 02 variant's fusion engine with a Light Fusion model. Powered by a 280-rated XL引擎, the Cicada 3X is armed with a pair of 中型X脉冲激光 Lasers and a pair of MML-7’s. Stealth 装甲 and 守护者ECM round out the variant. 特性：改进型传感器 部署成本倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 蝉式于2740年问世，是为与蟑螂竞争而开发的40吨机甲。它的武器略强却同样迅速，更厚的装甲和优秀的近战能力使其成为高效的轻型机甲猎手与侦察机。蝉式3X由一具280级XL引擎驱动，装备两门中型X脉冲激光器和两具MML-7。隐形装甲与守护者ECM完善了这一配置。 特性：改进型传感器 部署成本倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

A 320-rated XL Engine powers the Viper and 8 Jump Jets are hardwired into the chassis, further improving the mobility. The Viper F is armed with 8 HMG’s and a trio of ER Medium Lasers. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Long Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

column1: Introduced in 3054, the Cavalry Attack Helicopter was one of a number of VTOLs developed to fight the Clans by Michaelson Heavy Industries. Suited to hit-and-run engagements rather than front-line combat situations the Cavalry gained a reputation for flawless service when used correctly. It has since seen service in former FedCom States and minor-nobles among the Chaos March. While capable of speeds up to 162 km/h, the Cavalry doesn't rely on this alone for protection and has 3.5 tons armor. The craft can handle a direct hit from a Clan-tech ER PPC on the nose and keep flying. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 10/15 hexes / 300/450 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 100 15 Left 90 15 Right 90 15 Rear 65 15 Total 360 75 Quirk: Narrow/Low Profile Can carry 1 Battle Armor Squads.
column2: Cavalry 攻击直升机于 3054 年推出，是 Michaelson Heavy Industries 为对抗氏族而开发的多种 VTOL 之一。它适合执行袭扰战而非前线正面作战，正确使用时以近乎无瑕的服役表现赢得声誉。此后它在前联邦共同体各州以及混沌边疆的若干小贵族势力中服役。Cavalry 最高速度可达 162 km/h，但并不只依靠速度防护，机身还配备 3.5 吨装甲。这架飞行器甚至能承受氏族技术增程 PPC 直接命中机鼻后继续飞行。 生物群系限制：该单位无法部署于月球生物群系。 移动：10/15 格 / 300/450 米。 装甲： Armor 结构： Structure 数值 A S 前部 100 15 左侧 90 15 右侧 90 15 后部 65 15 总计 360 75 特质： 窄体/低矮轮廓 可搭载 1 个战斗装甲小队。

column1: Introduced in 3093, this variant is geared towards Clan-oriented commands. This advanced tech version of the Mongrel drops the AC/5 in favor of a ProtoMech AC/8 with 10 rounds of ammunition. In addition to a larger bore autocannon, the Mongrel is also fitted with a Guardian ECM suite and actuator enhancement system to give its retractable blade better odds in hitting its intended target.
column2: 该变体于 3093 年推出，面向以氏族部队为主的指挥体系。这款先进技术版 Mongrel 拆除 AC/5，换成配备十发弹药的原型机甲 AC/8。除口径更大的自动炮外，Mongrel 还装有守护者 ECM 系统和致动器增强系统，让伸缩刀更有把握命中目标。

column1: Introduced into service in 3123, the Taranis is a Heavy Class battle armor first created for the Armed Forces of the Republic of the Sphere. Built on Terra, the heavyweight suit was designed to work closely with the RAF's Combined Arms formations, bringing its considerable toughness and firepower to bear. The battle armor is used in a range of roles from close combat to providing defense against incoming enemies.
column2: Taranis 于 3123 年投入服役，是最初为球体共和国武装部队制造的重型战斗装甲。它在泰拉建造，旨在与 RAF 联合兵种编队密切协同，发挥自身出色的坚韧性和火力。该战斗装甲可执行多种任务，从近战到抵御来袭敌人。

column1: Introduced into service in 3123, the Taranis is a Heavy Class battle armor first created for the Armed Forces of the 球体共和国. column1: Introduced to service in 3133 from the Achernar BattleMechs plant on New Avalon, the Vulpes was intended from the outset to be a heavy but fast attack BattleMech, and was quickly adopted by the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns.
column2: Vulpes 于 3133 年在 New Avalon 的 Achernar BattleMechs 工厂投入服役。它从一开始就被设计成厚重但高速的攻击型 BattleMech，并迅速被联邦太阳军队采用。

column1: Introducing the Quicsell Locust – Unmatched Agility, Unrivaled Firepower! With a specially lightened structure for supreme agility, this variant carries two sets of Quicsell's pulse lasers and two heavy small chemical lasers for high stopping power. Topping it off is Quicsell's ViewMaster cockpit for the best view of the battle. The Quicsell Locust: Where agility meets firepower in style! Quirk: Quicksell Clan Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 隆重推出 Quicsell Locust——无与伦比的灵活性，势不可挡的火力！该型号采用特别轻量化结构，机动性卓越；携带两组 Quicsell 脉冲激光和两门重型小型化学激光，拥有强大制止力。最后还配备 Quicsell ViewMaster 驾驶舱，提供绝佳战场视野。Quicsell Locust：将灵活性与火力完美结合，风格十足！ 特质：Quicsell 氏族机甲 部署费用倍率：0.95 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: Introducing the Quicsell Nova S – Precision Unleashed! This Mech refines the game with heavy large chem lasers for accuracy and upgraded actuators. Dialing down the laser count to two, it retains the same 'heat management feature' as its heavy medium chem laser counterpart. Quicsell presents a Mech that dances on the edge of precision and heat, ensuring each shot hits the mark. The Nova S: where accuracy meets controlled firepower. Quirk: Quicksell Clan Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 隆重推出 Quicsell Nova S——释放精准火力！这台机甲通过重型大型化学激光和升级驱动器提升精度。激光数量降至两门，但仍保留与重型中型化学激光型号相同的‘热量管理功能’。Quicsell 带来一台游走于精准与热量边缘的机甲，确保每发都命中目标。Nova S：精准与可控火力的结合。 特质：Quicsell 氏族机甲 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1: Introducing the Quicsell Piranha – Unleash the Bullet Tsunami! Get ready for a wild ride with 12MGs that each somehow spit out an extra round – because why settle for standard when you can have more? Our state-of-the-art extralight structure ensures unmatched agility, and, oh yeah, it's definitely not prone to jamming. The Piranha: where firepower meets finesse. Own the battlefield, Quicsell style! Quirk: Quicksell Clan Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.95
column2: 隆重推出 Quicsell Piranha——释放子弹海啸！准备好迎接疯狂体验：12 挺机枪，每挺不知为何都能多射出一发子弹——为什么满足于标准配置，既然还能更多？我们先进的额外轻型结构确保无与伦比的灵活性，而且，哦，对了，它绝对不会卡壳。Piranha：火力与技巧的完美结合。以 Quicsell 风格称霸战场！ 特质：Quicsell 氏族机甲 部署费用倍率：0.95

column1: Ion Raptor 是 Vining Engineering and Salvage Team 最奇特的造物之一，是一系列利用氏族前线回收部件手工打造的机甲。它于 3053 年首次亮相，最初的 Ion Raptor 由 Masakari 和 Crab 的残骸拼装而成。Ion Raptor 5R 与 Sea Fox 商人合作设计，回归了 VEST 的本源。每台 5R 都按订单手工制造，主要供特定的 Solaris 马厩使用。它为竞技场和战场作战而设计，远程配备两门增程大型激光器；四门 IHML 则能出其不意地打击靠近的敌人。四具连发 LRM-5 为增程激光器提供支援，必要时也能攻击近距离目标。
column2: 离子猛禽是维宁工程与回收团队颇为独特的作品之一，是利用氏族前线回收部件手工打造的机甲系列。原型于 3053 年首次亮相，由 Masakari 和 Crab 的残骸拼装而成。Ion Raptor 5R 与海狐商人合作设计，回归了 VEST 的本源。每台 5R 都按订单手工制造，主要供特定的索拉里斯马厩使用。它为竞技场和战场作战而设计，远程配备两门增程大型激光器；四门改进型重型中型激光器则能出其不意地打击靠近的敌人。四具连发 LRM-5 为增程激光器提供支援，必要时也能攻击近距离目标。

column1: Irian’s attempt to make up for the shortcomings of the 5M, the 6M introduced in 3062 drops the SRMs and Narc entirely, upgrades the LRMs to 15-tube racks with integral Artemis IV FCS and three tons of reloads each, and upgrades the lasers to ER versions, mounting a fifth medium. Most importantly, the LRM magazines are now protected with CASE. Quirk: Combat Computer Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Irian 为弥补 5M 的不足，于 3062 年推出 6M。它拆除 SRM 和 NARC，将 LRM 升级为配有内置 Artemis IV 火控系统的 15 联装发射器，每具各配三吨弹药；激光器也升级为增程型号，并增加第五门中型激光。最重要的是，LRM 弹药舱现在由 CASE 保护。 特质：战斗计算机 部署费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: Is that Bean!? From "Locust-1VBean"?! Commander, I watch th— I, uh, I mean. I used to watch that show all the time as a kid! Everybody loves Bean!
column2: 那是Bean吗！？来自“Locust-1VBean”的Bean！？指挥官，我看过——呃，我是说，我小时候经常看那个节目！人人都喜欢Bean！

column1: It carries two Streak SRM-4 launchers in the legs, while each arm carries a Light PPC and MML-7. The 'Mech's top speed was reduced, so engineers fitted Improved Jump Jets to compensate.
column2: 该机甲双腿各携带一具 Streak SRM-4 发射器，双臂则各装一门轻型 PPC 和一具 MML-7。由于最高速度降低，工程师安装改进型跳跃喷射器作为补偿。

column1: It carries two 锁定式SRM-4 launchers in the legs, while each arm carries a Light PPC and MML-7. The 'Mech's top speed was reduced, so engineers fitted 改进型跳跃推进器 to compensate.
column2: 双腿各装有一具锁定式 SRM-4，双臂各有轻型 PPC 和 MML-7。机甲最高速度降低，因此工程师安装改进型跳跃喷射器进行补偿。

column1: It has some interesting tech, but mostly it is a stock Penetrator. Not sure how useful it would be for us, maybe just strip the clan tech and sell the chassis?
column2: 它有一些有趣的技术，但总体上仍是标准 Penetrator。我们不确定它对我们有多大用处，也许拆掉氏族技术、卖掉底盘更合适？

column1: It heats up real good sir, too bad this one doesn't have the sentience of the others.
column2: 先生，这东西热得厉害，可惜它没有其他型号那样的自我意识。

column1: It is uncertain who first built this heavily customized Quickdraw, very little remains of the original -8K it was based on. However, it is said the name of Death Incarnate is double edged. According to the rumours often heard in the mess ha...
column2: 没人能确定这台高度改装的快速射手最初由谁制造；它几乎已看不出原始-8K型的痕迹。不过，据说“死亡化身”这个名字暗藏双重含义，酒吧里流传的传闻也为它增添了神秘色彩。

column1: It is uncertain who first built this heavily customized Quickdraw, very little remains of the original -8K it was based on. However, it is said the name of Death Incarnate is double edged. According to the rumours often heard in the mess hall late at night, whoever rides the 'Mech into battle always ended up dead under seemingly natural causes, but only after killing a great number of foes. It is most likely just the typical drunk MechWarrior tales, but some might still refuse to pilot it.
column2: 没人确定这台高度定制的 Quickdraw 最初由谁打造，作为基础的 -8K 几乎已被完全改造。不过据说‘死神化身’这个名字意味深长。根据深夜餐厅里经常流传的传闻，任何驾驶这台机甲上战场的人最终都会以看似自然的原因死去，但在此之前总能杀死大量敌人。多半只是醉酒机甲战士的胡话，但仍有人拒绝驾驶它。

column1: It is uncertain who first built this heavily customized Quickdraw, very little remains of the original -8K it was based on. However, it is said the name of Death Incarnate is double edged. According to the rumours often heard in the mess hall late at night, whoever rides the '机甲 into battle always ended up dead under seemingly natural causes, but only after killing a great number of foes. It is most likely just the typical drunk 机甲Warrior tales, but some might still refuse to pilot it.
column2: 这台经过大幅定制的快枪手最初由谁制造，已经无从考证；如今它与原型-8K几乎没有相似之处。不过，据说“死神化身”这个名字有双重含义。食堂里深夜常有传闻称，驾驶这台机甲出战的人总会在杀死大量敌人后，死于看似自然的原因。多半只是醉酒机甲战士的夸张故事，但仍有人不愿驾驶它。

column1: It looks like an oversized Wolverine kitted out with whatever random things they had been unable to sell. It has mediocre weapons, mediocre gear and mediocre mobility. I am not really sure why this was created in the first place. Maybe it was just straight to sale 'Mech to clear overstock of components?
column2: 看起来像一台超大号 Wolverine，装满了他们卖不出去的各种杂物。它的武器、设备和机动性都很平庸。我真不明白当初为什么要造这东西。也许只是为了清理积压部件，直接拿来销售的机甲？

column1: It seems the Underwater Maneuvering Units have been removed and the torpedo tubes replaced with missile launchers, otherwise this is standard Crossbow U configuration.
column2: 水下机动单元似乎已被拆除，鱼雷管也被导弹发射器替换；除此之外，这仍是标准的 Crossbow U 配置。

column1: It's a Quickdraw, whoever stole the parts for it wasnt all to stupid though, giving it Improved Jump Jets and a Jump pack turning it into a oversized Mudstomper.
column2: 这是一台 Quickdraw。偷来零件的人至少不算太蠢，给它装上改进型跳跃喷射器和跳跃背包，把它改成了放大版的 Mudstomper。

column1: It's a Quickdraw, whoever stole the parts for it wasnt all to stupid though, giving it 改进的 Jump Jets and a Jump pack turning it into a oversized Mudstomper.
column2: 这是一台Quickdraw。偷零件的人虽然不算聪明，却给它装上了改进型跳跃喷射器和跳跃背包，把它变成了巨大的Mudstomper。

column1: It's a decent 'Mech, and the Guardian ECM can be useful on the battlefield. But it would have been nice to have better sensors too, so it could be used as a scout.
column2: 这是一台不错的机甲，守护者 ECM 在战场上很有用。不过如果它的传感器也能更好一些，就可以胜任侦察任务了。

column1: It's a decent 'Mech, but it does suffer from not using more recent technological breakthroughs. Still, there are a lot worse ones out there.
column2: 这是一台还算不错的机甲，但没有采用较新的技术突破，确实有所欠缺。不过，外面还有很多更差的机甲。

column1: It's a decent '机甲, and the 守护者ECM can be useful on the battlefield. But it would have been nice to have better sensors too, so it could be used as a scout.
column2: 这是一台还算不错的机甲，守护者ECM在战场上很有用。不过，如果传感器也能更好一些就好了，那样它就能真正承担侦察任务。

column1: It's a decent '机甲, but it does suffer from not using more recent technological breakthroughs. Still, there are a lot worse ones out there.
column2: 这是一台还算不错的机甲，但它没有采用较新的技术突破，性能因此受到限制。不过，外面还有很多更糟的型号。

column1: It's a pretty standard MRM mech. A bit faster than normal for a heavy mech, but not too far out of the bounds of normal. On the one hand, you've got to keep an eye out for that XL vulnerability, since I can't replace the engine. On the other hand, if I need to fix the damn thing again, at least it won't hurt the pocket books as much as installing a new one from scratch.
column2: 这是一台相当标准的 MRM 机甲。对于重型机甲来说它比通常型号稍快，但仍在合理范围内。一方面，你得留意 XL 引擎的脆弱性，因为我没法替换引擎；另一方面，如果我又得修这该死的东西，至少不会像从零安装新引擎那样掏空钱包。

column1: It's a pretty standard MRM mech. A bit faster than normal for a heavy mech, but not too far out of the bounds of normal. On the one hand, you've got to keep an eye out for that XL vulnerability, since I can't replace the 引擎. On the other hand, if I need to fix the damn thing again, at least it won't hurt the pocket books as much as installing a new one from scratch.
column2: 一台相当标准的MRM机甲。它比普通重型机甲稍快，但没有快到脱离常规。首先，你得留意XL引擎的脆弱性，因为我没法更换引擎。另一方面，如果我又得修理这破玩意儿，至少不会像从零安装一台新引擎那样烧钱。

column1: It's a straight upgrade of the brawler HBK-4H. It hits harder and runs cold unless you jump and alpha strike. It's as armored as it can be and even has CASE II.
column2: 这是格斗型 HBK-4H 的直接升级版，火力更强；只要不跳跃后全弹齐射，散热表现就很轻松。它的装甲已经堆到极限，甚至还配有 CASE II。

column1: It's a straight upgrade of the brawler HBK-4H. It hits harder and runs cold unless you jump and alpha strike. It's as 装甲ed as it can be and even has CASE II.
column2: 这是格斗型HBK-4H的直接升级版。它打击更重，只要不跳跃并全弹齐射，就能保持低温。装甲已达到极限，甚至配备CASE II。

column1: It's a tank, Boss, they all look the same to me. Except this one has a gutted Raven and two scavenged Air-to-Ground ArrowIV launchers welded to it. I guess they don't all look the same
column2: 老大，这就是一辆坦克；在我看来它们都长一个样。不过这辆车被拆空了一台乌鸦，并焊上了两具捡来的空对地 Arrow IV 发射器。看来它们也不全一样。

column1: It's a tank, Boss, they all look the same to me. This one is pretty big though.
column2: 老大，这就是一辆坦克，在我看来它们都一个样。不过这辆确实挺大。

column1: It's a...I...don't know? It looks like an oversized Annihilator, Boss. But look at those weapons, what is this? I will never understand the mind of these pirates.
column2: 这是一个……我……不知道？ Boss，看起来像是一个超大的歼灭者。但看看那些武器，这是什么？我永远无法理解这些海盗的心思。

column1: It's an APC boss, not much to note other than this one can swim.
column2: 这是一辆装甲输送车，老板。没什么特别值得说的，唯一亮点是它能游泳。

column1: It's hard to go wrong with a Wolverine, boss; this one ain't no different. It packs a punch at nearly all typical ranges.
column2: 驾驶 Wolverine 很难出错，Boss；这台也不例外。它几乎能在所有常见射程上造成可观伤害。

column1: It's lopsided boss. The idea was that you could carry troops and battle-armor into combat while keeping the heavily-armored side facing the enemy but all that extra armor amounts to it being over two tons heavier on the right side and throwing the steering all out of whack. What a stupid idea.
column2: 老大，这东西是歪的。原本的想法是运载部队和战斗装甲进入战场，同时让装甲最厚的一侧面对敌人；结果额外装甲让右侧比左侧重了两吨多，转向彻底失灵。真是个蠢主意。

column1: It's lopsided boss. The idea was that you could carry troops and battle-装甲 into combat while keeping the heavily-装甲ed side facing the enemy but all that extra 装甲 amounts to it being over two tons heavier on the right side and throwing the steering all out of whack. What a stupid idea.
column2: 这台机甲左右失衡，老大。设计思路是运输部队和战斗装甲时，让重装甲侧朝向敌人；但额外装甲使右侧比左侧重了两吨多，转向也完全失常。真是个愚蠢的主意。

column1: It's simple. It's pretty cheap. It's effective. VEST did something right with this export model.
column2: 很简单：便宜、直接、有效。VEST 在这款出口型号上确实做对了事情。

column1: Jack Blacks are solid, well-rounded musicians for their tonnage. They typically play guitars, which give them an extra edge by being able to play the greatest song in the world.
column2: RISC将这台King Crab作为测试台使用，从底盘开始以实验技术全面重建。

column1: Jack of all trades, master of none. It's limited to a normal fusion engine, and it's using chem lasers. Admitedly, powerful ones, but still chem lasers. Along with those mortars on the back, you're going to face a severe lack of staying power with this mech. Ten salvos, and you're out.
column2: 这台机甲样样都会，样样不精。它只能使用普通聚变引擎，而且装备化学激光。不得不承认，威力确实很强，但终究是化学激光。再加上背后的那些迫击炮，你很快就会发现它续航严重不足。齐射十次就没弹药了。

column1: Jack of all trades, master of none. It's limited to a normal fusion 引擎, and it's using chem lasers. Admitedly, powerful ones, but still chem lasers. Along with those mortars on the back, you're going to face a severe lack of staying power with this mech. Ten salvos, and you're out.
column2: 万金油，什么都能做，却没有一项精通。它只能使用普通融合引擎，而且采用化学激光。不得不承认，化学激光威力很强，但终究还是化学激光。再加上背部的迫击炮，这台机甲的持续作战能力会严重不足。十轮齐射后，你就弹尽粮绝了。

column1: James’ Crossfire UrbanMech defies expectations by emphasizing surprise in combat. While opponents see UrbanMechs as slow and weak, the Crossfire reaches speeds up to 97 kph and can jump 180 meters, tripling typical mobility. Powered by a 180 XL engine and extra jump jets, it uses lightweight Ferro Fibrous armor and double heat sinks to support its weapons. Its armament includes four medium lasers, paired SRM-2 launchers with ammo, and a small laser. This simple, reliable loadout has defeated heavier foes, benefiting from low costs and easy replacement parts, ideal for the mobile Rockers. Quirk: 360° Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: James 的 Crossfire UrbanMech 通过强调战斗中的突袭，打破了人们的预期。对手眼中的 UrbanMech 缓慢而脆弱，但 Crossfire 最高速度可达 97 kph，并能跳跃 180 米，机动性达到常规水平的三倍。它由 180 级 XL 引擎和额外跳跃喷口驱动，使用轻型铁磁纤维装甲和双重散热器支撑武器。武器包括四门中型激光、配备弹药的双联 SRM-2 发射器和一门小型激光。这套简单可靠的装载击败过更重型的敌人，低成本和易更换的零件尤其适合机动 Rockers。 特质：360° 躯干扭转 部署费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 许可使用。

column1: Jeez. Never get tired of seeing these things. This Atlas packed a serious punch for its time period, I can tell you that much. Lacking on the range a bit, but with the supercharger I'm not so sure it was ever intended to sit on the back lines.
column2: 天啊。永远不会厌倦看到这些东西。我可以告诉你，这本阿特拉斯在当时的时代具有巨大的冲击力。续航里程有点不足，但有了增压器，我不太确定它是否打算坐在后线上。

column1: Joint Equipment System’s first vehicle since the Clan Invasion overtook its main plant on Alshain. The JES I is a close-in fighting vehicle for primary escort and defense. The vehicle is considered by many to be underpowered with its 15-rating fusion engine and underarmored for its size. The vehicle’s glaring flaws were due to JES’s lack of capital to fund better equipment. However, the vehicle proved to be popular among Periphery nations and so the vehicle’s production continued well into the 3130s Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. column1: Jointly developed by the Federated Commonwealth and the Draconis Combine, the 85 ton Gunslinger entered production in 3053. Powered by a 255-rated XL Engine, the customised Gunslinger 1ERD-Jared is armed with a pair of LRM-15’s. 4 Medium Lasers, a pair of Streak SRM-4’s and a Small Laser add additional firepower at close ranges. A Guardian ECM Suite and a Beagle Active Probe enhance the Mechs capabilities.
column2: Gunslinger 由联邦共和体与龙蛇联合王国共同开发，85 吨的它于 3053 年投产。定制型 Gunslinger 1ERD-Jared 由 255 级 XL 引擎驱动，装备一对 LRM-15；四门中型激光、一对 Streak SRM-4 和一门小型激光提供额外近距离火力。Guardian ECM 套件和 Beagle 主动探测器进一步提升机甲能力。

Powered by a 255-rated XL Engine, the customised Gunslinger 1ERD-Jared is armed with a pair of LRM-15’s. 4 Medium Lasers, a pair of Streak SRM-4’s and a Small Laser add additional firepower at close ranges. column2: 联邦—康联与龙马联合开发的 85 吨 Gunslinger 于 3053 年投入生产。定制型 Gunslinger 1ERD-Jared 由 255 级 XL 引擎驱动，配备两具 LRM-15。四门中型激光、两具连射短程导弹/4 和一门小型激光补充了近距离火力。Guardian ECM 套件和 Beagle 主动探测器增强了这台机甲的能力。 特性：护颈装甲 部署成本倍率：1.17 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: Judging by its aesthetics and nomenclature, the fifteen-ton Cherub OmniMech is meant to invoke the terrifying spirit and flexibility of the Word of Blake’s Celestial OmniMech series. Unlike the other units in this list, the Cherub is not a robotic unit but a proper—if unusually small—BattleMech intended for use by human MechWarriors. With a top running speed approaching 120 kilometers per hour and protected by about as much armor as its frame can handle, this OmniMech leaves only twenty percent of its tonnage open for weaponry. To make even this much room possible, however, the improved C3 package, a mainstay on the original Celestial Omnis, is absent here. Curiously, two of the three known variants attempt to work around this by mounting battle-armor grade weapons, backed up by packs of single-use rocket launchers.
column2: 从外观与命名看，15 吨 Cherub OmniMech 意在唤起 Blake 圣言 Celestial OmniMech 系列令人恐惧的精神与灵活性。与列表中其他单位不同，Cherub 不是机器人，而是真正的（虽然异常小型）战斗机甲，供人类机甲战士驾驶。最高速度接近 120 km/h，装甲几乎达到机体承载上限，因此仅有 20% 吨位用于武器。为了腾出这点空间，原始 Celestial OmniMech 的核心改进型 C3 套件被取消。奇怪的是，已知三种型号中有两种试图通过安装战斗装甲级武器来弥补，另配一次性火箭发射器包。

column1: Just an 8K with a C3 instead of a Flamer, nothing else different about it. Still is a good 'Mech for many smaller mercenary companies though.
column2: 只是把 8K 的喷火器换成了 C3，没有其他区别。不过对许多小型佣兵公司来说，它仍是一台不错的机甲。

column1: Just an 8K with a C3 instead of a Flamer, nothing else different about it. Still is a good '机甲 for many smaller mercenary companies though.
column2: 这只是一台用C3替换喷火器的8K，其他方面没有变化。不过对于许多小型佣兵公司来说，它仍是一台优秀机甲。

column1: Kallon's latest Penetrator is an iterative development. Because of the increasing proliferation of reflective armor, older Penetrators struggled to deliver effective firepower. Kallon’s Tonkya complex on Wernke found an easy solution by leveraging the Federated Suns' experience with re-engineered lasers, mounting two Large ones as the main armament. Six Medium Lasers are kept as secondary, short range firepower, and a Laser AMS provides some defensive capabilities. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.11 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Kallon 的最新 Penetrator 是一个迭代开发。由于反光装甲的日益普及，老式穿甲弹很难提供有效的火力。卡隆位于韦恩克的 Tonkya 综合体找到了一个简单的解决方案，利用联邦太阳队在重新设计激光器方面的经验，安装两架大型激光器作为主要武器。六台中型激光器被保留作为次要的近程火力，而激光 AMS 则提供一些防御能力。 怪异：稳定 成本乘数： 1.11 手臂执行器限制：左下、右下

column1: Know who the most dangerous person in the world is? An Engineer, given a blank check to do whatever they want. Kim Aakawa, a relative to the Director of the Tonegawa Major shipyard, was scouted for such a project. The result? A bulked up DevastatUrb: the Urbiestator, a 200t mad dream of Urbies come to life. The shipyard has a constant demand for the Urbiestator from all over the Periphery, with each of the few handcrafted units produced each year being handed off in pompous ceremonies to the lucky recipients.
column2: 你知道世上最危险的人是谁吗？是一个拿到空白支票、可以随心所欲的工程师。金·赤川是户根川大型船厂厂长的亲属，正是这类项目把他招募了过去。结果呢？一台强化版的毁灭城市机甲：城市毁灭者，一场由城市机甲组成的 200 吨疯狂梦想成真。来自边疆各处的船厂对城市毁灭者需求不断，每年只生产寥寥几台手工打造的机体，并在盛大而傲慢的仪式上交给幸运的接收者。

column1: Known and revered across the Inner Sphere and beyond, the Warhammer is the pre-eminent heavy Mech. Debuting in 2515, the 70-ton Mech is a solid blend of firepower and mobility designed to outfight almost any opponent. Powered by a 280-rated 轻型引擎, the Warhammer WHM-9K is armed with a pair of Heavy PPCs. An MML-9 deters opponents from closing in. CASE II rounds out the design.
column2: 战锤在内层圈及更远地区都声名显赫，是最杰出的重型机甲。70 吨的它于 2515 年首次亮相，是火力与机动性的坚实结合，旨在击败几乎任何对手。战锤 WHM-9K 由额定 280 的聚变引擎驱动，装备一对重型 PPC；MML-9 可阻止敌人接近，CASE II 则完善了整体设计。

column1: Known and revered across the Inner Sphere and beyond, the Warhammer is the pre-eminent heavy 机甲. column1: Kong Interstellar built these for asteroid mining out of the Federated Commonwealth originally but they spread everywhere pretty fast. You see them all over the Periphery because the parts are cheap and they just don't quit. Not a combat machine by any stretch but those Piledrivers have a way of changing a pirate's mind real quick. Good salvage honestly.
column2: Kong Interstellar 最初为联邦国制造这些设备用于小行星采矿，但它们很快传播到各处。你在边疆到处都能看到它们，因为零件便宜，而且耐用得惊人。它无论如何都算不上战斗机器，但那些 Piledriver 能迅速改变海盗的想法。说实话，是很好的回收品。

column2: 让海盗找到一个完美的欧文斯并对其执行此操作，BAP 和 Tag 被撕掉一些 ECM 以支持其隐身能力

column1: Leonidas battle armor was a product of Etna Foundries and was intended to plug a capability gap in the armed forces of the Duchy of Oriente, a gap created by scarcity of the older Achileus stealth suit. The Leonidas suit is highly configurable, capable of being reconfigured for various battlefield missions including providing positional information, calling in artillery strikes, waging counterinsurgency warfare and conducting ambushes; the various roles are made possible through the different weapons and equipment loadouts available via the Modular Weapon Mount.
column2: Leonidas 战斗装甲由埃特纳铸造厂制造，原本用于弥补东方公国武装部队的能力缺口；这一缺口源于老式 Achileus 隐形装甲稀缺。Leonidas 高度可配置，能够针对不同战场任务重新调整，包括提供阵地信息、呼叫炮击、执行反叛乱行动和实施伏击。模块化武器挂点提供了多种武器与设备配置，使这些任务成为可能。

column1: Let me tell you about this one. It's a quad, and quads never really got respect until this design landed the SLDF contract nobody thought was possible after the Xanthos flopped two centuries back. The engineer named it after his own homeworld in the Free Worlds League, which I always thought was a nice touch. Heavy armor and real agility made up for the light weapons load in the right hands. When the civil war hit, the factory kept changing hands, and eventually its own side blew it up rather than let the Rim Worlds keep the tech.
column2: 让我来介绍一下这台。它是四足机，在这款设计拿下那份没人认为可能的SLDF合同之前，四足机一直得不到真正的尊重——而那已经是Xanthos惨败两百年后的事了。工程师以自己在自由世界联盟的故乡为它命名，我一直觉得这一点很有心。厚重装甲和真正的机动性弥补了武器配置偏轻的问题，只要交到合适的人手里。内战爆发后，工厂几经易手，最终它的阵营宁愿把工厂炸掉，也不让边疆世界保留这项技术。

column1: Lightest of the four Shattered Skies designs, and it shows the moment things get hot. Built for scouting with that Beagle probe doing the heavy lifting, not the armor. Named after an old Earth fighter jet, same as the rest of the project. Barely a few dozen were ever built before the whole line got swept up in the civil war.
column2: 这是 Shattered Skies 四种设计中最轻的一款，一旦战斗升温，缺点就会暴露出来。它依靠比格犬探测器进行侦察，装甲并不是重点。这款机甲和项目中其他设计一样，以一架古老地球战斗机命名。整条生产线在内战中被卷走前，仅造出几十台。
