Named after an old Earth fighter jet, same as the rest of the project. Barely a few dozen were ever built before the whole line got swept up in the civil war.
column2: 四种“破碎天空”设计中最轻的一款，一到高温环境就暴露出弱点。它依靠猎犬探针执行侦察，而不是依靠装甲。它与项目其他型号一样，以一架古老地球战斗机命名。在整条生产线被内战吞没前，只制造了几十台。

column1: Like many Solaris VII arena 'Mechs, the Spatha is designed as a brawler, but relies upon finesse rather than brute strength like most. A hand-tooled 360-rated XXL engine trades durability for tremendous weight savings but the Spatha only has to fear autocannon or gauss rifle fire on its fragile engine thanks to its eleven tons of advanced reflective armor and Laser AMS negating its opponents' energy and missile weaponry. The Spatha's thirteen double heat sinks are barely up the task of cooling its advanced power plant and its own energy weapons, actually an intentional choice given the Spatha is equipped with Triple Strength Myomer to boost its speed and dramatically boost the effectiveness of its sword.
column2: 与许多 Solaris VII 竞技场机甲一样，斯帕塔被设计为格斗机甲，但依赖于技巧，而不是像大多数机甲那样依靠蛮力。手工制作的 360 级 XXL 发动机以耐用性换取了巨大的重量减轻，但 Spatha 只需担心自动加农炮或高斯步枪对其脆弱的发动机开火，这要归功于其 11 吨的先进反射装甲和激光 AMS 可以抵消对手的能量和导弹武器。 Spatha 的 13 个双散热器勉强完成了冷却其先进动力装置和自身能量武器的任务，这实际上是有意的选择，因为 Spatha 配备了三重强度 Myomer 来提高其速度并显着提高其剑的效率。

column2: Spirit是最早在内圈生产的氏族机甲之一。尽管部分零件从氏族领地进口，额定245的XL引擎却是在云鹰占领区制造的。该设计还运用了其他减重技术：Spirit采用内骨骼钢结构，并装有6吨铁磁纤维装甲。Spirit本身是一台速度较快的侦察机甲，在远近距离都能自保。此外，它也适合作为训练机甲，因此未来很长时间都会留在玉鹰氏族的战团编制中。

column1: Limited to three chassis, this Banshee model was a thought experiment by 迪法恩斯工业 engineers at Kwangjong-ni. Seeking to maximize protection, these engineers installed 装甲ed Shoulder and 装甲ed Hip actuators to prevent the '机甲 from losing a limb. The 机甲Warrior is protected by an 装甲ed Cockpit. They also maximized protection by adding a ton of Modular 装甲 to each arm, leg, and forward torso. To make room for this equipment, they used an Endo Steel chassis and a Clan-spec XL引擎. For weapons, the engineers installed a 银弹高斯 Rifle and a pair of 浮夸激光s, while an ER Small Laser fills the head as an afterthought. Though not particularly quick (max speed 54 km/h) this Banshee variant can take massive amounts of damage before it falls.
column2: 这款 Banshee 仅生产了三具底盘，是 Kwangjong-ni 的迪法恩斯工业工程师进行的一项设计实验。为最大限度提升防护，工程师安装了强化肩部和髋部执行器，避免机甲失去肢体；驾驶员由强化驾驶舱保护。每条手臂、每条腿和前侧躯干都增加一吨模块化装甲。为容纳这些设备，机甲采用 Endo Steel 骨架和氏族规格 XL 引擎。武器包括一支银弹高斯步枪、一对浮夸激光，头部另装一门 ER 小型激光。虽然最高速度只有 54 公里/小时，这款 Banshee 能在倒下前承受巨量伤害。

column1: Manufactured by Ishikawajima-Harima Battle 装甲 Industries on Luthien, the Kishi battle 装甲 is a byproduct of the 设计 and testing process that 生产 the 氏族新星猫 Thunderbird series of battle 装甲 suits. As Kishi suits don't require oversized body types to operate it comfortably and can be easily maintained, it has rapidly become the primary battle 装甲 suit of the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery.
column2: Kishi战斗装甲由卢希恩的石川岛播磨战斗装甲工业制造，是设计和测试氏族新星猫Thunderbird系列战斗装甲的副产品。Kishi战斗装甲不需要超大体型即可舒适操作，也易于维护，因此迅速成为龙辰联合体常备部队的主力战斗装甲。

As Kishi suits don't require oversized body types to operate it comfortably and can be easily maintained, it has rapidly become the primary battle 装甲 suit of the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery. 怪癖: 标准部件 掉落成本乘数: 0.886 可搭载 Omni units, 可以近战, 可以群聚.

column1: Manufactured by Jalastar Aerospace from their plant on Panpour, the Gunsmith entered service shortly before the Blackout. Armed with 4 medium X-Pulses lasers,the Gunsmith quickly earned a fearsome reputation as a pursuit BattleMech and raider.
column2: Gunsmith 由 Jalastar Aerospace 在 Panpour 工厂制造，在 Blackout 前不久投入服役。它装备四门中型 X 脉冲激光，很快因追击型战斗机甲和突袭者的可怕名声而闻名。

column1: Manufactured by Jalastar Aerospace from their plant on Panpour, the Gunsmith entered service shortly before the Blackout. Armed with 4 medium X-Pulses lasers,the Gunsmith quickly earned a fearsome reputation as a pursuit Battle机甲 and raider.
column2: Gunsmith由Jalastar航空航天公司在Panpour的工厂制造，在黑幕事件前不久投入服役。装备4门中型X脉冲激光后，Gunsmith很快因作为追击型战斗机甲和突袭者的可怕名声而闻名。

column1: Manufactured in small numbers by Skobel 机甲Works from their facilities in the Russia region of Terra prior, the Omega represented the first truly viable superheavy Battle机甲 设计 to appear on the battlefield. Although the Omega was a prototype, almost thirty of the huge '机甲s were 生产 by Skobel prior to the Superheavy manufacturing wing of their Russian facility being destroyed. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.32
column2: 欧米茄由斯科贝尔机甲工厂在早期泰拉俄罗斯地区的设施少量制造，是战场上第一种真正可行的超重型战斗机甲设计。虽然欧米茄只是原型机，但在其俄罗斯设施的超重型制造部门被摧毁前，斯科贝尔仍生产了近三十台这种巨型机甲。 怪癖：扰乱 掉落成本乘数：1.32

column1: Manufactured on Emris IV by StarCorps Industries, the Carronade was designed to fill roles normally taken by two separate 'Mechs within the same lance - punching holes in the armor of enemy units, and then exploiting those holes with waves of small munitions.
column2: Carronade 由 StarCorps Industries 在 Emris IV 上制造，其设计目的是填补通常由同一支长矛中的两个独立机甲所承担的角色 - 在敌方单位的装甲上打孔，然后用小型弹药波利用这些孔。

column1: Manufactured on Emris IV by 星团工业, the Carronade was designed to fill roles normally taken by two separate 'Mechs within the same lance - punching holes in the armor of enemy units, and then exploiting those holes with waves of small munitions.
column2: 星团工业在Emris IV制造的卡隆纳德，设计用于在同一支机甲小队中承担通常由两台机甲分别执行的任务：先轰开敌方单位装甲，再用成群的小型弹药利用这些破口。

column1: Manufactured on Kwangjong-ni by Defiance, the Zeus X was both a poster child for excellence in production engineering and an innovative high-technology platform. The -X3 carried four ER 中型激光s in the right arm and an ER PPC in the left arm, connected to a 定位 Computer. The true uniqueness of the 设计 came in its use of 改进的 Jump Jets: the -X3 could jump up to 240 米, which rivaled the jumping capability of any light '机甲. This combination of heavy 装甲, speed and firepower made -the X3 the nightmare of any light or medium '机甲 and could outmaneuver any heavy or assault '机甲. The -X3 mounted seventeen double heat sinks. 怪癖: Command 机甲 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Defiance在广宗里制造了Zeus X。它既是生产工程卓越性的典范，也是创新的高科技平台。-X3右臂装有四门ER中型激光，左臂装有一门ER PPC，并连接至瞄准计算机。该型号真正独特之处在于使用改进型跳跃喷射器：-X3可跳跃至240米，媲美任何轻型机甲。重型装甲、速度和火力的结合，使-X3成为任何轻型或中型机甲的噩梦，并能机动胜过重型或突击机甲。-X3安装了十七具双联散热器。 特性：指挥机甲 部署费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧下臂，右侧下臂

column1: Many MechWarriors assigned a Rime Otter have outright demanded Sea Fox-built powerhouses like a Mad Dog Mk IV or a WarBear-designed Stormwolf instead. On the other hand, some pilots believe a warrior should work for a kill rather than simply overwhelm foes with firepower. I am one of the latter.
column2: 许多被分配驾驶 Rime Otter 的机甲战士，曾明确要求换成海狐制造的 Mad Dog Mk IV，或 WarBear 设计的 Stormwolf 之类的强机。另一方面，也有些驾驶员认为，战士应该靠自己赢得击杀，而不是单纯用火力压倒敌人。我属于后者。

column1: Marik factories continued to be the driving force behind further improvements to the Crusader. Kallon intermittently experimented with reduced speed and greater jump capacity, but ultimately consolidated the new weapons suite—mating multi-missile and Streak launchers with light PPCs—with the -5M’s movement profile to create the CRD-7M. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 马里克工厂仍然是十字军进一步改进的驱动力。 Kallon 间歇性地尝试了降低速度和提高跳跃能力，但最终将新的武器套件（将多导弹和 Streak 发射器与轻型 PPC 配合）与 -5M 的运动轮廓相结合，创造出 CRD-7M. Quirk：稳定武器 掉落成本乘数：1.09

column1: Marik factories continued to be the driving force behind further improvements to the Crusader. Kallon intermittently experimented with reduced speed and greater jump capacity, but ultimately consolidated the new weapons suite—mating multi-missile and Streak launchers with light PPCs—with the -5M’s movement profile to create the CRD-7M. 怪癖: 稳定 Weapons 掉落成本乘数: 1.09
column2: Marik 工厂继续推动 Crusader 的改进。Kallon 曾间歇性地试验降低速度、增加跳跃能力，但最终将多用途导弹与 Streak 发射器、轻型 PPC 组合成新的武器套件，并沿用 -5M 的移动特征，造就 CRD-7M。 怪癖：稳定武器s 掉落成本乘数: 1.09

column1: Meant for close in city fighting, the R60LL replaces its Autocannon 20 with an Ultra version.
column2: R60LL 专为城市近距离作战设计，将 AC/20 替换为 Ultra 版本。

column1: Meant for close in-city fighting, the R61L is upgraded with Stealth Equipment alongside its less expensive R60L cousin's AC20.
column2: R61L 专为城市近距离战斗而设计，与其较便宜的 R60L 表亲 AC20 一起升级了隐形装备。

column1: Meant for work at longer ranges than the previous variants, the main guns of the Luminos are a pair of ER PPCs. Jump jets give it the ability to maneuver to a good position to snipe from more quickly, while a Guardian ECM Suite provides added defense. In case an enemy gets close, the Archangel D can utilize four Medium Pulse Lasers, an ER Small Laser, and a Small Pulse Laser that is devastating to unarmored infantry.
column2: Luminos 的主炮是一对 ER PPC，适用于比以前的型号更远的射程。跳跃式喷气机使其能够机动到一个好的位置，以便更快地进行狙击，而守护者 ECM 套件则提供了额外的防御。如果敌人靠近，大天使 D 可以使用四个中型脉冲激光器、一个 ER 小型激光器和一个对无装甲步兵造成毁灭性打击的小型脉冲激光器。

column1: Mercenary custom refitted variant that removes the jump capabilities and uses Endo Steel and 铁纤维装甲 to free weight. As a result it mounts an impressive armament of three 锁定式SRM-4 launchers, with two ER 中型激光s as backup, as well as a 280 XL引擎. 特性：改进型生命维持系统 部署成本倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 这是佣兵定制改装型，拆除跳跃能力并采用内骨骼和铁纤维装甲以腾出重量。它因此安装三具锁定式SRM-4发射器，配备两门ER中型激光器作为备用，并采用280级XL引擎。 特性：改进型生命维持系统 部署成本倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: Mulligan 机动突击平台重 160 吨，设计目标是统治战场，在所有可想象的距离上与敌人交战。箭 IV 和两具 LRM-10 构成车辆的远程火力；六门中型激光器、一门 AC/20 和一门 UAC/5 提供近距离火力，四具 Streak SRM-2 用于消灭残敌。尽管在战场上表现成功，Mulligan 始终只进行有限生产，最终在继承战争的混乱中绝迹。 聚变：Expensive 引擎 that works in a Vacuum. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 2/3 格 / 60/90 米. 装甲: 铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 335 112 左侧 260 112 右侧 260 112 后方 210 112 炮塔 260 112 总计 1325 560 特性：主战坦克
column2: 这台160吨的穆利根机动突击平台旨在统治战场，与敌人在所有可想象的距离上交战。一具箭IV和一对LRM-10构成车辆的远程火力；六门中型激光、一门AC/20和一门UAC/5提供近距离火力，四具连射SRM-2负责消灭残敌。尽管在战场上表现出色，穆利根始终只进行有限生产，最终在继承战争的混乱中绝迹。 聚变：昂贵但可在真空中工作的引擎。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：2/3 格 / 60/90 米。 装甲: 铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前部 335 112 左侧 260 112 右侧 260 112 后部 210 112 炮塔 260 112 总计 1325 560 特性：主战坦克

column1: Named after a mythological Pirate from pre-spaceflight Terra, this one has been given extensive upgrades in every direction. A heavier Hatchet lets this refit cleave 'Mechs of the same weight class apart with ease. Stealth 装甲 makes it hard to detect while it's closing in, and the 330-rated 引擎 makes sure it doesn't take long. Five 中型激光s and a SRM6 see to it that it's also a dangerous brawler for its weight class. Fifteen 双散热器 ensure this Buccaneer won't die of heatstroke out in the sun - or of a trigger happy mech-jock.
column2: 它以太空飞行前泰拉神话中的海盗命名，并在各方面进行了大幅升级。更重型的战斧让这台改装机能够轻松劈开同重量级的战斗机甲。隐形装甲使其接近目标时难以被发现，330额定引擎则确保接近过程不会耗时太久。五门中型激光器和一具SRM6让它在同重量级中也成为危险的缠斗者。十五组双重散热器确保这台Buccaneer不会在阳光下中暑，也不会被冲动的机甲驾驶员拖垮。

column1: Named after the Vespa Genus of insects, the Vespa gunship is well equipped to sting it's opponents to death, one hit at a time. Hand made on the world of Redondo, the 15 ton Vespa has seen success across the Inner Sphere and Periphery. Produced by Vespa Inc since the 2843, the Gunship is exported at a rate of a couple of hundred a year to buyers everywhere. Powered by a 070 rated Fusion Core, the Vespa can reach speeds of 110kph and carries 3 tons of armour. A Large Laser is the Vespas only weapon. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 11/17 hexes / 330/510 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 70 10 Left 65 10 Right 65 10 Rear 50 10 Total 260 50 Quirk: Breaching Shot
column2: Vespa 武装直升机以胡蜂属昆虫命名，擅长逐次命中、最终击毙对手。15 吨的 Vespa 在 Redondo 手工制造，在内星和边境联盟均取得成功。Vespa Inc 自 2843 年起生产，每年向各地买家出口数百架。它由 070 级聚变核心驱动，速度可达 110 km/h，携带 3 吨装甲，唯一武器是一门大型激光。 生物群系限制：该单位无法部署于月球生物群系。 移动： 11/17 格 / 330/510 米。 装甲： 装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 正面 70 10 左侧 65 10 右侧 65 10 后方 50 10 总计 260 50 特性：破门射击

column1: Named after the mythological beings of power that almost rivals the Gods, the Jotunn is a Superheavy OmniMech designed by Clan Coyote. The 'Mech has seen widespread adoption amongst the Home Clans, often serving as the anchor of heavy assault Stars. A 375 XL engine serves as the powerplant, while a XL Omni helps increase the available podspace.
column2: Jotunn 以几乎能与诸神匹敌的神话巨人为名，是一台由郊狼氏族设计的超重型全能机甲。它在氏族母星广受采用，经常担任重型突击星群的核心。375 XL 引擎提供动力，XL 全能设备则进一步增加挂载舱空间。

column1: Named after the shield that was the primary means of defense for the Scottish Highlanders of Terra, the Targe is a lackluster recon and cavalry design born of compromise. To achieve enough movement speed to fullfill its role the 'Mech uses an 引擎 large enough that it uses up nearly half the 'Mech's weight. The use of 重型铁纤维装甲 装甲 maximized the five tons available for 装甲 coverage, while ten 双散热器 could easily cope with the design's heat output.
column2: 塔奇以 Terra 苏格兰高地人用于防御的盾牌命名，是一款因妥协而诞生、表现平庸的侦察与骑兵设计。为了达到任务所需的移动速度，机甲采用了占据近半重量的大型引擎。重型铁纤维装甲最大化了可用的五吨装甲覆盖，而十台双重散热器足以轻松应对设计产生的热量。

column1: Named for a legendary Terran raider, the Von Luckner was designed for the original Star League after the Reunification War. Few remain in service today. column1: Named for the symbol of the Egyptian goddess Wadjet, the Uraeus is a heavy BattleMech which first appeared during the Dark Age era in the hands of ComStar and the Republic of the Sphere. With the Malcolm Buhl-led splinter faction the Blessed Order seeking to secretly rebuild the Com Guards, in 3128 agents of the Blessed Order stole advanced Word of Blake technical data, including extensive specs on the Manei Domini's Celestial series OmniMechs, stored within a protected Republic of the Sphere data depot on Terra. Reengineering the secured schematics to develop the Uraeus BattleMech, Buhl commissioned the New Earth Trading Company - little more than a corporate front owned and operated by ComStar since the early Succession Wars - to secretly construct production lines for these new 'Mechs, hiding them among the massive volume of civilian manufacturing lines operated by NETC.
column2: 乌拉乌斯以埃及女神瓦杰特的象征命名，是一款重型战斗机甲，黑暗时代首次由 ComStar 和天球共和国投入使用。3128 年，马尔科姆·布尔领导的分裂派系“祝福教团”试图秘密重建 Com Guards；其特工从泰拉一处受保护的天球共和国数据中心窃取了先进的圣言之子技术资料，其中包括 Manei Domini 天体系列 OmniMech 的完整规格。布尔重新设计这些受保护的蓝图，用于研发乌拉乌斯，并委托新地球贸易公司秘密建设生产线。这家公司自继承战争初期起就只是 ComStar 控制的企业外壳，他们把新机甲隐藏在 NETC 运营的大量民用生产线之中。

column1: Needing to build up its forces after establishing the Wolf Empire and wanting a more generalist unit than the Skinwalker, Clan Wolf's Ramiel Bekker created the Stormwolf in collaboration with Clan Sea Fox by modifying the Wendigo to the Clan's exacting specifications. The 'Mech was designed with the intention of striking a balance between firepower and speed, and chief among Bekker's modifications was the addition of fixed mobility-enhancing equipment in order to shape the 'Mech's role in combat, as well as relocating the 'Mech's cockpit to the head. This relocation's associated visual changes gave the 'Mech a more canid or ursid appearance, bringing it more in line with the earlier Wulfen and Warwolf aesthetically.
column2: 在建立狼帝国后，为了扩充兵力并获得比 Skinwalker 更全能的单位，狼氏族的 Ramiel Bekker 与海狐氏族合作，按照氏族严格的规格改造 Wendigo，创造了 Stormwolf。该机甲旨在平衡火力与速度；Bekker 最重要的改动，是加入固定式机动增强设备以塑造其战斗定位，并将驾驶舱移至头部。这一改动带来的外观变化让机甲更像犬科或熊科动物，在美学上也更接近早期的 Wulfen 和 Warwolf。

column1: Nimakachi Fusion was building these when the Word of Blake hit Tematagi and destroyed the plant. Should have been the end of the design but Wakazashi picked up production in the mid-3070s. Nearly 173 kph in bursts with ECM and an Active Probe running is a hard combination to deal with. The weapons are light but that was never the point.
column2: 当布莱克的话语袭击了 Tematagi 并摧毁了工厂时，Nimakachi Fusion 正在建造这些工厂。设计本来应该结束，但 Wakazashi 在 3070 年代中期开始生产。天龙联合体曾一度专门使用它们，但到了黑暗时代，雇佣兵和海盗开始通过各种渠道获取它们。在使用 ECM 和 Active Probe 运行的情况下，突发时速接近 173 公里是一个很难应对的组合。武器很轻，但这不是重点。

column1: Obtaining a large number of mostly operational Battle Cobras in the aftermath of brutal conflict in the Devil's Bath during the Battle of Tukayyid, ComStar selected the Battle Cobra as the focus of their efforts to reverse-engineer and develop their own OmniMech.
column2: 图卡伊德战役期间，魔鬼之浴发生了惨烈冲突。战后，ComStar 获得了大量基本仍能运作的 Battle Cobra，并将其作为逆向工程、开发自有全能机甲的重点项目。

column1: Of the relatively few Sorcerers built before the Amaris Coup, the Sorcerer 1CC variant was considered an exceptionally rare design. Originally planned as a replacement for the 90 ton Cyclops, it quickly became apparent that the design teams at StarCorps Industries were not going to be able to best its incredible computer systems. Rather than spending several more decades of development, the design team decided that modifying the Sorcerer 1A would be a suitable method to cut corners. The 1CC drops the Snub-Nose PPCs, lasers and five Double Heat Sink in order to mount an additional Ceres Arms Smasher PPC, a quintet of Magna 400P Medium Pulse Lasers, and the advanced Command Console. 特性：Battle Fists 部署费用倍率：1.19
column2: 在阿玛里斯政变前制造的少数Sorcerer中，1CC变型被视为极其罕见的设计。它原本计划取代90吨Cyclops，但StarCorps Industries的设计团队很快发现自己无法超越其惊人的计算机系统。与其再花数十年开发，设计团队决定改造Sorcerer 1A以走捷径。1CC拆除短管PPC、激光器和5组双重散热器，改装一门Ceres Arms Smasher PPC、五门Magna 400P中型脉冲激光器和先进指挥控制台。 特性：战斗铁拳 部署费用倍率：1.19

column1: Oh boy, Boss. Quicksell really pushed the limits with their ad copy. Yeah, it has a Thumper Cannon, but the Long Tom is a one-shot, and the mortar just comes with flares. Not a bad idea if you needed to do some stealth ops while masquerading as workers, but anything else and you'll be wishing for more ammo, armor, and speed.
column2: 噢，老大。 Quicksell 的广告文案确实突破了极限。是的，它有一门重击炮，但长汤姆炮是一次性的，而且迫击炮只带有照明弹。如果你需要伪装成工人进行一些秘密行动，这不是一个坏主意，但如果你需要更多的弹药、装甲和速度，那么你会希望有更多的弹药、装甲和速度。

column1: Oh man Boss, this thing is a dream to work on. Those Coyote scientists included all the design schematics, ammunition formulas, everything to make the mech, in multiple redundant data storage spots located around the mech. The spacious room to do maintenance is something I haven't seen since an Orion, and I feel totally fine handing it over to the newbie mechtechs, because it's just so idiot proof (knock on wood).  They even engraved the wiring schematics into the mech's frame! Heck, I'd even let Darius try repairing it! Ok, no, I wouldn't, because somehow he'd find some hostile BA in a leg or something and we'd have a fight inside the Argo, but you know what I mean.
column2: 老杨，这东西简直是我的梦中情机！那些郊狼科学家把所有设计图、弹药公式，以及制造这台机甲所需的一切资料，都以多份冗余形式存进了机甲周围的数据存储点。宽敞的维护空间是我自 Orion 以来从未见过的，我完全放心把它交给新手技师，因为它实在太不容易被修坏了（敲敲木头）。他们甚至把线路图直接蚀刻在机甲骨架上！说真的，我甚至会让达利乌斯试着修它！好吧，不会，因为他肯定会在某条腿里找到敌对战斗装甲之类的东西，然后我们就得在阿耳戈号里面打起来，但你懂我的意思。

column1: On the one hand, that fuel cell is a work of art. Totally irreplaceable, and unreproducable. I don't know what 'contractors' (read: pirates) they got to make the thing, but they certainly managed to do something amazing. On the OTHER hand (the metal one, in case you were wondering), it's an abomination against all traditional mech engineering, and I'll be amazed if you don't blow yourself up with it at some point. So it's a bit of a tossup, really.
column2: 一方面，那块燃料电池简直是艺术品，完全无法替代，也无法复刻。我不知道他们找了什么“承包商”（说白了就是海盗）来造这玩意儿，但对方确实做出了不得了的东西。另一方面——如果你在想，我说的是金属的那一边——它完全违背传统机甲工程学，哪天你没把自己炸上天我都会惊讶。所以这事还真不好说。

column1: One of Clan Coyotes contributions to the Homeworld Clans, the Telippa is a fast and well armoured heavy tank. A 75 ton wheeled Omni-Tank, the Telippa is powered by a 355 XXL and clad in 18 tons of Ferro Lamellor armour; giving it 27 tons of podspace. Known variants include: An ER PPC/iATM-12 combo augmented by an Angel ECM suit and 4 Machine Guns, a HAG/20 paired with 3 ER Medium Lasers and an iATM-9; and 2 iATM-12s mated to an ER Large Laser and an Angel ECM suit.Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 5/8 hexes / 150/240 meters. column1: One of the Vining Engineering and Salvage Team’s more curious creations, the Ion Raptor is a hand built marque of battlemechs built with salvage from the Clan front lines. First debuting in 3053, the original Ion Raptor was built from the remains of a Masakari and a Crab. Designed in collaboration with Sea Fox merchants, the Ion Raptor 5R is a return to VEST’s roots. Each 5R is hand built to order, mostly for select Solaris stables. Designed to succeed in the Arena and on the battlefield, the 5R is armed with a pair of ER Large Lasers for ranged combat while 4 IHML’s surprise anyone who closes in. 4 Streak LRM-5’s support the ER Lasers, but can engage targets at close range if required.
column2: 离子猛禽是维宁工程与回收团队颇为独特的作品之一，是利用氏族前线回收部件手工打造的机甲系列。原型于 3053 年首次亮相，由 Masakari 和 Crab 的残骸拼装而成。Ion Raptor 5R 与海狐商人合作设计，回归了 VEST 的本源。每台 5R 都按订单手工制造，主要供特定的索拉里斯马厩使用。它为竞技场和战场作战而设计，远程配备两门增程大型激光器；四门改进型重型中型激光器则能出其不意地打击靠近的敌人。四具连发 LRM-5 为增程激光器提供支援，必要时也能攻击近距离目标。

column1: One of the earliest second generation OmniMech designs, the Kingfisher debuted in 2887 and is reputed to have influenced all subsequent Clan Assault OmniMech designs. A 90-ton mech powered by a 360-rated Fusion Engine, the Kingfisher has 24 tons of podspace provided by a combination of Ferro-Fibrous armor and an Endo Steel skeleton. The Kingfisher E is armed with an ATM-12 and a Large Pulse Laser. At closer ranges, the E can bring to bear 5 Medium Pulse Lasers.
column2: 王渔鸮是最早一代第二代 OmniMech 设计之一，于 2887 年首次亮相，据说影响了此后所有氏族突击级 OmniMech 的设计。这款 90 吨机甲采用 360 级聚变引擎，Endo Steel 内骨钢骨架与铁纤维装甲为其提供 24 吨模块载荷空间。王渔鸮 E 型装备一具 ATM-12 和一门大型脉冲激光器；近距离时还可动用五门中型脉冲激光器。

column1: One of the first mass production QuadMechs, the 55 ton Scorpion entered production in 2570 as an infantry support unit. Shunned by most MechWarriors due to its notoriously unstable gait, the Scorpion would nevertheless see uninterrupted use throughout the Succession Wars and beyond. The Scorpion 12C is powered by a 330-rated XL Engine giving it a top speed of 97 km/h. An ER PPC, iNARC and an ER Small Laser form the Mechs weapons load. A C3i module allows the Mech to share data with other C3i equipped Mechs.
column2: Scorpion是最早量产的四足机甲之一，55吨级机体于2570年作为步兵支援单位投产。尽管步态极不稳定、遭多数机甲战士嫌弃，它仍在继承战争期间及之后持续服役。Scorpion 12C由330级XL引擎驱动，最高速度97公里/小时；ER PPC、iNARC和ER小型激光构成武器配置。C3i模块让它能够与其他配备C3i的机甲共享数据。

column1: One of the latest UrbanMech variants, the UM-R96 is an evolution of the -R80. It drops all the weaponry bar the 短管PPC to mount the hardened armor of the -R93 model. The standard small laser remains, although now of the X-pulse variety. This creates an incredibly tough 'Mech with minimal logistics needs, which is perfectly suited to combat in an urban environment—but nowhere else.
column2: UM-R96 是 UrbanMech 的最新变体之一，也是 -R80 的演进型。它舍弃除重型 PPC 外的全部武器，改装 -R93 型的硬化装甲。标准小型激光器仍保留，但升级为 X 脉冲型号。这造就了一台极其坚固、后勤需求极低的机甲，非常适合城市作战——但不适合其他地方。

column1: One of the latest variants of the Panther to be introduced, this combination of Clan and Inner Sphere tech presents an interesting design.
column2: 这是 Panther 最新推出的型号之一，将氏族与内层圈技术结合在一起，形成了有趣的设计。

column1: One of the mechs of the infamous pirate band going by the name "The Sea Monkeys". Naming the mech after themselves shows a lot of hybris, especially since most of the band ended up dying when their illegal 'Mech factory blew up due to someone using rum as the coolant for the fusion power core.
column2: 这是臭名昭著的“海猴子”海盗团旗下的一台机甲。把机甲以自己命名，足见他们有多自负；尤其是这群海盗大多在其非法机甲工厂爆炸时丧生，而爆炸原因竟是有人用朗姆酒给聚变动力核心当冷却剂。

column1: One of the more interesting Jenner IIC variants, it could be worth doing some field trials with it.
column2: 这是 Jenner IIC 最有趣的变体之一，值得进行一些实地测试。

column1: One of the more recent additions to the line, the Subjugator 5 builds on the success of the Subjugator 1 by keeping most of the 设计 the same. The only real difference is the replacement of its two Extended Range 大型脉冲激光s with two Artemis IV-enabled LRM-15 Launchers and two ER 中型激光s. 怪癖: 令人胆怯 掉落成本乘数: 1.34
column2: Subjugator 5 是该系列较新的成员之一，在保留大部分设计的基础上延续了 Subjugator 1 的成功。唯一真正的区别，是用两具启用 Artemis IV 的 LRM-15 发射器和两具 ER 中型激光器，替换原有的两具扩展射程大型脉冲激光器。 怪癖: 令人胆怯 掉落成本乘数: 1.34

column1: One of the more recent variants, using MMLs to try and be more flexible. 'Jack of all trades, master of none' probably applies here.
column2: 这是较新的型号之一，使用 MML 以提高灵活性。“样样通、样样松”大概正适合它。

column1: One of the most popular Star League BattleMechs, many a Highlander accompanied General Aleksandr Kerensky into exile. Some were mothballed, but many found their way into the toumans of the Clans. As technology advanced, the weapons systems were upgraded until the design known as the Highlander IIC finally emerged. Though no new Highlanders have been produced in over a century, several hundred are still in scattered use throughout the touman of every Clan.
column2: 作为最受欢迎的星盟战斗机甲之一，许多 Highlander 曾随 Aleksandr Kerensky 将军流亡。有些被封存，但许多进入氏族的 touman。随着技术进步，武器系统不断升级，最终诞生了 Highlander IIC。虽然 Highlander 已超过一个世纪没有生产，但数百台仍分散服役于各氏族的 touman 中。

column1: One of the 瓦伊宁工程与打捞队’s more curious creations, the Ion Raptor is a hand built marque of battlemechs built with salvage from the Clan front lines. First debuting in 3053, the original Ion Raptor was built from the remains of a Masakari and a Crab. Designed in collaboration with Sea Fox merchants, the Ion Raptor 5R is a return to VEST’s roots. Each 5R is hand built to order, mostly for select Solaris stables. Designed to succeed in the Arena and on the battlefield, the 5R is armed with a pair of ER Large Lasers for ranged combat while 4 IHML’s surprise anyone who closes in. 4 Streak LRM-5’s support the ER Lasers, but can engage targets at close range if required.
column2: 瓦伊宁工程与打捞队最奇特的作品之一，离子猛禽是使用氏族前线战场残骸手工制造的战斗机甲型号。原型于 3053 年首次亮相，由 Masakari 和 Crab 的残骸拼装而成。5R 型与海狐商人合作设计，回归 VEST 的根源。每台 5R 都按订单手工制造，主要供应精选的 Solaris 竞技场马厩。为在竞技场和战场上取胜，5R 装备两门 ER 大型激光器用于远程作战，4 门 IHML 则用于突袭近身敌人。4 门 Streak LRM-5 支援 ER 激光器，必要时也能攻击近距离目标。

column1: One of two 'cousins', the -12K and the -12K2, they are fairly similar but different enough to have different combat profiles.

column1: One ton more of armor at the cost of the two Medium Pulse Lasers turning into a single Medium X-Pulse Laser is probably a worth trade.
column2: 牺牲两门中型脉冲激光、换成一门中型 X 脉冲激光，以此增加一吨装甲，应该算是值得的交换。

column1: One ton more of 装甲 at the cost of the two 中型脉冲激光s turning into a single 中型X脉冲激光 Laser is probably a worth trade.
column2: 用一吨额外装甲换取将两门中型X脉冲激光改成一门中型X脉冲激光，大概是值得的交易。

column1: Only a prototype in 3070, the 6S is an attempt to modify the 6Q to make it more durable. It replaces the engine with a Light Engine of the same size. In order to make up for the added mass, Ferro-Fibrous armor is utilized. This is not enough to make up the difference, however, so the pulse is downgraded to a standard Large Laser. The decrease in heat allowed for the removal of a heat sink, while the remaining tonnage went into a Guardian ECM Suite, which makes the Enfield more difficult to target.
column2: 6S 在 3070 年还只是原型机，旨在让 6Q 更加坚固。它以同尺寸的轻型引擎替换原引擎，并采用铁磁纤维装甲弥补增加的重量。然而仍不足以填平差距，因此脉冲激光降级为标准大型激光。热量降低后拆除一具散热器，剩余吨位用于 Guardian ECM 套件，使 Enfield 更难被锁定。

column1: Originally developed by Vitesse Vehicles of Terra in 2611, the Prowler Multi-Terrain-Vehicle was the most common hostile and exotic environment military-grade exploration vehicles. The Prowler was almost unsurpassed in its niche, the design proving popular enough for Vitesse to halt production and merely license the design to manufacturers across the Inner Sphere and Periphery. column1: Practically the posterchild of the SLDF's Gunslingers, the prized Marauder GSR refit was eagerly adopted as a platform for weapons research by Clan scientists. When the 改进的 Gauss Rifle was 开发, no time was wasted in replacing the aging LB-10-X Autocannon of the original 设计. Alongside the new Gauss armament are carried further improvements to the Clan's PPC and laser technologies.
column2: 作为 SLDF 枪手部队的标志性机甲，珍贵的Marauder GSR 改装型被氏族科学家积极采用为武器研究平台。当轻型高斯步枪问世后，他们立即用其替换原版机甲老旧的 LB-10-X 自动炮。同时，新高斯武器还搭配了氏族 PPC 与激光技术的进一步改进。

column1: Precentor Dantalion of the 49th Shadow Division equipped his personal 'Mech with some experimental equipment. A Small Cockpit allows a Laser AMS to be mounted in the head, while a Heavy-Duty Gyro and Light Engine make the 'Mech harder to kill. Protection was upgraded as well, using Heavy Ferro-Fibrous armor. Finally, a Guardian ECM Suiteprotects against enemy electronics. Offensively, Dantalion's custom Albatross uses an ER PPC with PPC Capacitor in the left arm, balanced by a Large VSP Laser in the right. For close combat, the left and right torso each get an ER Medium Laser and Medium Pulse Laser, and the right torso mounts a single ER Small Laser. In addition, the 'Mech is equipped with Triple Strength Myomer, making it a deadly foe in melee combat.
column2: 第 49 影子师的丹塔利昂教士为自己的机甲装上了实验设备。小型驾驶舱允许头部安装激光 AMS，重型耐久陀螺仪与轻型引擎则让机甲更难被摧毁。防护也得到升级，采用重型铁纤维装甲。最后，守护者 ECM 系统可抵御敌方电子设备。进攻方面，丹塔利昂的定制信天翁左臂装备带 PPC 电容器的增程 PPC，右臂则配备大型 VSP 激光器。近战时，左右躯干各装一门增程中型激光器和一门中型脉冲激光器，右侧躯干另有一门增程小型激光器。此外，机甲还配备 TSM，使它成为可怕的近战敌手。

column1: Presenting the Quicsell Nova M – Feel the Heat, No Breaks Required! This upgraded Mech boasts a swarm of standard chem lasers, delivering relentless firepower without the hassles of overheating. Quicsell brings you a Mech that thrives on the heat, ensuring more firing and zero downtime. The Nova M: turning up the battlefield intensity without missing a beat! Quirk: Quicksell Clan Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni

column1: Presenting the Quicsell Nova – Unleash the Inferno, MechWarriors! Our cutting-edge Mech comes equipped with heavy chem lasers, delivering superior damage and cost-efficient heat management. But here's the thrill – the more you fire, the hotter it gets. It's not a flaw; it's a feature! Embrace the strategic challenge of managing your firepower, and you'll own the battlefield. The Quicsell Nova – where the heat is on, and victory is sweeter when you earn it! Quirk: Quicksell Clan Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 推出 Quisell Nova – 释放地狱，机甲战士！我们的尖端机甲配备了重型化学激光器，可提供卓越的破坏力和经济高效的热管理。但令人兴奋的是——你开火越多，温度就越高。这不是一个缺陷；而是一个缺陷。这是一个功能！迎接管理火力的战略挑战，你将掌控战场。 Quicsell Nova——热火朝天，当你赢得胜利时，胜利会更加甜蜜！ 怪癖：快速销售部落机械 下降成本乘数： 1.04 Arm 执行器限制：Omni

column1: Pretty piece of kit, boss. Double heat sinks, ER lasers, double the missiles, and it kept the Gauss up front. Runs cool and reaches out. Trouble is, the folks who want a P-7 can't stretch to a P-9, and those who can already bought a flashier main-line variant. Good 'Mech, wrong crowd.
column2: 老大，这套装备挺漂亮：双重散热器、增程激光、双倍导弹，而且高斯步枪仍在前方。运行凉爽，射程也远。麻烦在于想要 P-7 的人买不起 P-9，而买得起的人早就买了更炫的主力型号。机甲不错，只是找错了客户。

column1: Pretty standard fare for these Star League upgrades. Buncha SRMs and some medlas. If it ain't broke, don't fix it.

column1: Produced by Maverick Industries after Operations Serpent and Bulldog, the TsarBomba is an attempt to improve the flexibility and survivability of artillery units. Noting the loss of many Arrow IV equipped units and the slaughter of their crews during Clan breakthroughs, the Maverick Industries design teams looked for ways to improve the situation. With a license to produce the Hollander BZK-F3 already secured, it was decided to produce an upgraded model that utilised an XL Engine to mount the Arrow IV launcher. Modern artillery tactics called for the deployment of anti-air and anti-mech units to protect the precious assets, so Maverick only mounted a Small Pulse Laser on the mech, augmented by a TAG; so that the Hollander could handle infantry infiltrators and spot for either its own launcher or the rest of its lancemates. The design's speed was judged sufficient for it to evade other threats that might threaten the mech, especially with its armor unable to stand up to much punishment.
column2: TsarBomba 由 Maverick Industries 在 Serpent 和 Bulldog 行动后生产，旨在提升炮兵单位的灵活性与生存能力。Maverick Industries 注意到氏族突破期间许多装备 Arrow IV 的单位损失，以及其乘员遭到屠杀，于是设计团队寻找改善方案。由于已取得 Hollander BZK-F3 的生产许可，他们决定制造升级型号，利用 XL 引擎安装 Arrow IV 发射器。现代炮兵战术要求部署反空和反机甲单位保护珍贵资产，因此 Maverick 只在机甲上安装一门小型脉冲激光，并加装 TAG，让 Hollander 能应对渗透的步兵并为自身发射器或其他长机标定目标。设计速度被认为足以躲避其他威胁，尤其考虑到其装甲无法承受太多打击。

column1: Produced exclusively for the Word of Blake, the LHW uses the same Endo Steel chassis and Ferro-Fibrous armor that worked so well in the LH8. A direct upgrade of the LH2, the LHW mounts an ER large Laser, twin LRM-5s, and four ER Medium Lasers. The crown jewel, however, is the C3i Computer that allows the 'Mech to share target data with five other units.

column1: Produced in 2546, the Toro was the Taurian Concordant’s first battlemech design. Based on captured Firebees, the Toro is a long range support mech. Armed with a PPC and a pair of LRM-5s the Toro carried two tons of ammo and 10 single heat sinks. The last Toro factory was demolished in 2598 by invading Star League troops and production would not resume until the Word of Blake Jihad. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

column1: Produced jointly by Victory Conditions Industries and Eris Enterprises, the Jackalope represented a leap forward in anti-missile and recon technology. Designed to serve in recon and pursuit lances, this compact and swift BattleMech was used to full effect in combat, and additionally served as a training 'Mech and as an arena combat 'Mech. The 'Mech gets its name from a mythical animal which was said to have existed on Terra's North American continent.
column2: 胜利条件工业与厄里斯企业联合生产的 Jackalope，代表了反导与侦察技术的飞跃。它被设计用于侦察和追击长枪，在战斗中充分发挥了这台紧凑而迅捷的战斗机甲的性能，也被用作训练机甲和竞技场机甲。它的名字来自一种神话动物，据说曾生活在 Terra 的北美大陆。

column1: Produced on Terra by StarCorp Industries, the Quirinus is a late thirty-first century Medium battle armor which was originally produced for general sale. Developed as a mainline trooper in the early years of the Republic Era, the Quirinus was sold initially to the fractured Free Worlds League. While not as flashy as many of its contemporaries of its time, the suit is known for its reliability and as a good unit in the field. The battle armor would find its way into hands of mercenary units and elements of the Republic of the Sphere.
column2: Quirinus 由 StarCorp Industries 在 Terra 生产，是一款 31 世纪末的中型战斗装甲，最初面向市场销售。它在共和国时代早期作为主力步兵装甲研发，最初卖给分裂的自由世界联盟。虽然外观不如同时代许多装甲华丽，但 Quirinus 以可靠著称，是一款优秀的战场单位。后来它进入雇佣兵部队和球体共和国部队手中。

column1: Production began on the 11D on New Valencia during the FedCom Civil War. Powered by a 轻型引擎, the 11D adds an additional ton and a half of 装甲 over that on the 10D. Two ER Large Lasers provide long-range firepower and the 锁定式SRM-4 is retained. The autocannon is replaced with a 转管自动炮/5 and three tons of ammunition in a CASE-protected bin. A C3 Slave allows integration with a C3 unit. Fifteen double heat sinks are able to effectively manage the heat levels.
column2: 11D 型在联邦合众国内战期间于新瓦伦西亚开始生产。它采用轻型引擎，相比 10D 型额外增加了 1.5 吨装甲。两门 ER 大型激光提供远程火力，并保留锁定式 SRM-4。原有自动炮被旋管自动炮/5 取代，三吨弹药存放在 CASE 防护弹舱中。C3 从属设备使其能够接入 C3 单元。十五个双重散热器足以有效控制热量。

column1: Quikscell came up with a clever idea in 3067, sell one cheap chassis and let customers buy different equipment kits for it. Six kits total covering pretty much every industrial job you can think of. Sold everywhere because it was affordable and flexible. Great Houses bought them, backwater planets bought them, mercenaries picked them up for the price. Quikscell stuff is never fancy but it gets the job done and parts are everywhere.
column2: Quikscell 在 3067 年想出了个聪明办法：先卖一台便宜底盘，再让客户购买不同设备套件。总共有六种套件，几乎覆盖所有能想到的工业工作。因为价格低、适应性强，它销往各处。大氏族买过，偏远星球买过，雇佣兵也按价格买来使用。Quikscell 的产品从不华丽，但总能完成任务，而且零件到处都能找到。

column1: Reintroduced in 3148, the Minsk 2 is an updated copy of the Golden Age Minsk MNK-1. Developed for second line units in the 蛇夫座自治领, the Minsk 2 is a 70-ton Mech. Powered by a 210-rated Fusion Core, the MSK-2 is armed with a pair of Capacitor enhanced ER PPCs and a Mech Mortar/6. Paired 锁定式SRM-6s, 小型脉冲激光s and B-Pods add additional firepower at close range. An 主动探头 allows the Minsk to spot hidden opponents while an Angel ECM shields the Mech from enemy sensors.
column2: 3148年重新推出的Minsk 2是黄金时代Minsk MNK-1的更新复制品，为边缘联盟的二线部队开发，是一台70吨机甲。MSK-2由210级聚变核心驱动，装备两门经电容器强化的ER PPC和一具机甲迫击炮/6；锁定式SRM-6、中型脉冲激光和B型炸弹提供额外近程火力。探测头用于发现隐蔽敌人，天使ECM则屏蔽敌方传感器。

column1: Relatively lightly armed for a heavy Battle机甲, the Jade Hawk is equipped only with four Series 1g ER Small Lasers and a set of four Mk. 22 Type III SRM-6s, as well as the claws on its extremities, themselves impressive close combat weapons for Death from Above attacks and grappling with other '机甲s in close combat conditions. This combination of melee and short ranged weaponry, heavy 装甲, and speed (rivaling '机甲s a third of its tonnage) make the Jade Hawk a powerful close-in fighter and a force to be reckoned with in urban environments.
column2: Jade Hawk 作为重型战斗机甲，武装相对轻量，仅配备四门 1g 系列增程小型激光、四组 Mk. 22 III 型 SRM-6，以及四肢上的利爪。利爪本身就是出色的近战武器，可用于从天而降攻击和近距离缠斗。近战与短程武器、厚重装甲以及媲美三分之一自重机甲的速度相结合，使 Jade Hawk 成为强大的近距离战士，在城市环境中尤其令人畏惧。

column1: Renewing the Mad Cat legend, the Mk IV used some of the most powerful configurations of its grand brother, while also incorporating easier to find and replace components. Clan Sea Fox expected to experience the same success with this model, as it had with previous ones.
column2: 重铸 Mad Cat 传奇，Mk IV 采用了其伟大前身最强大的几种配置，同时整合了更容易找到和替换的部件。海狐氏族期待这一型号取得与前代相同的成功。

column1: Reportedly piloted by Zane Nova Cat, the Jenner IIC Hero '机甲 mounts a Heavy Machine Gun and twin standard Machine Guns in each arm fed by five tons of Machine Gun rounds and three tons of Heavy Machine Gun ammunition, supported by a single center torso-mounted ER 中型激光. Defensively the Fury trades speed for 装甲, mounting an 280-rated XL引擎 to carry four and half tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲.
column2: 据称由Zane Nova Cat驾驶的Jenner IIC英雄机甲Fury，双臂各装一挺重型机枪和两挺标准机枪，携带5吨机枪弹药和3吨重型机枪弹药；中央躯干另有一门安装在躯干上的ER中型激光器。Fury牺牲速度换取装甲，采用280额定XL引擎，携带4.5吨铁纤维装甲。

column1: Reportedly 开发 in a mobile facility en route to the Inner Sphere, the Elemental II (X) is a prototype battle 装甲 开发 by 氏族地狱马 to integrate the capabilities of the standard Elemental battlesuit (known to many in the Inner Sphere as "Toad " 装甲) with myomer-boosting technology. The goal of this experimental 设计 was to enhance the Elemental as the Clans' "gold standard" in battle 装甲 设计, and produce a more effective general-purpose suit.
column2: 据称 Elemental II（X）是在前往内圈的移动设施中开发的原型战斗装甲，由地狱马氏族制造，用于将标准 Elemental 战斗服（内圈常称“蟾蜍”装甲）与肌纤维增强技术结合。实验设计旨在把 Elemental 打造成氏族战斗装甲的“黄金标准”，并生产更有效的通用战斗服。

column1: Requiring a more advanced and enduring Command Unit, designers have revisited the original Black Knight Specs. Taking cues from the Harjel system of Battle Armor, and advances from Clan Diamond Shark, this mech is outfitted with a specialized diagnostics and self repair system.
column2: 由于需要更先进、更耐用的指挥单元，设计师重新审视了最初的 Black Knight 规格。他们借鉴战斗装甲的 Harjel 系统以及钻石鲨氏族的技术进步，为这台机甲配备了专用诊断与自我修复系统。

column1: Rev up, Mech Commanders! The Quicsell Shadowcat – the Commander's Dream Mech is here with upgraded sensors, a custom cockpit for that personalized touch, and a speedy pair of Quicsell legs. It's a firepower feast with two pulse lasers, an SRM 4, and four light MGs – like a sports car in the stars! We're tossing in those extra MGs for the same price – consider it a "bullet bonus"! Don't lead the charge without the Quicsell Shadowcat – your ticket to tactical stardom! Quirk: Quicksell Command Clan Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 加速吧，机甲指挥官们！Quicsell Shadowcat——指挥官的梦中机甲登场了：升级传感器、定制驾驶舱带来个性化体验，还有一双 Quicsell 高速机甲腿。火力盛宴包括两门脉冲激光、一具 SRM-4 和四挺轻型机枪，简直像星际跑车！我们还免费附赠那些额外机枪，就当作‘子弹赠礼’吧！别在没有 Quicsell Shadowcat 的情况下冲锋——它就是你迈向战术明星的通行证！ 特质：Quicsell 指挥型氏族机甲 部署费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1: Rev up, Mech fans! The Quicsell Hunchback QSK is the dream machine you've been waiting for – packing a double AC/20 punch and speedy legs for a chase that'll leave your foes in the dust. With the ViewMaster cockpit and top-notch sensors, you'll be hitting your targets with pinpoint precision. Stay nimble with advanced compact X4 arm actuators, 5 extra double heatsinks, and 3 tons of ammo – because running out of bullets mid-battle is so last season. This isn't just a Mech; it's your ticket to MechWarrior stardom. Cruise into victory with style – the road to glory starts here! Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: 引擎启动，机甲迷们！Quicsell Hunchback QSK 就是你梦寐以求的机甲——双联 AC/20 火力，加上高速机动能力，追击时能把敌人远远甩在身后。ViewMaster 驾驶舱和顶级传感器让你精准命中目标。先进紧凑型 X4 手臂驱动器、额外五具双重散热器和三吨弹药，让它保持灵活；毕竟战斗中途没子弹早就过时了。这不只是一台机甲，更是你成为明星机甲战士的门票。潇洒地驶向胜利——荣耀之路从此开始！ 特质：战斗拳套 部署费用倍率：1.02

column1: Rev your excitement with the Quicsell Incubus! Lighter than your ex's potato salad and armed to impress, this battle-scarred beauty comes with an extralight structure for agile maneuvers. Act fast on this limited-time offer – hotter than a flamethrower and priced to make your wallet smile. Test pilots welcome for a thrilling ride into MechWarrior history with the Quicsell Incubus – where every Mech has a story, and yours starts now! Quirk: Quicksell Clan Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99
column2: 点燃你的热情，Quicsell Incubus 来了！它比前任的土豆沙拉还轻，武装足以让人眼前一亮。这位饱经战火的美人采用超轻结构，机动灵活。限时发售，机会稍纵即逝，火热程度胜过火焰喷射器，价格更让钱包会心一笑。欢迎试飞员来一场刺激之旅，载入机甲战士的历史！Quicsell Incubus：每台机甲都有故事，而你的故事现在开始！ 特性：Quicksell 氏族机甲 部署费用倍率：0.99

column1: Riley Centrella sent a team to Solaris VII in 3062 to set up Firefly Stables. This was the first thing Firefly Foundry built specifically for them, eleven years later. A 200 XXL engine in a 25-ton frame costs more than some assault mechs to maintain and the armor is basically paint. The PPC Capacitor on a Light PPC is experimental and the Rocket Launcher is single-use. It was built for the arena and nowhere else.
column2: 3062 年，Riley Centrella 派遣团队前往 Solaris VII 建立 Firefly Stables。十一年后，Firefly Foundry 专门为他们打造的第一台机甲终于问世。25 吨机体上装着一台 200 级 XXL 引擎，维护成本比一些突击机甲还高，装甲薄得几乎就像涂层。轻型 PPC 上的 PPC 电容器是实验型设备，火箭发射器则只能使用一次。这台机甲只为竞技场而造，除此之外毫无用途。

column1: Riley Centrella sent a team to Solaris VII in 3062 to set up Firefly Stables. This was the first thing Firefly Foundry built specifically for them, eleven years later. A 200 XXL engine in a 25-ton frame costs more than some assault mechs to maintain and the armor is basically paint. The PPC Capacitor on a Light PPC is experimental and the 火箭发射器 is single-use. It was built for the arena and nowhere else.
column2: 莱利·森特雷拉于 3062 年派遣团队前往 Solaris VII，建立萤火虫竞技场马厩。这是萤火虫铸造厂 11 年后专门为他们制造的第一件作品。25 吨框架中装入 200 级 XXL 引擎，维护成本甚至超过一些突击机甲，而装甲几乎只是油漆。轻型 PPC 上的 PPC 电容器仍属实验品，火箭发射器也只能使用一次。它只为竞技场而造。

column1: Rolling off the production line in 3052, the Rhino (3052) Upgrade is a complete rework of the original design, designed to make effective use of rediscovered Star League technology. Notably still missing CASE, much to the annoyance of vehicle crews, the Upgrade reskins the tank in Ferro Fibrous armour. The original weapons loadout has been removed and replaced with a trio of LRM-15’s augmented by Artemis IV. A pair of Medium Pulse Lasers replace the Medium Lasers. Much like the lack of CASE, designers neglected to improve the Vehicles speed, leaving it with much the same weaknesses as the original model. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 350 40 Left 285 40 Right 285 40 Rear 200 40 Turret 300 40 Total 1420 200 Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium
column2: Rhino（3052）升级型于 3052 年投产，是对原设计的全面重制，旨在有效利用重新发现的星盟科技。它仍未配备 CASE，令乘员十分不满；装甲则换为铁磁纤维装甲。原有武器被三具 Artemis IV 增强型 LRM-15 取代，中型激光则升级为中型脉冲激光。设计师也没有提升车辆速度，因此它仍保留原型号的大部分弱点。 生物群系限制：无。 移动： 3/5 格 / 90/150 米。 装甲： 铁磁纤维装甲 结构： Structure 数值 A S 正面 350 40 左侧 285 40 右侧 285 40 后方 200 40 炮塔 300 40 总计 1420 200 Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium

column1: Say what you will about the Light Mech Circuit at Solaris but you should probably not let Haley Flannigan hear it. Armed with a Plasma Rifle and two of those Retractable Blades, Haley's Cyclone is a force to be reckoned with in the arenas.
column2: 你可以随便评价 Solaris 的轻型机甲赛道，但最好别让 Haley Flannigan 听见。她的 Cyclone 装备一门等离子步枪和两把可收回刀刃，在竞技场上绝不可小觑。

column1: Say what you will about the Light 机甲 Circuit at Solaris but you should probably not let Haley Flannigan hear it. Armed with a 等离子步枪 and two of those 可伸缩刀刃s, Haley's Cyclone is a force to be reckoned with in the arenas.
column2: 别管你怎么评价 Solaris 的轻型机甲赛道，但最好别让 Haley Flannigan 听见。她的 Cyclone 装备一具等离子步枪和两把可伸缩刀刃，在竞技场上不可小觑。

column1: Scary walking firecracker. The torsos are full of incredibly dangerous missile ammo, and the only thing saving you from instant death via through armor critical is an off brand CASE II module. Even I'll admit that it's a lot of firepower for a medium mech, but it's not survivable or good at sustained engagements.
column2: 一枚会走路的吓人爆竹。躯干里塞满了极其危险的导弹弹药，唯一能让你不至于被穿甲暴击当场炸死的，就是一套杂牌 CASE II 模块。连我都得承认，这台中型机甲火力十足；但它生存能力差，也不适合持续交战。

column1: Scary walking firecracker. The torsos are full of incredibly dangerous missile ammo, and the only thing saving you from instant death via through 装甲 critical is an off brand CASE II module. Even I'll admit that it's a lot of firepower for a medium mech, but it's not survivable or good at sustained engagements.
column2: 一枚会走路的可怕爆竹。躯干里塞满极其危险的导弹弹药，唯一能避免穿透装甲暴击让你当场毙命的，是一个杂牌CASE II模块。即使我承认它对中型机甲而言火力很强，它也不耐打，无法胜任持续交战。

column1: Seizing on lore of old, and finding historical records of mighty creatures that once roamed Terra, the mighty engineers of Takara industries come forth once more, to show us how a 'Mech can be the most fearful thing on the battlefield.
column2: Takara Industries 的工程师从古老传说中汲取灵感，找到曾在泰拉漫游的强大生物历史记录，再次站出来向我们展示一台机甲如何成为战场上最令人畏惧的存在。

column2: Takara工业的工程师从古老传说中汲取灵感，查阅了曾在泰拉大地上漫游的巨兽历史记录，再次向我们展示一台战斗机甲如何成为战场上最令人恐惧的存在。

column1: Sheathed in hardened 装甲, the Cyclops C is a bit slower but much tougher than its forebears. A token but efficient weapons array exists merely to protect the '机甲's sophisticated communications equipment. A powerful force multiplier, the Cyclops C has been issued to Dominion PGCs, with a focus on Phalanxes to improve unit coordination. The simple, rugged '机甲 is an attractive alternative to the Clan's more advanced offerings.
column2: Cyclops C 覆盖着硬化装甲，速度略慢于前代，但坚固得多。它仅配备一组精简而高效的武器，主要用于保护机甲先进的通信设备。作为强大的力量倍增器，Cyclops C 已配发给鬼熊氏族的行星防卫部队，重点用于提升方阵部队的协同能力。这台简单而坚固的机甲，是氏族更先进型号之外的一个有吸引力的选择。

column1: Similar in some respects to the Dominus, the Infernus also mounts a Heavy PPC in the arm, but the other arm contains two Light PPCs. The weight saved allows the Archangel B to carry two 短管PPCs.

column1: Somewhat of a departure from most 氏族战斗机甲s, the Hellstar is a long-running campaign workhorse rather than the quick-and-deadly striker usually used in Clan warfare. A continuation of the collaboration between 氏族地狱马 and the Exiled Wolves on Arc-Royal during the Jihad which resulted in the Cygnus, a machine based on the earlier Annihilator, the Hellstar is more or less a Clan Awesome. Introduced in 3079, the Wolves-in-Exile and 地狱马 maintained exclusive production of the effective 'Mech since, with the largest number outside the ranks of their toumans being the relatively few examples the newborn 球体共和国 salvaged from the battlefields of Operation SCOUR. Built on a weight-saving Endo Steel frame and 380-rated XL fusion engine, the Hellstar boasts impressive speed for its weight while carrying eighteen-and-a-half tons of standard armor, the maximum possible for its weight. The real key to the design's reputation is its unprecedented thirty 双散热器, which allow it to fire all its weapons continuously without the risk of heat buildup.
column2: 地狱星与大多数氏族战斗机甲有所不同：它是适合长期战役的主力，而不是氏族战争中常见的快速致命突击者。这是圣战期间地狱马氏族与流亡之狼在阿克罗亚尔合作的延续，最终诞生了以早期歼灭者为基础的天鹅座；地狱星基本上就是氏族版的Awesome。该机甲于3079年投入使用，此后流亡之狼与地狱马氏族一直独占其生产。除他们的军团外，数量最多的是新生的球体共和国在“天谴行动”战场上回收的少数机体。它采用节省重量的内骨骼钢框架和380级XL融合引擎，以其重量而言速度惊人，同时携带18.5吨标准装甲，达到了该重量的最大值。该设计声誉的关键在于前所未有的30组双散热器，使其可以持续发射全部武器而不用担心热量积聚。

A continuation of the collaboration between 氏族地狱马 and the Exiled Wolves on Arc-Royal during the Jihad which resulted in the Cygnus, a machine based on the earlier Annihilator, the Hellstar is more or less a Clan Awesome. Introduced in 3079, the Wolves-in-Exile and 地狱马 maintained exclusive production of the effective 'Mech since, with the largest number outside the ranks of their toumans being the relatively few examples the newborn 球体共和国 salvaged from the battlefields of Operation SCOUR. Built on a weight-saving Endo Steel frame and 380-rated XL fusion 引擎, the Hellstar boasts impressive speed for its weight while carrying eighteen-and-a-half tons of standard 装甲, the maximum possible for its weight. The real key to the design's reputation is its unprecedented thirty 双散热器, which allow it to fire all its weapons continuously without the risk of heat buildup.
column2: 地狱使者的设计重达 65 吨，强调压倒性火力而非速度或装甲，是一款全向机甲。 Hellbringer 由 325 级 XL 发动机提供动力，拥有 28.5 吨的吊舱空间。地狱使者 D 装备有两门等离子炮。一个微型脉冲激光器、一对B-Pod和4个中型脉冲激光器覆盖近距离作战。

column1: Still an infantry killer, the IIC 7 mounts a trio of Anti-Personnel Gauss Rifles in each arm. One meager ton of ammunition supplies this variant. The ER 中型激光 of the IIC 4 remains in place. A 定位 Computer enhances these weapons' accuracy. 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: IIC 7仍然是一台步兵杀手，每只手臂安装三挺反人员高斯步枪。该型号仅配备一吨弹药；IIC 4的ER中型激光器继续保留。瞄准计算机提高了这些武器的命中精度。 特性：窄/低调 部署成本倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: TReportedly piloted by Dirk Radick, the Adder Hero 'Mech, the Cinder mounts an ER Large Laser in each arm supported by a Machine Gun in each side torso complimented by the head mounted Flamer. Carrying two and half tons of machine gun rounds, five extra 双散热器 maintain a high rate of laser fire.
column2: 据称由Dirk Radick驾驶的Adder英雄机甲Cinder，在双臂各装一门ER大型激光器，两侧躯干各装一挺机枪，头部另有一具喷火器。它携带2.5吨机枪弹药，额外5组双重散热器维持高频率激光射击。

column1: Take a basic Jagermech, make it even bigger, and you have Independence Weaponry's Uberjager. A 115 ton beast of raw ballistic damage, it is entirely focused on autocannons and their auxiliary systems. In an attempt to keep costs down, the Uberjager only mounts a 285 XL engine and has limited armor.
column2: 把一台普通 Jagermech 再放大一些，你得到的就是 Independence Weaponry 的 Uberjager。这是一头 115 吨的纯弹道伤害巨兽，完全围绕自动炮及其辅助系统打造。为压低成本，Uberjager 只安装 285 级 XL 引擎，装甲也相当有限。

column1: Taking a cue from Clan Jade Falcon’s Thor II, introduced during the previous decade, Nova Cat scientists removed the original Shadow Cat’s fixed jump jets to free valuable mass. Most of the remaining tonnage was allotted for pod space, enhancing the ’Mech’s flexibility, while the remainder maximized armor coverage to see the Clan’s precious OmniMechs and its warriors home safely. The Shadow Cat III A configuration features only a ER Large Laser in each arm. Mobility has been substantially increased with the retention of the MASC system and the inclusion of eight pod mounted Improved Jump Jets to increase jump ranges 50% over the original Shadow Cat.
column2: 受到玉隼氏族上一年代推出的 Thor II 启发，新星猫科学家拆除原版 Shadow Cat 固定跳跃喷射器，以腾出宝贵重量。其余吨位大多分配给模块载荷空间，增强机甲灵活性；剩余空间用于最大化装甲覆盖，确保氏族的珍贵 OmniMech 和战士安全返航。Shadow Cat III A 配置两臂各装一门增程大型激光器；保留 MASC，并增加八具安装在模块吊舱中的改进型跳跃喷射器，使跳跃距离比原版 Shadow Cat 提高 50%。

column1: Taking something of an alternate approach to the same battlefield niche, the Sprite 2 trades it’s quartet of LRM launchers for a single ‘Mech-scale ERLL. column1: The 'Rigor Mortis' project was focused on creating an even further improved version of the Ultralight 引擎. RISC scientists attempted to improve its performance by extending some parts of the 引擎 all the way into the shoulders of the 'Mech. 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.43 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: “Rigor Mortis”项目致力于制造进一步改进的超轻型引擎。RISC 科学家试图把引擎的部分结构一直延伸到机甲肩部，以提升性能。 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.43 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: The 'Vollstrecker', or Executioner, is a Steiner Elite Battlemech, agile like a medium 'Mech and armed to the Teeth, is this a true Lyran Military doctrine Scout.
column2: “Vollstrecker”，或称刽子手，是一款斯坦纳精英战机，像中型机甲一样敏捷，武装到牙齿，这是真正的天琴座军事学说侦察兵。

column1: The '机甲's Primary Configuration weaponry includes a Class 5 转管自动炮 and an ER Small Laser found in the right arm. The Autocannon has two tons of ammunition is found in its right torso with CASE II. In its left arm is a single Large 变速脉冲激光. The Prime uses some advanced electronics to give it an advantage on the battlefield; these include a C3 boosted slave to increase its accuracy in combat, and an Angel ECM Suite, which gives the '机甲 some considerable electronic warfare capacities. 怪癖: Variable Range 定位 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: 主要配置的武器包括右臂的一门 5 级转管自动炮和一门增程小型激光器。自动加农炮的两吨弹药存放在右侧躯干，并由 CASE II 保护。左臂安装一门大型变速脉冲激光器。Prime 型使用先进电子设备获得战场优势，包括由 C3 增强的从机以提高作战精度，以及赋予机甲强大电子战能力的天使 ECM 套件。 怪癖: 可变射程瞄准 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1: The '机甲's most prominent weapon is the TSEMP磁脉冲炮, which enable it to potentially disable an opponent. The cannon is backed up by a MML-3 and a single ER 中型激光器, and to fulfill its infantry support role, the '机甲 carries three heavy machine guns. The '机甲 is powered by a GM 210-rated extralight fusion 引擎, which gives it enough speed to keep up with most combat 车辆s. The '机甲's hull is protected by six and a half tons of standard 装甲 and standard CASE is protects ammunition stored in the left torso. 怪癖: 改进的 Communications 掉落成本乘数: 1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper
column2: 机甲最突出的武器是 TSEMP 磁脉冲炮，有可能使敌人失去行动能力。该火炮由一具 MML-3 和一门增程中型激光器支援；为执行步兵支援任务，机甲还携带三挺重型机枪。它由 GM 210 级超轻聚变引擎驱动，速度足以跟上大多数战斗车辆。机体由六吨半标准装甲保护，左侧躯干储存的弹药由标准 CASE 防护。 怪癖: 改进的 通信系统 掉落成本乘数: 1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂

column1: The '机甲's primary configuration allows it to be effective at both medium and long ranges. Its primary armament is a rotary AC/5 with three tons of ammo protected by CASE II, while for shorter ranges it carries a single ER 中型激光器. A light TAG is carried for target 设计ation. Ten double heat sinks are sufficient to keep the '机甲 cool, under most circumstances. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: 机甲的基础配置能够在中远距离有效作战。主要武器是一门转管自动炮/5，配备3吨CASE II保护弹药；近距离则携带一门ER中型激光器。轻型TAG用于标定目标。10组双重散热器在大多数情况下足以让机甲保持冷却。 怪癖: 干扰 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The -015 carries a 银弹高斯 Rifle in the right arm and a Light PPC with Twin Linked Capacitor in the left, making it a fearsome foe at medium to long ranges. A head mounted AMS Mk2 provides defensive capabilities. 特性：泰克铁康TC7000 部署成本倍率：1.45 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Upper
column2: -015 在右臂装备一门银弹高斯步枪，左臂装备带双联电容器的轻型 PPC，因此在中远距离都是可怕的敌人。头部安装的 AMS Mk2 提供防御能力。 特性：泰克铁康 TC7000 部署成本倍率：1.45 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Upper

column1: The -02 variant is designed as a missile boat, replacing the Ultra AC/10s with two Doombud LRM-20s, three tons of ammo for each, and a pair of Medium Pulse Lasers.
column2: -02 型被设计成导弹艇，用两具 Doombud LRM-20 替换 Ultra AC/10，每具配备三吨弹药，并加装两门中型脉冲激光器。

column1: The -0H is quite different from the other Longbow variants whose designation starts with -0x. The combination of two PPCs and 26 火箭发射器s makes a unusual pairing and the purpose of the 'Mech can be seen as quite niched toward sudden alpha strikes. Quirk: 防空瞄准系统 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: -0H 与其他编号以 -0x 开头的长弓型号截然不同。它将两门 PPC 与 26 具火箭发射器组合在一起，配置颇为独特；这台机甲显然专为突然发动齐射打击而设计。 特性：先进瞄准系统 部署费用倍率：1.13 手臂执行器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The -0H is quite different from the other Longbow variants whose designation starts with -0x. The combination of two PPCs and 26 火箭发射器s makes a unusual pairing and the purpose of the 'Mech can be seen as quite niched toward sudden alpha strikes. 特性：防空瞄准系统 部署成本倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: -0H与其他以-0x开头的Longbow变型完全不同。两门PPC和26具火箭发射器形成不寻常的组合，使这台机甲专注于突然发动全弹齐射。 特性：防空瞄准系统 部署成本倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The -12S builds upon the endo-steel chassis of prior models, upgrading it with a home-built Clan-grade engine and lasers. The weight savings enabled Defiance’s engineers to follow the weaponry layout of the -3S. Armor levels match the toughest Banshees, creating a very strong and fast assault ’Mech, albeit one with a challenging heat curve. Alpha-striking will shut the ’Mech down, so MechWarriors are advised to use either the main or secondary weapons, but not both at once.
column2: -12S型以旧型号的内骨骼钢底盘为基础，升级为自制的氏族级引擎和激光器。减重后，Defiance工程师得以采用-3S型的武器布局。装甲水平足以匹敌最坚固的Banshee，造就了一台强悍而迅捷的突击机甲，但散热曲线相当棘手。全弹齐射会令机甲停机，因此建议机甲战士在主武器和副武器之间择一使用，不要同时开火。

column1: The -12S builds upon the endo-steel chassis of prior models, upgrading it with a home-built Clan-grade engine and lasers. The weight savings enabled Defiance’s engineers to follow the weaponry layout of the -3S. Alpha-striking will shut the ’Mech down, so MechWarriors are advised to use either the main or secondary weapons, but not both at once. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.17 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: -12S 建立在先前型号的内钢底盘的基础上，并使用自制的 Clan 级发动机和激光器对其进行了升级。重量的减轻使 Defiance 的工程师能够遵循 -3S 的武器布局。装甲水平与最坚韧的女妖相匹配，创造出一种非常强大和快速的攻击机甲，尽管它具有挑战性的热曲线。阿尔法打击会关闭机甲，因此建议机甲战士使用主武器或副武器，但不要同时使用两者。 怪癖： Rugged 下降成本乘数：1.17 Arm执行器限制：左下

column1: The -4L was the only variant of the Gnat to be sold in the Inner Sphere as well. By switching to Double instead of single Heat Sinks, the variant can without issues run a total of four ER 中型激光s while still keeping its probe and ECM. 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: -4L 是 Gnat 唯一同时销往内圈的型号。改用双散热器后，它能无压力运行四具 ER 中型激光器，同时保留探针和 ECM。 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: The -4S variant, that first saw use during the FedCom Civil War, is intended for close-range combat. The vulnerable XL Engine has been replaced with a sturdier Light Fusion Engine, and has been redesigned to use an Endo Steel internal structure. The 'Mech is armed with a 重型高斯步枪 as its primary weapon. This is backed up by a 大型脉冲激光, two 中型脉冲激光s, and a pair of ER 中型激光s. Quirk: 超伸展驱动器 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1
column2: -4S 型号首次在联邦—联邦共和国内战期间投入使用，专为近距离战斗设计。脆弱的 XL 引擎被更坚固的轻型聚变引擎取代，内部结构也改为 Endo Steel。该机甲以一门重型高斯步枪为主武器，并辅以一门中型 X-Pulse 激光、两门大型 X-Pulse 激光和一对 ER 中型激光。 特性：改进型扩展弹药 部署费用倍率：1.1

column1: The -4S variant, that first saw use during the FedCom Civil War, is intended for close-range combat. The vulnerable XL引擎 has been replaced with a sturdier Light Fusion 引擎, and has been re设计ed to use an Endo Steel internal 结构. The '机甲 is armed with a Heavy Gauss Rifle as its primary weapon. This is backed up by a Large Pulse Laser, two Medium Pulse Lasers, and a pair of ER 中型激光器. 怪癖: Hyper-Extending Actuators 掉落成本乘数: 1.1
column2: -4S型最早在联邦-康联内战期间投入使用，定位是近距离战斗。脆弱的XL引擎被更坚固的轻型聚变引擎取代，内部结构也改为远端钢。该机甲以重型高斯步枪作为主武器，并由一门大型脉冲激光器、两门中型脉冲激光器和两门ER中型激光器提供支援。 特性：超伸展作动器 部署成本倍率：1.1

column1: The -5M is 设计ed to be a support force, using its 变色龙偏振护盾 to protect its whereabouts before delivering a long range strike. The combination of an Arrow IV launcher and a 重击者火炮 means the '机甲 can handle most support assignments, and two LRM-20 launchers provide more accurate firepower as needed. Two small mortars are used to deploy smoke as needed on the battlefield. The Serket 5M's major flaw is it lack of speed, it only brings a 275 engine core meaning almost any foe can easily catch it once detected. 怪癖: Multi Trac 掉落成本乘数: 1.32
column2: -5M型被设计为支援单位，利用变色龙偏振护盾隐藏自身位置，然后发动远程打击。箭IV发射器与重击者火炮的组合，使这台机甲能够承担大多数支援任务；两具LRM-20发射器则在需要时提供更精准的火力。两门小型迫击炮用于在战场上按需布置烟幕。Serket 5M的主要缺陷是速度不足，它只有275级引擎核心，一旦暴露，几乎任何敌人都能轻易追上。 怪癖：多重追踪 掉落成本乘数：1.32

column1: The -8M combine MML and LRM launchers, together with one of the most common and easily maintained ballistic weapons in the Periphery, the Heavy Rifle. Two Brightbloom ER 中型激光s and a Blazefire ER Large Laser finish up the weapons loadout of the -8M. 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.36 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: -8M结合MML和LRM发射器，并采用边疆最常见、最易维护的弹道武器之一——重型步枪。两门Brightbloom ER中型激光器和一门Blazefire ER大型激光器完成-8M的武器配置。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.36 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The -B4 is focused on clustering ballistic weapons through its combination of LB-X AC/20 and 银弹高斯. Having not other weapons, it keeps to the design change of the second generation Uberjager to only focus on its ballistic weapons. 特性：精准武器—弹道 部署成本倍率：1.27 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: -B4通过LB-X AC/20和银弹高斯的组合，专注于集中使用弹道武器。由于没有其他武器，它延续了第二代Uberjager只专注弹道火力的设计变化。 特性：精准武器—弹道 部署成本倍率：1.27 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The -C1 was 设计ed in response to both A and B series of the Uberjager not meeting the customer's needs. With this new line of 设计s, Independence Weaponry again returns to adding secondary weapons by popular request, in the form of Light PPCs and 小型脉冲激光s, in addition the the main armaments of four Superheavy Rotary AC/2. As a last touch, to enable fitting all the heavy weaponry the 引擎 has been upgraded to an XXL. 怪癖: 精准 Weapon - Ballistics 掉落成本乘数: 1.27 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: -C1 是为解决 Uberjager A、B 系列无法满足客户需求而设计的改型。Independence Weaponry 应大众要求重新加入副武器，采用轻型 PPC 和小型脉冲激光器，配合四门超重型旋转 AC/2。最后，为容纳全部重型武器，引擎升级为 XXL 型号。 怪癖：精准武器 - Ballistics 掉落成本乘数: 1.27 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: The -DD is the latest variant of the 70 ton JM7 line of the JagerMech. An XL gyro and Endo-Composite skeleton let Kallon Weapon Industries apply modern upgrades. The JagerMech’s signature twin autocannons are now Clan-spec Ultra autocannons, supplemented by light autocannons. CASE II envelops its enlarged ammo bays, a dual comfort to pilots. Federated Suns MechWarriors of course love autocannons, and they have welcomed the new JM7-DD with open arms. Quirk: Anti-Air Targeting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: -DD 是 70 吨 JagerMech JM7 系列的最新型号。XL 陀螺仪和 Endo-Composite 骨架让 Kallon Weapon Industries 得以采用现代化升级。JagerMech 标志性的双自动炮现已升级为氏族规格 Ultra Autocannon，并辅以轻型自动炮。CASE II 包覆扩大的弹药舱，让驾驶员倍感安心。联邦太阳共和国的机甲战士当然热爱自动炮，他们热烈欢迎全新的 JM7-DD。 特质：反空瞄准 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The -Er is a recent refit of the SG11-E to focus more on firepower over ruggedness. By dropping the Binary Lasers in favor of Large Pulser Lasers managed to upgrade the MRM-10 to MRM-30 launchers and adding two ER Medium Lasers, and the Heavy Duty Gyro and Reactive Plates have been exchanged for weight saving options. The final change of the refit is the switch to Compact Heat Sinks. Quirk: Improved Lifesupport Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.4
column2: -Er 是 SG11-E 最近的改装版，更加注重火力而不是坚固性。通过放弃二元激光器而代之以大型脉冲激光器，成功地将 MRM-10 发射器升级为 MRM-30 发射器，并添加了两个 ER 中型激光器，并且重型陀螺仪和反应板已更换为减轻重量的选项。改装的最后一个变化是改用紧凑型散热器。 Quirk：改进的生命支持 下降成本乘数： 1.4

column1: The -S3-DC subvariant of the -S3 replaces the two Small Lasers and two heatsinks with a Command Cockpit. The variant quickly became the main command Atlas within the Lyran forces.
column2: -S3-DC 子变体用指挥驾驶舱替换 -S3 的两门小型激光器和两组散热器。该变体很快成为莱拉军队的主力指挥 Atlas。

column1: The 002 is a variant sometimes found on the Capellan Confederation's and Free Worlds League's planets and operations. Four ER 中型激光s and three MML-9 launchers are mounted as secondary weapons, making the design more versatile. 特性：指挥机甲 部署成本倍率：1.34 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 002 是一种有时出现在卡佩兰联邦和自由世界联盟行星及行动中的改型。四具 ER 中型激光器和三具 MML-9 发射器作为副武器，使设计更加灵活。 特性：指挥机甲 部署成本倍率：1.34 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: The 005 King Crab is an upgraded version of the 000 model introduced in 3062. The autocannons have been upgraded to LB-X Autocannon/20s and the large laser has been upgraded to an ER Large Laser. The LRM-15 has been completely removed from the ‘Mech and replaced with two Streak SRM-4s. The final upgrade is the inclusion of an improved C3 computer to allow the King Crab to work in concert with up to five other units sharing targeting telemetry.
column2: 005 型 King Crab 是 3062 年推出的 000 型升级版。自动火炮升级为 LB-X 自动火炮/20，大型激光器升级为增程大型激光器。LRM-15 被从机甲上完全拆除，换成两具 Streak SRM-4。最后的升级是加装改进型 C3 计算机，使 King Crab 能与最多五个共享目标遥测数据的单位协同作战。
