The final upgrade is the inclusion of an improved C3 computer to allow the King Crab to work in concert with up to five other units sharing targeting telemetry. Quirk: Command Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: 005帝王蟹是3062年推出的000型号的升级版。自动炮已升级为LB-X自动炮/20s，大型激光器已升级为ER大型激光器。 LRM-15 已从“Mech”中完全移除，并替换为两架 Streak SRM-4。最终升级包括改进的 C3 计算机，使帝王蟹能够与最多五个共享目标遥测的其他单元协同工作。 Quirk：命令Mech 下降成本乘数：1.18 Arm执行器限制：左上，右上

column1: The 125-ton Hyaenodont OmniMech is a long-range support platform fielded by the Minnesota Tribe and constructed by Twin Forge Assemblies. Built on an Endo-Steel frame and powered by a 355-rated XL engine, it specializes in providing withering fire support from a distance, often anchoring the rear line of superheavy formations. It is clad in Ferro-Silk armor, a fragile yet lightweight steel-polymer lattice developed by Northern Meshworks, allowing for greater weapon mass at the expense of durability, consistent with the Tribe’s doctrine of prioritizing firepower above protection. Its name comes from an ancient Terran apex predator known for its bone-crushing bite and grim persistence, an icon preserved in Clan Wolverine mythos. Revived as a 'Mech by the Tribe, the Hyaenodont reflects their philosophy of overwhelming force and relentless pressure, hammering enemies down until there’s nothing left to resist.
column2: 125 吨的 Hyaenodont 全能机甲是明尼苏达部落部署的远程支援平台，由 Twin Forge Assemblies 建造。它采用内骨骼框架和 355 级 XL 引擎，专精于从远距离提供猛烈火力，常作为超重型编队的后卫支点。它披覆 Ferro-Silk 装甲，这种由 Northern Meshworks 开发的钢聚合物晶格轻薄却脆弱，以耐久性换取更大的武器重量，符合部落重火力、轻防护的理念。它的名字来自 Terra 古代一种以碎骨利齿和顽强意志闻名的顶级掠食者，也是狼氏族神话中保存的象征。部落将其复活为机甲后，Hyaenodont 体现了以压倒性力量和持续压力碾碎敌人的理念，直到对手再无抵抗之力。

column1: The 12R is a cut above many of the other variants with the inclusion of some stealth armor and a Clan ER Large Laser to bring respectable firepower and range for an Ostscout.
column2: 12R型比许多其他改型更胜一筹，配备隐身装甲和氏族ER大型激光，为Ostscout带来可靠的火力和射程。

column1: The 170 ton Stalker IV superheavy 'Mech, or the SuperStalker as commonly known amongst MechWarriors, is the creation of the best minds at the Republic Institute for Strategic Combat (RISC). It is an attempt to convert the otherwise somewhat fragile Stalker to a true superheavy juggernaut, combining the experimental Superheavy Ferro-Alloy armor with a reinforced structure and a heavy duty gyro. All together this creates an extremely durable basis for the rest of the 'Mech, although limited in free space and available weight capacity.
column2: 170 吨的 Stalker IV 超重型机甲，也就是机甲战士口中的 SuperStalker，是共和国战略战斗研究所（RISC）顶尖人才的成果。它试图把略显脆弱的 Stalker 改造成真正的超重型主宰，结合实验型超重型 Ferro-Alloy 装甲、强化结构和重型陀螺仪，形成极其坚固的基础，但可用空间和剩余载荷有限。

column1: The 2B variant of the Snake is a modification of the 'Mech that uses Stealth Armor to make the 'Mech harder to target. In order to do this one of the Streak SRM-2 launchers has been removed from the 'Mech and an ECM Suite has been added to the 'Mech.
column2: Snake 2B 型号使用隐形装甲，使机甲更难被锁定。为此，它拆除了一具 Streak SRM-2 发射器，并加装 ECM 套件。

column1: The 2B variant of the Snake is a modification of the 'Mech that uses 隐身装甲 to make the 'Mech harder to target. In order to do this one of the 锁定式SRM-2 launchers has been removed from the 'Mech and an ECM Suite has been added to the 'Mech.
column2: 蛇型 2B 是使用隐身装甲、让机甲更难被锁定的改进型号。为此，机甲拆除一具锁定式 SRM-2 发射器，并增加 ECM 套件。

column1: The 2B variant of the Vanquisher makes up roughly fifteen percent of the current production run. This variant carries four Ultra Autocannon/5s in place of the Light Gauss Rifles and ER Large Lasers. While this variant is much more reliant on ammunition based weapons, the four Ultra Autocannon/5s allow the 'Mech to put more fire downrange at a somewhat shorter range envelope than the 2A variant.
column2: 征服者 2B 型约占当前产量的 15%。该变体用四门超速 AC/5 取代轻型高斯步枪和增程大型激光器。它更加依赖弹药武器，但四门超速 AC/5 能在比 2A 型略短的射程内倾泻更多火力。

column1: The 2B variant of the Vanquisher makes up roughly fifteen percent of the current production run. This variant carries four 超级自动炮/5s in place of the 轻型高斯步枪s and ER Large Lasers. While this variant is much more reliant on ammunition based weapons, the four 超级自动炮/5s allow the 'Mech to put more fire downrange at a somewhat shorter range envelope than the 2A variant.
column2: Vanquisher 的 2B 分型约占当前产量的百分之十五。该分型以四门超级自动炮/5 取代了轻型高斯步枪和 ER 大型激光。虽然它更加依赖弹药武器，但四门超级自动炮/5 能让机甲在比 2A 略短的有效射程内倾泻更密集的火力。

column1: The 2D variant of the Argus was the original Argus configuration, designed as a long range support mech. Outfitted for long range combat at extreme ranges, it carried a pair of Artemis IV enhanced LRM 15s and an ER PPC.
column2: Argus 的 2D 型是最初的 Argus 配置，定位为远程支援机甲。它为极远距离作战而装备，搭载两具 Artemis IV 增强型 LRM-15 和一门增程 PPC。

column1: The 2M is a Minnesota Tribe upgrade variant of the old royal 1Gb. A pair enhanced PPCs, one of those Ion Stream Projectors, and a quintet of medium lasers makes this thing a nightmare. The Thermal Overload System and Particle Recyclers are just icing on the cake.
column2: 2M 是明尼苏达部族对旧皇家 1Gb 的升级型号。一对强化 PPC、一台离子流投射器和五门中型激光，让这台机甲变成噩梦。热过载系统和粒子回收器更是锦上添花。

column1: The 2M is a 明尼苏达部落 upgrade variant of the old royal 1Gb. A pair enhanced PPCs, one of those Ion Stream Projectors, and a quintet of 中型激光器 makes this thing a nightmare. The Thermal Overload System and Particle Recyclers are just icing on the cake.
column2: 2M是明尼苏达部落对旧式皇家1Gb的升级型。两门增强型PPC、一门离子流投射器和五门中型激光器让它成为噩梦。热量过载系统和粒子回收器只是锦上添花。

column1: The 3 answers the demands from the market, first produced in 3092. Based on the 2 variant, engineers removed the ATM-6s, which free enough space to add two ER medium lasers in each arm. The number of double heat sinks was increased to 22 for continued fighting over a longer period of time.
column2: 3 型号回应市场需求，于 3092 年首次生产。它以 2 型号为基础，拆除 ATM-6，从而腾出空间在每条手臂加装两门增程中型激光。双重散热器数量增加至 22 具，以便长时间持续作战。

column1: The 3 answers the demands from the market, first produced in 3092. Based on the 2 variant, engineers removed the ATM-6s, which free enough space to add two ER 中型激光器 in each arm. The number of double heat sinks was increased to 22 for continued fighting over a longer period of time.
column2: 3 型用于满足市场需求，于 3092 年首次生产。工程师以 2 型为基础移除 ATM-6，为每条手臂增加两具 ER 中型激光器，并将双散热器数量提高到 22 具，以便长时间持续作战。

column1: The 3064 2C variant of the Komodo removes the TAG unit from the 'Mech. The TAG designator is replaced with a C3 Slave unit. The 'Mech is capable of sharing targeting data with other friendly units, making the 'Mech and its lance mates extremely accurate.
column2: Komodo 的 3064 年 2C 型移除了机甲上的 TAG 单元，改为 C3 从属单元。该机甲能够与其他友军分享目标数据，使自身和同伴小队拥有极高的命中精度。

column1: The 3C is intended to spar with its enemies at long range. The 'Mech replaced the LB 20-X AC with a powerful Gauss Rifle. Additionally, the 3C removed the LRM-15 in favor of three LRM-5 launchers, giving it the same firepower but allowing it to spread it over a greater number of targets.
column2: 3C 旨在与敌人在远距离交战。它用强力高斯步枪替换 LB 20-X AC，并拆除 LRM-15，换成三具 LRM-5 发射器；火力相同，但可以分散攻击更多目标。

column1: The 3C variant that entered service in 3064, is a radical modification of the Komodo that makes it capable of commanding a C3 lance. This is done by removing two double heat sinks and two Medium Lasers as well as the TAG designator and adding a C3 Master Computer.
column2: Komodo 3C 型于 3064 年服役，是一次重大改型，使其能够指挥 C3 机甲小队。改装方式是拆除两台双倍散热器、两门中型激光器和 TAG 指示器，并加装 C3 主机。

column1: The 3C variant that entered service in 3064, is a radical modification of the Komodo that makes it capable of commanding a C3 lance. This is done by removing two double heat sinks and two 中型激光s as well as the TAG designator and adding a C3 Master Computer.
column2: 3064年服役的3C变型是Komodo的激进改装型，使其能够指挥一个C3小队。改装拆除两组双重散热器、两门中型激光器和TAG标定器，增加一具C3主计算机。

column1: The 3D variant is designed as a direct fire mech. 2 UAC/5's and LRM-10 provide the bulk of the firepower, whilst a Machine Gun and two Medium Lasers provide close in protection.
column2: 3D 型号专为直射火力设计。两门 UAC/5 和一具 LRM-10 提供主要火力，机枪和两门中型激光则负责近距离防护。

column1: The 3D variant is designed as a direct fire mech. 2 UAC/5's and LRM-10 provide the bulk of the firepower, whilst a Machine Gun and two 中型激光s provide close in protection.
column2: 3D变型设计为直射机甲。两门UAC/5和一具LRM-10构成主要火力，机枪和两门中型激光器则提供近距离防护。

column1: The 3LL is an alternative to the 3L, replacing the ER PPC with a ER Large Laser. The savings in weight permits adding one double heat sink and an additional ton of armor. Range and damage would be reduced, but the added protection and ability to fire both main weapons while in stealth mode – with no chance of overheating – is too good to resist.
column2: 3LL 是 3L 的替代型号，以一门增程大型激光替换增程 PPC。减重后可增加一具双重散热器和一吨装甲。虽然射程和伤害降低，但额外防护以及在隐身模式下同时开火两件主武器而不会过热的能力实在难以拒绝。

column1: The 3LL is an alternative to the 3L, replacing the ER PPC with a ER Large Laser. The savings in weight permits adding one double heat sink and an additional ton of armor. Range and damage would be reduced, but the added protection and ability to fire both main weapons while in stealth mode – with no chance of overheating – is too good to resist. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 3LL 是 3L 的替代型号，以一门增程大型激光器取代增程 PPC。节省的重量可增加一台双倍散热器和一吨装甲。虽然射程和伤害都会降低，但额外防护以及隐形模式下可同时发射两种主武器且不会过热的优势实在难以拒绝。 特性：战斗拳套 部署费用倍率：1.05

column1: The 3LL is an alternative to the 3L, replacing the ER PPC with a ER Large Laser. The savings in weight permits adding one double heat sink and an additional ton of 装甲. Range and damage would be reduced, but the added protection and ability to fire both main weapons while in stealth mode – with no chance of overheating – is too good to resist.
column2: 3LL是3L的替代型，用ER大型激光器替换ER PPC。节省的重量允许增加一组双重散热器和一吨装甲。射程与伤害会降低，但额外防护以及隐形模式下可同时发射两种主武器且不会过热的能力实在难以拒绝。

column1: The 3S variant of the Stealth is built using reverse engineered Stealth Armor. The 'Mech is armed with a single ER PPC which has a very long range. The ER PPCs long range and the Stealth Armor combine to make the 3S an almost perfect sniper 'Mech.
column2: 隐形 3S 型采用逆向工程仿制的隐形装甲。机甲配备一门射程极远的增程 PPC。增程 PPC 的远射程与隐形装甲相结合，使 3S 几乎成为完美的狙击机甲。

column1: The 3S variant of the Stealth is built using reverse engineered 隐身装甲. The 'Mech is armed with a single ER PPC which has a very long range. The ER PPCs long range and the 隐身装甲 combine to make the 3S an almost perfect sniper 'Mech.
column2: Stealth 3S型采用逆向工程获得的隐身装甲。机甲装备一门射程极远的增程PPC。增程PPC的长射程与隐身装甲相结合，使3S成为近乎完美的狙击机甲。

column1: The 3W is a Word of Blake variant that was reconfigured at the refitted factories on Hall. It strips the weapons and replaces them with four Krupp MML-9s that allow the Viking access to both SRM and LRM munitions and with seven tons of ammunition, it is almost guaranteed to have both. The close-support weapons were replaced with a pair of Skobel Little 20 Light AC/2s and a pair of Hovertec Streak SRM-2s that seem ancient by comparison. This variant is protected by seventeen and a half tons of armor, but does not add any heat sinks. Of course, all the weapons are aided by the inclusion of a C3i Computer.
column2: 3W 是 Blake 圣言型号，在 Hall 翻修后的工厂重新配置。它拆除原武器，换成四具 Krupp MML-9，让 Viking 能使用 SRM 和 LRM 弹药；七吨弹药几乎确保两种弹药都有储备。近距离支援武器换成一对 Skobel Little 20 轻型 AC/2 和一对相比之下显得古老的 Hovertec Streak SRM-2。该型号有 17.5 吨装甲，但未增加散热器。当然，所有武器都由 C3i 计算机辅助。

column1: The 3W is a 布雷克圣言会 variant that was reconfigured at the refitted factories on Hall. It strips the weapons and replaces them with four Krupp MML-9s that allow the Viking access to both SRM and LRM munitions and with seven tons of ammunition, it is almost guaranteed to have both. The close-support weapons were replaced with a pair of Skobel Little 20 Light AC/2s and a pair of Hovertec 锁定式SRM-2s that seem ancient by comparison. This variant is protected by seventeen and a half tons of armor, but does not add any heat sinks. Of course, all the weapons are aided by the inclusion of a C3i Computer.
column2: 3W 型是布雷克圣言会的一个型号，在霍尔的翻修工厂重新配置。它拆除原有武器，换成四具 Krupp MML-9，使维京能够使用 SRM 和 LRM 弹药；凭借 7 吨弹药，几乎可以同时满足两者需求。近距离支援武器则替换为两门 Skobel Little 20 轻型 AC/2 和两门 Hovertec 锁定式 SRM-2，相比之下显得十分古老。该型号配备 17.5 吨装甲，但没有增加散热器。当然，所有武器都由 C3i 计算机辅助。

column1: The 4D adds a Davion touch to the Sentinel. The SRM launcher has been completely done away with on this model and the Ultra Autocannon has been replaced with a rotary model. The Medium Laser from the 3M version has been upgraded to an ER Medium Laser, and its five and a half tons of standard armor have been replaced with seven tons of Ferro-Fibrous plate.
column2: 4D 为 Sentinel 注入了 Davion 风格。该型号完全拆除 SRM 发射器，并将 Ultra Autocannon 换成旋转型号。3M 型号的中型激光升级为增程中型激光，5.5 吨标准装甲则换成七吨铁磁纤维装甲。

column1: The 4D adds a Davion touch to the Sentinel. The SRM launcher has been completely done away with on this model and the 超级自动炮 has been replaced with a rotary model. The 中型激光 from the 3M version has been upgraded to an ER 中型激光, and its five and a half tons of standard 装甲 have been replaced with seven tons of 铁纤维装甲 plate.
column2: 4D为Sentinel加入了Davion特色。该型号完全拆除SRM发射器，用转管型号替换超级自动炮。3M的中型激光器升级为ER中型激光器，5.5吨标准装甲则替换为7吨铁纤维装甲板。

column1: The 4GLS is a simple upgrade of the 2GLS which replaces both Large Lasers with two ER Large Lasers and the 中型脉冲激光 with an ER 中型激光. The saved weight is used to make the 4GLS capable of jumping up to one hundred and twenty meters. Quirk: 易于驾驶 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 4GLS 是 2GLS 的简单升级型：两门大型激光均替换为 ER 大型激光，脉冲中型激光则替换为 ER 中型激光。节省下来的重量使 4GLS 的跳跃距离达到 120 米。 特性：易于驾驶 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂执行器限制：右下臂

column1: The 4GLS is a simple upgrade of the 2GLS which replaces both Large Lasers with two ER Large Lasers and the 中型脉冲激光 with an ER 中型激光. The saved weight is used to make the 4GLS capable of jumping up to one hundred and twenty 米. 怪癖: 易于驾驶 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: 4GLS 是 2GLS 的简单升级型，用两具 ER 大型激光器替换原有的两具大型激光器，并以一具 ER 中型激光器替换中型脉冲激光器。节省的重量使 4GLS 能够一次跳跃一百二十米。 怪癖: 易于驾驶 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower

column1: The 4HP is a further modified 4H, which mounts an ER PPC and medium laser in each arm supported by quad 火箭发射器 20s in each side torso. Built around a 300-rated standard engine and three jump jets, nineteen tons of standard armor, twenty one single heat sinks, giving it a higher heat curve but more survivability in combat than the 4H. The design was exclusively used by various pirate groups. Quirk: 窄小低矮轮廓 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 4HP 是对 4H 的进一步改进型：每条手臂各装有一门 ER PPC 和一门中型激光，两侧躯干则各有四具 Rocket Launcher 20 发射器作为支援。机体采用 300 级标准引擎和 3 具跳跃喷射器，配备 19 吨标准装甲与 21 台单散热器。与 4H 相比，它的热量负荷更高，但在战斗中生存能力更强。该设计仅被多个海盗团体使用。 特性：灵活小型支援 部署费用倍率：1.18 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: The 4HP is a further modified 4H, which mounts an ER PPC and 中型激光器 in each arm supported by quad 火箭发射器 20s in each side torso. Built around a 300-rated standard 引擎 and three jump jets, nineteen tons of standard 装甲, twenty one single heat sinks, giving it a higher heat curve but more survivability in combat than the 4H. The 设计 was exclusively used by various pirate groups. 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 4HP是4H的进一步改装型，双臂各安装一门ER PPC和一门中型激光器，两侧躯干各装四具火箭发射器20。它以300额定标准引擎和三具跳跃喷射器为核心，配备19吨标准装甲和21组单重散热器；相比4H热量曲线更高，但战斗生存性更强。该设计仅由多个海盗团体使用。 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: The 4L Vindicator is a major upgrade to the design, part of 塞雷斯金属' efforts to revive the line in 3063. The engine has been replaced with a 225-rated XL engine, granting the 'Mech a top speed of 86.4 km/h, and its jumping distance was increased to 150 meters with an additional jump jet. The 'Mech uses double heat sinks for its advanced weapons load, which includes an ER PPC and LRM-5 for striking power at long range and an ER medium laser and medium pulse laser for short range work. Finally, the 'Mech carries a 守护者ECM Suite and is protected with nine tons of 隐身装甲, making it harder to target at range. The 4L became a common design among Shadow Lances following their introduction. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 4L 是对设计的重大升级，属于 Ceres Metals 于 3063 年重振该产品线的计划之一。机体引擎升级为 225 级 XL 引擎，使最高速度达到 86.4 公里/小时；增加一具跳跃喷射器后，跳跃距离也提高至 150 米。它使用双重散热器支持先进武器配置：ER PPC 和 LRM-5 负责远程打击，ER 中型激光与中型脉冲激光用于近战。最后，机体还配备 Guardian ECM 套件，并以 9 吨隐形装甲提供防护。 特性：改进型稳定性 部署费用倍率：1.02 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: The 4L Vindicator is a major upgrade to the 设计, part of 塞雷斯金属' efforts to revive the line in 3063. The 引擎 has been replaced with a 225-rated XL引擎, granting the '机甲 a top speed of 86.4 km/h, and its jumping distance was increased to 150 米 with an additional jump jet. The '机甲 uses double heat sinks for its advanced weapons load, which includes an ER PPC and LRM-5 for striking power at long range and an ER 中型激光器 and medium pulse laser for short range work. Finally, the '机甲 carries a 守护者ECM Suite and is protected with nine tons of Stealth 装甲, making it harder to target at range. The 4L became a common 设计 among Shadow Lances following their introduction. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: 4L是Vindicator的大幅升级型，属于塞雷斯金属于3063年复兴该系列的努力。引擎被替换为225额定XL引擎，使机甲最高速度达到86.4 km/h；增加一具跳跃喷射器后，跳跃距离提升至150米。机甲使用双重散热器支持先进武器配置，包括ER PPC和LRM-5提供远程打击力，以及ER中型激光器和中型脉冲激光器用于近战。最后，机甲携带守护者ECM套件，并以9吨隐形装甲提供防护，使其更难被远距离锁定。4L推出后成为Shadow Lances的常见设计。 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 下臂

column1: The 4L was a variant built for the Capellan Confederation by 塞雷斯金属 starting in 3066. The 设计 used a Taurian-生产 standard engine for power and was built around a Endo Steel skeleton. The '机甲 carried an ER large laser in its right forearm as its primary weapon, joined by two ER medium lasers in the left and right arm for secondary weapons. It also mounted a machine gun in either arm, with half a ton of reloads carried in the center torso. The six jump jets split between the rear side torsos were also upgraded from the original, being specially 设计ed to protect the exhaust ports and improve cooling during operation. One of the more radical changes was the use of eight tons of 塞雷斯金属 Stealth 装甲, making the 凤鹰 harder to target at range. 怪癖: 改进的 Communications 掉落成本乘数: 1.03
column2: 4L型是塞雷斯金属自3066年起为卡佩兰联邦制造的改型。该设计使用陶里安生产的标准引擎，并以内骨骼钢为核心。机甲右前臂装备一门ER大型激光，两条手臂各装一门ER中型激光；每条手臂还装有机枪，中央躯干携带半吨弹药。后侧躯干分布的六具跳跃喷射器经过升级，专门保护排气口并改善运行散热。更激进的变化是采用8吨塞雷斯金属隐身装甲，使凤凰更难被远距离锁定。 怪癖：改进的通信 掉落成本乘数：1.03

column1: The 4U variant of the Albatross is a basic upgrade of the design. The 'Mech replaces the Medium Lasers with a pair of ER Medium Lasers. The 'Mech also replaces the LB-X Autocannon/10 with a Light Gauss Rifle. The SRM-6 launcher has also been replaced with a Streak SRM-6launcher.
column2: 信天翁 4U 型是该设计的基础升级款。它以两门增程中型激光器取代中型激光器，并以一门轻型高斯步枪取代 LB-X AC/10。SRM-6 发射器也换成了一具连发 SRM-6 发射器。

column1: The 4U variant of the Albatross is a basic upgrade of the design. The 'Mech replaces the 中型激光s with a pair of ER 中型激光s. The 'Mech also replaces the LB-X Autocannon/10 with a 轻型高斯步枪. The SRM-6 launcher has also been replaced with a 锁定式SRM-6launcher.
column2: Albatross 的 4U 变体是该设计的基础升级型。机甲将中型激光器替换为两门增程中型激光器，并将 LB-X 自动火炮/10 替换为高斯步枪。SRM-6 发射器也被替换为一具 Streak SRM-6。

column1: The 4Z variant of the Pillager is built to provide an almost perfect long range sniper 'Mech. The new Stealth armor makes it harder to hit, as does the required 守护者ECM Suite. In order to do fit these changes, the 'Mech has had two medium lasers and the Large Laser removed. The remaining medium lasers have been upgraded to ER medium lasers. The Pillager has also replaced the XL engine with a standard engine and added CASE for more reliability, so the 'Mech can survive a side torso destruction. Quirk: 战斗铁拳 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.18
column2: 掠夺者 4Z 型号旨在成为近乎完美的远程狙击机甲。新型隐身装甲和必需的守护者 ECM 套件让它更难被命中。为容纳这些改动，机甲拆除两门中型激光器和一门大型激光器，并将剩余中型激光器升级为 ER 中型激光器。掠夺者还把 XL 引擎替换为标准引擎，并增加 CASE 以提高可靠性，使机甲能够承受侧躯干被摧毁。 特性：战斗铁拳 部署费用倍率：1.18

column1: The 4Z variant of the Pillager is built to provide an almost perfect long range sniper '机甲. The new Stealth 装甲 makes it harder to hit, as does the required 守护者ECM Suite. In order to do fit these changes, the '机甲 has had two 中型激光器 and the Large Laser removed. The remaining 中型激光器 have been upgraded to ER 中型激光器. The Pillager has also replaced the XL引擎 with a standard 引擎 and added CASE for more reliability, so the '机甲 can survive a side torso destruction. 怪癖: 战斗铁拳 掉落成本乘数: 1.18
column2: 掠夺者4Z型的设计目标几乎是一台完美的远程狙击机甲。新型隐形装甲和必需的守护者ECM套件都让它更难被命中。为容纳这些改动，机甲拆除了两门中型激光器和大型激光器，并将保留下来的中型激光器升级为ER中型激光器。掠夺者还以标准引擎替换XL引擎并加入CASE，提高可靠性，使机甲即使一侧躯干被摧毁也能存活。 特性：战斗铁拳 部署成本倍率：1.18

column1: The 5D uses some of the newest technology available to the Federated Suns in 3067. The 'Mech is built based on the rugged older 1H chassis and standard engine. The 'Mech carries as its primary weapon a 转管自动炮/5. This is backed up by four ER 中型激光s and two Machine Guns. The lasers and autocannon are all linked to an advanced 瞄准计算机 which gives the Goliath deadly accuracy at long ranges. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 5D 型号采用了联邦太阳于 3067 年能够获得的一些最新技术。该机甲以坚固的旧式 1H 底盘和标准引擎为基础，主武器是一门旋转自动炮/5，另有四门 ER 中型激光和两挺机枪辅助。激光与自动炮均连接至先进瞄准计算机，使歌利亚在远距离也能精准打击。 特性：多重追踪 部署费用倍率：1.14

column1: The 5D uses some of the newest technology available to the Federated Suns in 3067. The '机甲 is built based on the rugged older 1H chassis and standard 引擎. The '机甲 carries as its primary weapon a 转管自动炮/5. This is backed up by four ER 中型激光s and two Machine Guns. The lasers and autocannon are all linked to an advanced 定位 Computer which gives the Goliath deadly accuracy at long ranges. 怪癖: Multi Trac 掉落成本乘数: 1.14
column2: 5D使用3067年联邦合众国可获得的部分最新技术。机体基于坚固的旧式1H底盘和标准引擎，主要武器是一门转管自动炮/5，另有四门ER中型激光器和两挺机枪。激光器和自动炮都连接至先进瞄准计算机，使Goliath在远距离拥有致命精度。 怪癖: Multi Trac 掉落成本乘数: 1.14

column1: The 5K variant comes the closest of any of the variants to living up to the 'Mech's name. The SRM-6 launcher has been removed from the 'Mech and replaced with a C3 Master Computer, allowing it to coordinate the actions of a C3 lance. The 'Mech is extremely valuable as a medium command 'Mech.
column2: 5K型最接近实现该机甲名称含义。它拆除SRM-6发射器，换成C3主计算机，从而能够协调C3长枪单位的行动。这台机甲作为中型指挥机甲极具价值。

column1: The 5R is an upgraded variant that was unveiled by StarCorps Industries after a Gladiator fielded by Major Alex Keller of the Devil's Brigade that utilized cutting-edge and experimental technology gained notoriety. The production model is powered by a bigger Light Fusion Engine. Improved jump jets, which had been installed onto Major Keller's 'Mech, have been omitted in favor of standard versions, and a C3i Computer allows the 'Mech to share targeting telemetry with like-equipped units. It is armed with a Snub-Nose PPC, two ER Medium Lasers, and an MML-5 with Artemis IV Fire Control System to improve accuracy. Additional heat sinks help to alleviate heat problems. This version has 9.5 tons of standard armor plates, which places it on par with the older 55-ton trio.
column2: 5R 是 StarCorps Industries 推出的升级型号。此前 Devil's Brigade 的 Alex Keller 少校驾驶一台采用尖端实验技术的 Gladiator 而声名大噪。量产型使用更大的轻型聚变引擎。少校机甲上的改进型跳跃喷射器被标准型号取代，C3i 计算机使它能与装备相同系统的单位共享目标遥测数据。武器包括短管 PPC、两门增程中型激光，以及一具配备 Artemis IV 火控系统、精度更高的 MML-5。额外散热器有助于缓解热量问题。该版本拥有 9.5 吨标准装甲，与较早的三种 55 吨型号相当。

column1: The 5R is an upgraded variant that was unveiled by 星团工业 after a Gladiator fielded by Major Alex Keller of the Devil's Brigade that utilized cutting-edge and experimental technology gained notoriety. The production model is powered by a bigger Light Fusion 引擎. Improved jump jets, which had been installed onto Major Keller's 'Mech, have been omitted in favor of standard versions, and a C3i Computer allows the 'Mech to share targeting telemetry with like-equipped units. It is armed with a 短管PPC, two ER 中型激光s, and an MML-5 with Artemis IV Fire Control System to improve accuracy. Additional heat sinks help to alleviate heat problems. This version has 9.5 tons of standard 装甲 plates, which places it on par with the older 55-ton trio.
column2: 5R 是由星团工业推出的升级型，此前魔鬼旅少校 Alex Keller 驾驶一台采用尖端实验技术的 Gladiator 而声名大噪。量产型改用更大的轻型聚变引擎，并以标准跳跃喷射器替代少校机甲上的改进型型号。C3i 计算机使它能与配备相同设备的单位共享瞄准遥测。武器包括一门短管 PPC、两门增程中型激光和一组配备 Artemis IV 火控系统的 MML-5。额外散热器缓解了过热问题；9.5 吨标准装甲使其与旧式 55 吨三型机甲相当。

column1: The 5S combines an Artemis IV LRM-10 with an ER Large Laser and two ER Medium Lasers. It also has C.A.S.E. protection and a small Targeting Computer and uses Endo Steel to carry it all on the frame.
column2: 5S 将 Artemis IV LRM-10 与增程大型激光和两门增程中型激光结合，并配备 C.A.S.E. 防护和小型瞄准计算机，采用 Endo Steel 以容纳全部设备。

column1: The 5S combines an Artemis IV LRM-10 with an ER Large Laser and two ER 中型激光s. It also has C.A.S.E. protection and a small 瞄准计算机 and uses Endo Steel to carry it all on the frame.
column2: 5S将装配Artemis IV的LRM-10与一门ER大型激光器和两门ER中型激光器组合。它还配备C.A.S.E.防护和小型瞄准计算机，并采用内骨骼结构承载全部设备。

column1: The 5V Locust is similar to the 3V Locust, carrying a pair of ER 中型激光器, two 火箭发射器 10s and protected by 铁纤维装甲 装甲. Built in 3068, its relatively low-tech 设计 made it attractive to Periphery powers, namely the Magistracy of Canopus and Taurian Concordat. 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 5V Locust 类似 3V，携带一对 ER 中型激光器和两具 RL-10，并由铁纤维装甲保护。它于 3068 年制造，低技术设计吸引了外围势力，包括金星王座和陶瑞安协约国。 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: The 5W variant of the Goliath is armed with two 等离子步枪s which not only inflict damage on their targets but heat as well. The 5W is also armed with three 中型激光s for close combat. The 'Mech has a 守护者ECM Suite which is needed to properly use its sixteen and a half tons of 隐身装甲. Additionally, the 'Mech has a 小型驾驶舱 that is cramped and makes the 'Mech harder to pilot but saves valuable weight. The 'Mech also has an Improved C3 computer, allowing it to share targeting telemetry with similarly equipped units. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 石像鬼 5W 型配备两门等离子步枪，不仅能对目标造成伤害，还能使其升温。5W 型还装备三门中型激光，用于近距离战斗。该机甲配备守护者 ECM 套件，这是正常使用其 16.5 吨隐形装甲所必需的。此外，机甲还拥有狭窄的小型驾驶舱，使驾驶更加困难，却能节省宝贵重量。机甲还安装了改进型 C3 计算机，能够与配备相同系统的单位共享目标遥测数据。 特性：多重锁定 掉落成本乘数：1.14

column1: The 5W variant of the Goliath is armed with two 等离子步枪s which not only inflict damage on their targets but heat as well. The 5W is also armed with three 中型激光s for close combat. The '机甲 has a 守护者ECM Suite which is needed to properly use its sixteen and a half tons of Stealth 装甲. Additionally, the '机甲 has a 小型驾驶舱 that is cramped and makes the '机甲 harder to pilot but saves valuable weight. The '机甲 also has an 改进的 C3 computer, allowing it to share targeting telemetry with similarly equipped units. 怪癖: Multi Trac 掉落成本乘数: 1.14
column2: 歌利亚的 5W 变体配备了两个等离子光束，它们不仅对目标造成伤害，而且还产生热量。 5W还配备了三门中型激光，用于近战。 “机甲”拥有守护者ECM套件，需要它才能正确使用其16吨半的隐形装甲。此外，“机甲”的小型驾驶舱很狭窄，使得“机甲”更难驾驶，但可以节省宝贵的重量。 “机甲”还拥有一台改进的 C3 计算机，使其能够与类似装备的单位共享目标遥测。 怪癖：多Trac 未知成本乘数: 1.14

column1: The 6C was 生产 by the 布雷克圣言会 starting in 3070 so that their Vulcans could be integrated in a C3 network. This upgraded version of the 5M swapped out the lasers for an ER Large Laser and ER 中型激光, respectively. The weight saved was used to install a C3i Computer. The removal of a heat sink allowed for the replacement of the machine gun with three 轻型 Machine Guns linked to a 机枪 Array. 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 6C由布雷克圣言会自3070年起生产，以便让他们的Vulcan接入C3网络。这一5M升级型分别用ER大型激光器和ER中型激光器替换原有激光器。节省的重量用于安装C3i计算机。拆除一组散热器后，又将机枪替换为三挺连接机枪阵列的轻型机枪。 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: The 9C further modifies the 8C by removing the autocannon and a heat sink to make room for a Gauss Rifle, turning the Shootist into a support 'Mech.
column2: 9C 进一步改造 8C，拆除自动火炮和一组散热器，为高斯步枪腾出空间，使 Shootist 成为支援型机甲。

column1: The 'Baracas' is the personal bio-locked battle armor of Bearing Banacek. It is a variation of the Rogue Bear originally designed and produced by Clan Ghost Bear. The 'Baracas' is a heavy battlesuit fitted with stealth, upgraded sensors and armed with heavy VibroClaws, MicroPulse Lasers and a PPC It is protected by almost enough armor to stop a Gauss rifle.
column2: “巴拉卡斯”是贝林·巴纳切克的个人生物锁定型战斗装甲，是幽灵熊氏族最初研发并生产的 Rogue Bear 的一种变体。这套重型战斗装甲配备隐形装甲、升级传感器、重型振动爪、微型脉冲激光器和一门 PPC。它的装甲厚到几乎能挡住高斯步枪。

column1: The Hellbringer 全向Mech was codenamed "Loki" by the Inner Sphere during the 氏族入侵. The pirates who claimed this chassis seem to have taken to the name, and have overwritten every mention of "Hellbringer" with "Loki" in the 'Mech's systems. 特性：集成探照灯 部署成本倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Hellbringer全向机甲在氏族入侵期间被内球体命名为“Loki”。声称拥有此底盘的海盗似乎已经接受了这个名字，并在“机甲”中用“洛基”覆盖了所有提到的 “地狱使者”。 Systems. 特性：集成探照灯 部署成本倍率：1.16 臂驱动器：左边上部，右侧上部

column1: The Mad Dog OmniMech was code-named "Vulture" by the Inner Sphere during the 氏族入侵. Quite how this "Vulture" made it into the hands of pirate MechTechs is probably better left unexplored, especially considering that they had the expertise to restore the 'Mech to full working order ... with a few shortcuts, naturally. Quirk: 高级光学系统 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Mad Dog 全向机甲在氏族入侵期间被内层圈以“秃鹫”为代号。它究竟如何落入海盗机甲技师手中，最好还是别深究了；更令人惊讶的是，他们竟有能力将机甲完全修复……当然，过程中少不了一些捷径。 特性：高级光学系统 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂，右下臂

column2: Mad Dog全向机甲在氏族入侵期间被内天体方面代号为“Vulture”。这台“Vulture”究竟如何落入海盗机甲技师手中，最好不要深究；更令人惊讶的是，他们竟有能力将这台机甲恢复到完全可用状态——当然，过程中免不了采用一些捷径。 特性：高级光学系统 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: The Summoner 全向Mech was code-named "Thor" by the Inner Sphere during the 氏族入侵. This "Thor" has been stylized in the image of the Norse God of thunder, or at least some pirate's interpretation of him. 特性：泰克铁康TC7000 部署成本倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Summoner全向机甲在氏族入侵期间被内天体方面代号为“Thor”。这台“Thor”以北欧雷神的形象为蓝本，至少是某个海盗对雷神的诠释。 特性：泰克铁康TC7000 部署成本倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: The A configuration changes the role of the Sojourner to be more of a close quarters brawler with its weaponry of a Rotary AC/2, a ProtoMech AC/8, a Large Pulse Laser and 4 ER Micro Lasers.
column2: A 配置改变了 Sojourner 的定位，使其成为更擅长近距离混战的机甲，武器包括一门旋转 AC/2、一门原型机甲 AC/8、一门大型脉冲激光器和四门增程微型激光器。

column1: The A configuration changes the role of the Sojourner to be more of a close quarters brawler with its weaponry of a Rotary AC/2, a 原型机甲自动炮/8, a 大型脉冲激光 and 4 ER Micro Lasers.
column2: A配置改变了漫游者的角色，使其更像近距离斗士，武器包括一门旋转AC/2、一门原型中型自动火炮/8、一门中型激光和4门ER微型激光。

column1: The A configuration is Stone Lion’s response to the Hellstar, featuring four ER PPCs linked to a Targeting Computer, along with an ECM Suite and Active Probe. column1: The Albatross was designed by the Free Worlds League in 3053 with an eye toward a possible future conflict with the then advancing Clans. column1: The Amarok is a unique assault 'Mech among the Clan Wolf touman, intended as a close combat 'Mech. It was built and conceived under Ramiel Bekker's idea of combating the Death From Above (or DFA for short) tactics being employed by 玉鹰氏族. However, lacking time he had to seek assistance from 海狐氏族 as he did with the Stormwolf. It was during his time with 海狐氏族 that he started to investigate the Hammerhead, a new Sea Fox 'Mech, and from that 'Mech he borrowed design choices that would later be a part of the Amarok. For example, the use of 加固装甲 for better protection and modified hand actuators for use in close combat.
column2: Amarok 是狼氏族部队中独特的突击机甲， 专门用于近距离战斗。它源自拉米尔·贝克尔为对抗玉鹰氏族所采用的“从天而降”战术（简称 DFA）的构想。由于时间紧迫，他像打造风暴狼时一样寻求海狐氏族的帮助。在海狐氏族期间，他开始研究 Hammerhead 这款新的海狐机甲，并从中借鉴了后来用于 Amarok 的设计方案，例如用于提升防护的加固装甲，以及适合近战的改进型手部执行器。

For this reason the 车辆 was given a wheeled chassis and 有限两栖 Equipment. column1: The Antlion is an unusual quad BattleMech, purpose-built by StarCorps Industries for the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns from their plant on Crofton to fill a tactical indirect fire support role. Outclassed in direct combat by many 'Mechs, the Antlion wasn't designed to fight opponents directly; instead, the Antlion was designed to rain down indirect fire, preferably from cover some distance away. The Bloodhound active probe helped with this mission profile, but StarCorps also installed a remote sensor dispenser in the Antlion's left torso, acting as a force multiplier by allowing an Antlion to seed an area with sensors in anticipation of subsequent fire missions.
column2: 蚁狮是一款非同寻常的四足战斗机甲，由 StarCorps Industries 在克罗夫顿工厂专门为联邦太阳联邦武装部队打造，用于执行战术间接火力支援。它在直接战斗中不如许多机甲，因此从未被设计来正面迎敌；蚁狮的任务是躲在远处的掩体后方，向敌人倾泻间接火力。血猎犬主动探测器有助于执行这一任务，StarCorps 还在左侧躯干安装远程传感器投放器，让蚁狮能提前向区域布设传感器，为后续火力任务提供倍增效果。

column2: 蚁狮是一种不寻常的四机甲，由星团工业在克罗夫顿的工厂为太阳联邦武装部队专门制造，以填补战术间接火力支援的角色。蚁狮在直接战斗中落后于许多机甲，因此它的设计初衷并不是直接与对手作战；相反，蚁狮的设计目的是进行间接火力攻击，最好是从远处的掩护处进行射击。寻血猎犬主动探测器帮助完成了这一任务，但星际军团还在蚁狮的左躯干中安装了一个远程传感器分配器，通过允许蚁狮在预期后续火力任务的区域中播种传感器来充当力量倍增器。

column1: The Anzu was well-regarded by both MechWarriors and technicians for its reliability; the AMSC found the Anzu to be a good fit for the aggressive combat tactics they had developed since the Jihad. Although the Anzu's maximum ground speed was 64 kph, the Chilton 465 Jump Jets allowed the Anzu to jump up to 120 meters. The Anzu mounted eleven tons of Starshield A Standard Armor with CASE II built in to protect the 'Mech and its pilot from ammunition explosions. The Anzu also used the same life support systems as the Shadow Hawk, already well-proven by the time the Anzu entered service, and the RCA Instatrac Mark X targeting and tracking system allowed the Anzu to simultaneously engage multiple targets while also spotting for indirect fire through the installed TAG system.
column2: 安祖以可靠性受到机甲战士和技术人员的好评；自圣战以来，AMSC 发展出的激进战术也很适合由安祖执行。安祖的最高地面速度为 64 kph，但奇尔顿 465 型跳跃喷射器可使其跃过 120 米。安祖装有 11 吨 Starshield A 标准装甲，并内置 CASE II，以保护机甲及驾驶员免受弹药爆炸伤害。安祖还采用与暗影鹰相同的生命维持系统；在安祖服役前，这套系统已得到充分验证。RCA Instatrac Mark X 瞄准与跟踪系统让安祖能够同时攻击多个目标，还可通过已安装的 TAG 系统为间接火力标定目标。

column1: The Arctic Wolf II is a Clan Wolf-in-Exile Medium OmniMech that was developed during the Jihad, and finally deployed in 3085. column1: The Arctos is a pure Society design based on the Minsk, and as such is carrying a lot of experimental and cutting edge technology that is still not generally available. Through the use of Ferro-Carbide Shell armor and Endo Titanium structure enough weight is saved to enable the Arctos to both be heavily armored and still mount a considerable weaponry with a large damage potential - it even still is somewhat mobile for a superheavy thanks to its large XL engine. To remaining noticeable features includes an Advanced Torso Cockpit, a head mounted Advanced Laser AMS and prototype double heat sinks.
column2: Arctos是Society基于Minsk打造的纯Society设计，因此搭载了大量尚未普及的实验性尖端技术。通过使用Ferro-Carbide Shell装甲和Endo Titanium结构，它节省了足够重量，既能装备厚重装甲，又能安装大量武器、造成可观伤害；得益于大型XL引擎，它作为超重型机甲仍保有一定机动性。其他显著特征包括先进躯干驾驶舱、安装于头部的先进激光AMS，以及原型双重散热器。

The Rotary Autocannon/5 and the ER Medium Lasers are linked to an advanced Targeting Computer which makes them extremely accurate.

column1: The Aries is a Star Adder assault OmniMech produced on Arcadia, with a possible secondary facility near their invasion corridor. It merges the banned Osteon's design with elements from the Blood Asp, offering 56 tons of pod space - matching the Tomahawk II. Though lacking Ferro-Lamelor armor, its durability and adaptability make it a serious threat. Reports indicate up to 16 variants, each capable of engaging at any range with ballistic, missile, and energy loadouts. Some variants show exceptional endurance and heat resistance, staying active under conditions that would disable most 'Mechs. The Aries should be considered a top-tier battlefield threat.
column2: Aries 是一台由星蝰氏族制造、在阿卡迪亚生产的强袭全能机甲，氏族入侵走廊附近可能还有一座备用工厂。它将被禁用的 Osteon 设计与血斑蛇的部件结合，提供 56 吨挂载舱空间，与 Tomahawk II 相当。虽然没有 Ferro-Lamellor 装甲，但它的耐久性和适应能力使其成为严重威胁。报告显示它有多达 16 种变体，每种都能以弹道、导弹和能量配置应对任何距离的交战。有些变体拥有出色的续航与耐热能力，在足以让大多数机甲瘫痪的环境中仍能持续作战。Aries 应被视为顶级战场威胁。

column1: The Arrowhead TH-A4B-AHD is a refresh of the original Arrowhead that improves it self-defense against infantry and battle armor and increases its versatility slightly. One of the Arrow IV launchers has been replaced by two Mortar/6, and the Medium Laser and two Machine Guns were replaced by four Small Lasers. To handle the increased heat generation, two more heat sinks were also added. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 箭头 TH-A4B-AHD 是原箭头的更新版本，提高了其对步兵和战斗装甲的自卫能力，并略微增加了其多功能性。其中一套 Arrow IV 发射器已被两套迫击炮/6 取代，中型激光炮和两挺机枪被四门小型激光炮取代。为了处理增加的热量，还添加了两个散热器。 Quirk：稳定 下降成本乘数： 1.14

column1: The Assassin II is the result of a Federated Suns specification calling for a 'quick strike harasser unit'. The Maltex Corporation proposed a major redesign of their older Assassin chassis, the resulting BattleMech exceeded all expectations and has started to see use as a counter to the stealth technology employed by the Capellan Confederation.
column2: Assassin II 源于联邦太阳提出的“快速突袭骚扰单位”需求。Maltex Corporation 对老款 Assassin 底盘进行了大幅重新设计，成品机甲超出所有预期，如今已开始用于对抗联邦制采用的隐形技术。

column1: The Attor is Clan Cloud Cobra's totem assault OmniMech, developed to replace the aging Highlander IIC. Named after an old Terran word for "poison," it emphasizes raw power and battlefield resilience. With 15 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, integral CASE II, and a built-in Supercharger, the Attor is both durable and mobile. Each variant includes advanced electronics such as Angel ECM, Active Probes, or Targeting Computers. Despite having 41 tons of pod space, the design avoids lighter weapons entirely. The Attor follows a "go big or go home" philosophy, making it a distinctive and dangerous presence in any combat scenario.
column2: Attor 是云毒蛇氏族的图腾突击 OmniMech，用于取代老旧的 Highlander IIC。它以古老泰拉词汇“毒”命名，强调原始力量和战场韧性。15 吨铁纤维装甲、内置 CASE II 和增压器让 Attor 既耐用又机动。每个变体都配备先进电子设备，如天使 ECM、主动探测器或瞄准计算机。尽管拥有 41 吨模块载荷空间，该设计完全放弃轻型武器，贯彻“要么火力全开，要么回家”的理念，在任何战场都格外危险。

column1: The Avalanche is a thirty-second century medium OmniMech, first deployed by the Draconis Combine and Clan Nova Cat. After decades of development, the Avalanche would still have a number of design flaws which would give it a bad reputation among warriors of Clan Nova Cat. The 'Mech would soon be deployed shortly before House Kurita's invasion of the Republic of the Sphere, where it would serve among House Kurita's elite forces. After the destruction of Clan Nova Cat, as a result of its revolt against Coordinator Yori Kurita, the dead Clan's allotment of Avalanches would be sold off to other Inner Sphere powers.
column2: Avalanche 是一款 32 世纪的中型全能机甲，最初由龙辰联邦和新星猫氏族部署。经过数十年开发，它仍存在不少设计缺陷，在新星猫战士中名声不佳。它很快在 Kurita 家族入侵球体共和国前投入部署，成为 Kurita 家族精锐部队的一员。新星猫氏族因反抗 Yori Kurita 协调官而毁灭后，死去氏族留下的 Avalanche 配额被卖给了其他内天体势力。

column1: The Bakeneko is a medium BattleMech originally created by the Draconis Combine and Clan Nova Cat at the dawn of the thirty-second century in a collaboration between Clan Nova Cat scientists and engineers from LAW. Based on the Phoenix Hawk, this slightly bigger design was intended as a fire support and skirmisher unit with the same mobility of the older design. The 'Mech was put into production in early 3100, where it was deployed to both Clan Nova Cat and the DCMS' Eleventh Ghost and Fifth Sword of Light Regiments during the last year of the Second Combine-Dominion War prior to the invasion of Irece in June, 3100. During the invasion, the greatly expanded factories which housed the Bakeneko's production lines were destroyed. The Bakeneko had a reputation as an effective fighting machine, as it was credited numerous kills by Draconis Combine forces during the conflict.
column2: Bakeneko 是一款中型战斗机甲，由龙马幕府与新星猫氏族于 32 世纪初合作研发，参与者包括新星猫科学家和 LAW 工程师。它以凤凰鹰为基础，体型稍大，旨在保持前代机动性的同时担任火力支援和游击单位。该机甲于 3100 年初投产，在同年 6 月 Irece 遭入侵前的第二次幕府—领地战争最后一年，分别部署到新星猫氏族、龙马幕府军方第十一幽灵团和第五光之剑团。入侵期间，容纳 Bakeneko 生产线的大型扩建工厂遭到摧毁。Bakeneko 被认为是高效的战斗机甲，冲突期间龙马幕府军方宣称它击毁了大量敌军。

column1: The Balius is a quadrupedal, front-line OmniMech produced by Clan Hell's Horses. It is a totem 'Mech, resembling a horse, that is meant to improve morale as much as to be an effective combat unit. There is apparently no factory producing this design. Instead, it is hand-crafted by a crew of technicians specifically selected for the task by the Khan. This has led to few Balius' being produced, so the 'Mech is only in the hands of select Bloodnamed warriors. Truly a frontline Omni, the Balius makes use of weight-saving technologies in the form of an Endo Steel chassis, eleven tons of ferro-fibrous armor, and an XL engine. However, on a quad, this leaves little room for other components. It does allow for great speed, though, and the Balius maxes out at 97 km/h, quite fast for a 'Mech its size.
column2: Balius 是地狱之马氏族生产的四足前线全能机甲，外形像一匹马，是一种图腾机甲，既用于提升士气，也具备真正的战斗能力。据说没有工厂生产它，而是由可汗亲自挑选的技术员手工打造。因此 Balius 产量极少，只有少数拥有血名的战士能够使用。作为真正的前线全能机甲，它采用内骨骼、11 吨铁纤维装甲和 XL 引擎等减重技术，但四足底盘仍几乎没有空间容纳其他部件。不过这带来了极高速度，Balius 最高可达 97 公里/小时，对同体型机甲而言相当快。

column1: The Bane 4 is 设计ed to address the ammunition-dependency of the earlier Banes. In this upgrade, 玉鹰氏族 scientists changed many elements of the Bane slightly, resulting in a '机甲 with a different appearance than its predecessors. Its focus is also short range, as evidenced by twin 超级自动炮/20s. Six tons of ammunition is adequate, though only barely. Three ATM 6s, along with four tons of ammunition, give the 设计 great flexibility at all ranges. A single ER Large Laser allows the '机甲 to stay in the fight in the event its ammunition bins have run dry. Seventeen double heat sinks are unequal to the task assigned to them.
column2: Bane 4旨在解决早期Bane对弹药的依赖。升级过程中，玉鹰氏族科学家对Bane的多个部件略作修改，使这台机甲外观不同于前代。它同样专注短程作战，双门超级自动炮/20便是证明。6吨弹药基本够用，但余量很小。三具ATM-6及4吨弹药让该设计在所有射程都具备很高灵活性。一门ER大型激光器确保弹舱耗尽后机甲仍能继续战斗。17组双重散热器却不足以承担全部任务。

column1: The Banshee IIC 2 was discovered during a Dark Caste raid on Star Adder holdings in the Kerensky Cluster, often mistaken for a captured Inner Sphere BNC-5S and considered weaker. Isolated in battle, it managed to score three kills before enemies withdrew. Maintaining the Banshee’s impressive speed for an assault mech, the IIC 2 reaches around 68 kph. Its armament includes two Improved Heavy Large Lasers, two Large Pulse Lasers, and a Class 20 Hyper Assault Gauss Rifle, all linked to a Targeting Computer. Despite its severe heat generation requiring careful management, pilots also lament the absence of jump jets that limits its battlefield mobility. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.23 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Upper Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Banshee IIC 2 是在克伦斯基星团对星蝰蛇势力的一次黑暗氏族袭击中发现的，常被误认为是缴获的内星 BNC-5S，并被认为性能较弱。它在孤军作战时仍击杀了三名敌人，直到对手撤退。IIC 2 保持了突击机甲令人印象深刻的速度，约为 68 千米/小时。它装备两门改进型重型大型激光器、两门大型脉冲激光器和一门 20 级超高斯步枪，全部连接至瞄准计算机。虽然严重的发热需要谨慎管理，驾驶员也对缺少跳跃喷射器、限制战场机动性这一点颇有怨言。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.23 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Banshee IIC is a Clan second-line variant of a Star League-era design, pressed back into service due to shortages. The original Banshee, while iconic, had notable flaws. As OmniMechs advanced, older chassis like the Banshee IIC were relegated to garrisons or caches. The Star Adders kept the largest stockpiles. Over time, it was upgraded from SLDF weaponry standards. Recent IIC and IIC 2 variants improve on the Defiance BNC-5S design using advanced Clan technology, making the Banshee a more capable and dangerous battlefield machine..
column2: Banshee IIC是星盟时代设计的氏族二线变体，因短缺而重新服役。原版Banshee虽然经典，但存在明显缺陷。随着全向机甲发展，Banshee IIC等老底盘被降为驻军或缓存。星蝰氏族保有最大的库存。后来它从SLDF武器标准逐步升级；近期IIC和IIC 2型使用先进氏族技术改进Defiance BNC-5S设计，使Banshee成为更强、更危险的战场机器。

column1: The Banzai is an experimental Draconis Combine BattleMech designed to be a close-in brawler with a deadly sting. Utilizing a mix of Inner Sphere and Clan technology, the 'Mech is built around the MAL-1K Mauler's Endo Steel chassis and powered by a massive 360-rated XL fusion engine, augmented by the inclusion of both MASC and a Supercharger. As a result, the Banzai is capable of reaching speeds of 100 km/h in brief bursts. Seventeen and half tons of standard armor allow the 'Mech to weather an incredible volume of fire as it advances, while fifteen Double Heat Sinks ensure the Banzai is able to fire its ranged weaponry as it closes with its intended target. For the pilot's protection from the 'Mech's booby trap, the Banzai is equipped with a Full-Head Ejection System.
column2: Banzai 是龙蛇联合王国的实验型战斗机甲，旨在成为带有致命尖刺的近战斗士。它混合采用内圈和氏族技术，以 MAL-1K Mauler 的 Endo Steel 底盘为基础，由巨大的 360 级 XL 聚变引擎驱动，同时配备 MASC 和增压器。因此 Banzai 能在短时间内达到 100 km/h。17.5 吨标准装甲让它在推进时承受惊人火力，15 具双重散热器确保它接近目标时仍能发射远程武器。为保护驾驶员免受机甲诱爆装置伤害，Banzai 配备全头部弹射系统。

column1: The Basilisk ProtoMech was designed and built by 云蛇氏族 to support their Elemental and OmniMech forces. Unlike most second generation Protos, the Basilisk has a relatively low top speed. The only problem with this is the severely limited ammunition supply.
column2: 巴西利斯克原型机甲由钢爪氏族设计并制造，用于支援其元素战士与 OmniMech 部队。与大多数第二代原型机甲不同，巴西利斯克的最高速度相对较低。它搭载一门与普通机甲同规格的 ER 中型激光，并以一具三联装 LRM 发射器配合攻击，在巴西利斯克接近目标时先行削弱敌人。其主要缺点是弹药储量严重不足。

column2: Basilisk原型机甲由云蛇氏族设计和制造，用于支援其元素战士和全向机甲部队。与多数第二代原型机甲不同，Basilisk最高速度相对较低。该改型移除标准武器组合，换装一门小型激光、两门微型激光、一具短程导弹发射器和跳跃喷射器。

column1: The Basilisk Proto机甲 was 设计ed and built by 云蛇氏族 to support their Elemental and Omni机甲 forces. Unlike most second generation Protos, the Basilisk has a relatively low top speed. column2: 蛇怪原型机甲是由云蛇氏族设计和建造的，用于支持他们的元素和万能机甲部队。与大多数第二代神族不同，蛇怪的最高速度相对较低。该版本携带单个ER中型激光器。为了提高战场上的机动性，它配备了五个扩展跳跃喷气机

column1: The Bee is a recent addition to the Inner Sphere OmniMechs. Designed as a mix between a scout and a flanker, it can fullfil both roles decently thanks to its large engine and relatively large available pod space. The design has been successful enough to be used by most of the Inner Sphere factions, making it an increasingly more common sight.
column2: Bee 是最近加入内天体全能机甲行列的新型号。它兼顾侦察与侧翼突袭，凭借大引擎和相对充足的挂载舱空间，能够胜任这两种任务。该设计十分成功，几乎被所有内天体势力采用，因此越来越常见。

column1: The Behemoth II Heavy Tank was designed in 3102 by Aldis Industries.The tank gained a reputation to be feared among MechWarriors during the Victoria War. The Capellan defenders utilized the tank's capacities to hold the high deserts plateau where they encountered the Hussars. The tanks proved to be resilient in combat and remained operational throughout the fight, forcing the Hussars to withdraw. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. column1: The Big Brother comes from the short-lived Parallax Corporation, built as an almost exact replica of its 35 ton counterpart the Little Brother, just scaled up with bigger weaponry to match. It shares the same fatal flaw though, an IndustrialMech frame that dooms it to obsolescence the moment real BattleMechs enter the picture. Parallax sold the two together as a pair for half a century, and wherever one went, the other typically followed.
column2: Big Brother 来自短命的 Parallax Corporation，几乎是其 35 吨级姊妹机型 Little Brother 的完整复制版，只是整体放大并配备更大型武器。它也有同样致命的缺陷：工业机甲底盘注定会在真正的战斗机甲出现时立刻过时。半个世纪以来，Parallax 一直将两台机甲成对出售；通常一台去了哪里，另一台也会跟着去。

column1: The Björn A configuration enhances long-range firepower by replacing the Prime’s ER PPC with an ER Large Laser and adding two more double heat sinks. This improves sustained fire capabilities while maintaining the original flexibility. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Energy Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Björn A 配置以一门增程大型激光器取代 Prime 型的增程 PPC，并额外增加两台双倍散热器，提升持续火力，同时保留原配置的灵活性。 特性：武器精准 - 能量武器 部署费用倍率：1.03 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Black Hawk carries eight and a half tons of standard 装甲, a ton and a half less than the Nova, and uses an endo steel internal 结构. The weight saved enables it to mount a pair of ER large lasers for direct fire support and four 锁定式SRM-4s for close range work. The Streak launchers were located in the '机甲's arms, but the lasers were mounted in the left and right torso, while four tons of ammunition for the Streak launchers were split across the left and right torsos.
column2: Black Hawk携带8.5吨标准装甲，比Nova少1.5吨，并采用内骨骼内部结构。节省的重量使其能够安装两门ER大型激光器用于直射支援，以及四具锁定式SRM-4用于近战。Streak发射器安装在机甲双臂中，激光器则安装在左右躯干；Streak发射器的四吨弹药分置于左右躯干。

column1: The Black Knight 6B was the harder-hitting, cooler-running Star League ancestor to the standard BL-6-KNT we have today. This one was refitted by a bunch of Pirates with some help of whatever goes as Moonshine among them.
column2: Black Knight 6B 是标准 BL-6-KNT 的星盟祖先，火力更强、运行更凉爽。这一台被一群海盗改装过，还加入了他们所谓的“月光酒”提供的帮助。

column1: The Black Mamba OmniMech is produced at three known facilities: on Strana Mechty by the Star Adders, on Huntress by the Cloud Cobras, and a rumored factory in the Deep Periphery near the invasion corridor. This OmniMech combines durability with agility, able to absorb significant damage while delivering powerful counterattacks. Despite its size, it remains remarkably nimble on the battlefield, making it a versatile and formidable asset in combat.
column2: 黑曼巴全能机甲目前已知在三处设施生产：星蝰蛇在斯特拉纳梅赫提负责生产，云蛇在女猎手负责生产，入侵走廊附近的深层边疆据说还有一座工厂。这款全能机甲兼具耐久与敏捷，能够承受大量损伤并发动强力反击。尽管体型庞大，它在战场上仍异常灵活，是一种用途广泛且令人畏惧的战斗资产。

column1: The Black Wolf is a thirty-second century, Heavy Class battle armor which was originally created by Clan Scientists from both halves of the divided Wolf Clan. The battle armor began as a joint project between Clan Wolf and Clan Wolf-in-Exile, as part of a means of reunification between the two sundered factions. However, the reunification the Black Wolf suggested would not come to pass with the later formation of the Wolf Empire in 3142. One of the Black Wolf's deployments would be during the invasion of Tharkad in 3143, where the suit's use would become a symbol of terror for Clan Wolf-in-Exile's allies in the Lyran Commonwealth.
column2: Black Wolf 是一款诞生于 32 世纪的重型战斗装甲，最初由分裂后的狼氏族两方科学家共同研制。它起初是狼氏族与流亡狼氏族的联合项目，意在促成这两个分裂派系重新统一。然而，Black Wolf 所寄托的统一并未实现，3142 年狼帝国的成立反而让这一愿景化为泡影。3143 年入侵 Tharkad 时，Black Wolf 曾投入战斗；这套装甲的出现，后来成为流亡狼氏族在利拉联邦盟友心中的恐怖象征。

column1: The Blackbird SL-SR71 leans into stealth scouting with a Guardian ECM system in place of an active probe. It carries an ER large laser and Streak SRM 2 launcher, giving it noticeably better self defense than its lighter Voodoo counterpart while still filling the same reconnaissance role. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02
column2: Blackbird SL-SR71 专注于隐形侦察，以守护者 ECM 系统取代主动探测器。它配备一门增程大型激光器和一具连发 SRM-2，自卫能力明显强于较轻的 Voodoo，但仍承担相同的侦察任务。 特性：陆空机甲 部署费用倍率：1.02

column1: The Blackjack 1Cr is a rather unusual refit, replacing the Autocannons with a pair of Mortars to allow indirect firing support and giving AMS coverage.
column2: Blackjack 1Cr是相当不寻常的改装，以两门迫击炮替换自动加农炮，从而提供间接火力支援，并获得AMS防护。

column1: The Blade is a light-weight scouting and raiding 'Mech that employs its fearsome speed to strike at larger 'Mechs, then to escape before their opponents can track them. Well-suited for pack-hunter and swarming tactics, the Blade works well with other fast units such as the classic Locust and the Clan Dasher. Originally commissioned by the Republic of the Sphere's first Commanding General Victor Steiner-Davion, the Blade was his attempt to standardize and simplify the hodgepodge military hardware as Stone's Coalition became the Republic Armed Forces. The Blade was manufactured from the mid-3080s until around 3096, becoming the signature 'Mechs for Principes Guards, Hastati Sentinels, and elite Knights of the Sphere regiments.
column2: Blade 是一款轻型侦察与突袭机甲，利用惊人的速度袭击大型机甲，然后在敌人锁定它们之前撤离。它非常适合群狼捕猎和蜂群战术，与经典的 Locust 及氏族 Dasher 等高速单位协同效果出色。Blade 最初由球体共和国首任总司令 Victor Steiner-Davion 下令研制，目的是在 Stone 联盟转变为共和国武装部队时，将杂乱的军用硬件标准化并简化。Blade 从 3080 年代中期生产至约 3096 年，后来成为 Principes Guards、Hastati Sentinels 以及球体骑士精锐团的标志性机甲。

column1: The Blue Flame began production after the 布雷克圣言会 took possession of Terra. The same factory that had produced the Shootist was upgraded to produce four legged BattleMechs. The Blue Flame is an extremely stable platform due to its quadrupedal configuration. In the later years of the Jihad, an engineer who had helped build the 'Mech stole the design specs and later created the Thunder Fox.
column2: Blue Flame 在布雷克圣言会占领 Terra 后开始生产。曾经生产 Shootist 的同一座工厂被升级，用于制造四足战斗机甲。Blue Flame 的四足构型使其成为极其稳定的平台。圣战后期，一名曾参与建造该机甲的工程师窃取了设计规格，后来制造出了 Thunder Fox。

column1: The Blue Flame's primary armament is two ER Large Lasers that allow the 'Mech to engage the enemy at long ranges. It also has three 锁定式SRM-2 launchers for close range combat. The 'Mech is built around a Endo Steel chassis that cradles a 225 Light Fusion engine that gives the 'Mech a top speed of 86.4 km/h. The Blue Flame carries an impressive eleven tons of armor and has ten double heat sinks. To allow the 'Mech to share targeting data with friendly units, it is equipped with an improved C3 computer that allows it to exchange information with other C3i equipped units Quirk: 稳定武器 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: 蓝焰的主武器是两门 ER 大型激光，使这台机甲能够在远距离与敌人交战。它还配备三具 Streak SRM-2 发射器，用于近距离战斗。机体以 Endo Steel 底盘为核心，搭载一台 225 级轻型聚变引擎，最高速度可达 86.4 公里/小时。蓝焰拥有多达 11 吨装甲和 10 台双重散热器。为与友军共享目标数据，它还配备改进型 C3 计算机，可与其他装备 C3i 的单位交换信息。 特性：稳定平台 部署费用倍率：1.03

It's relatively high ground speed is coupled with a 150 meter jumping capability to allow it to quickly engage multiple foes. The single 等离子炮 mounted on the Boggart is particularly effective against overheating 'Mechs. Conventional infantry and vehicles are also quickly damaged by the weapon.

column1: The Boyyi 1 is built for speed and firepower, centered around a massive XXL engine and an active probe mounted deep in its torso. This grants speeds comparable to many combat VTOLs, with a supercharger enabling short bursts of even greater velocity, albeit with high risk. Armed with Improved Heavy Lasers for close combat, the Boyyi excels in detection, evasion, and pursuit, thanks to intensive training by Stone Lion reconnaissance pilots. Though some Coyote pilots seek more “Clan-like” assignments, the invasion’s urgency has kept them committed, making the Boyyi a versatile and vital asset in the Touman’s operations. Quirk: Advanced Optics Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Boyyi 1 以速度和火力为核心，围绕一台巨大的 XXL 引擎和深藏于躯干内的主动探测器打造。它的速度可与许多战斗 VTOL 媲美，增压器还能让它短时间内以更高速度冲刺，但风险也很高。Boyyi 装备改良重型激光，擅长近距离作战；得益于石狮侦察飞行员的密集训练，它在探测、规避和追击方面表现出色。虽然部分 Coyote 飞行员希望承担更“氏族式”的任务，但入侵的紧迫性让他们继续坚守岗位，使 Boyyi 成为 Touman 行动中多用途且不可或缺的资产。 特质：高级光学 部署费用倍率：1.03 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 许可使用。

column1: The Bushranger is a Forestry and Surveyal 'Mech designed by the Star League to be deployed on planets still being 'tamed', the only design to receive unique reinforced structure and myomer more similar to Mech's far above its weight class is it not only sturdy, but able to carry large amounts of weight with ease.
column2: Bushranger 是星盟设计的森林与测绘机甲，用于部署到仍在“驯服”中的星球。它是唯一采用独特强化结构和肌肉、性能更接近高吨位机甲的设计；它不仅坚固，还能轻松携带大量重量。

column1: The Bushwacker S2c is a front line that upgrades the AMS to an APD system combined with an ECM to give advanced cover for its units.
column2: Bushwacker S2c 是将 AMS 升级为 APD 系统并结合 ECM 的前线，为其部队提供先进的掩护。

column1: The C Configuration is a Brawler, armed with close-in and hard hitting weaponry which is reminiscent of the original Thor's C Configuration. The Configuration's main gun is a left-torso Ultra Class 20 Autocannon with 3 tons of ammunition split between each of its side torsos. Its other weaponry includes: a pair of arm mounted Large Pulse Lasers, a 4-tubed Streak SRM Launcher, and a Flamer.
column2: C 配置是一款格斗者，配备近距离和重击武器，这让人想起最初的雷神托尔的 C 配置。该配置的主炮是一门左躯干 Ultra Class 20 自动加农炮，两侧躯干均装有 3 吨弹药。它的其他武器包括：一对安装在手臂上的大型脉冲激光器、一个 4 管 Streak SRM 发射器和一个火焰喷射器。

column1: The C configuration converts the Sojourner to a missile boat by arming it with two LRM 20s. The configuration also sports a Heavy Large Laser and a Micro Pulse Laser to defend itself.
column2: C型将Sojourner改造成导弹平台，装备两具LRM-20；同时配备一门重型大型激光和一门微型脉冲激光用于自卫。

column1: The C configuration only carries two weapons, but they are both able to do a very high amount of damage. The 左侧 Torso mounts a HAG/40, with four tons of available 装甲, while the 右侧 Torso contains an 改进的 重型高斯步枪 with three tons of ammo available. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.17 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: C配置只携带两件武器，但两者都能造成极高伤害。左侧躯干安装一门HAG/40，并配有四吨弹药；右侧躯干则装有一挺改进型重型高斯步枪，并配备三吨弹药。 特性：强化纤维 击杀倍率：1.17 部位装甲：全能

column1: The C configuration specializes in close combat, mounting twin 大型脉冲激光s and six 中型脉冲激光s connected to a 定位 Computer. It also features an ECM Suite and jump jets that allow it to leap 120 米. It has minor heat issues but remains manageable for skilled 机甲Warriors. 怪癖: 均衡 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: C 配置专精近战，装备两具大型脉冲激光器和六具中型脉冲激光器，并连接至瞄准计算机。它还配备 ECM 套件和跳跃喷射器，可跳跃 120 米。虽然存在轻微热量问题，但熟练的机甲战士仍能轻松驾驭。 怪癖: 均衡 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The C-1FC variant first appeared during the Jihad, where it was given minor Advanced Technology upgrades to its arsenal. The 'Mechs armor was switched from standard Ferro-Fibrous Armor to Light Ferro-Fibrous, which allowed for an increase in protection of the 'Mechs vitals. All weapons were removed in favor of three Rocket Launcher 10s, spread across the Cossack's torso sections. The only energy weapon available, a Medium Variable Speed Pulse Laser, is mounted in the left arm.
column2: C-1FC 型号首次在圣战期间亮相，为武器库加入了少量先进技术升级。机甲装甲从标准铁磁纤维装甲改为轻型铁磁纤维，提高了关键部位的防护。所有武器被拆除，换成分布在 Cossack 各躯干区段的三具火箭发射器 10。唯一的能量武器是一门安装在左臂的中型变速脉冲激光。

column1: The C-series of Jenners are some interesting upgrades, and work quite well as both a scout and a fast flanker.
column2: Jenners 的 C 系列是一些有趣的升级，并且作为侦察兵和快速侧卫都表现得很好。

column1: The C3B variant of the Naginata removes one of the LRM-15 launchers in order to add a larger 引擎, a 比格犬主动探头 and a 守护者ECM suite to the 设计. The '机甲 also had an ER 中型激光器 and an ER Small Laser added for close range defense. 怪癖: Cowl 掉落成本乘数: 1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower
column2: Naginata的C3B变型拆除一具LRM-15发射器，以便增加更大的引擎、比格犬主动探头和守护者ECM套件。机甲还增装一门ER中型激光器和一门ER小型激光器用于近距离防御。 怪癖: 头部护甲 掉落成本乘数: 1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂

column1: The CRLS-586 replaces the heavy autocannons of earlier variants with twin Rotary AC/5s, shifting the Coriolis away from single devastating strikes toward sustained high-volume fire. A 定位 Computer sharpens everything on the frame while an ER Large Laser and ER 中型激光 cover range brackets the autocannons cannot reach. CASE protects both ammunition bays and an 反导系统 adds defensive depth. Three jump jets keep the chassis signature ambush potential fully intact. 怪癖: 精准 Weapon - AC 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: CRLS-586用两门转管自动炮/5替换早期型号的重型自动炮，使Coriolis从一次性毁灭打击转向持续的高密度火力。瞄准计算机提升整机精度，ER大型激光器和ER中型激光器则覆盖自动炮无法触及的射程。CASE保护两个弹药舱，反导系统进一步增强防御深度。三具跳跃喷射器保留了底盘完整的伏击潜力。 怪癖: 精准 武器 - AC 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 下臂

column1: The Cadaver was introduced by the Taurian Concordat in 3094. With a top speed of 120 km/h, it typically functions as a high speed cavalry unit among Taurian forces, but has also been used as a scouting unit. Protected by six tons of ferro-fibrous armor, it has a great deal of armor for a light 'Mech, but doesn't possess much in the way of ranged firepower. The Cadaver carries a Full-Head Ejection System and a Guardian ECM suite disrupts enemy communications.
column2: Cadaver 由陶瑞安协约国于 3094 年推出。最高速度为 120 km/h，通常在陶瑞安部队中充当高速骑兵单位，也曾用于侦察。六吨铁磁纤维装甲为它提供充足防护；对轻型机甲而言装甲相当厚重，但远程火力不强。Cadaver 搭载全头部弹射系统，Guardian ECM 套件还能干扰敌方通信。

column1: The Calliope was primarily 设计ed as a garrison Battle机甲 for the Magistracy Armed Forces to combat infantry and 车辆s. The 设计 was also introduced to replace the aging Snake Battle机甲 commonly used by both the Capellan Confederation and the Magistracy of Canopus for the same role.
column2: Calliope 最初设计为王座联邦武装部队使用的驻军战斗机甲，用于对付步兵和车辆。它还被引入以替代老旧的 Snake 战斗机甲，后者常由卡佩兰联邦和金星王座都使用。

column1: The Candiru CND-101 is purpose built for anti infantry work, mounting four small lasers, two small pulse lasers, two machine guns and two flamers for close range devastation. column1: The Capellans did an admirable jump on this thing; it can bring those PPCs or Plasma Rifles to bear a lot faster than most people would suspect. If you're up close and the Plasma Rifles run dry, you'll still have four ER Medium Lasers and a pair of Smal Pulse Lasers to fall back on.
column2: 卡佩兰人在这台机甲上完成了出色的跳跃改进；它能比大多数人预想得更快地让 PPC 或等离子步枪投入射击。如果你已经逼近而等离子步枪耗尽，仍可依靠四门增程中型激光器和两门小型脉冲激光器。

column1: The Capellans have rebuilt the Griffin from the skeleton up to take advantage of their new stealth 装甲. The engineers selected a XL fusion engine to allow for the larger LRM-15 launcher and 守护者ECM system; thirteen double-strength heat sinks are required to keep the 设计 reasonably cool. Further upgrades include an Artemis IV targeting system to improve the accuracy of the missile rack and an ER PPC. Concerns about the fragility of using an XL engine was settled by allotting an additional 1.5 tons of 装甲. Finally, CASE protection for the ammunition bins was vital; while incapable of protecting the bulky engine, it allows the pilot to eject safely in the event of an ammunition explosion.
column2: 卡佩兰人从骨架开始重建Griffin，以利用新型隐身装甲。工程师选用XL聚变引擎，以容纳更大的LRM-15发射器和守护者ECM系统；十三枚双强度散热器用于保持合理温度。进一步升级包括提高导弹架精度的Artemis IV瞄准系统，以及一门ER PPC。为解决XL引擎脆弱性问题，机体额外分配了1.5吨装甲。最后，弹药箱的CASE防护至关重要；虽然无法保护笨重的引擎，却能在弹药爆炸时让驾驶员安全弹射。

column1: The Carnivore Assault Tank is a post-Jihad design produced by Clan Wolf as part their efforts to rebuild their touman. After its introduction, it would be traded to neighboring Clans and even Inner Sphere powers for additional supplies and equipment. The Carnivore was designed with lessons learned from the modern battlefield of the Jihad. A Guardian ECM Suite is meant to handle the Inner Sphere's usage of advanced electronic equipment. column1: The Clan Battle Armor is based on the Elemental suit, its visual aesthetic that shows that the Clan's contact with the Draconis Combine was already rubbing off on them. Though the design has a slow ground speed, the designers used the jump booster pioneered on the Gray Death Scout armor to rocket it up to one hundred twenty meters at a time. This necessitated a slight reduction in armor and a reworking of the weaponry.
column2: 氏族战斗装甲以元素战士装甲为基础，其外观显示出氏族与龙辰联邦的接触已经开始影响他们。虽然这套设计地面速度较慢，但设计师采用了源自 Gray Death 侦察装甲的跳跃助推器，使它一次可跃升 120 米。因此它不得不略微减少装甲，并重新设计武器配置。

column1: The Clans upgraded and lightened the venerable Griffin design until the BattleMech now known as the Griffin IIC emerged. It is slightly faster than its antecedent, and it correspondingly mounts enough jump jets to leap up to 180 meters at a time.
column2: 氏族对历史悠久的狮鹫设计进行了升级和轻量化，最终诞生了如今所称的狮鹫 IIC。Endo Steel 内骨钢骨架上装有七吨铁纤维装甲，使狮鹫 IIC 的防护几乎达到同级机甲的极限。它比前身略快，相应地也配备了足够的跳跃喷射器，单次可跃行至多 180 米。

column1: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. column1: The Cricket 'Mech was developed by the DCMS as a raider and harasser. Originally it was named the Roweena after Roweena Kurita, but the ISF suspected the designer was a Black Dragon Society sympathizer so a new name was assigned. The Cricket uses every weight saving technology possible to free enough room to have a high ground speed and pack on more armor. Capable of reaching over 150 km/h, it can also jump 180 meters at a time thanks to six jump jets. Despite its high speed and jump capability, the Cricket is unpopular for scouting and recon as it has a cramped cockpit and no electronics.
column2: 蟋蟀机甲由龙马幕府军方设计为袭扰与突袭单位。它最初以罗薇娜·库里塔之名命名为“罗薇娜”，但内务安全部怀疑设计师同情黑龙会，于是为它另取新名。蟋蟀运用了所有可行的减重技术，以腾出空间提升地面速度并加装更多装甲。它时速可超过 150 千米，还能依靠六具跳跃喷射器一次跃过 180 米。尽管速度和跳跃能力出众，蟋蟀并不受侦察部队青睐，因为驾驶舱狭窄，也没有电子设备。

column1: The Crimson HellKite was the result of a secret project by several design teams within the Clans to create the best medium 'Mech possible. The goal was never met, as the result 'Mech was just another standard 55 tonner Omni, its only benefit being its ease to repair due to using only stock components available from other common 'Mechs..
column2: Crimson HellKite 源于氏族内部多个设计团队的秘密项目，目标是打造最优秀的中型机甲。目标最终没有实现，成品只是另一台标准的 55 吨全能机甲，唯一优势是只使用其他常见机甲都能找到的库存部件，维修十分方便。

column1: The Crimson Langur is a remarkably fast 'Mech for its weight. In order to do this, it uses both an XL engine and an endo steel chassis to save weight. The design utilizes ten and a half tons of standard armor, the most the chassis can hold, though this weight only gives the Crimson Langur fifteen tons of pod space for modular equipment.
column2: Crimson Langur 以自身吨位而言快得惊人。它采用 XL 引擎和内骨骼框架减重，并装有 10.5 吨标准装甲，这是底盘能承载的最大装甲量；即便如此，这些装甲仍只为模块化设备留下 15 吨挂载舱空间。

column1: The Crosscut is a popular type of LoggerMech, praised for operating efficiency in woodlands and dominating commercial forestry. The IIC is a militarized Crosscut built with Clantech, powered by a 300-rated XL Engine and armed with an iHML in addition to the standard Chainsaw.
column2: Crosscut 是一种广受欢迎的伐木机甲，以林地作业效率和商业林业能力著称。IIC 是采用氏族技术军事化改装的 Crosscut，使用 300 额定 XL 引擎，除标准链锯外还配备一门 iHML。

column1: The Crosscut is a popular type of LoggerMech, praised for operating efficiency in woodlands and dominating commercial forestry. The X5M is a slight improvement on the X2M, since it upgrades both the engine type and the gun. For the poor sods who have to ride a logger-mech into battle, the gun is particularly appreciated, since the new light AC/2 allows their industrial armor to stay far back from the fight.
column2: 横切机是一种流行的 LoggerMech 类型，因其在林地中的作业效率和主导商业林业而受到赞誉。 X5M 在 X2M 的基础上略有改进，因为它升级了发动机类型和火炮。对于那些必须骑着伐木机械参加战斗的可怜的草皮来说，这把枪特别受欢迎，因为新型轻型 AC/2 可以让他们的工业装甲远离战斗。

column1: The Crossfire is a well-known 'Mech once piloted by James "Amalor Myrnnyx" Degenhardt of "Melody's Rockers." Originally a modified UrbanMech "appropiated" from a Periphery training site in 3070, it showcased James's skill as both 'MechWarrior and engineer.
column2: 交叉火力是一款著名的机甲，曾由《旋律摇滚乐队》中的詹姆斯·“阿玛洛·麦尼克斯”·德根哈特驾驶。最初是 3070 年从外围训练场“挪用”的改良版 UrbanMech，它展示了詹姆斯作为“机甲战士”和工程师的技能。

column1: The Crow Scout VTOL is a military-grade, scout combat vehicle that is based upon the civilian Soar. Yan Manufacturing designed the Crow to replace the many scout BattleMechs the Draconis Combine lost during the Combine-Ghost Bear War. The Yan team kept many of the strengths of the search-and-rescue vehicle the Crow is descended from, though they improved it using military-grade technologies. Yan initially had trouble selling the Crow to the DCMS. Finally, Yan agreed to give the unit to them as long as the Combine supplied the electronics. In exchange, Yan is free to sell the unit to mercenary units. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 13/20 hexes / 390/600 meters. column2: Crow Scout VTOL 是一款基于民用 Soar 的军用级侦察战车。 Yan Manufacturing 设计了乌鸦来取代天龙联合军在联合军与鬼熊战争中损失的许多侦察战机甲。 Yan 团队保留了 Crow 搜救车的许多优点，尽管他们使用军用级技术对其进行了改进。 Yan 最初很难将 Crow 出售给 DCMS。最后，严同意将设备交给他们，只要联合军提供电子设备。作为交换，Yan 可以自由将该单位出售给雇佣兵单位。 生物群落限制：该单位无法部署在月球生物群落中。 移动： 13/20 六角形 / 390/600 米。 装甲：装甲 结构： 结构 值 A S 前部 40 10 左 30 10 右 30 10 后 30 10 总计 140 50 怪异：改进的传感器

column1: The Cyllaros is a fascinating concept, combining the best of both worlds with its hybrid design. It's a marvel of engineering and technology, a true testament to the ingenuity of Clan Hell's Horses. I can't wait to see what kind of modifications could be made to enhance its combat capabilities even further.
column2: Cyllaros 是一个迷人的概念，以混合设计结合了两种体系的优点。它是工程与科技的奇迹，充分体现了地狱之马氏族的创造力。我迫不及待想看看还能进行哪些改装，以进一步增强它的战斗能力。

column1: The D configuration is effective at all ranges with an all-energy loadout that gives it the ability to operate beyond the range of supply lines. Two Light PPCs have the longest range of the Luminos' weapons. This variant also carries a pair of ER Medium Lasers, giving it a very small window where its four largest guns overlap optimal ranges. Should the Malak D find itself inside the minimum range of the PPCs, it can utilize three ER Small Lasers.
column2: D 配置使用全能量武器，可在各种射程有效作战，不受补给线范围限制。两门轻型 PPC 是 Luminos 射程最远的武器。该型号还装备一对增程中型激光，使四门最大型火炮的最佳射程重合区间非常短。若 Malak D 进入 PPC 最小射程内，可使用三门增程小型激光。

column1: The D configuration was developed during the Jihad to take on the Command Unit role. This configuration fitted a C3 Master Computer and a Targeting Computer in the Hauptmann's left torso. For ranged attacks this configuration has a Heavy PPC and Gauss Rifle with a single ton of ammunition. Complementing these weapons are a pair of 10-Tubed Rocket Launchers mounted in each of the 'Mech's arms. The 'Mech's only secondary weaponry is a pair of ER Medium Lasers.
column2: D 型号在圣战期间开发，用于承担指挥单位职责。该配置在 Hauptmann 左侧躯干安装 C3 主计算机和瞄准计算机。远程攻击装备一门重型 PPC 和一门高斯步枪，并配备一吨弹药；每条手臂各装两具十联装火箭发射器。机甲唯一的副武器是两门增程中型激光。

column1: The D loadout as usual for the Jade Falcon line of 机甲s mounts no Jump Jets, even though the chassis has 部分机翼s permanently attached. Instead it combines two ER PPC and a Gauss Rifle as the main weapons, with a single ER 中型激光 for close range support. All the weapons are bound together through a state of the art Tergeting Computer. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: 按照玉蜥星族机甲生产线的惯例，D配置不安装跳跃喷射器，尽管底盘永久连接着跳跃喷射器。它改用两门ER PPC和一挺高斯步枪作为主武器，并以一门ER中型激光提供近距离支援。所有武器都通过最先进的瞄准计算机联接。 特性：分心 击杀倍率：1.16 左下部装甲，右下部装甲：全能

column1: The D3's construction reflects its intended role as (almost) a custom design for Commanders. The 'Mech is designed for dealing punishing attacks, while retaining the survivability and speed of the original Atlas.
column2: D3 的结构体现了它几乎是为指挥官定制的设计目标。这台机甲专注于发动毁灭性攻击，同时保留原版 Atlas 的生存能力和速度。

column1: The D4 variant, introduced in 3073, changes out the '机甲's 装甲 for 轻型铁纤维装甲-Fibrous 装甲. The '机甲's double heat sinks have been increased to 16 to handle the '机甲's additional weapons. These additional weapons include a second pair of 中型激光s added to the center torso. In the arms, the Ultra AC/2s have been replaced by Light PPCs. 怪癖: Anti-Air 定位 掉落成本乘数: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: D4 改型于 3073 年推出，将机甲装甲替换为轻型铁纤维装甲。双散热器增加到 16 具，以应对新增武器：中央躯干增加第二对中型激光器，双臂的 Ultra AC/2 换成轻型 PPC。 怪癖：防空瞄准 掉落成本乘数: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: The Daimyo HQ was a heavy theater command unit utilized by the Draconis Combine. The first Daimyo was fielded in 2796 at the beginning of the Succession Wars by Jinjiro Kurita, who used the vehicle during the Kentares Massacre. While the Coordinator attended executions in person, the Daimyo HQ's crew transmitted the data to ComStar representatives on the planet who then sent the data through the whole Inner Sphere. When Jinjiro discovered the treason, the whole crew was executed. Daimyo production ceased between the years 3027 and 3063 because the unit's communication system technology become a form of Lostech. column1: The Dart was built when the Federated Commonwealth was looking for BattleMechs that were not ammunition dependent. The 'Mech was built with an all energy weapon arsenal on an extremely high-speed chassis. The 'Mech is capable of speeds of up to 151 km/h and is armored with three and a half tons of armor. The 'Mech, while lightly armed, is an exceptional recon 'Mech and also works well in a guerrilla force where its use of energy weapons allows it to operate independently. Quirk: Extended Torso Twist Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: 联邦合众国寻找不依赖弹药的战斗机甲时，Dart 应运而生。这台机甲以极高速底盘搭载全能量武器配置，最高速度可达 151 公里/小时，并装有三吨半装甲。虽然武装较轻，Dart 却是出色的侦察机甲；它的能量武器使其能够独立行动，在游击部队中同样表现出色。 特性：扩展躯干扭转 部署费用倍率：0.98

column1: The Deimos was developed by the Snow Raven Clan and the Mech was first introduced during the middle of the 3060s, allegedly on the Kerensky Cluster world of Lum. However, Inner Sphere intelligence agencies stopped hearing rumors about the 'Mech during the Jihad and it faded from memory. In 3085, the Snow Ravens revealed the existence of the Deimos to the Inner Sphere. It is considered as the pride of the Clan making at least one assigned to every touman. The A variant was geared for general combat.
column2: 火卫二是由雪鸦氏族开发的，而机甲则在 3060 年代中期首次引入，据称是在克伦斯基星团世界 Lum 上。然而，内部领域情报机构在圣战期间不再听到有关“机甲”的谣言，它也从记忆中消失了。 3085年，雪鸦向内层世界透露了火卫二的存在。它被认为是氏族的骄傲，为每个头曼至少分配了一个。 A型是为一般战斗而设计的。

column1: The DemoMax was built by MaxTech for the exact opposite of its construction focused siblings, dedicated entirely to demolition and destruction work. It became one of the rare MaxTech designs to sell in near record numbers, prized for being easy to pilot and versatile enough to handle nearly any wrecking job. Its heavy industrial armor protects it from the everyday hazards of debris and workplace accidents, though it notably lacks environmental sealing, leaving it grounded compared to something like the SpacerMax.
column2: DemoMax 由 MaxTech 打造，与专注建造工作的同系列机甲完全相反，专门执行拆除和破坏任务。它成为 MaxTech 少有的销售数量接近纪录的设计之一，因易于驾驶且用途广泛、几乎能处理所有拆除工程而备受青睐。重型工业装甲可防护碎片和工伤等日常危险；但它明显缺少环境密封，因此无法像 SpacerMax 那样执行相关任务。

column1: The Djinn is the first known example of the so-called Demon Series of battle armor designs produced by Word of Blake for their Manei Domini. The Djinn has been carefully crafted to instill fear in its enemies. Its slim profile shows that it is obviously specially designed for Manei Domini troopers, since their use of cybernetic enhancements make up for the muscular bulk that "frail" Elementals and their Inner Sphere counterparts need to operate battle armor.
column2: Djinn 是已知最早的“恶魔系列”战斗装甲，由圣言之书为其人类主宰制造。Djinn 的设计目标就是让敌人心生恐惧。它纤细的外形显然是为人类主宰步兵量身打造的，因为他们的控制论强化弥补了“脆弱”的元素战士及其内天体对手操作战斗装甲所需的肌肉体格。

column1: The Dominus configuration is armed with a pair of arm-mounted Heavy PPCs, giving it powerful ranged combat capabilities. It also has a Snub-Nose PPC and a pair of ER Medium Lasers mounted in the head and center torso, respectively, giving it a powerful close range punch. Eight additional double heat sinks keep the 'Mech's heat under control.
column2: Dominus 配置双臂各安装一门重型 PPC，具备强大的远程作战能力。头部和中央躯干分别安装短管 PPC 与一对增程中型激光，近距离火力同样强劲。额外的八具双重散热器负责控制机甲热量。

column2: Dominus 配置配备了一对安装在手臂上的重型 PPC，赋予其强大的远程作战能力。它还在头部和躯干中央分别安装了一个短管PPC和一对ER中型激光器，使其具有强大的近距离拳击能力。八个额外的双散热器可以控制“Mech”的热量。

column1: The Donar Assault Helicopter is a versatile VTOL that is useful in a variety of roles, similar in concept to the Inner Sphere's Warrior. The helicopter is operated by a pilot and copilot/gunner seated in a tandem configuration, with a limited amount of redundancy in both positions should one or the other be knocked out. Three tons of Compound A2F ferro-fibrous armor keeps it safe from small arms fire, and its rotary blades will remain operational even when hit by 40mm caliber weapons. The well-armored hide also gives the Donar a good survival rate in low-altitude crashes. Like most VTOLs, the Donar is fast, capable of achieving up to 151 km/h. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. column1: The Doom Courser is a 70 ton Quad OmniMech introduced by Clan Hell's Horses in an attempt to improve the performance of their QuadVee and improve the carrying capability of Elementals into battle by their forces.
column2: Doom Courser 是一台 70 吨四足全能机甲，由地狱之马氏族推出，旨在提升 QuadVee 的性能，并提高部队将元素战士运入战场的能力。

column1: The Dreka 1S prototype was built to showcase the 2 massive Defiance Hammerfist Heavy Gauss Rifles and is the testbed for what one day will become the Fafnir.
column2: Dreka 1S 原型机是为展示两门强力 Defiance Hammerfist 重型高斯步枪而打造的，也是未来 Fafnir 研发计划的试验平台。

column1: The Dreka 1S prototype was built to showcase the 2 massive Defiance Hammerfist 重型高斯步枪s and is the testbed for what one day will become the Fafnir.
column2: Dreka 1S原型机用于展示两门巨大的Defiance Hammerfist重型高斯步枪，也是未来Fafnir的试验平台。

column1: The E Configuration was, like the D configuration, developed during the Jihad. It was designed to use a large quantity of range-weaponry as its primary focus. The Hauptmann's right arm is fitted with a Gauss Rifle with 2 tons of ammunition mounted in that section. In the left arm, a Plasma Rifle has been fitted. Both arms have their lower arm actuators removed to allow for the pilot to flip arms. The Plasma Rifle's 2 tons of ammunition are stored in the left arm and in the left torso. The 'Mech's only secondary weapons are a pair of 5-Tubed Multi-Missile Launchers mounted in each side torso. The Hauptmann has been given 3 tons of CASE protected ammunition for the missile weaponry.
column2: E 配置与 D 配置一样，都是在圣战期间开发的，主要目标是使用大量远程武器。Hauptmann 右臂安装一门高斯步枪，并在该部位配置两吨弹药；左臂安装一门等离子步枪。两侧下臂驱动器都被拆除，以便驾驶员翻转手臂。等离子步枪的两吨弹药存放在左臂和左侧躯干。机甲唯一的副武器是两侧躯干各一具五管多用途导弹发射器，另配三吨由 CASE 保护的导弹弹药。

column1: The E configuration makes use of a Hyper-Assault Gauss Rifle 30 in each arm, though each one only has a single ton of ammunition to draw upon.
column2: E 配置双臂各装一门 Hyper-Assault Gauss Rifle 30，不过每门只有一吨弹药可用。

column1: The E configuration makes use of a 超突击高斯 Rifle 30 in each arm, though each one only has a single ton of ammunition to draw upon.
column2: E 配置双臂各使用一门 30 型超重型突击高斯步枪，但每门只有一吨弹药。

column1: The ERE-P2 is fully focused on long range combat, as it combines the Mass Driver with a 超重型突击高斯 Rifle and two Extended Range Large Pulser Laser. To be able to fit all the weapons and somewhat adequate cooling, the 设计 uses an XXL 引擎, which leaves it more vulnerable to side torso penetration. 怪癖: 稳定 Weapons 掉落成本乘数: 1.4 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: ERE-P2 完全专注于远程战斗，将质量驱动器、超重型突击高斯步枪和两具扩展射程大型脉冲激光器结合在一起。为容纳全部武器并提供勉强足够的冷却，设计采用 XXL 引擎，但这也让它更容易遭受侧面躯干穿透。 怪癖：稳定武器s 掉落成本乘数: 1.4 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: The EWS on this mech are actually decent for a Quicsell product. Through sheer tonnage, if nothing else. It's a pretty decent all-rounder, but you need to know how to use those lasers. The long range damage drops off to nothing, and they're no good against structure, so stripping off armor from nearby fast moving targets is their bread and butter.
column2: 这台机甲的 EWS 对 Quicsell 产品而言其实还不错，哪怕只是靠巨大的吨位撑起来的。它是相当可靠的全能型机甲，但你得知道如何使用那些激光。远程伤害会衰减到几乎为零，而且它们对结构无效，所以剥掉附近高速目标的装甲才是它们的拿手好戏。

column1: The Ebony is a light BattleMech produced jointly by the Magistracy of Canopus and the Capellan Confederation. This stealthy BattleMech first appeared in 3081, and was reportedly being built in factories on Canopus IV and Sian. The 'Mech is allegedly named for the Magistracy's secret intelligence branch, the Ebon Magistrate.
column2: Ebony 是金星都督府与卡佩兰联邦联合生产的轻型战斗机甲。这台隐形战斗机甲于 3081 年首次出现，据称在金星都督府第四行星和 Sian 的工厂生产。传闻它以都督府秘密情报部门 Ebon Magistrate 命名。

column1: The Echidnae is one of the most rare and powerful Battlemech's, equipped with carefully preserved LosTech is it able to quickly strike hard and suppress the opposition.
column2: Echidnae 是最稀有、最强大的战斗机甲之一，装备精心保存的失落科技，能够迅速发动猛烈打击并压制敌人。

column1: The Eminus variant is similar in many respects to the Luminos with its pair of arm-mounted ER PPCs. It differs in that it is ground-bound and more focused on long range. It only carries a pair of ER Small Lasers to supplement its damage potential up close. Instead, it mounts an ER Large Laser and a Light PPC. The inclusion of a Targeting Computer makes all the weapons more accurate.
column2: Eminus 型号在许多方面与 Luminos 相似，都装备一对安装在双臂的增程 PPC。不同之处在于它不具备飞行能力，更专注远程作战。它只装备一对增程小型激光补充近距离伤害；主要武器则是增程大型激光和轻型 PPC。瞄准计算机使所有武器更加精准。

column1: The Endo Steel, Enhanced Imaging, Active Probe and XL engine are all Clan made, everything else is Innersphere Tech. One Rotary AC5 and a MRM30 launcher, coupled with 2 Medium Xpulse laser Make it a Threat on the Battlefield. 12 Double Heatsinks Cool this Mech Down, but its still kinda Hot. Wait... what the hell is that? Why is there a Streak SRM Launcher ON the Arm, not IN it?
column2: Endo Steel 内骨钢、增强成像、主动探测器和 XL 引擎均为氏族制造，其余设备则是内天体技术。一门旋转 AC/5、一具 MRM-30 和两门中型 X 脉冲激光器，让它在战场上颇具威胁。12 台双倍散热器负责为机体降温，不过它仍然相当热。等等……那是什么鬼？为什么一具连发 SRM 发射器装在手臂上，而不是装进手臂里？

column1: The Enyo Strike Tank is a combat vehicle produced by Clan Hell's Horses. Following the success of the XL Engine variant of the Mars, Khan Malavai Fletcher ordered his scientist caste to come up with a main battle tank that could take advantage of the speed a lightweight engine could bring. His successor, James Cobb, liked the idea and maintained the mandate for such a proof of concept. The result of the scientists' labor is the Enyo. It can hit speeds up to 97 km/h, which enables it to keep up with many Clan medium 'Mechs. Seven and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor protect the tank, allowing it to withstand some punishment, though speed is its best defense. Biome Restrictions: None.
