column1: The Eris, named after the Terran Goddess of Chaos and Strife, is capable of delivering a stunning long range blow that can unexpectedly crush all but the most capable Combatants.
column2: Eris 以特兰的混乱与纷争女神命名，能够在远距离发动惊人打击，出其不意地击溃除最强悍战士之外的几乎所有敌人。

column1: The Exhumer is a medium BattleMech first produced for the Draconis Combine in the third decade of the thirty-second century. The 'Mech was first advocated to enter the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery by Benjamin District Warlord Mitsura Sakamoto, who felt that the design would become a mainstay of the Combine's Armed forces. With the Warlord's backing, the 'Mech would finally enter service with its first production models joining the 2nd Benjamin Regulars in 3129. However, early engagements using the 'Mech by frontline forces would prove disastrous due to a flaw in the Exhumer's targeting systems. The 'Mech orders from DCMS were subsequently canceled, shuffling the produced units to sale in the mercenary market.
column2: Exhumer 是一台中型 BattleMech，于三十二世纪第三个十年首次为 Draconis Combine 生产。Benjamin 区军阀 Mitsura Sakamoto 首先倡议将它编入 Draconis Combine 军队，认为该设计会成为联合部队的主力。在军阀支持下，首批量产机终于于 3129 年加入第 2 Benjamin 常备团。然而，前线部队早期使用它作战时，目标锁定系统的缺陷造成了灾难性后果。DCMS 随后取消订单，将已生产单位转售给佣兵市场。

column1: The Expunger 1 mounts a total of five Compact PPC, four of them are mounted in the head while the fifth sits in the center torso. Each arm also carries a 转管自动炮/10, meaning the burst potential of the Expunger 1 is quite high. 怪癖: 精准 Weapon - Ballistics 掉落成本乘数: 1.47 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Expunger 1 总共安装五具紧凑型 PPC，其中四具位于头部，第五具安装在中央躯干。双臂还各有一门转管自动炮/10，因此 Expunger 1 的爆发潜力相当高。 怪癖：精准武器 - Ballistics 掉落成本乘数: 1.47 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: The Expunger is a 185 ton strike superheavy designed and fielded by Clan Wolverine. Any enemy is wise to never turn its back on an Expunger, as it is often used to bring their latest experimental weapons to the front - especially the Compact PPC. The Compact PPC is one of Clan Wolverine's most secret weapons, developed in parallel to the general Clan improvements of original Star League PPC technology. Although the Expunger has for a Superheavy 'Mech low rated engine core, the 'Mech' instead utilizes two massive Booster Jets to outmaneuver enemy forces. As a final touch, the torso mounted cockpit of the Expunger ensures the safety of the pilot, allowing the 'Mech's head to be fully utilized for Compact PPCs.
column2: 毁灭者是由 Wolverine 氏族设计并部署的 185 吨突击型超重型机甲。任何敌人都不应将后背暴露给毁灭者，因为它常被用于将氏族最新的实验武器送上前线，尤其是紧凑型 PPC。紧凑型 PPC 是 Wolverine 氏族最机密的武器之一，与氏族对星盟时期原始 PPC 技术的普遍改进同步开发。虽然以超重型机甲的标准来看，毁灭者的引擎核心额定功率偏低，但它改为使用两具巨型助推喷射器来机动压制敌军。最后，躯干式驾驶舱确保驾驶员安全，也让机甲头部能够完全用于安装紧凑型 PPC。

column1: The Extinguisher FireMech comes from two brothers out of Rasalhague who built it as a dedicated emergency response unit, well equipped enough to handle fires both large and small. They designed the controls simply enough for even novice pilots to operate with ease, a decision that helped secure a thousand unit order from the Star League. Environmental sealing protects the pilot from smoke, and 24 tons of industrial armor keep it safe in the line of duty, though its modest 54 kph top speed means these 'Mechs typically stay stationed close to the areas they're meant to protect.
column2: Extinguisher FireMech 出自 Rasalhague 两兄弟之手，他们将它打造为专用应急响应单位，装备精良，足以应对大小火情。他们将操控设计得足够简单，让新手驾驶员也能轻松使用，这一决定帮助他们获得星盟的一千台订单。环境密封系统保护驾驶员免受烟雾侵害，24 吨工业装甲让它能在执行任务时保持安全；但最高速度仅 54 kph，因此这类机甲通常驻扎在需要保护的区域附近。

column1: The F loadout combines rapid-fire and energy weaponry for versatile offensive roles. Twin Rotary Gauss Rifles, prototypes from Clan Wolverine’s Project Omega, deliver high heat and burst damage, with a risky “Overload” mode for powerful single shots. Complementing these are two Ion Stream Projectors that scatter energized plasma particles for close-range suppression, backed by two i-LRM 15 launchers for indirect guided missile fire. A Medium Pulse Laser in the head provides additional short-range precision. Equipped with Beagle Probe, Guardian ECM, and the PHI Suite, this setup excels in flexible engagement but demands careful heat and ammo management. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.4 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: F 型配置结合速射武器与能量武器，承担灵活的进攻任务。两支旋转高斯步枪是钢琴狼计划 Omega 的原型武器，能产生高热和爆发伤害，并拥有风险很高但可发射强力单发的“过载”模式。两具离子流投射器可散射高能等离子粒子，用于近距离压制；两具 i-LRM 15 则提供间接制导导弹火力。头部的中型脉冲激光提供额外的近距离精准射击。Beagle 探测器、Guardian ECM 和 PHI 套件使其擅长灵活交战，但需要谨慎管理热量和弹药。 特性：多目标追踪 部署成本倍率：1.4 手臂执行器限制：全向机甲

Even a single ER 大型脉冲激光 is mounted in the head. Quirk: 稳定武器 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.42

column1: The FDE-1A is one of the most unconventional Capellan 设计s ever fielded, built around twin Arrow IV 火炮 systems carrying a staggering variety of munitions. Homing, cluster, Thunder, Inferno and 大卫·克罗克特 nuclear rounds give it an answer to virtually any battlefield situation. A torso-mounted cockpit frees the head for an 反导系统 and heat sink. 中型激光s and 小型脉冲激光s handle self-defense, but the Fusillade was never meant to fight at close range. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: FDE-1A是卡佩兰投入服役的最不寻常设计之一，围绕两套Arrow IV火炮系统打造，能够携带种类惊人的弹药。制导弹、集束弹、雷霆弹、地狱火弹和大卫·克罗克特核弹头使它几乎能应对任何战场情况。躯干驾驶舱腾出头部空间，用于安装反导系统和散热器。中型激光器和小型脉冲激光器负责自卫，但Fusillade从未被设计用于近战。 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The Fa Shih duplicates many of the features of the Inner Sphere Standard battle armor, including its jump capacity and most of the weaponry used. However the suit went against battle armor philosophy at the time by emphasizing defensive capabilities as much as offensive.

column1: The Falconer FLC-10R attempts to address the most common complaint of the FLC-8R, the tendency of its Gauss Rifle to take catastrophic damage, by increasing the amount of effective 装甲 the 机甲 carries by utilizing 轻型铁纤维装甲-Fibrous 装甲 and dropping one heat sink. While updating the 设计 the lasers were also all upgraded to Extended Range versions. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Falconer FLC-10R 通过增加有效装甲来解决 FLC-8R 高斯步枪易受灾难性损伤的问题，采用轻型铁纤维装甲并减少一具散热器。升级过程中，所有激光器也换成扩展射程型号。 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

The 设计 also upgrades the 中型激光s to Extended Range variants. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 猎鹰者FLC-11R解决了FLC-9R最常见的问题：装甲略显不足。改用强化纤维装甲后，它增加了1.5吨有效装甲。该机甲还将中型激光升级为延伸射程型号。 特性：稳定 击杀倍率：1.11 左下部装甲，右下部装甲

column1: The FarmerMax started out as a quadrupedal design, but MaxTech ran into gyro and stability problems in that configuration and converted it into a bipedal machine instead. Built as an all-in-one farming solution, it combines harvesting, irrigation and land clearing into a single unit, making it valuable enough to replace multiple pieces of separate equipment. Its 11 tons of industrial armor rarely see much use given the low-risk nature of agricultural work, though they've occasionally helped it survive when caught up in conflict.
column2: FarmerMax 最初采用四足设计，但 MaxTech 遇到了陀螺仪与稳定性问题，于是将其改成双足机体。它是一款一体化农用解决方案，将收割、灌溉和土地清理整合到同一台设备中，价值足以替代多种独立农机。它装备 11 吨工业装甲；农业作业风险较低，平时很少用得上，但偶尔卷入冲突时，这些装甲也曾帮它幸存下来。

column1: The Federated Commonwealth rejected this one for being too slow and underarmored for its weight, which tells you something about how they think. The Taurian Concordat saw it differently, and honestly I side with them. Three Gauss Rifles on one frame is not something you just walk away from. Production line got wrecked in the Jihad and the design nearly vanished entirely. Finding one of these still operational is like finding a fossil that can still bite.
column2: 联邦国拒绝了这款机甲，认为以其重量而言速度太慢、装甲太薄，这能说明他们的想法。陶瑞安协约国却有不同看法，我老实说站在他们这边。一台机体上装三把高斯步枪，不是你能轻易忽视的火力。生产线在圣战中被摧毁，这种设计几乎完全消失。找到一台仍能运行的，就像发现一块还会咬人的化石。

column1: The Ferret Light Scout VTOL was first introduced to House Davion troops in 2901 and later adopted by House Marik, House Steiner and certain Periphery powers. The vehicle serves as an advanced scout with the ability to monitor enemy troop movements and radio in artillery strikes. Thanks to its speed, a single Ferret can patrol a front of up to twenty kilometers long, moving quickly from one area to the next. The vehicle is lightly armored and a hit from nearly any kind of 'Mech weaponry will destroy the Ferret. However, the Ferret's job is to avoid combat, and its agility allows it to remain outside the effective range of the enemy's weapons until reinforcements arrive. Besides reconnaissance and artillery spotting, the Ferret's cargo capacity also makes it suitable for transport and rescue operations. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. column1: The Firestorm was created by a combined group of Spina Khanate and Wolf Empire warriors and technicians. Based on a new OmniMech derived from the Shadow Cat, this long term project wasn't ready for production; however, a BattleMech could be developed from a planned configuration, thus laying the groundwork for the Firestorm. With this in mind, the Clan Wolf warriors favored a weapons suite focused on incendiary operations. This allowed the Wolf touman to rapidly expand its second line and garrison forces without incurring the cost of expensive OmniMechs.

column2: Fury 凭借武器和防护水平，在 SLDF 内广受欢迎。这一设计还因配备 Nirasaki-400X 指挥计算机而闻名。该系统接近人工智能，在最初星盟覆灭前是速度最快的战场计算机之一。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：4/6 格 / 120/180 米。 装甲：装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 前部 325 40 左侧 225 40 右侧 225 40 后部 200 40 炮塔 300 40 总计 1275 200 特质：主战坦克

column1: The GLD-9SF mounts varied equipment to enable the machine to douse fires, weld seams, lift over 100 tons, and otherwise appear as a mundane spaceport IndustrialMech — an illusion quickly dispelled with one look at its right arm and its ER PPC. When moving cargo, pilots can use a special diagnostic computer mode that runs the shoulder-mounted flamers in a repeating activation cycle, automatically keeping the 'Mech's enhanced myomers active and giving the -9SF the appearance of a steam-age automaton with a flame-spouting smokestack. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: GLD-9SF 安装了各种设备，使机器能够灭火、焊缝、提升超过 100 吨的重量，或者看起来像一个普通的太空港工业机甲——只要一看它的右臂和 ER PPC，这种错觉很快就消失了。运输货物时，飞行员可以使用特殊的诊断计算机模式，在重复激活周期中运行肩部安装的火焰喷射器，自动保持“Mech”的增强型 myomer 处于活动状态，并使 -9SF 看起来像带有火焰喷出烟囱的蒸汽时代自动机。 Quirk： Cowl 下降成本乘数：1.05

column1: The GUN-3ERD was intended to be a renewed symbol of friendly relations between the Combine, Commonwealth, and Republic shortly before the Blackout. Instead, it became one of the first casualties of the Inner Sphere’s descent into anarchy. Using X-Pulse lasers and Clan ER Medium Lasers to update the earlier designs, but still keeping the Gauss Rifles. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: GUN-3ERD 原本计划在 Blackout 前不久成为龙马幕府、联邦共和体和共和国友好关系的新象征，最终却成了内环陷入无政府状态后的首批牺牲品之一。该设计以 X 脉冲激光和氏族增程中型激光升级早期型号，同时保留高斯步枪。 特性：罩甲 部署费用倍率：1.15 手臂致动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: The Gauntlet is a medium-class OmniMech that was manufactured for the Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces. It was designed as a swift cavalry unit capable of keeping up with lighter 'Mechs while also being able to bring the flexibility and firepower of a medium 'Mech.
column2: Gauntlet 是一款为莱拉联邦武装部队制造的中型全能机甲。它被设计成快速骑兵单位，既能跟上轻型机甲，又能发挥中型机甲的灵活性和火力。

column1: The Ghostmaker balances heavy armor and average speed with overwhelming firepower. Its primary weapons are paired RAC-5s, each carrying five tons of ammo, allowing it to sustain prolonged combat. James’s skill ensures these rotary autocannons rarely jam, making them a formidable threat. Secondary weapons include four ER Medium Lasers and paired Medium Pulse and ER Small Lasers, providing solid short-to-medium range firepower in case of rotary jams. Twelve double heat sinks manage heat during intense firing, though James mainly relies on lasers as a backup. Despite its power, James is disappointed by the Ghostmaker’s lack of speed, limited by a 300 XL Fusion engine. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - AC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.13 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Ghostmaker 兼具厚重装甲和普通速度，火力则压倒性地强。它的主武器是一对 RAC-5，每门配有 5 吨弹药，足以支撑持久作战。James 的高超技巧使这些转管自动炮极少卡壳，成为令人生畏的威胁。副武器包括四门增程中型激光，以及成对的中型脉冲激光和增程小型激光；万一转管炮卡壳，它们可提供可靠的近中程火力。12 台双倍散热器可应对猛烈射击时产生的热量，不过 James 主要把激光当作备用武器。尽管 Ghostmaker 火力强大，James 仍对其速度不足感到失望，因为 300 级 XL 聚变引擎限制了机甲的机动性。 特性：精准武器 - 自动炮 部署费用倍率：1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Gladiator is a commissioned Black Knight refit, carrying 2 prototype Plasma Cannons, Hardened Armour and composite internal structures. A brutal Solaris brawler with enhanced melee abilities.
column2: 角斗士是受委托改装的黑骑士，配备两门原型等离子炮、强化装甲和复合内骨架结构。这是一台在 Solaris 上以近战闻名、格斗能力得到强化的凶悍机甲。

column1: The Gnat is a basic scout used by many periphery factions. Too lightly armored to withstand any real combat it fully relies on evasion and stealth armor to avoid being hit.
column2: Gnat是许多边疆势力使用的基础侦察机。它装甲过于薄弱，无法承受真正的战斗，完全依靠规避和隐形装甲来避免被击中。

column1: The Gorgon is a heavy fire support unit that often anchors ProtoMech Points. A Jihad era variant, this model utilized an AP Gauss Rifle and SRM-6 Launcher. It was given a half-set of jump jets and a rearrangement of its protection.
column2: Gorgon是重型火力支援单位，经常作为原型机甲分队的核心。这个圣战时代的变体使用AP高斯步枪和SRM-6发射器，并配备半套跳跃喷射器，重新调整了防护布局。

column1: The Gorgon is a heavy fire support unit that often anchors ProtoMech Points. Developed in the 3060s, this variant is designed for close-quarters combat. The long-range weaponry is dropped, for additional armor, Jump Jets, and a Medium Pulse Laser.
column2: Gorgon 是一种重型火力支援单位，常作为 ProtoMech 小队的核心。该型号于 3060 年代开发，专为近距离战斗设计。它拆除远程武器，换取额外装甲、跳跃喷射器和一门中型脉冲激光。

column1: The Goshawk II is a Medium BattleMech built by Clan Snow Raven in the mid-3080s. Based on the heavier Vapor Eagle (also known as the Goshawk), it is produced on the Inner Sphere world of Dante. The Goshawk II was designed as a second-line BattleMech for use exclusively by the Ravens.
column2: Goshawk II 是雪鸦氏族在 3080 年代中期制造的中型战斗机甲。它以更重的 Vapor Eagle（也称 Goshawk）为基础，在内天体的 Dante 星生产，专供雪鸦作为二线战斗机甲使用。

column1: The Grand Summoner shares some similarities to its predecessor, sharing the same size XL Fusion Engine, and physical appearance. What differs from the older design is its Pod Capacity; the Grand Summoner has a 30.5 ton capacity over the older model's 22.5. This increase of capacity comes from the reshuffling of the 'Mech's internal components and dropping the original's permanently-mounted Jump Jets from the design. The Grand Summoner's armor protection is slightly greater than the original, with half a ton more. The Prime Configuration long-range firepower comes from its side-torso-mounted 15-Tubed Long-Range Missile Launcher and pair of arm-mounted Class 5 Ultra Autocannons. Their ammunition is kept where these weapons are housed, with single ton per Autocannon and two tons for the missile launcher. In intermediate and close ranges, the Grand Summoner's full arsenal — including its four Extended Range Medium Lasers — can be brought to bear on a target with a minimum of overheating concerns (except when its Jump Jets are in use).
column2: 巨型召唤者与其前身有一些相似之处，采用相同规格的 XL 融合引擎，外观也相近。两者的差异在于模块容量：巨型召唤者拥有 30.5 吨模块容量，而旧型号为 22.5 吨。增加的容量来自机甲内部组件的重新布局，以及移除原设计中永久固定的跳跃喷射器。巨型召唤者的装甲防护略胜原型，多出半吨装甲。基础配置的远程火力来自安装在两侧躯干的 15 管远程导弹发射器，以及双臂各一门的 5 级超重型自动炮。弹药存放在对应武器所在位置：每门自动炮各配一吨弹药，导弹发射器配两吨。在中近距离，巨型召唤者可倾泻全部武器，包括四门增程中型激光器，过热顾虑很小（使用跳跃喷射器时除外）。

column1: The Gravedigger was introduced by Odin Manufacturing in an effort to stave off bankruptcy. The company's plants sustained heavy damage in the Second Combine-Ghost Bear War, and the Gravedigger was produced to generate much needed capital. Built using many Inner Sphere components, the 'Mech was designed to be cheap to produce. When introduced, it initially used standard Inner Sphere weaponry, but after the massive infusion of money from sales to mercenary forces Odin created a new version with Clan-spec weaponry and additional electronics.
column2: 掘墓者是奥丁制造公司为了避免破产而推出的。该公司的工厂在第二次联合鬼熊战争中遭受严重破坏，而生产掘墓者是为了筹集急需的资金。 “Mech”使用许多“Inner Sphere”组件构建，其设计成本低廉。推出时，它最初使用标准的内层武器，但在向雇佣兵部队销售大量资金后，奥丁创建了一个带有氏族规格武器和附加电子设备的新版本。

column1: The Gray Death Heavy battle armor has a built-in Support PPC, two detachable one-shot SRM-4s, a Basic Manipulator, and Improved Sensors.
column2: 灰死病重型战斗装甲内置一门支援型 PPC，配有两具可拆卸的一次性 SRM-4、基础操纵器和改进型传感器。

column1: The Gray Death Heavy battle 装甲 has a built-in Support PPC, two detachable one-shot SRM-4s, a Basic Manipulator, and 改进型传感器.
column2: Gray Death重型战斗装甲内置支援PPC、两具可拆卸的一次性SRM-4、基础操纵器和改进型传感器。

column1: The Great Turtle was designed as an experiment in MechWarrior safety. With the recovery of the Helm Memory Core, weapons technology had advanced more in the twenty years between the Fourth Succession War and the Clan Invasion than it had in the previous three hundred years. One effect of these advances in weapons was the dramatic reduction in a MechWarrior's life expectancy. Many weapons could destroy a 'Mech's head, engine, or gyro with one shot, leaving the MechWarrior dead or wounded. VEST took the concept of MechWarrior protection to an extreme. The Great Turtle uses a quad chassis to hold the maximum amount of armor possible. The Great Turtle's armor weighs 40 tons, as much as a Clint BattleMech. For more protection the VEST engineers used experimental Hardened Armor that effectively provides twice as much protection as standard armor. This means that the Great Turtle can take staggering amounts of damage without worrying the pilot. Enemies who target the 'Mech's head looking for a clean kill will be disappointed. The Hardened armor can withstand a Gauss rifle hit, but more importantly, the Great Turtle uses a Torso Mounted Cockpit to provide extra protection for the pilot. Using a standard engine reduces the possibility of an engine explosion, and a compact gyro further increases longevity.
column2: Great Turtle 是为研究机甲战士安全而设计的实验品。赫尔姆记忆核心重新发现后，第四次继承战争至氏族入侵之间短短二十年的武器技术进步，超过此前三百年的总和。这些进步造成的后果之一，是机甲战士预期寿命大幅缩短：许多武器一发就能摧毁机甲头部、引擎或陀螺仪，让机甲战士死亡或负伤。VEST 将保护理念推向极致。Great Turtle 使用四足底盘，以容纳尽可能多的装甲。其装甲重达 40 吨，与一台 Clint 战斗机甲相当。为进一步提高防护，VEST 工程师采用实验型强化装甲，其有效防护能力是标准装甲的两倍。因此 Great Turtle 能承受惊人的伤害，驾驶员无需担心。瞄准机甲头部、试图一击毙命的敌人会失望：强化装甲可以抵挡高斯步枪命中。更重要的是，它采用躯干安装式驾驶舱，为驾驶员提供额外保护。标准引擎降低了引擎爆炸的可能性，紧凑型陀螺仪则进一步延长生存时间。

column1: The Griffin 2N is an old Star League model that was among the most versatile 'Mechs in its heyday. Its weapons generated a lot of heat, but the old 双散热器 were put in to handle it.
column2: Griffin 2N是古老的星盟时代型号，在其鼎盛时期属于最为多用途的机甲之一。它的武器会产生大量热量，但古老的双重散热器足以处理这些热量。

column1: The Grigori is one of the Word of Blake's new Celestial series OmniMechs designed by Doctor Devon Cortland. The Grigori (named after fallen angels from Christianity) was added to the Word of Blake Militia's arsenal in late 3069 as Doctor Cortland oversaw the final production personally. It is constructed on a standard chassis, but makes use of eleven tons of Light Ferro-Fibrous armor, a light fusion engine, and an XL Gyro; as well as the small cockpit that is common to all of the Celestials. Like the other Celestials, the Grigori has a C3i Computer to help direct its fire. Another missile-heavy variant, the Grigori B mounts an Artemis IV-guided MML-7 in each arm. A Plasma Rifle provides respectable firepower and forces conventional units to reconsider attacking the Infernus variant. A Medium Pulse Laser provides a more accurate weapon. A rear-mounted ER Small Laser makes small units think twice about attacking the 'Mech's rear. Like the Invictus, this configuration can also jump up to 120 meters.
column2: Grigori 是布雷克之言新型天体系列全能机甲之一，由 Devon Cortland 博士设计。Grigori（名称取自基督教中的堕落天使）于 3069 年末加入布雷克之言民兵的武库，最终生产由 Cortland 博士亲自监督。它采用标准底盘，但使用 11 吨轻型铁磁纤维装甲、轻型融合引擎和 XL 陀螺仪；驾驶舱则与所有天体系列一样采用小型设计。与其他天体系列一样，Grigori 配备 C3i 计算机来辅助火力指挥。另一个以导弹为主的变体 Grigori B 在每条手臂上各安装一具由 Artemis IV 制导的 MML-7。等离子步枪提供可观火力，也能让常规单位重新考虑是否攻击 Infernus 变体。中型脉冲激光器则提供更精准的武器。后置增程小型激光器让小型单位不敢轻易从机甲后方进攻。与 Invictus 一样，该配置也能跳跃至 120 米。

column2: Grim Reaper 是 ComStar 为补充 Tukayyid 战役中 Com Guards 遭受的重大装备损失而设计的机甲。Blake 圣言占领泰拉后继续生产它，以重建并扩充 Blake 圣言民兵。因此，无论世俗还是狂热武装中都能见到数量可观的 Grim Reaper。它作为通用步兵机甲设计，武器载荷种类繁多但缺乏专精。这台定制机甲由 Com Guard 的 Einar Halldórsson 牧师研发，专注于生存能力并使用氏族技术武器。

column1: The Grizzly is a BattleMech that was developed by Clan Ghost Bear scientists in the 30th century. Unfortunately, the design excels at no one thing, so it never carved a niche in the Clan's touman. Thirteen tons of armor are mounted on an Endo Steel frame. Jump jets are mounted so that the Grizzly can leap up to 120 meters at a time. Aside from the 'jack of all trades, master of none' moniker, the Grizzly is also poorly engineered. Slagged armor tends to get stuck in joints and weapons, while the actuators are difficult to repair in their own right.
column2: 灰熊是一款由幽灵熊氏族科学家于 30 世纪研发的战斗机甲。遗憾的是，它没有任何特别突出的长处，因此始终未能在氏族机甲部队中找到定位。机体以 Endo Steel 内骨钢骨架承载 13 吨装甲，并配备跳跃喷射器，单次可跃行至多 120 米。除了“样样通、样样松”的名号，灰熊的工程设计也颇为糟糕：熔渣装甲容易卡进关节和武器中，致动器本身也很难维修。

column1: The Grond is a massive 175-ton OmniMech built by Hallowed Iron Assembly for the Minnesota Tribe, visually resembling a larger Stone Rhino. Equipped with an Endo-Steel frame, a potent 350-rating XL engine, and Plasmo-Electric Heat Sinks, it expertly manages heat from its devastating energy weapons. Designed foremost as an offensive alpha-striker, the Grond unleashes overwhelming, high-impact volleys to shatter enemy defenses quickly. Its imposing presence and raw power embody the Tribe’s doctrine of relentless, decisive firepower, making it a terrifying force that dominates the battlefield with swift, crushing strikes.
column2: Grond 是一台重达 175 吨的巨型全能机甲，由圣铁工造为明尼苏达部落制造，外观像放大版的石犀。它采用内骨骼框架、强力的 350 级 XL 引擎和等离子电散热器，能够熟练处理毁灭性能量武器产生的热量。Grond 的首要定位是进攻型全弹齐射机甲，以压倒性的高冲击火力迅速击碎敌方防线。它的威严外形与原始力量体现了部落毫不留情、果断火力的信条，能以迅猛而沉重的打击主宰战场。

column1: The Gryphon D configuration delivers high accuracy and firepower by combining a Class 30 超重型突击高斯 Rifle (split between the left arm and left torso), an 改进的 Heavy Large Laser, and an ER Small Laser. All three weapons are connected to a 定位 Computer, greatly improving their lethality. 怪癖: 战斗计算机 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.

column1: The Gryphon, built from an improved Hellbringer chassis, is Clan Stone Lion’s durable heavy OmniMech. It features thick Ferro-Lamellor armor—nearly double that of its predecessor—25.5 tons of pod space, and a supercharged 325 XL engine with 10 double heat sinks. Though slightly lighter than the Hellbringer, it delivers strong protection and firepower, reaching speeds over 100 kph briefly. Manufactured mainly on Niles, the Gryphon is agile and tough, with five flexible variants and the unique ability to carry Battle Armored troops into combat, making it a key unit in Clan Stone Lion’s touman.
column2: Gryphon 以改进型 Hellbringer 底盘为基础，是石狮氏族坚固的重型 OmniMech。它采用厚重的 Ferro-Lamellor 装甲，几乎是前身的两倍，拥有 25.5 吨模块载荷空间、增压 325 级 XL 引擎和 10 台双倍散热器。虽然略轻于 Hellbringer，它仍兼具防护和火力，短时间速度超过 100 km/h。Gryphon 主要在 Niles 生产，机动灵活且坚韧，拥有五种灵活变体，还能搭载战斗装甲部队投入战斗，是石狮氏族的重要单位。

column1: The HAR-111 is the export variant of the Haruna, stripping out all Clan technology while retaining the core 设计 philosophy. 守护者ECM powers the Stealth 装甲, MASC still pushes the 35-ton frame past 170 kph and the Vibroblade remains as the primary close-range threat. A 中型X脉冲激光 Laser replaces the Heavy 中型激光 and twin Streak SRM 2s handle ranged harassment. This model reached the Magistracy of Canopus and 弗朗克边域 markets. 怪癖: Nimble 掉落成本乘数: 0.98

column1: The HBK-GI Grid Iron is the Hero variant of the Hunchback. It has the characteristic hunch with quirks that emphasize the Gauss Rifle and 中型脉冲激光s. It comes from the factory with 双散热器, Endo-Steel, and an XL引擎. Unfortunately, since Gauss Rifles explode like ammo, the XL引擎 tends to be more of a downside.
column2: HBK-GI“铁栅”是巫师的英雄变体。它保留标志性的驼背结构，并通过特性强化高斯步枪和中型脉冲激光。出厂时配备双倍散热器、内骨骼和XL引擎。不幸的是，高斯步枪会像弹药一样爆炸，因此XL引擎往往反而成为弱点。

column1: The Hai is a heavy cavalry 'Mech born from Lyran desperation and Sea Fox negotiation. Produced by Defiance Industries in 3140, it’s a joint effort that gave both sides what they wanted—advanced firepower and profit. Based on the Uziel 8S, the Hai uses a Sea Fox XL engine and Clan-spec weapons to deliver superior range and damage. Heavier than its predecessor, it can take and deal more punishment, making it a valuable asset in modern combat.
column2: 海是一款重型骑兵机甲，诞生于莱兰人的困境与海狐氏族的谈判。Defiance Industries 于 3140 年投产，这项合作让双方各取所需：先进火力与商业利润。海以 Uziel 8S 为基础，使用海狐氏族 XL 引擎和氏族规格武器，提供更远射程与更强杀伤力。它比前代更重，能承受并造成更大的打击，因此成为现代战场上的重要资产。

column1: The Headsman is one of the largest 'Mechs made by the clans. A 190 ton OmniMech with a 450 XXL engine, Ferro-Carbide Lamellor Armor and advanced piloting, firing and EWS systems, it is not a 'Mech you want to see in the opposing forces. It's major downside is it very high cost, making acquiring, fielding and repairing it a huge cost.
column2: Headsman 是氏族制造的最大型机甲之一。这台 190 吨全能机甲装备 450 XXL 引擎、Ferro-Carbide Lamellor 装甲以及先进的驾驶、火控和电子战系统，没人愿意在敌方阵线看到它。它最大的缺点是价格极高，获取、部署和维修都要付出巨大代价。

column1: The Heavy Metal model of the Highlander is the signature ride of Rhonda Snord of the Snord's Irregulars mercenary unit. This customized Highlander features a number of recently reintroduced Lostech technologies. The most expensive example is the 275 XL引擎 which saves weight for a heavy weapons payload, a Gauss Rifle in the right arm provides respectable punch at long range, while 13 双散热器 keep the design running cool.
column2: 高地人重金属型是斯诺德游击队雇佣兵罗达·斯诺德的标志性座驾。这款定制高地人采用多项近期复原的失落科技。最昂贵的部件是275级XL引擎，可减轻重量以携带重型武器；右臂的高斯步枪提供可靠的远程火力，13台双倍散热器让机甲保持低温运行。

column1: The Hel HL-1 does not bring anything more fancy than a Heavy PPC, a single 锁定式SRM-6 launcher and two ER 中型激光s, but this also keeps the mech quite reliable and easy to maintain. The Endo Steel 结构 saves enough weight to also fit a 250 XL引擎, making the '机甲 quite mobile. Five jump jets add to the mobility, resulting in the '机甲s common role of a fast flanker performing hit and run strikes. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: Hel HL-1没有追求花哨配置，只装备重型PPC、一具锁定式SRM-6发射器和两门ER中型激光，因此可靠且易于维护。内骨骼钢结构节省的重量足以安装250级XL引擎，使机甲相当灵活。五具跳跃喷射器进一步提升机动性，让它成为快速侧翼突袭机甲。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右侧下臂

column1: The Hel is noted for its large 40 ton Omni Pod Capacity. This improvement was achieved through reducing the size of the 'Mech's engine to a 260-Rated XL Fusion Engine, installing a Small Cockpit, and the use of Ferro-Fibrous armor. The Prime Configuration of the Loki is geared towards long-range combat. The 'Mech's arms are fitted with a pair of Gauss Rifles and ER Large Lasers. In closer ranges, MechWarriors have a right torso mounted 4-tubed Streak SRM Launcher to add additional firepower where the Gauss Rifles become difficult to aim. The main guns are supplied with 3 tons of ammunition, while the Streak launcher is allotted a single ton. Two additional Double Heat Sinks are fitted to the Prime, to help it cope with the heat of the ER Larges.
column2: Hel 以巨大的 40 吨全能挂载舱容量闻名。这一提升通过缩小引擎、换用 260 级 XL 聚变引擎、安装小型驾驶舱并采用铁纤维装甲实现。Loki 的 Prime 配置专注于远程作战，双臂各装一门高斯步枪和 ER 大型激光。近距离时，右侧躯干的四管 Streak SRM 发射器可补充火力，弥补高斯步枪难以瞄准的问题。主炮配有 3 吨弹药，Streak 发射器配有 1 吨；Prime 还安装两个额外双重散热器，以应对 ER 大型激光产生的热量。

column1: The Hellspawn was designed in response to a call from the Federated Commonwealth for a modern, highly mobile, fire-support BattleMech. The Hellspawn is built on an Endo Steel chassis and a 270 XL engine that gives it a top speed of 97.2 km/h. For protection, the Hellspawn is equipped with a Guardian ECM Suite and has six and a half tons of armor that is barely adequate when compared to other medium 'Mechs. This 3081 variant carries a Light PPC and ER Medium Laser in each arm. It's also equipped with a Guardian ECM Suite, Beagle Active Probe, and TAG. The Hellspawn-10SR also carries eight Improved Jump Jets, allowing for 240 meter jumps.
column2: Hellspawn 是为响应联邦共和体对现代、高机动火力支援战斗机甲的需求而设计的。它采用 Endo Steel 底盘和 270 XL 引擎，最高速度可达 97.2 km/h；配备 Guardian ECM 套件和六吨半装甲，与其他中型机甲相比仅勉强够用，并安装六具跳跃喷射器提升机动性。这个 3081 年型在每条手臂各配备一门轻型 PPC 和一门增程中型激光，同时搭载 Guardian ECM 套件、Beagle 主动探测器与 TAG。Hellspawn-10SR 还配备八具改进型跳跃喷射器，可跳跃 240 米。

column1: The Hellspawn was designed in response to a call from the Federated Commonwealth for a modern, highly mobile, fire-support BattleMech. The Hellspawn is built on an Endo Steel chassis and a 270 XL engine that gives it a top speed of 97.2 km/h. For protection, the Hellspawn is equipped with a Guardian ECM Suite and has six and a half tons of armor that is barely adequate when compared to other medium 'Mechs. column1: The Hierofalcon is a medium Clan OmniMech designed primarily as a striker unit by Clan Jade Falcon. As part of the push to be ever more flexible in movement, the 'Mech features a 270-rated extralight engine, allowing the mech to move at speeds up to 97.2 km/h. The addition of a permanently equipped partial wing adds dual benefits, both increasing jump distance and cooling capabilities. The 'Mech's hull is protected by seven and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor, giving it modest protection from enemy fire, while an ECM suite provides additional protection from other threats.
column2: Hierofalcon 是翡翠隼氏族设计的中型氏族 OmniMech，主要作为突击单位。为提升机动灵活性，它配备 270 级额外轻型引擎，速度可达 97.2 km/h。永久安装的部分翼带来双重收益，既增加跳跃距离，也改善散热。机体由 7.5 吨铁磁纤维装甲保护，防护能力适中，ECM 套件则抵御其他威胁。

column1: The Hierophant is a 200-ton superheavy OmniMech fielded by the Minnesota Tribe as a battlefield oracle, commanding, interpreting, and unleashing battlefield truth with devastating clarity. Named for the ancient spiritual title of one who reveals sacred mysteries, the Hierophant embodies the Tribe’s view of war as a ritual of revelation. Exclusively piloted by high-ranking commanders, it serves as both a strategic nerve center and an unyielding war idol. Powered by a volatile Magnothermic Plasma Engine and cooled with advanced Plasmo-Electric Heat Sinks, the Hierophant stands as a towering symbol of the Tribe’s grim, transcendent purpose.
column2: Hierophant 是一台 200 吨级超重型全能机甲，由明尼苏达部落部署为战场神谕，负责指挥、解读并以毁灭性的清晰度揭示战场真相。它的名字源自古老的宗教称号，指代揭示神圣奥秘之人；Hierophant 体现了部落将战争视为启示仪式的观念。它只由高级指挥官驾驶，既是战略中枢，也是坚不可摧的战争图腾。Hierophant 由不稳定的磁热等离子引擎驱动，并以先进的等离子电热散热器冷却，巍然象征着部落阴郁而超然的使命。

column1: The Hornet debuted in 2760 as an urban recon '机甲, but lack of interest forced the 设计 to be shelved two years later. In 2990, 卡隆工业 rediscovered the blueprints and resumed production. The upgraded HNT-171 started production in 3051. The production line was destroyed by the Capellans in 3069. The '机甲 is 设计ed around the concept of being able to swiftly move through an urban environment with relatively heavy 装甲. Overall, because of its eclectic mix of weapons and relatively slow speed, the Hornet is only somewhat effective when inside of a city. When caught outside an urban environment the '机甲 is hard pressed to defend itself. 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 0.97 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Hornet于2760年作为城市侦察机甲首次亮相，但缺乏兴趣使该设计两年后搁置。2990年，卡隆工业重新发现图纸并恢复生产；升级后的HNT-171于3051年投产，生产线在3069年被卡佩兰摧毁。该机甲旨在以相对厚重的装甲快速穿越城市环境。由于武器混杂且速度较慢，Hornet在城市内尚算有效，离开城市后则很难自卫。 怪癖：窄小/低调 掉落成本乘数：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左侧上臂、右侧上臂

column1: The Horses have supplemented their generalist and missile boat Svartalfas with a close-combat variant dropping the Streak missiles to mount more chemical lasers. Accordingly, it is slightly less sluggish once airborne.
column2: 马匹为他们的多面手和导弹船斯瓦塔法斯号补充了一种近战变体，可以投放条纹导弹以安装更多的化学激光器。因此，一旦升空，它的迟缓程度就会稍微减轻一些。

column1: The Hunchback C is the antithesis of the 驼背 IIC used by other Clans, combining toughness and great ground speed with the heavy firepower of its autocannon. Piloted by Star Commander Matthew Wayne, of the Clan Ghost Bear's Seventh Phalanx. Disgraced after losing his OmniMech and from an insignificant Bloodhouse, he saw it as his only resort to take charge of a Hunchback of Lyran origins. However, heavy modifications to the 'Mech and his unrelenting desire to redeem himself led to him eventually being adopted by Delta Galaxy's Seventy-Third Battle Cluster, before he finally was killed while clearing Blakists during a glorious charge at Fell's Fort.
column2: 驼背 C 与其他氏族使用的巨型驼背 IIC 截然相反，兼具坚固耐用、地面速度出色和自动炮火力强大等特点。它由幽灵熊氏族第七方阵的星队指挥官 Matthew Wayne 驾驶。失去自己的 OmniMech、又因出身于不起眼的血宅而蒙羞后，他认为驾驶一台源自莱茵同盟的驼背是唯一出路。然而，他对机甲进行的大幅改造，加上始终不渝的自我救赎之志，最终使他获准加入三角星系第七十三战斗集群。后来，他在费尔堡的一次英勇冲锋中清剿圣战军时阵亡。

column2: I 型配置使用原型机甲 AC/4，并结合内层星域盟友提供的等离子步枪。最终武装是一门增程中型激光。

column1: The I configuration, popularized by Star Commander Lauren Hawker, features an ER PPC paired with a capacitor in the left arm, and two Rotary Autocannon/2s in the right arm to exploit holes opened up by the PPC.
column2: I 型配置由星际指挥官 Lauren Hawker 推广：左臂的增程 PPC 配有电容器，右臂则有两门旋转自动火炮/2，用来利用 PPC 撕开的装甲缺口。

column1: The IIC 10 is hard to see as anything other than a conceptual failure. This variant of the IIC 2 has been recently spotted in Raven AMC units. The use of Proto机甲-class autocannons results in a platform that does nothing especially well, with the loss of range and accuracy a serious hindrance. The addition of a supercharger to enable pilots to close range is insufficient to balance things out.
column2: 很难把IIC 10看作概念失败以外的东西。这个IIC 2改型最近在乌鸦特遣队单位中被发现。使用原型机甲级自动加农炮后，它没有任何特别擅长之处，射程和精度的损失更是严重障碍。加装增压器以帮助驾驶员接近目标，也不足以弥补这些缺点。

column1: The IIC 4 retains two of the Large Pulse Lasers from the base variant, but adds a pair of ATM 9s, each of which can draw on two tons of ammunition. Sixteen double heat sinks are all that is needed to keep all heat from the weapons under control.
column2: IIC 4 保留基础变体的两门大型脉冲激光器，并增加两门 ATM 9，每门可使用两吨弹药。十六组双散热器足以控制全部武器产生的热量。

column1: The Ice Ferret Prime-EWR is an emergency refit developed by the Invading Clans to improve the Mechs combat effectiveness. Prompted by a shortage of ER PPC's, Clan Techs swapped in a Large Pulse Laser with the ER Small Laser being sacrificed for a Flamer and the SSRM-2 changed for an SRM-4
column2: Ice Ferret Prime-EWR 是入侵氏族为提升机甲战斗效能研发的紧急改装型。由于增程 PPC 短缺，氏族技师换装一门大型脉冲激光器；牺牲增程小型激光器改为火焰喷射器，并将 SSRM-2 换成 SRM-4。

column1: The Ice Ferret Prime-EWR is an emergency refit 开发 by the Invading Clans to improve the 机甲s combat effectiveness. Prompted by a shortage of ER PPC's, Clan Techs swapped in a 大型脉冲激光 with the ER Small Laser being sacrificed for a Flamer and the SSRM-2 changed for an SRM-4
column2: 冰雪貂 Prime-EWR 是入侵氏族开发的紧急改装型，用于提升机甲战斗效能。由于增程 PPC 短缺，氏族技术人员换装一门大型脉冲激光器；拆除增程小型激光器，换成一具火焰喷射器；并将 SSRM-2 改为 SRM-4。

column1: The Imp II was developed as the next generation Command Mech by Clan Wolf and Clan Diamond Shark together. The result is a 140 ton, heavily armored 'Mech filled with EWS and lance coordination equipment, but is generally seen as a failure due to its lack of proper firepower for its cost.
column2: Imp II 由狼氏族与钻石鲨氏族共同研发，是新一代指挥机甲。它重达 140 吨，装甲厚重，配备 EWS 和长枪协调设备；但由于与成本相比火力不足，通常被视为失败之作。

column1: The Impaler is James "Amalor Myrnnyx" Degenhardt's custom-built replacement for the lost UrbanMech "Crossfire." Debuting in 3085 with Melody's Rockers, the 50-ton 'Mech uses a 350 XL engine to hit 119 kph, emphasizing speed. With Stealth Armor, Guardian ECM, and a frame partially based on a Mad Cat Mk II Enhanced, it's hard to track and harder to hit. Armed with twin lances and Clan tech, the Impaler brings medieval menace to the battlefield without suffering from the balance issues typical of mixed-origin builds.
column2: Impaler 是 James“Amalor Myrnnyx”Degenhardt 为取代失踪的 UrbanMech“Crossfire”而定制打造的机甲。它于 3085 年随 Melody 乐队首次亮相，是一台 50 吨机甲，采用 350 级 XL 引擎，速度可达 119 千米/小时，设计重点在于高速。它配备隐形装甲和守护者 ECM，底盘部分参考增强型 Mad Cat Mk II，因此难以追踪，更难命中。Impaler 装有双枪骑兵长枪和氏族技术，在战场上带来中世纪般的威胁，同时避免了混合来源改装常见的平衡问题。

column2: 穿刺者是詹姆斯·“阿马洛尔·米尔尼克斯”·德根哈特为替代失踪的城市机甲“交火”而定制制造的机甲。它于 3085 年随梅洛迪的摇滚手登场，这台 50 吨机甲使用 350 级 XL 引擎达到 119 kph，强调速度。凭借硬化装甲、守护者 ECM 以及部分基于强化型 Mad Cat Mk II 的骨架，它难以被追踪，也更难被命中。穿刺者装备两把长枪和氏族技术，把中世纪般的威胁带上战场，同时避免了混血设计常见的平衡问题。

column1: The Incursion ICR-N5 carries an LRM 20 for ranged harassment alongside six small lasers for close defense, all backed by a Guardian ECM suite, Beagle active probe and remote sensor dispenser. An anti-missile system and CASE protect it further, while a supercharger boosts its already high speed. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: Incursion ICR-N5 搭载用于远程骚扰的 LRM 20 以及用于近距离防御的 6 个小型激光器，所有这些均由 Guardian ECM 套件、Beagle 主动探头和远程传感器分配器提供支持。反导弹系统和外壳进一步保护它，而增压器则提高了它已经很高的速度。 怪异：改进的传感器 降低成本乘数：1.1 Arm 执行器限制：左下

column1: The Incursion ICR-N5 carries an LRM 20 for ranged harassment alongside six small lasers for close defense, all backed by a Guardian ECM suite, Beagle active probe and remote sensor dispenser. An anti-missile system and CASE protect it further, while a supercharger boosts its already high speed. 特性：Improved Sensors 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂
column2: Incursion ICR-N5携带一具LRM-20进行远程骚扰，并以六门小型激光器负责近距离防御；整机还配备守护者ECM套件、比格犬主动探头和远程传感器分配器。反导系统和CASE进一步提供保护，增压器则让它本已很高的速度更上一层楼。 特性：改进型传感器 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

column1: The Incursion ICR-N5-2 drops the C.A.S.E. and all of the Small Lasers to instead add three Medium Lasers and an extra heat sink. These changes were a common request for garrison units as they tended to find more utilization for the longer range of the Medium Laser than the shorter range of the Small Lasers. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: 入侵 ICR-N5-2 掉落 C.A.S.E.以及所有小型激光器，改为添加三个中型激光器和一个额外的散热器。这些变化是驻军部队的常见要求，因为他们往往更倾向于使用长射程的中型激光器而不是短程的小型激光器。 Quirk：改进传感器 下降成本乘数：1.1 Arm执行器限制：左下

column1: The Incursion ICR-N5-2 drops the C.A.S.E. and all of the Small Lasers to instead add three 中型激光器 and an extra heat sink. These changes were a common request for garrison units as they tended to find more utilization for the longer range of the 中型激光器 than the shorter range of the Small Lasers. 特性：Improved Sensors 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂
column2: Incursion ICR-N5-2拆除C.A.S.E.和所有小型激光器，改为增装三门中型激光器和一组散热器。驻军单位经常提出这种改动，因为相比小型激光器较短的射程，他们更需要中型激光器的远射程。 特性：改进型传感器 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

column1: The Inferno heavy OmniMech was introduced by StarCorps Industries of Crofton after New Avalon fell to the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery in the Dark Age. With twenty-nine tons of pod space available and protected by thirteen and a half tons of armor, the Inferno became a popular unit in the AFFS. By building on an Endo-Steel chassis with a Compact Gyro engineers were able to free up a lot of space in the traditionally crowded center torso. This freed room for heavy weapons in the most heavily protected part of the 'Mech. In every configuration the main weapons are mounted in the center torso, with additional weaponry in the side torsos (often in over the shoulder mounts), leaving the arms free for physical attacks.
column2: Inferno 重型全能机甲由 Crofton 的 StarCorps 工业推出，时间是在新 Avalon 于黑暗时代陷落、被龙辰联邦集结军占领之后。它拥有 29 吨挂载舱和 13.5 吨装甲，因此很快成为 AFFS 的热门单位。工程师采用内骨骼钢底盘和紧凑型陀螺仪，从传统上拥挤的中央躯干中腾出了大量空间。这些空间可用于在机甲防护最严密的部位安装重型武器。所有配置都将主武器装在中央躯干，侧躯干则配备额外武器（通常为肩上安装），让双臂能够专注于物理攻击。

column1: The Infernus variant is a mobile sniper and a capable light 'Mech killer. Six Jump Jets catapult the 'Mech up to 180 meters at a leap. A Heavy PPC gives the Preta B a respectable punch. It is supplemented by an ER Medium Laser.
column2: Infernus 型是机动狙击机甲，也能有效猎杀轻型机甲。六具跳跃喷射器可将机体一次抛至 180 米。重型 PPC 让 Preta B 拥有可观的火力，另有一门增程中型激光器提供补充。

column1: The Infernus variant is a mobile sniper and a capable light 'Mech killer. Six Jump Jets catapult the 'Mech up to 180 meters at a leap. A Heavy PPC gives the Preta B a respectable punch. It is supplemented by an ER 中型激光.
column2: 地狱火型是机动狙击配置，也是出色的轻型机甲杀手。六具跳跃推进器可使机甲一次跳跃180米。重型粒子加农炮为普瑞塔B提供了可靠的火力，另有一门增程中型激光作为补充。

column1: The Invictus variant of this light 'Mech features a Light PPC, an ER Medium Laser, and a Flamer that allow it to operate far from supply lines. The SRM-2 is capable of mounting inferno munitions, which can make quick work of vehicles and infantry. To protect the 'Mech from ammunition explosions it mounts CASE in the right torso. For close combat it carries a Retractable Blade.
column2: Invictus 型号是一台轻型机甲，装备轻型 PPC、增程中型激光和喷火器，因此能远离补给线作战。SRM-2 可装填地狱火弹药，能迅速解决车辆和步兵。为防止弹药爆炸，右侧躯干安装 CASE；近战时则携带一把可收回刀刃。

column1: The Invictus variant of this light '机甲 features a Light PPC, an ER 中型激光, and a Flamer that allow it to operate far from supply lines. The SRM-2 is capable of mounting inferno munitions, which can make quick work of 车辆s and infantry. To protect the '机甲 from ammunition explosions it mounts CASE in the right torso. For close combat it carries a 可伸缩刀刃.
column2: 该轻型机甲 Invictus 改型装备轻型 PPC、ER 中型激光器和火焰喷射器，可脱离补给线作战。SRM-2 能装填 Inferno 弹药，迅速消灭车辆和步兵。右侧躯干安装 CASE 防止弹药爆炸，近战时携带可伸缩刀刃。

column1: The Invictus, or primary, version of the Archangel carries a Guardian ECM Suite to allow the 'Mech to disrupt enemy electronics and targeting systems. For ranged combat, the Archangel Invictus carries a Plasma Rifle and Heavy PPC, both of which are slaved to an advanced targeting computer. The Invictus also includes jump jets, allowing the 100-tonner to hop 90 meters. Finally, a Retractable Blade gives the design added defense in close combat situations.
column2: Archangel 的 Invictus（基础）型号搭载 Guardian ECM 套件，能够干扰敌方电子设备和瞄准系统。远程作战时，Archangel Invictus 使用等离子步枪和重型 PPC，两者均接入先进瞄准计算机；跳跃喷射器让这台 100 吨机甲能跳跃 90 米。最后，可收回刀刃为近战提供额外防御。

column1: The Invictus, or primary, version of the Archangel carries a 守护者ECM Suite to allow the '机甲 to disrupt enemy electronics and targeting systems. For ranged combat, the Archangel Invictus carries a 等离子步枪 and Heavy PPC, both of which are slaved to an advanced targeting computer. The Invictus also includes jump jets, allowing the 100-tonner to hop 90 米. Finally, a 可伸缩刀刃 gives the 设计 added defense in close combat situations.
column2: Archangel的Invictus（基础）版本携带守护者ECM套件，可干扰敌方电子设备和瞄准系统。远程作战时，Archangel Invictus使用一把等离子步枪和一门重型PPC，两者都连接至先进瞄准计算机。Invictus还配备跳跃喷射器，使这台100吨机体能够跳跃90米。最后，可伸缩刀刃为该设计提供额外的近战防御。

column1: The Ion Sparrow, initially designated as the Butcherbird when first encountered by the Lyran Intelligence Corps, was introduced by Clan Jade Falcon on Alyina as an experimental testbed for the advanced partial wing system. The Ion Sparrow uses an endo steel chassis, XL engine, ferro-fibrous armor, and small cockpit to save weight. Eight jump jets have been mounted in the right and left torso, and when paired with the partial wing, allows the Ion Sparrow to cover 300 meters per jump. The wing also works with the double heat sinks to dissipate more heat.
column2: 离子麻雀最初被莱茵情报兵团发现时，代号为屠鸟；随后，玉衡鹰氏族在Alyina推出它，作为先进局部翼系统的实验测试平台。离子麻雀采用Endo Steel骨架、XL引擎、Ferro-Fibrous装甲和小型驾驶舱以减轻重量。左右躯干安装了八台跳跃喷射器，与局部翼配合后，每次跳跃可跨越300米。机翼还能与双重散热器协同，散去更多热量。

column1: The Italipas, or Chinook as it is known by Clan Coyote, was designed before but produced nearly 30 years after Clan Coyote’s touman was devastated in the Wars of Reaving. Built at the rebuilt Barcella Alpha facility using updated Nova Cat components, production was fast. This 70-ton heavy OmniMech sacrifices speed for firepower and protection, featuring a 280-rated XL engine with a supercharger boosting sprint speed from 64 to 86 kph. With 15.5 tons of Ferro-Lamellor armor and an Endo Steel skeleton, it offers excellent defense and ample pod space despite its bulk.
column2: Italipas（郊狼氏族称其为 Chinook）早在郊狼氏族军团于掠夺战争中遭受重创前就已设计，但近 30 年后才投入生产。它在重建的 Barcella Alpha 工厂使用更新后的新星猫部件快速生产。这台 70 吨重型全能机甲牺牲速度换取火力和防护，配备 280 级 XL 引擎，并通过增压器将冲刺速度从 64 提升到 86 公里/小时。15.5 吨 Ferro-Lamellor 装甲和内骨骼框架让它即使体型庞大，仍拥有出色防御和充足挂载舱空间。

column1: The JES III Missile Carrier was originally built in the 3130s prior to the fall of the HPG Communication grid. The JES III was designed to be faster and better armored than its two predecessors. The vehicle's main armaments consist of four LRM-15 launchers mounted in the turret. For self-defense against regular infantry the vehicle also mounts two machine guns. The machine guns share a half ton of ammunition, while the LRM-15s can draw from a six-ton ammunition bay. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 200 30 Left 110 30 Right 110 30 Rear 100 30 Turret 135 30 Total 655 150 Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles
column2: JES III 导弹载具最初于 3130 年代、HPG 通信网络崩溃前建造。JES III 的设计比前两代速度更快、装甲更厚。其主要武器为炮塔内的四具 LRM-15 发射器；为了抵御普通步兵，车辆还装有两挺机枪。机枪共用半吨弹药，LRM-15 则可从 6 吨弹药舱中取用弹药。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米。 装甲：装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 前部 200 30 左侧 110 30 右侧 110 30 后部 100 30 炮塔 135 30 总计 655 150 特性：精准武器 - 导弹

column1: The JagerMech H is a Marian Hegemony retrofit designed as a multipurpose command mech. Able to support at range while still crippling any over eager headhunting unit with a barrage of rockets.
column2: JagerMech H 是马里安霸权的改装型，设计为多用途指挥机甲。它既能提供远程支援，也能用火箭齐射重创冒进的猎头单位。

column1: The JagerMech JO is a field refit that carries 2 Light Gauss Rifles in place of its ACs.
column2: JagerMech JO 是战场改装型，以两门轻型高斯步枪取代原有的自动炮。

column1: The Jager机甲 H is a 马里安霸权 retrofit 设计ed as a multipurpose command mech. Able to support at range while still crippling any over eager headhunting unit with a barrage of rockets.
column2: Jager机甲H是马里安霸权的改装设计，定位为多用途指挥机甲。它能在远距离提供支援，同时用火箭弹幕击垮任何过于冒进的猎头单位。

column1: The Jager机甲 JO is a field refit that carries 2 轻型高斯步枪s in place of its ACs.
column2: Jager 机甲 JO 是战地改装型，用两具轻型高斯步枪替换自动炮。

column1: The Jenner JR7-RX design has been adapted to carry several Multi Missile Launcher.
column2: Jenner JR7-RX 设计经过改装，可搭载多具多用途导弹发射器。

column1: The Jenner JR7-RX 设计 has been adapted to carry several 多用途导弹发射器.
column2: Jenner JR7-RX设计改装后可搭载数个多用途导弹发射器。

column1: The Jenner JR8-X is a commissioned Mercenary Design, bringing Thunderbolt launcher with pinpoint accuracy.
column2: Jenner JR8-X 是受委托设计的佣兵机甲，配备一具能够精准命中的 Thunderbolt 发射器。

column1: The Joermungandr, named for the great 'Midgard Serpent' of ancient Norse legend said to herald Ragnarok and bring an end to the Gods, brings a terrifying rain of fire and death to the battlefield.
column2: Joermungandr 以古诺斯传说中预示诸神黄昏、终结众神的巨大“米德加尔特巨蛇”命名，为战场带来令人恐惧的火焰与死亡之雨。

column1: The Justicar SecurityMech arms a machine gun and SRM 2 in the right arm for crowd control, backed by a small laser near the left wrist for close lethal threats. An LRM 5 in the left arm covers ranged engagements against vehicles or fighters. Six tons of heavy industrial armor offer modest protection. Quirk: Ubiquitous Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.71
column2: Justicar SecurityMech 右臂装有机枪和 SRM-2 用于控制人群，左腕附近的小型激光则负责应对近距离致命威胁。左臂的 LRM-5 可远程攻击车辆或战斗机。六吨重型工业装甲提供适度防护。 特质：无处不在 部署费用倍率：0.71

column1: The K306 variant is a modification of the Battle Hawk that looks to make the 'Mech more durable. This is accomplished by removing the XL Engine and replacing it with a Light Fusion Engine, which allows the 'Mech to withstand the destruction of a side torso. Additionally, the Medium Pulse Lasers have been upgraded to ER Medium Lasers and the Streak SRM-2 launcher has been replaced with a Streak SRM-4 launcher.
column2: K306 型是 Battle Hawk 的改进型，旨在增强机体耐久性。它拆除 XL 引擎并换装轻型聚变引擎，使机甲即使一侧躯干被摧毁也能继续作战。此外，中型脉冲激光器升级为增程中型激光器，连发 SRM-2 发射器则换成连发 SRM-4。

column1: The Kamakiri mounts three weapon systems mounted in the front of the VTOL - a single Tiegart Particle Projection Cannon and a pair of Telos ThunderShot Thunderbolt 10 Missile Launchers. The Kamakiri Attack VTOL was developed at the end of the thirty-first century by Yan Manufacturing of New Samarkand as a result of their growing success in the military aerospace market. Dubbed as resembling a praying mantis, the Kamakiri was an immediate success; the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery personnel responsible for supervising the first vehicle trial watched for just two minutes before approving the Kamakiri for purchase. Moving as fast as many reconnaissance and strike platforms in service with the DCMS already thanks to the DAV 155 XL extra light engine, the original specification armor installed by Yan was replaced with seven tons of StarGuard Aurora Reflective at the request of the DCMS, who wanted to improve the Kamakari's protection against energy weapons, although the nature of the Reflective Armor didn't offer any additional protection against the flak commonly directed at VTOLs. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 7/11 hexes / 210/330 meters. Armor: Reflective Coating Structure: Structure Values A S Front 175 30 Left 140 30 Right 140 30 Rear 100 30 Total 580 150 Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles

column1: The Karura is a heavy trooper 'Mech introduced in 3084 to replace older designs like the Avatar and Dragon. Built for efficiency, two Karuras can be produced for the cost of one Avatar. With an XL engine and MASC, it can achieve impressive bursts of speed. Though limited beyond 450 meters, it excels in close to mid-range combat with a Heavy PPC, two Medium Lasers, and CASE-protected Streak SRM-6s. Solid armor and flexible battlefield performance make the Karura a reliable frontline workhorse with staying power.

column1: The Kestrel began as a worn-out Phoenix Hawk salvaged by dispossessed 'MechWarrior Steven Faulkner for Solaris VII arena combat. column1: The Kestrel is a close-combat specialist, combining the Phoenix Hawk’s top speed with 8 Improved Jump Jets for exceptional maneuverability and jumps up to 240 meters. Faulkner uses its battle claws to attack weak or damaged rear armor, famously ripping an opponent’s head off during a match. For ranged combat, it features two Medium Variable Speed Pulse Lasers linked to an advanced Targeting Computer, allowing precise, adjustable firepower. Ten double heat sinks cool the mech, though intense jumping and firing can strain them. The reliable 270 Standard engine and light armor balance cost with survivability, enabling it to keep fighting when others fall. column2: Kestrel 是一款近战专家，将 Phoenix Hawk 的最高速度与 8 具改进型跳跃喷口结合起来，拥有卓越的机动性和最长 240 米的跳跃距离。Faulkner 使用它的战斗爪攻击敌方脆弱或受损的后部装甲，并曾在比赛中一举扯下对手的头颅。远程作战时，它配备两门连接至先进定位计算机的中型变速脉冲激光，可提供精准且可调节的火力。十台双倍散热器负责冷却机甲，但高强度跳跃和射击可能使其不堪重负。可靠的 270 级标准引擎和轻型装甲在成本与生存能力之间取得平衡，使它能在其他单位倒下后继续战斗。 特性：空中突袭 部署费用倍率：1.05 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The King Dragon is a new addition to the roster of 'Mechs fielded by House Kurita in the Inner Sphere. Developed by the well-known manufacturer, Takara Tomy, this 'Mech was a massive upgrade over the 60-ton Dragon - both considering firepower and survivability. With its imposing size and heavily reinforced armor, the King Dragon was designed to fill the role of the ultimate heavy-hitter on the battlefield, a true Dreadnought. Despite its massive size, the King Dragon is surprisingly agile thanks to its highly balance chassis, making it a formidable opponent even for lighter and more nimble 'Mechs. This agility, combined with its advanced targeting systems and unparalleled firepower, makes the King Dragon a fearsome sight on any battlefield. The King Dragon quickly gained a reputation as one of the most fearsome and unstoppable Superheavy BattleMechs in the Inner Sphere and pilots of the 'Mech quickly became legendary figures in the various wars and conflicts that wracked the region, inspiring awe and fear in equal measure. Overall, the King Dragon is a testament to the engineering prowess of Takara Tomy and the relentless pursuit of new and improved designs to bring to the battlefield.
column2: King Dragon 是内天体库里的一款新机型，由库里塔家族部署。它由知名制造商 Takara Tomy 开发，相比 60 吨的 Dragon，在火力和生存能力上都有巨大提升。凭借压迫感十足的体型和加厚装甲，King Dragon 被设计为战场上的终极重击者，是真正的无畏舰。尽管体型庞大，它高度平衡的底盘让它出人意料地灵活，即使面对更轻、更敏捷的机甲也毫不逊色。再加上先进瞄准系统和无与伦比的火力，King Dragon 在任何战场上都令人胆寒。它很快成为内天体最可怕、最难以阻挡的超重型战斗机甲之一，驾驶员也在当地接连不断的战争与冲突中成为传奇人物，令人敬畏又恐惧。总体而言，King Dragon 证明了 Takara Tomy 的工程实力，以及其不断追求新设计、改进战场装备的决心。

column1: The Kobold is a battle armor design that was collaborated on by the Free Rasalhague Republic, ComStar, and the second Star League. Originaly a project for a battlesuit that could mimic the capabilities of the Draconis' Kage, later the concept of shifted somewhat to a light armor that can still hold its own in battle. The Kobold can only jump up to ninety meters at a time, but it does boast enough armor to stop a Medium Laser. This armor is of the basic stealth variety, making it more difficult to target far away.
column2: Kobold 是自由拉萨哈格共和国、ComStar 与第二星盟合作设计的战斗装甲。它最初是模仿德拉科尼斯影武者能力的战斗服项目，后来概念有所转变，成为一套仍能在战场上自立的轻型装甲。Kobold 一次最多只能跳跃 90 米，但装甲厚度足以抵挡中型激光。它采用基础隐形装甲，因此远距离下更难被锁定。

column1: The Kohlen K-112 arms a rock cutter in the right arm capable of breaking down anything from pebbles to boulders, paired with a mining drill in the left arm for reaching deeper depths. Twin lift hoists, a searchlight and environmental sealing support deep mining operations. A small laser has been added to the left torso for extra flexibility. Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.87
column2: Kohlen K-112 的右臂配备了一个岩石切割机，能够破碎从卵石到巨石的任何东西，搭配左臂的采矿钻机可以到达更深的深度。双提升机、探照灯和环境密封支持深部采矿作业。左侧躯干添加了一个小型激光器，以提高灵活性。 怪异：坚固 下降成本乘数： 0.87

column1: The Kohlen comes from a long forgotten Terran Hegemony concern, built as a MiningMech capable of replacing entire teams of miners even in dangerous conditions. Its size works against it in tighter mines, but where it fits, it's usually a welcome sight, able to dig itself out of cave-ins with its own tools. 24 tons of industrial armor protect it from falling debris, though its rock cutter and mining drill have occasionally proven far more dangerous when turned against people rather than stone.
column2: Kohlen 来自一个被遗忘已久的泰拉霸权企业，最初设计为采矿机甲，即使在危险环境下也能取代整支矿工队。它体型庞大，在狭窄矿井中反而受限；但只要能开进去，通常都会受到欢迎，因为它能用自己的工具挖出塌方。24 吨工业装甲保护它免受落石伤害，不过岩石切割器和采矿钻偶尔对人使用时，比对石头更加危险。

column1: The Krait A configuration focuses on precise energy-based attacks, using a 定位 Computer linked to twin ER Large Pulse Lasers. It is further backed by an 改进的 Heavy 中型激光器, an 改进的 Heavy Small Laser, and an extra Double Heat Sink for better thermal efficiency. 怪癖: 改进的 Cooling Jacket - Laser 掉落成本乘数: 1.01 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Krait A 专注于精确的能量攻击，使用瞄准计算机连接两具 ER 大型脉冲激光器；另有一具改进型重型中型激光器、一具改进型重型小型激光器和一具额外双散热器，提高热效率。 怪癖: 改进的 冷却夹套 - 激光 掉落成本乘数: 1.01 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Krait Prime configuration is an agile skirmisher, wielding a Class 20 超重型突击高斯 Rifle guided by a 定位 Computer for accurate long-range strikes. Two tons of HAG ammunition support sustained fire, while an 改进的 Heavy 中型激光 and an 改进的 Heavy Small Laser round out its short-range capabilities. 怪癖: 改进的 Cooling Jacket - Laser 掉落成本乘数: 1.01 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Krait Prime配置是一台敏捷的游击机甲，配备20级超重型突击高斯步枪，并由定位计算机引导，以便进行精准的远程打击。两吨HAG弹药支持持续射击，改进型重型中型激光和改进型重型小型激光则完善了它的短程作战能力。 特性：改进型冷却夹套 - 激光 部署费用倍率：1.01 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Kraken may be made by pirates welding different Crab parts together but it's surprisingly well made, though theres some profanity's etched in the chassis towards their ''Queen''.
column2: Kraken 也许是海盗把不同 Crab 部件焊在一起造出来的，但成品出奇地精良；只是底盘上刻着一些针对他们那位“女王”的脏话。

column1: The Kugelblitz, also known as the Hypernova, Superluminous Supernova, or 'Type 1A Supernova' is a gigantic Supernova chassis. Nothing really out of the ordinary until one checks the armor plating on it, mounting WarShip class 'Ferro-Carbide Lamellor', this expensive armor is capable of protecting a 'Mech's internals without issue, but the price to maintain the armor is something even the richest of Clan Diamond Shark might have an issue with.
column2: Kugelblitz 也被称为 Hypernova、Superluminous Supernova 或“1A 型超新星”，是一款巨大的 Supernova 底盘。乍看之下没什么特别，直到注意到它的装甲：这款昂贵的装甲采用战舰级 Ferro-Carbide Lamellor，能可靠保护机甲内部；但即使是最富有的钻石鲨氏族，也可能难以承担其维护费用。

column1: The Kugelblitz, also known as the Hypernova, Superluminous Supernova, or 'Type 1A Supernova' is a gigantic Supernova chassis. column2: Kugelblitz 又称 Hypernova、超光度超新星或“1A 型超新星”，是一副巨型超新星底盘。它本身并无异常，直到人们检查其装甲板：它使用战舰级铁碳化物层压装甲，昂贵的装甲足以保护机甲内部，但维护成本即使对最富有的钻石鲨氏族也可能难以承受。

column1: The Kurita 'Mech designers tried solving their lack of a modern light 'Mech by throwing all the latests tech at it. I am not sure they fully succeeded, or this variant would have been actually mass-produced.
column2: 库里塔机甲设计师试图解决缺少现代轻型机甲的问题，于是把所有最新技术都堆了上去。我不确定他们是否真的成功了，否则这款变体应该早就量产了。

column1: The Kurita '机甲 设计ers tried solving their lack of a modern light '机甲 by throwing all the latests tech at it. I am not sure they fully succeeded, or this variant would have been actually mass-生产.
column2: Kurita 的机甲设计师试图把所有最新技术都塞进这台现代轻型机甲，以解决他们缺少现代轻型机甲的问题。我不确定他们是否真正成功了，否则这个改型本应投入大规模生产。

column1: The L005 variant changes the basic loadout of the Quad机甲 to be more support focused. Two Delta LRM-20 launchers, an experimental Huge Pulse Laser and a 长 Tom 火炮加农炮; all allowing long range support and makes any attempts to approach the 机甲's defensive position quite rough. A 作战套件 even provides electronic warfare capabilities. 怪癖: Reinforced 结构 掉落成本乘数: 1.44
column2: L005型改变了四足机甲的基础配置，使其更偏向支援。两具Delta LRM-20发射器、一门实验型巨型脉冲激光，以及一门长吨级火炮加农炮，都能提供远程支援，让任何试图接近这台机甲防御阵地的行动变得极其困难。一套作战套件还赋予它电子战能力。 怪癖：强化结构 掉落成本乘数：1.44

column1: The LB-185 is another variant of the Lu Bu that replaces the ER PPC with Snub-Nose variants. The lower heat profile allows for dropping three heat sinks, which in turns enables the fitting of an extra Large Laser. Quirk: Improved Cooling Jacket - PPC Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower

column1: The Lament is a Heavy Class BattleMech originally created for the Armed Forces of the 球体共和国 in late 3120s. Its blend of firepower and armor has individuals comparing the 'Mech with previous designs such as the Warhammer and the heavier Awesome Assault 'Mech. Quirk: 可变射程瞄准系统 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 哀叹是一台重型战斗机甲，最初为 3120 年代末的联邦共和国武装部队制造。其火力与装甲的平衡让人们将它与战锤和更重型的强袭机甲相提并论。 特性：可变射程瞄准系统 掉落成本乘数：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左侧下臂，右侧下臂

column2: Lament-3L 围绕两门巨型超激光设计，并配备蓝盾和脉冲模块。

column1: The Lament-3L was 设计ed around two massive Hyper Lasers as well as a Blue Shield and a pulse module.
column2: Lament-3L 围绕两具巨型超脉冲激光器设计，并配备蓝盾偏转护盾和脉冲模块。

column1: The Lao Hu is capable of engaging an enemy at most any range. For long-range combat, the Lao Hu has a Martell ER Large Laser and a Zeus LRM-15 launcher, giving the '机甲 a powerful long range punch. For close combat, the Lao Hu has a devastating Shengli LB-X Autocannon/20 which is capable of firing both solid rounds for 装甲 penetration and cluster rounds allowing it to find holes in already damaged 装甲 and for anti-aircraft use.
column2: 老虎能够在几乎任何距离与敌人交战。远程作战时，它配备 Martell ER 大型激光和一具 Zeus LRM-15 发射器，具有强大的远程打击能力。近战时，老虎使用威力惊人的 Shengli LB-X 自动炮/20：既可发射实心弹穿透装甲，也可发射集束弹，利用已受损装甲上的缺口；此外还能用于防空。

column1: The Laser Bellona was massively upgraded with an XL engine, 装甲ed motive system, Streak LRMs, and a targeting computer This update gives Support Cizins a run for their money. In the late 3060s, under Khan James Cobb's command, 氏族地狱马 began preparation for a renewed presence in the Inner Sphere. The scientist caste saw this as an opportunity to create a new cavalry 车辆, which they called the Bellona. 设计 as a striker and flanker, the Bellona carries enough firepower on a nimble enough frame to keep up with even the fastest-advancing lines. The original specs called for tracks, but test pilots for the 车辆 cited that 'speed is 装甲', which led to the Bellona being re设计ed as a hover坦克. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 10/15 hexes / 300/450 meters. 装甲: 铁纤维装甲(氏族) 结构: 结构 Values A S 前方 160 25 左侧 145 25 右侧 145 25 后方 105 25 炮塔 160 25 总计 715 125 怪癖: Nimble
column2: Laser Bellona通过XL引擎、装甲化动力系统、Streak LRM和瞄准计算机进行了大幅升级，这一更新让支援市民也能与之抗衡。3060年代后期，在汗王James Cobb指挥下，氏族地狱马开始准备重新进驻内圈。科学家阶层借此机会创造了新型骑兵车辆，称为Bellona。Bellona作为突击和侧翼单位设计，在灵活底盘上携带足够火力，甚至能跟上最快的推进部队。原始规格要求履带，但车辆试飞员认为“速度就是装甲”，于是Bellona被重新设计为气垫坦克。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：10/15格 / 300/450米。 装甲：铁纤维装甲（氏族） 结构：结构 数值 A S 前方 160 25 左侧 145 25 右侧 145 25 后方 105 25 炮塔 160 25 总计 715 125 怪癖：灵巧

column1: The Legionnaire was developed as the Federated Suns answer to the Lyran Blitzkrieg, and entered production during the Word of Blake Jihad. A lance of Legionnaires played an important role in the Third Battle of New Avalon, where they quickly assaulted the Blakist force's left flank as they were attempting to ford the Thames river, breaking their momentum and eventually forcing them off world. Capable of reaching 118 km/h, the Legionnaire is a fast flanker.
column2: Legionnaire 是联邦太阳对莱兰闪电战的回应，在圣言之书圣战期间开始生产。一支 Legionnaire 小队在新亚法隆第三次战役中发挥了重要作用：它们迅速攻击正在渡过泰晤士河的圣战派部队左翼，打破其攻势，最终迫使敌军撤离星球。Legionnaire 最高时速可达 118 公里，是优秀的快速侧翼机甲。

column1: The Leopard LPD-79 uses MASC to blitz targets before retreating, mounting two SRM 6s, two Streak SRM 2s, two small pulse lasers and two small lasers for close range devastation. column1: The Lightray was designed by Martinson Armaments to be a heavy scout 'Mech. The Lightray is built on a lightweight endo steel chassis to help maximize the available weight for weapons and equipment, and features a gigantic 385 XL engine, the largest that can possibly be carried by a 'Mech its size. This engine allows the scout 'Mech to outpace most other medium designs with a top speed of 118 km/h, though it lacks the added maneuverability that could be provided by jump jets. The Lightray carries ten and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor, giving the 'Mech a great deal of protection
column2: 光线是Martinson Armaments设计的重型侦察机甲。它采用轻量Endo Steel骨架，以尽量增加武器和设备的可用重量，并配备385级巨型XL引擎，这是同吨位机甲能够搭载的最大引擎。该引擎让这台侦察机甲以118公里/小时的最高速度超过大多数其他中型设计，但它没有跳跃喷射器带来的额外机动性。光线搭载10.5吨Ferro-Fibrous装甲，为机体提供了很强的防护。

column1: The Lineholder was the first BattleMech design to come from Kressly Warworks. The Lineholder is designed around a set of `Common Sense Rules` for 'Mech design. This approach has produced a 'Mech with a good ground speed and respectable amount of armor and firepower. The 'Mech has a top speed of 86.4 km/h, allowing it to keep up with all but the fastest light and medium 'Mechs. The Lineholder also carries ten tons of armor protection and has fourteen heat sinks. Its mix of off-the-shelf weapons and equipment makes the Lineholder a reliable 'Mech that is easy to repair and is dependable in battle. However, the ultimate selling point for the Lineholder, especially to its target audience of small units and minor nobles, is value and price. In the first year of sales, the Lineholder was historically successful compared with other 55-ton BattleMechs. For minor factions able to afford brand new BattleMechs, the Lineholder has become the garrison machine of choice. Quirk: 易于维护 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Lineholder 是克雷斯利工厂推出的第一款战斗机甲。它围绕机甲设计的“常识规则”打造，兼顾良好地面速度、可观装甲和火力，最高速度 86.4 km/h，能跟上除最快轻型和中型机甲外的大多数单位。它携带 10 吨装甲和 14 台散热器，采用现成武器与设备，可靠、易维修且适合战斗。对小型部队和小贵族而言，它最大的卖点是物有所值、价格低廉。上市首年，Lineholder 相比其他 55 吨战斗机甲取得了历史性的成功；对于买得起新机甲的小型势力，它已成为首选驻防机甲。 特性：铁纤维装甲 掉落成本乘数：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左侧下臂，右侧下臂

column1: The Little Brother comes from the Parallax Corporation, built to accompany its larger counterpart the Big Brother onto the field. It carries nothing but combat equipment, no superfluous industrial gear weighing it down, making it purpose built despite its IndustrialMech roots. It holds up fine against primitive combat vehicles and infantry but stands little chance against an actual BattleMech, and its speed leaves it wanting once drawn into open terrain.
column2: Little Brother 来自 Parallax Corporation，设计用来伴随更大的 Big Brother 上战场。它只携带战斗设备，没有多余的工业装备拖累重量，因此尽管源自工业机甲，仍是专门的战斗平台。它应付原始战斗车辆和步兵还算不错，但面对真正的战斗机甲机会渺茫，一旦进入开阔地形，速度不足的问题就会暴露。

Taking a standard Longinus suit, reducing its jumping ability to sixty meters, shedding 120 kg of armor, and limiting the weapons payload capability, "Chiphead" was able to install an experimental battle armor C3i system captured from the Word of Blake.
column2: “黑入版”朗基努斯战斗装甲是鲁古鲁斯亲王国的技师马克“芯片头”贾帕卢奇对标准朗基努斯进行的实验性改装。他与苹果电脑星际公司合作，利用回收技术协助重建鲁古鲁斯军队。芯片头以标准朗基努斯战斗装甲为基础，将跳跃距离缩短至 60 米、削减 120 千克装甲，并限制武器载荷能力，最终装上了一套从圣言之子手中缴获的实验型战斗装甲 C3i 系统。

column1: The Mauler MAL-2P should be considered a prototype. Unlike the -1P or MX90, the -2P carries a pair of Lasers in each arm; it's rumored that more than two can affixed if need be. Its twin LRM-10s allow it to send missiles at a greater distance and two 超级自动炮/5s give it long to close range support. Both the LRMs and UAC/5s have two tons of ammunition a piece, and like the -1P and MX90, the 2P has Cellular Ammunition Storage Equipment to help protect it from ammo explosions. Eleven 双散热器 and a 270 Standard 引擎 round out the rest of it load out.
column2: Mauler MAL-2P应视为原型机。与-1P或MX90不同，-2P双臂各装两门激光器，据说必要时还能安装更多。两具LRM-10使它能在更远距离发射导弹，两门超级自动炮/5提供远近程支援。每具LRM和UAC/5都配有两吨弹药；与-1P和MX90一样，2P拥有细胞弹药储存设备，以防弹药爆炸。11组双重散热器和一台270级标准引擎完成其配置。

column1: The Mauler has had a lack of new variants since the Jihad. LAW's developmental experimentation in the late 3060s sought to perfect a new weapons suite focused on medium ranges while  improving the armor to suit an assault 'Mech. It did not fare well. As in a prior attempt to update the BattleMech most liked variant — 3062's MAL-3R — the Mauler's volatile CASE had to be discarded to accommodate new autocannon solutions, thereby undermining the quest for increased resilience. Increased armor mass required the use of a bulky endo-steel structure, reducing internal space, and allowing only a small cockpit. This aggregation of compromises eventually resulted in the flawed MAL-1KX, many of its shortcomings were never fixed, as the final production version that eventually became the MAL-1K was instead based on the MAL-1R.
column2: 圣战结束后，毛勒一直缺少新变体。3060 年代后期，LAW 进行了开发试验，试图完善一套以中距离作战为核心的新武器系统，同时增强装甲以适应突击机甲定位，但结果并不理想。此前更新该战斗机甲最受欢迎型号（3062 年的 MAL-3R）时也遇到过类似问题：为容纳新的自动炮方案，不得不舍弃毛勒不稳定的 CASE，从而削弱了增强生存能力的目标。增加装甲质量又迫使设计采用笨重的内骨架结构，挤占内部空间并只能安装小型驾驶舱。这一连串妥协最终造就了有缺陷的 MAL-1KX；其许多不足始终未能修复，最终量产的 MAL-1K 改为以 MAL-1R 为基础。

column1: The Menace is one of the heavier Clan Superheavy OmniMechs, weighing in at 185 tons. Based on an Endo Steel chassis with a 350 XL engine, the chassis is not particularly fast or agile, but it makes up for it with its general offensive package. All configurations of the Menace are heavily focused on offensive firepower at range, often used as a long range option when firepower matters more than survival. To ensure it has enough cooling it uses the volataile Prototype heat sinks, meaning any internal critical hits can turn deadly, but an acceptable risk considering its large offensive arsenal.
column2: Menace 是较重的氏族超重型全能机甲之一，重达 185 吨。它采用内骨骼底盘和 350 XL 引擎，速度与灵活性并不突出，但通用攻击配置弥补了这一点。Menace 的所有配置都高度侧重远距离火力，往往在火力比生存更重要时作为远程选项使用。为保证散热，它采用不稳定的原型散热器，这意味着内部暴击可能引发致命后果；考虑到它庞大的攻击武库，这仍是可以接受的风险。

column1: The MetalMax was built by MaxTech to fix the mistakes of the SpacerMax, offering an IndustrialMech advertised for both zero-g and terrestrial metalworking. It carries several of the same features as its predecessor, like environmental sealing and jump jets, though tailored more specifically toward construction site tasks. Despite weighing five tons more than the SpacerMax, it actually costs slightly less, and its improved marketing helped it sell far better across the Great Houses and beyond.
column2: MetalMax 由 MaxTech 制造，用来纠正 SpacerMax 的缺陷，作为同时面向零重力和地面金属加工的工业机甲进行宣传。它保留了前身的一些特征，例如环境密封和跳跃喷射器，但更专门针对建筑工地任务。尽管比 SpacerMax 重五吨，它的成本反而略低；改进后的营销也让它在各大贵族领地及更远地区卖得更好。

column2: Mikasi C 擅长近距离战斗，使用五具 ER 中型脉冲激光器、六具跳跃喷射器（提供 180 米机动范围）、一套瞄准计算机和强大的散热系统，在狭窄空间压倒敌人。 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - 长 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Mikasi is a fast, heavily armored OmniMech fielded by Clan Coyote. With a supercharged 300 XL engine, 20 tons of pod space, and Ferro-Lamellor armor, it's built for aggressive strike roles. Primarily used by Coyote front-line units, its variants offer strong firepower and mobility, with limited use outside the Clan.
column2: Mikasi 是郊狼氏族使用的高速重装全能机甲。它配备增压 300 XL 引擎、20 吨挂载舱空间和 Ferro-Lamellor 装甲，专为激进突击任务打造。它主要由郊狼前线部队使用，变体拥有强大火力和机动性，在氏族之外很少出现。

column1: The Mingan A configuration is commonly deployed in Beta Galaxy’s Stealth Star formations, utilizing a Class 20 Hyper Assault Gauss Rifle, two Improved Heavy Medium Lasers, and a single ER Medium Laser for close to mid-range engagements with strong burst damage potential. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Mingan A 配置通常部署在 Beta Galaxy 的隐形星编队中，使用 20 级超级突击高斯步枪、两把改进型重型中型激光器和一个 ER 中型激光器，用于近中程交战，具有强大的爆发伤害潜力。 Quirk： Cowl 下降成本乘数： 1.01 经Aries Games and Miniatures许可使用。

column1: The Mingan A configuration is commonly deployed in Beta Galaxy’s Stealth Star formations, utilizing a Class 20 超重型突击高斯 Rifle, two 改进的 Heavy 中型激光s, and a single ER 中型激光 for close to mid-range engagements with strong burst damage potential. 怪癖: Cowl 掉落成本乘数: 1.01 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.

column1: The Mingan C configuration is optimized for close combat in urban environments. It employs four 改进的 Heavy 中型激光s and a 定位 Computer to devastating effect, aided by a jump capacity of 180 米 and surplus heat dissipation, making it deadly at close range. 怪癖: Cowl 掉落成本乘数: 1.01 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Mingan C配置针对城市环境中的近距离作战进行了优化。它使用四门改进型重型中型激光和一台定位计算机，配合180米的跳跃能力与额外散热能力，可在近距离造成毁灭性打击。 特性：整流罩 部署费用倍率：1.01 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Mingan D configuration is a precise medium-range skirmisher. Armed with twin ER 大型脉冲激光s linked to a 定位 Computer, the inherent accuracy of its pulse lasers combined with targeting assistance ensures deadly precision in battle. 怪癖: Cowl 掉落成本乘数: 1.01 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Mingan D配置是一台精准的中距离游击机甲。它装备两门ER大型脉冲激光，并连接至定位计算机；脉冲激光本身的高精度结合瞄准辅助，确保其在战斗中实现致命的精准打击。 特性：整流罩 部署费用倍率：1.01 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Mingan Prime configuration is a heavy-hitting 设计 favored by Empire Warriors. It pairs an ER PPC with an 改进的 Heavy Large Laser, offering formidable firepower with minimal heat concerns, making it a reliable and popular skirmisher. 怪癖: Cowl 掉落成本乘数: 1.01 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Mingan Prime配置是一台由帝国勇士青睐的重火力设计。它将ER PPC与改进型重型大型激光结合，在极低散热压力下提供强大火力，使其成为可靠而受欢迎的游击机甲。 特性：整流罩 部署费用倍率：1.01 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Mingan, named for the Gray Wolf, is a heavy-hitting light OmniMech replacing the aging Adder. Built alongside the Wulfen and Warwolf, it shares a similar wolf-like design and components, simplifying repairs and logistics. Deployed heavily by the Wolf Empire, the Mingan excels in versatility—switching between close combat and long-range fire support. Its Laser-Reflective armor offers strong defense against energy weapons, making it a prized and adaptive unit in the Republic of the Sphere assault.
column2: 明甘以灰狼命名，是一台火力强大的轻型全能机甲，用来替代日渐老旧的阿达。它与乌尔芬和战狼一同建造，共享相似的狼形设计与部件，从而简化维修和后勤。明甘被狼帝国大量部署，拥有出色的多用途能力，可在近距离战斗与远程火力支援之间切换。其激光反射装甲能有效抵御能量武器，使它成为球体共和国攻势中备受珍视且适应力极强的单位。

column2: Minotaur 是第一代 ProtoMech 的“突击级”型号。它比任何其他 ProtoMech 都重，以装甲和武器换取速度。这一变体使用一门 LB 2-X 自动火炮，并携带一吨弹药。

column1: The Minotaur is the 'assault class' of the first generation Proto机甲s. This variation of the Minotaur was re设计ed as a fire support model, armed with an LRM-12 Launcher as its 'main gun'. Improvements to the 设计 include an increase of its maximum speed to 80 km/h, increase range to its jumping capacity, and additional 装甲 protection. 怪癖: Resilient 掉落成本乘数: 0.984
column2: Minotaur是第一代原型机甲中的“突击级”型号。这一变体被重新设计为火力支援型号，以LRM-12发射器作为主炮。改进包括将最高速度提升至80公里/小时、增加跳跃距离，并加强装甲防护。 怪癖：坚韧 掉落成本乘数：0.984

Its origin stems from Clan Ghost Bear's need to replace its aging inventory of 'Mechs; in order to accomplish this, a joint project was started between manufacturers in the Rasalhague Dominion and those in the Lyran Commonwealth that produced 'Mechs for Clan Wolf-in-Exile. The two Clan manufacturers desired for the 'Mech to be both inexpensive and combat effective.
column2: Mongrel是混合技术中型氏族战斗机甲，最初由流亡狼氏族与拉萨尔哈格自治领联合开发。它源于鬼熊氏族替换老旧机甲库存的需求；拉萨尔哈格自治领制造商与莱拉联邦制造商共同启动项目，后者为流亡狼氏族生产机甲。两家氏族制造商希望这台机甲既便宜又具备战斗效能。

column1: The Night Wolf is a Clan Wolf Assault BattleMech produced by 3085 on Weingarten. The design was created by the Wolves as a practical means to deal with the new Combined Arms strategies employed by its opponents. The Night Wolf is meant as a replacement assault 'Mech for its second-line units which needed to replace the aging designs in their ranks. The 'Mech is not considered very fast, but its jump jets make it mobile enough to handle most contemporaries on the battlefield. Using a 360 Rated Extra Light Fusion Engine, the design is able to afford a large array of weaponry. Due to use of standard armor, its armor protection is considered to be less than other Clan 'Mechs. However, its 15.5 tons of armor coverage is considered strong enough for normal encounters. To help deal with more sophisticated electronics that may be employed against it, the 'Mech has been fitted with a Guardian ECM Suite.
column2: 夜狼是 Weingarten 3085 生产的一款氏族狼突击战机。该设计是狼队创建的，作为应对对手采用的新联合兵种策略的实用手段。夜狼旨在作为其二线部队的替代突击机甲，这些部队需要更换其队伍中老化的设计。机甲的速度被认为不是很快，但它的跳跃式喷气机使其具有足够的机动性，足以应对战场上的大多数同时代人。该设计使用 360 度超轻型聚变引擎，能够承受大量武器。由于使用标准装甲，其装甲防护被认为低于其他氏族机甲。不过，其 15.5 吨的装甲覆盖范围对于正常遭遇来说已经足够了。为了帮助处理可能用于对抗它的更复杂的电子设备，“Mech”配备了 Guardian ECM 套件。

column1: The Ninja-To is intended to work with, and take advantage of, other units which carry a C3 Master Computer by carrying a C3 slave unit that allows it to share targeting data with other units in a C3 equipped unit. The Ninja-To is built on a lightweight Star League XT Light Endo Steel that cradles a powerful Magna 390 XL engine that gives the 'Mech a top speed of 97.2 km/h, more when TSM is activated. While this combination of structure and engine saves weight, it also makes the Ninja-To susceptible to being a combat loss from side torso destruction. This variant of the Ninja-To puts a Snub Nose PPC in each arm, removes a heat sink, and adds an advanced Targeting Computer. The standard armor plate of the original is replaced by Ferro-Fibrous Armor.

column2: 与许多 Solaris VII 竞技场机甲一样，斯帕塔被设计为格斗机甲，但依赖于技巧，而不是像大多数机甲那样依靠蛮力。手工制作的 360 级 XXL 发动机以耐用性换取了巨大的重量减轻，但 Spatha 只需担心自动加农炮或高斯步枪对其脆弱的发动机开火，这要归功于其 11 吨的先进反射装甲和激光 AMS 可以抵消对手的能量和导弹武器。 Spatha 的 13 个双散热器勉强完成了冷却其先进动力装置和自身能量武器的任务，这实际上是有意的选择，因为 Spatha 配备了三重强度 Myomer 来提高其速度并显着提高其剑的效率。

column1: The Ninja-To is intended to work with, and take advantage of, other units which carry a C3 Master Computer by carrying a C3 slave unit that allows it to share targeting data with other units in a C3 equipped unit. The Ninja-To is built on a lightweight Star League XT Light Endo Steel that cradles a powerful Magna 390 XL engine that gives the 'Mech a top speed of 97.2 km/h. While this combination of structure and engine saves weight, it also makes the Ninja-To susceptible to being a combat loss from side torso destruction. The EMP Variant is a close range in-fighter packing dual Snub-Nose PPCs, ER Medium Lasers and Medium Pulse Lasers as well as TSM for that up close and personal touch.
column2: 忍者刀旨在与配备 C3 主计算机的其他单位协同，并借助 C3 从属单元与 C3 编队内的其他单位共享目标数据。忍者刀采用轻型星盟 XT 轻型内骨架，内置强劲的 Magna 390 XL 引擎，使机甲最高速度达到 97.2 km/h。虽然这种结构与引擎组合减轻了重量，但侧躯干被摧毁时也更容易导致忍者刀战损。EMP 变体专为近距离缠斗设计，配备双联短管 PPC、增程中型激光器、中型脉冲激光器和 TSM，适合贴身作战。

column1: The Notos is an advanced Heavy-class hybrid between a Quadrupedal OmniMech and Combat Vehicle design, known more simply as a QuadVee, introduced by Clan Hell's Horses. Named after the Greek Goddess of the south wind, the Notos is a more refined QuadVee design in comparison to its earlier predecessors. Retaining the best qualities of the previous models, the machine has been built to support a diverse array of weapon and equipment configurations, while also taking advantage of using wheels in place of tank treads. The Notos can call upon 15 tons worth of equipment allowed by its omnipods. While it sports a modest 12.5 tons of standard armor protection from enemy fire, its true innovation comes with its unique ability: transformation into a combat vehicle. Powered by a 300-Rated Extra-Light Fusion Engine, the vehicular Notos can travel at up to a swift 95 km/h, while in 'Mech mode it can move at a solid 80 km/h. This high speed gives it the capability to keep pace with fast combat formations. Unlike its predecessors, the Notos can move significantly faster over flat terrain thanks to its incorporation of wheels rather than tank treads.
column2: Notos 是一种先进的重型混合设计，将四足全能机甲与战斗载具结合起来，通常简称为 QuadVee，由地狱之马氏族推出。它以希腊南风女神命名，相比早期前代产品，Notos 是更成熟的 QuadVee 设计。它保留了前代型号的优点，支持多种武器和设备配置，同时用轮子取代坦克履带。Notos 的全能挂载舱可容纳 15 吨设备。虽然它只有 12.5 吨标准装甲，真正的创新在于独特能力：变形成战斗载具。车辆模式下，300 级超轻融合引擎可让 Notos 以最高 95 km/h 的速度行驶；机甲模式下则能达到稳定的 80 km/h。这样的高速让它能够跟上快速作战编队。与前代不同，得益于轮式结构而非坦克履带，Notos 在平坦地形上的移动速度明显更快。

column1: The Nova Cats introduced this version in 3078. Based on the IIC 5, it keeps the jump capability but replaces all weapons with arm mounted Heavy Large Lasers and Plasma Cannons. A Targeting Computer makes these weapons extremely effective.
column2: Nova Cat 氏族于 3078 年推出这一版本。它基于 IIC 5，保留跳跃能力，但将所有武器替换为手臂安装的重型大型激光器和等离子炮。目标锁定计算机让这些武器极其高效。

column1: The Nuberu Anti-Aircraft Tank is a post-Jihad design, which was developed jointly by Clan Snow Raven and the Outworlds Alliance in the early 3080s. After the end of the Jihad, pirate activity in the newly expanded Raven Alliance began to increase to the point that the OA's armed forces were no longer able provide adequate air cover for its worlds' ground forces. Based on the Partisan, the Nuberu use advanced technology to provide a greater air-defense capacity to both Clan and Alliance ground forces. Powered by a 180-rated Fuel Cell engine, the vehicle has a modest 54 kilometer per hour speed, keeping pace with slower combat vehicles. Protecting its hull, Clan Scientists have added 9.5 tons of Clan Laser Reflective Armor. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 3/5 hexes / 90/150 meters. column2: Nuberu 防空坦克是圣战后的设计，由雪鸦氏族与外世界联盟于 3080 年代初联合研发。圣战结束后，新扩大的乌鸦联盟境内海盗活动日益猖獗，外世界联盟武装部队已无法为各星球地面部队提供足够的空中掩护。Nuberu 以 Partisan 为基础，采用先进技术，为氏族与联盟的地面部队提供更强的防空能力。该车由 180 额定功率的燃料电池引擎驱动，最高时速为 54 km/h，能够跟上较慢的战斗车辆。氏族科学家为车体加装了 9.5 吨氏族激光反射装甲。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米。 装甲：釉面装甲（氏族） 结构：结构 数值 A S 前部 200 30 左侧 150 30 右侧 150 30 后部 150 30 炮塔 200 30 总计 850 150 特性：防空瞄准
