column1: The Nyx is a light BattleMech originally developed by the Word of Blake in the late Jihad. The Blakists' designs for the 'Mech and a prototype were captured by the Allied Coalition's Draconis Combine force on Quentin in 3077,[4] and were rushed off to the Draconis Combine's Diplan MechYards, where engineers did not have the resources to put the advanced design into production. After the liberation of Terra in 3079, the Combine would ask aide from the new Terran government to assist with development of the 'Mech. It would be jointly produced by both the Republic and Combine, prior to the very end of the Jihad. The design was conceived as a speedy recon 'Mech, with a 300 XL engine allowing it to reach 162 km/h.
column2: Nyx 是一款轻型战斗机甲，最初由 Blake 之言在圣战末期研发。3077 年，盟军联军中的龙辰联邦部队在 Quentin 缴获了 Blake 教徒的设计图和一台原型机[4]，随后紧急送往龙辰联邦的 Diplan 机甲厂；那里的工程师缺乏将这项先进设计投入生产的资源。3079 年 Terra 解放后，龙辰联邦向新成立的地球政府求助，请其协助开发这台机甲。圣战结束前，它由球体共和国与龙辰联邦联合生产。该设计定位为高速侦察机甲，配备 300 级 XL 引擎，最高速度可达 162 km/h。

column1: The Ogre heavy battle armor has a physically intimidating appearance, largely due to the twin Heavy Battle Claws used as weapons and Tvastar's choice to use an unusually wide frame for the suit. Despite that appearance, the Ogre isn't well-suited to fighting conventional infantry, but the heavy armor and weapons mounted on the Ogre allows it to attack enemy armor, and actions in certain early battles saw the Ogre gain a reputation for tearing tanks in half - a reputation that was rather fanciful, but did serve to enhance the Ogre's reputation. The Ogre has since been exported outside the Regulan Fiefs by Tvastar, with the Duchy of Andurien and the Lyran Commonwealth both ordering large production runs. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.892 Can mount Omni units, can melee, can not swarm.
column2: 食人魔重型战斗装甲外形极具压迫感，主要归功于用作武器的一对重型战斗爪，以及特瓦斯塔为装甲服选用的异常宽大框架。尽管外表威猛，食人魔并不擅长对付普通步兵；不过，其厚重装甲与所搭载的武器足以攻击敌方装甲单位。在早期几场战斗中，食人魔曾因把坦克撕成两半而声名大噪——这种说法颇为夸张，却确实进一步提升了它的名声。此后，特瓦斯塔将食人魔出口到雷古兰封地以外，安杜里恩公国和莱拉联邦都订购了大批产品。 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：0.892 可搭载全能单位，可近战，不可被攀附。

column1: The Onryo NSS-X1 harasses from stealth, cloaked by a Null Signature System and Chameleon Light Polarization Shield that render it nearly undetectable. An LRM 10 with Artemis IV fire control provides long range harassment, while a medium pulse laser handles closer threats. CASE protects the missile ammunition. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Missiles Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98
column2: Onryo NSS-X1 借 Null Signature System 和 Chameleon Light Polarization Shield 的掩护隐形骚扰敌人，使其几乎无法被探测。带 Artemis IV 火控系统的 LRM-10 可远程骚扰目标，中型脉冲激光负责应对近距离威胁。CASE 保护导弹弹药。 特质：精准武器 - 导弹 部署费用倍率：0.98

column1: The Ophanim was created by the Word of Blake to become the keystone of their blessed military forces. Weighting in at 150t and utilizing a 425-rated core, the Ophanim brings Divine Wrath in its arms, and the Blessed Rains in the side torsos.  Those hoping that great weight given to the weaponry has cost it armor protection, will find that the Spirit of Blake has been blessed on this Sanctus Armor, helping to lift the load from those going to preach the Truth under fire.  Included as well, is a Blessed Gyro, and Seraphim EWAR Suite, both given blessings by the highest priests of the order, which has had some positive effects on combat performance. And to drive home the point that this is a model just for those who truly believe, it requires the pilot to have undergone significant cyberfication, to the point of almost embedding them into the cockpit.
column2: Ophanim 由圣言之书制造，旨在成为其神圣军力的核心。它重 150 吨，配备 425 级核心，双臂装有“神圣之怒”，两侧躯干装有“祝福之雨”。如果有人担心如此巨大的武器负载会牺牲装甲防护，那么布莱克之灵已经为它祝福了 Sanctus 装甲，减轻了那些在炮火下宣讲真理者的负担。它还配备受最高阶牧师祝福的祝福陀螺仪和 Seraphim 电子战套件，对战斗表现产生了积极影响。为了证明它只属于真正的信徒，驾驶员必须接受大规模控制论改造，几乎与驾驶舱融为一体。

column1: The Orc is the first ProtoMech developed wholly by Clan Hell's Horses. The Orc reflects the unique battle tactics of the Horses. The standard Orc uses a quartet of SRM-1 missile tubes, with each of the launchers carries five reloads.
column2: Orc是第一台完全由氏族地狱马开发的原型机甲，体现了该氏族独特的战术。标准Orc使用四具SRM-1导弹管，每具发射器携带五次再装填。

column1: The Orc is the first ProtoMech developed wholly by Clan Hell's Horses. The Orc reflects the unique battle tactics of the Horses. This version tries to take the best features of the Orc 2 and Orc 3. It carries three SRM tubes in its torso, and a machine gun in each arm.

column1: The Orion 2K is a prototype upgrade of an already impressive design, adding 2 PPCs with upgraded capacitors, and an AC/5 with specialized ammo as well as heat-dissipating armor.
column2: Orion 2K 是一款原本就很出色的设计的原型升级型：它加装两门带升级电容器的 PPC、一门使用特种弹药的 AC/5，以及散热装甲。

column1: The Orion has long held an important place in the Clan Wolf Touman, and the Orion C 2 is a capable heir to the favored ride of Aleksandr Kerensky. The response has been mixed, however, as it continues to use non-Clan structural components to reduce the strain on the Wolves’ industrial resources. The weapons, though, are mostly Clan. Short to medium range is covered by a Streak rack and ER medium laser, backed up with a large pulse laser in the left arm. The Orion’s standard right torso ballistic weapon was replaced by an ER large laser, both for weight and range. Having been burned by the superior range of extended LRMs, the Wolves are experimenting with the weapon system on the C 2. column1: The Pebble Crab started life with the Word of Blake before the Lyran Alliance and Federated Suns started buying it, and by 3080 it had spread to essentially every major military in the Inner Sphere and Periphery, which is a remarkable adoption rate for a 35-ton light. The reason is straightforward enough: putting two ER Large Lasers on a frame this small and keeping it functional requires fourteen heat sinks and leaves almost nothing else, but the result is a light mech that threatens targets well outside the range where most opponents expect to be shot at. It punches considerably above its weight class.

column1: The Phalanx is a battle armor design created and produced by Irian Technologies in the Free Worlds League. This design is the FWLM's answer to larger, harder-hitting battle armor such as the Kanazuchi and Gnome.
column2: Phalanx 是由自由世界联盟的 Irian Technologies 设计并生产的战斗装甲。这一设计是自由世界联盟军事部队对 Kanazuchi 和 Gnome 等更大型、更重火力战斗装甲的回应。

column1: The Phoenix Hawk L is a light BattleMech, produced originally for the Draconis Combine at the dawn of the thirty-second century. It was modeled to resemble Crosby's old and remodeled Phoenix Hawk, which they had first produced in the 3060s, and was their BattleMechs Research Firm's bid to offer a replacement to the venerable Panther after the Second Combine-Dominion War. Alternately known as the Fenikkusu Taka, the Phoenix Hawk L retains the movement profile of its heavier predecessor.
column2: Phoenix Hawk L 是一种轻型战斗机甲，最初于三十二世纪初为龙蛇联合王国生产。它仿照 Crosby 早期改进的 Phoenix Hawk；该型号最初于 3060 年代生产，也是其战斗机甲研究机构在第二次联合王国—自治领战争后提出的、用于替代 Panther 的方案。它也被称为 Fenikkusu Taka，并保留了较重前代机型的机动性能。

column1: The Pit Viper B configuration is built for close-quarters brawling, featuring dual Streak SRM-6 racks—each with one ton of ammo—backed by an AMS and four ER Medium Lasers in the torso. This loadout lets the Pit Viper B unleash devastating alpha strikes on nearby foes. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Short Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Pit Viper B 配置专为近距离格斗设计，配备两具连发 SRM-6 发射架，每具各有一吨弹药；躯干内还装有 AMS 和四门增程中型激光器。这套配置让 Pit Viper B 能向近处敌人发动毁灭性的全弹齐射。 特性：近程瞄准改进 部署费用倍率：1.01 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Pollux ADA Heavy Tank was a dedicated air defense artillery vehicle designed to serve as a component of the Terran Hegemony's planetary defense forces. Armed with a Sniper Artillery Piece and a LB 10-X Autocannon, the Pollux carried 3 tons of ammunition for each weapon.A turret mounted Medium Laser and forward facing Small Pulse Laser gave the tank some token means of close-in self-defense. Also protecting the tank is 6 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor giving its hull modest strength ward off light attacks as its escorts take out would be attackers. Powering the vehicle is a GM 225-rated standard Fusion Engine, giving the vehicle modest speeds to keep with typical vehicle formation and heavy 'Mechs Biome Restrictions: None. column1: The Praetorian is the ancestor to all other Superheavy 'Mechs. Created at the height of the first Starleague as a sign of power and prestige, it brought a totally new kind of mechanical beast to the battlefield. At 175 tons, it was so much larger than anything previously seen that it is claimed many foes fled as the mere sight of it.
column2: Praetorian 是所有其他超重型机甲的祖先。它在第一星盟鼎盛时期作为力量与威望的象征诞生，为战场带来一种全新的机械巨兽。它重达 175 吨，比此前任何机甲都大得多，据说许多敌人仅仅看到它就转身逃跑。

column1: The Prefect was an ammo-independent Republic of the Sphere BattleMech, designed specifically for guerrilla combat. With increasing legal tensions between the newborn Republic and military manufacturers who suffered heavy damage at the hands of Stone's Coalition during Operation SCOUR, Exarch Devlin Stone commissioned a new BattleMech intended to create jobs, bolster his military, and to stave off the worst of the lawsuits. While ultimately unsuccessful on the last count, the well-regarded Prefect would enter service with the public RAF as well as black ops units. Mandating a simple, fast and durable energy weapon design based on the guerrilla-style warfare he conducted in the early years of resistance to the Blakists, Stone was forced to make a number of concessions and include a more expensive Endo Steel chassis along with ferro-fibrous armor, as well as the more fragile Light Fusion Engine and XL Gyro in an attempt to win over the military-industrial complex.
column2: Prefect 是一款无需弹药的球体共和国战斗机甲，专为游击战设计。新生共和国与军工制造商之间的法律矛盾日益加剧，而这些制造商在 Stone 联盟的 SCOUR 行动中遭受重创，于是执政官 Devlin Stone 委托研制了新的战斗机甲，旨在创造就业、增强军力，并避免最严重的诉讼。虽然最后一个目标最终未能实现，广受好评的 Prefect 仍进入共和国武装部队公开编制和黑色行动单位。Stone 要求它采用简单、快速且耐用的能量武器设计，体现自己在早期抵抗 Blake 教徒时使用的游击战术；为争取军工复合体支持，他不得不作出多项妥协，加入更昂贵的内骨骼钢结构和铁素体装甲，以及更脆弱的轻型融合引擎和 XL 陀螺仪。

column1: The Preta C is a scout variant with its Beagle Active Probe and TAG. A Plasma Rifle is effective against all types of units. In close, the Comminus variant can call upon an ER Small Laser and two Medium Pulse Lasers.
column2: Preta C 是侦察型，配备比格犬主动探测器和 TAG。等离子步枪能有效对付各种单位。近距离作战时，Comminus 变体可使用一门增程小型激光器和两门中型脉冲激光器。

column1: The Preta E utilizes an experimental Thunderbolt 15, though it only has enough ammunition to fire four times. Nonetheless, CASE protects the ammo bin. A pair of ER Mediums provide respectable firepower, while a Rocket Launcher 10 should make smaller enemies wary until it is expended.

column1: The Primary configuration of the Keratos mounts five iATM launchers with 12 tons of ammunition. Four Small Supra Lasers provide some defensive fire capabilities and 18 heat sinks provide just enough cooling to limit the heat buildup of consecutive alpha strikes. 特性：Multi Trac 部署成本倍率：1.37 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Prime configuration of the Haider sticks to a proven loadout: a single Class 20 Hyper Assault Gauss Rifle delivers long-range power, while twin ER Large Pulse Lasers provide precision and flexibility. It’s a straightforward build that favors efficiency and steady battlefield pressure. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Haider 的 Prime 配置坚持经过验证的负载：单支 20 级超级突击高斯步枪可提供远程威力，而双 ER 大型脉冲激光器可提供精确性和灵活性。这是一个简单的构建，有利于效率和稳定的战场压力。 怪癖：稳定武器 下降成本乘数： 1.12 经Aries Games and Miniatures许可使用。

column1: The Prototype of the Centurion OmniMech sports an advanced FCS and Sensors system alongside a less bulky experimental Endo-Steel.
column2: Centurion OmniMech 的原型配备先进火控与传感器系统，并采用体积更小的实验型 Endo-Steel。

column1: The Purifier Adaptive battle armor is produced by Word of Blake, though the original data was stolen from ComStar. The Purifier Adaptive is revolutionary in that it uses mimetic, color-shifting armor. The Mimetic Armor makes the Purifier Adaptive much more difficult to target, especially when it is motionless. The drawback comes in the amount of armor it carries
column2: 净化者自适应战斗装甲由圣言之书生产，最初的数据则是从 ComStar 窃取而来。它采用会变色的拟态装甲，堪称革命性设计。拟态装甲让净化者自适应装甲更难被锁定，静止时尤其如此。代价是它能携带的装甲量受到限制。

column1: The R4N is a 3063 modification that looks to the original design of the 休伦战士 and reverts the 'Mech back to its original fire support role. This is done by stripping the 'Mechs weapons and ammunition payload and replacing them with a pair of LRM-15 launchers and four 中型激光s. The 'Mech is also armored with new 隐身装甲 and carries a 守护者ECM Suite. This combination of LRM-15s and 隐身装甲 makes the R4N an incredibly powerful fire support 'Mech. Quirk: 改进型传感器 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower

column1: The Rabid Coyote was 设计ed by scientists from Clan Coyote to be a complement to other, slower Battle机甲s. First deployed in 3066, the '机甲 was deployed in an effort to stave off the slow decline of the previous decades that had befallen the Clan that created the Omni机甲. Curiously, as the '机甲 is intended to be a bodyguard for larger '机甲s like the 野蛮郊狼, front-line warriors spurn the 设计 because they do not wish to be seen merely as "support". 怪癖: Experimental TC 掉落成本乘数: 1.19
column2: 狂暴郊狼是由郊狼氏族的科学家设计的，旨在作为其他速度较慢的战机甲的补充。 “机甲”于 3066 年首次部署，其部署目的是为了避免创建全机甲的氏族在过去几十年中缓慢衰落。奇怪的是，由于“机甲”的目的是成为北极郊狼等大型机甲的保镖，前线战士们拒绝了这种设计，因为他们不希望仅仅被视为“支持”。 怪癖：实验性TC 未知成本乘数: 1.19

column1: The Radius came out of the Jihad in tiny numbers and nearly all of them were destroyed before the war ended, so finding one operational is genuinely unusual. The Word of Blake built it as a network anchor, and in that role it makes every allied unit around it more dangerous without firing a single shot. A mech that wins fights by making its teammates better is a rare thing to find at this weight class. Blake hardware always makes me uneasy, but I cannot argue with what it does.
column2: Radius在圣战末期以极少数量问世，几乎全数在战争结束前被摧毁，因此找到一台仍能运作的实属罕见。布雷克圣言会把它作为网络锚点，使周围每个友军单位都更危险，而无需开一枪。以提升队友来赢得战斗的机甲，在这个重量级别非常少见。布雷克设备总让我不安，但它的效果无可争辩。

column1: The Raider was an unusual experimental medium BattleMech, which was the brain child of a Republican Industrialist named Jacob Bannson. The design was created as a means to skirt around Republic of the Sphere restrictions on military hardware under the project name ''Jacob's Ladder'', and Bannson's technical and engineering teams would utilize whatever technology they could access to reach their goal. The resulting design turned out to be not necessarily a failure, with the Raider proving to be a commercial success when it first appeared on the battlefields by 3134.
column2: 掠袭者是一款不同寻常的实验型中型战斗机甲，由共和国工业家Jacob Bannson构想。该设计以“Jacob的梯子”为项目名，旨在绕开星际共和国对军用硬件的限制；Bannson的技术和工程团队会利用能接触到的一切技术来实现目标。最终设计谈不上失败：掠袭者在3134年首次出现在战场时，证明了自己在商业上取得成功。

column1: The Rasalhague Dominion has long relied on the Dragonfly "Viper" Medium OmniMech, which showed its age after shifting to the Inner Sphere. By early 3100, a replacement was needed. Their top technicians developed several prototypes before finalizing the Björn - named after the ancient Swedish word for "bear." The Björn succeeds the Viper with the latest 32nd-century technology. Following the Kodiak's example, it is becoming a totem 'Mech for the clan, with many warriors competing for the honor of piloting this new "symbol of the bear."
column2: Rasalhague 自治领长期依赖 Dragonfly‘Viper’中型 OmniMech，但转向内圈后该设计逐渐老化。到 3100 年初，替代品已势在必行。其顶尖技师开发了数个原型，最终确定 Björn 型号；名称取自古老瑞典语‘熊’。Björn 以最新的三十二世纪技术接替 Viper，仿照 Kodiak 的先例，逐渐成为氏族图腾机甲，许多战士争相获得驾驶这头‘熊之象征’的荣誉。

column1: The Rattler RT-L3R has a very unusual 设计, as practically every available bit of space is filled to the brim with weapons. Each arm houses two custom 开发 锁定式SRM-2 quad-launcher package, while the side torsos each contain two Machine Gun arrays and a Dual Machine Gun. A single 中型激光器 in the head was added as a last ditch weapon if all ammunition was used. The '机甲 also carries three Jump Jets to improve its mobility. 怪癖: Multi Trac 掉落成本乘数: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 响尾蛇RT-L3R拥有极不寻常的武器布局，几乎每一寸可用空间都塞满了武器。双臂各安装两套定制的四联装SRM-2发射器，左右两侧躯干各装有两个机枪阵列和一挺双联机枪。头部增加一门中型激光，作为弹药耗尽后的最后手段。该机甲还携带三具跳跃喷射器，以提高机动性。 特性：多重追踪 击杀倍率：1.18 左下部装甲，右下部装甲

column1: The Rattler was originally intended as an anti-infantry 'Mech but never reached any large acceptance into the Great Houses' armies. Instead the only production run of the mech was eventually sold to various mercenary outfits, with some 'Mechs eventually even finding their way into pirate hands.
column2: 响尾蛇最初被设计为反步兵机甲，却始终未能在各大国军队中广泛列装。最终，这款机甲唯一的一批产品被卖给了不同的佣兵组织，其中一些甚至落入海盗手中。

column1: The Rattler was originally intended as an anti-infantry '机甲 but never reached any large acceptance into the Great Houses' armies. Instead the only production run of the mech was eventually sold to various mercenary outfits, with some '机甲s eventually even finding their way into pirate hands.
column2: 响尾蛇原本设计为反步兵机甲，但始终未能在各大贵族的军队中获得广泛接受。最终，这台机甲唯一的生产批次被卖给不同的佣兵组织，其中一些甚至落入海盗之手。

column1: The Raven LR 'Dagger' sports a prototype Electronics Warfare suite, Stealth Armor, TAG, and HayWire and NARC launchers.
column2: Raven LR‘匕首’配备原型电子战套件、隐形装甲、TAG，以及 HayWire 和 NARC 发射器。

column1: The Raven LR 'Dagger' sports a prototype Electronics Warfare suite, Stealth 装甲, TAG, and HayWire and NARC launchers.
column2: Raven LR“Dagger”配备原型电子战套件、隐形装甲、TAG以及HayWire和NARC发射器。

column1: The Raven X is a Capellan experimental refit of the Raven-3L upgrading nearly every portion of the 设计. The X3X electronics have been upgraded to an Angel ECM and 血猎犬主动探头, additionally the right arm 中型激光器 have been replaced with upgraded X-Pulse models and the SRM6 has been removed in favor of an Apollo Guided MRM 20 system.  These upgrades come at the cost of the traditional Tag laser and Narc beacon launcher but the result is a capable striker and scout.
column2: Raven X是卡佩兰联邦对Raven-3L进行的实验性改装，几乎升级了设计的每个部分。X3X电子设备升级为天使ECM和猎犬主动探测器，右臂的中型激光器则替换为升级型X脉冲型号，并移除了SRM6，改用阿波罗制导MRM 20系统。这些升级牺牲了传统的TAG激光器和NARC信标发射器，但最终造就了一台能力出色的突击侦察机甲。

column1: The Raven X is a Capellan experimental refit of the Raven-3L upgrading nearly every portion of the 设计. The X3X electronics have been upgraded to an Angel ECM and 血猎犬主动探头, additionally the right arm 中型激光器 have been replaced with upgraded X-Pulse models and the SRM6 has been removed in favor of an Apollo Guided MRM 20 system. These upgrades come at the cost of the traditional Tag laser and Narc beacon launcher but the result is a capable striker and scout. 怪癖: 改进的 Jammer 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Raven X 是卡佩兰对 Raven-3L 的实验性改装，几乎升级了设计的每个部分。X3X 电子设备升级为天使 ECM 和血猎犬主动探头，右臂中型激光器替换为升级型 X 脉冲型号，SRM-6 则被拆除并换成 Apollo 制导 MRM-20 系统。这些升级牺牲了传统 TAG 激光器和 Narc 信标发射器，却造就了一台能力出色的突击和侦察机甲。 怪癖: 改进的 干扰器 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The Raven was a light-weight electronic warfare BattleMech which, when it first debuted after the end of the Third Succession War, was not just one of the first truly original 'Mech designs produced in centuries, but also represented humanity's refusal to slide back technologically. This variant of the 4L allows the Raven to integrate with a C3 network by removing the 4L's active probe. It is replaced by a C3 Slave Unit and an ER Small Laser.
column2: Raven 是一种轻型电子战战斗机甲。它在第三次继承战争结束后首次亮相，不仅是数世纪以来首批真正原创的机甲设计之一，也象征着人类拒绝在技术上倒退。该 4L 改型通过拆除主动探测器，让 Raven 能接入 C3 网络；原位置改装了 C3 从属单元和一门增程小型激光。

column1: The Raven was a light-weight electronic warfare BattleMech which, when it first debuted after the end of the Third Succession War, was not just one of the first truly original 'Mech designs produced in centuries, but also represented humanity's refusal to slide back technologically. This variant removes the Narc and SRM of the standard 4L, replacing them with an MML-7 equipped with Artemis IV guidance. The Capellans added a third medium laser, making this variant of the Raven an effective scout hunter. It can set easy ambushes because its Stealth Armor gives it an advantage against scouts.
column2: 乌鸦是一款轻型电子战战斗机甲。它在第三次继承战争结束后首次亮相，不仅是数百年来首批真正原创的机甲设计之一，也象征着人类不愿在技术上倒退。该变体拆除标准 4L 型的 NARC 和 SRM，改装配备 Artemis IV 制导系统的 MML-7。卡佩兰人还增加了第三门中型激光器，使其成为有效的侦察猎手；隐形装甲则让它能够轻松伏击侦察单位。

column1: The Rawhide is a medium BattleMech built by Kaiser Systems. It shares many similarities to the Scourge heavy BattleMech, and these similarities are more than superficial. In fact, some parts of the Rawhide come from a failed Scourge prototype. [3] Aside from the armor and actuator enhancement system, the Rawhide is constructed of fairly standard and common parts. While some may call this design choice a detriment, it is in fact an advantage on the combat and marketing battlefields, where ease of maintenance and lower costs make the Rawhide attractive to the mercenary market.
column2: Rawhide 是 Kaiser Systems 制造的中型战斗机甲。它与 Scourge 重型战斗机甲有许多相似之处，而且并非表面相似；实际上，Rawhide 的部分组件来自失败的 Scourge 原型机。除装甲和驱动器增强系统外，Rawhide 由相当标准且常见的部件组成。有人可能认为这是缺点，但在战斗与市场竞争中，易于维护、成本较低反而让 Rawhide 对佣兵市场很有吸引力。

column1: The Rawhide is a medium Battle机甲 built by Kaiser Systems. It shares many similarities to the Scourge heavy Battle机甲, and these similarities are more than superficial. In fact, some parts of the Rawhide come from a failed Scourge prototype. [3] Aside from the 装甲 and actuator enhancement system, the Rawhide is constructed of fairly standard and common parts. While some may call this 设计 choice a detriment, it is in fact an advantage on the combat and marketing battlefields, where ease of maintenance and lower costs make the Rawhide attractive to the mercenary market.
column2: Rawhide 是由 Kaiser Systems 制造的中型战斗机甲。它与 Scourge 重型战斗机甲有许多相似之处，而且并非表面相像：Rawhide 的部分零件实际上来自一台失败的 Scourge 原型机。除了装甲和执行器增强系统外，Rawhide 采用的都是相当标准且常见的部件。有人可能认为这种设计选择是缺点，但在战场和市场上它反而是优势；易于维护且成本较低，使 Rawhide 对佣兵市场颇具吸引力。

column1: The Razorback is a 设计 that excels at little, but is similarly deficient in few areas. hough the 设计 is rather slow for a '机甲 of its size, it is rarely the slowest '机甲 on the field, either. Because of the '机甲's general reliance on ballistic and missile weaponry, it does not have to worry about overheating under normal circumstances but is dependent on supply trains.
column2: 剃刀背是一种没有突出长处、缺点也不多的设计。虽然以其尺寸而言速度偏慢，但在战场上很少是最慢的机甲。由于机甲通常依赖弹道武器和导弹武器，在正常情况下无需担心过热，却十分依赖补给列车。

column1: The Reaver is a one-of-a-kind machine, built by Firefly Foundry from the ground up for Firefly Stables to compete in Solaris VII assault-class tournaments starting in 3073. Arena mechs get designed around a very different set of priorities than battlefield machines, and this one shows it, with a Fluid Gun for limiting the opponents strength and a Lance for crowd-pleasing melee work alongside the conventional weapons. Getting something purpose-built for the Games into field service is always an interesting problem to solve.
column2: Reaver 是独一无二的机器，由 Firefly Foundry 从零打造，供 Firefly Stables 自 3073 年起参加 Solaris VII 突击级锦标赛。竞技场机甲的设计优先级与战场机甲完全不同，这台机甲就体现了这一点：它用流体枪削弱对手，以长枪进行吸引观众的近战，同时保留常规武器。把专为比赛打造的机甲投入战场，始终是个有趣的难题。

column1: The Reaver is a one-of-a-kind machine, built by Firefly Foundry from the ground up for Firefly 稳定s to compete in Solaris VII assault-class tournaments starting in 3073. Arena mechs get 设计ed around a very different set of priorities than battlefield machines, and this one shows it, with a Fluid Gun for limiting the opponents strength and a Lance for crowd-pleasing melee work alongside the conventional weapons. Getting something purpose-built for the Games into field service is always an interesting problem to solve.
column2: 掠夺者是一款独一无二的机器，由 Firefly 铸造厂从头开始为 Firefly 稳定公司打造，用于参加 3073 年开始的 Solaris VII 突击级锦标赛。竞技场机甲的设计优先级与战场机器截然不同，这台机甲就展示了这一点，它配备了用于限制对手力量的流体枪和用于与常规武器一起进行讨人喜欢的近战工作的长枪。将专为奥运会打造的东西投入现场服务始终是一个需要解决的有趣问题。

column1: The Regent was born when Coventry Metal Works, the designers of the Hauptmann, managed to secure construction rights for an updated version of the original design after help by the ilKhanate. The efficiency of Clan technology meant that the Hauptmann could be replicated on a lighter chassis. Coventry technicians revised their schematics to employ the more readily available 270-rated engine and Clan heat sinks. The 'Mech shed five tons and a significant amount in production costs. Many MechWarriors refer to the resulting product as the Awesomann, a ridiculous yet accurate nickname for the imposing 'Mech, leading pilots of alternate configurations to call their rides Fafnirmann, Maulermann, and others.
column2: Regent 诞生于 Coventry 金属工厂获得原始设计更新版的建造权之后；这家公司正是 Hauptmann 的设计者，并在 ilKhan 给予帮助后取得了许可。氏族科技的高效率意味着 Hauptmann 可以用更轻的底盘复制出来。Coventry 技师修改图纸，采用更容易获得的 270 级引擎和氏族散热器。该机甲减重五吨，生产成本也大幅下降。许多机甲战士把成品称为 Awesomann——这个绰号荒唐却准确地描述了这台魁梧机甲，因此其他配置的驾驶员也把自己的座驾称为 Fafnirmann、Maulermann 等。

column1: The Remix is a one-of-a-kind machine, the first of three Project Rewrite designs commissioned by the Centrella granddaughter who took over leadership of the Rangers around 3080, built from a deliberate mix of Jihad-era Word of Blake salvage and Diamond Shark Clan technology. That combination is unusual enough on its own, but the Bloodhound Active Probe and Laser AMS together give it a defensive and sensor awareness package you rarely see on a skirmisher this size. It is a reserved-pilot machine, which tells you everything about how the Rangers value it.
column2: Remix 是独一无二的机器，也是 Project Rewrite 三台设计中的第一台。该项目由 Centrella 家族一位在 3080 年左右接管游骑兵领导权的孙女委托，故意混合采用圣战时代 Blake 圣言的缴获残骸与钻鲨氏族技术。这个组合本身就很罕见，而 Bloodhound 主动探测器与激光 AMS 共同构成的防御和态势感知套件，更是很少出现在这种尺寸的突击机甲上。它是一台只交给指定驾驶员的机甲，这足以说明游骑兵有多重视它。

column1: The Remix is a one-of-a-kind machine, the first of three Project Rewrite 设计s commissioned by the Centrella granddaughter who took over leadership of the Rangers around 3080, built from a deliberate mix of Jihad-era 布雷克圣言会 salvage and 钻石鲨 Clan technology. That combination is unusual enough on its own, but the 血猎犬主动探头 and Laser AMS together give it a defensive and sensor awareness package you rarely see on a skirmisher this size. It is a reserved-pilot machine, which tells you everything about how the Rangers value it.
column2: Remix是一台独一无二的机器，是3080年前后接掌游骑兵领导权的Centrella家族孙女委托的三个“重写计划”设计之一。它由圣战时期布雷克圣言会的战场残骸与钻石鲨氏族技术有意混合制造。这样的组合本已十分罕见，而血猎犬主动探头与激光AMS又共同提供了这个体型的游击机甲很少具备的防御和传感器感知能力。它是一台为预备驾驶员保留的机体，这足以说明游骑兵有多么重视它。

column1: The Republic invested into rebuilding the Kallon facility on Nanking with the express purpose of ensuring a flow of Wolverines into the RAF. The WVR-10R’s internal layout marks it as an evolution from older variants, but it is significantly more mobile, has excellent protection, and carries traditionally solid weaponry. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 共和国投资重建 Nanking 的 Kallon 工厂，明确目标是确保 RAF 能持续获得 Wolverine。WVR-10R 的内部布局表明它是旧型号的进化版，但机动性显著更强、防护出色，且保留了传统的可靠武器配置。 特质：改进型通信 部署费用倍率：1.05

column1: The Revenant was originally a Word of Blake light drone 'Mech. The Revenant was primarily intended to engage light armor and infantry, a role that its weapon mix favored, but its ability to do so was hampered by a combination of mobility and armor more common to Succession Wars-era scout 'Mechs than the more advanced designs commonplace in the late thirty-first century.
column2: Revenant 最初是 Blake 之言的轻型无人机甲，主要用于对付轻型装甲和步兵，武器组合也偏向这一任务。但它的机动性和装甲更接近继承战争时期的侦察机甲，而不是 31 世纪末常见的先进设计，因此实际作战能力受到限制。

column1: The Rhino was developed by Escorpión Imperio in the thirty-second century. The unusual quad BattleMech was fielded by Omega Galaxy during the invasion of the Hanseatic League in 3140.
column2: Rhino 由 Escorpión Imperio 于三十二世纪开发。这台非同寻常的四足战斗机甲在 3140 年入侵汉萨同盟期间由 Omega 星群部署。

column1: The Rhino was 开发 by Escorpión Imperio in the thirty-second century. The unusual quad Battle机甲 was fielded by Omega Galaxy during the invasion of the Hanseatic League in 3140.
column2: Rhino 由 Escorpión Imperio 于三十二世纪开发。这台独特的四足 BattleMech 在 3140 年汉萨同盟入侵期间由 Omega Galaxy 部署。

column1: The Rifleman 9T is armed with a pair of Light PPCs backed up by a pair of 轻型自动炮/5s for medium range sniping. These are backed up by a pair of ER 中型激光s for close combat. All of the '机甲's weapons are linked to a 定位 Computer for increased accuracy. The 9T also uses Stealth 装甲, making it much harder to hit at long range.
column2: Rifleman 9T 装备一对轻型 PPC，并由一对轻型自动加农炮/5 支援中程狙击；近战时则使用一对增程中型激光器。机甲所有武器都连接至定位计算机，以提高准确度。9T 还采用隐身装甲，使其在远距离更难被击中。

column1: The Rifleman 9T is armed with a pair of Light PPCs backed up by a pair of 轻型自动炮/5s for medium range sniping. These are backed up by a pair of ER 中型激光s for close combat. All of the '机甲's weapons are linked to a 定位 Computer for increased accuracy. The 9T also uses Stealth 装甲, making it much harder to hit at long range. 怪癖: Anti-Air 定位 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Rifleman 9T装备一对轻型PPC，配合一对轻型自动炮/5，在中距离进行狙击；另有一对ER中型激光用于近战。机甲的所有武器均连接至定位计算机，以提高命中率。9T还采用隐形装甲，使其在远距离更难被击中。 特性：防空定位 部署费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧上臂，右侧上臂

column1: The Rifleman IIC S is a Society refit designed to provide direct fire support for Society mech formations. The Z variant sports a Light Ultra Gauss Rifle and a Large Supra Laser in each arm, providing a frightening amount of firepower at range, and a suite of improved electonics including a Nova CEWS.
column2: Rifleman IIC S 是 Society 的改装型，旨在为 Society 机甲编队提供直射火力支援。Z 型号双臂各装一门轻型 Ultra Gauss Rifle 和一门大型 Supra Laser，在远程提供惊人火力；改进电子设备套件还包括 Nova CEWS。

column1: The Rikki Tikki Tavi 1 mounts a Gauss rifle in the right arm, two ER large lasers in the left torso and two medium pulse lasers in the right. An enhanced ultra class 20 autocannon in the left arm fires at double speed with four tons of ammunition. Ferro-fibrous armor and integrated CASE round out the design. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24
column2: Rikki Tikki Tavi 1 在右臂安装一把高斯步枪，在左躯干安装两个 ER 大型激光器，在右侧安装两个中型脉冲激光器。左臂中的一门增强型超 20 级自动炮以双倍速度发射，弹药量为 4 吨。铁纤维装甲和集成外壳使设计更加完美。 怪异：分散注意力 成本乘数： 1.24

column1: The Rikki Tikki Tavi 1 mounts a Gauss rifle in the right arm, two ER large lasers in the left torso and two medium pulse lasers in the right. An enhanced ultra class 20 autocannon in the left arm fires at double speed with four tons of ammunition. 铁纤维装甲 装甲 and integrated CASE round out the design. 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：1.24
column2: Rikki Tikki Tavi 1 右臂安装高斯步枪，左侧躯干装有两具 ER 大型激光器，右侧装有两具中型脉冲激光器。左臂的增强型超重型自动炮/20以四吨弹药提供双倍射速。铁纤维装甲和集成 CASE 完善了设计。 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：1.24

column1: The Rikki Tikki Tavi 5 is an experimental variant, trying to introduce artillery as part of the line-up with its arm mounted Sniper Artillery. The rest of the loadout is also greatly changed, only the original Gauss Rifle remains, now accompanied by three Extended Range Medium Lasers and one Extended Range PPC. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24
column2: Rikki Tikki Tavi 5 是一种实验型变体，尝试通过安装在手臂上的狙击炮将火炮纳入该系列。其余武器配置也大幅调整，只保留了原有高斯步枪，并增加三门增程中型激光器和一门增程 PPC。 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：1.24

column1: The Rikki Tikki Tavi 5 is an experimental variant, trying to introduce 火炮 as part of the line-up with its arm mounted Sniper 火炮. The rest of the loadout is also greatly changed, only the original Gauss Rifle remains, now accompanied by three Extended Range 中型激光器 and one Extended Range PPC. 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：1.24
column2: Rikki Tikki Tavi 5是试验型变体，试图通过安装在手臂上的狙击火炮，将火炮纳入武器阵容。其余配置也大幅改变：原有的高斯步枪得以保留，另增三门远程中型激光器和一门远程PPC。 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：1.24

column1: The SLDF wanted a Firestarter and Wasp rolled into one and Argile Technologies delivered. Only a few dozen were ever built before the Amaris Civil War shut production down, and the ones that survived went with Kerensky into exile. Finding one of these in working condition is genuinely remarkable. It is fast, it jumps well, it burns things, and unlike the originals it can actually hold its own in a firefight if it has to. Treat it carefully.
column2: SLDF 想把 Firestarter 和 Wasp 合二为一，Argile Technologies 做到了。Amaris 内战中止生产前只造出几十台，幸存者随 Kerensky 流亡。能找到一台仍可运行的机体确实令人惊叹：它速度快、跳跃性能好、能纵火；与原版不同，必要时它也能在交火中保护自己。请小心对待它。

column1: The Sagittaire is built to fight in the confines of an urban battlefield. Weighing in at a massive ninety-five tons, the Sagittaire started production in mid-3063 and began to trickle out to units clamoring for close combat 'Mechs in the midst of the FedCom Civil War. As a power source, the 'Mech has a 285 XL engine. The XL engine saves weight at the cost of survivability and gives the 'Mech a top speed of 54.0 km/h while its mobility is enhanced with three jump jets, allowing the 'Mech to jump up to ninety meters.
column2: 射手座专为城市战场的狭窄环境而造。这台重达九十五吨的机甲于 3063 年年中开始生产，在联邦-康姆内战期间，陆续交付给渴望近距离战斗机甲的部队。它以一台 285 型 XL 引擎为动力。XL 引擎牺牲生存能力来减轻重量，使机甲最高速度达到 54.0 公里/小时；三个跳跃喷射器进一步增强机动性，让它能够跃过九十米的距离。

column1: The Salamander 设计 incorporates fire-based weapons, its primary armaments being a pair of flamers slung under the arms and a single, one-shot 短-Range Missile strapped to the shoulder, invariably one with an Inferno payload. This makes the Salamander especially potent against infantry and combat 车辆s, though that does not mean it is less intimidating to 机甲Warriors: few would want to get caught in the sights of a Salamander Point.
column2: Salamander设计采用火焰武器，主要武器是悬挂在双臂下方的两具喷火器，以及肩部固定的一具一次性短程导弹，通常装填地狱火弹。这使Salamander对步兵和战斗车辆尤其有效，但并不意味着机甲战士会低估它：很少有人愿意被Salamander小队瞄准。

column1: The Satyr ProtoMech was designed to serve as a deep raider and reconnaissance unit. Offering only slightly more protection than a Harpy or Siren, the Satyr's best defense is to remain hidden from enemy units. The Satyr's single ER Small Laser allows it to inflict moderate damage on any enemy unit that gets too close. It also carries a 轻型 主动探头 in its torso, allowing it to more easily find hidden units.
column2: Satyr 原型机甲的设计目标是执行纵深袭扰和侦察任务。它提供的防护仅略强于 Harpy 或 Siren，因此最好的防御方式是隐藏在敌方单位视线之外。Satyr 的唯一武器是一门增程小型激光，能够对靠近的敌方单位造成中等伤害。它还在躯干内装有轻型主动探头，便于发现隐藏单位。

column1: The Satyr Proto机甲 was 设计ed to serve as a deep raider and reconnaissance unit. column2: 萨提尔原型机甲的设计目标是执行深入敌后的袭击和侦察任务。它提供的防护只比哈比或塞壬略强，最好的防御就是不被敌军发现。为支援战斗装甲编队，萨提尔-XP降低了最高速度（97公里/小时），并增加了180米的跳跃能力。为容纳跳跃喷射器，原有武器被替换为一具配备十发弹药的SRM-2。

column1: The Scorpion was one of the first QuadMechs to come out of the Terran Hegemony en masse. Weird design at the best of times, but this one is somethin' else entirely. The stealth systems on this thing mean it could creep right up behind ya' and you wouldn't even know 'til it stung you.
column2: Scorpion 是泰拉霸权大规模生产的第一批四足机甲之一。平时看就已经很怪了，但这一台更是完全不同。它的隐形系统意味着它可以悄悄爬到你身后，在它刺你之前你甚至毫无察觉。

column1: The Scorpion was one of the first Quad机甲s to come out of the 泰拉霸权 en masse. Weird 设计 at the best of times, but this one is somethin' else entirely. The stealth systems on this thing mean it could creep right up behind ya' and you wouldn't even know 'til it stung you.
column2: 蝎子是最早一批从泰拉霸权中脱颖而出的四机甲之一。即使在最好的时候也是很奇怪的设计，但这个设计完全是另一回事。这东西上的隐形系统意味着它可能会悄悄爬到你身后，而你甚至不会知道，直到它蜇了你。

column1: The Scribe came out of a rushed DCMS development program in the mid-3060s and ended up serving all the way through the Jihad and into Republic of the Sphere service, which is a solid track record for what was essentially a quick-turnaround contract job. The ER PPC gives it genuine reach for a 45-ton machine, and the Sword is a real threat to anything that closes thinking it has an easy target. Not a complicated mech, but it does what it was designed to do without much fuss.
column2: Scribe 源自 3060 年代中期龙马幕府军方仓促推进的研发计划。作为一项快速交付的合同项目，它却从圣战一直服役到天球共和国时期，服役记录相当出色。增程 PPC 让这台 45 吨机甲拥有真正的远程打击能力；任何以为它好欺负而靠近的敌人，都会受到 Sword 的严重威胁。它设计并不复杂，但能毫不含糊地完成本职工作。

column1: The Sea Fox amphibious battle armor is a niche unit, but one that excels within that niche; intended to operate underwater and equipped with a Clantech Underwater Maneuvering Unit capable of moving the suit at the same speed in shallow water as it could move on land, the Sea Fox is an excellent infiltrator and ambush fighter, capable of excelling in urban operations in areas where waterways are available for access.
column2: 海狐两栖战斗装甲是专门用途的单位，却能在其擅长的领域发挥出色。它专为水下行动设计，配备氏族科技水下机动装置，使其在浅水中的速度与陆地行进速度相同。海狐是优秀的渗透与伏击单位；只要有水道可供接近，它在城市作战中也能大显身手。

column1: The Sea Foxes’ variant replaces the Lyran Endo Steel and Light Ferro-Fibrous armor with their own Endo Steel and the maximum Ferro-Fibrous weave the chassis can support. The weapons and Angel ECM remain unchanged, while CASE II armor is added to match the Clan-grade protection. An additional double heat sink is also installed on the engine. Visually identical to the SFH-2, the SFH-3 variant is rumored to deliver improved performance. Quirk: Tacticon TC7000 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Sea Fox 型号以自家的 Endo Steel 和底盘所能支持的最高等级铁磁纤维装甲，替换 Lyran 的 Endo Steel 与轻型铁磁纤维装甲。武器和 Angel ECM 保持不变，同时增加 CASE II 装甲，达到氏族级防护；引擎还额外安装一具双重散热器。SFH-3 型号与 SFH-2 外观完全相同，据传性能更强。 特质：Tacticon TC7000 部署费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 许可使用。

column1: The SecuriMax SC-200 mounts two heavy rifles and six machine guns spread across its arms and torsos, backed by two flamers for overkill firepower. An LRM 5 in the left torso and SRM 6 in the right round out the loadout, though both missile systems suffer from their accuracy being hampered due to the limited fire control systems of an Industrial Mech. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.91
column2: SecuriMax SC-200 在其手臂和躯干上安装了两挺重型步枪和六挺机枪，并配有两个火焰喷射器，可提供超杀火力。左侧躯干中的 LRM 5 和右侧躯干中的 SRM 6 使装载更加完整，尽管由于工业机械火控系统有限，这两种导弹系统的准确性都受到阻碍。 维护 下降成本乘数：0.91

column2: SecuriMax SC-200 在双臂和躯干分布安装两支重型步枪和六挺机枪，并以两具火焰喷射器提供压倒性火力。左侧躯干的 LRM-5 和右侧的 SRM-6 完善了装载，但工业机甲有限的火控系统削弱了两套导弹系统的精度。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：0.91

column1: The SecuriMax stands as proof of just how badly MaxTech wanted a proper BattleMech to its name, though like other SecurityMechs of its era, its industrial roots simply couldn't compete with the real thing. Its heavy rifles and machine guns had little effect against modern armor, doing real damage only to similarly outdated equipment or vulnerable infantry. It survived for a time on backwater worlds far from modern militaries, but flawed fire control on its missile systems and overall high cost sealed its fate, making it one of MaxTech's shortest lived designs.
column2: SecuriMax 证明了 MaxTech 多么渴望拥有一台冠以自己名号的正牌战斗机甲。但和同一时代的其他 SecurityMech 一样，它的工业血统无法与真正的战斗机甲竞争。重型步枪和机枪对现代装甲作用甚微，只能真正伤害同样过时的装备或脆弱步兵。它在远离现代军队的偏远世界存续了一段时间，但导弹系统糟糕的火控和总体高昂成本最终决定了命运，使其成为 MaxTech 寿命最短的设计之一。

column1: The Seishin came out of the post-Jihad salvage boom, when pirates across the Periphery suddenly had access to Word of Blake hardware they had no business owning and the ambition to do something creative with it. The design caught on in the Tortuga Dominions and built a nasty reputation, because a mech optimized for taking prisoners and capturing hardware intact is genuinely harder to deal with than one that just wants to kill you. The Shield and Retractable Blade tell you exactly what happens if the taser does not land.
column2: Seishin 诞生于圣战后的回收热潮。当时外环海盗突然获得大量本不该属于他们的圣言之子设备，也萌生了将其改造一番的野心。这台机甲在 Tortuga 领地流行起来，并留下恶名：一台专为俘虏敌人和完整夺取装备而优化的机甲，确实比只想杀死你的机甲更难对付。盾牌和伸缩刀清楚说明了电击枪失效后会发生什么。

column1: The Serket is a Taurian Concordat produced 140 ton Omni QuadMech based on the older Scorpion. Its name is based on the old egyptian mythology from ancient times and was coined by a member of the design team born on Pharos, in the Alexandrian Covenant.
column2: Serket 是陶里安协约生产的 140 吨全能四足机甲，基于更老的 Scorpion 设计。它的名字源自古埃及神话，由一名出生于亚历山大公国法罗斯岛的设计团队成员命名。

column1: The Shadow Wolf has one of the more chaotic production histories you will find, with the Errai factory changing hands between the AFFS, the Combine, and the Word of Blake in the space of a few years before eventually landing with the Republic of the Sphere. Despite all that upheaval, the design kept getting built, which tells you the demand was real. Stealth Armor combined with TAG on a frame this fast makes it genuinely dangerous to anything operating without artillery cover, because it can call fire down on targets that never even knew it was there.
column2: Shadow Wolf 拥有你能见到的最混乱生产史之一：Errai 工厂在短短几年间先后易手于 AFFS、联合王国和 Blake 圣言，最终归入球体共和国。尽管经历如此动荡，这个设计仍不断生产，说明市场需求真实存在。隐形装甲与 TAG 结合在如此高速的底盘上，对任何没有炮兵掩护的单位都极其危险，因为它能呼叫火力轰击目标，而目标甚至不知道自己已被发现。

column1: The Shadowhawk IIC Z has very little in common with its other SHD-IIC cousins thanks to extensive modifications by Society Engineers. 设计 to be a devastating guerilla warefare mech, the SHD-IIC S features a 变色龙光极化护盾, Nova CEWS, Advanced 躯干挂载 Cockpit, a Snub-Nosed PPC, and a pair of Medium Heavy Lasers. column2: 由于社会工程师的大规模改造，Shadowhawk IIC Z 与其他 SHD-IIC 近亲几乎没有共同之处。SHD-IIC S 旨在成为毁灭性的游击战机甲，配备变色龙光极化护盾、Nova CEWS、高级躯干挂载驾驶舱、一门短管 PPC 和一对中型重型激光器。多数 S 型还携带两具 T.A.E. 分配器，用于区域封锁和资产拒止行动。

column1: The Shamash Hover Reconnaissance Vehicle began production by Clan Blood Spirit in the late 29th century following the declining fortunes of that Clan as a cheaper replacement for the Asshur. The Shamash is faster and cheaper, weighing in at almost half of the Asshur, while the 60-rated fusion engine can propel it up to 216 km/h. This variant carries an ECM Suite and an ER Medium Laser. column1: The Shen Yi is a front line stealth BattleMech which has its roots in previous programs such as the Men Shen and Sha Yu BattleMechs. The design was seen as a breakthrough in using 'Mechs with Stealth Armor in a front line role as opposed to the previously seen reconnaissance role by the CCAF. Within 15 years of its introduction, many older missile support elements in the CCAF had been replaced by the Shen Yi.
column2: 神意是一款前线隐形战斗机甲，其设计源自门神、鲨鱼等早期项目。CCAF 将它视为隐形装甲机甲从侦察用途转向前线作战的一项突破。神意问世后的 15 年内，CCAF 许多较老的导弹支援单位都被它取代。

column1: The Shen Yi is a front line stealth BattleMech which has its roots in previous programs such as the Men Shen and Sha Yu BattleMechs. column2: 申乙是一款前线隐形战斗机甲，其根源可追溯到Men Shen和Sha Yu等早期项目。对卡佩兰中央军而言，使用配备隐身装甲的机甲执行前线任务，而非传统侦察任务，是一次突破。它推出后的15年内，卡佩兰中央军许多老式导弹支援单位都被申乙取代。

column1: The Shinigami, 'Death Spirit', is a Kurita Prototype using stolen and reverse engineered Stealth Systems, striking from the shadows while being just as respectable a foe at shorter ranges.
column2: 死神“死亡之魂”是栗田原型机，使用偷来的和逆向工程的隐形系统，从阴影中发起攻击，同时在较短距离内也是一个值得尊敬的敌人。

column1: The Shiro BattleMech was originally produced for the Draconis Combine's armed forces. Named for House Kurita's founder, Shiro Kurita, the Shiro was made to embody the spirit of bushido, the Way of the Warrior, its armor designed to resemble the Samurai armor of ancient Japan. When it was first presented to the DCMS, it was ordered only to those who are acclaimed and honor would be granted with the chance to pilot the Shiro.
column2: Shiro 战斗机甲最初为龙蛇联合王国武装部队生产。它以栗田家族创始人 Shiro Kurita 命名，旨在体现武士道，即武士之道；装甲外形仿照古代日本武士铠甲。Shiro 首次呈交 DCMS 时，只会授予那些获得认可者，只有他们才有荣誉驾驶这台机甲。

column1: The Shrike is outfitted with a powerful 定位 Computer that allows it to bring accurate firepower to bear on the battlefield. It has a hard-hitting armament that gives the '机甲 a powerful sting in combat at most ranges. A 长 Bow LRM-10-rack allows pilots to engage enemies at long range, and two Type 9 超级自动炮/5s are effective against even other assault-class '机甲s. Lastly, two Series 2b ER Large Lasers provide a fairly powerful punch should the other weapon systems deplete their ammunition. The 设计 owes its large weapon capacity to due use to its Endo Steel construction and its large 380-rated Extra-Light Fusion 引擎. Engineers enhanced the 设计 by adding a 部分机翼, giving the Shrike extra jump capacity as well as additional cooling abilities under normal atmospheric conditions. 怪癖: Command 机甲 掉落成本乘数: 1.23 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower
column2: 伯劳装备一台强大的定位计算机，能够在战场上实施精准火力。它的武器配置火力强劲，在大多数距离都能给予敌人有力打击。长弓 LRM-10 发射器让驾驶员可以攻击远距离目标，两门 Type 9 超级自动加农炮/5 甚至能有效对付其他突击级机甲。最后，两门 Series 2b 增程大型激光器在其他武器弹药耗尽时仍能提供相当强的火力。该设计采用内骨骼钢结构，并使用大型 380 级超轻聚变引擎，因此拥有宽裕的武器载荷。工程师又加入部分机翼，在正常大气条件下同时提升伯劳的跳跃能力和散热能力。 怪癖: 指挥机甲 掉落成本乘数: 1.23 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂

column1: The Sidewinder A configuration mounts two 改进的 Heavy 中型激光s, an iATM-3 missile launcher, and CASE II 装甲 in the right torso. It includes a 定位 Computer to boost laser accuracy, balancing firepower and defense in a compact 设计. 怪癖: Nimble 掉落成本乘数: 0.99 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Sidewinder A 双臂各安装一具改进型重型中型激光器，另有 iATM-3 导弹发射器和右侧躯干的 CASE II 装甲。瞄准计算机提升激光精度，使这台紧凑机甲兼具火力与防御。 怪癖: 灵巧 掉落成本乘数: 0.99 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Sidewinder C configuration combines two Improved Heavy Medium Lasers with a Targeting Computer and adds six Jump Jets, enabling a 180-meter jump range. This enhances the Sidewinder C’s mobility and close-range striking capability. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Sidewinder C 配置将两个改进型重型中型激光器与瞄准计算机结合在一起，并添加了六个跳跃喷气机，可实现 180 米的跳跃范围。这增强了响尾蛇 C 的机动性和近距离打击能力。 怪异：Nimble 下降成本乘数： 0.99 经Aries Games and Miniatures许可使用。

column1: The Sidewinder D configuration is a powerful mid-range striker armed with five ER 中型激光s all linked to a 定位 Computer, providing precision and sustained firepower to dominate opponents at medium distances. 怪癖: Nimble 掉落成本乘数: 0.99 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Sidewinder D配置是一台强力的中程突击机甲，装备五门ER中型激光器，全部连接至瞄准计算机，可在中距离提供精确而持续的火力，压制对手。 怪癖: 灵活 掉落成本乘数: 0.99 经Aries游戏与模型工作室许可使用。

column1: The Sidewinder Prime configuration is a versatile skirmisher equipped with an ER Large Laser for long-range attacks and an 改进的 Heavy 中型激光 for close combat. Both weapons link to a 定位 Computer for superior accuracy. It handles heat efficiently, allowing Alpha Strikes at full speed without overheating, making the Sidewinder Prime a popular choice for scouts. 怪癖: Nimble 掉落成本乘数: 0.99 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: 响尾蛇Prime配置是一台用途灵活的游击机甲，装备ER大型激光器用于远程攻击，并以一门改进型重型中型激光器进行近战。两种武器均连接到瞄准计算机，以获得更高精度。它的散热效率很高，可以在全速行动时发动全弹齐射而不过热，因此深受侦察部队欢迎。 特性：敏捷 部署成本倍率：0.99 经Aries Games and Miniatures许可使用。

column1: The Sidewinder is a high-speed OmniMech developed by the Star Adders, drawing inspiration from the Cephalus but avoiding banned tech. Built across three facilities—including Strana Mechty, Huntress, and a Deep Periphery site—it’s favored by scout and headhunter Stars. A 250 XXL engine, Endo-Steel chassis, and Supercharger push speeds over 150 kph. Though armed lightly due to limited pod space, it’s one of the fastest OmniMechs ever made. Its 6.5 tons of Ferro-Lamellor armor offer solid protection, but it can't sustain prolonged combat.
column2: Sidewinder 是星际蝰蛇氏族研发的高速 OmniMech，设计灵感来自 Cephalus，但避开了违禁技术。它在三处设施生产，包括 Strana Mechty、Huntress 和外环深处的一处基地，深受侦察星群和猎杀星群青睐。250 级 XXL 引擎、Endo Steel 内骨钢底盘和增压器使其速度超过 150 千米/时。受模块空间限制，它武装较轻，却是有史以来速度最快的 OmniMech 之一。6.5 吨 Ferro-Lamellor 装甲提供可靠防护，但它无法长时间持续作战。

column1: The Simian is a thirty-second century medium battle armor which was the brain child of Republic of the Sphere Paladin, Kara Rutherford. The design came about due in part to Paladin Rutherford's concern of the high cost of battle armor development. Her efforts to make a cost-effective design would give birth to the Simian, however, she would not live to see it enter production.
column2: Simian 是一款 32 世纪中型战斗装甲，由球体共和国圣骑士卡拉·卢瑟福构想。高昂的战斗装甲研发成本促使她开始这项设计。她希望打造一种高性价比型号，最终催生了 Simian；然而在它投入生产前，她便已去世。

column1: The Siorc Wolf 1 features an impressive jump capacity of 120 meters, armed with twin ATM-6s and Class 20 Hyper Assault Gauss Rifles, complemented by a Watchdog CEWS for solid offensive capabilities. What truly sets this ‘Mech apart is its unique torso design. Instead of a traditional single pivot, it uses twin torso discs to allow torso twisting. This innovative mechanism protects the armor and CASE II mounts from damage while enabling faster rotation and a wider arc of fire. This design significantly enhances the pilot’s ability to engage enemies across a broader field without repositioning the entire mech. Quirk: Improved Targeting - Medium Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.24 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Siorc Wolf 1 拥有令人印象深刻的 120 米跳跃能力，装备双联 ATM-6 和 20 级超突击高斯步枪，并以 Watchdog CEWS 提供可靠的进攻能力。真正让这台机甲与众不同的是其独特的躯干设计：它没有传统的单一旋转轴，而是使用双躯干圆盘实现扭腰。该创新机构既能保护装甲和 CASE II 挂载免受损伤，又能加快旋转并扩大射界，使机师无需重新调整整台机甲的位置，就能在更宽广的战场范围内与敌人交战。 特性：改进型瞄准 - 中程 部署费用倍率：1.24 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column2: Siorc Wolf 1 拥有惊人的 120 米跳跃能力，装备两具 ATM-6 和两门 20 型超重型突击高斯步枪，并配备 Watchdog CEWS。它独特的躯干结构是最大特色：不采用传统单轴，而是使用双躯干圆盘实现扭转。该机构保护装甲和 CASE II 挂载免受损坏，同时带来更快旋转和更广射界，使驾驶员无需移动整台机甲即可攻击更大范围的敌人。 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - 中程 掉落成本乘数: 1.24 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Siorc Wolf, Clan Sea Fox’s latest Assault-class OmniMech, is based on the Mad Cat MK II 4-6 and quickly became a bestseller. Weighing 100 tons, it combines surprising speed—up to 80+ kph via supercharger—with an endo-composite skeleton maximizing weapon space. Manufactured primarily on Tukayyid, it’s widely available across multiple factions, including Clan Sea Fox, Federated Suns, and Wolf Empire, with other factions showing varied interest.
column2: Siorc Wolf 是海狐氏族最新的突击级 OmniMech，以 Mad Cat MK II 4-6 为基础，很快成为畅销机型。它重 100 吨，却能借助增压器达到 80 km/h 以上的惊人速度；Endo-Composite 复合骨架最大化武器空间。它主要在图卡伊德生产，海狐氏族、联邦太阳联邦和狼帝国等多个阵营都能获得，其他势力也表现出不同程度的兴趣。

column1: The Sköll is a fast, versatile medium OmniMech developed by the Wolf Empire to replace the Stormcrow. Built alongside the Tomahawk II, it shares components for easier repairs and logistics. Equipped with a Supercharger and Laser-Reflective armor, the Sköll excels in both speed and survivability. Its adaptable configurations suit various combat roles, making it a deadly frontline unit. Highly valued, no Sköll has been lost to isorla, underscoring its importance in the Empire’s push beyond the Fortress Republic.
column2: 斯库尔是一台由狼帝国开发、用于替代风暴乌鸦的高速多用途中型全能机甲。它与战斧 II 一同建造，共享部件以便维修和后勤。斯库尔配备增压器与激光反射装甲，在速度和生存能力方面都表现出色。其可调整的配置适合多种战斗职责，是一台致命的前线单位。它受到高度重视；没有任何一台斯库尔被当作伊斯欧拉战利品失去，这凸显了它在帝国越过堡垒共和国推进过程中的重要性。

column1: The Slagmaiden BattleMech is a mixed hybrid of Clan and Inner Sphere experimental technologies. column1: The Smilodon is a 110-ton line BattleMech fielded by the Minnesota Tribe, produced by Independence Weaponry as a dependable frontline brawler. Named after the prehistoric saber-toothed predator, the Smilodon symbolizes brutal efficiency and predatory focus, traits the Tribe values in its martial tradition. Its design draws inspiration from the Ebon Jaguar, sharing a low-slung, forward-thrusting posture and a menacing profile suited for battlefield intimidation. While lacking the advanced modularity of an OmniMech, the Smilodon is built for sustained frontline engagement. It uses Ferro-Silk armor, a lightweight, steel-polymer lattice developed by Northern Meshworks, trading some durability for weight savings to support heavier weapons in line with the Tribe’s focus on overwhelming offensive capability. The Smilodon stands as a testament to the Tribe’s doctrine of overwhelming force and their refusal to abandon classic battle-tested principles.
column2: Smilodon 是明尼苏达部落部署的 110 吨线列战斗机甲，由 Independence Weaponry 生产，是可靠的前线格斗者。它以史前剑齿掠食者命名，象征着部落武术传统所重视的残酷效率和捕食者般的专注。设计灵感来自 Ebon Jaguar，拥有低伏、前倾的姿态和适合震慑敌人的凶悍外形。它没有全能机甲的先进模块化能力，却为持续前线作战而生。Smilodon 使用 Northern Meshworks 开发的轻型钢聚合物晶格 Ferro-Silk 装甲，以部分耐久性换取减重，从而安装更重武器，贯彻部落压倒性进攻理念。它证明了部落坚持经典实战原则、追求压倒性力量的信条。

column1: The Sobek is a 170 ton superheavy, named after an ancient crocodile god in a long dead religion from Terra due the likeness of the 'Mech's head to an alligator. Produced within the Taurian Concordat by Vandenburg Mechanized Industries and sold to most anyone in the Periphery, it is quite a basic design for being a superheavy which makes it easy to maintain and repair.
column2: Sobek 是一台 170 吨超重型机甲，以 Terra 古老宗教中的鳄鱼神命名，因为它的机甲头部酷似短吻鳄。它由陶里安协约的范登堡机械工业生产，几乎销往所有边缘邦国。作为超重型机甲，它的设计相当基础，因此易于维护和维修。

column1: The Society managed to squeeze in both a 转管自动炮 20 and a Large Supra Laser, making the ERE-PZ the best performing variant of the Erebus. The major downside is the huge price increase by almost a third more c-bills. Quirk: 稳定武器 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.42 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 学会设法同时塞入一门转管自动炮/20和一门大型超脉冲激光，使 ERE-PZ 成为厄瑞布斯中性能最好的变体。主要缺点是价格暴涨，C-bill 成本增加了将近三分之一。 特性：稳定武器 掉落成本乘数：1.42 手臂驱动器限制：左侧下臂，右侧下臂

column1: The Society managed to squeeze in both a 转管自动炮 20 and a Large Supra Laser, making the ERE-PZ the best performing variant of the Erebus. The major downside is the huge price increase by almost a third more c-bills. 特性：武器稳定 部署成本倍率：1.42 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 社会将一门转管自动炮20和一门大型Supra激光器塞入其中，使ERE-PZ成为最强的厄瑞玻斯变型。代价是价格大幅上涨，几乎比标准型号高出三分之一的C币。 特性：武器稳定 部署成本倍率：1.42 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: The Sortek Assault Hover Craft is a thirty-second century combat hovercraft, originally produced by Corean Enterprises for the armed forces of the Federated Suns. Built on New Avalon, Corean Enterprises constructed the craft as a means to repeat its success with its last successful hovercraft, the Musketeer. The Sortek was used by many Armed Forces of the Federated Suns combat units by the 3140s to rebuild their devastated forces. Many AFFS commanders would mistakenly use the Sortek as a main combatant, which would cause heavy casualties due to the Sortek's lack of being able to deliver a killing blow to a heavier opponent. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. Armor: Heavy Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 205 25 Left 130 25 Right 130 25 Rear 110 25 Total 575 100 Quirk: Improved Sensors
column2: 索特克突击气垫船是三十二世纪的战斗气垫载具，最初由科瑞安企业为联邦太阳国武装部队生产。科瑞安企业在新亚瓦隆建造该船，希望复制其上一款成功气垫船“火枪手”的佳绩。到3140年代，索特克已被联邦太阳国许多作战部队用于重建饱受重创的军力。不少联邦太阳国武装部队指挥官误将索特克当作主力战车投入战斗；由于它缺乏对重型敌手一击制胜的能力，这种用法造成了重大伤亡。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：9/14 格 / 270/420 米。 装甲：重型铁纤维装甲 结构：结构 数值 装甲 结构 前部 205 25 左侧 130 25 右侧 130 25 后部 110 25 总计 575 100 特性：改进传感器

column1: The SpacerMax SP-2 mounts a fluid gun in the left torso with four tons of ammunition for oil, coolant, bonding agents, cleaning solutions and water. A spot welder replaces the right hand for construction work, while a small laser in the left arm handles debris clearing and precision cutting or demolition. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.75
column2: SpacerMax SP-2 在左躯干上安装了一支流体枪，装有四吨弹药，用于油、冷却剂、粘合剂、清洁溶液和水。点焊机代替右手进行建筑工作，而左臂中的小型激光器则负责清理碎片和精确切割或拆除。 Quirk：易于操作维护 下降成本乘数：0.75

column1: The SpacerMax SP-2 mounts a fluid gun in the left torso with four tons of ammunition for oil, coolant, bonding agents, cleaning solutions and water. A spot welder replaces the right hand for construction work, while a small laser in the left arm handles debris clearing and precision cutting or demolition. 特性：Easy to Maintain 部署费用倍率：0.75
column2: SpacerMax SP-2 左侧躯干安装流体枪，并携带四吨油料、冷却剂、粘合剂、清洁液和水。右手替换为点焊机用于施工，左臂的小型激光器则负责清理碎片、精密切割和拆除作业。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：0.75

column1: The SpacerMax was built by MaxTech as a worker 'Mech meant for construction tasks in the vacuum of space, and it helped build the Star League's SDS platforms. Despite being marketed solely for non-atmospheric conditions, it was fully capable of working on the ground too, though that narrow marketing angle ended up hurting its overall sales. Its environmental sealing system was notoriously fragile, and any damage to even one part of it compromised the whole setup, keeping pilots reliant on a delicate lifeline while working out among the stars.
column2: SpacerMax 是由 MaxTech 制造的，作为一种工人机甲，用于在真空中执行施工任务，它帮助建造了星际联盟的 SDS 平台。尽管仅针对非大气条件进行营销，但它也完全有能力在地面上工作，尽管这种狭窄的营销角度最终损害了其整体销量。它的环境密封系统是出了名的脆弱，任何一个部件的损坏都会影响整个装置，使飞行员在星际中锻炼时必须依赖脆弱的生命线。

column1: The Spectre Battle Armor was developed and fielded by Protectorate Arms Conglomerate. It has got its name from the stealth armor that protects it. This armor, while good at hiding it from enemy sensors, fares very poorly when under fire. The Spectre is pretty quick for a humanoid Battle Armor, but its Mechanical Jump Booster is not a true replacement for regular Jump Jets. Magnetic clamps adapted from the Fa Shih Battle Armor allow the Spectre to be carried into battle. While its armament gives it better combat ability than some early stealth suits, it still cannot stand up to larger battle armor like the Elemental or Kanazuchi.
column2: 幽灵战斗装甲由保护国武器联合企业研发并投入使用，其名称源于保护它的隐形装甲。这种装甲善于躲避敌方传感器，却很不耐炮火。对人形战斗装甲而言，幽灵的速度相当快，但机械式跳跃增幅器无法真正取代常规跳跃喷射器。它采用从法师战斗装甲改进而来的磁力夹具，可由其他单位携带投入战场。幽灵的武装使其战斗力胜过某些早期隐形战斗装甲，但仍无法与元素或金槌等大型战斗装甲正面对抗。

column1: The Spectre 战斗装甲 was developed and fielded by Protectorate Arms Conglomerate. It has got its name from the stealth 装甲 that protects it. This 装甲, while good at hiding it from enemy sensors, fares very poorly when under fire. The Spectre is pretty quick for a humanoid 战斗装甲, but its Mechanical 跳跃放大器 is not a true replacement for regular Jump Jets. Magnetic clamps adapted from the Fa Shih 战斗装甲 allow the Spectre to be carried into battle. While its armament gives it better combat ability than some early stealth suits, it still cannot stand up to larger battle 装甲 like the Elemental or Kanazuchi.
column2: Spectre 战斗装甲由保护国武器联合体开发并列装，名称源自保护它的隐身装甲。该装甲能躲避敌方传感器，却很难承受持续射击。Spectre 对人形战斗装甲而言速度很快，但机械跳跃放大器无法真正取代常规跳跃喷射器。

column1: The Spiner SPR-SNP-X is a testbed built solely to prove the Snub-Nose PPC on a light frame. Weighing 25 tons with a 150 fusion engine, it carries a single center torso mounted Snub-Nose PPC backed by six tons of standard armor for protection. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - PPC Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: Spiner SPR-SNP-X 是专用试验平台，旨在证明轻型机甲底盘也能搭载短鼻 PPC。它重 25 吨，采用 150 级聚变引擎，中央躯干安装一门短鼻 PPC，并以六吨标准装甲提供防护。 特性：武器精准 - PPC 部署费用倍率：0.98 手臂致动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The Spiner SPR-SNP-X is a testbed built solely to prove the Snub-Nose PPC on a light frame. Weighing 25 tons with a 150 fusion 引擎, it carries a single center torso mounted Snub-Nose PPC backed by six tons of standard 装甲 for protection. 特性：Accurate Weapon - PPC 部署成本倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Spiner SPR-SNP-X 是一台试验平台，专门用于验证轻型机架搭载短管 PPC 的可行性。它重 25 吨，由 150 级聚变引擎驱动，搭载一具安装在中央躯干的短管 PPC，并以六吨标准装甲提供防护。 特性：精准武器 - PPC 部署成本倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: The Spirit is one of the first Clan 'Mechs produced in the Inner Sphere. Though some components are imported from Clan space, the 245 XL engine is made in the Clan Jade Falcon Occupation Zone. The engine is only one of the weight-saving technologies the design makes use of, however, as the Spirit incorporates both an endo steel structure and six tons of ferro-fibrous armor. The Spirit itself is a relatively fast recon 'Mech that can hold its own at both long and short ranges. In addition, it makes for a good training 'Mech, ensuring that it will have a place in the Falcon touman for a long time to come.
column2: 灵魂是最早在内星系生产的氏族机甲之一。虽然部分组件从氏族空间进口，但其 245 XL 引擎产自氏族 Jade Falcon 占领区。引擎只是这款设计采用的减重技术之一：灵魂还使用内骨架结构和 6 吨铁磁纤维装甲。灵魂本身是一款速度较快的侦察机甲，在远近距离都能自保。此外，它也很适合作为训练机甲，确保它在未来很长一段时间内继续留在猎鹰氏族的 touman 编制中。

column1: The Spirit is one of the first Clan 'Mechs produced in the Inner Sphere. Though some components are imported from Clan space, the 245 XL engine is made in the 玉鹰氏族 Occupation Zone. The engine is only one of the weight-saving technologies the design makes use of, however, as the Spirit incorporates both an endo steel structure and six tons of ferro-fibrous armor. The Spirit itself is a relatively fast recon 'Mech that can hold its own at both long and short ranges. In addition, it makes for a good training 'Mech, ensuring that it will have a place in the Falcon touman for a long time to come.
column2: 灵魂是最早在内层圈生产的氏族机甲之一。虽然部分组件从氏族领地进口，但其 245 级 XL 引擎产自翡翠隼占领区。不过，引擎只是该设计采用的众多减重技术之一；灵魂还结合了内骨骼结构和 6 吨铁纤维装甲。灵魂本身是一款速度相当快的侦察机甲，在远距离和近距离都能独当一面。此外，它还是很好的训练机甲，因此很长时间内都会在翡翠隼氏族的军团中占有一席之地。

column2: 灵体是最早在内圈生产的氏族机甲之一。虽然部分部件来自氏族空间，245级XL引擎产自玉鹰氏族占领区。该设计还采用内骨骼结构和6吨铁纤维装甲，是一台速度较快、能在远近距离作战的侦察机甲。

In addition, it makes for a good training 'Mech, ensuring that it will have a place in the Falcon touman for a long time to come.
column2: Stealth 3S型采用逆向工程获得的隐身装甲。机甲装备一门射程极远的增程PPC。增程PPC的长射程与隐身装甲相结合，使3S成为近乎完美的狙击机甲。

column1: The Stag II 24M is a minor evolution of the 24G variant. The 24M trades in the short ranged Medium Pulse and Small Lasers in for an Ion Stream Projector in order to handle 战斗装甲 and Infantry while still being detrimental to BattleMechs. 特性：通信增强 部署成本倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: Stag II 24M是24G变型的小幅演进。24M用离子流投射器替换射程较短的中型脉冲激光和小型激光器，以对付战斗装甲和步兵，同时仍能有效威胁战斗机甲。 特性：通信增强 部署成本倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 下臂

column1: The Stalking Spider II is a Clan Medium BattleMech designed and produced by Clan Sea Fox at its Manufacturing Plant SFF-TU1 on Tukayyid. Produced since the dawn of the thirty-second century, the Stalking Spider II was a result of the merchant Clan’s desire to bring more revenue into its coffers. The Clan redesigned the original Stalking Spider Quad 'Mech with new innovations, but these "innovations" began being problematic for its pilots, due to a unique turret design. It proved to be popular with Inner Sphere second-line defense units, despite its shortcomings.
column2: Stalking Spider II 是氏族中型战斗机甲，由海狐氏族在 Tukayyid 的 SFF-TU1 制造厂设计并生产。自三十二世纪初开始生产，它源于商人氏族增加收入的愿望。氏族用新技术重设计了原始的四足 Stalking Spider，但这些“创新”因独特炮塔设计给驾驶员带来问题。尽管存在缺陷，它仍受到内层圈二线防御部队欢迎。

column1: The Star Crusader was created by Scorpion engineers by modifying the never realized Blakist plans, an OmniMech version of the Grand Crusader.
column2: 星际十字军由蝎帝国工程师依据圣言之子未能实现的方案改造而成；该方案原本计划将 Grand Crusader 设计成 OmniMech。

column1: The Star Crusader was created by Scorpion engineers by modifying the never realized Blakist plans, an 全向Mech version of the 大十字军.
column2: Star Crusader由蝎子氏族工程师改造未实现的布雷克圣言会方案而成，是大十字军的全向机甲版本。

column1: The Star League-era Marksman was created as a fire support vehicle, specifically to carry the newly designed Sniper Artillery Piece. As a successor to the Thor, the designers improved the design by trading the previous wheeled configuration for tracks. The tracks gave the Marksman more stability, as well as increased all-terrain capabilities. The designers equipped the Marksman with 7 and half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor. Armed with a Sniper Artillery Piece, the Marksman carries a Light PPC and four heavy machine guns for defensive purposes. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Light Ferro Structure: Structure Values A S Front 275 35 Left 100 35 Right 100 35 Rear 95 35 Turret 110 35 Total 680 175 Quirk: Accurate Weapon - Ballistics
column2: 星盟时代的 Marksman 是火力支援车辆，专门搭载新式 Sniper 火炮。作为 Thor 的后继型号，它以履带替代旧有轮式配置，提升稳定性和全地形能力。Marksman 配备 7.5 吨铁磁纤维装甲、一门 Sniper 火炮、一门轻型 PPC 和四挺重型机枪用于自卫。 生物群系限制：无。 移动： 4/6 格 / 120/180 米。 装甲： 轻型铁磁装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 正面 275 35 左侧 100 35 右侧 100 35 后方 95 35 炮塔 110 35 总计 680 175 特性：武器精准 - 弹道

column1: The Star Python poses little threat to an enemy of greater size or moderately respectable armor. The Scorpion Empire employs the ’Mech in groups, enhancing the threat through numbers rather than via armament. Though their current numbers remain low, an unverified report indicates Star Pythons are being deployed in Trinary-sized hunting packs. The combined might of many light ’Mechs delivers through synergy what each lacks individually. It doubles as a fast scout, combining excellent speed with limited jump capability. Quirk: Nimble Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 星蟒对体型更大或装甲相当坚固的敌人威胁不大。蝎子帝国通常成群运用这种机甲，依靠数量而非单体武装增强威胁。虽然目前数量仍少，但有未经证实的报告称，星蟒正以三列规模组成猎杀小队部署。众多轻型机甲通过协同作战，弥补各自单独行动时的不足。星蟒也可充当快速侦察机，兼具出色速度与有限的跳跃能力。 特性：敏捷 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: The Starslayer was a mainstay of the Lyran military when the 'Mech was resurrected in the thirty-first century. This highly mobile energy weapon platform can stay in the field nearly indefinitely with minimal resupply, making it an optimal raider. Upgraded Starslayers played a key role in Task Force Kingbreaker on Buena. Precision strikes disabled the equipment of the Third Collective Guards at Fort Buena without killing their occupants, whom the LCAF regarded as misguided fellow Lyran citizens
column2: Starslayer在31世纪复兴后成为莱拉军队的主力。这种高度机动的能量武器平台只需极少补给就能几乎无限期留在战场，因而是理想的突袭者。升级后的Starslayer在Buena的Kingbreaker特遣队行动中发挥了关键作用。精确打击瘫痪了Buena堡垒第三集群卫队的装备，没有杀死其中人员；LCAF认为他们只是误入歧途的莱拉同胞。

column1: The Stone Giant is a 180 ton superheavy developed by Robinson Standard BattleWorks at their main research and development plant on Robinson III, loosely based on the Atlas. It's a very versatile chassis that exists in many variants with different configurations and roles. Although initially sold to Federated Suns only it soon reached new markets all over the Inner Sphere and even some larger Periphery states.
column2: 石巨人是罗宾逊标准战斗工坊在罗宾逊 III 号主要研发工厂制造的 180 吨超重型机甲，设计略微参考了擎天神。它是一款用途广泛的底盘，拥有多种配置和作战定位。最初只向联邦太阳销售，后来很快进入整个内天体，甚至一些较大的边缘邦国市场。

column1: The Stone Lion developed the Haider, a heavy OmniMech based on an upgraded Summoner chassis and armor, produced using equipment moved from St. Louis MechWorks to Industriplex Alpha to centralize manufacturing and simplify battlefield repairs. Production began in early 3136 at two sites. The Haider features a supercharger allowing bursts up to 103 kph, 32.5 tons of pod space, and uses an Extra-Extra Light engine to maximize capacity, balanced by reinforced engine armor. All variants include targeting computers and 12 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor.
column2: Stone Lion 开发了 Haider，这是一台基于升级 Summoner 底盘和装甲的重型 OmniMech。制造设备从 St. Louis MechWorks 搬迁至 Industriplex Alpha，以集中生产并简化战场维修。生产于 3136 年初在两个地点开始。Haider 配备增压器，短时间速度可达 103 kph，拥有 32.5 吨吊舱空间，并采用超轻型引擎最大化容量，再以强化引擎装甲平衡。所有型号都配备瞄准计算机和 12 吨铁磁纤维装甲。

column1: The Stormbird was commissioned by Clan Jade Falcon and intended as a bridge between the available Elemental and Ironhold battlesuits, being the result of collaboration between Falcon resources and Clan Snow Raven science. The proposed anti-infantry role for the Stormbird interested the Snow Ravens, who desired a similar-sized suit with a similar operational profile. The final result was not the versatile platform expected by the Falcons, with the design closely matching the already available Salamander. For the Snow Ravens however, the Stormbird proved to be an immense success providing them with fire-resistant armor that had thus far proved impossible to produce.
column2: Stormbird 由翡翠隼氏族委托设计，原计划作为现有 Elemental 与 Ironhold 战斗服之间的过渡型号，是隼氏族资源与雪鸦氏族科学力量合作的成果。Stormbird 的反步兵定位吸引了雪鸦氏族，他们希望拥有尺寸与作战特性相近的战斗服。最终成品并非隼氏族期望的多用途平台，设计反而与 Salamander 高度相似。不过对雪鸦氏族而言，Stormbird 极为成功，因为它采用了此前一直无法制造的防火装甲。

column1: The Stormbird was commissioned by 玉鹰氏族 and intended as a bridge between the available Elemental and Ironhold battlesuits, being the result of collaboration between Falcon resources and 雪鸦氏族 science. The proposed anti-infantry role for the Stormbird interested the Snow Ravens, who desired a similar-sized suit with a similar operational profile. The final result was not the versatile platform expected by the Falcons, with the design closely matching the already available Salamander. For the Snow Ravens however, the Stormbird proved to be an immense success providing them with fire-resistant 装甲 that had thus far proved impossible to produce.
column2: Stormbird由玉鹰氏族委托开发，旨在弥合现有Elemental与Ironhold战斗装甲之间的空缺，是猎鹰资源与雪鸦氏族科学合作的成果。Stormbird拟议的反步兵角色吸引了雪鸦氏族，他们希望拥有一套尺寸和作战特性相近的装备。最终结果并非猎鹰预期的多用途平台，其设计与现有Salamander高度相似；但对雪鸦氏族而言，Stormbird极其成功，为他们提供了此前一直无法制造的耐火装甲。

column1: The Subjugator is a 120 ton Clan BattleMech with one focus, long range devastating strikes with its Improved Railgun and other weapons. It is slightly less heavily armored than most Superheavy units, but instead relies on other means such as mobility or stealth to be effective in battle. Besides the fixed Improved Railgun in the right torso, the other very interesting thing with the design is the Encased Cybernetic Cockpit; this cockpit encases the piloting MechWarriors in extra thick armor and utilizes a window less design to lower the amount of weakspots.
column2: Subjugator 是一台 120 吨的氏族战斗机甲，核心任务是利用改进型轨道炮和其他武器实施远程毁灭性打击。它的装甲略逊于大多数超重型单位，却依靠机动性和隐形等手段保持战斗力。除了右侧躯干固定安装的改进型轨道炮，最引人注目的是封装式义体驾驶舱：它用额外厚重的装甲包裹驾驶员，并采用无窗设计，减少薄弱点。

column1: The Surtur is a fast medium BattleMech developed by the Hanseatic League as their first home built design. By 3120s, the League industrial/technology levels had achieved pre-Jihad level of technology. The governing Merchant Council decided it was time of the reason was pride in their nation's achievement, as indigenous design should be made. The Surtur is designed as a skirmisher, intended to get into close-quarters combat to render the enemies.
column2: Surtur 是汉萨同盟开发的快速中型战斗机甲，也是其首款自主设计。到 3120 年代，同盟的工业和技术水平已达到圣战前的水平。执政的商人委员会出于对国家成就的自豪，决定制造本土设计。Surtur 被设计成游击机甲，旨在迅速接近敌人进行近距离战斗。

column1: The Suski is a medium OmniMech developed by Clan Coyote for the renewed invasion of the Inner Sphere. Drawing on Society Septicemia data and Stormcrow components, it features 13 tons of Ferro-Lamellor armor for enhanced durability. While sacrificing some pod space, most variants include a Supercharger to match the speed of its sibling, the Mikasi. The Suski’s blend of old tech and modern updates makes it a resilient and fast striker, ideal for rapid assaults and extended frontline engagements.
column2: Suski 是郊狼氏族为重新入侵内天体而开发的中型全能机甲。它吸收社会氏族败血症计划的数据，并采用 Stormcrow 的部件，配备 13 吨 Ferro-Lamellor 装甲以提高耐久性。大多数变体牺牲部分挂载舱，安装增压器以追上姊妹机 Mikasi 的速度。Suski 将老技术与现代升级结合，成为坚韧而迅捷的突击机甲，适合快速突袭和长时间前线作战。

column1: The T configuration carries an ER PPC with a PPC Capacitor in each arm. An extra double heat sink is in the left and right torso, but to handle heavy heat loads the right torso carries a triple Coolant Pod.
column2: T型在每条手臂上各装备一门ER PPC和一个PPC电容器。左右躯干各增加一枚双重散热器；为了处理巨大的热负荷，右侧躯干还安装了三重冷却舱。

column1: The T variant is a hybrid missile boat configuration featuring the powerful Artemis V guidance system for its two LRM20s. An ER Large and ER Medium Laser in each arm provide additional firepower.
column2: T 型是混合导弹艇配置，两个 LRM-20 采用强大的 Artemis V 制导系统。每只手臂各有一门增程大型激光器和增程中型激光器，提供额外火力。

column1: The TNS-7D refines the TNS-4S, keeping proven systems and upgrading weaknesses. A ClanTech pulse laser and missile launcher extend range and precision, while an advanced electronics suite boosts accuracy and shields the ’Mech from targeting. Critics note its conventional C³ slave instead of a boosted model, but consider this a minor drawback. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: TNS-7D 在保留成熟系统的同时改进了 TNS-4S 的弱点。氏族技术脉冲激光器和导弹发射器扩大了射程并提高精度，先进电子设备则强化瞄准并保护机甲免遭敌方锁定。评论者指出它采用普通 C3 从机，而非增幅型；不过这只算小小的缺憾。 特性：稳定 部署费用倍率：1.09 手臂致动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: The Taipan is a powerful medium OmniMech co-developed by Clans Star Adder and Cloud Cobra, named after the deadly Terran snake. Produced on Strana Mechty, Huntress, and a Deep Periphery world, it boasts 19 tons of pod space and Ferro-Lamellor armor. Though lacking in jump capability in most variants, it can deal and withstand heavy damage. Designed after the Society conflict, the Taipan is a versatile, hard-hitting OmniMech that demands caution whenever encountered on the battlefield.
column2: Taipan 是星蝰氏族与云蛇氏族联合研发的强力中型全能机甲，以 Terra 上的致命蛇类命名。它在 Strana Mechty、Huntress 和一颗深层边缘星球生产，拥有 19 吨挂载舱空间和 Ferro-Lamellor 装甲。虽然大多数变体没有跳跃能力，但它既能造成重创，也能承受重击。Taipan 在社团冲突后设计，是一款多用途、高火力的全能机甲，在战场上遭遇它时必须保持警惕。

column1: The Tau is Clan Stone Lion’s fast, hard-hitting replacement for medium-class OmniMechs, developed from captured Ice Ferret chassis after the Wars of Reaving. Named after the Tswana word for lion, the Tau boasts a base speed of 127 kph, with some variants hitting 165 kph using a supercharger. Its Ferro-Lamellor armor, provided via Star Adder specs, offers enhanced protection, making the Tau a difficult and resilient target in combat.
column2: 陶是石狮氏族为替代中型全能机甲而开发的高速重击型机体，源自掠夺战争后缴获的冰鼬底盘。其名称取自茨瓦纳语中的“狮子”，基础速度达到 127 公里/小时，部分变型机配备增压器后可达到 165 公里/小时。由星蝰蛇规格提供的铁素体层压装甲带来更强防护，使陶在战斗中成为难以击破且十分坚韧的目标。

column1: The Telesilla is a Majesty Metals design built around the Binary Laser Cannon, which tells you the Magistracy was willing to experiment with technology that most Inner Sphere manufacturers had quietly set aside for good reason. The original model went into MAF service despite mixed field trials, which is the kind of decision that makes more sense when you understand how limited Periphery procurement options were during the Succession Wars. The 511 upgrade addressed most of the structural complaints and turned it into a machine that actually delivers on what the original was trying to be.
column2: 特蕾西拉是至尊金属公司围绕双联激光炮打造的设计。这说明治国会愿意尝试内天体多数制造商早已出于充分理由悄然放弃的技术。尽管原型机的实地测试结果褒贬不一，它仍进入了治国会武装部队服役；考虑到继承战争期间外环采购渠道有多么有限，这一决定也就不难理解。511 型改进解决了大部分结构问题，终于让这台机器真正实现了原设计的目标。

column1: The Telesilla is a Majesty Metals design built around the 二元激光 Cannon, which tells you the Magistracy was willing to experiment with technology that most Inner Sphere manufacturers had quietly set aside for good reason. The original model went into MAF service despite mixed field trials, which is the kind of decision that makes more sense when you understand how limited Periphery procurement options were during the Succession Wars. The 511 upgrade addressed most of the structural complaints and turned it into a machine that actually delivers on what the original was trying to be.
column2: Telesilla是Majesty Metals设计的机甲，以星元炮为核心；这说明治安官辖区愿意尝试大多数内天体制造商因充分理由而悄然放弃的技术。尽管实地测试结果褒贬不一，原始型号仍进入MAF服役；要理解这一决定，就必须考虑继承战争期间边疆采购选项有多么有限。511升级型号解决了大多数结构问题，终于让这台机器实现了原始设计的目标。

column1: The Temax Cat Ninjabolt is a heavy class of BattleMech which, over time, was repaired with odd-'Mech parts, which resulted in it becoming an Experimental FrankenMech. It was cobbled together from a collection of parts over the years by Solaris VII MechWarrior Larry Allen Barttelbort.
column2: Temax Cat Ninjabolt 是一种重型战斗机甲，多年来不断用奇怪的机甲部件修理，最终成为实验性的 FrankenMech。Solaris VII 机甲战士 Larry Allen Barttelbort 多年来用各种部件将它拼凑起来。

column1: The Templar III is a Dark Age era Assault Class OmniMech, first produced by General Motors for the Federated Suns. It was intended as a replacement for the original Templar, whose factory lines were destroyed during the Jihad. General Motors established a new production line on New Valencia for what was to become the next generation of the Templar with newer technologies.
column2: Templar III 是黑暗时代的强袭级全能机甲，最初由通用汽车为联邦太阳生产。它原本要替代最初的 Templar，后者的生产线在圣战期间被摧毁。通用汽车在新瓦伦西亚建立了新的生产线，制造这款采用更新技术的下一代 Templar。

column1: The Tenshi's Primary configuration is equipped mainly with standard technologies that allow the 'Mech to engage an enemy unit at long-range. Its main weapon is an arm-mounted Gauss Rifle which is fed with 3 tons of ammunition. Its other set of long range weaponry consists five Light Particle Projection Cannons, all of which are fitted into the 'Mech's right arm. For a last resort, the 'Mech sports a pair of 10-tubed Rocket Launchers, with one placed in each of its legs. All of the energy weapons are tied to a Targeting Computer for greater accuracy. Among other equipment found in this configuration is a Guardian ECM, providing an electronic screen against enemy attacks, while a Supercharger is fitted into the center torso to help temporarily increase ground speed.
column2: Tenshi 的主要配置主要配备标准技术，使“机甲”能够远距离与敌方单位交战。它的主要武器是一支装在手臂上的高斯步枪，弹药量为3吨。它的另一套远程武器包括五门光粒子投射炮，所有这些都安装在“机甲”的右臂上。作为最后的手段，“Mech”配备了一对 10 管火箭发射器，每条腿上各放置一个。所有能量武器都与瞄准计算机相连，以提高准确性。此配置中的其他设备包括卫士 ECM，可提供电子屏幕以抵御敌人的攻击，而超级充电器则安装在中央躯干中，以帮助暂时提高地面速度。

column1: The Teppō artillery support vehicle is an experimental super heavy combat Vehicle which is designed to provide support to frontline combat units of the Draconis Combine. First produced just after the Jihad, this massive vehicle was designed to be a regiment's mobile artillery battery and also provide additional command and repair abilities through its pair of Support Trailers. The Teppō's creation was as a result of the hard lessons learned from nearly two decades of fighting the Word of Blake and the Black Dragon Society. Using the Ryuken's Combined-Arms command style as a model, the Teppō and its support trailers would attempt to replicate the elite brigade's command capabilities for other frontline Regiments. Built on Unity at Pesht Motors, the Teppō is noted for its high quality due to each vehicle being hand-built. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 2/3 hexes / 60/90 meters. Armor: Heavy Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 400 105 Left 400 105 Right 400 105 Rear 400 105 Turret 400 105 Total 2000 525 Quirk: Enhanced FPE Can carry 1 Battle Armor Squads.
column2: Teppō 炮兵支援车是一款实验性超重型战斗车辆，旨在支援天龙联合体前线部队。它在圣战结束后不久投入生产，体型庞大，可充当团级机动炮兵连，并通过两辆支援拖车提供额外的指挥与维修能力。Teppō 的诞生源于近二十年来对抗布莱克之言和黑龙会所吸取的惨痛教训。它以 Ryuken 的诸兵种协同指挥方式为蓝本，试图让其他前线团也能具备这支精锐旅的指挥能力。Teppō 由 Pesht Motors 基于 Unity 平台打造，每辆车均为手工制造，因此品质出众。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：2/3 格 / 60/90 米。 装甲：重型铁磁纤维装甲 结构：结构 数值 A S 前部 400 105 左侧 400 105 右侧 400 105 后部 400 105 炮塔 400 105 总计 2000 525 特性：强化防火控制 可搭载 1 个战斗装甲小队。

column1: The Tercio is the Escorpión_Imperio's flagship BattleMech. The 185 ton behemoth is focused on massive firepower and supporting it with advanced technology to maximize its efficiency. Although constructed only in limited numbers, the Tercio has quickly gained a reputation of being able to overwhelm even the most reinforced of positions.
column2: Tercio 是 Escorpión_Imperio 的旗舰战斗机甲。这头重达 185 吨的巨兽以强大火力为核心，并以先进技术提升火力运用效率。虽然产量有限，Tercio 很快就因足以压垮最坚固阵地而声名远扬。

column1: The Thanatos-8S has been refit with an Emergency Coolant System and Prototype DHS, sporting both a Mortar and MML with a wide variety of ammo is it able to stay longer in the fight and dominate the engagement.
column2: Thanatos-8S 加装了应急冷却系统和原型双重散热器，同时配备迫击炮和 MML。多种弹药让它能够在战斗中坚持更久并掌控交战。

column1: The Thresher Mk II is a Heavy Clan BattleMech designed as a skirmisher by Clan Sea Fox. This is a remodeled/refitted version of the venerable Thresher. The Thresher Mk II came about when a number of these 'Mechs were produced during the Dark Age Era and Clan Sea Fox Merchants were unable to sell them. Negotiations with Clan Wolf Khan Alaric Ward paved the way toward a sale, but only if the 'Mechs were refitted to Clan Wolf's specifications, which included arm actuators that the original design never featured.
column2: Thresher Mk II 是 Sea Fox 氏族设计的重型氏族 BattleMech，定位为游击机。它是老牌 Thresher 的重制／改装型。黑暗时代期间，Sea Fox 商人生产了多台 Thresher Mk II 却无法销售；与 Wolf 氏族可汗 Alaric Ward 的谈判促成了交易，但前提是按 Wolf 氏族规格重新改装，包括原始设计没有的手臂驱动器。

column1: The Thug was designed by Maltex Corporation as a direct competitor to the popular Warhammer BattleMech. First seeing production in 2572, the Thug sought to directly address some of the challenges which faced the Warhammer, chief of which was to increase armor protection without sacrificing firepower.
column2: Thug由Maltex Corporation设计，用于直接竞争热门的Warhammer战斗机甲。它于2572年首次投产，目标是解决Warhammer面临的若干问题，其中最主要的是在不牺牲火力的情况下增加装甲防护。

column1: The Thunder is the first heavy ’Mech designed and produced by a Capellan manufacturer following the Clan invasion. Powered by a 280 XL Engine and mounting 6 Improved Jump Jets, the 70 ton Thunder THR-4L is armed with a Thunderbolt 20 along with three Extended-Range Medium Lasers and a Medium X-Pulse Laser. CASE II protects the 4 tons of Thunderbolt ammo.
column2: Thunder 是氏族入侵后首款由卡佩兰制造商设计并生产的重型机甲。70 吨的 Thunder THR-4L 由 280 XL 引擎驱动，安装 6 具改进型跳跃喷射器，配备一具 Thunderbolt 20、三门增程中型激光器和一门中型 X-Pulse 激光器。CASE II 保护其 4 吨 Thunderbolt 弹药。

column1: The Thunder is the first heavy ’Mech designed and produced by a Capellan manufacturer following the Clan invasion. Powered by a 280 XL Engine and mounting 6 Improved Jump Jets, the 70 ton Thunder THR-4L is armed with a Thunderbolt 20 along with three Extended-Range Medium Lasers and a Medium X-Pulse Laser. CASE II protects the 4 tons of Thunderbolt ammo. Quirk: Cowl Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Upper
column2: Thunder 是氏族入侵后首款由卡佩兰制造商设计并生产的重型机甲。70 吨的 Thunder THR-4L 由 280 XL 引擎驱动，安装六具改进型跳跃喷射器，装备一具 Thunderbolt 20、三门增程中型激光和一门中型 X 脉冲激光。CASE II 保护四吨 Thunderbolt 弹药。 特质：头盔 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右上臂
