Powered by a 280 XL引擎 and mounting 6 Improved Jump Jets, the 70 ton Thunder THR-4L is armed with a Thunderbolt 20 along with three Extended-Range 中型激光器 and a Medium X-Pulse Laser. CASE II protects the 4 tons of Thunderbolt ammo.
column2: 雷霆是氏族入侵后第一台由卡佩兰制造商设计和生产的重型机甲。70 吨的 Thunder THR-4L 采用 280 级 XL 引擎和六具改进型跳跃喷射器，装备一门 Thunderbolt 20、三门增程中型激光器和一门中型 X 脉冲激光器。CASE II 保护四吨 Thunderbolt 弹药。

column1: The Thunder is the first heavy ’Mech designed and produced by a Capellan manufacturer following the Clan invasion. Powered by a 350 XL Engine, the 70 ton Thunder THR-2L is armed with an LB-20X along with two Extended-Range Medium Lasers, a Streak SRM-6 rack and an Extended-Range Small Laser. column1: The Thunderbolt IIA is a one-off project to create a larger version of the 'Mech. Weighing in at 90 tons of total weight it really is just a larger and slower version of the original, and according to some MechWarriors worse.
column2: Thunderbolt IIA 是一次性项目，目的是制造更大型的该系列机甲。它总重 90 吨，实际上只是原版更大、更慢的版本，而且据一些机甲战士说，表现更糟。

column1: The Tian-zong is a post-Jihad design that the Capellan Confederation first developed in 3090. Equipped with thirteen and a half tons of 隐身装甲 powered by an Angel ECM Suite, the Tian-zong is a premier 'Recon in Force' 'Mech. The 300-rated extralight engine propels the Tian-zong to a top speed of 64 km/h, which can make for a jarring ride given the 小型驾驶舱. The Tian-zong is one of the first Capellan 'Mechs to use an Endo-Composite skeleton. Twelve 双散热器 dissipate the heat from the 隐身装甲. It is a popular 'Mech with CCAF commanders.
column2: 天宗是圣战后的设计，卡佩兰联邦于 3090 年首次开发。天宗配备十三吨半隐形装甲，并由天使 ECM 套件驱动，是顶尖的“武力侦察”机甲。额定功率 300 的超轻型引擎将其最高速度推至 64 公里/小时，但由于采用小型驾驶舱，驾驶体验可能颇为颠簸。天宗是首批采用 Endo-Composite 骨架的卡佩兰机甲之一。十二个双散热器负责消散隐形装甲产生的热量。它深受卡佩兰联邦武装部队指挥官欢迎。

column1: The Tocho is a fast and agile Light OmniMech by Clan Stone Lion, named after the Hopi word for "mountain lion." Built alongside other models at Niles Industriplex Alpha, it shares components for easy maintenance. With only 6.5 tons of pod space, it’s lightly armed but hard to hit thanks to its extreme speed and built-in Supercharger. Though the Coyote Boyyi is faster, the Tocho remains formidable. 5.5 tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor max out its protection for its weight class, making it a nimble and resilient scout or skirmisher.
column2: 托乔是石狮氏族制造的高速敏捷轻型全能机甲，名称取自霍皮语中的“山狮”。它与其他型号一同在尼尔斯工业园 Alpha 建造，共享部件以便维护。它只有 6.5 吨的 Pod 空间，武装较轻，却凭借极端速度和内置增压器而难以命中。虽然郊狼博伊更快，托乔依旧不可小觑。5.5 吨铁素体纤维装甲已将其重量级别的防护能力推至上限，使它成为灵活而坚韧的侦察或游击单位。

column1: The Tomahawk is an assault-class OmniMech designed by Clan Wolf in 3065. By September of that year, a few prototypes had been built and were being tested in trial runs. One these prototypes was piloted by Nathan Wolf in a Circle of Equals on Tamar when he attained the rank of Star Colonel. Although he was victorious against a Thor, it was noted that the Tomahawk still suffered from numerous system errors and gremlins and was not yet ready for mass production. Still, Nathan retained the 'Mech for his subsequent assignment to Omega Galaxy and successfully piloted it in combat on Novo Cressidas in the Star's End system on 11 April 3064.
column2: Tomahawk 是狼氏族于 3065 年设计的强袭级全能机甲。同年 9 月，数台原型机已经造出并开始试运行。其中一台原型机由 Nathan Wolf 驾驶，在 Tamar 的平等圆环决斗中帮助他晋升为星际上校。虽然他击败了 Thor，但人们发现 Tomahawk 仍存在大量系统故障和小毛病，尚未准备好量产。尽管如此，Nathan 仍在随后调往 Omega 星群时保留了这台机甲，并于 3064 年 4 月 11 日在 Star's End 星系的 Novo Cressidas 作战中成功驾驭它。

column1: The Tora 2 was developed after a single year of feedback from Spirit Cat MechWarriors. By removing the original's main weaponry and jump jets—but retaining the Supercharger and Targeting Computer—designers were able to install a Class 20 Hyper Assault Gauss Rifle and twin Improved Heavy Large Lasers. While the design presents potential heat issues, any experienced MechWarrior can effectively manage the heat buildup. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Tora 2 根据 Spirit Cat 机甲战士一年的实战反馈开发。设计师拆除原有主武器和跳跃喷射器，但保留增压器与瞄准计算机，从而安装一门 20 级 Hyper Assault Gauss Rifle 和两门改进型重型大型激光。这种配置可能存在热量问题，但经验丰富的机甲战士能够有效控制热量积累。 特质：易于驾驶 部署费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 许可使用。

column1: The Tora 3, developed after another year of operational feedback, takes a sharp turn from its predecessor’s loadout. It mounts twin ATM-9s and a single ER PPC, giving it effective coverage at all ranges. A Targeting Computer enhances accuracy, while 120 meters of jump capability and the continued use of a Supercharger ensure strong mobility and tactical flexibility. Quirk: Easy to Pilot Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.15 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: 经过又一年的实战反馈，Tora 3 对前代的武器配置进行了大幅调整。它装备双联 ATM-9 和一门增程 PPC，可有效覆盖所有射程。瞄准计算机提升精度；120 米跳跃能力和保留的增压器则确保机动性与战术灵活性。 特质：易于驾驶 部署费用倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂、右上臂 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 许可使用。

column1: The Trinity is really three different battle armors, all initially constructed by the Capellan Confederation and therefore sharing the same base chassis. The Ying Long ("Shadow Dragon") uses the mimetic armor first created by Word of Blake for their Purifier, though how they acquired the technology is unknown. The Asterion and Theseus are functionally identical, but have different aesthetics.
column2: Trinity 实际上是三种不同的战斗装甲，最初都由联邦制制造，因此共用同一基础底盘。Ying Long（“影龙”）采用圣言之书为净化者开发的拟态装甲，但其技术来源至今不明。Asterion 和 Theseus 在功能上完全相同，只是外观不同。

column1: The Triton was designed by Clan Goliath Scorpion for their Seekers. The main weapon, a Streak SRM-4, is very conservative with its ammunition, while the ER Micro Laser provides a weapon that isn't tied to logistical bases.
column2: Triton 由 Goliath Scorpion 氏族为其搜索者设计。主武器 Streak SRM-4 对弹药非常节省，而增程微型激光器则提供了不依赖后勤基地的武器。

column1: The Triton was designed by Clan Goliath Scorpion for their Seekers. This is a fire-support variant equipped with an LRM-3 launcher a pair of ER Micro Lasers and an ER Small Laser.
column2: Triton 由 Goliath Scorpion 氏族为其搜索者设计。这是一个火力支援变体，配备一具 LRM-3 发射器、两门增程微型激光器和一门增程小型激光器。

column1: The Triton was designed by Clan Goliath Scorpion for their Seekers. This variant replaces the Streak and ER Micro Laser of the standard model for a single Heavy Medium Laser.
column2: Triton 由 Goliath Scorpion 氏族为其寻迹者设计。该型号用一门重型中型激光替换标准型号的 Streak 发射器和增程微型激光。

column1: The Triton was designed by Clan Goliath Scorpion for their Seekers. This version carries a single ER Micro Laser in the torso and a Heavy Small Laser on each arm.
column2: Triton 是由歌利亚蝎子氏族为其探索者设计的。该版本在躯干上携带一个 ER 微型激光器，在每只手臂上携带一个重型小型激光器。

column1: The Triton was designed by Clan 歌利亚蝎 for their Seekers. This variant replaces the Streak and ER Micro Laser of the standard model for a single Heavy 中型激光.
column2: 该Triton曾是designed by Clan 歌利亚蝎，用于their Seekers. 该变体 replaces the Streak、ER Micro Laser的the standard model，用于a single Heavy 中型激光.

column1: The Tunder Wolf 3 variant removes an additional three tons of 装甲 and two of the 中型激光器 from the second variant. An additional ER PPC was added, though this necessitated the removal of the 瞄准计算机 and the 锁定式SRM-4 of the base design. 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 雷霆狼3型从第二型上进一步减少三吨装甲，并拆下两门ER中型激光。它新增一门ER PPC，但因此不得不移除基础设计中的瞄准计算机和连射SRM-4。 特性：改进型耐久 击杀倍率：1.17 左下部装甲，右下部装甲

column1: The Tundra Wolf was the first brand new Clan Wolf BattleMech fully developed and solely produced in the Inner Sphere. With losses mounting during the Word of Blake's Jihad, rather than a costly and complex OmniMech, Wolf technicians focused on producing a standard generalist design that could be readily manufactured and fill as many roles within their depleted touman as possible. While somewhat slow for a Clan-made 75-ton 'Mech, the Tundra Wolf made up for that with MASC, that allowed it to sprint in bursts and jump jets, enabling it to leap up to 120 meters at a time.
column2: Tundra Wolf 是 Wolf 氏族第一种完全在内圈开发并独立生产的全新战斗机甲。Blake 圣言圣战期间损失不断增加，Wolf 技师没有选择昂贵复杂的 OmniMech，而是专注于制造易于量产、能在兵力枯竭的 touman 中承担尽可能多任务的标准通用设计。对一台氏族制造的 75 吨机甲而言，Tundra Wolf 略显缓慢，但 MASC 可让它短时间冲刺，跳跃喷射器也能让它一次跃过 120 米。

column1: The Turhan was first built for the Terran Hegemony in 2530 by Dieron's Buhallin Military Products. The company, known for its wheeled vehicles, built the Turhan to answer the HAF's need for an urban assault vehicle to support its infantry in urban environments. The vehicle acted as an Armored Personnel Carrier, deploying troops from its large infantry transport bay. The vehicle is protected by seven and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor, which ensured its cargo arrived at the designation intact. The Turhan's principal weaponry was its twin Large Lasers which were mounted in its turret. Mounted with the lasers were a pair of Machine Guns. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 175 25 Left 150 25 Right 150 25 Rear 140 25 Turret 120 25 Total 735 125 Quirk: Improved Communications Can carry 1 Battle Armor Squads. Has firing ports.
column2: Turhan 于 2530 年由 Dieron 的 Buhallin Military Products 为 Terran Hegemony 首次制造。以轮式车辆闻名的该公司，为满足 HAF 在城市环境中支援步兵的需求而设计这款城市突击车。它作为装甲运兵车，通过大型步兵舱运送部队。7.5 吨铁磁纤维装甲确保载荷安全抵达。主要武器为炮塔上的两门大型激光，旁边还装有两挺机枪。 生物群系限制：无。 移动： 4/6 格 / 120/180 米。 装甲： 铁磁纤维装甲 结构： Structure 数值 A S 正面 175 25 左侧 150 25 右侧 150 25 后方 140 25 炮塔 120 25 总计 735 125 特性：改进型通信 可搭载 1 个战斗装甲小队，配备射击孔。

column1: The Turkina X variant is designed as a fire support mech with an LRM-20 slaved to an Artemis V FCS mounted in each arm. These launchers are backed up by six Medium Pulse Lasers and an ECM system. Talons are mounted on each foot for inflicting additional damage from kick attacks
column2: Turkina X 是火力支援机甲，每只手臂各有一具连接 Artemis V 火控系统的 LRM-20。发射器由六门中型脉冲激光器和 ECM 系统支援，双脚安装爪刃，可在踢击时造成额外伤害。

column1: The Tyr Infantry Support Vehicle was a joint design by Clan Ghost Bear and Joint Equipment Systems, part of a plan by the Clan's leadership to reach out more to the conquered Rasalhagian populace. It has a five-ton infantry bay, enough to carry a full Point of Elementals. Since most front-line units have OmniMechs that the battle armor troopers can ride in on, the Tyr has mostly been distributed to second-line forces. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 9/14 hexes / 270/420 meters. Armor: Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 105 25 Left 105 25 Right 105 25 Rear 95 25 Turret 100 25 Total 510 125 Quirk: Improved Communications Can carry 1 Battle Armor Squads. Has firing ports.
column2: Tyr 步兵支援车由幽灵熊氏族与 Joint Equipment Systems 联合设计，是氏族领导层主动接触被征服的拉萨尔海格民众计划的一部分。它拥有 5 吨步兵舱，足以搭载一整点元素战士。由于大多数前线单位配有可供战斗装甲步兵搭乘的 OmniMech，Tyr 主要配发给二线部队。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：9/14 格 / 270/420 米。 装甲： 装甲 结构： 结构 数值 装甲 结构 前部 105 25 左侧 105 25 右侧 105 25 后部 95 25 炮塔 100 25 总计 510 125 特质： 改良通讯 可搭载 1 个战斗装甲小队。 配备射击孔。

column1: The Uller aptly named for a god of archery sports long range weapons and agility
column2: Uller的名字来自弓箭运动之神，恰如其分地体现了远程武器和敏捷性。

column1: The Umbriel is a 135 ton Superheavy 'Mech imagined as a continuation of the Celestial series. It carries the newly developed Superheavy version of the Void Signature System as well as the Blake developed massive Astral Hammer autocannon. It further sports the typical Blakist Omni Superheavy Mech equipment of a Buffered VDNI combined with a small cockpit and the Seraphim Suite networking system.
column2: Umbriel 是一台 135 吨超重型机甲，被视为天体系列的延续。它搭载新开发的超重型虚空特征系统，以及由布莱克开发的巨型星锤自动炮。此外还配备布莱克派超重型全能机甲的典型设备：缓冲式 VDNI、小型驾驶舱和 Seraphim 套件网络系统。

column1: The UrbanLord appears to be a very heavy counterpart to the much older UrbanMech, weighing in at 70 metric tons, making it two entire weightclasses heavier than the UM-R60 UrbanMech.
column2: UrbanLord似乎是更老的UrbanMech的重型对应型号，重量达70公吨，比UM-R60 UrbanMech整整重两个重量级别。

column1: The UrbanMax UX-2 arms an AC/5 in place of the right arm with two tons of ammunition split across the arm and torso, alongside a medium laser and small laser mounted where the left arm would be. Seven tons of heavy industrial armor protect the frame against most small arms fire. Quirk: Easy to Maintain Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.72 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Upper, Right Upper
column2: UrbanMax UX-2 右臂安装一门 AC/5，弹药两吨分置于手臂和躯干；左臂位置则安装一门中型激光器和一门小型激光器。七吨重型工业装甲可保护底盘免受大多数轻武器火力伤害。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：0.72 手臂致动器限制：左上臂、右上臂

column1: The UrbanMax UX-2 arms an AC/5 in place of the right arm with two tons of ammunition split across the arm and torso, alongside a 中型激光器 and small laser mounted where the left arm would be. Seven tons of heavy industrial 装甲 protect the frame against most small arms fire. 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：0.72 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: UrbanMax UX-2 右臂安装 AC/5，并在右臂和躯干之间分配两吨弹药；左臂位置安装一具中型激光器和一具小型激光器。七吨重型工业装甲保护机体，使其能抵御大多数轻武器射击。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：0.72 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: The UrbanMax is cheap and slow, built by MaxTech purely for urban defense without any thought given to crowd control or other non lethal options. It has decent enough firepower to handle most of the threats it's likely to face, but its industrial armor is no match for a real BattleMech. Then Orgus Industries rolled out the UrbanMech and outclassed it in every way, leaving the UrbanMax a cautionary tale in cutting corners.
column2: UrbanMax 廉价而迟缓，由 MaxTech 专为城市防御打造，完全没有考虑人群控制或其他非致命方案。它的火力足以应付大多数可能遇到的威胁，但工业装甲无法与真正的战斗机甲抗衡。后来 Orgus Industries 推出了 UrbanMech，在各方面都胜过 UrbanMax，使它成为削减成本过头的警示案例。

column1: The UrbanMax is cheap and slow, built by MaxTech purely for urban defense without any thought given to crowd control or other non lethal options. It has decent enough firepower to handle most of the threats it's likely to face, but its industrial 装甲 is no match for a real BattleMech. Then Orgus Industries rolled out the UrbanMech and outclassed it in every way, leaving the UrbanMax a cautionary tale in cutting corners.
column2: UrbanMax 廉价而缓慢，由 MaxTech 专门为城市防御制造，完全没有考虑人群控制或其他非致命选项。它的火力足以应付大多数可能遇到的威胁，但工业装甲无法与真正的战斗机甲匹敌。随后 Orgus 工业公司推出 UrbanMech，在各方面都超越了它，使 UrbanMax 成为削减成本的反面教材。

column1: The Urbanking UBK-044 replaces the Binary laser of the -042 with three ER 中型激光s, while still keeping the 长汤姆加农炮 in the 右侧 Arm. Otherwise it is utterly bland, it's most advanced feature the XL引擎. 特性：360° 躯干扭转 部署成本倍率：1.24 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Urbanking UBK-044用三门ER中型激光器替换-042的二元激光器，同时保留右臂的长汤姆加农炮。除此之外它平淡无奇，最先进的设备就是XL引擎。 特性：360° 躯干扭转 部署成本倍率：1.24 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The Ursus II is a Clan medium BattleMechb based on the Ghost Bears' second-line Ursus, the design had some considerable changes from the original. The XL Fusion Engine was downgraded to a 200-rated engine, to help lower costs. To make up for its loss in speed, the design was fitted with improved jump jets, which granted more tactical mobility. In its role as a bodyguard unit, the 'Mech employs an ECM suite. Its hull is protected by 10.5 tons of standard armor.
column2: Ursus II 是基于幽灵熊氏族二线 Ursus 的氏族中型战斗机甲，对原设计进行了重大改动。XL 聚变引擎降级为 200 级引擎，以降低成本。为弥补速度损失，安装改进型跳跃喷射器，获得更强战术机动性。作为护卫单位，它配备 ECM 套件；机体由 10.5 吨标准装甲保护。

column1: The Ursus II is a Clan medium BattleMechb based on the Ghost Bears' second-line Ursus, the design had some considerable changes from the original. The XL Fusion 引擎 was downgraded to a 200-rated 引擎, to help lower costs. To make up for its loss in speed, the design was fitted with improved jump jets, which granted more tactical mobility. In its role as a bodyguard unit, the 'Mech employs an ECM suite. Its hull is protected by 10.5 tons of standard 装甲.
column2: 乌尔苏斯 II 是一种氏族中型战斗机甲，基于幽灵熊氏族的二线乌尔苏斯，但相较原型进行了重大改动。XL 聚变引擎降级为 200 级引擎，以降低成本。为弥补速度损失，设计安装了改进型跳跃喷射器，获得更强的战术机动性。作为护卫单位，机甲配备 ECM 套件，车体由 10.5 吨标准装甲保护。

column1: The Ursus II is a well-rounded 'Mech. Its long-range firepower includes an Artemis IV–guided LRM-10 launcher and an ER large laser. As the 'Mech closes in on its target, it can employ its close-range weaponry, which includes two medium pulse lasers, two ER small lasers, and a Streak SRM-6 launcher. Both missile launchers are allotted a single ton of ammunition, though both ammo bins are protected by CASE. To manage the 'Mech's potential heat issues, the Ursus II uses 13 double heat sinks. A pilot using the 'Mech must be careful not to overload their heat sinks, having to choose which systems to employ. Quirk: Distracting Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: Ursus II 是一台面面俱到的机甲。其远程火力包括一具由 Artemis IV 制导的 LRM-10 发射器和一门增程大型激光。接近目标后，它可以使用近程武器，包括两门中型脉冲激光、两门增程小型激光和一具 Streak SRM-6 发射器。两具导弹发射器各配有一吨弹药，且弹药舱均由 CASE 保护。为应对可能出现的热量问题，Ursus II 使用 13 台双倍散热器。机师必须注意不要让散热器超负荷，因此需要谨慎选择启用哪些系统。 特性：扰人 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右下臂

column1: The Valedictus is a Detroit Consolidated design that came out of the 32nd century MAF procurement pipeline, built at a time when the Magistracy was watching the Wolf Empire consolidate power and needed assault-weight hardware that could handle a broad range of battlefield problems rather than excel at just one thing. The Bombast Laser never found wide adoption because it demands more from a pilot than most weapons do, but Detroit Consolidated bet on Canopian MechWarriors being good enough to use it properly. From what the Ebon Magistrate did with it in Marian Hegemony raids, that bet paid off.
column2: Valedictus 是 Detroit Consolidated 的设计，源自三十二世纪 MAF 采购体系。当时治安官正眼看狼帝国巩固势力，需要的是能处理广泛战场问题的突击级装备，而不是只擅长某一件事。Bombast 激光对驾驶员的要求高于大多数武器，因此始终没有广泛采用；但 Detroit Consolidated 认为卡诺普斯机甲战士足够优秀，能够正确使用它。从 Ebon Magistrate 在马里安霸权突袭中的表现来看，这场押注成功了。

column1: The Vali was produced for more than fifty years and was a mainstay in the forces of the SLDF through the twenty-seventh and twenty-eighth centuries. It fought all the way though Operation LIBERATION, suffering the highest losses of any artillery units. It is unknown if any were taken on Kerensky's Exodus, but each of the Successor States were able to take possession of many of the vehicles that were left behind; these went on to participate in the Succession Wars. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar or Martian biomes due to using an ICE. Movement: 4/6 hexes / 120/180 meters. Armor: Ferro-Fibrous Structure: Structure Values A S Front 100 20 Left 100 20 Right 100 20 Rear 60 20 Total 360 80 Quirk: Thermal Sight
column2: 瓦利的生产持续了五十余年，在二十七、二十八世纪一直是SLDF部队的中坚力量。它一路战斗到“解放行动”结束，损失率在所有炮兵单位中最高。尚不清楚是否有瓦利被克伦斯基带走参与大逃亡，但各继承国都获得了许多遗留下来的车辆，它们随后又参加了继承战争。 生物群系限制：由于使用内燃机，该单位无法部署于月球或火星生物群系。 移动：4/6 格 / 120/180 米。 装甲： 铁磁纤维 结构： 结构 数值 装甲 结构 前部 100 20 左侧 100 20 右侧 100 20 后部 60 20 总计 360 80 特质： 热能观瞄

column1: The Vandura armored car is a top-of-the-line civilian security vehicle produced by GMC, first hitting the market in the mid-thirty-first century. This rugged vehicle was enhanced with advanced technology to boost its performance, a testament to the company's innovative spirit. The Vandura was specifically designed to maneuver around heavily-armed adversaries, given the increasing prevalence of such threats. Aside from its primary role of transporting high-value cargo, the Vandura can double as an armored personnel carrier. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 6/9 hexes / 180/270 meters. Armor: Ferro-Lamellor (C) Structure: Structure Values A S Front 130 15 Left 85 15 Right 85 15 Rear 55 15 Turret 55 15 Total 410 75 Quirk: Improved Communications Can carry 1 Battle Armor Squads. Has firing ports.
column2: 范杜拉装甲车是 GMC 生产的顶级民用安保车辆，于三十一世纪中叶首次上市。这款坚固的车辆采用先进技术提升性能，体现了公司的创新实力。随着重装武装威胁日益普遍，范杜拉专为在这类敌人周围灵活机动而设计。除了运输高价值货物，它也能兼作装甲运兵车。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：6/9 格 / 180/270 米。 装甲：层叠铁纤维装甲 (C) 结构：结构 数值 装甲 结构 前部 130 15 左侧 85 15 右侧 85 15 后部 55 15 炮塔 55 15 总计 410 75 特性：改进通信 可搭载1个战斗装甲小队。配有射击孔。

column1: The Vapor Eagle features an eclectic and close-ranged weapons load-out, mounting a 大型脉冲激光 in its right arm, supported by a single Machine Gun, two 锁定式SRM-2s and three 中型脉冲激光s split between its side torsos and rounded out by a trio of Machine Guns in a handgun shaped housing in the left arm. The addition of a 瞄准计算机 makes its firepower even more deadly as long as it can get its weapons into range. Eleven 双散热器, half a ton of machine gun ammunition and one Streak missiles are more than adequate for the average Clan trial.
column2: Vapor Eagle采用杂色的近程武器配置：右臂装备一门大型脉冲激光，配以一挺机枪、两具锁定式SRM-2和分布于两侧躯干的三门中型脉冲激光；左臂的手枪形外壳中还装有三挺机枪。瞄准计算机让它在武器进入射程后更加致命。11枚双重散热器、半吨机枪弹药和一吨Streak导弹足以应付普通氏族试炼。

column1: The Varhunter is an ultralight urban support 'Mech developed by the DCMS at the start of the Jihad but shelved until the Dark Age. Designed for low cost and easy maintenance, it uses standard components and minimal advanced tech. Visually, the Varhunter resembles a blend of the Hussar and Crab, with clawed limbs and dorsal-mounted lasers. Its unfamiliar silhouette, combined with hit-and-run tactics, initially confused enemy targeting systems during early deployments, making it difficult to identify and counter effectively.
column2: Varhunter 是 DCMS 在圣战初期开发、直到黑暗时代才重新启用的超轻型城市支援机甲。它以低成本和易维护为目标，使用标准部件和极少的先进技术。外形上类似 Hussar 与 Crab 的混合体，拥有爪状肢体和背部安装的激光器。陌生的轮廓配合袭扰战术，使其在早期部署中扰乱了敌方瞄准系统，难以被有效识别和反制。

column1: The Victor XR was a project by the Republic Institute of Strategic Combat to supersize a Victor and use it as a platform for the newly developed Micro Missile System, their replacement for the MRM. A number of variants were developed, some even including stealth or huge ballistic weapons, but all were based around the same two MMS-40 launchers. All models also share the same 445 Ultralight engine, compact Gyro and Buffered Vehicular DNI Cockpit. Overall the project was deemed a failure, just like the MMS itself, but enough of the 'Mechs were produced that they can still be found throughout the Inner Sphere.
column2: 胜利者 XR 是共和国战略作战研究所的项目，旨在放大胜利者机甲，并将其用作新开发的微型导弹系统平台，以取代 MRM。该项目开发了多个变体，有些甚至配备隐形系统或巨型弹道武器，但它们都以两具 MMS-40 发射器为核心。所有型号还共用 445 超轻型引擎、紧凑型陀螺仪和缓冲式车辆 DNI 驾驶舱。总体而言，这个项目与 MMS 系统一样被判定为失败；不过，生产数量仍足以让这些机甲至今散布在整个内星系。

column1: The Viper B-EWR is an emergency refit developed by the Invading Clans to improve the Mechs combat effectiveness. Prompted by a shortage of ER PPC's, Clan Techs swapped in an ER Large Laser and used the remaining free weight to upgrade the Pulse Lasers to Medium models.\n\n部署成本倍率：1.03.
column2: Viper B-EWR是入侵氏族为提升机甲战斗效能而开发的应急改装型。由于ER PPC短缺，氏族技术人员换装一门ER大型激光器，并利用剩余重量将脉冲激光器升级为中型型号。\n\n部署成本倍率：1.03.

column1: The Void is a battle armor design that is produced by the Draconis Combine. The Void is protected by stealth armor and is a fairly mobile jump-capable battle armor. Armed with a single Support PPC, the Void is capable of moderate suppressing fire against larger targets. The stealth armor ensures it takes minimal return fire and the Support PPC guarantees the Void is useful on most battlefields.
column2: 虚空是由天龙联合体生产的战斗装甲设计。虚空受到隐形装甲的保护，是一种相当机动、具有跳跃能力的战斗装甲。虚空配备了一个支援 PPC，能够对较大目标进行适度火力压制。隐形装甲确保其受到的还击最少，而支援 PPC 则保证虚空在大多数战场上都很有用。

column1: The Volkh was originally designed on Solaris VII by Vining Engineering and Salvage Team to serve as a testbed for advanced technology. THIS setup seems to be a testbed for how many "lances" some mechjockey could control at once. There's a lengthy poem in some archaic Terran language carved all throughout the cockpit.

column1: The Vulcan II VLC-N4M trades a Medium Pulse Laser for an Anti-Missile System and CASE. Short-Range Missiles are often the most common anti-'Mech weapon encountered at the infantry level, and so an AMS would increase the Vulcan II's survivability at little cost to its effectiveness.
column2: Vulcan II VLC-N4M 用反导系统和 CASE 替换一门中型脉冲激光。短程导弹是步兵层级最常遇到的反机甲武器，因此 AMS 能以较小的效能代价提高 Vulcan II 的生存能力。

column1: The Vulcan II VLC-N4M trades a 中型脉冲激光 for an 反导系统 and CASE. 短程火箭s are often the most common anti-'Mech weapon encountered at the infantry level, and so an AMS would increase the Vulcan II's survivability at little cost to its effectiveness.

column1: The Vulcan is one of the most well-known Inner Sphere anti-infantry 'Mechs. Its unparalleled mobility and loadouts fully focused on dealing with infantry and Battle Armor lead to it for a long time being the prime 'Mech for urban battlefields.
column2: 火神是内星系最知名的反步兵机甲之一。它拥有无与伦比的机动性，武器配置也完全围绕对付步兵和战斗装甲而设计，因此长期以来都是城市战场上的首选机甲。

column1: The Vulcan is one of the most well-known Inner Sphere anti-infantry 'Mechs. Its unparalleled mobility and loadouts fully focused on dealing with infantry and 战斗装甲 lead to it for a long time being the prime 'Mech for urban battlefields.
column2: Vulcan 是内层圈最知名的反步兵机甲之一。它无与伦比的机动性和完全针对步兵与战斗装甲的武器配置，使其长期以来一直是城市战场的首选机甲。

column1: The WVR-9R, built on a former RetroTech factory line after the Jihad ended, could not be more traditional if it tried. It is a licensed derivative of a Thermopolis export model geared towards revamping older ’Mechs. This variant utilizes a large autocannon for maximal close-range firepower as most earlier variants did. After decades of production, the WVR-9R can rightfully be called an 'old mainstay'. Quirk: Improved Communications Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: WVR-9R 是在圣战结束后在前 RetroTech 工厂生产线上制造的，如果尝试的话，它是再传统不过的了。它是 Thermopolis 出口模型的授权衍生品，旨在改造旧的“机甲”。与大多数早期的变体一样，该变体利用大型自动加农炮来实现最大的近距离火力。经过数十年的生产，WVR-9R 可以理所当然地被称为“老中流砥柱”。 怪异：改进的通信 降低成本乘数：1.05

column1: The Warhammer-X is a testbed for the RISC Targeting Computer Systems, hammering any Target to oblivion with 2 Hyperlaser and a Artemis Supported MML.
column2: Warhammer-X 是 RISC 瞄准计算机系统的试验平台，依靠两门 Hyperlaser 和一具 Artemis 支援的 MML 将目标彻底摧毁。

column1: The Warhammer-X is a testbed for the RISC 瞄准计算机 Systems, hammering any Target to oblivion with 2 Hyperlaser and a Artemis Supported MML.
column2: Warhammer-X是RISC瞄准计算机系统的测试平台，配备两门超级激光和一具由阿尔忒弥斯系统支持的MML，可将目标轰至毁灭。

column1: The Warlord was originally intended as a streamlined, all-energy weapon variation of the classic BLR-1G BattleMaster, but the changes and weight reduction were significant enough that GM's intellectual property lawyers insisted on a new name.
column2: Warlord 最初计划作为经典 BLR-1G BattleMaster 的流线型全能量武器变体，但改动和减重幅度太大，迫使 GM 的知识产权律师坚持要求更换名称。

column1: The Warthog SL-A10 favors hit and run assaults, arming an Autocannon-5 alongside two RL 15s and a single RL 10 for single shot burst damage. Ten tons of armor plating make it more heavily protected than contemporary lighter LAMs, though this comes at the cost of noticeably reduced speed. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
column2: Warthog SL-A10 擅长打完就跑攻击，配备一门 Autocannon-5 以及两门 RL 15 和一门 RL 10，可实现单发爆发伤害。十吨的装甲板使其比当代轻型 LAM 受到更严密的保护，尽管这是以速度明显降低为代价的。 Quirk：陆地航空Mech 下降成本乘数：1.03

column1: The Warthog SL-A10 favors hit and run assaults, arming an Autocannon-5 alongside two RL 15s and a single RL 10 for single shot burst damage. Ten tons of 装甲 plating make it more heavily protected than contemporary lighter LAMs, though this comes at the cost of noticeably reduced speed. 特性：Land Air Mech 部署费用倍率：1.03
column2: Warthog SL-A10 偏好打了就跑的突袭战术，装备一门自动炮/5、两具 RL-15 和一具 RL-10，以单发爆发火力迅速脱离。十吨装甲板使它比同期轻型 LAM 防护更强，但代价是速度明显降低。 特性：陆空机甲 部署费用倍率：1.03

column1: The Warthog was named after the old ground attack plane, and built to hit hard before pulling out fast, at least in theory. It traded speed for armor compared to its siblings, ten tons worth total. Those rocket launchers are one shot deals though, so pilots had to make every volley count. Like the rest of the project, it never got past the Amaris civil war in any real numbers.
column2: 疣猪以一款旧式对地攻击机命名，设计理念是猛攻后迅速脱离，至少理论上如此。与同系列机型相比，它牺牲速度换来了总计十吨的额外装甲。不过，火箭发射器都是一次性武器，驾驶员必须确保每轮齐射都物尽其用。和该项目的其他机型一样，它始终没能大规模投产，民众只在阿马里斯内战期间见过它。

It traded speed for 装甲 compared to its siblings, ten tons worth total. Those rocket launchers are one shot deals though, so pilots had to make every volley count. column2: Warthog 以古老的对地攻击机命名，理论上用于重击目标后迅速撤离。与同系列相比，它牺牲速度换取总计十吨装甲。火箭发射器只能单发使用，因此驾驶员必须让每次齐射都物有所值。和项目其他型号一样，它在阿马里斯内战结束前都没有形成大规模产量。

column1: The Warwolf is a Heavy Class OmniMech, first produced by Clan Wolf during the mid-thirty-second century. Conceived as a part of Clan Wolf's movement to replace their old signature Timber Wolf, the Warwolf was designed to be a flexible cavalry unit. Powered by the Timber Wolf's 375-rated Extra-Light Fusion Engine, the Warwolf shares its predecessor's flexible speed. Using the weight savings of the XL Engine and the strength of its endo-steel construction, the Warwolf is able to carry 30 tons worth of OmniPod weapons and equipment. The 'Mech is protected by 14.5 tons of Clan grade reactive armor, giving the Warwolf the ability to ward off explosive type weaponry while retaining the strength of standard armor. In addition to the Warwolf's armor, the 'Mech uses a Laser-based Anti-Missile System to help fight off incoming missile attacks.
column2: Warwolf 是一款重型全能机甲，由狼氏族在 32 世纪中期首次生产。它诞生于狼氏族替换旧标志性机甲 Timber Wolf 的计划，设计目标是一台灵活的骑兵单位。Warwolf 使用 Timber Wolf 的 375 级超轻融合引擎，因此继承了前代的灵活速度。XL 引擎带来的减重以及内骨骼钢结构的强度，让 Warwolf 能携带 30 吨全能挂载武器与设备。机甲配备 14.5 吨氏族级反应装甲，既能抵御爆炸类武器，又保留标准装甲的强度。此外，Warwolf 还使用激光式反导系统，帮助抵御来袭的导弹攻击。

column1: The Wasp is a popular Light Mech designed primarily for Reconnaissance work. The Wasp 3X is a failed prototype of a Dark Age redesign. Armed with a pair of Thunderbolt 5’s and a Medium Laser, the 3X relies on a combination of an XL Engine, XL Gyro, Ferro-Fibrous, Endo Steel and Compact Heat Sinks; in order to mount the heavy weapons payload.
column2: 黄蜂是一款广受欢迎的轻型机甲，主要用于侦察。黄蜂 3X 是黑暗时代改型的失败原型。3X 配备一对 Thunderbolt 5 和一门中型激光器，并依靠 XL 引擎、XL 陀螺仪、铁磁纤维装甲、内骨架和紧凑型散热器的组合，来容纳这套沉重的武器载荷。

column1: The Wasp is a popular Light Mech designed primarily for Reconnaissance work. The Wasp 3X is a failed prototype of a Dark Age redesign. column2: 黄蜂是一款主要用于侦察的热门轻型机甲。Wasp 3X 是黑暗时代重设计的失败原型，装备两门雷电 5 和一门中型激光器。它依靠 XL 引擎、XL 陀螺仪、铁纤维装甲、内骨骼钢和紧凑型散热器，才能搭载如此沉重的武器。

column1: The Wraith marked Curtiss Militech's entry into BattleMech production. When the design was announced, many felt that the design would be little more than a walking water cooler. What the critics got was a shock. The Wraith is a 'Mech that, when properly employed, can wreak havoc on an enemy with its astounding speed and maneuverability. It is built around a massive LTV 385 XL Engine that allows it to reach speeds of just under 119 km/h. The Wraith has a simple, yet effective, pulse weapons payload. Pulse laser weaponry allows the Mech to negate most of the side effects on accuracy that are introduced by the Wraith's heavy use of jump jets, making it incredibly accurate and powerful for such a lightly armed Mech. A modification of the Wraith made by the Word of Blake, the TR3 replaces the two Medium Pulse Lasers with two ER Medium Lasers while one of the jump jets is removed to make room for an improved C3 computer, making the Wraith an incredibly powerful point 'Mech for units equipped with C3i equipment.
column2: Wraith 标志着 Curtiss Militech 进军战斗机甲制造业。设计公布时，许多人认为它不过是个会走路的饮水机。批评者很快就被震惊了：只要运用得当，Wraith 凭借惊人的速度和机动性就能给敌人造成巨大破坏。它以巨大的 LTV 385 XL 引擎为核心，速度略低于 119 km/h。Wraith 的脉冲武器配置简单而有效。脉冲激光能抵消大量使用跳跃喷射器对射击精度造成的大部分影响，使这台武装轻型的机甲异常精准且强大。Blake 圣言对 Wraith 进行的 TR3 改型，将两门中型脉冲激光换成两门增程中型激光，并拆除一具跳跃喷射器，为改进型 C3 计算机腾出空间；这使 Wraith 成为配备 C3i 设备部队中极为强大的点防御机甲。

column1: The Wulfen is a Clan Wolf light OmniMech which was first introduced shortly before the Clan's departure from its original Occupation Zone. The 'Mech utilizes its high speed and stealth technology to engage opponents in long-range combat. The Wulfen uses mix of advanced Clan and Inner Sphere technologies in its construction. The 'Mech is fitted with 300-rated XXL engine, Inner Sphere XL gyro, and endo steel which gives the 'Mech enough room for 10 tons of pod space. Among the 'Mech's other features is an ECM suite and six and a half tons of stealth armor.
column2: Wulfen 是狼氏族的轻型全能机甲，首次亮相于氏族离开原占领区前夕。它凭借高速和隐形技术与对手进行远程交战。Wulfen 的建造融合了先进氏族技术和内天体技术，配备 300 级 XXL 引擎、内天体 XL 陀螺仪和内骨骼，为 10 吨挂载舱空间提供余量。它还拥有 ECM 套件和 6.5 吨隐形装甲。

column1: The Wulfgar Prime configuration mirrors the classic Glass Spider layout but upgrades its firepower with twin Class 20 超重型突击高斯 Rifles. This variant delivers a heavy long-range punch with superior performance over its predecessor. 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - Medium 掉落成本乘数: 1.09 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Wulfgar Prime配置沿用了经典Glass Spider布局，但以两门20级超重型突击高斯步枪升级火力。该变型能在远距离打出强劲火力，性能优于前代。 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - 中型 掉落成本乘数: 1.09 经Aries游戏与模型工作室许可使用。

column1: The Xiphos assault battle armor was developed by Irian Technologies specifically to create an infantry suit protected against artillery attacks, one of the most commonly-used tactics for defeating battle armor. Manufactured on Irian and Washburn for the Marik-Stewart Commonwealth (prior to the capture of Washburn by Clan Wolf) the Xiphos was manufactured in three common configurations and specifically incorporated a high-powered communications system to allow battlefield commanders to keep lines of communication open even in the face of hostile electronic countermeasures.
column2: Xiphos 强袭战斗装甲由 Irian Technologies 专门研发，用于打造能够抵御炮击的步兵装甲；炮击是消灭战斗装甲最常用的战术之一。它在 Irian 和 Washburn 为马里克-斯图尔特联邦生产（Wolf 氏族占领 Washburn 前），拥有三种常见配置，并特别配备高功率通信系统，让战场指挥官即使面对敌方电子反制也能保持通信畅通。

column1: The Yari is a Draconis Combine designed superheavy loosely based on the Orochi. The 145 ton 'Mech mounts a chassis-attached special type of experimental missile launcher which rotating tubes. Although this allows firing of far more missiles, the bulk and weight of the system means the rest of the design is left with little to no defensive capabilities and mobility. To add on top of this, there is also a reliability issue with the launchers which tend to cause both jamming and misfires.
column2: Yari 是龙辰联邦设计的超重型机甲，大致参考了 Orochi。它重 145 吨，底盘固定安装了一种带旋转炮管的实验型特殊导弹发射器。虽然这套系统能发射远多于普通发射器的导弹，但体积和重量过大，导致机甲几乎没有防御能力和机动性。此外，发射器还存在可靠性问题，容易卡弹和哑火。

The long range weapons, respectable speed and relatively heavy armor keep the vehicle safer than many of it's peers. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. column1: The Yu Huang, named for the Jade Emperor that rules the Heavenly Court in the ancient Chinese pantheon, debuted with the promise from Sun-Tzu Liao that "it shall sit in judgment over a battlefield, meting out justice to those who would transgress against us". To live up to the promise of the Chancellor of the Capellan Confederation, the Yu Huang carries some of the most advanced technologies available at the time of its initial production. The Yu Huang is built on an Endo Steel chassis and carries a 360 XL engine that gives the 'Mech a top speed of 64.8 km/h.
column2: 以古代中国神话中统治天庭的玉皇大帝命名，玉皇机甲首次亮相时，孙祖·廖承诺“它将坐镇战场，向胆敢冒犯我方者施以正义审判”。为了兑现卡佩兰联邦总理的承诺，玉皇搭载了初次生产时可用的最先进技术。它采用内骨骼钢底盘和360级XL引擎，最高速度可达64.8公里/小时。

column1: The Yun Qi came out of Firefly Foundry's Sea Fox partnership and was built specifically to give Firefly Stables a competitive medium-class entry in the Solaris VII games, which had been a gap in the stable's lineup. Arena design requires a different kind of thinking than field hardware, and whoever drew this one up understood that a medium mech needs to be dangerous at every range to survive against opponents who will probe for weaknesses before committing. Fitting a Clan Gauss Rifle into a 50-ton frame without sacrificing close-range options is not a trivial engineering problem, and they solved it well.
column2: 云气是 Firefly Foundry 与 Sea Fox 合作的产物，专门为 Firefly Stables 在 Solaris VII 游戏中提供有竞争力的中级参赛作品而打造，这一直是该马厩阵容中的一个空白。竞技场设计需要一种与现场硬件不同的思维方式，无论谁设计了这个思维方式，都明白中型机甲需要在每个范围内都具有危险性，才能在对手在投入之前探索弱点的情况下生存下来。在不牺牲近距离选项的情况下将氏族高斯步枪安装到 50 吨重的框架中并不是一个微不足道的工程问题，他们很好地解决了这个问题。

column1: The Z-A is an advanced Society configuration that utilizes a pair of Light Ultra Gauss Rifles and a pair of iATM3s in addition to the Nova CEWS.
column2: Z-A 是 Society 的先进配置，除 Nova CEWS 外，还使用一对轻型 Ultra 高斯步枪和一对 iATM-3。

column1: The Z-B is an advanced Society configuration that utilizes a pair of Society MRM45s, a pair of Medium Supra Lasers, and a pair of Small Supra Lasers.

column1: The Ziegfried came out of the pre-Civil War Commonwealth procurement period, when both halves of the Federated Commonwealth were still trying to field hardware that impressed the other side, and Kallon delivered something genuinely clever with the TSM integration. After the split, both the Lyran Alliance and the Federated Suns ended up running it, which led to the unusual situation of identical machines facing each other across the front lines. A heavy mech that deliberately runs hot as part of its combat plan requires a very specific kind of pilot discipline to use properly, but when it works the Sword hits hard enough to end engagements quickly.
column2: Ziegfried诞生于内战前联邦采购时期，当时联邦两半都试图部署能让对方印象深刻的装备，Kallon交付了一台真正巧妙地整合TSM的机甲。分裂后，莱拉联盟和联邦太阳都装备了它，导致相同机器在前线相遇的奇特局面。让重型机甲按战斗计划故意保持高热，需要非常严格的驾驶纪律；但一旦运作，Sword的打击力足以迅速结束交战。

column1: The advanced model employed by the 星际联盟防卫军 Royal Divisions in 2743 changed the role of the 'Mech from a missile to an energy boat, replacing the LRM launcher with an ER Large Laser, retaining one 中型激光器 and downgrading the other to a Small Laser. Dropping the no longer required CASE, the 'Mech also used a MASC system for temporary speed bursts and 双散热器 to vent its increased waste heat output. The THE-Nb mounted an XL引擎 to save the weight to mount this extra equipment, at the cost of reduced survivability.
column2: 星际联盟防卫军皇家部队于2743年采用的先进型号，将机甲从导弹平台转变为能量平台：用一门ER大型激光器替换LRM发射器，保留一门中型激光器并将另一门降级为小型激光器。拆除不再需要的CASE后，机甲还采用MASC实现临时加速，并使用双重散热器排出增加的废热。THE-Nb安装XL引擎以腾出重量容纳这些额外设备，但生存能力因此降低。

column1: The brainchild of Dr. Stephen Vance, Tortoise II Battle Armor was an assault-class quad battle armor developed by the Republic of the Sphere. It was a hybrid of Inner Sphere and Clan technologies utilized by the Republic which was costly for StarCorps Industries of Terra to develop due to the unique design features Dr. Vance incorporated into it. Dr. Vance utilized wheels instead of rear legs to help the design carry its twin weapons modules onto the battlefield. Nicknamed the \\"Wheelbarrow\\", the original Tortoise prototype was a money pit. After a redesign and technology purchase from Arc-Royal MechWorks, the new Tortoise II proved to be successful despite its critics.
column2: Tortoise II 战斗装甲由斯蒂芬·万斯博士构想，是球体共和国研发的强袭级四足战斗装甲。它融合共和国采用的内天体与氏族技术；由于万斯博士加入了独特设计特征，开发成本让 Terra 的星际军团工业不堪重负。万斯博士用轮子取代后腿，让它能够将两组武器模块运上战场。最初的 Tortoise 原型被戏称为“独轮车”，是个吞金黑洞。重新设计并从 Arc-Royal 机甲工坊购入技术后，新型 Tortoise II 尽管饱受质疑，最终仍获得成功。

column1: The complex actuator design and the lack of credible defensive weaponry leaves the Goliath open to close-range attacks and battle armor swarms. Osaka Heavy Metrics’ recently introduced GOL-7K has a deadly counter to such threats: M-pods concealed in the center torso and in each leg. These defenses are hidden behind blow-away panels designed to resemble maintenance hatches, providing an unwelcome surprise for anyone who gets too close. With a focus on mediumrange combat, this Goliath variant is part of their expansion to add a true BattleMech to their stable of combat support quad IndustrialMechs. How and when Osaka acquired the plans is unknown, but espionage is suspected. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.14
column2: 复杂的执行器设计和缺乏可靠防御武器，使 Goliath 容易遭受近距离攻击和战斗装甲集群围攻。Osaka Heavy Metrics 最近推出的 GOL-7K 为这类威胁准备了致命反制：安装在中央躯干和每条腿中的 M 炸弹舱。这些防御装置隐藏在伪装成维护舱口的可炸脱面板后，会给靠得太近的敌人带来意外惊喜。该 Goliath 型号专注于中距离作战，是 Osaka 扩展其战斗支援四足工业机甲系列、加入真正战斗机甲的一部分。Osaka 如何以及何时取得设计图纸尚不清楚，但疑似涉及间谍活动。 特性：多目标追踪 部署成本倍率：1.14

column2: 这是 Opacus Venatori 成员 Mi Tomitaki 的定制配置。她的全能机甲双臂各装一具实验型 Ramtech 5500V 中型可变脉冲激光器，头部另有 ER 小型激光器；增压器让她能瞬间接近最佳武器射程。

column1: The customized '机甲 of Anastasia Kerensky, also known as Tassa Kay, utilizes twelve tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲, the most the 设计 can mount. Two ER PPCs provide long range damage capability, while a pair of ER 中型激光s and 锁定式SRM-6s can exploit the holes the PPCs makes in an enemy's 装甲. Fifteen double heat sinks keeps the '机甲 relatively cool, while jump jets enable her to vault up to 150 米 at a time. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.17
column2: 这台由阿纳斯塔西娅·克伦斯基（又名塔莎·凯）定制的机甲，使用十二吨强化纤维装甲，这是它能够安装的最大装甲量。两门ER PPC提供远程伤害，一对ER中型激光和连续射击SRM-6则能利用PPC在敌方装甲上撕开的缺口。十五组双散热器让机甲保持相对低温，跳跃喷射器则使她一次能够跃过150米。 特性：稳定 击杀倍率：1.17

column1: The customized Merlin C of Knight-Errant Jones of Clan Sea Fox. The 'Mech is named after his very first personal BattleMech, a Thor II named 'Tremor'. It is still uncertain if the Merlin is just a temporary replacement while his Thor II is getting repairs, or if it is a more permanent switch of prefered BattleMech to pilot.
column2: Sea Fox 氏族 Knight-Errant Jones 定制的 Merlin C。机甲以他人生中第一台私人 BattleMech 命名，那是一台名为“Tremor”的 Thor II。目前尚不确定 Merlin 只是 Thor II 维修期间的临时替代品，还是他永久更换了偏好的驾驶机甲。

column1: The customized configuration of the Opacus Venatori member Demi-Precentor Kendali Morris mounts enough Improved Jump Jets to leap 240 meters; the 'Mech also is equipped with TAG and a Light PPC fitted with a capacitor supported by a single Small Variable Speed Laser.
column2: Opacus Venatori 成员、副前哨长 Kendali Morris 的定制配置安装了足够多的改进型跳跃喷射器，可跃过 240 米；该机甲还配备 TAG、一门装有电容器的轻型 PPC，以及一门小型变速激光器作为支援。

column1: The customized configuration of the Opacus Venatori member Demi-Precentor Kendali Morris mounts enough Improved Jump Jets to leap 240 米; the 'Mech also is equipped with TAG and a Light PPC fitted with a capacitor supported by a single Small Variable Speed Laser.
column2: 欧帕库斯猎手组织副领唱肯达利·莫里斯的定制配置，安装了足够的改进型跳跃喷射器，可跃过240米。该机甲还配备TAG，以及一门装有电容器的轻型PPC，并由一门小型变速激光提供支援。

column1: The customized configuration of the Opacus Venatori member Demi-Precentor Kendali Morris mounts enough 改进的 Jump Jets to leap 240 米; the '机甲 also is equipped with TAG and a Light PPC fitted with a capacitor supported by a single Small Variable Speed Laser. 怪癖: 改进的 Communications 掉落成本乘数: 1.03 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: 欧帕库斯猎手组织副领唱肯达利·莫里斯的定制配置，安装了足够的改进型跳跃喷射器，可跃过240米。该机甲还配备TAG，以及一门装有电容器的轻型PPC，并由一门小型变速激光提供支援。 特性：改进型通讯 击杀倍率：1.03 左下部装甲：全向

column1: The design of the Arctic Wolf is simple: get close, unleash a torrent of missiles, and get out. Like the Pack Hunter, some materials used in the design were obtained from the Kell Hounds, though the design is Clan-tech in every way that matters.
column2: Arctic Wolf的设计很简单：接近目标，倾泻导弹，然后脱离。和Pack Hunter一样，设计中使用的部分材料来自Kell Hounds，但在关键方面它完全采用氏族技术。

column1: The difference between the -7M and -7M2 is not that great, but the better heat management of the -7M2 might be better in situations where a full alpha strike is needed.
column2: -7M 和 -7M2 之间的差异并不是很大，但 -7M2 更好的热管理在需要全面阿尔法打击的情况下可能会更好。

column1: The difference towards the 7M is small, the Heavy PPC has slightly shorter range and deals a bit less damage than the Large Lasers, but in turn generates less heat.
column2: 与 7M 型相比差异很小：重型 PPC 的射程略短，伤害也比大型激光低一些，但产生的热量更少。

column1: The disabling variant of the Sea Monkey, mounting two plasma cannons as well as several missile systems. Due to shortage of proper disabling ammunition for the missile launchers the 'Mech is actually quite inefficient at its task. 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.43 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Sea Monkey的瘫痪型变体，装备两门等离子炮以及多套导弹系统。由于缺少适用于导弹发射器的专用瘫痪弹药，这台机甲实际上并不擅长执行瘫痪任务。 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.43 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: The end result of a very wealthy pirate deciding to see how many shells he could hurl downrange per second from a single mech. The answer was ''This many''.
column2: 一个非常富有的海盗决定看看他每秒可以从单个机甲中投掷多少炮弹的最终结果。答案是“这么多”。

column1: The experimental Goblin X from Jalastar Aerospace uses an XXL 引擎 to provide power. 重型铁纤维装甲 装甲 protects the hull and the newly expanded (eight ton) Infantry Bay. The Goblin-X uses a dual turret configuration for its weapons. The main turret carries a Light PPC equipped with a PPC Capacitor and a single MML-9 missile launcher. The forward turret carries a pair of Magshots for anti-battle 装甲 defense. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 4/6 格 / 120/180 米. 装甲: 重型铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 250 25 左侧 170 25 右侧 170 25 后方 120 25 炮塔 215 25 总计 925 125 怪癖: Variable Range 定位 Can carry 2 Battle 装甲 Squads.
column2: 贾拉斯塔航空航天公司的实验型哥布林 X 使用 XXL 引擎提供动力。重型铁纤维装甲保护车体和新扩充的（八吨）步兵舱。哥布林-X 采用双炮塔武器布局。主炮塔搭载一门装有 PPC 电容器的轻型 PPC，以及一具 MML-9 导弹发射器。前部炮塔搭载一对麦格射击器，用于对抗战斗装甲。 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 4/6 格 / 120/180 米. 装甲: 重型铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 250 25 左侧 170 25 右侧 170 25 后方 120 25 炮塔 215 25 总计 925 125 怪癖: 可变射程定位 可搭载 2 个战斗装甲小队。

column1: The famous 'Mech of Grace Shiro! Where did you find this one, Boss? Can I have it? Pretty please? With sugar on top?
column2: 这是 Grace Shiro 的著名机甲！老大，你从哪儿找到的？能送给我吗？求你了，再加点糖霜就更好了！

column1: The final Clan version is based off the Jade Hawk 2, dropping the Ferro-Fibrous plating and shaving the armor levels to restore the standard Jade Hawks jump-jets and upgrade two of the arm-mounted lasers to Medium Pulse versions instead of the ER Large models.
column2: 最终的氏族版本以Jade Hawk 2为基础，取消铁纤维装甲并削减装甲等级，以恢复标准Jade Hawk的跳跃喷射器；同时将两门手臂激光升级为中型脉冲型号，替代ER大型激光。

column1: The first Clantech OmniMech produced by Odin Manufacturing for the Ghost Bear Dominion, the Karhu (Finnish for "Bear") earned the reputation as a fast cavalry 'Mech. Built on an Endo Steel based chassis, powered by a 325-rated XL engine and clad in ten and half tons of ferro-fibrous armor, the Karhu featured respectable speed and armor for its size while providing thirty tons of available pod space for equipment. Twelve Double Heat Sinks coped with most of the waste heat of its varied configurations.
column2: Karhu（芬兰语意为“熊”）是奥丁制造为幽灵熊自治领生产的第一台氏族技术全能机甲，以快速骑兵机甲闻名。它采用内骨骼底盘、325 级 XL 引擎和 10.5 吨铁纤维装甲，在这一吨位下拥有可观的速度与防护，并提供 30 吨挂载舱空间。十二个双重散热器足以处理各种配置产生的大部分废热。

column1: The first Clantech OmniMech produced by Odin Manufacturing for the 鬼熊 Dominion, the Karhu (Finnish for "Bear") earned the reputation as a fast cavalry 'Mech. Built on an Endo Steel based chassis, powered by a 325-rated XL引擎 and clad in ten and half tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲, the Karhu featured respectable speed and 装甲 for its size while providing thirty tons of available pod space for equipment. Twelve 双散热器 coped with most of the waste heat of its varied configurations.
column2: 卡鲁是奥丁制造公司为熊之星际国家生产的第一款氏族技术全向机甲，因速度惊人的骑兵机甲性能而闻名。它采用远端钢底盘，由325级XL引擎驱动，披覆十吨半的重型铁纤维装甲，在保持可观速度和防护的同时，为设备提供三十吨模块舱位。十二台双重散热器足以处理各种配置产生的大部分废热。

column1: The first custom configuration used by the infamous Bounty Hunter of the time of the initial 氏族入侵, it mounted a 大型脉冲激光 and a 中型脉冲激光 in each arm. It also had a 中型脉冲激光 in both the left and right torso with a Clan Light TAG in the center torso. A 轻型 主动探头, ECM suite, and a 瞄准计算机 provided stealth and increased accuracy.
column2: 这是初次氏族入侵时期臭名昭著的赏金猎人使用的第一种定制配置，双臂各安装一门大型脉冲激光和一门中型脉冲激光。左右躯干也各有一门中型脉冲激光，中央躯干安装氏族轻型TAG。轻型主动探头、ECM套件和瞄准计算机提供隐蔽性并提升精度。

column1: The first generation Black Watches were solid assault mechs- giving classics like the Battlemaster a run for their money. This -8A refit package sports the best our Inner-Sphere tech and Clan-tech has to offer. I've always wanted to get under the hood of one myself, but they're quite exclusive, and this one seems to be almost perfect as is. Also, the designer was a boxing fan. 11/10 Boss.
column2: 第一代黑色手表是坚固的攻击机甲——可以与《战斗大师》等经典游戏相媲美。这款 -8A 改装套件体现了我们的 Inner-Sphere 技术和 Clan-tech 所提供的最佳性能。我一直想亲自了解一下，但它们非常独特，而这个看起来几乎是完美的。此外，设计师还是一名拳击迷。 11/10 老板。

column1: The first native Battlemech to be built by the FedSuns, the 70 ton Battleaxe debuted in 2459. Based off of the technology used in the Mackie, the Battleaxe would be constantly updated with new technology, before being retired after the Reunification War when newer designs such as the Hammerhands and Warhammer entered service. The Battleaxe BKX-8D is a Jihad era revamp of the ancient design. Built around a 280-rated Light Engine, the BKX-8D is armed with a trio of MML-7’s, with 4 ER Medium Lasers as backup weapons.
column2: Battleaxe 是联邦太阳共和国制造的第一种本土战斗机甲，70 吨的它于 2459 年问世。它以 Mackie 所采用的技术为基础，不断吸收新技术升级，直到统一战争后被 Hammerhands、Warhammer 等新设计取代而退役。Battleaxe BKX-8D 是这款古老设计在圣战时代的改进型，以 280 级轻型引擎为核心，装备三具 MML-7，另有四门增程中型激光作为备用武器。

column1: The first native Battlemech to be built by the FedSuns, the 70 ton Battleaxe debuted in 2459. Based off of the technology used in the Mackie, the Battleaxe would be constantly updated with new technology, before being retired after the Reunification War when newer designs such as the Hammerhands and Warhammer entered service. The Battleaxe BKX-8D is a Jihad era revamp of the ancient design. Built around a 280-rated Light Engine, the BKX-8D is armed with a trio of MML-7’s, with 4 ER Medium Lasers as backup weapons. Quirk: Stable Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: Battleaxe 是联邦太阳共和国制造的第一种本土战斗机甲，70 吨的它于 2459 年问世。它以 Mackie 所采用的技术为基础，不断吸收新技术升级，直到统一战争后被 Hammerhands 和 Warhammer 等新设计取代而退役。Battleaxe BKX-8D 是这款古老设计在圣战时代的改进型，以 280 级轻型引擎为核心，装备三具 MML-7，另有四门增程中型激光作为备用武器。 特质：稳定 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂、右下臂

column1: The first native Battlemech to be built by the FedSuns, the 70 ton Battleaxe debuted in 2459. Based off of the technology used in the Mackie, the Battleaxe would be constantly updated with new technology, before being retired after the Reunification War when newer designs such as the Hammerhands and Warhammer entered service. The Battleaxe BKX-8D is a Jihad era revamp of the ancient design. Built around a 280-rated 轻型引擎, the BKX-8D is armed with a trio of MML-7’s, with 4 ER 中型激光s as backup weapons.
column2: Battleaxe是联邦太阳首次国产的战斗机甲，70吨型号于2459年问世。它基于Mackie所用技术不断升级，直到统一战争后才因Hammerhands和Warhammer等新设计服役而退役。Battleaxe BKX-8D是这款古老设计在圣战时代的改进版，以280级聚变引擎为核心，装备三具MML-7发射器，另有4门ER中型激光作为备用武器。

column1: The first purely Marian mech to come from hegemony Factories. It keeps costs down with both primitive armor and engine but counteracts this with a massive alpha from it's 5 Rocket Launchers.
column2: 这是第一台完全由马里安霸权工厂生产的机甲。它用原始装甲和引擎控制成本，再以五具火箭发射器的猛烈齐射弥补不足。

column1: The first purely Marian mech to come from hegemony Factories. It keeps costs down with both primitive 装甲 and 引擎 but counteracts this with a massive alpha from it's 5 火箭发射器s.
column2: 这是霸主工厂生产的第一台纯粹玛丽安机甲。它用原始装甲和原始引擎压低成本，却以5具火箭发射器带来的巨大全弹齐射抵消了性能不足。

column1: The heaviest of the three Spectral LAMs to be designed by the Word of Blake, the Waneta was produced from factories on both Terra and Gibson. Quirk: Land Air Mech Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.05
column2: 由布莱克之言设计的三台幽灵 LAM 中最重的一台，Waneta 在 Terra 和 Gibson 两地的工厂生产。 特性：陆空机甲 部署费用倍率：1.05

column1: The heavy missile-laden configuration, the B Config's principal weaponry is a pair of arm mounted 15-tubed LRM Launchers with 3 tons of ammo per launcher in same location. A pair of smaller side torso 5-tubed LRMs, with mix sized Advanced Missile Launchers, 9 and 6 is found in the left torso exclusively. The design's only energy weapons are pair of ER Small Lasers found inside torsos.
column2: 这套重型导弹配置的主武器是两具安装在手臂上的十五管 LRM 发射器，每具同部位配备三吨弹药。左侧躯干单独安装两具较小的五管 LRM，并混合搭载九联和六联高级导弹发射器。该设计唯一的能量武器是躯干内的两门增程小型激光器。

column1: The hell did you bring me, Boss? Yes. I know it says "Mad Cat" in its computer, but this is definitely not a Timber Wolf. It's pieced together from several 'Mechs that have no business being mangled together like that!
column2: 老大，你给我带来了什么鬼东西？是的，我知道它的计算机上写着“Mad Cat”，但这绝对不是一台 Timber Wolf。它由几台本来不该被这样肢解拼接的机甲硬凑在一起。

column1: The increased presence of Sea Fox traders on Son Hoa has lead to the introduction of the ClanTech-equipped -7R/SF. The 'Mech seems lacking compared to the -7R, but this is intentional; its multiple ammo bins and eclectic weaponry make it well-suited to address a wide range of garrison contingencies (albeit in an unfocused, jack-of-all-trades fashion). The variant is commonly sold via Son Hoa’s hiring hall to Periphery merc units that can’t afford Omni technology or need a versatile anchor unit for urban deployments; the nearby Sea Fox offices offer payment plans of varying degrees of onerousness.
column2: 随着海狐商人在 Son Hoa 的影响力不断扩大，配备氏族技术的 -7R/SF 随之问世。与 -7R 相比，这台机甲看似配置不足，但这是有意为之：多种弹药箱和多样化武器使其适合应对各种驻防任务，尽管它有些样样通、样样松。该变体通常通过 Son Hoa 招募所出售给外环佣兵部队；这些部队要么买不起 Omni 技术，要么需要一台适合城市部署的多用途核心单位。附近的海狐办事处还提供各种付款方案，条件有的相当苛刻。

column1: The increased presence of Sea Fox traders on Son Hoa has lead to the introduction of the ClanTech-equipped -7R/SF. The '机甲 seems lacking compared to the -7R, but this is intentional; its multiple ammo bins and eclectic weaponry make it well-suited to address a wide range of garrison contingencies (albeit in an unfocused, jack-of-all-trades fashion). The variant is commonly sold via Son Hoa’s hiring hall to Periphery merc units that can’t afford Omni technology or need a versatile anchor unit for urban deployments; the nearby Sea Fox offices offer payment plans of varying degrees of onerousness.
column2: 海狐商人在 Son Hoa 的活动日益频繁，促成了配备氏族技术的 -7R/SF 型号问世。这台机甲看似不如 -7R，但这是有意为之：多个弹药舱和混合武器使它能够应对各种驻防任务，尽管整体配置较为分散。该分型通常通过 Son Hoa 的雇佣大厅出售给无力负担全能技术、或需要适合城市部署的多用途核心单位的边疆佣兵部队；附近的海狐办事处还提供条件各异、负担程度不同的分期付款方案。

column1: The increased presence of Sea Fox traders on Son Hoa has lead to the introduction of the unusual -9SF. Only produced by special request, the -9SF is almost always seen in Shoal Clusters (where it is considered a somewhat better prospect for glory in battle than most IndustrialMechs). Some merchants bring them on trade ships to increase cargo space by combining BattleMech and IndustrialMech capabilities in a single bay, but finding pilots can be difficult; few Trueborn warriors are willing to be perceived as glorified stevedores, leaving freeborn, solahma, or contract pilots as the go-to options for such expeditions.
column2: Sea Fox 商人在 Son Hoa 的活动日益频繁，促成了不寻常的 -9SF 型号。它只接受特殊订购，几乎总出现在 Shoal Cluster 中，在那里被认为比大多数工业机甲更有机会在战斗中成名。一些商人把它们带上贸易船，将战斗机甲与工业机甲能力合并到一个舱位以增加货运空间；但驾驶员很难寻找，少有 Trueborn 战士愿意被视为镀金搬运工，因此远征通常选择 freeborn、solahma 或合同驾驶员。

column1: The increased presence of Sea Fox traders on Son Hoa has lead to the introduction of the unusual -9SF. Only 生产 by special request, the -9SF is almost always seen in Shoal Clusters (where it is considered a somewhat better prospect for glory in battle than most Industrial机甲s). Some merchants bring them on trade ships to increase cargo space by combining Battle机甲 and Industrial机甲 capabilities in a single bay, but finding pilots can be difficult; few Trueborn warriors are willing to be perceived as glorified stevedores, leaving freeborn, solahma, or contract pilots as the go-to options for such expeditions.
column2: 海狐贸易商在松华的活动日益增加，促成了不寻常的-9SF问世。该-9SF它只有在特殊请求下才会制造，几乎总能在浅滩集群中看到；在那里，与大多数工业机甲相比，它被认为更有机会在战斗中赢得荣耀。一些商人把它们带上贸易船，通过在同一货舱中结合战斗机甲和工业机甲的能力来增加货运空间。但飞行员很难寻找：很少有真生战士愿意被视为高级搬运工，因此自由生、索尔玛或合同飞行员成了这类远征的常见人选。

column1: The invasion strategies that created the Boyyi also shaped the Canis II design. Though designated second-line, the original Canis was built to aggressively engage Inner Sphere forces. It featured extremely heavy firepower but suffered from severe heat issues and poor speed, limiting its effectiveness in combat. After the Wars of Reaving, Clan Coyote developed the Canis II to address these flaws, though it was costly and only a few units were produced.

column1: The lack of a Clan-made Superheavy QuadMech irked some of the more progressive scientists from the clans that had made it back to the Inner Sphere. So they decided to collaborate in secret on Project Colossus, meant to be the pinnacle of Clan design and ingenuity. The resulting 200 ton Quad OmniMech was eventually renamed to the Arachnid, and was more an ode to the decadence and delusion of grandeur that has started to seep into the Inner Sphere clans than fulfilling any practical role.
column2: 一些回到内天体的氏族进步派科学家，对氏族没有自行制造的超重型四足机甲十分恼火。于是他们秘密合作开展“巨像计划”，试图打造氏族设计与工程的巅峰。最终诞生的 200 吨四足全能机甲后来改名为 Arachnid，但它更像是内天体氏族逐渐沾染的奢靡与妄自尊大，而不是实用需求的产物。

column1: The late 3050s and early 3060s saw the Absorption of Clan Burrock by Clan Star Adder. After the proof of collusion with the Bandit Caste, most Burrocks were eager to be rid of the taint of corruption. The Star Adders read this as a desire to join a more powerful Clan, so they were surprised when many former Burrocks clung to that identity. In order to appeal to them, the Star Adder leadership authorized a new BattleMech to honor them. The Burrock is a fast heavy 'Mech with incredible short-range firepower. Though its XL engine leaves it somewhat vulnerable, the Burrock is protected by twelve and a half tons of armor.

column1: The light assault 'Mech of the Celestial series of OmniMechs, the Seraph is somewhat slow for its weight, but it attempts to make up for that with the inclusion of Triple-Strength Myomer that enables the 'Mech to speed up to 64 km/h when it runs hot. Three Medium Pulse Lasers and a Small Laser are used defensively in the event an enemy units gets inside the minimum range of the PPCs. A Flamer provides effective anti-infantry defense.

column1: The main guns on the Legacy are its two large-bore Mydron Excel autocannon, which are capable of punching through any opposing 'Mech with amazing speed. The three Diverse Optics lasers and the Guided Technologies 2nd Gen 4-tube are clearly backup weapons. The lack of significant long-range weapons hampers the design somewhat, an absence that is only exacerbated by its slow speed. Moreover, the 'Mech's vaunted durability is limited due to its reliance on ammo-fed weaponry. Should the Legacy run out of ammunition, it is clearly advantageous for the pilot to quit the field rather than attempt to use energy weaponry that can be outclassed by 'Mechs half its size.
column2: Legacy的主炮是两门大口径Mydron Excel自动加农炮，能够以惊人速度击穿任何敌方机甲。三门Diverse Optics激光和Guided Technologies第二代四管发射器显然只是备用武器。缺少有效的远程武器削弱了设计，缓慢速度又加重了这一问题。此外，机甲依赖弹药供给武器，传闻中的耐久性也受到限制。如果Legacy耗尽弹药，驾驶员最好退出战场，而不是尝试使用会被半重量机甲压制的能量武器。

column2: Stewart出产的新型Locust IIC 10源自狼族科学家的判断：脉冲激光器精度高，对高速侦察机甲构成最大威胁。反射装甲和射程更远的激光器协同使用，以降低这一风险。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The newest generation of Falcon OmniMechs represents a rift in design philosophy that mirrors the rift inside the Clan. The savage adherents of Malvina Hazen pilot more stylized ’Mechs like the Gyrfalcon and Shrike, whereas more moderate warriors prefer the toned-down aesthetics of newer machines like the Jade Phoenix, just as they prefer a toned down version of combat. The Jade Phoenix embodies what it means to be a true Jade Falcon, as did its namesake, the legendary Aidan Pryde.
column2: 新一代猎鹰全能机甲体现了设计理念的分裂，也映照出氏族内部的裂痕。马尔维娜·哈岑的狂热追随者驾驶 Gyrfalcon、Shrike 等风格张扬的机甲；更温和的战士则偏爱 Jade Phoenix 等审美收敛的新机型，也更倾向于克制的战斗方式。Jade Phoenix 体现了真正玉衡鹰战士的含义，正如它的名字来源、传奇人物艾丹·普莱德一样。

column1: The odd variant out, the Archangel C eschews PPCs in favor of two MRM 40s, each of which are fed by a two-ton, CASE-protected ammunition bin. They are supplemented by a pair of ER Medium Lasers and a rear-mounted ER Small Laser. A Guardian ECM Suite protects it from enemy electronics.
column2: Archangel C 是该系列中较为另类的变体，舍弃 PPC，改装两具 MRM-40，每具由一只受 CASE 保护的两吨弹药箱供弹。两门增程中型激光器和一门后置增程小型激光器提供补充火力，守护者 ECM 系统则用于抵御敌方电子设备。

column1: The odd variant out, the Archangel C eschews PPCs in favor of two MRM 40s, each of which are fed by a two-ton, CASE-protected ammunition bin. They are supplemented by a pair of ER 中型激光器 and a rear-mounted ER Small Laser. A Guardian ECM Suite protects it from enemy electronics.
column2: Archangel C是与众不同的变型，放弃PPC，改为两具MRM-40，每具由两吨CASE保护弹药供给。另有两门ER中型激光器和一门后向ER小型激光器提供支援。守护者ECM套件保护它免受敌方电子设备影响。

column1: The only superheavy chassis Clan Widowmaker managed to design on their own, the Atrax is a 175 ton beast in the shape of a four-legged spider. Bringing all the strengths of a QuadMech and a Superheavy together, but at the cost of very limited mobility, the 'Mech was never favoured amongst the warriors of the Widowmaker touman, who only begrudgingly piloted the Superheavy. The strangest trait of the chassis are the four LRM-10 launchers that are constructed as a permanent part of the chassis, one in each knee.
column2: Atrax 是寡妇制造者氏族唯一独立设计的超重型底盘，重 175 吨，外形像一只巨大的四足蜘蛛。它结合了四足机甲与超重型机甲的所有优点，代价是机动性极差，因此从未受到寡妇制造者军团战士青睐，他们只是勉强驾驶这台超重型机甲。它最奇特的特征是四门永久固定在底盘上的 LRM-10 发射器，每个膝部各安装一门。

column1: The origin of this mech is unknown, but all the mech's equipment indicate it's made by the Society. Its codename 'Obsidian Skull' is only known if you have seen this mech before and left alive to continue living.
column2: 这台机甲的来历不明，但所有的装备都表明它是公会制造的。它的代号“黑曜石头骨”只有在您之前见过这个机甲并活着继续生活时才知道。

column1: The original Bane combined with modern Endo-Composite structure and a huge targeting computer. Ouch.
column2: 原始的 Bane 结合了现代 Endo-Composite 结构和巨大的瞄准计算机。哎哟。

column1: The original Bane combined with modern Endo-Composite 结构 and a huge targeting computer. Ouch.
column2: 原版 Bane 结合现代内骨骼复合结构与巨型瞄准计算机，效果令人咋舌。

column1: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. Designed by the Raven Alliance, this variant replaces the standard Fusion Core of the IIC-1 with an XL Engine. An LRM-15 is mounted in each side torso with 3 tons of ammo allocated to the launchers. The IIC-13 is otherwise identical to the IIC-1 with the exception of reduced armor.
column2: 原版战锤设计为突击战斗机甲，但后来被更重、更新的机甲设计取代，尽管它仍是强大的武器平台。氏族明智地保留并改进了这一坚实底盘，打造出真正的突击机甲战锤 IIC。该变体由 Raven Alliance 设计，以 XL 引擎取代 IIC-1 的标准融合核心。两侧躯干各安装一具 LRM-15 发射器，每具分配 3 吨弹药。除此之外，IIC-13 与 IIC-1 相同，只有装甲有所减少。

column1: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. This variant of the IIC 4 replaces five heat sinks and the missile launchers with a Hyper-Assault Gauss Rifle 30 and four tons of ammunition.
column2: 最初的 Warhammer 被设计为突击战斗机甲。不过后来更大型、更重的机甲设计取代了它，但它仍是强大的武器平台。氏族明智地保留并强化了这一可靠底盘，打造出真正的突击机甲 Warhammer IIC。该 IIC 4 改型拆除五具散热器和导弹发射器，换装一具 Hyper-Assault Gauss Rifle 30 及四吨弹药。

column1: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. This variant removes all of the previous weapons. In their place is a pair of arm-mounted Hyper-Assault Gauss Rifle 20s. A pair of Heavy Medium Lasers are mounted on each side of the body, while a Streak SRM-4 is in the head.
column2: 最初的战锤是为突击作战设计的战斗机甲。尽管后来出现了更重、更先进的机甲设计，战锤仍是一款强大的武器平台。氏族明智地保留并强化了这一坚固底盘，打造出真正的突击机甲战锤 IIC。该变体拆除所有原有武器，改在两臂各安装一门 Hyper-Assault Gauss Rifle 20。机体两侧各装有两门重型中型激光器，头部则装有一具连发 SRM-4。

column1: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. This variant switched the previous rocket weapons to a pair of ATM6 and also downgraded the medium pulse laser to ER small lasers.
column2: 原版战锤设计为突击战斗机甲，但后来被更重、更新的机甲设计取代，尽管它仍是强大的武器平台。氏族明智地保留并改进了这一坚实底盘，打造出真正的突击机甲战锤 IIC。该变体将先前的火箭武器换成一对 ATM6，并将中型脉冲激光器降级为增程小型激光器。

column1: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. This version drops the ER PPCs and replaces them with experimental Rotary AC/5s. An XXL Fusion Engine provides enough power for a top speed of 86 km/h. The RACs are backed up by a pair of ER Medium Lasers and ER Small Lasers, and the missile launcher is now an LRM-10. In addition to the Ferro-Fibrous Armor, an ECM Suite in the head disrupts enemy electronics.
column2: 最初的 Warhammer 被设计为突击战斗机甲。后来虽然被更新、更重型的设计取代，仍是强大的武器平台。氏族以这一可靠底盘打造出真正的突击机甲 Warhammer IIC。该型号拆除增程 PPC，换成实验型旋转 AC/5。XXL 聚变引擎使最高速度达到 86 km/h。旋转自动炮由一对增程中型激光和增程小型激光支援，导弹发射器则改为 LRM-10。除铁磁纤维装甲外，头部的 ECM 套件还能干扰敌方电子设备。

column1: The original Warhammer was designed as an assault BattleMech. However, it had been superseded by later and heavier 'Mech designs, though it remained a powerful weapons platform. The Clans wisely maintained and built on this solid frame a real assault 'Mech, the Warhammer IIC. This version uses an XXL Engine to reach top speeds of 86 km/h. Its weapon load hearkens back to the original Warhammer, carrying ER PPCs in the arms and a single ER Medium Laser and ER Small Laser in the left and right torso. An SRM-6 is also carried in the right torso, and an ECM Suite disrupts enemy communications and targeting. This version is protected by Heat-Dissipating Armor.
column2: 最初的战锤是为突击作战设计的战斗机甲。尽管后来出现了更重、更先进的机甲设计，战锤仍是一款强大的武器平台。氏族明智地保留并强化了这一坚固底盘，打造出真正的突击机甲战锤 IIC。该型号采用 XXL 引擎，最高速度可达 86 千米/时。它的武器配置回归原版战锤风格：两臂各装有增程 PPC，左、右躯干分别配备一门增程中型激光器和一门增程小型激光器。右侧躯干还装有一具 SRM-6，ECM 系统则能干扰敌方通信和瞄准设备。机体采用散热装甲保护。

column1: The personal 'Mech of Crucis March Militia deserter-turned-bandit Greta Halperin, her Hellspawn introduced in 3072 had been extensively modified with experimental technologies to turn it into a deadly first strike backstabber.
column2: 个人“十字军三月机甲”由逃兵变身强盗的格蕾塔·哈尔珀林 (Greta Halperin) 于 3072 年推出，她的地狱之卵已通过实验技术进行了广泛修改，使其成为致命的先发制人的背刺者。

column1: The personal 'Mech of Lt. Hannah McQuarters of the 1st Kestrel Grenadiers, all of Gertrude's medium pulse lasers were removed and replaced with eight forward facing ER medium lasers, two in each arm, two in the center torso, and one in both left and right torsos.
column2: 这是第一骑兵掷弹兵团Hannah McQuarters中尉的私人机甲。Gertrude原有的所有中型脉冲激光都被拆除，换成八门面向前方的ER中型激光：每条手臂两门，中央躯干两门，左右躯干各一门。

column1: The personal '机甲 of Crucis March Militia deserter-turned-bandit Greta Halperin, her Hellspawn introduced in 3072 had been extensively modified with experimental technologies to turn it into a deadly first strike backstabber. 怪癖: 改进的 Cooling Jacket - Missile 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 这是 Crucis March 民兵逃兵转为匪徒的 Greta Halperin 的私人机甲。她的 Hellspawn 于 3072 年推出，经过大量实验技术改装，成为致命的先发背刺机甲。 怪癖：改进型冷却夹套 - 导弹 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: The personal '机甲 of David Kalasa, the Founding Khan of 海狐氏族, later renamed to 氏族钻石鲨. He was killed piloting it during Operation KLONDIKE, and while his '机甲 was recovered afterwards it somehow got "misplaced" during transport back from the battlefield. The '机甲 was heavily converted to use Clan tech, being able to convert all the lasers to Extended Range variants and still improve the cooling capabilities. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 这是海狐氏族创始可汗David Kalasa的私人机甲，后来更名为钻石鲨氏族。他在KLONDIKE行动中驾驶此机甲阵亡；机甲随后被回收，却在运回战场途中不知怎的“遗失”。它被大幅改造以使用氏族技术，能够将所有激光器转换为增程型号，同时改善散热能力。 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The personal '机甲 of a Solaris Liao Fanatic, the 'Kun Lun Feng' or 'Kun Lun Wasp' was named for the mythological being in the Mountains of the pilot's ancestral Home. The '机甲 is said to have brought luck to its owner, and when it arrives will pause whatever's currently happening thanks to it's 'swarm of stings', just like the fabled creatures for which it was named 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.06
column2: 这是 Solaris 的廖氏狂热分子的私人战斗机甲。“昆仑风”或“昆仑黄蜂”以飞行员祖居山脉中的神话生物命名。据说这台机甲能给主人带来好运；它抵达战场后会凭借“成群的毒刺”让正在发生的一切暂时停滞，就像传说中的生物一样。 怪癖: 扰乱 掉落成本乘数: 1.06

column1: The personal Battle 装甲 设计 of former General Anori McFaris, member of the Mercenary outfit The Silent Reapers. By using improved stealth 装甲 the unit is much easier concealed, allowing it to sneak up on its foes and unleash its Flamer and Machine Gun at close range. 怪癖: 信息收集者 掉落成本乘数: 0.906 可搭载 Omni units, 可以近战, 可以群聚.
column2: 这是前将军 Anori McFaris 的私人战斗机甲，她是雇佣兵组织The Silent Reapers的成员。通过使用改进型潜行装甲，该单位更容易隐藏，能够悄悄接近敌人并在近距离释放火焰喷射器和机枪。 怪癖: 信息接收器 掉落成本乘数: 0.906 可由 Omni units, 进行战斗, 氏族部队.

column1: The personal BattleMech of Colonel Isolde Centrella of the Magistracy Armed Forces. Chosen especially for its strengths as a command 'Mech for her squad of lighter scouting 'Mechs.
column2: 这是治安军上校Isolde Centrella的私人战斗机甲，专门看中它作为轻型侦察机甲小队指挥机甲的优势。

column1: The personal Battle机甲 of one "Rumia", this unit has been rumored to be able to partially transform itself into a 坦克! The armaments consist of a pair of suspicious-looking MRM40 launchers that someone yanked off of some other '机甲s. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 这是某位“露米娅”的私人战斗机甲，据说能够部分变形成坦克！武器包括两具外形可疑的 MRM40 发射器，似乎是从其他机甲上硬拆下来的。 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂，右下臂

column1: The personal Fafnir of Peter Steiner Davion, equipped with a special 3-Pack RL 20 system in both Arms.
column2: 这是Peter Steiner Davion的私人Fafnir，双臂各装备一套特殊的3联装RL-20系统。

column1: The personal ‘Mech of Leftenant Natasha Ergen of the Fifth FedCom RCT, her stock Griffin had been refitted with ferro-fibrous armor and a light fusion engine. Fourteen double heat sinks and a targeting computer allowed Ergen to obtain maximum effect from an all-energy weapons array consisting of an ER PPC, two standard medium lasers mounted one per side torso alongside three ER medium lasers, one mounted in each torso component.
column2: 这是第五联邦统合军团 Natasha Ergen 中尉的专属机甲。她的原装狮鹫经过改装，换上铁磁纤维装甲和轻型融合引擎。14 具双重散热器和一台瞄准计算机，使 Ergen 能充分发挥全能量武器配置的效果：一门增程 PPC、两门标准中型激光器（左右侧躯干各一门），以及三门增程中型激光器（每个躯干部位各一门）。

column1: The personal ‘Mech of Leftenant Natasha Ergen of the Fifth FedCom RCT, her stock Griffin had been refitted with ferro-fibrous armor and a light fusion engine. Fourteen double heat sinks and a targeting computer allowed Ergen to obtain maximum effect from an all-energy weapons array consisting of an ER PPC, two standard medium lasers mounted one per side torso alongside three ER medium lasers, one mounted in each torso component. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.07
column2: 第五次 FedCom RCT 左翼娜塔莎·埃尔根 (Natasha Ergen) 的个人机甲，她的原配狮鹫已经改装了铁纤维装甲和轻型聚变引擎。十四个双散热器和一台瞄准计算机使埃尔根能够从全能武器阵列中获得最大效果，该阵列由 ER PPC、每侧躯干各安装一个的两个标准中型激光器以及三个 ER 中型激光器（每个躯干组件各安装一个）组成。 Quirk：战斗拳头 掉落成本乘数：1.07

column1: The personal ‘Mech of Leftenant Natasha Ergen of the Fifth FedCom RCT, her stock Griffin had been refitted with 铁纤维装甲 装甲 and a light fusion 引擎. Fourteen double heat sinks and a targeting computer allowed Ergen to obtain maximum effect from an all-energy weapons array consisting of an ER PPC, two standard 中型激光器 mounted one per side torso alongside three ER 中型激光器, one mounted in each torso component.
column2: 这是联邦第五 RCT 中尉 Natasha Ergen 的私人机甲。她的制式 Griffin 改装为铁纤维装甲和轻型聚变引擎；14 具双散热器和瞄准计算机让她充分发挥全能量武器阵列，包括 ER PPC、双侧躯干各一具标准中型激光器及三具 ER 中型激光器。

column1: The personal 设计 of Feng Hu, the mastermind behind the concept of the Tian Xie Zuo, the F configuration is an attempt to turn the Quad into a true vanguard unit. Ten 中型脉冲激光s, a Light PPC and a M9 Gauss Rifle as weapons, while Hardened 铁纤维装甲 装甲 and a torso mounted cockpit makes the '机甲 considerably more durable than the other loadouts. The 设计s major survivability drawback is its XL引擎, which by protruding into the side torsos opens the core up for more chances to get hit. 怪癖: 精准 Weapon - Ballistics 掉落成本乘数: 1.36
column2: F配置属于Tian Xie Zuo概念背后策划者Feng Hu的私人机甲，尝试将这台四足机甲变成真正的先锋单位。它以十门中型脉冲激光、一门轻型PPC和一门M9高斯步枪为武器，强化铁纤维装甲和安装在躯干内的驾驶舱使其比其他配置耐用得多。该机甲最大的生存性缺点是XL引擎：引擎延伸到两侧躯干，暴露核心并增加受击机会。 怪癖: 精准 武器 - 弹道 掉落成本乘数: 1.36

column1: The pirates who got their hands on this Swordsman really took its name seriously. Besides this huge ten-ton blade, it's crammed full of flamers and covered in spikes. They even found room to fit this stolen rotary AC/2.
column2: 拿到这个剑士手上的海贼们，真的是非常看重这个剑士的名字。除了这把重达十吨的巨大刀片之外，它还塞满了火焰喷射器并布满了尖刺。他们甚至找到了空间来放置这台偷来的旋转式 AC/2。

column1: The preferred configuration by Clan Wolf, mounting two Improved Heavy Medium Lasers, twin LRM-10 launchers with 2 tons of ammo and an Extended Range PPC.
column2: 这是 Wolf 氏族最偏爱的配置，装备两门改进型重型中型激光、双联 LRM-10 发射器及两吨弹药，还有一门增程 PPC。

column1: The preferred configuration by Clan Wolf, mounting two Improved Heavy 中型激光s, twin LRM-10 launchers with 2 tons of ammo and an 增程PPC.
column2: 狼氏族偏好的配置，装备两具改进型重型中型激光器、两具 LRM-10 发射器及两吨弹药，并配备一具增程 PPC。

column1: The primary configuration of the Templar is intended to be able to engage an enemy effectively at any range. For effective long range hitting power, the Templar carries a powerful Gauss Rifle. If the Templar does close with an enemy, it can bring its highly accurate Large Pulse Laser, Medium Pulse Laser, and two ER Medium Lasers to bear on a target. For increased accuracy, the Gauss Rifle and all the lasers are linked to an advanced Targeting Computer. The Templar Prime has a Streak SRM-4 launcher for seeking weak points in an enemy's armor.
column2: Templar 的主要配置旨在有效应对任何距离的敌人。远程火力依靠强力高斯步枪；如果敌人逼近，它还能用高精度大型脉冲激光、中型脉冲激光和两门 ER 中型激光还击。为提高精度，高斯步枪和全部激光都连接到高级瞄准计算机。Templar Prime 还配备 Streak SRM-4 发射器，用于寻找敌方装甲弱点。

column1: The primary variant, the Invictus, is armed with an incredibly accurate Retractable Blade for close combat. It also uses a Light PPC and a Snub-Nose PPC that deals more damage as the 'Mech closes with its opponent. The Invictus sports an anti-missile system for further defensive capabilities.
column2: 主力型 Invictus 配备一把精度极高的伸缩刀，用于近距离格斗。它还使用一门轻型 PPC 和一门短鼻 PPC；短鼻 PPC 在机甲接近敌人时威力更强。Invictus 另装有反导系统，进一步增强防御能力。

column1: The primary variant, the Invictus, is armed with an incredibly accurate 可伸缩刀刃 for close combat. It also uses a Light PPC and a 短管PPC that deals more damage as the 'Mech closes with its opponent. The Invictus sports an anti-missile system for further defensive capabilities.
column2: 主要变体“Invictus”配备了极其精确的可伸缩刀刃，适合近距离战斗。它还使用轻型 PPC 和短管 PPC，当“机甲”接近对手时会造成更多伤害。 Invictus 配备反导弹系统，以提高防御能力。

column1: The production Skinwalker removes the controversial triple-strength myomers of its prototype Ryoken III-XP. MechWarriors appreciated the speed boost, but the interface cockpit system made them more hesitant than other Clan MechWarriors to engage in physical combat. This rendered the myomers moot. Like its Stormcrow progenitor, the Skinwalker excels in a cavalry role, bringing heavy firepower to bear with speed and stunning accuracy
column2: 量产型 Skinwalker 移除了原型 Ryoken III-XP 上饱受争议的三重强化肌腱。机甲战士喜欢由此带来的速度提升，但接口驾驶舱系统让他们比其他氏族机甲战士更不愿进行近身战。这使强化肌腱失去了意义。和它的前身 Stormcrow 一样，Skinwalker 擅长骑兵定位，以高速和惊人精度倾泻重火力。

column1: The production version of Arc-Royal MechWorks' GHR-7X prototype, the 7P uses a Torso Mounted Cockpit, Endo Steel and  a Light Fusion Engine, and mounts four Improved Jump Jets. The Type VI Bloodhound Active Probe was also retained. It carries 2 X-Pulse LL, and 3 ER ML.
column2: 这是 Arc-Royal MechWorks GHR-7X 原型机的量产版本。7P 使用躯干式驾驶舱、内骨架和轻型融合引擎，并安装四具改进型跳跃喷射器。它还保留了 VI 型 Bloodhound 主动探测器。武器包括两门 X-Pulse 大型激光器和三门增程中型激光器。

column1: The production version of Arc-Royal MechWorks' GHR-7X prototype, the 7P uses a 躯干挂载 Cockpit, Endo Steel and  a Light Fusion 引擎, and mounts four 改进型跳跃推进器. The Type VI 血猎犬主动探头 was also retained. It carries 2 X-Pulse LL, and 3 ER ML.
column2: 这是 Arc-Royal 机甲工坊 GHR-7X 原型的量产型。7P 使用躯干挂载驾驶舱、内骨骼钢和轻型聚变引擎，安装四具改进型跳跃喷射器，并保留 VI 型血猎犬主动探头。它携带两具 X 脉冲大型激光器和三具 ER 中型激光器。

column1: The prototype Defiance was intended to be the flagship design of venerable Defiance Industries, Described as a ''Warhammer on steroids'', it is visually similar to the original WHM-6R, carries a similar weapons array, and advanced TC
column2: Defiance 原型机旨在成为老牌 Defiance Industries 的旗舰设计，被形容为“打了兴奋剂的战锤”。它在外形上类似原版 WHM-6R，武器配置也与之相近，并配备先进 TC。

column1: The prototype Defiance was intended to be the flagship design of venerable 迪法恩斯工业, Described as a ''Warhammer on steroids'', it is visually similar to the original WHM-6R, carries a similar weapons array, and advanced TC
column2: Defiance 原型机原本是老牌企业的旗舰设计，被形容为“服用类固醇的 Warhammer”。它在外观上类似最初的 WHM-6R，搭载相近的武器阵列以及先进的瞄准计算机。

column1: The quadrupedal Ursa was a jack of all trades often paired alongside the Scourge to perform risky escort duties or to go on heavy recon missions. The Ursa is popular with mercenary units and with those forces fighting along the border between the Lyran Commonwealth and Clan Jade Falcon. Key to the Ursa's design is its revolutionary gyroscope, which renders the 'Mech exceptionally stable - even in comparison to other quad BattleMechs.
column2: 四足熊是一款多面手四足机甲，常与天灾并肩执行危险的护送任务或重型侦察任务。它深受佣兵部队以及在莱兰联邦与 Jade Falcon 氏族边境作战的势力欢迎。四足熊的关键设计是一套革命性陀螺仪，使机甲异常稳定，甚至胜过其他四足战斗机甲。

column1: The quadrupedal Ursa was a jack of all trades often paired alongside the Scourge to perform risky escort duties or to go on heavy recon missions. The Ursa is popular with mercenary units and with those forces fighting along the border between the Lyran Commonwealth and 玉鹰氏族. Key to the Ursa's design is its revolutionary gyroscope, which renders the 'Mech exceptionally stable - even in comparison to other quad BattleMechs.
column2: 四足机甲乌尔萨是一台全能型单位，常与天灾搭档执行危险护航或重型侦察任务。它深受佣兵部队以及在莱拉联邦和翡翠隼氏族边境作战的势力欢迎。乌尔萨设计的关键是革命性陀螺仪，使这台机甲异常稳定，即便与其他四足战斗机甲相比也是如此。

column1: The sales model of the Mad Cat MK II lacks many important Clan upgrades, being equipped with basic Free Inner Sphere technology and downgraded Electronics is it still a capable foe.
column2: Mad Cat MK II 的销售型号缺少许多重要的氏族升级，采用基础的自由内圈技术和降级电子设备，但仍然是一个有能力的敌人。

column1: The scientists of Clan Blood Spirit and Clan Snow Raven worked together to start their ProtoMech programs. The six-meter tall Chrysaor was the first ProtoMech the two clans designed. Chrysaor 2 removes the ER Micro Lasers and replaces them with two Micro Pulse Lasers and five jump jets
column2: 血灵氏族与雪鸦氏族的科学家合作启动 ProtoMech 项目。高六米的 Chrysaor 是两族共同设计的第一种 ProtoMech。Chrysaor 2 拆除增程微型激光，换成两门微型脉冲激光和五具跳跃喷射器。

column1: The scientists of 血灵氏族 and 雪鸦氏族 worked together to start their Proto机甲 programs. The six-meter tall Chrysaor was the first Proto机甲 the two clans 设计ed. Chrysaor 2 removes the ER Micro Lasers and replaces them with two 微型 Pulse Lasers and five jump jets
column2: 血灵氏族与雪鸦氏族的科学家合作启动原型机甲计划。六米高的Chrysaor是两族共同设计的第一台原型机甲。Chrysaor 2移除ER微型激光，换成两门微型脉冲激光和五具跳跃喷射器。

column1: The scientists of 血灵氏族 and 雪鸦氏族 worked together to start their Proto机甲 programs. The six-meter tall Chrysaor was the first Proto机甲 the two clans 设计ed. Combining high speed with ammunition-independent ER Micro Lasers and good 装甲 make the Chrysaor a dangerous foe.
column2: 血灵氏族和雪鸦氏族的科学家合作启动原型机甲项目。六米高的Chrysaor是两族设计的第一台原型机甲。它结合高速、无需弹药的ER微型激光器和良好装甲，成为危险的敌手。

column1: The second 'Mech personally built by Sneede of Cranston Snord's Irregulars, this FrankenMech combines several laser weapons, an ER PPC and an Artemis V-enabled LRM-20. A simple ECM suite provides rudimentary electronic warfare capabilities.
column2: 这是克兰斯顿·斯诺德不规则军团的 Sneede 亲手打造的第二台机甲。这台拼装机甲结合了多种激光武器、一门增程 PPC 和一具配备 Artemis V 制导系统的 LRM-20。简易 ECM 系统提供基础电子战能力。

column1: The second '机甲 personally built by Sneede of Cranston Snord's Irregulars, this Franken机甲 combines several laser weapons, an ER PPC and an Artemis V-enabled LRM-20. A simple ECM suite provides rudimentary electronic warfare capabilities.
column2: 这是克兰斯顿·斯诺德非正规军的斯尼德亲自制造的第二台机甲。弗兰肯机甲结合了数种激光武器、一门ER PPC和一具启用阿耳忒弥斯V的LRM-20。简单的ECM套件提供基础电子战能力。

column1: The second MWO 开发 variant, the Piranha B carries a pair of ER Small Lasers in each arm supported by a pair of Heavy Machine Guns in each side torso and twin ER 中型激光s in the center torso. Built on the same body as the Piranha A, the B variant carries a single ton of heavy machine gun reloads.
column2: 这是第二种来自《机甲战士：在线》的食人鱼变体。食人鱼B双臂各装备一对ER小型激光，左右躯干各装一对重型机枪，中央躯干则装有双联ER中型激光。它沿用了食人鱼A的机体，并携带一吨重型机枪弹药。

column1: The second configuration conceived during the Jihad, this in role of a brawler. The 'Mech receives a Snub-Nose PPC in each arm linked to a Targeting Computer; the 'Mech equipment also includes TAG.
column2: 这是圣战期间构思的第二种配置，定位为近战斗士。机甲双臂各装一门与瞄准计算机连接的短管 PPC，另配 TAG。

The vehicle's is named after Draconis Combine warrior Charles Giggins who died fighting in the Jihad. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 6/9 hexes / 180/270 meters.
