column1: The switch to 双散热器 does wonders, even with more lasers it still runs cooler! It might still overheat if you keep firing them constantly, but at least it takes more than one salvo now.
column2: 换装双重散热器效果惊人，即使激光器更多，机甲运行起来仍然更凉！如果持续射击，仍可能过热，但至少现在要超过一轮齐射才会出问题。

column1: The third variant of the Yen-Lo-Wang, the YLW3 replaces a Gauss rifle, a LRM-20 launcher and a single ER Medium laser - all Clan spec. Further it upgrades the 'Mech to use double heat sinks and light Ferro-Fibrous armor.
column2: 这是 Yen-Lo-Wang 的第三种型号。YLW3 拆除一门氏族规格高斯步枪、一具 LRM-20 发射器和一门增程中型激光，并升级为双重散热器和轻型铁磁纤维装甲。

column1: The third variant of the Yen-Lo-Wang, the YLW3 replaces a Gauss rifle, a LRM-20 launcher and a single ER 中型激光器 - all Clan spec. Further it upgrades the 'Mech to use double heat sinks and 轻型铁纤维装甲-Fibrous 装甲.
column2: Yen-Lo-Wang 的第三种改型 YLW3 移除一门高斯步枪、一具 LRM-20 发射器和一具 ER 中型激光器，全部为氏族规格；同时升级为双散热器，并采用轻型铁纤维装甲。

column1: The third variant produced in 3112, replacing both LB 2-X ACs with two Type 25 Ultra AC/2s, the original engine and Ferro-Fibrous Armor. The variant retains the original's Targeting Computer, while fitted with Gyrfalcon 2's Ferro armor, a Small Cockpit, and carries only 10 Laser Heat Sinks.
column2: 第三个变体于 3112 年生产，用两辆 Type 25 Ultra AC/2、原始发动机和铁纤维装甲取代了两辆 LB 2-X AC。该变体保留了原版的瞄准计算机，同时配备了 Gyrfalcon 2 的铁装甲、小型驾驶舱，并且仅携带 10 个激光散热器。

column1: The third variant produced in 3112, replacing both LB 2-X ACs with two Type 25 Ultra AC/2s, the original 引擎 and 铁纤维装甲 装甲. The variant retains the original's Targeting Computer, while fitted with Gyrfalcon 2's Ferro 装甲, a Small Cockpit, and carries only 10 Laser Heat Sinks.
column2: 第三个变体于3112年生产，用2门Type 25 Ultra AC/2替换两门LB 2-X AC、原装引擎和铁纤维装甲。该变体保留原版的瞄准计算机，采用Gyrfalcon 2的铁质装甲和小型驾驶舱，并仅携带10具激光散热器。

column1: The third variation is based on the original. It mounts an ER Large Laser and a pair of Heavy Medium Lasers. Three additional double heat sinks keep heat in check, while a Targeting Computer aids the accuracy of all three weapons.
column2: 第三种变体以原型为基础，装备一门增程大型激光器和两门重型中型激光器。三组额外双散热器控制热量，目标锁定计算机则提高三件武器的命中精度。

column1: The triple light PPC setup is quite unusual for the Wolfhound size of 'Mech, and the actual performance of this variant on the battlefield has been disputed.
column2: 对 Wolfhound 这么大的机甲来说，三门轻型 PPC 的配置相当不寻常，这一变体在战场上的实际表现也一直存在争议。

column1: The ubiquitous Karnov only became a dedicated infantry transport in the last century. The Republic’s variant uses stealth armor for safer troop insertion. The Karnov (BA Stealth)’s 10-ton carrying capacity is ideal not only for moving Spheroid battle armor and special forces alike, but also for transporting Clan second-line forces. The market potential is incredible, especially with aftersales packages figured in. Biome Restrictions: This unit can not deploy in Lunar biomes. Movement: 11/17 hexes / 330/510 meters. Armor: Vehicle Stealth Armor Structure: Structure Values A S Front 50 15 Left 35 15 Right 35 15 Rear 25 15 Total 160 75 Quirk: Quick Off The Line Can carry 2 Battle Armor Squads.
column2: 无处不在的Karnov直到上世纪才成为专用的步兵运输工具. 共和国的变体使用潜行装甲以实现更安全的部队投放. Karnov (BA Stealth)的10吨载重能力不仅非常适合运送球形战斗装甲和特种部队 ， 也适合运输氏族二线部队. 市场潜力巨大 ， 尤其是考虑到售后套餐. 生物群系限制：该单位无法部署于月球生物群系。 移动：11/17 格 / 330/510 米。 装甲： 载具隐形装甲 结构： 结构 数值 装甲 结构 前部 50 15 左侧 35 15 右侧 35 15 后部 25 15 总计 160 75 特质： 启动迅速 可搭载 2 个战斗装甲小队。

column1: The ultralight OmniMech Celerity was initially ComStar's attempt at creating an expendable drone reconnaissance BattleMech right after the Battle of Tukayyid. After the Fortress Protocols were activated, the Republic of the Sphere began experimenting with the Celerity as a means of expanding its military technology. They created a true OmniMech version of the Celerity to expand upon its utility and used it extensively on raids across their borders in the Dark Age era, causing endless confusion as to the identity of the parties using them.
column2: 轻量级全能机甲 Celerity 最初是 ComStar 在图卡伊德战役后尝试制造的一次性无人侦察战斗机甲。堡垒协议启动后，球体共和国开始试验 Celerity，希望借此扩展自身军事技术。他们制造了真正的 Celerity 全能机甲版本，进一步发挥其用途，并在黑暗时代大规模用于边境袭扰，令外界始终无法确定究竟是哪一方在使用它们。

column1: The variant produced by the 布雷克圣言会 replaces the PPC with a 短管PPC. To supplement close-range combat, the -14S carries a pair of 火箭发射器 10s. The Endo Steel chassis supports enough 改进型跳跃推进器 to vault the Panther up to 180 米 at a time. Thirteen heat sinks keeps heat in check, made possible by the inclusion of a 小型驾驶舱.
column2: 星盟制造的这个变体用一门短管PPC替换了原有PPC。为加强近距离作战，-14S携带一对SRM-10发射器。内骨骼结构支撑足够的改进型跳跃喷射器，使猎豹一次可跃过180米。十三组散热器控制热量，驾驶舱改装也为此提供了帮助。

column1: The years following the Truce of Tukayyid saw an unprecedented era of close cooperation between the Federated Commonwealth and the Draconis Combine. Having contributed greatly to the Mauler's fame, the AFFC received many more through trade agreements. House Davion has a lasting fascination with autocannons, and invested heavily in advancing their technology in the 3050s, using the Mauler as one of its testbeds.
column2: Tukayyid 停战后的岁月见证了联邦国与龙马联邦之间前所未有的密切合作。AFFC 通过贸易协议获得了更多 Mauler，这对其声名远扬功不可没。达维翁家族一直痴迷于自动火炮，并在 3050 年代投入大量资源推进相关技术，把 Mauler 当作测试平台之一。

column1: The 休伦战士 RX4 carries a 银弹高斯 Rifle and a 大型X脉冲激光 Laser. Protected by ten tons of Reactive 装甲, it is also equipped with a Supercharger that allows it to reach sprint speeds of 100 km/h. The '机甲 was originally refit for Republic Legate Dean Singer, but was stolen by a minor criminal.
column2: 休伦战士 RX4 携带银弹高斯步枪和大型 X 脉冲激光器。十吨反应装甲提供防护，增压器使其冲刺速度达到 100 km/h。该机甲原本为共和国执政官 Dean Singer 改装，后来被一名小罪犯盗走。

column1: The 凤鹰 L is a light BattleMech, produced originally for the Draconis Combine at the dawn of the thirty-second century. It was modeled to resemble Crosby's old and remodeled 凤鹰, which they had first produced in the 3060s, and was their BattleMechs Research Firm's bid to offer a replacement to the venerable Panther after the Second Combine-Dominion War. Alternately known as the Fenikkusu Taka, the 凤鹰 L retains the movement profile of its heavier predecessor.
column2: 凤鹰 L 是一台轻型战斗机甲，于 32 世纪初最初为龙马联邦生产。它仿照 Crosby 的老式改装凤鹰，后者于 3060 年代首次生产；该机型是其战斗机甲研究机构为在第二次联邦-自治领战争后替代老牌 Panther 提出的方案。它也被称为 Fenikkusu Taka，并保留了更重前代的移动特征。

column1: The 大型脉冲激光, 中型脉冲激光, and two ER 中型激光s give the White Flame WHF-3B an all-energy configuration for its offensive weaponry. This gives it the ability to operate far from supply for extended periods, but the damage rate is rather low when compared to other '机甲s of a similar size. Its strength is undoubtedly its speed, which it can use to harass enemies and keep from taking too many hits. The -3B is as protected by its jump jets that can propel it up to 150 米 as by its fifteen tons of 装甲. A C3i Computer allows it to share targeting telemetry with other similarly equipped units. 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - Medium 掉落成本乘数: 1.1
column2: White Flame WHF-3B 采用大型脉冲激光、中型脉冲激光和两门增程中型激光组成的全能量武器配置，可长期远离补给作战，但伤害率低于同吨位机甲。它的优势是速度，能够骚扰敌人并减少受击。 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - Medium 掉落成本乘数: 1.1

column1: The 布雷克圣言会 introduced an advanced Zhukov equipped with an 改进的 C3 Computer, a pair of Large 变速脉冲激光s, and a single MML-7. Additional 装甲 and CASE protects the 坦克 crew from ammunition explosions. To make room for all these changes this version is equipped with an XL引擎. In 3030, Aldis Industries deployed the successful follow up to its venerable Demolisher 设计, the slightly lighter Zhukov. While it shares many of the parts and features of the 设计 that inspired it, the Zhukov is smaller, better 装甲ed, and packs less weaponry than its predecessor. Its first major deployment was with the Wolf's Dragoons whereupon the Zhukov has since seen constant improvements and tweaks as suggested to Aldis Industries by the field units that use it. The Zhukov's strength is its relative simplicity. Two turret mounted SarLon MaxiCannon Autocannon/10s are more than adequate at providing sufficient firepower for the discriminating buyer while imitating its larger cousin the Demolisher. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 4/6 格 / 120/180 米. 装甲: 重型铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 290 40 左侧 185 40 右侧 185 40 后方 120 40 炮塔 240 40 总计 1020 200 怪癖: 主战坦克
column2: 布雷克圣言会推出了一款先进的祖科夫坦克，配备改进型 C3 计算机、一对大型变速脉冲激光器和一具 MML-7。额外装甲与 CASE 系统可保护乘员免受弹药爆炸伤害。为了容纳这些改进，该型号配备了 XL 引擎。3030 年，奥尔迪斯工业公司推出了其经典毁灭者设计的后继车型，即更轻的祖科夫。祖科夫沿用了原设计的许多部件和特性，但车体更小、装甲更厚、武器更少。它首次大规模部署于狼之龙骑兵部队，此后奥尔迪斯工业公司不断根据一线部队的建议改进和调整祖科夫。祖科夫的优势在于结构相对简单。炮塔上的两门 SarLon MaxiCannon 自动加农炮/10 足以为挑剔的买家提供充足火力，同时保留了大型毁灭者的风格。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：4/6 格 / 120/180 米。 装甲： 重型铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 290 40 左侧 185 40 右侧 185 40 后方 120 40 炮塔 240 40 总计 1020 200 怪癖：主战坦克

column1: The 布雷克圣言会's Bolla Stealth Tank was 设计ed during the early part of the Jihad as part of the Serpentus Series of OmniVehicles. column1: The 黑骑士 6B was the harder-hitting, cooler-running Star League ancestor to the standard BL-6-KNT we have today. It did everything the 6 does, but better. Mostly thanks to its 双散热器.
column2: 黑骑士6B是如今标准BL-6-KNT的前身，也是火力更强、散热更好的星盟时代祖型号。它完成6型能做的一切，而且更好，主要得益于双重散热器。

column1: There is one major flaw here. Cooling. The cockpit will quickly turn into a sauna if you keep firing all weapons, so you better bring your towel.
column2: 这里有一个主要缺陷：散热。如果持续开火，驾驶舱很快会变成桑拿房，所以最好带上毛巾。

column1: There's a reason the Bane has been around for so long, they just keep re-innovating it. This new variant makes it even more powerful, stay clear of it unless it is on your side.
column2: Bane 能服役这么久是有原因的：它一直在不断革新。这一新变体让它更加强大，除非它站在你这边，否则最好离它远点。

column1: There's not really much special going on here, Boss. Sure, it's an Excalibur. And sure, it's got some Star League stuff in it, but it's just a 'Mech. The cockpit does look a little cramped, I suppose — as if it was made for somebody smaller than usual.
column2: 这里没什么特别的，老大。当然，它是 Excalibur，也确实装了些星盟设备，但终究只是一台机甲。驾驶舱看起来有点拥挤，仿佛是为比常人更小的驾驶员制造的。

column1: These Pirates. They always find new ways to amaze me. In that is not in a positive sense, Boss. What the blazes is this thing??
column2: 这些海盗总能找到新方法让我大开眼界——当然是负面的，Boss。这到底是什么鬼东西？？

column1: They weren't kidding about welding every spare scrap of metal on this thing. I can fix it up as is, but there's almost nothing I can swap out without compromising the structure.
column2: 他们说把所有能找到的废金属都焊到这东西上，看来一点也没夸张。我可以按现状把它修好，但几乎没有任何部件能在不破坏结构的情况下更换。

column1: This 'Black Marauder' was found abandoned on the Asteroid LV-426, composed of extremely advanced Materials does it sport unique Weaponry and a unnerving capacity for Self Repair...
column2: 这艘“黑色掠夺者”被发现遗弃在小行星 LV-426 上，由极其先进的材料组成，它是否拥有独特的武器和令人不安的自我修复能力……

column1: This 'Commando' was found in a Deep Periphery Weapons Cache, named after the Furies of Terran Mythology, it packs a surprisingly mean punch for it's size.
column2: 这台“突击队”是在边疆深处的武器库中发现的。它以泰拉神话中的复仇女神命名，以这样的体型而言，火力强得出人意料。

column1: This 'Mech has some speed on her, Boss. Just as well, too - all these weapons are a helluva lot shorter range than the usual LRMs these things carry. 12 SRMs, 3 medium lasers, and 3 smalls should be enough to put the hurt on most things around the same weight class.
column2: 这个机甲的速度比她快，老大。同样，所有这些武器的射程都比这些东西携带的普通 LRM 短得多。 12 个 SRM、3 个中型激光和 3 个小型激光应该足以对相同重量级别的大多数物体造成伤害。

column1: This 'Mech has some speed on her, Boss. Just as well, too - all these weapons are a helluva lot shorter range than the usual LRMs these things carry. 12 SRMs, 3 中型激光器, and 3 smalls should be enough to put the hurt on most things around the same weight class.
column2: 这台机甲速度不错，老板。这样正好——它搭载的所有武器射程都比通常配备的 LRM 短得多。12 具 SRM、3 具中型激光器和 3 具小型激光器，足以重创大多数同吨位目标。

column1: This 'Mech is old, boss. Like, seriously old. We're talking early - or maybe even before - Star League. Somebody's given this baby a lot of love over the years, although I definitely question some of the decisions. The targeting system especially seems a bit of a hack job.
column2: 这个机甲是 old，老大。就像，严重老了。我们很早就在谈论——甚至可能更早——《星际联赛》。多年来，有人给予了这个孩子很多爱，尽管我确实质疑其中的一些决定。尤其是瞄准系统似乎有点像黑客工作。

column1: This 'Mech is about as duelist as they come, Boss. Sure, the configuration isn't what they might call "optimised" over on Solaris, but this thing'll still strip your armour and rinse out your internals.
column2: 这个机甲几乎是他们中的决斗者，老大。当然，配置并不是他们所说的在 Solaris 上“优化”的，但是这个东西仍然会剥去你的盔甲并冲洗你的内部结构。

column1: This 'Mech is pretty storied, Boss. Black box says she served in BULLDOG and god knows what else afterwards. There's a kill-count scratched into the console here. Sixteen. The last couple look pretty fresh.
column2: 这台机甲的经历相当传奇，老大。黑匣子显示它曾在 BULLDOG 服役，之后还干过天知道多少事情。这里的控制台上刻着击杀数：十六。最后几笔看起来还很新。

column1: This 'Mech seems to have an old fashioned phone booth mounted in the cockpit that says "Phone Home".
column2: 这台机甲的驾驶舱里似乎装着一间老式电话亭，上面写着“打电话回家”。

column1: This 'Mech was made for punching, and thats just what it'll do, and one of these days, it's gonna be punching you....
column2: 这台机甲就是为了挥拳而生，而它也确实只会做这一件事；总有一天，它的拳头会落到你身上……

column1: This 'Panther' has all kinds of weird scribbles on it. They seem to be praising something called 'The Book of the Dead' and 'Naturom Demonto.' I just have to assume whatever idiot got their hands on it was stuck in some Cabin too long.
column2: 这台“猎豹”上到处都是奇怪的潦草字迹，似乎在赞美某种叫作《亡灵之书》和“Naturom Demonto”的东西。我只能假设，拿到它的那个白痴在某间小屋里待得太久了。

column1: This 'was' a K2 Catapult, but somehow they screwed Rifleman parts into the Arms and made it a Ballistic Carrier....
column2: 它“曾经”是一台 K2 Catapult，但不知怎么的，他们把 Rifleman 部件硬塞进手臂，把它改成了弹道武器载体……

column1: This 2721 SLDF variant replaces the short range missile launcher and CASE for a pair of forward-firing Medium Lasers and two extra heat sinks. Side firing Medium Lasers are fitted in the forward arch. However, this leaves the vehicles' other flanks unarmed, with the exception of the turret mounted Gauss Rifle. It should be noted that it was rarely deployed except in defensive positions. The Demon was originally created by the SLDF as its standard fighting vehicle in 2716. A match for any light or medium BattleMech, the Demon had good maneuverability and was protected by ten tons of slab armor, most of it concentrated in its front. Due to the nature of its powerful main weapon the Demon was often used in ambush attacks and fought in pairs instead of the usual four-vehicle lance. The vehicle's main disadvantage was its lack of speed, which made it vulnerable to faster 'Mechs and other vehicles able to maneuver around and engage its weaker rear armor. Biome Restrictions: None. column2: 这台Crab经过如此彻底的改装，以至于原始编号已经毫无意义。它唯一的称呼来自驾驶员的血名“Hallis”；这台古老战争机器还携带着氏族武器技术的早期样本。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: This Talos 1B bears an eclectic mixture of technologies spanning from the days of the Star League all through to the end of the 氏族入侵. In fact, it's quite possible that the very same equipment that saw the SLDF leave also saw them return in the form of the Clans. 特性：易于驾驶 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: 这台Talos 1B融合了从星盟时代一直延续到圣战末期的多种技术。事实上，很可能正是 SLDF 撤离时使用的设备，后来以氏族形式随他们重新归来。 特性：易于驾驶 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower

column1: This was a Thunderbolt 5S until some pirates got their hands on it. All the weapons have been sort of welded into spikes, resulting in a loadout that's much closer ranged, and much hotter.
column2: 曾是一台 Thunderbolt 5S，后来落入海盗手中。所有武器都被胡乱焊成尖刺，导致其配置更偏向近距离作战，而且热量更高。

column1: This was a 雷电5S until some pirates got their hands on it. All the weapons have been sort of welded into spikes, resulting in a loadout that's much closer ranged, and much hotter.
column2: 这台雷电5S机甲原本状态良好，直到落入海盗手中。所有武器都被粗暴地焊成尖刺，导致武器配置射程更近、发热更高。

column1: This Archer variant, based on the 9K, was introduced during the Dark Ages. It retained the four MML-5 launchers and two of the three Light PPCs of the earlier design, but replaced the third Light PPC and C3 Slave with a C3 Boosted Slave and an ER medium laser.
column2: 这款 Archer 变体以 9K 为基础，于黑暗时代推出。它保留了四具 MML-5 发射器和原设计三门轻型 PPC 中的两门，但将第三门轻型 PPC 与 C3 从属单元替换为 C3 增强型从属单元和一门增程中型激光器。

column1: This Archer variant, based on the 9K, was introduced during the Dark Ages. It retained the four MML-5 launchers and two of the three Light PPCs of the earlier design, but replaced the third Light PPC and C3 Slave with a C3 Boosted Slave and an ER 中型激光器.
column2: 这款基于 9K 的 Archer 改型于黑暗时代推出。它保留四具 MML-5 发射器和早期设计的三具轻型 PPC 中的两具，但用 C3 增强从属单元和一具 ER 中型激光器替换第三具轻型 PPC 及 C3 从属单元。

column1: This Argus variant, introduced in 3074, is equipped with a then-experimental C3 Boosted Slave to cut through Jihad-era ECM. The weapons load has been tweaked as well, with an MML-7 replacing the LRM-10. The Machine Guns of the original have also been removed.
column2: 该 Argus 型号于 3074 年推出，配备当时仍属实验性质的 C3 增强从属单元，用来穿透圣战时代的 ECM。武器配置也经过调整，以 MML-7 替换 LRM-10，并移除了原型的机枪。

column1: This Bombard variant uses engines and Compact Heat Sinks originally intended for the HNT-181 Hornet. It also carries Light Gauss Rifles and a Chameleon Light Polarization Shield.
column2: 这个 Bombard 变体使用原本为 HNT-181 Hornet 准备的引擎和紧凑型散热器。它还配备轻型高斯步枪与变色龙轻型极化护盾。

column1: This Bombard variant uses engines and 紧凑型散热器s originally intended for the HNT-181 Hornet. It also carries 轻型高斯步枪s and a 变色龙光极化护盾.
column2: 这台轰炸型使用原本为HNT-181黄蜂设计的引擎和散热器。它还携带重型高斯步枪和一套彩虹光谱干扰系统。

column1: This Chimera variant introduced in 3069, carries a C3 Slave unit and replaces the standard weaponry with a 短管PPC, Small Laser, 小型脉冲激光, and a quartet of 中型激光s. It also carries a Sword in the right arm, and uses 三重肌纤维束 to maximize damage. It's also equipped with a larger XL引擎 that permits a cruising ground speed of 76 km/h. When the 三重肌纤维束 activates, it reaches a maximum ground speed of 120 km/h. The 2K also has a 210 meter jump range.
column2: 该 Chimera 改型于 3069 年推出，携带 C3 从属单元，并将标准武器换成短管 PPC、小型激光器、小型脉冲激光器和四具中型激光器。右臂安装长剑，并使用三倍肌纤维束最大化伤害。更大的 XL 引擎使巡航速度达到 76 km/h；三倍肌纤维束启动后最高速度可达 120 km/h。2K 还拥有 210 米跳跃范围。

column1: This Commando is built like a cockroach. While it doesn't have much in the way of advanced tech, it's got as much armor as Quicsell could conceivably shove on there, and then some more litterally glued on top of that. Oh, and get this: to keep those lasers cool without cooking the pilot, the extra-large internal combustion engine is hardwired into the frame. I guess you could turn it into a decent energy boat, but don't expect it to ever move all that fast.
column2: 这个突击队的体型就像蟑螂一样。虽然它没有太多先进技术，但它拥有奎塞尔可以想象到的尽可能多的装甲，然后在上面粘了一些更多的东西。哦，还有这个：为了保持这些激光器冷却而不把飞行员煮熟，超大型内燃机被硬连线到框架中。我想你可以把它变成一艘像样的能量船，但不要指望它能移动得那么快。

column1: This Commando is built like a cockroach. While it doesn't have much in the way of advanced tech, it's got as much 装甲 as Quicsell could conceivably shove on there, and then some more litterally glued on top of that. Oh, and get this: to keep those lasers cool without cooking the pilot, the extra-large internal combustion 引擎 is hardwired into the frame. I guess you could turn it into a decent energy boat, but don't expect it to ever move all that fast.
column2: 这台Commando像蟑螂一样结实。它没有多少先进技术，却装上了Quicsell能想办法塞进去的全部装甲，甚至还在上面硬粘了更多装甲。还有一点：为了让激光保持冷却、不把驾驶员烤熟，那台超大型内燃机被直接接入了机体框架。你或许能把它改成一台不错的能量武器平台，但别指望它跑得多快。

column1: This Configuration of the Nova, in the Wakes of the War of Reaving, has been Equipped With Mortars. Even Though Clan Honor Shames Non-Direct Combat, The Steel Vipers used 机甲s like this to still Put up a Fight against Impossible Odds. Not Much is Known if this was a Personal Refit of a Important Viper Warrior, or a Prototype of their Science Caste. If the Name of the 机甲 is Taken into Consideration, It was Probably a Scientists Pet Project, though How he Managed to Gain all of the Resources For this is Questionable.
column2: 这款Nova配置在掠夺战争余波中加装了迫击炮。尽管氏族荣誉鄙视非直接战斗，钢蛇氏族仍使用这类机甲在绝境中奋战。没人知道它是某位重要钢蛇战士的个人改装，还是科学阶层的原型机。若考虑其名称，它很可能是某位科学家的个人项目，但他如何获得全部资源仍是疑问。

column1: This Conjurer variant uses an XL Engine to achieve the same speed as the original, but saves weight for added components. A short-range powerhouse, the 设计ers included four Heavy 中型激光s that max out the fourteen double heat sinks. Despite that, they also included a 中型脉冲激光 and two 锁定式SRM-6s to aid to hunting battle 装甲. For work against conventional infantry, it includes two 轻型 Machine Guns. A 定位 Computer improves the accuracy of the lasers. 怪癖: 延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: 左侧 Lower
column2: 该Conjurer改型使用XL引擎以达到与原型相同的速度，同时节省重量安装其他部件。设计师加入四门重型中型激光，使其成为短程火力强者，并将十四枚双重散热器推至极限。除此之外，它还配备一门中型脉冲激光和两具锁定式SRM-6，用于猎杀战斗装甲；对付常规步兵则有两挺轻型机枪。定位计算机提高激光精度。 怪癖：延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左侧下臂

column1: This Conjurer variant uses an XL引擎 to achieve the same speed as the original, but saves weight for added components. column2: 这一Conjurer变型采用XL引擎，在保持原版速度的同时为额外部件腾出重量。设计师加入四门重型中型激光器，几乎耗尽14组双重散热器，使其成为近距离火力强者。此外还配备一门中型脉冲激光器和两具锁定式SRM-6，用于猎杀战斗装甲；对付普通步兵时则使用两挺轻型机枪。瞄准计算机提高激光器精度。

column1: This Cronus variant was apparently built for the Word of Blake in 3072. It carries an Improved C3 Computer, Targeting Computer and Guardian ECM Suite. The Guardian ECM powers the Stealth Armor. The Cronus-TD9 is equipped with three Small Variable Speed Pulse Lasers, and each hand has been replaced by a Claw. A MASC system allows the Cronus to reach 120 km/h for short bursts.
column2: 这款 Cronus 变体似乎是圣言之子于 3072 年打造的。它配备改进型 C3 计算机、瞄准计算机和守护者 ECM 系统，后者为隐形装甲提供能量。Cronus-TD9 装备三门小型可变速脉冲激光器，双手也被利爪取代。MASC 系统可令 Cronus 短时间冲刺至 120 千米/时。

column1: This Cronus variant was apparently built for the 布雷克圣言会 in 3072. It carries an 改进的 C3 Computer, 定位 Computer and 守护者ECM Suite. The 守护者ECM powers the Stealth 装甲. The Cronus-TD9 is equipped with three Small 变速脉冲激光s, and each hand has been replaced by a Claw. A MASC system allows the Cronus to reach 120 km/h for short bursts.
column2: 该 Cronus 改型据称为布雷克圣言会于 3072 年制造，配备改进型 C3 计算机、瞄准计算机和守护者 ECM 套件。守护者 ECM 为潜行装甲供能。Cronus-TD9 装备三具小型可变脉冲激光器，双手替换为利爪；MASC 系统让它能短时间达到 120 km/h。

column1: This Dark Age configuration carries a TSEMP Cannon, two Streak SRM-4s, and two Medium X-Pulse Lasers. A Beagle Active Probe is carried in the center torso, while a MASC system allows it to briefly reach speeds of 120 km/h.
column2: 这套黑暗时代配置携带一门TSEMP炮、两具Streak SRM-4和两门中型X脉冲激光。中央躯干装有比格犬主动探头，MASC系统则能让它短时间达到120公里/小时。

column1: This Dark Age era configuration carries a pair of Clan-spec ER PPC and an LB 10-X autocannon. These are supported by four Medium Re-engineered Lasers.
column2: 这套黑暗时代配置携带两门氏族规格的增程 PPC 和一门 LB 10-X 自动火炮，另有四门中型重构激光器提供支援。

column1: This Dark Age era variant carries two "King David" Light Gauss Rifles and is equipped with a Battle Armor Mechanical Jump Booster. It is protected by Improved Stealth armor.
column2: 该黑暗时代型号携带两门‘King David’轻型高斯步枪，并配备战斗装甲机械跳跃助推器。它由改进型隐形装甲保护。

column1: This Dark Age era variant carries two "King David" 轻型高斯步枪s and is equipped with a Battle 装甲 机甲anical 跳跃放大器. It is protected by 改进的 Stealth 装甲.
column2: 这个黑暗时代变体装备两门“King David”重型高斯步枪，并配备战斗装甲机械跳跃系统。它由改进型隐形装甲保护。

column1: This Dark Age variant is a direct fire support model introduced by the 球体共和国 in 3125. It carries a light PPC and light AC/2 in each arm; a small cockpit was needed to fit this equipment in place. It is protected by seven and a half tons of reactive 装甲. 怪癖: 模块化武器 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 该黑暗时代改型是联邦共和国于 3125 年推出的直射火力支援型号。双臂各装备一具轻型 PPC 和轻型 AC/2，为容纳设备而采用小型驾驶舱。七吨半反应装甲为其提供防护。 怪癖: 模块化武器 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: This Dark Age version of the 黑骑士 uses a 轻型引擎 to reach a top speed of 54 km/h. It also has an advanced Endo-Composite skeleton protected by thirteen and a half tons of 装甲. Seventeen Clan-spec double heat sinks keep heat load under control. The right arm carries a Medium Shield, and it has an advanced 定位 Computer. Its weaponry is all Clan-spec. An ER PPC, two ER Large Lasers, two ER 中型激光s, two ER Small Lasers and twin 小型脉冲激光s arm the 黑骑士.
column2: 这个黑暗时代版本的武士使用一台超级充能器，最高速度达到54公里/小时。先进的内骨骼复合结构由十三吨半装甲保护。十七组星盟规格双散热器控制热负荷。右臂携带一面中型盾牌，机体还配备先进的瞄准计算机。所有武器均为星盟规格：一门ER PPC、两门ER大型激光、两门ER中型激光、两门ER小型激光，以及双联中型脉冲激光。

column1: This Dark Age-era variant was created by the Capellan Confederation. It uses a light fusion 引擎 to reduce vulnerability to 引擎 destruction, and carries a Gauss Rifle in each arm. These are supported by a single torso mounted ER PPC. A 守护者ECM Suite powers the Stealth 装甲 that encases this 设计. It retains the ability to jump 90 米 at a time.
column2: 这是黑暗时代的变体，由坎培拉联盟制造。它采用轻型聚变引擎，以降低遭受引擎毁坏的风险；双臂各装备一门高斯步枪，躯干上还安装了一门ER PPC作为支援。内置的隐形装甲由一套ECM套件驱动，覆盖并保护整台机甲。它仍保留一次跳跃90米的能力。

column1: This Draconis Combine variant of the Thug 12E, introduced in 3067; replaces the C3i with a C3 Slave and a Guardian ECM Suite.
column2: 这是 Thug 12E 的龙蛇联合王国型号，于 3067 年推出；它以 C3 从属单元和 Guardian ECM 套件替换了 C3i。

column1: This Draconis Combine variant of the Thug 12E, introduced in 3067; replaces the C3i with a C3 Slave and a 守护者ECM Suite.
column2: 这是3067年推出的龙马联盟Thug 12E变型，用C3从属单元和守护者ECM套件替换C3i。

column1: This Dragon 'P' is in pretty good condition for a pirate 'Mech, but all its weapons have been replaced with Incendiary variants and it's covered in all kinds of unicorn graffiti. A real joker owned this.
column2: 这台 Dragon P 作为海盗机甲状态相当不错，但所有武器都被换成了燃烧型变体，机身还画满各种独角兽涂鸦。它的前主人绝对是个爱开玩笑的家伙。

column1: This Dragon 'P' is in pretty good condition for a pirate '机甲, but all its weapons have been replaced with Incendiary variants and it's covered in all kinds of unicorn graffiti. A real joker owned this.
column2: 这台Dragon“P”作为海盗机甲，状态相当不错，但所有武器都被替换成燃烧型变体，机身还涂满了各种独角兽涂鸦。它曾被一个真正的怪人拥有。

column1: This Falconer found itself in a World of Pain boss. Extremely Rare Clantech, mixed with Inner Sphere Technology makes this a Walking Nightmare, for me. 2 Clan Gauss Rifles and 1 Large X Pulse Laser give it a Long Range Armament, while the 4 Torso mounted Medium Xpulse Lasers give it Short range Capabilities. The Engine is Still a XL but at a considerably lower Rating while 14 Clan Double Heatsinks also make it nearly Sweat as much. It even has a Very Sweet Ewar Package, i have to say.
column2: 老大，这台 Falconer 让自己陷入了无尽痛苦。极其罕见的氏族技术与内圈科技混合在一起，对我来说就是一场行走的噩梦。两门氏族高斯步枪和一门大型 X 脉冲激光构成远程武器，四门安装在躯干的中型 X 脉冲激光则负责近距离。引擎仍是 XL，但等级低了很多；14 具氏族双重散热器让它几乎不会过热。它甚至拥有相当不错的电子战套件，我得承认。

Extremely Rare Clantech, mixed with Inner Sphere Technology makes this a Walking Nightmare, for me. 2 Clan Gauss Rifles and 1 Large X Pulse Laser give it a 长 Range Armament, while the 4 Torso mounted Medium Xpulse Lasers give it 短 range Capabilities. The 引擎 is Still a XL but at a considerably lower Rating while 14 Clan Double Heatsinks also make it nearly Sweat as much. It even has a Very Sweet Ewar Package, i have to say.
column2: 这台 Falconer 曾陷入一场痛苦的首领战。极其罕见的氏族科技与内圈技术混合在一起，造就了我的行走噩梦。两具氏族高斯步枪和一具大型 X 脉冲激光器提供远程火力，四具安装在躯干上的中型 X 脉冲激光器则负责近距离作战。引擎仍是 XL 型号，但额定功率大幅降低；14 具氏族双散热器也让它几乎不会过热。不得不说，它还配备了非常出色的电子战套件。

column1: This Fireball unique variant built in 3077 was equipped with a 320 XXL Engine, MASC, and Supercharger. This combination of speed systems gives it a consistent running speed of 240 km/h, with bursts of up to 400 km/h possible. This Fireball has a pair of ER Small Lasers as its only weapons and a mere three and a half tons of Ferro-Fibrous armor protect it. Despite these limitations, and the fragile XL Gyro, the owner (noted as a criminal) didn't see this as a problem. The Fireball-XF (which stands for `Extra Fast`) is used only in illegal street races.
column2: 这台于 3077 年制造的 Fireball 独特型号配备 320 级 XXL 引擎、MASC 和增压器。这套速度系统让它稳定奔跑速度达到 240 km/h，短时间爆发最高可达 400 km/h。该 Fireball 唯一武器是一对增程小型激光，仅有 3.5 吨铁磁纤维装甲提供防护。尽管存在这些限制和脆弱的 XL 陀螺仪，所有者（记录为罪犯）并不在意。Fireball-XF（意为“Extra Fast”）只用于非法街头竞速。

column1: This Flashman was Upgraded with Special Electronics to make the 4 Plasma Rifles even more Potent. The Heat it dishes out is enormous, and if someone thinks they can get close, those Micro Lasers will hurt a Lot. 2 AMS make sure it doesnt get any Missiles close to it, while the Probe and ECM give it a good Defense. Oh and, the Cooling System on this Thing is Quite something to look at.
column2: 这台 Flashman 通过特殊电子设备升级，使四门等离子步枪的威力更强。它释放的热量极其惊人，任何试图靠近的人都会被微型激光器狠狠教训。两套 AMS 确保导弹无法接近，探测器和 ECM 则提供良好防御。哦，这东西的冷却系统也相当值得一看。

column1: This Free Worlds League variant upgrades the autocannon to an 超级自动炮/10 and the laser to an ER Small Laser. This is all made possible by the upgrade to five tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲 and the removal of the eleventh heat sink. While the ultra-class autocannon provides superior firepower, it can also eat through the single ton of ammunition at an alarming rate.
column2: 这一自由世界联盟变型将自动炮升级为超级自动炮/10，将激光器升级为ER小型激光器。它通过增加至5吨铁纤维装甲并拆除第11组散热器实现升级。超级自动炮能提供更强火力，但也会以惊人速度耗尽唯一一吨弹药。

column1: This Galahad looks Pretty alright Boss. Mixed Tech, but thats just how it Goes nowadays. The 2 UAC10's Provide the Mainstay of this Mech, the Pulse Laser and SRM6 provide additional Firepower. The Sensors are a Good Package all together, While the Targeting Systems got special attention aswell. The XL Engine was Increased in Rating, meaning this Mech will move Fast. Both Arms have Additional Armour Plates too, meaning those Weapons are all nice and Protected.
column2: 老大，这台 Galahad 看起来还不错。混合技术，不过现在也就这样了。两门 UAC/10 是主力武器，脉冲激光器和 SRM-6 提供额外火力。传感器套件整体不错，瞄准系统也经过特别强化。XL 引擎提高了额定功率，所以机甲速度很快。两条手臂还加装了装甲板，让武器得到良好保护。

column1: This Galahad looks Pretty alright Boss. Mixed Tech, but thats just how it Goes nowadays. The 2 UAC10's Provide the Mainstay of this 机甲, the Pulse Laser and SRM6 provide additional Firepower. The Sensors are a Good Package all together, While the 定位 Systems got special attention aswell. The XL引擎 was Increased in Rating, meaning this 机甲 will move Fast. Both Arms have Additional Armour Plates too, meaning those Weapons are all nice and Protected.
column2: 这台 Galahad 看起来相当不错，老板。如今混合技术已经司空见惯。两门 UAC/10 是这台机甲的主力武器，脉冲激光器和 SRM-6 提供额外火力。传感器整合得很好，瞄准系统也经过特别强化。XL 引擎的额定功率得到提升，因此这台机甲移动很快。双臂还增加了装甲板，让武器得到充分保护。

column1: This Grand Titan is based on a field refit. It carries a Heavy PPC, two ER 中型激光s, a single ER Large Laser, two 中型激光s, and a 小型脉冲激光 for anti-infantry work. For close combat it carries a Sword. It also has a 90 meter jump radius. A Heavy Duty Gyro has been 装甲ed, as has the cockpit and all the arm and leg actuators. At the same time, this Grand Titan is equipped with 三重肌纤维束 which allows it to inflict twice as much damage in a physical brawl, as well as reach speeds of 64 km/h.
column2: 这台Grand Titan基于战场改装型，装备重型PPC、两门ER中型激光、一门ER大型激光、两门中型激光和一门小型脉冲激光，用于对付步兵。近战时它还携带一把剑，并拥有90米跳跃半径。重型陀螺仪、驾驶舱以及所有手臂和腿部驱动器都得到了装甲强化。同时，这台Grand Titan配备三重肌纤维束，使其在肉搏中造成双倍伤害，并达到64公里/小时的速度。

column1: This Hunchback IIC was in use for Clan Wolf... Wait, something here is wrong. The Clan Wolf emblem looks like an actual kid painted it. The colors are wrong too. Look at the weapons, those aren't AC20's, they're Chemical Lasers. What insane lunatic made this... thing! The IFF codes read Clan Wolf, but this looks like a Hunchback-4P stuffed with all those lasers. The e-sig reads that there are several Clan Battle computers in here… Boss, the mix of Inner Sphere and Clan Technology actually hurts my brain. If I didn't know any better, this was purpose built to confuse Clanners. They do know this is not very honorable... Right? Right???
column2: 这台 Hunchback IIC 曾由狼氏族使用……等等，这里不对劲。狼氏族徽记看起来像是小孩画的，颜色也不对。看看武器，那不是 AC/20，而是化学激光器。到底是哪个疯子造出了这东西！IFF 代码显示它属于狼氏族，但看起来更像是一台塞满激光器的 Hunchback-4P。电子信号显示里面还有几台氏族战斗计算机……老大，这种内天体与氏族技术的混合真的让我头疼。如果我没猜错，这东西就是专门用来迷惑氏族人的。他们应该知道这很不光荣……对吧？对吧？？？

column1: This Hunchback nicknamed the 'Flying Debris' is equipped with a jury rigged Silver 'Ware' Gauss rifle, Jury Rigged engine and a Aftermarket EWS.
column2: 这个驼背绰号“飞行碎片”，配备了一支临时装备的银色“Ware”高斯步枪、临时装备的发动机和售后 EWS。

column1: This Hunchback nicknamed the 'Flying Debris' is equipped with a jury rigged Silver 'Ware' Gauss rifle, Jury Rigged 引擎 and a Aftermarket EWS.
column2: 这台绰号“飞行碎片”的Hunchback装备了拼装Silver 'Ware'高斯步枪、拼装引擎和一套售后加装的电子战系统。

column1: This Legacy uses the same frame and engine as the 03 model but uses a 紧凑型陀螺仪 to provide enough room to add MASC. This means it can reach a speed of 86 km/h. The weaponry has been replaced with a pair of 短管PPCs, and the hand actuators have been replaced by Claws. The standard armor is replaced by Light Ferro-Fibrous.
column2: 这款 Legacy 使用与 03 型号相同的车架和发动机，但使用结构型陀螺仪来提供足够的空间来添加 MASC。这意味着它的速度可以达到86公里/小时。武器装备已更换为一对短管PPC，手动执行器已更换为利爪。标准装甲被轻铁纤维取代。

column1: This Legacy uses the same frame and 引擎 as the 03 model but uses a 紧凑型陀螺仪 to provide enough room to add MASC. This means it can reach a speed of 86 km/h. The weaponry has been replaced with a pair of 短管PPCs, and the hand actuators have been replaced by Claws. The standard 装甲 is replaced by 轻型铁纤维装甲-Fibrous.
column2: Legacy 采用与 03 型相同的底盘和引擎，但使用紧凑型陀螺仪腾出空间安装 MASC，速度可达 86 km/h。武器换成一对短管 PPC，手部执行器替换为利爪，标准装甲改为轻型铁纤维装甲。

column1: This Mad Cat Mark III is a reproduction in the Inner Sphere after RISC Engineers analyzed and retrofitted the Diamond Sharks original MKIII.
column2: 这台 Mad Cat Mark III 是内天体的仿制机型，由 RISC 工程师分析并改装钻石鲨氏族原版 MKIII 后制造。

column1: This Mad Cat Mark III is a reproduction in the Inner Sphere after RISC Engineers analyzed and retrofitted the 钻石鲨s original MKIII.
column2: 这台 Mad Cat Mark III 是内圈的再生产型号，RISC 工程师分析并改装了钻石鲨氏族原版 MKIII。

column1: This Marauder, commonly refered as the MAD-DER, was first seen as a Solaris VII speed boosted refit which boasts of a L.A.M. System incorporated to the very mech's chassis and engine, enabling it to go faster and actually fly in short bursts. In botched attempt to make a Marauder into a L.A.M. the armor and it's unique JJ system got fused into the chassis making it impossible to make heavy modifications to the mech. I guess some sacrifices needed to be made for a 75-Ton ''Flying'' mech.
column2: 这架掠夺者通常被称为 MAD-DER，最初被视为 Solaris VII 速度增强改装，拥有 L.A.M.该系统与机甲的底盘和发动机相结合，使其能够行驶得更快，并且实际上可以在短时间内飞行。将掠夺者变成 L.A.M. 的尝试失败了。装甲及其独特的 JJ 系统被融合到底盘中，使得无法对机甲进行重大修改。我想，对于一个 75 吨的“飞行”机甲来说，需要做出一些牺牲。

column1: This Omnimech is better in any way compared to its other Models. Upgraded with an XL Engine, Ferro Fibrous and Endo Steel it shows the advantage it gets by Mounting 4 Medium Pulse, 1 Large Pulse and a Narc Launcher. While you might think this Weapons Loadout is Underwhelming, the MASC makes it able to Brawl with any other Mech. Its also not as Underarmoured as Normal Clan Mechs, thanks to Blood Spirits different Thinking, so be Prepared. They even Mounted MG's on it to Fend off any Elementals that might come for your Mech.
column2: 这款全能机甲各方面都优于其他型号。它升级为 XL 引擎、铁磁纤维装甲和内骨架，展现出搭载四门中型脉冲激光器、一门大型脉冲激光器和一具 Narc 发射器的优势。你可能觉得这套武器配置不怎么样，但 MASC 让它能与任何机甲近身格斗。得益于 Blood Spirit 氏族不同的理念，它的装甲也不像普通氏族机甲那样薄弱，所以做好准备吧。他们甚至还装了机枪，用来击退可能袭击你机甲的 Elemental。

column1: This Osteon configuration uses energy weapons. Three ER Large Lasers provide covering fire as the Osteon closes. For shorter ranges, the 'Mech carries two Improved Heavy Large Lasers. For close combat, the Osteon-B carries a Large Vibroblade.
column2: 这套 Osteon 配置使用能量武器。三门增程大型激光在 Osteon 接近目标时提供掩护火力；中距离则使用两门改进型重型大型激光；近战时，Osteon-B 携带一把大型振动刀。

column1: This Perseus configuration has a Rotary AC/5, MRM-20, PPC, and Streak SRM-4. Each leg carries a Small Laser. A Guardian ECM Suite disrupts enemy networks, while a head mounted TAG system allows the Perseus-P to designate artillery targets.
column2: Perseus 配置装备一门 Rotary AC/5、MRM-20、PPC 和 Streak SRM-4。每条腿各搭载一门小型激光。Guardian ECM 套件可干扰敌方网络，头部安装的 TAG 则能让 Perseus-P 为火炮标定目标。

column1: This Perseus configuration has a Rotary AC/5, MRM-20, PPC, and 锁定式SRM-4. Each leg carries a Small Laser. A 守护者ECM Suite disrupts enemy networks, while a head mounted TAG system allows the Perseus-P to designate 火炮 targets.
column2: 这套珀耳修斯配置拥有旋转AC/5、MRM-20、PPC和连续射击SRM-4。双腿各装一门小型激光。守护者ECM套件可干扰敌方网络，头部安装的TAG系统则让珀耳修斯-P能够标记目标。

column1: This Pirate refit of a Hollander II trades the usual Gauss Rifle for some kind of rotary rifle abomination. To their credit, these pirates at least thought to put some advanced electronics and more than token armor on it.
column2: 这具海盗改装的 Hollander II 用某种旋转步枪怪物取代了通常的高斯步枪。值得肯定的是，这些海盗至少想到了安装先进电子设备和不止象征意义的装甲。

column1: This Pirate refit of a 荷兰人 II trades the usual Gauss Rifle for some kind of rotary rifle abomination. To their credit, these pirates at least thought to put some advanced electronics and more than token 装甲 on it.
column2: 这台Hollander II的海盗改装型号用某种旋转步枪怪物替换了常规高斯步枪。值得肯定的是，这些海盗至少考虑安装了先进电子设备，并给它配备了不止象征性的装甲。

column1: This Pirate version of the Hoplite includes multiple methods of interfering with another '机甲's entire kit. It comes with a Taser, a Harpoon, and a pair of Fluid Guns that can spray a selection of chemicals on enemy units. It's equipped with a 机甲anical Jump Jet system to get it in and out of range of its targets. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.03 Arm Actuator Limits: 左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 这台 Hoplite 海盗版本具备多种干扰另一台机甲整套装备的方法。它配备 Taser、鱼叉和一对流体炮，可向敌方单位喷洒多种化学物质；还装有机械跳跃喷射系统，以便进出目标射程。 特质：分心 投放成本倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左上、右上

column1: This Republic Trebaruna has been turned into some slow walking Monster. The 加固装甲 is still on it, but they reinforced the 结构 as well. Ripping out anything and everything that has to do with speed, don't expect this to move very far. The Armaments have been replaced with various Pirate and Periphery Weapons, some of which are either Genius Engineering or Insanity. They even crammed a 工业级三倍强度人造肌 in there to mount all of these Weapons on the Mech. Looking at what this thing was supposed to do, I nearly think they made a Wannabie Urbanmech. Pirates, Boss, I tell you.
column2: 这台共和国Trebaruna被改造成了缓慢行走的怪物。加固装甲仍在，但他们也加固了结构。为了彻底拆除一切与速度有关的部件，别指望它能走多远。武器被替换成各种海盗和边疆武器，其中有些属于天才工程，有些则纯属疯狂。他们甚至塞进一套工业级增强型外骨骼，用来在机甲上安装这些武器。看着它原本的用途，我几乎以为他们造了一个想成为UrbanMech的东西。海盗，老大，真是无话可说。

column1: This Republic variant uses the failed Condor Trans-Track as a base chassis. It removes the lift skirts and other hover-related components in favor of a fifty ton tracked chassis. Equipped with an LB 5-X autocannon, LRM-15, and two machine guns, it serves in the Republic Standing Guard. It can reach a top speed of 96 km/h thanks to an XL Fusion engine. Biome Restrictions: None. Movement: 6/9 hexes / 180/270 meters. column1: This Strix has seen some special alterations by some pirate wise guy who actually added some pretty decent targeting system upgrades and thankfully was smart enough not to 'improve' the engine. The weapons though, well you might be better just flying the thing into you target.

column1: This Tarantula was Designed for Counter Scouting. While not as Fast or Nimble, the Weapons would make short work of any other Scout, while taking a lot of fire. The Clan XL with a 150 Core makes enough space for One Plasma Cannon, A Lrm 10 Clan launcher and a Medium Pulse Laser. There is also a Heavy MG for Anti Personnel Purposes with enough ammo to last a While. 14 Tons of Clan Heatsinks make it Cooler than Cool.
column2: 这台 Tarantula 专为反侦察设计。它虽然没那么快、灵活，但武器足以迅速解决其他侦察机甲，也能承受大量火力。氏族 XL 引擎配合 150 级聚变核心腾出空间，安装一门等离子炮、一具氏族 LRM-10 发射器和一门中型脉冲激光。此外还有一挺重型机枪用于反步兵，并配有足够使用一阵子的弹药。14 吨氏族散热器让它凉爽无比。

column1: This Vanquisher variant uses a Compact Engine and Compact Gyro to improve survivability. The MechWarrior piloting it is forced into a Small Cockpit, which allows the head to carry a Heavy Flamer and fuel. Each arm carries a Plasma Rifle and ER Flamer, which are backed up by a Snub Nose PPC and two Small VSP Lasers. A Beagle Active Probe allows the 7U to find hidden enemy units, and a Remote Sensor Dispenser is also fitted. This variant also carries sixteen double heat sinks to dissipate the heat generated by the weapons, but it is also equipped with Triple Strength Myomer to turn a liability (excess heat) into a strength.
column2: 这款征服者变体采用紧凑型引擎和紧凑型陀螺仪，提升生存能力。驾驶员只能使用小型驾驶舱，因此头部可以搭载重型火焰喷射器和燃料。两臂各装有一门等离子步枪和一门增程火焰喷射器，另有一门短鼻 PPC 与两门小型 VSP 激光器提供支援。比格犬主动探测器帮助 7U 发现隐藏敌人，机上还安装了远程传感器投放器。该变体另有 16 台双倍散热器，用于消散武器热量；TSM 则将过热这一负担转化为优势。

column2: 这款 3L 基础改型用等离子步枪替换了 PPC。它将两门前向脉冲激光器换成增程中型激光器，为三吨弹药腾出了重量空间。热负荷降低后，3LL 在受损之前无需担心积热。

column1: This basic refit of the 3L replaced the PPC with a 等离子步枪. Tonnage was freed up for its three tons of ammunition by swapping out the two forward-facing pulse lasers for ER 中型激光s. The reduced heat load gives the 3LL the luxury of not building heat before it is damaged.
column2: 这是 3L 型的基础改装，用等离子步枪替换 PPC。通过把两门前向脉冲激光器换成 ER 中型激光器，为 3 吨弹药腾出了重量。热负荷降低后，3LL 型即使受损也不会积累热量。

column1: This certainly meet the requirements of a 'support mech'. As in, it shouldn't be anywhere close to combat. It's a mine-layer, and that's all it does. While it does have two tons of deadfire LRMs for if an enemy is charging, it's accuracy is crap with those LRM launchers and the shortened arm servos.
column2: 这确实符合“支援机甲”的要求——也就是说，它根本不该靠近战斗。它是一台布雷机甲，除此之外什么也不会。虽然它携带两吨死火 LRM，以防敌人冲锋，但这些 LRM 发射器和缩短的手臂伺服机构让它的准确度糟糕透顶。

column1: This chassis is a pretty radical depature from the usual jack-of-all-trades approach your regular Thunderbolt has. Makes sense given the designation, I suppose. No need for MGs or small lasers if you're only expecting to fight 'Mechs.
column2: 该机箱与常规 Thunderbolt 所采用的万能方法截然不同。我想，鉴于这个名称，这是有道理的。如果您只想与“机甲”作战，则不需要机枪或小型激光器。

column1: This commando is surprisingly hardy for how fast it is. The shotgun is a nice touch, but be careful about trying to overuse that TSM, since it's got 'Quicsell Quality' stamped all over it. Oh, and be careful at full speed, this thing is rather unsteady.
column2: 这台突击队机甲以如此高的速度而言出奇地坚固。霰弹枪是不错的点子，但要小心别过度使用 TSM，因为机体到处都盖着“Quicsell 品质”的印章。还有，全速行驶时要当心，这东西相当不稳定。

column1: This configuration carries a C3 Slave unit, fifteen double heat sinks, two Heavy PPCs, and a Gauss Rifle.
column2: 此配置携带一个 C3 从属单元、十五个双散热器、两个重型 PPC 和一把高斯步枪。

column1: This configuration carries a Nova CEWS and Light TAG. Each arm carries three Improved Heavy Small Lasers, while each side torso carries an iATM 12 with two tons of ammunition. Seventeen double heat sinks keep it cool.
column2: 该配置带有 Nova CEWS 和 Light TAG。每只手臂携带三把改进型重型小型激光器，而每侧躯干则携带一把装有两吨弹药的 iATM 12。十七个双散热器保持凉爽。

column2: 该配置在躯干中携带两支轻型高斯步枪，并在每条手臂上安装一门大型 X 脉冲激光器。

column1: This configuration is apparently intended for space operations. Each arm carries an Arc Welder, a 中型脉冲激光 and an ER 中型激光. Two ER Small Lasers are in the right and left torso, while a single ER PPC is installed in the left torso. Seven 改进型跳跃推进器 and a series of Articulated Jump Jets provide mobility in the depths of space, with two tons of 液体储罐 that doubles as a Cooling Pod for increased stability. To maintain grip on spacecraft, the Septimecia US has talons on each leg.
column2: 该配置显然用于太空作战。每条手臂装备一台电弧焊机、一门中型脉冲激光和一门增程中型激光；左右躯干各有两门增程小型激光，左躯干另装一门增程粒子加农炮。七具改进型跳跃推进器和一组关节式跳跃推进器提供太空机动能力，两吨液体储罐兼作冷却舱以提高稳定性。为在飞船表面保持抓附，塞普蒂米西亚US的每条腿都装有爪。

column1: This configuration is meant for engagement at all ranges. In its arms are a pair of 超级自动炮/5s for long-range engagements. Backing up the autocannons are four SRM-6s, as well as two 中型脉冲激光s found in the center torso. The A configuration has two additional 双散热器 to cope with the new heat load of the weapons
column2: 该配置用于全射程交战。双臂各有一门超级自动炮/5，负责远程攻击；四具SRM-6和中央躯干的两门中型脉冲激光提供支援。A型还增加两组双散热器，以应对武器带来的额外热量。

column1: This configuration is principally armed with a pair of shoulder mounted LRM-15 launchers with four tons ammunition. For close-range fighting, the '机甲 utilizes a pair of SRM-6 launchers with an accompanying small pulse laser in each arm. For added protection, the '机甲 is fitted with an ECM suite.
column2: 这套配置的主要武器是肩部的一对 LRM-15 发射器，并配有 4 吨弹药。近距离作战时，这台机甲使用一对 SRM-6 发射器，双臂还各装有一门小型脉冲激光。为增强防护，机体另配 ECM 套件。

column1: This configuration mounts a powerful 重击者火炮 Cannon and carries three tons of ammunition. The Scapha Hover坦克 is a thirty-second century Hover 全向车辆 which was originally exclusively 生产 for the Armed Forces of the 球体共和国. Built by Grumman Industries on Terra in 3123, the Scapha was 设计ed with the best technologies of its time. It would go on to serve in multiple roles in the RAF due to its flexibility and firepower. The 设计 was highly popular in the service of the RAF well into the fall of most the Republic's Prefectures to invading forces after 3132. While part of many Republic Standing Guard units, the Scapha was noted for delaying the fall of many Republic worlds. 设计 as a fast and flexible 坦克, the Scapha is powered by a Strand 265-rated Extra-Extralight Fusion 引擎, giving excess speed. Despite the cost of the 引擎 and its bulkiness, the Scapha has thirteen tons of pod space for weapons and equipment. Protecting its 装甲ed hide is 7.5 tons of Grumman CRR Reflective 装甲 which dampens the damage caused by energy weapons. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 11/17 格 / 330/510 米. 装甲: 反射涂层 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 170 20 左侧 105 20 右侧 105 20 后方 100 20 炮塔 160 20 总计 640 100 怪癖: Variable Range 定位 Omni 车辆
column2: 该配置安装一门威力强大的重击者火炮，并携带三吨弹药。Scapha 气垫坦克是三十二世纪的全向气垫车辆，最初专为球体共和国武装部队生产。3123 年，Grumman 工业公司在 Terra 建造了 Scapha，采用当时最先进的技术。凭借灵活性和火力，它后来在共和国空军中承担多种任务。直到 3132 年入侵势力攻陷共和国大部分总督区后很久，这一设计仍在空军服役并广受欢迎。Scapha 曾属于许多共和国常备卫队，以拖延多个共和国世界的陷落而闻名。Scapha 作为快速灵活的坦克设计，采用 Strand 265 级超超轻聚变引擎，拥有过剩的速度。尽管引擎昂贵且体积庞大，Scapha 仍有 13 吨吊舱空间用于武器和设备。保护其装甲外壳的是 7.5 吨 Grumman CRR 反射装甲，可削弱能量武器造成的伤害。 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 11/17 格 / 330/510 米. 装甲: 反射涂层 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 170 20 左侧 105 20 右侧 105 20 后方 100 20 炮塔 160 20 总计 640 100 怪癖: 可变射程瞄准 Omni 车辆

column1: This configuration retains the ER PPC and the ER Small Pulse Lasers of the original. It replaces the autocannon with another energy weapon - a Medium Pulse Laser - and swaps out the SRM-6s, mounting a single Streak LRM-15 in each of the left and right torsos instead.
column2: 该配置保留原版的增程 PPC 和增程小型脉冲激光器。它用另一件能量武器——中型脉冲激光器——替换自动火炮，并拆除 SRM-6，改为在左右侧躯干各安装一具 Streak LRM-15。

column1: This configuration sports Improved Jump Jets that allow the Preta to jump up to 240 meters. Offensively, it uses two pairs of arm-mounted ER Medium Lasers guided by a Targeting Computer. An extra pair of heat sinks keeps the heat buildup null.
column2: 该配置装备改进型跳跃喷射器，可让 Preta 一次跃行至多 240 米。进攻方面，瞄准计算机引导两对安装在手臂上的增程中型激光器；额外的一对散热器可消除热量积累。

column1: This configuration sports 改进型跳跃推进器 that allow the Preta to jump up to 240 meters. Offensively, it uses two pairs of arm-mounted ER 中型激光s guided by a 瞄准计算机. An extra pair of heat sinks keeps the heat buildup null.
column2: 该配置配备改进型跳跃推进器，使普瑞塔能够跳跃至240米。武器方面，它使用两对安装于手臂的增程中型激光，并由瞄准计算机辅助引导。额外的一对散热器可抑制热量累积。

column1: This configuration uses a Plasma Rifle for its main weapon. This is backed up by a single ER Small Laser and a trio of Small Pulse Lasers.
column2: 该配置以等离子步枪为主武器，辅以一门增程小型激光和三门小型脉冲激光。

column1: This configuration utilizes a mix of Inner Sphere and Clan Technologies. The R configuration's long-range firepower comes from a pair of side-torso mounted 20-Tubed Extended Long-Range Missile Launchers with six tons of ammunition. Other weapons include five Clan Tech ER Medium Lasers found in the arms and in the center torso. A single Double Heat Sink is added to help manage heat.
column2: 该配置混合采用内天体和氏族技术。R 配置的远程火力来自两具安装在侧躯干的 20 管增程远程导弹发射器，并配备六吨弹药。其他武器包括五门安装在手臂和中央躯干的氏族增程中型激光器。另加一台双倍散热器协助控制热量。

column1: This configuration utilizes a mix of Inner Sphere and Clan Technologies. The R configuration's long-range firepower comes from a pair of side-torso mounted 20-Tubed Extended 远程导弹发射器s with six tons of ammunition. Other weapons include five Clan Tech ER 中型激光s found in the arms and in the center torso. A single 双散热器 is added to help manage heat.
column2: 该配置混合使用内圈和氏族技术。R 配置的远程火力来自两具安装在侧躯干的 20 管扩展型远程导弹发射器，并携带六吨弹药。其他武器包括五门氏族技术 ER 中型激光，分布在手臂和中央躯干中。另加一台双散热器以帮助控制热量。

column1: This custom Mad Cat MkII is the personal ride of IlKhan Morphyum Kerensky, made infamous when he 'accidentally' fragged an allied BattleMech because he 'needed a hole to shoot the enemy through'. As could be imagined, the Lady Killer is an Autocannon specialist.
column2: 这台定制 Mad Cat Mk II 是伊尔汗 Morphyum Kerensky 的私人座驾。他曾以“意外”击毁一台友军战斗机甲而臭名昭著，理由是“我需要在那儿打个洞，好射击敌人”。Lady Killer 果然不负其名，是一台专精自动炮的机甲。

column1: This custom Mad Cat MkII is the personal ride of IlKhan Morphyum Kerensky, made infamous when he 'accidentally' fragged an allied Battle机甲 because he 'needed a hole to shoot the enemy through'. As could be imagined, the Lady Killer is an Autocannon specialist.
column2: 这台定制Mad Cat MkII是伊尔汗Morphyum Kerensky的座驾。它因“意外”击毁一台友军战斗机甲而臭名昭著——因为他说自己“需要一个能向敌人开火的洞”。不难想象，“Lady Killer”是一台专精自动加农炮的机甲。

column1: This custom Solaris variant debuted in 3128 in Noisiel and piloted first by Natalia Porter and then by her daughter Carolyn Fischer, this Clint IIC upgrade reverses the trend of Clan-modified-Inner-Sphere machines. Starting from the Clan-built frame, the variant drops the Jump Jets to change the weapon load. It keeps the two Clan Extended Range 中型激光 and swaps the Clan LB 10-X AC for a Large 变速脉冲激光 and a Medium Re-Engineered Laser mating them all to a 氏族瞄准计算机. The standard plate 装甲 is replaced with Ballistic-加固装甲.
column2: 这台定制的太阳神七号变体于3128年在诺瓦谢尔首次亮相，最初由娜塔莉亚·波特驾驶，后来交给她的女儿卡罗琳·费舍尔。这个克林特IIC升级型逆转了星盟改造内圈机器的惯例：它以星盟制造的骨架为基础，拆除跳跃喷射器以调整武器配置。它保留两门星盟延伸射程中型激光，并将星盟LB 10-X自动火炮替换为一门大型激光和一门中型重构激光，全部接入一台瞄准计算机。标准板式装甲则换成了弹道强化装甲。

column1: This custom variant mounts a Heavy Machine Gun and ER Medium Laser in each arm, with another laser mounted in the left torso and a Light PPC in the right torso. Two extra Jump-Jets are added, allowing the Sekhmet to jump 180 meters.
column2: 该定制变体两臂各装有一挺重型机枪和一门增程中型激光器，左侧躯干另装一门激光器，右侧躯干则配备一门轻型 PPC。它还增加两具跳跃喷射器，使 Sekhmet 的跳跃距离达到 180 米。

column1: This custom variant mounts a Heavy Machine Gun and ER 中型激光器 in each arm, with another laser mounted in the left torso and a Light PPC in the right torso. Two extra Jump-Jets are added, allowing the Sekhmet to jump 180 米.
column2: 该定制型号双臂各装备一挺重型机枪和一门ER中型激光，左侧躯干另装一门激光，右侧躯干装有一门轻型PPC。额外增加两具跳跃喷射器后，塞赫麦特一次可跳跃180米。

column1: This custom variant of the Galahad was used by Phantom Demi-Precentor Delta Laodices, a commander of the 40th Shadow Division. It uses a 小型驾驶舱, an 改进的 C3 Computer, one 轻型高斯步枪, and a 守护者ECM Suite - just like a standard 3D Galahad. It differs, however, in that it drops the other 轻型高斯步枪 and one ton of ammunition, replacing them with an ER PPC enhanced by an experimental PPC Capacitor in the right arm. In addition, a Light PPC is mounted in the center torso. These modifications allow the '机甲 to remain in combat for far longer.
column2: 加拉哈德的这款定制变体由第 40 暗影师指挥官幻影半前身德尔塔·劳迪斯 (Delta Laodices) 使用。它使用小型驾驶舱、改进的 C3 计算机、轻型高斯探测器和守护者 ECM 套件 - 就像标准的 3D 加拉哈德一样。然而，它的不同之处在于它会掉落另一个轻型高斯杖和一吨弹药，并用右臂中的实验性 PPC 电容器增强的 ER PPC 代替它们。此外，轻型 PPC 安装在躯干中央。这些修改使得‘机甲’能够在战斗中保持更长时间。

column1: This custom-设计ed model is piloted by a Capellan bounty hunter, who goes by the moniker Dao. It has been rebuilt using Clan-technology heat sinks, 铁纤维装甲 装甲, and Endo Steel. A Clan ER PPC is the primary weapon, and the '机甲 also carries a Battle机甲 Taser to aid in capturing targets alive. A Supercharger and an 驱动器增强系统 add to the Vindicator's speed and accuracy.
column2: 这台定制型号由一名坎培拉赏金猎人驾驶，代号“道”。它使用星盟技术散热器、强化装甲和内骨骼结构重建。主要武器是一门星盟ER PPC，同时还携带一件战斗机甲电击器，以便活捉目标。超级充能器和改进型瞄准系统提升了维克多的速度与精度。

column1: This customized 'Mech is equipped with 270 XL引擎, two ER Micro Lasers and Heavy Machine Guns in both torsos, Streak SRM 4 with it's one ton of ammo in central torso and two Streak SRM 2's in the right arm, along with 10 双散热器 to cope with the heat, half ton of HMG ammo in left torso and one full ton of HMG and Streak SRM 4 ammo bins in right torso.
column2: 这台定制机甲装备270级XL引擎，双侧躯干各有两门ER微型激光器和重型机枪，中央躯干有一具Streak SRM-4及一吨弹药，右臂有两具Streak SRM-2；另有10组双重散热器应对热量，左侧躯干存放半吨重机枪弹药，右侧躯干存放一整吨重机枪和Streak SRM-4弹药。

column1: This customized Hellspawn variant appears to be a battlefield refit, featuring a mix of Clan and Inner-Sphere tech. Three tons of CASE-protected missile ammo feed a pair of MML-9 launchers, backed up by a heavy 中型激光器 in each arm. Defensively the '机甲 retains the Hellspawn's customary mobility, alongside an externally-mounted anti-missile system and a Clan-made heat bank to reduce the impact of incendiary munitions. Even the ECM has been upgraded to a Kuritan "Angel" suite.
column2: 这台定制 Hellspawn 改型似乎是战场改装品，混合采用氏族与内圈技术。三吨由 CASE 保护的导弹弹药为两具 MML-9 发射器供弹，双臂各有一具重型中型激光器。防御方面，它保留 Hellspawn 一贯的机动性，并加装外置反导系统和氏族制造的热能储存器，以减轻燃烧弹药的影响。甚至 ECM 也升级为库里塔“天使”套件。

column1: This customized Merlin C keeps the same general weapons loadout as the stock variants, but considerably upgrades the internal systems and electronics of the 'Mech. The one big change is the removal of the Flamer to instead add more armor plates. Quirk: 易于维护 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.16 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这台定制梅林 C 型保留了标准型号的大体武器配置，但大幅升级内部系统和电子设备。最大的改动是拆除火焰喷射器，改为增加装甲板。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂，右下臂

column1: This customized Merlin C keeps the same general weapons loadout as the stock variants, but considerably upgrades the internal systems and electronics of the '机甲. The one big change is the removal of the Flamer to instead add more 装甲 plates. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: This dedicated anti-infantry variant is 设计ed for urban defense, and is not for use against other '机甲s. Each arm has four 轻型 Machine Guns and a 机枪 Array. It also utilizes a Flamer that can threaten combat 车辆s as well as infantry. A single 火箭发射器 10 provides a one-shot damage potential against 装甲ed targets. The 19 has proven popular with Periphery nations and mercenary units.
column2: 这一专用反步兵变型为城市防御设计，不适合对抗其他战斗机甲。每条手臂安装四挺轻型机枪和一组机枪阵列。它还配备一具喷火器，既能威胁战斗车辆，也能对付步兵。一具火箭发射器10可对装甲目标造成一次性高额伤害。19型深受边疆国家和佣兵部队欢迎。

column1: This entire mech is built around Quicsell's so called 'Gauss' rifle. And yes, it needs the quotes. It works by using twice the powder of a normal AC2 round, and loading the thing into a massively overbuilt firing chamber needed to contain the blast. Even then, the AC2 rounds just arn't designed for those velocities, and you can expect a significant damage drop-off over the range of the gun.
column2: 整台机甲都围绕 Quicsell 所谓的“高斯”步枪打造。没错，必须加引号。它的工作原理是使用两倍于普通 AC/2 炮弹的装药量，再把炮弹塞进一个巨大、过度强化的发射膛，以承受爆炸。即便如此，AC/2 炮弹也不是为这种速度设计的，因此炮弹在射程上的伤害衰减会非常明显。

Unfortunately, field trials revealed the experimental launcher to be somewhat unreliable. To address this vulnerability and the original design's unimpressive dogfighting, wing-mounted backup weapons were deemed a necessity after all. column1: This experimental variant was made at Ronin Incorporated's facility on Wallis in 3039. Techs removed the standard weaponry from a Marauder and replaced the arm mounted weapons with a 二元激光 Cannon in each arm, while the torso mounted autocannon was replaced by twin SRM-6 launchers backed by one ton of ammunition. The Marauder-4X was also noteworthy because it used a Prototype Endo Steel chassis. To keep the heat under control, technicians installed twelve single heat sinks and six prototype 双散热器.
column2: 这一实验型于3039年在Wallis的Ronin Incorporated工厂制造。技术人员拆除Marauder的标准武器，将双臂武器替换为每臂一门二元激光炮，并把躯干自动炮换成两具SRM-6发射器和一吨弹药。Marauder-4X还采用原型内骨骼底盘。为控制热量，技术人员安装12组单重散热器和6组原型双重散热器。

column1: This field refit of the 3063 MRM-20 version drops 1 ton of ammo for an Apollo Fire Control System. The ER 中型激光, 守护者ECM Suite and a C3 slave are retained. The Pegasus is a popular recon unit, due to its good speed, decent 装甲, and respectable firepower. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：9/14 格 / 270/420 米. 装甲： 铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 140 20 左侧 100 20 右侧 100 20 后方 55 20 炮塔 100 20 总计 495 100 特性：通信增强
column2: 这是 3063 年 MRM-20 型的战地改装，牺牲一吨弹药换装 Apollo 火控系统；增程中型激光、守护者 ECM 套件和 C3 从属设备得以保留。Pegasus 速度快、装甲尚可、火力可靠，因此成为受欢迎的侦察单位。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：9/14 格 / 270/420 米. 装甲： 铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 140 20 左侧 100 20 右侧 100 20 后方 55 20 炮塔 100 20 总计 495 100 特性：通信增强

The dropoff in rate of fire is offset by the ability to use Precision Ammunition. Quirk: Barrel Fist Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 这次战地改装于联邦-康联内战期间推出，仅将超级自动炮/10 替换为标准自动炮/10。射速下降由能够使用精确弹药的优势弥补。 特性：炮管之拳 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂，右下臂
