column2: 这种战地改装型于联邦-康联邦内战期间推出。它仅将超重型自动炮/10替换为标准自动炮/10。射速下降由可使用精准弹药的能力弥补。 特性：枪管拳 部署成本倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: This field refit was introduced during the Jihad in 3071. It carries the Autocannon/10s of the RFL-3C, but uses an XL Gyro to provide room for a pair of Medium Lasers. Heavy Ferro-Fibrous armor increases the amount of protection.
column2: 这套战地改装于 3071 年圣战期间推出。它保留 RFL-3C 的 AC/10，但使用 XL 陀螺仪腾出空间安装一对中型激光。重型铁磁纤维装甲提升了防护能力。

column1: This field refit was introduced during the Jihad in 3071. It carries the Autocannon/10s of the RFL-3C, but uses an XL Gyro to provide room for a pair of 中型激光s. 重型铁纤维装甲 装甲 increases the amount of protection.
column2: 这款战地改装型于3071年圣战期间推出。它携带RFL-3C的AC/10，但使用XL陀螺仪腾出空间，安装两门中型激光器。重型铁纤维装甲提高了防护水平。

column1: This field-expedient refit was introduced to fight off the Draconis Combine during their early 32nd century invasion of the Draconis March. All the weapons have been removed and replaced with a Large Re-engineered Laser, ER Flamers, and two Magshots. The laser and flamers are on one arm, while the Magshots are on the opposite arm.
column2: 这套战场应急改装用于抵御 32 世纪初 Draconis March 遭受的 Draconis Combine 入侵。所有武器都被拆除，换成一门大型重构激光器、增程喷火器和两把 Magshot。激光器与喷火器安装在一只手臂，Magshot 则安装在另一只手臂。

column1: This has to be the most adorable BattleMech I've ever seen. It's like those holovids of people dressing their pets up in cute outfits for Halloween.
column2: 这一定是我见过最可爱的战斗机甲。它就像那些万圣节把宠物打扮成可爱服装的全息影片。

column1: This has to be the most adorable Battle机甲 I've ever seen. It's like those holovids of people dressing their pets up in cute outfits for Halloween.
column2: 这是我见过最可爱的战斗机甲。它就像全息影像里那些万圣节把宠物打扮得可可爱爱的人。

column1: This hover APC has been retrofitted for combat it has a few more weapons and some extra armor but come on, just drop a proper combat vehicle or better yet, a 'Mech for the weight.
column2: 这辆悬浮 APC 被改装成了战斗用途，多装了几件武器和一些装甲。不过说真的，这个吨位还不如直接部署一辆正经战斗车辆，或者干脆上一台机甲。

column1: This hover APC has been retrofitted for combat it has a few more weapons and some extra 装甲 but come on, just drop a proper combat 车辆 or better yet, a '机甲 for the weight.
column2: 这辆悬浮装甲输送车已经为战斗进行了改装，增加了几件武器和一些额外装甲。不过，说真的，按它的重量，应该直接换成真正的战斗装甲输送车，或者更好，换成一台战斗机甲。

column1: This infantry-hunter variant moves the ER 中型激光s to the left arm, while the right arm now mounts 2 Flamers, with a third Flamer in the center torso. A Machine Gun in each side-torso with 3 tons of ammo rounds off the -2V's weapons. Five and a half tons of 装甲 provides excellent durability.
column2: 这一反步兵变型将ER中型激光器移至左臂，右臂则安装两具喷火器，中央躯干再装一具喷火器。两侧躯干各有一挺机枪和3吨弹药，完成-2V的武器配置。5.5吨装甲提供出色耐久性。

column1: This is a Sheriff's mech, it brings a peace of mind to folk, but is not heavy on technology. By switching to double heat sinks, the 2L model of the Marshal is able to upgrade the LRM-5 launcher to a much more powerful LRM-15 launcher.
column2: 这是一台治安官机甲，能给人带来安心，但技术含量不高。Marshal 2L型改用双重散热器后，可以将LRM-5发射器升级为威力强得多的LRM-15。

column1: This is a Sherrif's mech, It brings a piece of mind to folk, but is not heavy on technology. This is a Magistracy of Canopus variant of the Marshal, that was developed during the Jihad. This model saw introduction of a Light Fusion Engine, and some modern weaponry to the Marshal's arsenal. Right Torso's Medium Pulse Laser is retained, while a Light PPC, Plasma Rifle, and a MML-9 is introduced for ranged attacks. For dedicated anti-infantry work, the Machine Guns are exchanged for pair of Light Machine Guns in a Machine Gun Array.
column2: 这是一台治安官机甲，给人安心感，但技术含量不高。这是金星联邦在圣战期间开发的 Marshal 型号。它为 Marshal 引入轻型聚变引擎和一些现代武器。右侧躯干的中型脉冲激光保留，另增加轻型 PPC、等离子步枪和 MML-9 进行远程攻击。为专门反步兵，机枪换成机枪阵列中的一对轻型机枪。

column1: This is a Sherrif's mech, It brings a piece of mind to folk, but is not heavy on technology. This is a Magistracy of Canopus variant of the Marshal, that was developed during the Jihad. This model saw introduction of a Light Fusion 引擎, and some modern weaponry to the Marshal's arsenal. 右侧 Torso's 中型脉冲激光 is retained, while a Light PPC, 等离子步枪, and a MML-9 is introduced for ranged attacks. For dedicated anti-infantry work, the Machine Guns are exchanged for pair of 轻型 Machine Guns in a 机枪 Array.
column2: 这是治安官的机甲，能让民众安心，却没有堆砌过多高科技。它是金星合众国在圣战期间开发的元帅改型。该型号为元帅换装了轻型聚变引擎，并加入了一些现代武器。右侧躯干的中型激光得到保留，同时新增轻型PPC、短管步枪和MML-9，用于远程攻击。为专门对付步兵，原有机枪被一对机枪阵列取代，每个阵列都装有两挺机枪。

column1: This is a Sherrif's mech, it brings a piece of mind to folk, but is not heavy on technology. This variant of the Marshal was introduced during the Dark Age. It carries a TSEMP Cannon, MML-9 with a three ton ammunition bay, two Machine Guns, a Flamer, a Medium Laser, and a Medium Pulse Laser. It is otherwise identical to the original Marshal.
column2: 这是一台警长的机甲，能让民众安心，但技术配置并不先进。Marshal 的这个变体于黑暗时代推出，配备一门 TSEMP 炮、一具 MML-9 和 3 吨弹药舱、两挺机枪、一具喷火器、一门中型激光器和一门中型脉冲激光器。除此之外，它与原版 Marshal 完全相同。

column1: This is a bit a white elephant. It's a mech built around a gun that catastrophically fails after an average of about 20 shots. If you stick some proper UACs in there to replace Quicsell's knock-offs, this could actually make for a decent sniper mech.
column2: 这有点白象。这是一种围绕枪建造的机甲，平均射击约 20 次后就会发生灾难性故障。如果你在里面放一些合适的 UAC 来取代 Quicsell 的仿制品，这实际上可以成为一个像样的狙击机甲。

column1: This is a custom Clint mech of a Solaris Gladiator, who shared the name with his favorite mech. The pilot supposedly called Clint Eastwood was well known by fans and his enemies, that after making gaping holes with his customized weaponry in your mech, he likes to shout in all comms "Do you feel lucky, punk? Do ya??!.
column2: 这是 Solaris 角斗士定制的 Clint 机甲，驾驶员与自己最喜欢的机甲同名。据说名叫 Clint Eastwood 的驾驶员在粉丝和敌人中都很有名；他用定制武器在敌方机甲上打出巨大缺口后，总会在所有通讯频道大喊：“你觉得自己走运吗，混蛋？嗯？！”

column1: This is a custom, heavily modified Shootist by Precentor Apollyon, commander of the Word of Blake Shadow Divisions. Apart from the Gauss Rifle, which was kept from the C9 Shootist variant the rest of the weaponry was changed into various type of PPCs and the whole mechs skeleton structure was rebuilt into Endo Steel.
column2: 这是一台由 Blake 圣言影子师团指挥官 Apollyon 牧师改装的定制重装 Shootist。除保留 C9 Shootist 型号的高斯步枪外，其余武器都换成了各种 PPC，整台机甲的骨架也重建为 Endo Steel。

column1: This is a custom, heavily modified Shootist by Precentor Apollyon, commander of the Word of Blake Shadow Divisions. Apart from the Gauss Rifle, which was kept from the C9 Shootist variant the rest of the weaponry was changed into various type of PPCs and the whole mechs skeleton 结构 was rebuilt into Endo Steel.
column2: 这是文字之神阴影师团指挥官阿波利昂领唱定制并大幅改装的射手机甲。除了从C9射手变体保留的高斯步枪外，其他武器全部更换为不同型号的PPC，整台机甲的骨架也重建为内骨骼结构。

column1: This is a deathtrap, boss. Since rifle ammo can't pass through the mech's conveyor ports, it has to be stored in the same compartment as the gun. Not a problem, except these idiots decided to store four tons of heavy rifle ammo in a compartment with no CASE. And right next to the engine to boot. Lets not even mention the machineguns with volatile ammo dotted around the mech. You are exactly one bad overheat or one penetrating hit from death in this thing.
column2: 这是一个死亡陷阱，老板。由于步枪弹药无法通过机甲的传送口，因此必须与枪存放在同一隔间中。没问题，除了这些白痴决定在没有箱子的隔间里存放四吨重型步枪弹药。就在发动机旁边启动。更不用说机甲周围散布着易挥发弹药的机枪了。在这件事上，你正是严重过热或死亡的一击。

column1: This is a deathtrap, boss. Since rifle ammo can't pass through the mech's conveyor ports, it has to be stored in the same compartment as the gun. Not a problem, except these idiots decided to store four tons of heavy rifle ammo in a compartment with no CASE. And right next to the 引擎 to boot. Lets not even mention the machineguns with volatile ammo dotted around the mech. You are exactly one bad overheat or one penetrating hit from death in this thing.
column2: 老大，这东西就是死亡陷阱。步枪弹药无法通过机甲的输送端口，只能和火炮存放在同一隔舱里。问题在于，那群蠢货把四吨重型步枪弹药放进了没有CASE的隔舱，而且就在引擎旁边。更别提机甲各处还散布着装有易爆弹药的机枪了。只要一次糟糕的过热或一次穿透命中，这台东西就会要你的命。

column1: This is a decent anti-missile mech, I guess, but it's really a lot of wasted tonnage to accomplish that. Other than my complaint at the 'standard' Quicsell XL internal combustion engine, my main issue with this one is the lack of ability to do anthing to enemies that are outside it's engagement window, which is pretty small, thanks to the falloff of those lasers it mounts.
column2: 这台机甲用来反导还算不错吧，不过为此浪费的吨位实在太多。先不说我对它那台 Quicsell 标准 XL 内燃机的意见，最让我不满的是它几乎无法攻击交战范围之外的敌人；它装的激光器射程衰减很严重，交战窗口非常窄。

column1: This is a decent anti-missile mech, I guess, but it's really a lot of wasted tonnage to accomplish that. Other than my complaint at the 'standard' Quicsell XL internal combustion 引擎, my main issue with this one is the lack of ability to do anthing to enemies that are outside it's engagement window, which is pretty small, thanks to the falloff of those lasers it mounts.
column2: 我猜这是一台还不错的反导机甲，但为此浪费了太多吨位。除了对Quicsell“标准”XL内燃机的抱怨，我最大的问题是它几乎无法攻击交战窗口之外的敌人；而它的交战范围又很小，因为所装激光存在射程衰减。

column1: This is a hell of an interesting science project you've found, boss. As far as I could learn, this 'Mech was an attempt to beat the Clans at their own game. Everything else beyond that seems to be classified. We're probably on somebody's watchlist now.
column2: 老大，你找到的这是个相当有意思的科学项目。据我所知，这台机甲是为了在氏族最擅长的领域击败他们而研发的。除此之外的资料似乎都列为机密了。我们现在大概已经上了某些人的监视名单。

column1: This is a hell of an interesting science project you've found, boss. As far as I could learn, this '机甲 was an attempt to beat the Clans at their own game. Everything else beyond that seems to be classified. We're probably on somebody's watchlist now.
column2: 老板，你找到的这个科学项目真够有意思。据我所知，这台机甲曾试图用氏族自己的方式击败氏族。除此之外的所有信息似乎都已列为机密。我们现在大概已经进入某些人的监视名单了。

column1: This is a loot pinata, boss. Most of the gear is crap, but Quicsell had to import the light engine and the specialist missile ammunition so if nothing else, make sure to grab those. Other than that, it's a decent all-around 25 ton mech, but nothing special.
column2: 这是台战利品宝箱，Boss。大多数装备都是垃圾，但 Quicsell 不得不进口轻型引擎和特殊导弹弹药，所以无论如何记得把它们拆下来。除此之外，它是一台不错的 25 吨全能机甲，但没什么特别之处。

column1: This is a nod to their touman changing its attitude towards the use of physical attacks, namely using Death from Above maneuver.The second version of the Gyrfalcon would appear in 3112. This version dropped the Reflective Armor of the standard model for Ferro-Fibrous. Using a less advanced armor, this version also drops the Light Active Probe and adds two laser heat sinks.
column2: 这款设计体现了 touman 对实体攻击态度的转变，尤其是开始采用“自天而降”机动。Gyrfalcon 的第二个版本于 3112 年问世。该版本用铁磁纤维装甲替换标准型号的反射装甲。由于采用了较不先进的装甲，它还移除了轻型主动探测器，并增加两具激光散热器。

column1: This is a nod to their touman changing its attitude towards the use of physical attacks, namely using Death from Above maneuver.The second version of the Gyrfalcon would appear in 3112. This version dropped the Reflective 装甲 of the standard model for 铁纤维装甲. Using a less advanced 装甲, this version also drops the 轻型 主动探头 and adds two laser heat sinks.
column2: 这是对其战团改变肉搏战态度的致意，具体体现为采用“天降死神”机动。Gyrfalcon的第二个型号于3112年问世，用铁纤维装甲替换标准型号的反射装甲。由于使用较不先进的装甲，它还取消轻型主动探头，增加两具激光散热器。

column1: This is a pretty interesting find, boss. Looks like an old SLDF custom, but with some kind of early Clan prototypes integrated. With the way this thing is set up for stealth, as long as you can keep it out of direct line of sight, the enemy'll never even know it's there.
column2: 这是个很有意思的发现，Boss。看起来像是旧 SLDF 定制机，但整合了某种早期氏族原型技术。它的隐形配置非常彻底，只要避免进入敌人的直接视线，对方甚至不会知道它在那里。

column1: This is a pretty interesting find, boss. Looks like an old SLDF custom. With the way this thing is set up for stealth, as long as you can keep it out of direct line of sight, the enemy'll never even know it's there.
column2: 这是个很有意思的发现，Boss。看起来像是旧 SLDF 定制机。它的隐形配置非常彻底，只要避免进入敌人的直接视线，对方甚至不会知道它在那里。

column1: This is a production variant based on the AXM-6X. This version, introduced in 3083, uses an Inner Sphere–produced XL engine and lacks the supercharger of the 6X. The top speed of the 6T is 86 km/h. The armor protection and weapon configuration are identical to the Axman 6X, but the Thunderbolt launchers have two tons of ammunition each. It is also the only Axman to not carry its typical melee weapon. Quirk: Melee Actuators Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 这是基于 AXM-6X 的量产型号，于 3083 年推出。该版本采用内圈生产的 XL 引擎，且没有 6X 的增压器。6T 的最高速度为 86 km/h。装甲防护和武器配置与 Axman 6X 相同，但 Thunderbolt 发射器各配两吨弹药。它也是唯一不携带典型近战武器的 Axman。 特质：近战驱动器 部署费用倍率：1.09

column1: This is a production variant based on the AXM-6X. This version, introduced in 3083, uses an Inner Sphere–produced XL engine and lacks the supercharger of the 6X. The top speed of the 6T is 86 km/h. The armor protection and weapon configuration are identical to the Axman 6X, but the Thunderbolt launchers have two tons of ammunition each. It is also the only Axman to not carry its typical melee weapon. Instead, this carries a handheld Streak SRM-6 launcher. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - HandHeld Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 这是基于 AXM-6X 的生产型号。该版本于 3083 年推出，使用 Inner Sphere 生产的 XL 发动机，并且缺少 6X 的增压器。 6T的最高时速为86公里/小时。装甲防护和武器配置与 Axman 6X 相同，但雷电发射器各有两吨弹药。它也是唯一一个不携带典型近战武器的斧兵。相反，它携带手持式 Streak SRM-6 发射器。 Quirk：精确武器 - 手持 下降成本乘数： 1.09

column1: This is a production variant based on the AXM-6X. This version, introduced in 3083, uses an Inner Sphere–produced XL engine and lacks the supercharger of the 6X. The top speed of the 6T is 86 km/h. The armor protection and weapon configuration are identical to the Axman 6X, but the Thunderbolt launchers have two tons of ammunition each. It is also the only Axman to not carry its typical melee weapon. Instead, this carries a handheld unarmored NLRM-10 launcher. Quirk: Accurate Weapon - HandHeld Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.09
column2: 这是基于 AXM-6X 的量产型号，于 3083 年推出。它采用内圈制造的 XL 引擎，未配备 6X 的增压器，6T 最高速度为 86 km/h。装甲和武器配置与 Axman 6X 相同，但 Thunderbolt 发射器各配两吨弹药。它也是唯一不携带典型近战武器的 Axman，改为携带一具手持式无装甲 NLRM-10 发射器。 特质：精准武器 - 手持 部署费用倍率：1.09

column1: This is a strange one, boss. It's got that CLPS for stealth but it can also run and jump like the devil. This thing would be hell to track down.
column2: 这台很奇怪，Boss。它有 CLPS 用于隐形，却还能像恶魔一样奔跑和跳跃。追捕这东西会是噩梦。

column1: This is a tough light mech, true. The problem is the weaponry. The whole mech has less than 30 missile tubes and no other weapons. The so called self repair capabilites are mostly a gimick. It's like watching paint dry when damage happens, and it's only really useful for scratch damage from infantry weapons and the like.
column2: 这是一个坚固的轻型机械，确实如此。问题是武器装备。整个机甲只有不到三十个导弹管，没有其他武器。所谓的自我修复能力，大多都是噱头。这就像损坏发生时看着油漆变干一样，而且它只对步兵武器等造成的划痕损坏真正有用。

column1: This looted Viper retains its traditional high mobility and energy-resistant 装甲, but the weapons have been replaced with heavy inner-sphere pulse lasers. Living up to its inner-sphere nickname, this 'Dragonfly' packs a nasty punch at close range.
column2: 这台缴获的Viper保留了传统的高机动性和抗能量装甲，但武器换成了重型内天体脉冲激光器。它不负内天体方面赋予的“Dragonfly”绰号，在近距离拥有凶猛的打击力。

column1: This model is 生产 by both Oriente Weapon Works and 卡隆工业 using the latest innovations to move the Rifleman towards a more prominent role again. Compared to its brother 设计, the RFL-7N2, the RFL-7N focuses more on direct energy weapons over ballistics. This model is 生产 by both Oriente Weapon Works and 卡隆工业, although not in as great numbers as the -7N2. 怪癖: Anti-Air 定位 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 这台型号由东方武器工坊与卡隆工业共同制造，采用最新技术，试图让射手重新承担更重要的角色。与其兄弟型号RFL-7N2相比，RFL-7N更偏重直接能量武器，而非弹道武器。两家公司也制造了该型号，但产量不如-7N2。 特性：防空单位 击杀倍率：1.08 左上部装甲，右上部装甲

column1: This modification of the Kyudo replaces the LRM20 launcher with twinned SRM6 launchers coupled with Artemis IV fire control. A supercharger allows the '机甲 to reach speeds of over 100km/h, allowing it to easily close into range for its small laser banks. 怪癖: 易于驾驶 掉落成本乘数: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Upper
column2: 这次Kyudo改装用双联 SRM-6 发射器和 Artemis IV 火控系统替换 LRM-20 发射器。增压器让机甲速度超过 100 km/h，能够轻松接近目标并使用小型激光器阵列。 特性: 易于驾驶 部署费用倍率: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Upper

column1: This non-Omni 3083 version of the Hephaestus 侦察坦克 is equipped with a pair of ER 中型激光s, TAG, ECM Suite, and an 主动探头. The standard fusion 引擎 provides a maximum ground speed of nearly 150 km/h while five and a half tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲 protects the 坦克 while the hoverskirts have been reinforced with an 装甲ed Motive System. The most interesting feature, however, is the set of eight Jump Jets mounted in the body, which allows this hover坦克 to cover 240 米 in a single bound. Not since the Kanga has this system been deployed on a combat unit. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 9/14 格 / 270/420 米. 装甲: 铁纤维装甲(氏族) 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 120 20 左侧 120 20 右侧 120 20 后方 95 20 炮塔 110 20 总计 565 100 怪癖: Distracting
column2: 这款非全向的3083年Hephaestus侦察坦克装备两门ER中型激光器、TAG、ECM套件和主动探头。标准聚变引擎提供接近150 km/h的最高地面速度，5.5吨铁纤维装甲保护坦克，悬浮裙还由装甲机动系统强化。不过最有趣的特点是车体内安装的8具跳跃喷射器，使这辆气垫坦克一次跳跃即可跨越240米。自Kanga以来，还没有战斗单位部署过这样的系统。 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 9/14 格 / 270/420 米. 装甲: 铁纤维装甲(氏族) 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 120 20 左侧 120 20 右侧 120 20 后方 95 20 炮塔 110 20 总计 565 100 怪癖: 干扰

column1: This once was just an average commando but someone padded it up with spikes and grapplers all over, unfortunately the badly maintained actuators decrease its chance to punch anything.
column2: 它原本只是一台普通的 Commando，但有人给它全身加装尖刺和抓钩。遗憾的是，维护不善的驱动器降低了它成功出拳的机会。

column1: This one has been retrofitted with on land weapons instead of it's underwater original parts.
column2: 这台机甲用陆地武器替换了原本的水下部件。

column1: This one is tricked out with everything a ComStar Problem fixer could possibly want.
column2: 这个解决方案配备了 ComStar 问题修复者可能想要的一切。

column1: This one's a copycat, built by the Lyrans just to prove they could match the Hunchback, but lighter at 45 tons thanks to endo steel and double heat sinks. Stayed exclusive to the Commonwealth its whole life.
column2: 这是莱拉人为了证明自己能与 Hunchback 匹敌而造的仿制品。它采用内骨骼和双重散热器，重量减轻到 45 吨，并在整个服役期内始终只供莱拉联邦使用。

column1: This one's a one trick pony boss, built just to see if the ER PPC could work on something small. Center torso mount caused nasty electromagnetic interference when fired, chalked up to the design rather than the weapon itself. Only six were ever made.
column2: 这台机甲只有一个绝招，老大：它被制造出来只是为了测试增程 PPC 能否装在小型机体上。中央躯干挂载在开火时会产生严重电磁干扰，问题被归咎于设计而不是武器本身。总共只制造了六台。

column1: This one's a one trick pony boss, built just to see if the Snub-Nose PPC could work on something small. Center torso mount caused nasty electromagnetic interference when fired, chalked up to the design rather than the weapon itself. Only six were ever made.
column2: 老大，这台机甲就是个只会一招的家伙，专门用来验证短管 PPC 能不能装在小型机甲上。躯干中央安装方式在开火时造成严重电磁干扰，最后被认为是设计问题，而非武器本身的问题。总共只制造了六台。

column1: This one's a one trick pony boss, built just to see if the 短管PPC could work on something small. Center torso mount caused nasty electromagnetic interference when fired, chalked up to the design rather than the weapon itself. Only six were ever made.
column2: 老板，这台机甲只有一个用途：验证磁轨 PPC 能否安装在小型平台上。中央躯干安装导致开火时产生严重电磁干扰，问题被归咎于设计而非武器本身。最终只制造了六台。

column1: This one's a prototype through and through, boss. Built to test the Narc missile beacon back when the Hegemony was still keeping it secret. Endo steel, ferro-fibrous, XL engine, all cutting edge for its day. Most got scrapped for parts during the Clan exodus, real rare find now.
column2: 这是一个彻头彻尾的原型，老板。当霸权仍在保守秘密时，它是为了测试缉毒警察导弹信标而建造的。远藤钢、铁纤维、XL 发动机，都是当时最先进的。大多数在氏族大迁徙期间被拆解成零件，现在非常罕见。

column1: This one's a prototype through and through, boss. Built to test the Narc missile beacon back when the Hegemony was still keeping it secret. Endo steel, 铁纤维装甲, XL引擎, all cutting edge for its day. Most got scrapped for parts during the Clan exodus, real rare find now.
column2: 老板，这台从头到尾都是原型机。它最初用于测试Narc导弹信标，当时霸主还在严密保密。内骨骼、铁纤维装甲、XL引擎，在它的时代全都是尖端技术。氏族大迁徙期间，大多数原型被拆解取件；如今再找到一台实在罕见。

column1: This one's a testbed, built by House Liao to see how the snub-nose PPC performs. Simple design, no frills beyond the cannons and the heat sinks needed to run them. Project got canned inside a decade, most parts scavenged before the Amaris war even started.
column2: 这是测试平台，由廖氏家族制造，用来检验短管 PPC 的性能。设计简单，除了火炮和运行所需的散热器外没有多余装置。项目在十年内被取消，大多数部件在阿玛瑞战争开始前就已被拆作备件。

column1: This one's mostly a copycat, boss, based on Wasp blueprints stolen by Capellan Confederation agents. Only ever built for House Liao, and the factory got wiped out early in the Succession Wars so it never spread far before vanishing. Odd choice giving it five jump jets instead of six though.
column2: 老板，这台基本上是山寨货，设计基于卡佩兰联邦特工盗取的 Wasp 蓝图。它只为廖家制造过；工厂在继承战争初期被摧毁，因此还没来得及广泛传播就销声匿迹了。不过，把它设计成五具跳跃喷口而不是六具，确实有点奇怪。

column1: This one-off Q-Mech variant of the Chameleon hunted down and attacked senior officers in several academies across the Inner Sphere. It was equipped with a Heavy PPC and PPC Capacitor, and three Improved Heavy Medium Lasers tied into an advanced Clan Targeting Computer. An Angel ECM Suite is mounted in the center torso to disguise its weapons. Despite the increased scrutiny and security at academies caused by this 'Mech, it wasn't a success on the field, with only one confirmed KIA.
column2: 这是 Chameleon 的 Q-Mech 独有型号，曾在内圈多所学院猎杀并袭击高级军官。它配备一门重型 PPC 和 PPC 电容器，以及三门接入先进氏族瞄准计算机的改进型重型中型激光。中央躯干搭载 Angel ECM 套件以掩藏武器特征。尽管这台机甲促使各学院加强审查和安保，它在战场上并不成功，目前仅确认击杀一人。

column1: This one-off Q-Mech variant of the Chameleon hunted down and attacked senior officers in several academies across the Inner Sphere. It was equipped with a Heavy PPC and PPC Capacitor, and three Improved Heavy 中型激光s tied into an advanced 氏族瞄准计算机. An Angel ECM Suite is mounted in the center torso to disguise its weapons. Despite the increased scrutiny and security at academies caused by this 'Mech, it wasn't a success on the field, with only one confirmed KIA.
column2: 这台 Chameleon 的独特 Q-Mech 改型曾在内圈数所学院追杀并袭击高级军官。它装备重型 PPC 和 PPC 电容器，三具改进型重型中型激光器连接至先进氏族瞄准计算机。中央躯干安装天使 ECM 套件以隐藏武器。尽管学院因此加强审查和安保，这台机甲在战场上并不成功，仅确认击杀一人。

column1: This only really has one weapon, but it's a scary one! I don't know what voodoo the pirates worked on that AC/20, but I think I can hear it chanting quietly to itself in the mechbay.
column2: 它实际上只有一件武器，但那件武器非常吓人！我不知道海盗对那门 AC/20 施了什么巫术，但我觉得自己能听见它在机甲库里轻声吟唱。

column1: This overhaul replaces the lasers with 短管PPCs. The autocannons were replaced with the same number of 轻型自动炮/5s, along with enough ammo bins to take advantage of special munitions. It's also fitted with an additional double heat sink, giving this version of the Mauler adequate heat-dissipation capabilities.
column2: 此次检修用短管 PPC 取代了激光器。自动炮被替换为相同数量的轻型自动炮/5，以及足够的弹药箱以利用特殊弹药。它还配备了额外的双散热器，为该版本的 Mauler 提供了足够的散热能力。

column1: This particular Hammer was built by a Cavalry Military Man that had enough freedom and CBills to do it. Having it mainly built for harassment tactics, it 'only' sports a trio of SRM launchers and a backup trio of Medium Lasers. However, a MASC combined with the increased engine size lets this 'Mech run circles around anything and turn it to swiss cheese. Upgraded Double Heat Sinks make sure it doesn't run hot, while a Tag helps allies call down fire upon the enemy. I think I've seen this thing before on Solaris, Boss. Maybe there's more to this machine than it seems.
column2: 这台 Hammer 是一名有足够自主权和 C-Bill 的骑兵军官打造的。他主要将它用于袭扰战术，所以“只”装了三具 SRM 发射器和三门备用中型激光器。不过，MASC 配合更大的引擎，让这台机甲能绕着任何对手飞奔，把它打成筛子。升级型双倍散热器确保它不会过热，TAG 则可帮助友军呼叫火力支援。老大，我好像在 Solaris 见过这家伙。说不定它还有更多来头。

column1: This particular Hammer was built by a Cavalry Military Man that had enough freedom and CBills to do it. Having it mainly built for harassment tactics, it 'only' sports a trio of SRM launchers and a backup trio of 中型激光s. However, a MASC combined with the increased 引擎 size lets this 'Mech run circles around anything and turn it to swiss cheese. Upgraded 双散热器 make sure it doesn't run hot, while a Tag helps allies call down fire upon the enemy. I think I've seen this thing before on Solaris, Boss. Maybe there's more to this machine than it seems.
column2: 这台 Hammer 由一名拥有足够自由和资金的骑兵军官打造，主要用于骚扰战术，仅装备三具 SRM 发射器和三具中型激光器作为备用。然而，MASC 与加大的引擎结合后，让这台机甲能够绕着任何目标高速机动并将其打成蜂窝。升级型双散热器确保它不会过热，TAG 则帮助友军呼叫火力支援。我似乎在 Solaris 见过这东西，老板；这台机器可能比表面看起来更有来头。

column1: This particular Zeus model has seen some rather advanced Wobbie upgrades and sports some serious firepower while still maintaining the traditional speed they are known for.
column2: 这台 Zeus 型号接受了相当先进的沃比升级，仍保持其一贯的速度，同时拥有强大的火力。

column1: This particular model, already a rare prototype, has seen additional RISC enhancements alongduring its lifetime. This machine is a thing of beauty!
column2: 这台型号本已是罕见原型机，在服役期间又接受了额外的 RISC 强化。这台机器真是美得惊人！

column1: This periphery Hellspawn refit is missing all of its advanced electronics, but what's here is in pretty good shape. Ten and a half tons of ferro-fibrous armor over an endo-steel frame give it staying power, while leaving room for four medium lasers and this hotwired LRM launcher.
column2: 这具边缘区 Hellspawn 改装机缺少全部先进电子设备，但留下的部件状态相当不错。十吨半铁素体装甲覆盖在内构钢骨架上，赋予它持久力，同时还能容纳四门中型激光和这具热插线 LRM 发射器。

column1: This periphery Hellspawn refit is missing all of its advanced electronics, but what's here is in pretty good shape. Ten and a half tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲 over an endo-steel frame give it staying power, while leaving room for four 中型激光器 and this hotwired LRM launcher.
column2: 这台边疆Hellspawn改装机拆除了全部先进电子设备，但剩下的部件状态相当不错。十吨半的装甲覆盖在内骨骼钢框架上，为它提供持久力，同时还留出空间安装四门中型激光和这具硬接线的LRM发射器。

column1: This pricey option brings the laser platform variant up to modern standards, with a light fusion 引擎 and a supercharger providing blinding bursts of speed. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 14/21 格 / 420/630 米. 装甲: 重型铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 60 15 左侧 50 15 右侧 50 15 后方 45 15 炮塔 50 15 总计 255 75 怪癖: 窄/低调
column2: 这个昂贵选项让激光平台变体达到现代标准，配备轻型融合引擎和增压器，能够爆发出令人目眩的速度。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：14/21 格 / 420/630 米. 装甲： 重型铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 60 15 左侧 50 15 右侧 50 15 后方 45 15 炮塔 50 15 总计 255 75 特性：窄小低矮轮廓

column1: This rather unique Bushwacker seems to have been made to order by a rather obsessive RISC Engineer, sporting not only upgrades to its Electronics and Actuators, but firepower on par with far Heavier Mech's.
column2: 这款相当独特的 Bushwacker 似乎是由一位相当痴迷的 RISC 工程师定制的，不仅升级了电子设备和执行器，而且火力也与重型机甲相当。

column1: This refit of the 2B variant replaces the standard autocannon with a pair of Plasma Rifles. Though amazingly effective against battle armor, the Plasma Rifles can quickly run out of ammunition. Like many other newly manufactured machines the variant contains Stealth armor for better protection.
column2: 这款 2B 改型用一对等离子步枪替换标准自动炮。等离子步枪对付战斗装甲的效果惊人，但弹药很快就会耗尽。与许多新近制造的机体一样，该变体配备隐形装甲以增强防护。

column1: This refit of the 2B variant replaces the standard autocannon with a pair of 等离子步枪s. Though amazingly effective against battle 装甲, the 等离子步枪s can quickly run out of ammunition. Like many other newly manufactured machines the variant contains Stealth 装甲 for better protection.
column2: 这次改装以2B变体为基础，用一对短管步枪替换了标准自动火炮。短管步枪对战斗装甲极其有效，但弹药会很快耗尽。和许多新制造的机体一样，该变体配备隐形装甲以获得更好的防护。

column1: This reimagined Cascatelle is little more than a flying 长 Tom Cannon. Slow and carrying minimal supporting weaponry, it is nonetheless highly mobile for an 火炮 platform, relying on its raw destructive output to keep safely positioned. 生物群系限制: 该单位无法在月球生物群系部署。 移动: 6/9 格 / 180/270 米. 装甲: Integrated Laser AMS 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 225 30 左侧 155 30 右侧 155 30 后方 100 30 总计 660 150 怪癖: 集成探照灯
column2: 这台重新构想的Cascatelle几乎就是一门会飞的长汤姆加农炮。它速度缓慢、支援武器极少，却作为火炮平台拥有很高机动性，依靠原始破坏力确保自身处于安全位置。 生物群系限制: 该单位无法在月球生物群系部署。 移动: 6/9 格 / 180/270 米. 装甲: 集成激光AMS 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 225 30 左侧 155 30 右侧 155 30 后方 100 30 总计 660 150 怪癖: 集成探照灯

column1: This ridiculous experimental carries three Bombast Lasers on a prototype Crab chassis designed to reduce the Lasers' immense heat generation. Is it scary? Yes. Effective? Only in arctic conditions. Just evade it once and watch it try to cool off. Do NOT get hit by its Alpha though...
column2: 这款荒唐的实验机甲安装了三门 Bombast 激光器，搭载于经过改造、旨在降低激光器巨大热量的 Crab 原型底盘上。它吓人吗？是的。实用吗？只有在极地环境中才算。只要避开它的攻击，再看它想办法冷却就行。但千万别被它的全弹齐射命中……

column1: This ridiculous experimental carries three 浮夸激光s on a prototype Crab chassis designed to reduce the Lasers' immense heat generation. Is it scary? Yes. Effective? Only in arctic conditions. Just evade it once and watch it try to cool off. Do NOT get hit by its Alpha though...
column2: 这台荒谬的试验机将三门浮夸激光器安装在经过改造的Crab底盘上，专门降低激光器巨大的热量产生。它可怕吗？是的。有效吗？只有在极地环境中有效。躲过一次攻击，然后看它努力冷却。千万别被它的全弹齐射命中……

column1: This started as a fairly normal Crosscut X5M, and then some crazy fool ripped out the nice light AC2 and put a hotwired PPC in it's place. The scary thing is that it can take the heat. Oh, and watch out for the downright terrifying missile pack they bolted on too.
column2: 一开始是一台相当普通的 Crosscut X5M，然后一些疯狂的傻瓜拆掉了漂亮的轻型 AC2，并在其位置上放了一个热连线的 PPC。可怕的是它可以承受热量。哦，还要注意他们还安装的彻头彻尾可怕的导弹包。

column1: This striker configuration carries a pair of ER medium lasers in each arm, supported by another ER medium laser in the right torso and a plasma cannon with a ton of ammunition in the left torso. An extra double heat sink is carried in the center torso. Quirk: 改进型传感器 Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.99 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这款突击配置的每条手臂各装有一对 ER 中型激光，右躯干另有一门 ER 中型激光作为支援；左躯干则配备一门等离子炮和 1 吨弹药。中央躯干还装有一台额外的双重散热器。 特性：改进型传感器 部署费用倍率：0.99 手臂执行器限制：Omni

column1: This striker configuration carries a pair of ER 中型激光器 in each arm, supported by another ER 中型激光器 in the right torso and a plasma cannon with a ton of ammunition in the left torso. An extra double heat sink is carried in the center torso. 特性：改进型传感器 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 该突击配置双臂各携带两门ER中型激光器，右侧躯干另有一门ER中型激光器，左侧躯干装有一门等离子炮和一吨弹药。中央躯干还携带一组额外双重散热器。 特性：改进型传感器 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: This thing can really soar. If you ever get bored inside it during patrol duty, just found a local mountain top and jump on top of it. Just don't blame me when you come falling down due to excessive heat.
column2: 这东西真的能飞得很高。如果巡逻时在里面感到无聊，就找座当地山峰跳上去吧。只是别在因过热掉下来时怪我。

column1: This thing dates back to 2501, which means it was already ancient when the Star League collapsed. New Earth Trading Company built it, Earthwerks kept producing it, and somehow examples survived all the way to now. The jump jets on an assault mech that size were a big deal when it was new and honestly they still are. Getting one of these out of salvage is finding a piece of history that can still punch a hole through most of what it faces.
column2: 这东西可以追溯到 2501 年，也就是说，星盟崩溃时它就已经是古董了。新地球贸易公司建造了它，地球工坊一直负责生产，不知怎么的，居然还有样机一路留存到了今天。这么大的突击机甲上安装的跳跃喷射器，在它刚问世时可是不得了的配置，说实话现在依然如此。能从打捞物中找到一台这样的机体，就等于发现了一段仍能在战场上给大多数对手开个洞的历史。

column1: This thing has pretty good damage potential with flexible range, and the iATM system makes efficient uses of ammo. But it lacks focused pinpoint damage.
column2: 这东西拥有不错的伤害潜力和灵活射程，iATM 系统也能高效利用弹药。但它缺乏集中、精确的爆发伤害。

column1: This thing is built like a cockroach, there's no denying that. The issue is the firepower. It's only got eight SRM tubes on the whole mech, other than those grenades it lugs around.
column2: 这东西的构造就像蟑螂一样，这是不可否认的。问题是火力。整个机甲上只有八个 SRM 管，除了它随身携带的手榴弹。

column1: This thing is fast and packs a punch! Good luck keeping up with it when the Supercharge is enabled, and when it stops...hide!
column2: 这东西速度快，威力大！祝你好运，当超级充电启用时，能跟上它；当超级充电停止时……隐藏！

column1: This thing is fast and that ion projector thingy-ma-bob concerns the hell out of me.
column2: 这东西速度很快，而那个离子投射器之类的玩意儿让我非常不安。

column1: This thing is just silly, boss. One half of the mech is just full of heatsinks. I don't think there's a single heatsink left in the engine itself, which has been stripped down the the very minimum required to run a mech this size. All to fit two of those knock-off artillery pieces into a light mech, for some reason I cannot fathom.
column2: 这东西简直荒谬，Boss。机体一半空间全塞了散热器。我怀疑引擎里一个散热器都没留下，只保留了让这种尺寸的机甲运转所需的最低配置。就为了把两门仿制火炮塞进轻型机甲，我实在无法理解。

column1: This thing is just silly, boss. One half of the mech is just full of heatsinks. I don't think there's a single heatsink left in the 引擎 itself, which has been stripped down the the very minimum required to run a mech this size. All to fit two of those knock-off 火炮 pieces into a light mech, for some reason I cannot fathom.
column2: 这东西太荒唐了，老板。机甲的一半都塞满了散热器。我觉得引擎里甚至没剩下一台散热器，因为它已经被削减到驱动这个尺寸机甲所需的最低限度。所有这一切，只是为了不知为何把两门山寨火炮塞进一台轻型机甲。

column1: This thing is terrifying, boss. While it's a poor excuse for an assault mech in several areas, you do not want to be down range of this thing when it fires. It can spit PPC flavored death at you all day long. On the other hand, if you charge the thing, it's as helpless as a 80 ton bipedal machine can be.
column2: 这东西太可怕了，Boss。虽然它在几个方面都算不上合格的突击机甲，但你绝对不想站在它的射界里。它可以整天向你喷吐 PPC 形态的死亡。另一方面，只要你冲到它身边，它就会像一台 80 吨的双足机器一样无助。

column1: This thing is wild, Boss. Seems like the RISC engineers left those blazing-hot pulse lasers on the arms, but removed the Clan ATMs and instead filled out the torsos with their own brand of specialty missiles and a heavy-duty AMS.
column2: 老板，这东西太疯狂了。RISC工程师似乎保留了手臂上那些炽热的脉冲激光，却拆掉氏族ATM，改在躯干中塞满自家特种导弹和重型AMS。

column1: This thing may be a bit slow, boss, but this thing seems purpose built to demolish everything in a certain area.
column2: 这东西可能有点慢，Boss，但它显然是专门用来摧毁某一片区域内的一切的。

column1: This thing may be a bit slow, boss, but those AC20s with Ares TPS are going to really hurt anything in range.
column2: 这东西可能有点慢，老板，但那两门装有阿瑞斯TPS的AC/20足以重创射程内的任何目标。

column1: This thing may be sold as an E-war mech, but that's no excuse to only give it one gun. If I were you I'd rip out some of the unnecessary weight and give it some proper weaponry. Oh, and watch that left arm, the whole thing is packed with ammo.
column2: 这东西可以被宣传成电子战机甲，但这可不是只给它一把枪的借口。如果我是你，我会拆掉一些多余重量，给它装上真正的武器。还有，盯紧左臂，整条手臂都塞满了弹药。

column1: This thing must've been crazy impressive in its time, Boss. Artemis fire controllers, Chameleon LPS, Gauss rifles ... yeah. This was something, alright. Funnily enough, the parts aren't that hard to find these days - even if the 'Mech is once you've built it.
column2: 老大，这东西在当年肯定厉害得离谱。Artemis 火控、变色龙 LPS、高斯步枪……没错，确实是个狠角色。有意思的是，如今这些零件倒不难找；难找的是你把它拼好之后的那台机甲。

column1: This thing must've been crazy impressive in its time, Boss. Artemis fire controllers, 变色龙偏振护盾, Gauss rifles ... yeah. This was something, alright. Funnily enough, the parts aren't that hard to find these days - even if the 'Mech is once you've built it.
column2: 这东西在它的时代一定令人印象深刻，老板。Artemis 火控系统、蓝盾偏转护盾、高斯步枪……没错，这确实是了不起的设计。奇怪的是，如今零件并不难找——即使这台机甲在组装完成后就已经损坏。

column1: This unusual Sea Wolf configuration was designed and piloted by saKhan Savarok of Clan Ghost Bear. This loadout carries a unique Railgun, designed specifically for punching holes in large fortified targets, fused to the chassis. Using this 'Mech allowed Savarok to get the killing blow on the first confirmed 'Mech kill of a Rattler Mobile Fortress. Quirk: Multi Trac Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.42 Arm Actuator Limits: Omni
column2: 这种不寻常的海狼配置是由幽灵熊氏族的萨汗·萨瓦洛克设计和驾驶的。该装备携带独特的轨道炮，专为在大型防御目标上打孔而设计，并与底盘融合在一起。使用这个机甲让萨瓦洛克在第一次确认的机甲击杀响尾蛇移动堡垒时获得了致命一击。 Quirk：多Trac 下降成本乘数：1.42 Arm 执行器限制： Omni

column1: This upgrade made use of double heat sinks and used the tonnage saved to max out the 装甲 on the Annihilator. Offensively, four ER 中型激光s and eight 轻型自动炮/2s were incredibly accurate thanks to the inclusion of a 定位 Computer. Ample autocannon ammunition (five tons) allowed flexibility when choosing special munitions, making this '机甲 非常有效 against 车辆s. To fit all this equipment, a Compact 引擎 and 紧凑型陀螺仪 are mounted in the center torso. The '机甲 is protected by 轻型铁纤维装甲-Fibrous 装甲 and CASE.
column2: 该升级型采用双重散热器，并将节省的重量全部用于提高Annihilator的装甲。进攻方面，四门ER中型激光器和八门轻型自动炮/2因瞄准计算机而拥有极高精度。充足的自动炮弹药（五吨）让驾驶员能够灵活选择特殊弹药，使这台机甲对车辆极其有效。为容纳全部设备，中央躯干安装紧凑型引擎和紧凑型陀螺仪。机甲由轻型铁纤维装甲和CASE保护。

column1: This upgrade of the 8S was 生产 by 迪法恩斯工业 at their Kwangjong-ni annex while 布雷克圣言会 held Hesperus II. It retains the light 引擎 of earlier models, but returns to the speed of the earliest versions. It carries a Defiance 753 Heavy PPC, Defiance 250 Light PPC, and Poland Main Model A Gauss Rifle for long range combat. Should an enemy survive long enough to close with the 9S, it can utilize three Defiance E3M ER 中型激光s and a single Defiance B3M 中型激光. A TharHes Maxi SRM-6 can exploit weaknesses in an opposing unit's 装甲, while CASE keeps the ammunition from doing too much damage in the event of an explosion. In order to make room for all of these things, the XL Gyro of the 8S is also retained. Finally, a 定位 Computer improves the accuracy of all the weapons except for the missile launcher.
column2: 这一8S升级型由迪法恩斯工业在布雷克圣言会占领Hesperus II期间，于其Kwangjong-ni分厂生产。它保留早期型号的轻型引擎，却恢复了最早版本的速度。远程作战武器包括Defiance 753重型PPC、Defiance 250轻型PPC和Poland Main Model A高斯步枪。若敌人存活到足以接近9S，它还能使用三门Defiance E3M ER中型激光器和一门Defiance B3M中型激光器。TharHes Maxi SRM-6可利用敌方装甲弱点，CASE则能在爆炸时防止弹药造成过大伤害。为容纳全部设备，8S的XL陀螺仪也被保留。最后，瞄准计算机提高了除导弹发射器外所有武器的精度。

column1: This upgrade of the Legacy utilizes a Light Fusion Engine to increase the 'Mech's top speed to 64 km/h, though its jumping capacity does not increase commensurately. All of the 'Mech's backup weapons remain the same, but the autocannons are replaced with a pair of Heavy PPCs. The 'Mech's heat dissipation capability has also not kept up, utilizing only fourteen double heat sinks.
column2: Legacy 的这一升级型使用轻型聚变引擎，将最高速度提高到 64 km/h，但跳跃能力没有同步增加。所有备用武器保持不变，自动炮则换成一对重型 PPC。机甲散热能力也没有跟上，仅使用 14 具双重散热器。

column1: This upgrade of the Legacy utilizes a Light Fusion 引擎 to increase the '机甲's top speed to 64 km/h, though its jumping capacity does not increase commensurately. All of the '机甲's backup weapons remain the same, but the autocannons are replaced with a pair of Heavy PPCs. The '机甲's heat dissipation capability has also not kept up, utilizing only fourteen double heat sinks.
column2: Legacy 的升级型使用轻型聚变引擎，将机甲最高速度提高到 64 km/h，但跳跃能力没有相应提升。所有备用武器保持不变，自动炮替换为一对重型 PPC；散热能力也未跟上，只使用 14 具双散热器。

column1: This upgrade of the R40 model drops both the ER large laser and medium pulse laser, one ton of ammo, and an actuator to add an XL gyro, stealth armor, Guardian ECM suite and a PPC with PPC capacitor.
column2: 该 R40 型号升级版拆除增程大型激光、中型脉冲激光、一吨弹药和一具驱动器，换装 XL 陀螺仪、隐形装甲、Guardian ECM 套件以及带 PPC 电容器的 PPC。

column1: This upgrade of the R40 model drops both the ER large laser and medium pulse laser, one ton of ammo, and an actuator to add an XL gyro, stealth 装甲, 守护者ECM suite and a PPC with PPC capacitor.
column2: R40型号的升级版去掉了ER大型激光器和中型脉冲激光器、一吨弹药和一个致动器，以添加XL陀螺仪、隐形装甲、守护者ECM套件和带有PPC电容器的PPC。

column1: This variant carries a Snub-Nose PPC, Small Pulse Laser, TAG, Beagle Active Probe, and Guardian ECM Suite. It retains the Small Laser of the standard UrbanMech as well. Improved Jump Jets help the UrbanMech move around the city it defends more effectively.
column2: 该变体装备短鼻 PPC、小型脉冲激光器、TAG、比格犬主动探测器和守护者 ECM，同时保留标准 UrbanMech 的小型激光器。改进型跳跃喷射器让 UrbanMech 能在自己守护的城市中更灵活地移动。

column1: This variant carries a 短管PPC, 小型脉冲激光, TAG, 比格犬主动探头, and 守护者ECM Suite. It retains the Small Laser of the standard UrbanMech as well. 改进型跳跃推进器 help the UrbanMech move around the city it defends more effectively.
column2: 该变体携带短管PPC、小型脉冲激光、TAG、比格犬感应探头和守护者ECM套件。它还保留了标准 UrbanMech 的小型激光器。 改进型跳跃推进器帮助UrbanMech更有效地在其防御的城市周围移动。

column1: This variant carries an ER PPC, TAG, Beagle Active Probe, and Guardian ECM Suite. It retains the Small Laser of the standard UrbanMech as well. Improved Jump Jets help the UrbanMech move around the city it defends more effectively.
column2: 该变体配备一门增程 PPC、TAG、比格犬主动探测器和守护者 ECM 系统，同时保留标准 UrbanMech 的小型激光器。改进型跳跃喷射器让 UrbanMech 能在自己守护的城市中更灵活地移动。

column1: This variant carries an ER PPC, TAG, 比格犬主动探头, and 守护者ECM Suite. It retains the Small Laser of the standard Urban机甲 as well. 改进的 Jump Jets help the Urban机甲 move around the city it defends more effectively.
column2: 该变体携带 ER PPC、TAG、比格犬激发探头和守护者 ECM 套件。它还保留了标准城市机甲的小型激光。 改进的跳跃喷气机帮助城市机甲更有效地在其防御的城市周围移动。

column1: This variant developed in 3068 replaces the Guardian ECM suite with an Improved C3 Computer. The Medium Pulse Lasers have been replaced with two ER Medium Lasers.
column2: 该变体于 3068 年研发，以改进型 C3 计算机取代守护者 ECM 系统，并将中型脉冲激光器换成两门增程中型激光器。

column1: This variant developed in 3068 replaces the 守护者ECM suite with an Improved C3 Computer. The 中型脉冲激光s have been replaced with two ER 中型激光s.
column2: 该变体于3068年研发，以改进型C3计算机取代守护者ECM套件；原有的中型脉冲激光则替换为两门增程中型激光。

column1: This variant is a capable knife fighter. Six Jump Jets give it a maximum jumping distance of 180 meters. A 短管PPC deals damage at long range, but is more powerful up close. A pair of 中型脉冲激光s are highly accurate, as are the twin 小型脉冲激光s that are so devastating against infantry.
column2: 该配置擅长近距离缠斗。六具跳跃推进器使最大跳跃距离达到180米。短管粒子加农炮可在远距离造成伤害，近距离威力更强；一对中型脉冲激光精度很高，双联小型脉冲激光对步兵也极具杀伤力。

column1: This variant is as if a later Marauder design was meshed with the base variant of the Bandersnatch. As to if it is an upgrade or not, I leave for you to decide.
column2: 这个型号仿佛将后期 Marauder 设计与 Bandersnatch 基础型号熔为一体。至于它到底算不算升级，就留给你判断。

column1: This variant is as if a later Marauder 设计 was meshed with the base variant of the Bandersnatch. As to if it is an upgrade or not, I leave for you to decide.
column2: 这个型号仿佛将后期的掠夺者设计与班德斯纳奇的基础型号融合在一起。它究竟算不算升级，就留给你来判断。

column1: This variant is built using a Hollis Marik III Endo Steel chassis and powered by a Magna 260 extralight engine, using the saved weight to make the C2 a dedicated long range 'Mech. The primary weapon of this upgrade consists of 2 Extended LRM-15's with 4 tons of ammo backed up by 2 Light PPCs.
column2: 该型号采用 Hollis Marik III 内构钢底盘，由 Magna 260 额外轻型引擎驱动，并利用节省的重量将 C2 打造成专用远程机甲。这个升级型号的主武器是两具增程 LRM-15 和四吨弹药，另有两门轻型 PPC 提供支援。

column1: This variant is built using a Hollis Marik III Endo Steel chassis and powered by a Magna 260 extralight engine, using the saved weight to make the C2 a dedicated long range 'Mech. The primary weapons are two Federated LRM-15 launchers mated to an Artemis IV fire control system. The 中型激光s have been replaced with two Defiance Shredder LB-X Autocannon/2s. While this makes the Catapult vulnerable to close range attacks, it also makes it extremely deadly at long range.

The left arm mounts the '机甲's energy weapons, which consists of two standard 中型激光s and a single 中型脉冲激光.
column2: 这个改型于圣战最激烈的时期推出。H-11 双臂各装有一具重型自动炮，中央躯干储存四吨弹药。左右侧面躯干各安装一具五管多用途导弹发射器，每具发射器配备两吨由 CASE 保护的弹药。左臂安装该机甲的能量武器，包括两具标准中型激光器和一具中型脉冲激光器。

column1: This variant, introduced during the Jihad, uses advanced technology. Major changes to allow more equipment include the introduction of a Light Fusion Engine and a Heavy Duty Gyro. The left arm now has a Large Variable Speed Pulse Laser with a pair of Magshots. In the right arm, there are a pair of ER Medium Lasers. The left torso has retained its CASE protection to keep the 'Mech safe in the event of a Magshot ammunition explosion.

column1: This version of the Rommel removes the standard weaponry and replaces it with weapons that are allegedly easier for newer troops to use and less likely to fall victim to electronic warfare or Anti-Missile systems. The main gun is a Long Tom Artillery Cannon. This weapon can inflict massive amounts of damage on the target and its immediate surroundings and it doesn't require a great gunner. The LRM-5 was replaced by a Thunderbolt 5 launcher to provide more punch. The Rommel tank is a 65-ton armored combat vehicle, specializing in close range fighting and urban combat. Identical to its twin, the Patton, in every way but armament and armor configuration, the Rommel has primarily served with the Lyran Commonwealth and the Lyran Alliance. It is named after Field Marshal Erwin Rommel, a legendary commander of armored and mechanized forces renowned for his exploits during World War II on Terra. The Rommel was designed concurrently with the Patton in the early 3000s, when Defiance Industries decided that an armored combat vehicle capable of replacing 'Mechs was needed. The main gun is a Long Tom Artillery Cannon. This weapon can inflict massive amounts of damage on the target and its immediate surroundings and it doesn't require a great gunner. The LRM-5 was replaced by a Thunderbolt 5 launcher to provide more punch. The engine is an expensive XL model, later dropped to a standard for the production version. The Rommel tank is a 65-ton armored combat vehicle, specializing in close range fighting and urban combat. Identical to its twin, the Patton, in every way but armament and armor configuration, the Rommel has primarily served with the Lyran Commonwealth and the Lyran Alliance. It is named after Field Marshal Erwin Rommel, a legendary commander of armored and mechanized forces renowned for his exploits during World War II on Terra. column1: This version uses an experimental 350-rated XXL 引擎, a Laser Anti Missile System, and a pair of Improved Heavy 中型激光器. The Jade Falcon engineers who designed it also installed an XL Gyro and used Heavy 铁纤维装甲 装甲 to protect the chassis. 特性：Narrow/Low Profile 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂, 右上臂

column2: 该型号据称由星盟制造。它从PHX-HK1R上移除了猎犬主动探测器和一门中型激光，换成一台改进型C3计算机。短管PPC得到保留，剩余两门激光则升级为延伸射程型号。

column2: 这个版本显然是布雷克圣言会创建的，因为它从PHX-HK1R上移除了比格犬探头和中型激光，并用改进的C3计算机取代了该设备。短管 PPC 保留下来，剩下的两个激光器是增程型号。

column1: This version was created before the introduction of the PHX-HK2, in 2695. It removed the ER Large Laser, a 中型激光, and two heat sinks, replacing them with an experimental 短管PPC, 比格犬主动探头, and an additional half ton of armor.
column2: 该版本在 PHX-HK2 于 2695 年推出之前制造。它拆除了增程大型激光器、中型激光器和两组散热器，换装实验型短管 PPC、主动探测器，并增加半吨装甲。

column1: This version was introduced by House Kurita in 3077. A Heavy Duty Gyro allows it to stay in the fight longer, making good use of twin 短管PPCs and ER 中型激光s. Though it's slightly slower than the standard Ostroc, jump jets allow it to maneuver around the battlefield, striking where it will inflict the most damage. After the Jihad ended, this model went into factory production.
column2: 该型号由库里塔家族于3077年推出。重型陀螺仪让它能在战场上坚持更久，并充分发挥双联短管PPC和ER中型激光的威力。虽然速度略低于标准奥斯卓克，但跳跃喷射器使它能在战场上灵活机动，攻击最能造成伤害的位置。圣战结束后，该型号进入工厂量产。

column1: This version was 生产 for 玉鹰氏族 by Red Devil Industries in 3083. Using an experimental XXL 引擎 and 改进的 Jump Jets to provide mobility, the chassis is protected by 铁纤维装甲 装甲. Each arm mounts an ER Large Laser and 改进的 Heavy 中型激光. 怪癖: Anti-Air 定位 掉落成本乘数: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 该型号由Red Devil Industries于3083年为玉鹰氏族生产。它采用实验性的XXL引擎和改进型跳跃喷射器来提供机动性，底盘由铁纤维装甲保护。每条手臂都装有一门ER大型激光和一门改进型重型中型激光。 特性：防空定位 部署费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左侧上臂，右侧上臂

column1: This version, introduced in 3079, used a light fusion 引擎 that reduced the '机甲's top speed, though engineers installed improved jump jets to compensate. The 240 meter jump range allowed the 凤鹰 to use the light PPC and ER 中型激光器 in each arm to great effect.[46] Additionally a 守护者ECM suite helps jam enemy networks, a heavy-duty gyro allows the '机甲 to hang in a fight longer, and a full-head ejection system protects the pilot. 怪癖: 改进的 Communications 掉落成本乘数: 1.03
column2: 这款3079年推出的型号采用轻型聚变引擎，降低了机甲最高速度；工程师则安装改进型跳跃喷射器进行补偿。240米跳跃距离让凤鹰能够充分发挥双臂各一门轻型PPC和ER中型激光器的威力。此外，守护者ECM套件可干扰敌方网络，重型陀螺仪让机甲在战斗中坚持更久，全头弹射系统则保护驾驶员。 怪癖: 改进的 Communications 掉落成本乘数: 1.03

column1: This was originally the personal Battle Armor of legendary Warrior Bearing Banacek, callsign 'Bearing'. The 'Baracas' is a variation of the Rogue Bear originally designed and produced by Clan Ghost Bear. The 'Baracas' is a heavy battlesuit fitted with stealth and heavy VibroClaws It also comes armed with Battle Armor versions of MicroPulse Lasers and a PPC. It is protected by almost enough armor to stop a Gauss rifle.
column2: 这原本是传奇战士 Bearing Banacek（呼号“Bearing”）的私人战斗装甲。'Baracas' 是 Rogue Bear 的一个变体，最初由幽灵熊氏族设计并生产。'Baracas' 是一套配备隐形系统和重型振动爪的重型战斗服。它还装备战斗装甲版微型脉冲激光与 PPC，装甲厚到几乎能挡住高斯步枪。

column1: This was originally the personal BattleMech of legendary MechWarrior Khan Darkan K'Haos, callsign "Dark Khaos".
column2: 这原本是传奇机甲战士 Darkan K'Haos 可汗的私人战斗机甲，呼号“Dark Khaos”。

column1: This was test-bed '机甲 which was fitted out with experimental weaponry and equipment by Warrior House Imarra. The Jinggau's main weaponry was replaced with an experimental Sniper Cannon and four 中型X脉冲激光 Lasers. The '机甲 was equipped with an XL Gyro, TAG, and a C3 Slave. 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 这是 Warrior House Imarra 为试验武器和设备改装的试验台机甲。Jinggau 主武器换成实验狙击炮和四具中型 X 脉冲激光器，并装备 XL 陀螺仪、TAG 和 C3 从属单元。 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: This 布雷克圣言会 variant replaces the torso weapons with an 改进的 C3 Computer and four plasma rifles. The arms retain the ER 中型激光 of the original Fafnir. It also carries twenty-two double heat sinks. 怪癖: 稳定 Weapons 掉落成本乘数: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 该布雷克圣言会改型用改进型 C3 计算机和四具等离子步枪替换躯干武器，双臂保留原版 Fafnir 的 ER 中型激光器，并携带 22 具双散热器。 怪癖: 稳定 Weapons 掉落成本乘数: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: This 雷马 was named after Dragoons, ancient Terran warriors that rode to battle on horseback to then dismount and fight on foot. Some History buff named this 机甲, don't ask me where he learned all that history from though. This 雷马 comes equipped with a Heavy PPC, one 重型高斯步枪 and two Clan LRM20's. While not as fast as its namesake, this thing will still provide ample support from the rear or flanks. It can be counted on to do this well, with Sniper Sensors for eyes and an Angel ECM for ears.
column2: 这台机甲以古代骑马作战、随后下马步战的地球龙骑兵命名。某位历史爱好者给它取了这个名字，别问他从哪里学来的历史。它装备重型 PPC、一具高斯步枪和两具氏族 LRM-20。虽然不像名字来源那样迅速，但仍能从后方或侧翼提供充足支援；狙击手传感器负责观察，天使 ECM 负责监听。

column1: This 驼背 IIC was in use for Clan Wolf... Wait, something here is wrong. The Clan Wolf emblem looks like an actual kid painted it. The colors are wrong too. Look at the weapons, those aren't AC20's, they're 化学激光s. What insane lunatic made this... thing! The IFF codes read Clan Wolf, but this looks like a Hunchback-4P stuffed with all those lasers. The e-sig reads that there are several Clan Battle computers in here… Boss, the mix of Inner Sphere and Clan Technology actually hurts my brain. If I didn't know any better, this was purpose built to confuse Clanners. They do know this is not very honorable... 右侧? 右侧???
column2: 这台 Hunchback IIC 曾在狼氏族服役……等等，这里不对劲。狼氏族徽记看起来像是小孩画的，颜色也完全错误。看看武器，那不是 AC/20，而是一堆能量激光器。到底是哪个疯子制造了这东西！敌我识别代码显示它属于狼氏族，但看起来却像把 Hunchback-4P 塞满了激光器。电子信号显示内部装有数台氏族战斗计算机。老板，内圈与氏族技术的混合简直让人头疼。如果不是亲眼所见，我会以为这是专门用来迷惑氏族人的。难道他们不知道这样一点也不荣誉……右臂？左臂？？？

column1: Though bearing a remarkable outward resemblance to the Timberwolf, this BattleMech is a new and powerful creation. This variant removes the Gauss Rifles and Jump Jets and replaces them with a HAG/30 in each arm. The side torsos each mount an LRM-10 and a pair of ER 中型激光s. A 轻型 主动探头 is mounted in the head, and the remaining tonnage is given over to more 装甲 protection.
column2: 虽然外形极其像 Timberwolf，这台战斗机甲却是全新的强力设计。该型号拆除高斯步枪和跳跃喷射器，改为双臂各装一门 HAG/30。两侧躯干各安装一具 LRM-10 和一对增程中型激光器。头部装有轻型主动探头，剩余吨位全部用于增加装甲防护。

column1: Though bearing a remarkable outward resemblance to the Timberwolf, this Battle机甲 is a new and powerful creation. Carrying thirteen tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲, the Mad Cat MK II is an incredibly resilient 设计. A pair of arm mounted Gauss Rifles supported by torso mounted LRM racks give it complete command over the battlefield. 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - Medium 掉落成本乘数: 1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 虽然外形与Timberwolf极为相似，但这台战斗机甲是全新而强大的设计。Mad Cat MK II携带十三吨铁纤维装甲，是极其坚韧的型号。双臂安装的高斯步枪与躯干安装的LRM发射架相互支援，使其能够全面掌控战场。 特性：改进的定位 - 中 部署费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左侧下臂，右侧下臂

column1: Though the Stinger IIC has a relatively low ground speed by Jihad Era standards, it is still fast enough to act as a harasser unit as well as a recon platform. The 180 meter jump capability is also useful, allowing the pilot to get out of tight terrain very quickly. The upgraded 装甲 protection is valued by those warriors used to the older Stinger as well, but this 装甲 is still too light to allow the '机甲 to operate in a stand up fight. 怪癖: Ubiquitous 掉落成本乘数: 1.01
column2: 尽管Stinger IIC按圣战时代标准而言地面速度较低，但仍足以担任骚扰单位和侦察平台。180米跳跃能力也很有用，能让驾驶员迅速脱离复杂地形。升级后的装甲防护同样受到熟悉旧款Stinger的战士重视，但这层装甲仍太薄，无法让机甲正面作战。 特性：无处不在 部署费用倍率：1.01

column1: Titan II 在各种射程都能有效作战，但仍保留前身作为近战斗士的特点。它的主要远程火力来自一门 Blankenburg Divine Wrath 重型 PPC，并由一对 Helga MML-9 补充，后者在近距离更有效。接近敌人后，Titan II 还能使用 ZT Triple Fire Streak SRM-6、四门 Diplan M3-XR 增程中型激光和一门 Kressly Premiere Optics 增程小型激光全力开火。通常，18 具双重散热器足以让机甲保持冷却。

column1: Trust pirates to ruin a perfectly good fire support platform. This has got half the firepower it should in the stock format; and in exchange you get that massive AMS monstrocity.
column2: 相信海盗，他们总能毁掉一台完美的火力支援平台。它只有标准配置一半的火力，换来的却是那座巨大的AMS怪物。

column1: Twenty tons, Clan Omni, running at over 120 kph. Speed like that on a frame this light — it is impressive engineering, I will give Clan Burrock that. Shame about the Dark Caste connection. The pod space is tight at seven tons, so every config is making hard choices. Some do it well. Some less so. Whoever pilots one needs to keep moving and stay smart about range.
column2: 20 吨重的氏族全能机甲，速度超过 120 公里/小时。如此轻的底盘能有这种速度，确实是出色的工程，我得承认布洛克氏族做得不错。可惜它和黑暗氏族扯上了关系。挂载舱只有 7 吨，空间很紧，所以每种配置都必须做出取舍。有些配置做得很好，有些就差些。驾驶它的人必须持续移动，并时刻注意交战距离。

column1: Ummm... Huh? It's a 'Mech painted in the color scheme of a Triple F Cheeseburger. And it's got a freaking TOPHAT! This one's got the firing triggers all crosswired together with a big button that has 'Get over here for your Special Sauce, Lettuce, and Cheese' pasted over it.
column2: 嗯……嗯？这是一个采用 Triple F 芝士汉堡配色方案绘制的“机甲”。而且它还有一个可怕的顶帽！这个触发器的触发装置全部交叉连接在一起，上面有一个大按钮，上面贴着“到这里来买你的特制酱汁、生菜和奶酪”。

column1: Unlike its cousin, the CRB-21 fields Light Autocannon/5s and MML Launchers, while retaining most of its energy weaponry. Practically every aspect of the 'Mech has been upgraded from the stock version.
column2: 与同族型号不同，CRB-21 使用轻型自动火炮/5 和 MML 发射器，同时保留大部分能量武器。机体几乎每个方面都比标准版本有所升级。

column1: Used by RISC as a testbed, this King Crab has been rebuilt from the ground up with experimental technology.
column2: 这款帝王蟹被 RISC 用作测试平台，并通过实验技术从头开始重建。

column1: Used by RISC as a testbed, this Orion has been rebuilt from the ground up with experimental technology.
column2: Orion 被 RISC 用作测试平台，并通过实验技术从头开始重建。

column1: Used by The Society's MechWarriors, this version of the Timber Wolf carries twin iATM 9 missile launchers with four tons of ammunition. Each arm carries an ER Large Laser and an ER Medium Pulse Laser. To maximize its battlefield utility it also carries a Nova CEWS in the center torso.
column2: 该版本的木狼由协会的机甲战士使用，携带两个 iATM 9 导弹发射器，弹药量为四吨。每只手臂都携带一个 ER 大型激光器和一个 ER 中型脉冲激光器。为了最大限度地发挥其战场效用，它还在躯干中央配备了 Nova CEWS。

column1: Used by the Word of Blake's Protectorate Militia in 3078, this Archer variant carried a pair of ER Large Lasers and Artemis IV-enhanced LRM-15 launchers, with a maximum speed of 58 km/h. For protection, the 9W used an experimental Angel ECM Suite and Void Signature System.
column2: 圣言之子保护国民兵于 3078 年使用这款 Archer 变体，装备两门增程大型激光器和两具配备 Artemis IV 制导系统的 LRM-15 发射器，最高速度为 58 千米/时。9W 使用实验型天使 ECM 系统和虚空特征系统提供防护。

column1: Used by the commander of Youling Zhanshi, the Snake Arthur is equipped with Stealth Armor and Guardian ECM Suite, while an Anti-Missile System destroys incoming fire. The standard weapons have been replaced by an ER PPC and LRM-5. Thirteen double heat sinks keep the Mech cool, while a MASC system allows Arthur to put on bursts of speed. The lack of weapons might be an issue for some pilots, but this Snake variant is used as a command 'Mech, so it's not a problem for Arthur.
column2: 游灵战士的指挥官使用的 Snake Arthur 配备隐形装甲和守护者 ECM 系统，反导系统则负责摧毁来袭火力。标准武器被替换为一门增程 PPC 和一具 LRM-5。13 台双倍散热器让机甲保持凉爽，MASC 系统可令 Arthur 短时间加速。对某些驾驶员而言，它的武器可能太少；但 Snake 变体是指挥机甲，这对 Arthur 来说并非问题。

column1: Used by the commander of Youling Zhanshi, the Snake Arthur is equipped with 隐身装甲 and 守护者ECM Suite, while an 反导系统 destroys incoming fire. column2: 幽灵战士的指挥官使用的蛇型机甲配备隐身装甲和守护者 ECM 套件，反导系统还能摧毁来袭火力。标准武器被一门 ER PPC 和一具 LRM-5 替代。13 台双倍散热器保持机甲冷却，MASC 系统则让亚瑟能够短时间爆发加速。武器数量较少可能令一些驾驶员担忧，但这款蛇型机甲承担的是指挥任务，因此对亚瑟来说并非问题。

column1: Used by the 布雷克圣言会's Protectorate Militia in 3078, this Archer variant carried a pair of ER Large Lasers and Artemis IV-enhanced LRM-15 launchers, with a maximum speed of 58 km/h. For protection, the 9W used an experimental Angel ECM Suite and 虚空信号系统.
column2: 3078年，布雷克圣言会保护国民兵使用这一Archer变型。它携带两门ER大型激光器和两具装配Artemis IV的LRM-15发射器，最高速度为58 km/h。为提供防护，9W采用实验型天使ECM套件和虚空信号系统。
