column1: VND-1SIC 是迈克尔·琼斯"圣艾夫斯蓝"的标准化改装，由新成立的圣艾夫斯共同体于 3031 年采用，它把 PPC 降级为大型激光，同时把 LRM 挂架升级为 LRM-10。 Quirk: Rugged Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.01 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: VND-1SIC 是对天蝎“圣殿骑士”标准装甲配置的改进型。该型号于 3031 年推出，使用中型激光替换 PPC，并将 LRM 发射器升级为 LRM-10。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.01 手臂执行器限制：右下臂

column1: Vengeance Industries, attempting to get a foothold in the Market for 全向Mechs, have redesigned the ancient Talos based on 'liberated' blueprints from 范登堡军工. With a focus on easily maintainable parts, they have ensured that it can be repaired with spares from any Talos model. 特性：易于驾驶 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: Vengeance Industries 试图在全向机甲市场站稳脚跟，于是根据从范登堡军工“解放”出的蓝图重新设计了古老的 Talos。通过采用易于维护的零件，他们确保这台机甲可以使用任何 Talos 型号的备件进行维修。 特质：易于驾驶 投放成本倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Very similar to the Word of Blake produced Locust LCT-5W, this variant is far more common.
column2: 该变体与布雷克之言生产的 Locust LCT-5W 非常相似，但常见得多。

column1: Very similar to the 布雷克圣言会 produced Locust LCT-5W, this variant is far more common.
column2: Very similar to the 布雷克圣言会 produced Locust LCT-5W, this variant是far more common.

column1: Vindicator 6L is simultaneously a cross between the 4L, 5L, and something completely new. The salvaged nature of the 6L makes it incredibly rare, with each one being ''handmade'' and awarded to only the most deserving Vindicator pilots.
column2: Vindicator 6L同时融合了4L、5L以及全新的设计。6L由打捞部件构成，极其稀有；每一台都是“手工打造”，只授予最值得的Vindicator驾驶员。

column1: Vindicator P's are basically ramshackle pieces of barely working scrap metal, typically encountered among pirates but one never knows how bad someone's mechtech really is.
column2: 维护者 P 基本上是摇摇欲坠的废金属，通常在海盗中遇到，但人们永远不知道某人的机甲技术到底有多糟糕。

column1: Volkh 最初由 Vining Engineering and Salvage Team 在 Solaris VII 设计，作为先进技术的试验平台。这套配置看起来像是在测试某位机甲驾驶员能同时指挥多少个“枪骑兵连”。驾驶舱里到处刻着一首用古老泰拉语言写成的长诗。
column2: Volkh 最初由维宁工程与回收团队在索拉里斯 VII 设计，用作先进技术的试验平台。这套配置似乎是在测试某位机甲驾驶员能同时控制多少个“枪骑兵连”。驾驶舱里到处刻着一首用古老泰拉语言写成的长诗。

column1: We call the Cataphract a "FrankenMech" because it's got a little bit of everything stitched together on it. This was somehow 'repaired' by a punch of pirates, theres spikes everywhere, even in the chassis.
column2: 我们称 Cataphract 为“FrankenMech”，因为它上面缝合了一些东西。这不知何故被海盗的一拳“修复”了，到处都有尖刺，甚至在底盘上。

column1: We call the Cataphract the "FrankenMech" because it's got a little bit of everything stitched together on it. The 1E variant was upgraded to employ an EWS and a Null Signature System.
column2: 我们称 Cataphract 为“弗兰肯机甲”，因为它身上东拼西凑了各种部件。1E 型号升级后配备 EWS 和 Null Signature System。

column1: We call the Cataphract the "FrankenMech" because it's got a little bit of everything stitched together on it. The 1E variant was upgraded to employ an EWS and a 虚无信号系统.
column2: 我们把Cataphract称为“弗兰肯机甲”，因为它身上缝合了各种各样的部件。1E变型经过升级，采用EWS和虚空信号系统。

column1: We see a lot of kill markers scratched into mechs but this one's got ones that look like those big Clan fellas and there are a lot of them. I have a feeling they know this one.
column2: 我们看到很多杀戮标记被刻在机甲上，但这个有一些看起来像那些大部落家伙的标记，而且有很多。我有一种感觉，他们认识这个人。

column1: Well Boss, a lot of effort has gone into making this thing more or less unstoppable. I once saw a mech like this in a Solaris game. I'll never forget the expression on the opposing pilot's face when she blew off both side torsos and it just kept shooting.
column2: 老板，为了让这东西几乎无法被阻止，他们投入了大量精力。我曾在Solaris的一场比赛中见过类似的机甲。对方驾驶员打掉它两侧躯干后，它仍然继续开火；她脸上的表情我永远忘不了。

column1: Well Boss, this is a Razorback, but these junkers replaced most of its Parts to Support its Flamers. Theres a note saying 'Be wary what you wish for'.
column2: 没错，Boss，这是一台 Razorback，但这些破烂工匠替换了它的大部分部件，以支援火焰喷射器。上面还有一张字条：“小心你所祈求的东西。”

column1: Well Thats one way to make an 'Assault Mech'.
column2: 嗯，这确实是一种制造“突击机甲”的办法。

column1: Well boss, the shell of this thing is still an Alacorn so you got a bunch of armor. But some junker thought the original Gauss Rifles were too heavy so they just cut the end of the barrels off, remounted them crooked in the turret and broke the optics in the process. Now what you have is a weapon that charges up a bit faster and fires a projectile in the general direction of your target.
column2: 老大，这东西的外壳仍是阿拉康，所以装甲不少。但某个拾荒者嫌原装高斯步枪太重，直接锯掉枪管末端，把它们歪歪扭扭地重新装进炮塔，还顺便弄坏了光学设备。现在这变成了一种充能更快、却只能朝目标大致方向发射的武器。

column1: Well boss, the shell of this thing is still an Alacorn so you got a bunch of 装甲. But some junker thought the original Gauss Rifles were too heavy so they just cut the end of the barrels off, remounted them crooked in the turret and broke the optics in the process. Now what you have is a weapon that charges up a bit faster and fires a projectile in the general direction of your target.
column2: 老大，这东西的外壳仍然是 Alacorn，所以你能得到一大堆装甲。不过某个废品商觉得原装高斯步枪太重，于是把炮管末端直接锯掉，把它们歪歪扭扭地重新装进炮塔，还顺手弄坏了光学设备。现在这件武器充能更快一些，发射的弹丸也大致会朝目标方向飞。

column1: Well it is fast, and tough, but it lacks punch unless you are fighting the lightest of opponents.
column2: 它速度快、也很坚固，但除非对手是最轻型的单位，否则火力并不够强。

column1: Well it is fast, tough, and surprisingly carries a Large VSPL for an APC refit. You can't ask much else out of a medium hovercraft boss.
column2: 它速度快、够坚固，而且作为 APC 改装型，居然还装了一门大型 VSPL。对一辆中型气垫船来说，老大，你还能要求更多吗？

column1: Well, Boss, this might look like an Excalibur, but it's about as far from one as you could get in terms of equipment. The level of technology we're looking at here? It's somethin' else. Whoever came up with this design knew what they needed to put on this thing to ruin somebody's day.
column2: 老板，这东西看起来像Excalibur，但就装备而言，它离Excalibur差得远。我们看到的技术水平？简直非同寻常。设计它的人非常清楚该装什么，才能毁掉某人的一天。

column1: Well, Boss. I've got good news and bad news. The good news is that the armor on this thing is top-of-the-line tech. The bad news is that I have no idea how badly I messed up getting it off. The armor, I mean. Why are you grinning?
column2: 老大，好消息和坏消息各一个。好消息是这东西的装甲属于顶尖技术；坏消息是我完全不知道自己拆装甲时把它弄坏到什么程度了。呃，我是说装甲。你为什么在笑？

column1: Well, Boss. I've got good news and bad news. The good news is that the 装甲 on this thing is top-of-the-line tech. The bad news is that I have no idea how badly I messed up getting it off. The 装甲, I mean. Why are you grinning?
column2: 老板，消息有好有坏。好消息是，这台东西的装甲采用了最尖端的技术。坏消息是，我完全不知道自己拆装甲时弄得有多糟。我是说装甲。你为什么在笑？

column1: Well, I can say that this 'Ronin' had more brains and better tastes than most of the periphery and pirate junk we often come across. Must've been pretty well off to afford all this custom work, and I'd really love to meet the tech who made it happen. Pretty straight forward missile brawling mech CO, my kind of style.
column2: 嗯，我可以说，这个“浪人”比我们经常遇到的大多数外围和海盗垃圾更有头脑，更有品味。一定很富裕才能负担得起所有这些定制工作，我真的很想见到实现这一切的技术人员。相当直接的导弹战斗机甲CO，我的风格。

column1: Well, I thought this was a standard Spartan to begin with, but it looks like there's been a bunch of aftermarket improvements made to it by the Com Guards — mainly swapping some weaponry out for sorely needed heat sinks.
column2: 我原本以为这是一台标准的Spartan，但看起来Com Guards对它进行了大量售后改进——主要是把一些武器换成急需的散热器。

column1: Well, boss, the strangest thing amongst this is the Big Steel on his arm. Big Steel on his arrrrmmmm...
column2: 老板，这东西最奇怪的地方就是它手臂上的那块大钢铁。大钢铁在它的手臂上……它的手臂上……

column1: Well, congratulations, Amaris. You built a Rifleman. I really hope that this is a custom job by some merc company or something. This is just kind of ridiculous, if you ask me. Look - somebody's even stenciled the name on the side here: "Rattler".
column2: 恭喜你，Amaris，你造出了一台步枪手。我真希望这只是某个佣兵公司的定制改装之类的东西。依我看，这实在荒唐。看——有人甚至把名字喷在了侧面：“响尾蛇”。

column1: Well, great, it parades itself like an omnimech. But ask me to fix that? Don't bother. This supposed 'lightened structure' looks more like a shortcut than an advantage. Dual Quicsell Pulse Lasers might glitter, but I doubt they've got the substance. Double AC/5? Feels like compensating. Extra Light Rifle? Just trying too hard. And that 'secretive' Quicsell Special Streak SRM 4? Please. The LRM 5 is the icing on the cake – a mishmash without a plan. Battle scars or not, this Quicsell Shadowhawk won't earn my trust on the battlefield.
column2: 嗯，太棒了，它像一个全能机甲一样炫耀自己。但要求我解决这个问题？别打扰。这种所谓的“轻型结构”看起来更像是一种捷径，而不是一种优势。双 Quicsell 脉冲激光器可能会闪闪发光，但我怀疑它们是否有这种物质。双AC/5？感觉像是在补偿。超轻步枪？只是太努力了。还有那个“神秘的”Quicsell Special Streak SRM 4 吗？请。 LRM 5 是锦上添花——没有计划的大杂烩。不管是否有战斗伤痕，这把奎塞尔暗影鹰在战场上都不会赢得我的信任。

column1: Well, if you ever wanted to see a mech burst into flames despite having a fully functioning cooling system, then point this thing at them. Those "double ACs" are a lot less flexable than UACs, but their one upside is that they can use normal AC rounds, which in this case means inferno rounds. Just be careful with letting the newbie pilots in the cockpit, since a "misfire" will damage those guns.
column2: 好吧，如果你想看到一个机甲在拥有功能齐全的冷却系统的情况下突然起火，那么就把这个东西指向他们。这些“双 AC”的灵活性比 UAC 低得多，但它们的一个优点是可以使用普通的 AC 回合，在这种情况下意味着地狱回合。只是要小心让新手飞行员进入驾驶舱，因为“失火”会损坏这些枪。

column1: Well, it is a Longbow, for the most parts just a pretty normal looking one too, and if it werent for that engine and these weird Thunderbolt '30' id say they just stole it somewhere......
column2: 嗯，它是一具 Longbow，大部分地方看起来也相当普通；要不是那台引擎和这些奇怪的 Thunderbolt“30”，我会以为他们只是从哪里偷来的……

column1: Well, it is a Longbow, for the most parts just a pretty normal looking one too, and if it werent for that 引擎 and these weird Thunderbolt '30' id say they just stole it somewhere......
column2: 这是一台Longbow，大体上看起来还算普通；要不是那台引擎和这些怪异的Thunderbolt“30”，我会以为他们只是从某处偷来的……

column1: Well, its a Piranha, though these Junkers somehow managed to mangle its targeting Systems while installing better MachineGun Mounts.....
column2: 好吧，它是一台 Piranha，只是这些垃圾佬在安装更好的机枪挂架时，居然把它的目标系统弄坏了……

column1: Well, this 'Mech works. I don't like that it works, but it does. I'm not crazy enough to try and reverse all the hack-jobs that were done to make this into a BattleMech instead of an OmniMech, so this is as good as you'll get, Boss.
column2: 嗯，这个机甲有效。我不喜欢它有效，但它确实有效。我还没有疯狂到尝试扭转所有为了将其变成 BattleMech 而不是 OmniMech 所做的黑客工作，所以这已经是你能得到的最好的了，老板。

column1: Well, this is a monster of a 'Mech. Whoever designed this thing loved their PPCs; the entire fire control systems are optimised around squeezing as much out of them as possible. She runs way hot, though, so keep an eye on that.
column2: 这真是一台怪物般的机甲。设计它的人热爱 PPC；整套火控系统都围绕着尽可能榨出 PPC 火力进行优化。不过它运行时非常过热，一定要盯紧热量。

column1: Well, this is a monster of a 'Mech. Whoever designed this thing loved their PPCs; the entire fire control systems are optimised around squeezing as much out of them as possible. She still runs a little hot, though, so keep an eye on that.
column2: 这真是一台怪物般的机甲。设计它的人热爱 PPC；整套火控系统都围绕着尽可能榨出 PPC 火力进行优化。不过它运行时仍然有些过热，记得盯紧热量。

column1: Well, this is new, Commander! Clan Hell's Horses has developed a brand-new BattleMech inspired by the Arion Quadvee, and they're calling it the Jumping Jack. This thing is a beast! It's armed with a bunch of AP Gauss rifles, perfect for short-range engagements. And the best part? It's got jump jets for enhanced mobility, maxed armor for increased durability, and its unique quadrupedal design allows it to move swiftly across the battlefield. This bad boy is going to be a hunter of infantry and battle armor units, clearing the way for our forces. I can't wait to see it in action, Commander. This is going to be a game-changer for us!
column2: 指挥官，这可真是新鲜事！Hell's Horses 氏族开发了一种受 Arion Quadvee 启发的全新战斗机甲，名叫 Jumping Jack。这家伙简直是头野兽！它装备一堆 AP 高斯步枪，非常适合近距离交战。更棒的是，它有跳跃喷射器提升机动性、满配装甲增强耐久，而且独特的四足设计让它能在战场上快速移动。这家伙会成为步兵和战斗装甲单位的克星，为我方部队扫清道路。我迫不及待想看它投入实战，指挥官。这绝对会改变战局！

column1: Well, this is new, Commander! 氏族地狱马 has developed a brand-new BattleMech inspired by the Arion Quadvee, and they're calling it the Jumping Jack. This thing is a beast! It's armed with a bunch of AP Gauss rifles, perfect for short-range engagements. And the best part? It's got jump jets for enhanced mobility, maxed 装甲 for increased durability, and its unique quadrupedal design allows it to move swiftly across the battlefield. This bad boy is going to be a hunter of infantry and battle 装甲 units, clearing the way for our forces. I can't wait to see it in action, Commander. This is going to be a game-changer for us!
column2: 指挥官，这可是新东西！星盟制造了一台受Arion四足车启发的全新战斗机甲，并把它命名为跳跃杰克。这东西强得惊人，装备大量AP高斯步枪，非常适合近距离交战。更棒的是，它拥有跳跃喷射器来增强机动性，最大化装甲来提高耐久；独特的四足结构还能让它迅速穿越战场。这家伙会专门猎杀步兵和战斗装甲单位，为我们的部队扫清道路。我迫不及待想看它投入战斗，指挥官。这将彻底改变战局！

column1: Well, this is something you don't see every day - missiles on a Black Knight! These look like old designs, boss. Definitely Star League. We found some interesting pieces of combat data left over from when it was still operational that backs that up, too. Turns out this was some kind of rearguard unit.
column2: 老大，这可真少见——黑骑士居然装了导弹！看起来是老设计，肯定来自星盟时期。我们还找到了一些它仍在服役时留下的战斗数据，可以佐证这一点。看来它应该是某种后卫单位。

column1: Well, this is something you don't see every day - missiles on a 黑骑士! These look like old designs, boss. Definitely Star League. We found some interesting pieces of combat data left over from when it was still operational that backs that up, too. Turns out this was some kind of rearguard unit.
column2: 每天都能见到在黑骑士上安装导弹的情况吗？当然不能！这些看起来像是老板你说的老式设计，绝对属于星盟时代。我们还发现了一些有趣的战斗数据，证明它仍在运作时确实使用过这些武器。结果表明，这似乎是某种后卫单位。

column1: Well, this thing works as a sniper, I guess, but those so called 'gauss' rifles have some pretty severe damage loss at long range, thanks to the fact that AC2 shells aren't designed for those velocites. Not a bad budget assault though.
column2: 好吧，这东西可以当狙击机，但那些所谓的“高斯”步枪在远距离会严重损失伤害，因为 AC/2 炮弹根本不是为那种速度设计的。不过作为廉价突击机，它并不算差。

column1: Well. Somebody's definitely been rooting around in here long before we were. If you were under the impression this was a swanky Clanner OmniMech, you're fresh outta luck, Boss. This here is a grade-A FrankenMech job.
column2: 嗯，肯定有人在我们之前很久就翻过这里。如果你以为这是体面的氏族全向机甲，那就想多了，Boss。这是货真价实的顶级 FrankenMech 改装。

column1: What a fine Machine, a Cougar OmniMech! Except everything thats making it an Omni got replaced by jury rigged and non standard parts sewing and duct taping this piece of frankenmech together. One can wonder, how it doesn't fall apart.
column2: 多好的机器啊，美洲狮 OmniMech！除了所有使它成为 Omni 的东西都被临时装配和非标准零件缝制和管道胶带这块弗兰肯机械所取代。人们可能想知道，它如何不崩溃。

column1: What a funny-lookin' 'Mech. There's a ton of comments tucked away in her maintenance logs talking about how special she is. I don't see it. It's a bunch of half-baked Clan tech bolted onto a crumbling chassis. I'll make her sing, sure, but it might not be the soprano you're hoping for, Boss.
column2: 多么滑稽的机甲啊。她的维护日志中隐藏着大量评论，谈论她有多么特别。我没看到。这是一堆半生不熟的氏族技术，被固定在摇摇欲坠的底盘上。我会让她唱歌，当然，但这可能不是你想要的女高音，老板。

column1: What do you get when you take the iconic BRRRRRT away from the Warthog? Not much, except a cheaper LAM.
column2: 把疣猪那标志性的 BRRRRRT 火力拆掉之后还剩下什么？没剩多少，不过至少变成了一台更便宜的 LAM。

column1: What do you get when you take the iconic BRRRRRT away 来自 the Warthog? Not much, except a cheaper LAM.
column2: 从Warthog上拿走标志性的BRRRRRT后，你还剩下什么？没多少，只是一台更便宜的LAM。

column1: What do you want me to say? It shoots lasers... and I guess missiles sometimes. It shoots.
column2: 你想让我说什么？它会发射激光……我猜有时也会发射导弹。反正它会开火。

column1: What ever the engineer in the Hegemony was smoking, I want some. If nothing else it'll help me destress from clearing out all these bloody rocket tube.
column2: 不知道霸权时代那个工程师抽了什么，我也想来一点。至少能帮我在清理这些该死的火箭发射管后缓解压力。

column1: What happens when Pirates are successful? They go and refit a perfectly fine Atlas II to look like a Pirate! Id say its still a pretty solid Mech, if you ignore that they welded a bloody Raven onto its Shoulder and called it Polly...
column2: 海盗成功后会发生什么？他们把一台完好的 Atlas II 改装得像海盗机甲！就算忽略他们把一只该死的 Raven 焊在肩膀上并命名为 Polly，我还是得说它是一台相当扎实的机甲。

column1: What happens when an Industrial Mech Pilot turns into a Gladiator on the outskirts of the Periphery? With extra spikes, a Wrecking Ball and industrial Chainsaw it has everything to give someone a bad time. And lets not forget the Redneck Pilot's favorite, the Boomstick!
column2: 当工业机甲驾驶员在边缘区外围变成角斗士，会发生什么？加上额外尖刺、破坏球和工业链锯，它拥有让任何人都不好受的一切。别忘了乡巴佬驾驶员最爱的——大铁棍！

column1: What happens when an 工业机甲 Pilot turns into a Gladiator on the outskirts of the Periphery? With extra spikes, a 破坏球 and industrial Chainsaw it has everything to give someone a bad time. And lets not forget the Redneck Pilot's favorite, the Boomstick!
column2: 一名工业机甲驾驶员跑到边疆外围，变成了角斗士，会发生什么？加上额外尖刺、破坏球和工业链锯，它足以让任何人吃尽苦头。别忘了红脖飞行员的最爱——Boomstick！

column1: What is better than Command Consoles or Dual Cockpits? Why, two separate heads of course! Or at least to the crazy pirates who came up with this abomination of a design.
column2: 有什么能胜过指挥控制台或双驾驶舱？当然是两个独立的头部！至少那些设计出这个怪胎的疯狂海盗是这么认为的。

column1: What is better than Command Consoles or Dual Cockpits? Why, two separate heads of course! Or at least to the crazy pirates who came up with this abomination of a design. And it even carries a huge wooden cudgel, that is clearly made from no type of tree I know of. Just look at that size of that trunk!
column2: 还有什么比指挥控制台或双人驾驶舱更好？当然是两个独立的头部！至少那些想出这种畸形设计的疯狂海盗是这么认为的。它甚至还带着一根巨大的木棒，显然不是用我认识的任何树木制成的。看看那树干有多粗！

column1: What is now known as the Hellcat had its humble origins in a Clan's desperation nearly a century ago. One of the many projects born out of Clan Nova Cat's post-Abjurement rebuilding program was a radical take on the Conjurer BattleMech. Jade Falcon merchants took advantage of their old rival's panic, swapping sorely needed raw materials for access to the Cats' ballooning catalog of 'Mech chassis. Falcon technicians and scientists reworked an atypical Conjurer variant to emphasize flexible firepower over the Nova Cat model's speed and energy-based weaponry. Named as a subtle wink to both the BattleMech's creators and the Conjurer's Spheroid name, their early Hellcat saw only limited production before the Jihad.
column2: 如今被称为 Hellcat 的机甲，起源于近一个世纪前某个氏族在绝境中启动的项目。新星猫氏族遭到除名后，为重建力量而开展的多个项目之一，便是对 Conjurer 战斗机甲进行激进改造。玉隼商人趁着老对手陷入恐慌，以急需的原材料换取猫氏族不断扩充的机甲底盘目录。玉隼技师和科学家重做了一款非典型 Conjurer 变体，强调灵活火力，而非新星猫版本的速度与能量武器。早期 Hellcat 的名称巧妙呼应了机甲的创造者，以及 Conjurer 的内天体称呼；它在圣战前只少量生产。

column1: What is now known as the Hellcat had its humble origins in a Clan's desperation nearly a century ago. One of the many projects born out of 氏族新星猫's post-Abjurement rebuilding program was a radical take on the Conjurer BattleMech. Jade Falcon merchants took advantage of their old rival's panic, swapping sorely needed raw materials for access to the Cats' ballooning catalog of 'Mech chassis. Falcon technicians and scientists reworked an atypical Conjurer variant to emphasize flexible firepower over the Nova Cat model's speed and energy-based weaponry. Named as a subtle wink to both the BattleMech's creators and the Conjurer's Spheroid name, their early Hellcat saw only limited production before the Jihad.
column2: 如今被称为地狱猫的机甲，起源于近一个世纪前某个星族的绝望。它是星族解盟后重建计划的众多项目之一，也是对召唤者战斗机甲的一次激进改造。玉蜥星族商人利用老对手的恐慌，以急需的原材料换取大量机甲骨架。猎鹰技术人员和科学家重新设计了一种非典型的召唤者变体，强调灵活火力，而不是新星猫型号的速度与能量武器。早期地狱猫的名称同时向机甲创造者和召唤者的球状星域名称致意，但在圣战前只进行了有限生产。

column1: What we have here is something I never thought I would see. It has clan tech, It is built by the clans, but it is definitely designed to rip your face off with those talons. I hope Malvina Hazen gifted you that mech, else you may be in trouble.
column2: 我们眼前的是我从没想过会见到的东西。它采用氏族技术，由氏族制造，但那些爪子显然是用来撕碎敌人的。希望Malvina Hazen把这台机甲送给了你，否则你可能要倒霉。

column1: What...in...the...world!? Is this a 'Mech or ancient behemoth!? Look at all that armor, that protective plating, and all those latest tech weapons!
column2: 这……这……世界上有什么！？这是机甲还是远古巨兽！？看看所有的装甲、防护镀层，以及所有最新的科技武器！

column1: What...in...the...world!? Is this a 'Mech or ancient behemoth!? Look at all that 装甲, that protective plating, and all those latest tech weapons!
column2: 什么……这到底是什么！？这是战斗机甲还是远古巨兽！？看看这些装甲、那些防护板，还有所有最新科技武器！

column1: What? Don't look at me like that, Boss. Ain't much to say. It's damn fast and that Heavy Large Laser is no joke. Seems pretty obvious to me.
column2: 什么？别这样看着我，老板。没什么可说的。它的速度实在是太快了，重型大型激光可不是闹着玩的。对我来说似乎很明显。

column1: Whatever pirates were responsible for this refit, they did a better job than most. This high-tech armor has been kept in good shape, and most of the equipment is totally functional. Just don't look too hard at that "HPCS" they've bolted in there.
column2: 负责这次改装的海盗无论是谁，都比大多数人做得好。这套高科技装甲保养良好，大部分设备也完全可用。只是别太仔细看他们用螺栓固定进去的那个“HPCS”。

column1: When Clan Coyote prepared to return to the Inner Sphere, they committed to a do-or-die campaign: either secure territory or be broken. The Boyyi - meaning roadrunner in Terran Native American Zuni - reflects this harsh philosophy. Its design is resource-intensive and limited in numbers, created to serve as a superior recon presence on enemy worlds. This strategy and other invasion policies have left the Coyotes’ Clan Homeworld territories severely depleted of resources.
column2: 当郊狼氏族准备返回内层世界时，他们致力于一场生死攸关的战役：要么确保领土安全，要么被破坏。博伊（Boyyi）——在美洲原住民祖尼语中的意思是走鹃——反映了这种严酷的哲学。它的设计资源密集且数量有限，旨在作为对敌方世界的高级侦察存在。这一战略和其他入侵政策使土狼氏族家园领地的资源严重枯竭。

column1: When Clan Ghost Bear needed a superheavy 'Mech, they took the basic Kodiak concepts and created the Nanook. A 160 ton beast of a 'Mech, fully armored and surprisingly fast thanks to its 460 XXL engine, it is meant to outmaneuver other superheavies before dealing a full on alpha strike. Worth noticing is that the way the internal circuitry of the Nanook is set up, it heavily favours Laser weapons.
column2: 氏族幽灵熊需要超重型机甲时，借鉴 Kodiak 的基本概念制造了 Nanook。这台 160 吨的巨兽装甲齐全，凭借 460 XXL 引擎速度出奇地快；它的战术是在发动全力齐射前先机动压过其他超重型机甲。值得注意的是，Nanook 的内部电路布局极度偏向激光武器。

column1: When General Aleksandr Kerensky led most of the Star League Defense Force into exile in 2784, they brought prototypes of the Clint BattleMech with them. After the annihilation of Clan Wolverine, Clan Snow Raven revisited these prototypes and was able to begin mass-production of the 'Mech in 2830 and introduced 2842. They ensured that it kept up with advances in Clan technology, eventually becoming the design that is now known as the Clint IIC. Developed during the Jihad in 3073, the Clint IIC 2 was fitted with an all-energy weapons configuration. The 'Mech mounts five Medium Pulse Lasers divided amongst its center torso, left torso, and right arm; one in each of the torso locations, and the remaining three in the arm. This variant has been provided eight Improved Jump Jets to greatly enhance its mobility in tactical situations. To cope with the new levels of heat, ten Double Heat Sinks are used instead of the single versions. Additionally, an ECM Suite has been allocated to the head. Lastly, Ferro-Fibrous armor now protects the design in place of the original Standard armor.
column2: 2784 年，亚历山大·克伦斯基将军率星盟防卫军大部分部队流亡时，带走了 Clint 战斗机甲的原型。Wolverine 氏族覆灭后，Snow Raven 氏族重新研究这些原型，于 2830 年开始量产，并在 2842 年正式推出。他们确保该机甲跟上氏族技术的发展，最终演变为如今所称的 Clint IIC。圣战期间开发的 Clint IIC 2 于 3073 年采用全能量武器配置。机甲安装五门中型脉冲激光器，分布于中央躯干、左侧躯干和右臂：两个躯干部位各一门，剩余三门装在手臂上。该变体配备 8 具改进型跳跃喷射器，大幅提升战术机动性。为应对新增热量，机甲使用 10 具双重散热器取代单重散热器。此外，头部还安装了一套 ECM。最后，设计改用铁磁纤维装甲取代原有标准装甲。

column1: When General Aleksandr Kerensky led most of the 星际联盟防卫军 into exile in 2784, they brought prototypes of the Clint BattleMech with them. After the annihilation of 狼獾氏族, 雪鸦氏族 revisited these prototypes and was able to begin mass-production of the 'Mech in 2830 and introduced 2842. They ensured that it kept up with advances in Clan technology, eventually becoming the design that is now known as the Clint IIC. Developed during the Jihad in 3073, the Clint IIC 2 was fitted with an all-energy weapons configuration. The 'Mech mounts five 中型脉冲激光s divided amongst its center torso, left torso, and right arm; one in each of the torso locations, and the remaining three in the arm. This variant has been provided eight 改进型跳跃推进器 to greatly enhance its mobility in tactical situations. To cope with the new levels of heat, ten 双散热器 are used instead of the single versions. Additionally, an ECM Suite has been allocated to the head. Lastly, 铁纤维装甲 装甲 now protects the design in place of the original Standard 装甲.
column2: 受到玉鹰家族在过去十年推出的《雷神二号》的启发，新星猫的科学家们拆除了原来的影子猫的固定跳跃喷射器，以释放宝贵的质量。剩余的大部分吨位被分配给吊舱空间，增强机甲的灵活性，而其余的则最大化装甲覆盖范围，以确保氏族珍贵的全向机甲及其战士安全回家。暗影猫III的主要配置是左臂装有三吨弹药的高斯步枪，右臂有一对中型脉冲激光器。  增加了机动性，它保留了原始影子猫的固定 MASC。

column1: When Kallon Industries reintroduced the Penetrator, they switched to endo steel and reflective armor, allowing the arm weapons to be upgraded to snubnosed PPCs aimed with enhanced actuators. This 'Mech is now quite deadly for its weight.
column2: Kallon Industries 重新推出 Penetrator 时，换用了 Endo Steel 和反射装甲，使双臂武器升级为带增强驱动器瞄准的短管 PPC。这台机甲如今以其吨位而言相当致命。

column1: When Pirates find something New They always take advantage of it.Shortly after recovering a drone's carcus they shoved it into one of their most beloved designs.
column2: 海盗一旦发现新东西，总会想办法利用。刚回收一台无人机残骸，他们就把它塞进自己最喜欢的设计之一。

column1: When StarCorps Industries wanted to move into the superheavy market, they created the Peacemaker. With a familiar exterior design they hoped to build on top of the Warhammer's reputation for being "just enough". However, the final product instead turned into a PPC focused 155 ton superheavy, which was not cheap nor as versatile as the Warhammer.
column2: 星际军团工业进军超重型市场时制造了和平缔造者。他们采用熟悉的外形设计，希望延续战锤“刚刚好”的声誉。然而最终产品却变成了一台以 PPC 为核心、重达 155 吨的超重型机甲，既不便宜，也没有战锤那么灵活。

column1: When the Capellan Confederation needed a new 'Mech to export, House Liao decided the easiest and cheapest way was to "acquire" the design of the Sunder OmniMech from a certain neighbor Inner Sphere state. To prevent any accusations about using their design without permissions, House Liao scientists then decided to simply upscale the design and make it a superheavy. This is how the 165 ton Wannu OmniMech was born, which then was exported to both the Lyrans and the Suns. Some even found their way back to the Draconis Combine, although House Kurita did refuse to buy any directly for some reason.
column2: 卡佩兰联邦需要一款新的出口机甲时，廖家认为最简单、最便宜的办法就是“借用”某个邻近内天体国家的 Sunder OmniMech 设计。为了避免被指控未经许可使用设计，廖家科学家干脆放大该设计，将其改造成超重型机甲。于是 165 吨的 Wannu OmniMech 诞生，并出口给莱茵人和太阳人。有些机体甚至回到了龙马幕府，但库里塔家族不知为何拒绝直接购买。

column1: When the RISC laboratories developed the superheavy version of the Wraith Suppression Shield System, they wanted to see how it fared in actual combat at a larger scale before they re-geared to their own heavily over-utilized superheavy factories. Three of the Great Houses were persuaded to design a number of superheavy 'Mechs around the system, all three ending up with very similar looks due to the prototype stealth system requirements and pre-designed components supplied by the Republic. The house Liao result was the Hēi Lián, translating to Black Lotus from mandarin, a 170 ton superheavy focused on delivering a powerful punch at enough range to have a chance to remain hidden after firing.
column2: RISC 实验室研发出幽灵压制护盾系统的超重型版本后，希望先在更大规模的实战中检验效果，再对自家过度满载的超重型工厂重新调整设备。实验室说服了三个大国围绕该系统设计若干超重型机甲。由于原型隐形系统的要求，以及共和国提供的预制部件，三家的机甲外观最终十分相似。廖家的成果是黑莲（Hēi Lián，普通话意为 Black Lotus），一台 170 吨超重型机甲，专注于在足够远的距离上打出强力一击，以便开火后仍有机会继续隐藏。

column1: When the RISC laboratories developed the superheavy version of the Wraith Suppression Shield System, they wanted to see how it fared in actual combat at a larger scale before they re-geared to their own heavily over-utilized superheavy factories. Three of the Great Houses were persuaded to design a number of superheavy 'Mechs around the system, all three ending up with very similar looks due to the prototype stealth system requirements and pre-designed components supplied by the Republic. Unlike the other two houses, House Davion decided to fit the stealth system into a smaller 150 ton OmniMech chassis, the Night Bastion
column2: RISC 实验室研发幽灵压制护盾系统的超重型版本后，希望先在更大规模的实战中检验效果，再对自家过度满载的超重型工厂重新调整设备。实验室说服了三个大国围绕该系统设计若干超重型机甲；由于原型隐形系统的要求和共和国提供的预制部件，三家的机甲外观最终十分相似。与另外两家不同，达维翁家族决定将隐形系统装入更小的 150 吨 OmniMech 底盘，这就是 Night Bastion。

column1: When the RISC laboratories developed the superheavy version of the 幽灵抑制护盾系统, they wanted to see how it fared in actual combat at a larger scale before they re-geared to their own heavily over-utilized superheavy factories. Three of the Great Houses were persuaded to design a number of superheavy 'Mechs around the system, all three ending up with very similar looks due to the prototype stealth system requirements and pre-designed components supplied by the Republic. The house Liao result was the Hēi Lián, translating to Black Lotus from mandarin, a 170 ton superheavy focused on delivering a powerful punch at enough range to have a chance to remain hidden after firing.
column2: RISC实验室开发超重型幽灵抑制护盾系统后，希望在重新改造自家超负荷运转的超重型工厂之前，先在更大规模的实战中观察其表现。他们说服三大高等家族围绕该系统设计多台超重型机甲。由于原型隐形系统的要求以及共和国提供的预制部件，三家的成品外形都非常相似。辽家族的成果是Hēi Lián，普通话意为“黑莲”，这是一台170吨超重型机甲，专注于在足够远的距离释放强大火力，以便射击后仍有机会保持隐蔽。

column1: When the news of Precentor Vapula's Celestial series of 'Mechs reached Precentor Destral VII, he refused to have his devotion be outdone. Throwing all available, and unavailable, resources at the task, Precentor Destral VII's design team created the Leliorium, a 200t Omnimech, named after the highest rank of demons in the Ars Goetia, as compared to the Celestial series' angels. Furthering the point that these are not just the Celestials on steroids, each configuration is further named after one of the nine demon kings.  Each one brings to bear the cutting edge of experimental weaponry and armor, such as the Exsecratio Stealth Armor and the Seraphim Electronic Warfare Suite. The final check, before each unit is released from the factory, is a holy blessing by 6 high Blakist Priests, ensuring that the pilot, and 'Mech, are well taken care of by Blake.
column2: 当瓦普拉军事主教的天体系列机甲传到德斯特拉尔七世军事主教耳中时，他拒绝让自己的信仰被比下去。他把一切可用和不可用的资源都投入其中，设计团队最终打造出 Leliorium——一台重 200 吨的全能机甲。它的名字取自《所罗门之钥》中地位最高的恶魔，对应天体系列的天使。为了进一步说明这些并非单纯强化版天体机甲，每种配置都以九位恶魔之王中的一位命名。每台机甲都使用 Exsecratio 隐形装甲、Seraphim 电子战套件等最前沿的实验武器与装甲。每台机甲出厂前的最后一道检查，是由六名高级布莱克牧师进行神圣祝福，确保驾驶员和机甲都受到布莱克庇佑。

column1: When this 'Mech goes at full speed the MechWarrior inside that Small Cockpit gets an almost surreal experience, the pace is that fast. Just don't check your underwear afterwards...
column2: 这台机甲全速前进时，小型驾驶舱里的机甲战士会有近乎超现实的体验，速度实在太快了。不过之后可千万别检查你的内裤……

column1: When th是'Mech goes at full speed the MechWarri或 在side that 小型驾驶舱 gets an almost surreal experience, the pace 是that fast. Just don't check your underwear afterwards...
column2: 当机甲全速行驶时，机甲战士或小型驾驶舱一侧获得近乎超现实的体验，速度就是那么快。事后不要检查内衣...

column1: When utilized in a more defensive role, the Incursion ICR-N5 was often found lacking. The upgraded ICR-N5-3 tried to address this by upgrading to double heat sinks and dropping the AMS and Remote Sensor Dispenser. This allowed adding a Medium Laser and a SRM-2 launcher. As a final touch three of the Small Lasers were exchanged for two Machine Guns to improve the heat profile. Quirk: Improved Sensors Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.1 Arm Actuator Limit: Left Lower
column2: Incursion ICR-N5 用于防御时往往表现不足。升级型 ICR-N5-3 试图解决这一问题，升级为双倍散热器，并拆除 AMS 和远程传感器投放器。腾出的空间可安装一门中型激光器和一具 SRM-2。最后，为改善热量表现，设计者拆除三门小型激光器，换成两挺机枪。 特性：改进型传感器 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂致动器限制：左下臂

column1: When utilized in a more defensive role, the Incursion ICR-N5 was often found lacking. The upgraded ICR-N5-3 tried to address this by upgrading to double heat sinks and dropping the AMS and Remote Sensor Dispenser. This allowed adding a 中型激光器 and a SRM-2 launcher. As a final touch three of the Small Lasers were exchanged for two Machine Guns to improve the heat profile. 特性：Improved Sensors 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂
column2: Incursion ICR-N5在承担更偏防御的任务时经常显得不足。升级型ICR-N5-3通过换装双重散热器并拆除AMS和远程传感器分配器来解决这一问题，腾出的空间用于增加一门中型激光器和一具SRM-2发射器。最后，它用两挺机枪替换三门小型激光器，以改善热量特性。 特性：改进型传感器 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

column1: When 卡隆工业 reintroduced the Penetrator, they switched to endo steel and reflective 装甲, allowing the arm weapons to be upgraded to snubnosed PPCs aimed with enhanced actuators. This 'Mech is now quite deadly for its weight.
column2: 卡隆工业重新推出穿透者时，换用了内骨骼和反射装甲，使双臂武器升级为短管PPC，并通过强化执行器进行瞄准。这台机甲以自身重量而言如今极其致命。

column1: While it has been noted that its MechWarriors have it customized for their purposes, this design's original weapons layout consisted of two Series 6b Extended Range Large Lasers and two Type OVR-V LB 2-X ACs mounted in its shortened arms actuators. In addition to these ranged weapons systems, engineers would go on to reinforce the Gyrfalcon's legs. This is a nod to their touman changing its attitude towards the use of physical attacks, namely using Death from Above maneuver.
column2: 虽然机甲战士常常会根据自身用途定制它的配置，但该设计最初的武器布局是两门 6b 系列增程大型激光，以及两门安装在缩短手臂驱动器上的 OVR-V 型 LB 2-X AC。除了这些远程武器，工程师还强化了 Gyrfalcon 的腿部。这体现了其 Touman 对物理攻击态度的转变，尤其是采用从天而降的死亡机动。

column1: While never a showstopper, the Merlin has been a solid, ubiquitous addition to every Periphery realm, and it remains popular in the mercenary market. It is as iconic in the Periphery as the Phoenix Hawk or Warhammer are in the Inner Sphere. With the debut of new upgrades, Mountain Wolf’s classic Merlin is receiving renewed attention.
column2: Merlin 虽然从未惊艳全场，却一直是各个边疆王国可靠而普遍的机甲，在佣兵市场也依然受欢迎。它在边疆的标志性地位，堪比 Phoenix Hawk 或 Warhammer 在内圈的地位。随着新升级型号问世，Mountain Wolf 的经典 Merlin 再度受到关注。

column1: While never a showstopper, the Merlin has been a solid, ubiquitous addition to every Periphery realm, and it remains popular in the mercenary market. It is as iconic in the Periphery as the 凤鹰 or Warhammer are in the Inner Sphere. With the debut of new upgrades, Mountain Wolf’s classic Merlin is receiving renewed attention.
column2: Merlin从未成为改变战局的机甲，却一直是每个边疆领域中坚实而普遍的存在，在雇佣兵市场也很受欢迎。它在边疆的标志性不亚于内圈的凤凰鹰或Warhammer。随着新升级型号问世，Mountain Wolf的经典Merlin重新受到关注。

column1: While often derided as a poor man's Rommel/Patton tank, the simply constructed and dependable Po Heavy Tank, named by Romano Liao for the mischievous and vengeful spirit of Chinese tradition, has become the principal combat vehicle on Capellan worlds lacking 'Mech units. Introduced in 3031, the Po is built around the rugged, dependable, and cheap Ceres 240 internal combustion engine, which gives the tank a maximum flank speed of 65 kph. Ten and half tons of armor provides respectable protection for a heavy tank. Along with its ease of maintenance and decent firepower, this protection has made the Po a popular choice among cash strapped mercenaries, lower ranked garrison units, the Free Worlds League and Word of Blake, with such export sales keeping much needed funds flowing into the Confederation's coffers. column1: While still Pretty much a Victor, it looks as if they tried to 'upgrade' the AC20, totally screwing up the entire balance and chassis. It has DOOMGUY written all over...

column1: While the Armament might look a bit Small, believe me that for a 65Ton Mech, its scary enough. 2 RAC5's 2 MRM10's make a good Dent in any mech, while the 2 Small Xpulses make sure no pesky Infantry come close to it. The Bloodhound and Clan Guardian ECM give it a Very nice Ewar Package, Combined with the reduced but still respectable Speed, its nothing to Laugh at Boss.
column2: 它的武器配置看上去可能有点少，但相信我，对于一台 65 吨机甲来说已经够吓人了。两门 RAC/5 和两具 MRM-10 足以给任何机甲造成重创，两门小型 X 脉冲激光器则能阻止讨厌的步兵靠近。再加上血猎犬与氏族守护者 ECM 系统组成的电子战套件，以及有所降低但仍相当可观的速度，这家伙一点都不好惹，老大。

column2: Galleon 是最常见的载具之一，但这个 Maxwell 版本来自极少见的实验性限量生产批次。它加强了武器配置，还配有几项稀有升级，例如保护履带的装甲传动系统。

column1: While the Titan II is effective at all ranges, it is still reminiscent of its antecedent's role as a brawler. Its main long-range fire comes from a Blankenburg Divine Wrath Heavy PPC. This is supplemented by a pair of Helga MML-9s, though they are more effective up close. In addition to those missiles, when it closes with an enemy, the Titan II can cut loose with a ZT Triple Fire Streak SRM-6, four Diplan M3-XR ER Medium Lasers and a single Kressly Premiere Optics ER Small Laser. Eighteen double heat sinks are usually up to the task of keeping the 'Mech cool.
column2: Titan II 在各种射程都能有效作战，但仍保留前身作为近战斗士的特点。它的主要远程火力来自一门布兰肯堡“神圣之怒”重型 PPC，并由一对 Helga MML-9 提供补充，后者在近距离更有效。接近敌人后，Titan II 还能使用 ZT 三连发 Streak SRM-6、四门 Diplan M3-XR 增程中型激光器和一门 Kressly Premiere Optics 增程小型激光器全力开火。通常，18 具双重散热器足以让机甲保持冷却。

column1: While this isn't as stealthy as other Exterminators we've seen, this thing is still far faster than it has any right to be.
column2: 这家伙没我们见过的其他圣剑机甲那么擅长隐形，但它的速度快得实在不讲道理。

column1: While this isn't as stealthy as other 灭绝者s we've seen, this thing is still far faster than it has any right to be.
column2: 虽然它不像我们见过的其他灭绝者那样隐秘，但这东西的速度依然快得离谱。

column1: While this thing doesn't have the tube count of other Stalkers, I wouldn't discredit the punch those larger missiles dish out.
column2: 虽然这东西的发射管数量不如其他“潜行者”，但那些大型导弹的打击力绝不能小看。

column1: Whoa! Hold on a second, Boss! You gotta be crazy if you think I'm going to work on something that's making the geiger counters go this nuts! ... Huh. Hazard pay? Hey, Sumire! Where's my hazmat suit?
column2: 哇！等一下，Boss！如果你觉得我会去修理一台让盖革计数器疯狂报警的东西，那你一定疯了！……什么？有危险津贴？嘿，Sumire！我的防护服在哪？

column1: Whoever came up with this thing was crazy. Heavy PPC on a light mech, XL internal combustion engine, and trying to push an ICE mech into a speedster by replacing the entire leg assemblies. Oh, and be careful with that PPC. If you fired it from a normal light mech, it'd practically fry you alive thanks to the backwash from the heat.
column2: 设计这东西的人肯定疯了。轻型机甲上装重型 PPC，使用 XL 内燃机，还想通过更换整套腿部组件，把 ICE 机甲改成高速单位。还有，千万小心那门 PPC。要是从普通轻型机甲上开火，热量反冲几乎能把你活活烤熟。

column1: Whoever got this refit done loved their Shadow Hawk, Boss. This ain't the type of gear you commission for just your regular rank and file. Hell, some of this stuff would've been a nightmare to get if you weren't Star League. Our original owner here was well-connected, that's for sure.
column2: 这次改装的人显然非常喜欢 Shadow Hawk，Boss。这可不是普通士兵能申请到的装备。有些东西要不是在星盟时期，弄到手简直是噩梦。原主人肯定人脉很广。

column1: Why? Just... why?? Sure, you can shoot 40 SRM missiles in one volley, but then what? Only carrying two ER Large Lasers besides the one-shots makes the use of this configuration quite low on a proper battlefield.
column2: 为什么？就……为什么？？当然，你可以一轮齐射 40 枚 SRM 导弹，但然后呢？除了那些一次性武器外只携带两门增程大型激光，使这种配置在真正的战场上用途极低。

column1: With 'Mechs having begun their rule of the open battlefields the Gallant was intended as a niche product for the specific role of urban warfare and infantry support. Developed by Freeport Armorworks on Helm (production was later taken over by Kallon Industries on Loyalty) the design was nearly killed by budget issues which forced downgrades to the planned fusion power plant and other modern features, though eventually it was equipped at least with CASE. To fulfill its urban combat role the vehicle featured a low, very heavily armored chassis with self-inflating tires, a necessity to keep the heavy six-wheeler mobile under fire. A Light Active Probe helps locate hidden enemies, and 90 meters of jump capability allows it to strike from unexpected angles. Once it’s in position, a Class 30 Hyper Assault Gauss Rifle, an ER PPC, and an Improved Heavy Medium Laser combine to deliver devastating blows. Quirk: Stable Weapons Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.12 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Haider 的 C 配置转为猎杀平台。轻型主动探测器帮助发现隐藏敌人，90 米跳跃能力让它能从意想不到的角度发动攻击。就位后，一门 30 级 Hyper Assault Gauss Rifle、一门增程 PPC 和一门改进型重型中型激光可联合打出毁灭性火力。 特质：稳定武器 部署费用倍率：1.12 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 许可使用。

column1: With only a pair of Thunderbolt-5 launchers and a retractable blade for weapons, “Aladdin” isn’t a flashy fighter. Its Angel ECM and stealth armor give it the ability to hide in built up terrain, and thus surprise strikes are its best hope
column2: “Aladdin”只有两具 Thunderbolt-5 发射器和一把伸缩刀作为武器，算不上华丽的战士。它的 Angel ECM 和隐形装甲让它能藏在建筑密集地形中，因此突袭是它最好的希望。

column1: With the -8R 卡隆工业 returned to the roots of the Crusader, once again going for long-range firepower instead of the MMLs used in other recent variants. Due to using 轻型铁纤维装甲-Fibrous 装甲 and both an XL引擎 core and XL gyro the -8R allows the mounting of two LRM-15 launchers, two 锁定式SRM-6 and twin Machine Guns, and still have enough weight capacity left to increase the total amount of 装甲 to 12 tons. 怪癖: 稳定 Weapons 掉落成本乘数: 1.09

column1: With the B configuration the Sojourner gets more of a support role, carrying an ECM suite and 2 ER Large Pulse lasers combined with a single Streak SRM-6. Four Jump Jets together with a Supercharger ensures the mobility of the configuration.
column2: 采用 B 配置后，Sojourner 更偏向支援角色，配备一套 ECM、一具 Streak SRM-6，以及两门增程大型脉冲激光器。四具跳跃喷射器配合增压器，确保该配置具备良好机动性。

column1: With the B configuration the Sojourner gets more of a support role, carrying an ECM suite and 2 ER Large Pulse lasers combined with a single 锁定式SRM-6. Four Jump Jets together with a Supercharger ensures the mobility of the configuration.
column2: B 型配置让 Sojourner 更偏向支援角色，携带 ECM 套件、两门增程大型脉冲激光器和一具改进型 SRM-6。四具跳跃喷射器与增压器确保了该配置的机动性。

column1: With the STR-7 variant being designed for space operations, its full weaponry is energy based as to work efficiently in a vacuum environment, and the leg actuators have been reinforced to handle higher loads. The variant mounts a 大型脉冲激光 on each Arm, a ER Larger Laser in each torso location and a 小型脉冲激光 in the Head. 14 external 双散热器 allows the STR-7 to operate its weapons and three Jump Jets inside an atmosphere.
column2: STR-7为太空作战设计，全部武器采用能量系统，以便在真空环境高效运行；腿部驱动器也经过强化以承受更高负荷。该变型每条手臂安装一门大型脉冲激光，双侧躯干各有一门ER大型激光器，头部安装一门小型脉冲激光器。14组外置双重散热器让STR-7能够在大气中运行武器和三具跳跃喷射器。

column1: With the bad reputation the Sarath had obtained, the Free Worlds League approved the creation of a 140 ton superheavy version in an attempt to regain some of the design lines reputation. The task of designing it was once again given to Ronin Inc, and the result was the Narayana Omni QuadMech. Its main focus are on indirect fire support with a 425 XL engine to ensure the QuadMech is mobile enough to reposition without too much delay. Eventually a deal was struck with House Steiner to also provide them with a number of Narayana, making that the only other faction to field any of the 'Mechs.
column2: 由于Sarath声名狼藉，自由世界联盟批准制造一款140吨超重型版本，试图挽回这一设计系列的声誉。设计任务再次交给Ronin公司，产物便是Narayana Omni四足机甲。它主要专注于间接火力支援，配备425级XL引擎，确保四足机甲能及时重新部署。最终，联盟与Steiner家族达成协议，向其提供若干Narayana，使后者成为唯一拥有这款机甲的其他派系。

column1: With the bad reputation the Sarath had obtained, the Free wolds League approved the creation of a 140 ton superheavy version in an attempt to regain some of the design lines reputation. The task of designing it was once again given to Ronin Inc, and the result was the Narayana Omni QuadMech. Its main focus are on indirect fire support with a 425 XL engine to ensure the QuadMech is mobile enough to reposition without too much delay.
column2: 由于“萨拉特”号的声誉不佳，自由世界联盟批准了建造 140 吨超重型版本，试图重新获得一些设计线的声誉。设计任务再次交给Ronin Inc，其成果就是Narayana Omni QuadMech。其主要重点是使用 425 XL 发动机进行间接火力支援，以确保 QuadMech 具有足够的移动性，可以在没有太多延迟的情况下重新定位。

column1: With the destruction of many BattleMech factories in the Jihad, the Mjolnir was designed for the Lyran Commonwealth's export market. By selling the Mjolnir to any interested party, the Lyrans would gain much needed capital to rebuild their factories and restore their industrial might. To maximize profits, the designers focused on using existing successful 'Mech parts and components. Drawing from the Commando and Wolfhound designs, the Mjolnir entered production at Arc-Royal only a few months after being designed.
column2: 圣战摧毁了许多 BattleMech 工厂后，Mjolnir 被设计用于莱拉联邦的出口市场。莱拉人将 Mjolnir 卖给所有有兴趣的买家，以获得急需的资金，重建工厂并恢复工业实力。为最大化利润，设计师集中使用现有的成功机甲零件和组件。Mjolnir 参考 Commando 和 Wolfhound 的设计，设计完成数月后便在 Arc-Royal 投入生产。

column1: With this 'Mech somebody has taken an old Zeus model and upgraded everything in it with clan tech. I'm not sure why someone would take the time to do this over starting with a clan 'Mech, but I am sure glad they did!

column1: Wooo Eeee Boss, this is one speedy mech for a 70 ton Heavy! SaKhan Burt O'Nias told me that LAST RITES is his very own modified Minsk 102. This mech was made specifically for him as his personal battlemech and is built to his personal combat style, which means no lasers. Ghost Bear Dominion engineers were instructed to remove the Active Probe and upgrade the engine to a Clan XL. The core was increased for more power to a 270 and boosts speed further with the addtion of a Supercharger. Weapon loadouts include Twin Gauss Rifles (C), 5x AP Gauss Rifles, and a pair of SRM6 (C) launchers.
column2: 哇哦，老大，这台 70 吨重型机甲可真够快！伯特·奥尼亚斯副可汗告诉我，LAST RITES 是他亲自改装的 Minsk 102。这台机甲专为他打造，是他的私人座驾，完全按照他的战斗风格配置——所以没有激光器。幽灵熊领地的工程师奉命拆除主动探测器，并升级为氏族 XL 引擎。核心引擎提升到 270 级，配合增压器进一步提高速度。武器配置包括两门氏族高斯步枪、五门 AP 高斯步枪和两具氏族 SRM-6 发射器。

column1: Yes, this is a fast mech for what is nearly a heavy. No, it's not worth it, unless you're hunting light mechs or VTOLs, it's just too undergunned otherwise. It only has two large lasers, except, you don't even have that, because the beam focusers are cracked, so they spread beams all over the place and don't do that nice pinpoint damage.
column2: 是的，对于近乎重型的东西来说，这是一个快速的机械。不，这不值得，除非你正在寻找轻型机甲或垂直起降飞机，否则它的武器装备太不足了。它只有两个大型激光器，但你甚至没有，因为光束聚焦器破裂了，所以它们将光束散布到各处，并且不会造成那么好的精确损坏。

column1: 与许多 Solaris VII 竞技场机甲一样，斯帕达是为近战格斗设计的，但它依靠技巧而非蛮力取胜。手工调校的 360 级 XXL 引擎大幅减重，却牺牲了耐久性；凭借 11 吨先进反射装甲和激光反导系统，斯帕达只需担心自动加农炮或高斯步枪击中其脆弱的引擎。激光反导系统还能抵消敌方能量武器与导弹的威胁。它的 13 台双重散热器几乎无法冷却先进动力装置和能量武器，这其实是有意为之：斯帕达装备三倍强度肌肉组织，可提高速度并显著增强剑刃的威力。

column1: 塞雷斯金属 put this together as a joint project between the Confederation and the Magistracy, and honestly it shows. 加固结构 under all that 铁纤维装甲 plating means this thing shrugs off punishment that would wreck most other heavies. It is slow, but it does not need to be fast when everything shooting back at it is having such a hard time actually hurting it. Good machine to have on your side in a grinding fight.
column2: 塞雷斯金属将它作为联邦与治安官辖区的联合项目制造出来，成品确实体现了双方风格。铁纤维装甲下的加固结构能够承受足以摧毁多数其他重型机甲的打击。它速度缓慢，但当敌人的火力很难真正伤害它时，也就无需追求速度。在消耗战中，这是值得拥有的可靠机器。

column1: 增强成像, Special Sensors and very nice Optics make this Glass Spider a Real Danger to anything it sees. The XL Engine makes room for the Two UAC2's and Two UAC5's, complemented by the Lone Medium Heavy Laser. An 主动探头 and a 守护者ECM give this enough Ewar to make it look Sensible too, while the Laser AMS give it good Coverage. All in all, a Very nice, purpose Built Mech Boss, even if albeit a bit on the Slower Side of things.
column2: 增强成像、特殊传感器和非常好的光学器件使这款玻璃蜘蛛对其看到的任何东西都构成真正的危险。 XL 发动机为两个 UAC2 和两个 UAC5 腾出了空间，并辅以单独的中型重型激光器。一个激发探测器和一个守护者 ECM 给了它足够的 Ewar，使其看起来也很敏感，而激光 AMS 则给了它很好的覆盖范围。总而言之，这是一个非常好的、有目的的机甲 Boss，尽管速度有点慢。

column1: 幽灵标志着柯蒂斯军工进军战斗机甲生产。该设计公布时，许多人觉得它不过是个会走路的水冷器。批评者们得到的是震惊。幽灵是一台只要运用得当，就能以惊人的速度与机动性在敌阵中大闹的机甲。它围绕一台巨大的LTV 385 XL引擎建造，使其速度可达略低于119公里/小时。幽灵拥有一套简单却有效的脉冲武器载荷。脉冲激光武器让该机甲能抵消其大量使用跳跃推进器对精度造成的大部分副作用，使这台轻武装机甲拥有令人难以置信的精度与威力。A modification of the Wraith made by the 布雷克圣言会, the TR3 replaces the two 中型脉冲激光s with two ER 中型激光s while one of the jump jets is removed to make room for an improved C3 computer, making the Wraith an incredibly powerful point 'Mech for units equipped with C3i equipment.

column1: 恩菲尔德最初旨在取代双足飞龙成为城市战斗机甲，但从未进入量产。其图纸在继承战争中遗失，2870 年由联邦太阳系在阿克尔纳星上寻回。该设计的知识一直被保密到 3050 年代，NAIS 选定恩菲尔德作为执法者的搭档机甲。恩菲尔德于 3055 年开始生产，因氏族的持续威胁而在莱兰联盟大量部署。机甲携带十一吨星卫 III 装甲并配 C.A.S.E. 以防弹药爆炸。恩菲尔德建立在黑石 MD2E 内骨骼底盘上，使用玛格纳 250 XL 引擎，最高速度 86.4 公里/小时，以节省重量从而搭载重型武器库。然而由于使用超轻型引擎，它在激烈战斗中落下了"脆弱"的冤枉名声。 Quirk: 增强躯干转向 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limits: Left Lower, Right Lower
column2: 恩菲尔德在继承了双联中型激光的基础上，成为一款重型战斗机甲。其设计图纸在继承战争期间失传，直到 2870 年才在太阳系边缘的一处废弃殖民地被发现。相关知识一直保密，直至 3050 年，NAIS 选定恩菲尔德作为执行任务的搭档机甲。恩菲尔德于 3055 年开始生产，旨在应对长期冲突中日益加剧的装甲威胁，并配备 11 吨 Ferro-Fibrous 装甲及 CASE，以防止弹药殉爆。它在哈德森 MD2E 底盘上安装 250 级 XL 引擎，最高速度达到 86.4 公里/小时。尽管跳跃喷射器会带来额外散热负担，但它仍能在混战中保持灵活。 特性：增强型躯干扭转 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂执行器限制：左下臂、右下臂

In addition to the 铁纤维装甲, an ECM Suite in the head disrupts enemy electronics.

column2: 死神是康星设计的通用机甲。这台定制机甲由康卫圣职者 Einar Halldórsson 开发，重点提升生存能力并使用氏族科技武器。

column1: 氏族钻石鲨 built this at the turn of the 32nd century and the 引擎 alone takes up 40% of the total mass. Most of the ones produced ended up with wealthy private buyers using them for illegal street racing in the Periphery rather than actual military service. A former pirate named Ryan Reynolds bought one, won a bunch of races, then hit a canyon wall at nearly 400 kph on Tincalunas in 3142. Finding one of these intact and operational is almost unbelievable.
column2: 这台机体由钻石鲨氏族在32世纪初制造，单是引擎就占总质量的40%。大多数成品最终被富有的私人买家购得，用于边疆的非法街头竞速，而非真正服役。一名叫Ryan Reynolds的前海盗买下一台，赢得多场比赛，随后于3142年在Tincalunas以接近400 kph的速度撞上峡谷壁。能找到一台完整且仍可运行的机体，几乎不可思议。

column1: 渡鸦是一款轻型电子战战斗机甲，在第三次继承战争结束后首次亮相时，它不仅是数个世纪以来首批真正原创的机甲设计之一，更代表了人类拒绝在技术上倒退的决心。This variant of the 4L allows the Raven to integrate with a C3 network by removing the 4L's active probe. It is replaced by a C3 Slave Unit and an ER Small Laser.
column2: 渡鸦是一款轻型电子战战斗机甲。在第三次继承战争结束后首次亮相时，它不仅是数个世纪以来首批真正原创的机甲设计之一，也代表了人类拒绝在技术上倒退的决心。这一 4L 分型拆除了主动探测器，使渡鸦能够接入 C3 网络；原位置改装为 C3 从属设备和一门增程小型激光。

column1: 渡鸦是一款轻型电子战战斗机甲，在第三次继承战争结束后首次亮相时，它不仅是数个世纪以来首批真正原创的机甲设计之一，更代表了人类拒绝在技术上倒退的决心。This variant removes the Narc and SRM of the standard 4L, replacing them with an MML-7 equipped with Artemis IV guidance. The Capellans added a third medium laser, making this variant of the Raven an effective scout hunter. It can set easy ambushes because its 隐身装甲 gives it an advantage against scouts.
column2: 渡鸦是轻型电子战战斗机甲，在第三次继承战争结束后首次亮相时，不仅是数百年来首批真正原创的机甲设计之一，也体现了人类拒绝技术倒退的决心。该变体移除标准4L型的NARC和SRM，换成配备阿尔忒弥斯IV制导的MML-7。卡佩兰人增加第三门中型激光，使其成为高效的侦察猎手；隐身装甲让它能轻松设置伏击并克制侦察单位。

column1: 灰熊是鬼熊氏族科学家在三十世纪开发的战斗机甲。遗憾的是，该设计在任何方面都不出众，因此从未在氏族的图曼中占据一席之地。Thirteen tons of armor are mounted on an Endo Steel frame. Jump jets are mounted so that the Grizzly can leap up to 120 meters at a time. Aside from the 'jack of all trades, master of none' moniker, the Grizzly is also poorly engineered. Slagged armor tends to get stuck in joints and weapons, while the actuators are difficult to repair in their own right.
column2: 格里兹利是一台 20 世纪末设计的战斗机甲，几乎各方面都能应付，因此长期占据一席之地。它在内骨骼框架上安装 13 吨装甲，并配备跳跃喷射器，可一次跳跃 120 米。除了“样样通、样样松”的称号外，它还存在工程缺陷：剥落的装甲容易卡入关节和武器，执行器本身也难以维修。

column1: 玉鹰氏族's version of the Jade Hawk is purely Clan-spec and lacks the advanced myomers and claws of the DOA JHK-03 model, carrying four 锁定式SRM-6 launchers instead of the standard models and mounting a 轻型 主动探头 in its head. Four tons of ammo give the design excellent endurance despite the large number of launchers, while the addition of Ferro-Fibrous plating increases its protection.
column2: Jade Hawk 的这一版本完全采用氏族规格，不具备 DOA JHK-03 型的先进肌肉束和爪。它以四具改进型 SRM-6 取代标准型号，并在头部安装主动探测器。四吨弹药为大量发射器提供出色续航，铁纤维装甲也提升了防护。

column1: 由于它是"伟大之父"选用的战斗机甲，古老的猎户座在氏族的神秘传统中始终占有特殊地位。出于对克伦斯基将军遗产的尊重，所有氏族都维持该设计数十年，即便更新更先进技术的发展日益令它在战场上失去效力。猎户座 IIC 并非像某些氏族升级那样彻底重做，而是更换了原版的大部分内部结构与武器，同时保留其质量与外观。此次 IIC 升级采用内骨骼底盘和十二吨铁纤维装甲，并使用十二台双倍散热器，腾出重量以搭载更重的武器。This variant switches the Gauss Rifle to an 超级自动炮/10 and downgrading the LRM-20 rack into an LRM-15.

column1: 皇帝是最早的突击战斗机甲之一，可追溯至 2502 年。它还享有另一项殊荣：首款装备跳跃推进器的 90 吨以上战斗机甲（著名的高地人于 2592 年开始生产）。In 2612, StarCorps introduced an upgraded Emperor, EMP-6A designed for and distributed exclusively to 星际联盟防卫军s Royal Units. The Emperor was produced continuously until Marik forces destroyed 星团工业 facility with nuclear arms on Son Hoa during the Second Succession War. Production of the Emperor resumed in 3057 alongside the legendary Highlander.

column1: 设计 and 生产 for the Magistracy of Canopus; as part of an upgrade of mothballed Succession Wars era 机甲s, the KGC-0010M takes the already fearsome King Crab and upgrades it with new weapons and 2.5 tons of extra 装甲. column1: 这是一种在雇佣兵部队中很常见的简单改装；UM-R60LRM，即 LRMbie，旨在提供廉价火力支援。它以 LRM-20 和 2 吨弹药替换 AC/20，并为机甲增加两门中型激光以提升中距离效率。LRMbie 比昂贵的 AC 型号更便宜、更易维护，正逐渐受到飞行员欢迎。LRM 更远的射程与较慢的地面速度相得益彰，甚至有人认为它提高了机甲在战斗中的生存率。随着 Helm 核心技术日益普及，许多所有者计划让 LRM 使用射程更远的特种弹药，打造一台能以低廉成本执行从布雷到间接火力支援各种任务的有效支援机甲。已知多家制造商获得了样机，并热衷于试验这一设计。 特质： 360° Torso Twist 部署费用倍率： 0.97 手臂驱动器限制： Left Upper, Right Upper

column1: 随着赫尔姆核心失落科技的重现，陶里安防卫军发现自己落后于邻国。正如战争时代一样，陶里安人转向了本土成长的塔洛斯。这款机甲以易于维护和易于制造著称，正是陶里安防卫军所需。由于缺乏资源将新设计的塔洛斯转为可行的量产型号，陶里安人以加入正在进行的"三位一体同盟"谈判为交换，寻求邻国援助。在卡佩兰工程师的专业知识与卡诺普斯女权国的资金投入协助下，范登堡于 3059 年末在其新范登堡工厂开始了塔洛斯的限量生产。3062 年三位一体同盟正式签署，授予陛下金属公司与底特律联合机工厂生产许可。两家公司迅速开设了自己的生产线，为自用与远销生产了塔洛斯的多种变体。 Quirk: 易于驾驶 Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.04 Arm Actuator Limit: Right Lower
column2: 塔罗斯源自一项失败的项目：卡佩兰邦联希望在内战期间将一款设计转化为战斗机甲，但最终只完成了原型。由于资源不足，该项目随后被改造成试验平台。经过卡佩兰工程师多年改进，并与坎诺普斯女公爵领谈判寻求援助后，双方于 3059 年末达成协议。原型最终于 3062 年正式签署协议并投入生产。塔罗斯随后迅速发展成多种型号，为远程火力任务提供了坚实平台。 特性：易于驾驶 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂执行器限制：右下臂
